patterns.context: When introducing research questions, the modal verb will co-occurs with subsequent answer/question wording; activation is strong here but this usage does not appear in similar passages, so it may be a secondary pattern.

5_427.description: 强烈响应NIH研究计划中目标、问题或任务清单的首项编号，尤其数字1紧接右括号或句点；常由冒号及aims、objectives、will等引出。少数伴随列表引导语中的will。

patterns.name: 编号1后接右括号
patterns.context: 科研提案或目标清单中，编号“1)”的数字与右括号被强烈激活；数字前的冒号或介绍句并非必要条件。

patterns.name: 编号1后接句点
patterns.context: 科研目标列表以“1.”起头时，编号数字和句点激活；附近常有“aims”“will”等目标清单引导语。

patterns.name: 括号包围的编号
patterns.context: 目标条目采用“(1)”格式时，左右括号和数字均激活，数字及右括号强度略低于冒号式清单中的编号。

patterns.name: 冒号后列举第一项
patterns.context: 在“questions”“Specific Aims”“will:”等引出列表的表达之后，冒号紧接编号“1)”；触发核心仍是列表编号格式。

patterns.name: 冒号后列举第一项（句点格式）
patterns.context: 研究目的或 aims 的引导语以冒号收尾，后接“1.”及条目正文。

patterns.name: 清单引导语中的 will
patterns.context: 介绍研究问题时，情态动词 will 与后续 answer/question 表达共同出现；此处激活较强，但不见于其他段的同类用法，可能是次要模式。

en.description: Responds to statements in NIH research abstracts that introduce a research plan and list objectives or questions; activation often falls on aims, objectives, questions, are, the colon, and subsequent numbering, with varied research topics.

patterns.name: Research plan/proposal framework
patterns.context: When introducing research objectives, specific aims, or research questions in an NIH research abstract, an objective statement often leads into a numbered list; activation is especially concentrated on objective terms and the punctuation, numbering, and parentheses that follow

5_427.description: 对 NIH 研究摘要中提出研究计划并列出目标或问题的语句反应；激活常落在 aims、objectives、questions、are、冒号及随后编号上，具体研究主题各异。

patterns.name: 研究计划/提案框架
patterns.trigger: “proposal”“research”“study”与“objectives”“aims”“questions”相邻或在同一分句中；如 “this proposal asks four questions”“objectives of this research proposal”“specific aims are to”
patterns.context: NIH 研究摘要中介绍研究目标、具体目标或研究问题时，常由目标陈述引出编号列表；激活尤集中在目标词及其后的标点、编号和括号
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究资助摘要

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to templates in NIH research abstracts that introduce specific objectives or research questions: aims/objectives/goals near are/to, a colon, and a numbered list; it also responds to action verbs or question-form objectives at the beginning of objective items.

patterns.name: Research-objective statement framework
patterns.context: Sentence pattern introducing research objectives, specific aims, or research questions in NIH research abstracts; common forms include “specific aims of this proposal/study are to:” or similar structures, followed by numbered objectives.
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical and public health grant applications

patterns.name: Numbering and punctuation in objective lists
patterns.context: A colon appears after the objective-introducing phrase, followed by a parenthesized number, digit, or period opening an objective; markers are distributed across adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Formatting in NIH project abstract lists

patterns.name: Action verbs after listing objectives
patterns.context: A verb at the beginning of an objective-list item or after an objective-introducing phrase describes the proposed research; capitalization and specific verbs vary.

patterns.name: Posing a research question
patterns.context: A research plan states its objective as a specific question rather than simply an action verb, then directly presents the question content.

5_427.description: 神经元主要响应 NIH 研究摘要中引出具体目标或研究问题的模板：aims/objectives/goals 与 are/to、冒号及编号列表相邻；也响应目标条目开头的动作动词或问题式目标。

patterns.name: 研究目标陈述框架
patterns.trigger: «objectives»、«research»、«are»、«aims»、«to»；以及 «goals»、«proposal»、«study» 后接 «are» 和目标内容
patterns.context: NIH 研究摘要中提出研究目标、具体目标或研究问题的句式；常见“specific aims of this proposal/study are to:”或相近结构，后接编号目标。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学及公共卫生科研申请

patterns.name: 目标列表的编号与标点
patterns.context: 目标引导语后出现冒号，随后以括号编号、数字或句点开启一项目标；标记在相邻 token 间分布。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要的格式化列表

patterns.name: 列出目标后的动作动词
patterns.context: 位于目标列表条目开头或目标引导语之后，以动词说明拟开展的研究工作；大小写和具体动词各异。
patterns.domain: 科研计划与项目目标写作

patterns.name: 提出研究问题
patterns.context: 研究计划以具体问题而非单纯动作动词来表述目标，随后直接提出问题内容。

en.description: Strongly responds to stock phrases introducing research objectives in NIH grant abstracts (Specific Aims, objectives, goals, aims are to), and the following colon, number, or lettered-list marker; surrounding purpose and planning terms activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Specific Aims/objectives paragraph lead-in
patterns.context: In NIH research plans, projects, or conference grant abstracts, introduces research objectives and often uses a colon to introduce numbered objectives; activation is concentrated on aims, are, the colon, and nearby numbers and parentheses.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter grant application abstracts, formal scientific prose

patterns.name: Introducing research objectives with objectives
patterns.context: A proposal or research plan states objectives, purposes, or questions to be addressed, often followed by are, a colon, or a list structure.

patterns.name: Objective list markers
patterns.context: A list-opening marker follows the objective lead-in; numbers, parentheses, periods, or letter markers themselves activate strongly, while list-item text may activate more weakly.
patterns.domain: Numbered or lettered item format in formal proposals

patterns.name: Local activation on purpose/planning function words
patterns.context: Occurs near research objectives, planned work, or an objectives list; these words are not consistently strongly activating by themselves and appear more like local accompanying features of objective statements.
patterns.domain: Purpose and future-action language in research plan abstracts

5_427.concept: 资助申请目标列表格式
5_427.description: 强烈响应 NIH 资助摘要中引出研究目标的套语（Specific Aims、objectives、goals、aims are to），以及其后的冒号、编号或字母列表标记；周围目的和计划用语也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Specific Aims/目标段落引出语
patterns.trigger: “Specific Aims”“specific aims”“specific aims of this study are to:”及“aims … will be:”
patterns.context: NIH 研究计划、项目或会议资助摘要中，介绍研究目标并常以冒号引出编号目标；激活集中在 aims、are、冒号及其附近编号和括号。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 资助申请摘要，正式科研文体

patterns.name: objectives 引出研究目标
patterns.trigger: “research proposal objectives”“objectives of this proposed research are:”“proposal addresses three fundamental issues”“overall goals of this proposal are”
patterns.context: 提案或研究计划说明目标、目的或待解决问题，常由 are、冒号或列举结构承接。
patterns.domain: NIH 科研资助申请摘要

patterns.name: 目标列表标记
patterns.context: 目标引导语后出现列表起始标记；数字、括号、句点或字母标记本身有强激活，列表项正文也可能有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 正式提案的编号或字母分项格式

patterns.name: 目的/计划类功能词局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在研究目标、拟开展工作或目标列表附近；这些词本身并非处处强激活，较像目标陈述格式中的局部伴随特征。
patterns.domain: 科研计划摘要中的目的与未来行动表述

en.concept: Introducing research objectives and subitem lists
en.description: Strongly responds to wording that introduces project objectives, specific aims, or objectives in NIH research abstracts and their list formatting; also responds to subsequent numbering and verbs describing research tasks.

patterns.name: Introduction to research objectives/specific aims
patterns.context: An NIH research abstract outlines project objectives, usually followed by a numbered list (e.g., «1»«)» or «1»«.»); sometimes it lists specific aims, and sometimes overall goals or major objectives.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter research grant application abstracts, spanning biomedical science, neuroscience, behavioral science, and engineering

patterns.name: Objective-list punctuation and numbering
patterns.context: After the introductory phrase for objectives or research questions, items are listed; the neuron also activates strongly on the list markers themselves.
patterns.domain: Structured writing format of research plans

patterns.name: Purpose-oriented wording in research plans
patterns.context: Discusses the proposed research, project, or research objectives; these words often co-occur with the objective-introduction structure, but the same combination does not appear in every passage.
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts and research plans

patterns.name: Verbs describing research objective content
patterns.context: After the objective-introducing phrase or numbered list, an infinitive, imperative verb, or nominalized research activity explains what will be done; trigger words vary by passage.

5_427.concept: 科研目标与分项列表引导
5_427.description: 对 NIH 研究摘要中引出项目目标、specific aims 或 objectives 的措辞及其列表格式强烈响应；也响应其后的编号和描述研究任务的动词。

patterns.name: 研究目标/具体 aims 的引入
patterns.trigger: «aims»、«objectives»、«goals»，以及 «are»/«include»/«will be» 后引出目标列表的结构，如 «are»:、«include»:、«will be»:
patterns.context: NIH 研究摘要中概述项目目标，通常紧接编号列表（如 «1»«)» 或 «1»«.»），有时列出 specific aims，有时为 overall goals 或 major objectives。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 科研资助申请摘要，涵盖生物医学、神经科学、行为与工程等领域

patterns.name: 目标列表标点与编号
patterns.context: 目标或研究问题的引导语结束后，开始分项列举；神经元也对列表标记本身有强激活。
patterns.domain: 科研计划书的结构化写作格式

patterns.name: 研究计划的目的性措辞
patterns.context: 围绕拟开展的研究、项目或研究目标展开；这些词常与目标引入结构共同出现，但并非每段都出现同一组合。
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要与研究计划书

patterns.name: 说明研究目标内容的动词
patterns.context: 目标引导语或编号列表之后，以不定式、祈使式动词或名词化研究活动说明具体要做什么；触发词因段而异。

en.description: All passages are NIH research abstracts; the neuron responds strongly to expressions introducing research objectives, specific aims, or questions, especially structures in which an objective noun is followed by are/to, a colon, and a numbered list, with variable numbering punctuation.

patterns.name: Research objective/purpose lead-in
patterns.context: Sentence forms introducing specific objectives, research purposes, or questions to be addressed in NIH research abstracts; commonly occur after aims/objectives/goals/proposal/study/questions, followed by a colon and numbered items.
patterns.domain: NIH grant application abstracts spanning biomedical, clinical, behavioral, and cognitive research

patterns.name: Numbered format for objectives lists
patterns.context: A colon and number begin a list after the objective lead-in; numbering punctuation varies, including parentheses and periods.
patterns.domain: Structured lists in research application abstracts

patterns.name: Introducing research questions
patterns.context: Introduces specific research questions or objectives by stating that a proposal asks questions.

patterns.name: Variations in objective wording
patterns.context: Nouns denoting research purposes or objectives, often paired with this study/proposal/research or specific; activation is not limited to one fixed word but centers on the position introducing an objectives list.

5_427.description: 所有片段均为 NIH 研究摘要；神经元强烈响应引出研究目标/具体 aims 或问题的表达，尤其是目标名词后接 are/to、冒号及编号列表的结构，编号标点可变。

patterns.name: 科研目标/目的引导语
patterns.trigger: «are»7«:»10«、«aims»4« of this« study»2« are»7« to»7«:»10«、«goals»3« of this« proposal»3« are»7
patterns.context: NIH 研究摘要中引出具体目标、研究目的或待解决问题的句式；常见于 aims/objectives/goals/proposal/study/questions 后，随后接冒号和编号
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请摘要，涵盖生物医学、临床、行为及认知研究

patterns.name: 目标列表编号格式
patterns.context: 目标引导语之后以冒号和数字编号开始列表；括号、句点等编号标点形式有所不同
patterns.domain: 科研申请摘要的结构化列表

patterns.name: 提出研究问题
patterns.trigger: «proposal»4« asks»6« four»2« questions»4 which« are»2« our»1« specific»1« aims»4
patterns.context: 以 proposal asks questions 的方式引出后续具体研究问题或目标

patterns.name: 目标措辞本身的变体
patterns.context: 作为研究目的、目标的名词，常与 this study/proposal/research 或 specific 搭配；激活不限于单一固定词，而集中在目标列表的引出位置

en.concept: Local lexical features of “regularly” and philosophical terms
en.description: The main pattern is “regularly”: it strongly activates on this word whether it modifies volunteering, scheduling, use, drinking, or behavior. The second passage instead activates near philosophical terms and citation numbers, forming a distinct, rare pattern.

patterns.name: Frequency use of “regularly”
patterns.context: The adverb modifies a verb, participle, or state to indicate something happens periodically, frequently, or repeatedly; nearby words to its left vary considerably across passages.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, news, papers, emails, and forum text

patterns.name: Philosophical terms and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation occurs near philosophical terms concerning uncertainty, ontology, or vague identity, or near citation numbers; this is not the “regularly” pattern.

5_456.concept: regularly 与哲学术语的局部词汇特征
5_456.description: 主要模式是 regularly：无论修饰志愿服务、排班、使用、饮水或行为，均在该词上强激活。第2段则在哲学术语及引文编号附近激活，属于独立的少见模式。

patterns.name: regularly 的频率用法
patterns.context: 该副词修饰动词、分词或状态，表示定期、经常或反复发生；其左侧邻近词在各段差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、新闻、论文、邮件及论坛文本

patterns.name: 哲学术语与专名
patterns.context: 激活落在关于不确定性、存在论、模糊同一性的哲学术语或引文编号附近；并非 regularly 模式。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the word form “regularly,” spanning publications, volunteering, dialysis, website use, meetings, animal drinking, bodily elimination, work habits, and critical commentary. There is also sporadic activation in a philosophical terminology list, which is difficult to integrate into the main pattern.

patterns.name: Lexical activation of regularly
patterns.context: The word itself is marked by strong activation; the sentence concerns something happening periodically, being scheduled regularly, or recurring.

patterns.name: Regular publication and social issues
patterns.context: regularly describes a publication repeatedly publishing content, near topics concerning women, South Asian communities, and Pakistan.

patterns.name: Regularly providing volunteer service
patterns.context: regularly describes a person engaging in volunteer activities on an ongoing basis, near mentions of supporting charities.

patterns.name: Appointments on a fixed schedule
patterns.context: regularly modifies scheduled, describing patients receiving hemodialysis according to a set schedule.

patterns.name: Frequent use of a service or tool
patterns.context: regularly describes continued use of a social networking site over a past period.

patterns.name: Regularly scheduled meetings
patterns.context: regularly modifies scheduled, indicating business conference calls planned to occur periodically.

patterns.name: Recurring animal behavior
patterns.context: regularly describes koalas drinking water even in winter.

patterns.name: Regular removal or excretion
patterns.context: regularly modifies the process of the body eliminating pollutants, in a health-advice context.

patterns.name: Conditional about working regularly
patterns.context: regularly describes whether a user often works past midnight, as a condition for whether a tool is useful.

patterns.name: New things continually appearing
patterns.context: regularly modifies imposed theories, conveying that this happens repeatedly or continually, with a critical tone.

patterns.name: Philosophical terms or citation entries
patterns.context: Activation occurs in term lists and quoted philosophical concepts or reference numbers, but without regularly or an obvious similar sentence pattern.

5_456.description: 最稳定触发是词形“regularly”，横跨刊物、志愿服务、透析、网站使用、会议、动物饮水、身体排出、工作习惯及批评性议论；另有一段哲学术语列表中的分散激活，难以并入主模式。

patterns.name: regularly 的词项激活
patterns.context: 该词本身被标记为强激活；所在句谈周期性发生、定期安排或反复进行的事。

patterns.name: 定期刊载与社会议题
patterns.context: regularly 描述刊物反复刊载内容，邻近女性议题、南亚社群及巴基斯坦。

patterns.name: 经常提供志愿服务
patterns.context: regularly 描述人物持续从事志愿活动，邻近对慈善机构的支持。

patterns.name: 按固定计划就诊
patterns.context: regularly 修饰 scheduled，描述患者按既定计划接受血液透析。

patterns.name: 频繁使用服务或工具
patterns.context: regularly 描述过去一段时期持续使用社交网站。

patterns.name: 定期安排的会议
patterns.context: regularly 修饰 scheduled，表示原定周期性举行的商务电话会议。

patterns.name: 反复发生的动物行为
patterns.context: regularly 描述考拉在冬季也会饮水。

patterns.name: 定期清除或排出
patterns.context: regularly 修饰身体排出污染物的过程，属于健康建议语境。

patterns.name: 经常工作的条件句
patterns.context: regularly 描述用户是否经常工作到午夜之后，并作为工具是否有用的条件。

patterns.name: 新事物不断出现
patterns.context: regularly 修饰被强加的理论，表达其反复或不断发生，语气批评。

patterns.name: 哲学术语或引用条目
patterns.context: 术语列举及带引号的哲学概念、参考编号中出现激活，但未见 regularly 或明显同类句式。

en.description: Primarily responds to regularly, covering scheduled, frequent, or recurring events across a range of domains and genres. The first passage, however, uses philosophical terminology and citation formatting that do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Regularity/frequency use of regularly
patterns.context: The word indicates that something happens periodically, frequently, or habitually; it appears in varied syntactic positions and with differing surrounding meanings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, medical papers, business emails, forums, commentary, and health articles

patterns.name: Philosophical terms and citation markers
patterns.context: Conceptual discussion and reference formatting in philosophical literature; “regularly” does not appear.

5_456.description: 主要响应 regularly，涵盖定期安排、经常进行或反复出现，横跨多种领域文体。第1段则是哲学术语与引文格式，和主模式不符。

patterns.name: regularly 的规律性/频率用法
patterns.context: 该词表示某事定期、经常或按惯例发生；出现于多种句法位置，前后语义各异。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、医学论文、商务邮件、论坛、评论及健康文章

patterns.name: 哲学术语及引文标记
patterns.trigger: “indefiniteness”, “disjunctive facts”, “vague identity”, “indeterminacy”, “ontic”及引号、方括号和引文编号
patterns.context: 哲学文献中的概念讨论与参考文献格式；未见“regularly”。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various corpora. More prominent examples include words such as “effective” and “regularly” and common English function words. Other activations occur around philosophical citations, NIH application wording, subword segmentation of titles and proper nouns, and math Q&A; no single stable semantic pattern emerges.

patterns.name: Text fragments containing words for efficacy/effect
patterns.context: In sentences describing goals, treatment plans, daily operations, or customary support; “effective” occurs in NIH applications and medical abstracts, while “regularly” occurs in charity reports and organizational descriptions
patterns.domain: Research applications, medical abstracts, news, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Common words and punctuation in English text
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous English prose or document headers, with no stable semantic collocation

patterns.name: Philosophical terms and parenthetical quotations
patterns.context: Terms are highlighted in quotation marks and accompanied by citation page numbers and author names

patterns.name: NIH application numbers and administrative project wording
patterns.context: Grant applications or project descriptions containing numbers, aims, and management structures

patterns.name: Unusual word forms/capitalization in titles or proper nouns
patterns.context: In titles, proper nouns, or code comments, words are split into subwords by the tokenizer; triggers are not concentrated on a single word sense

patterns.name: Educational math Q&A format
patterns.context: A question asks for an approximate value of a root, followed on a new line by a numerical answer

5_456.concept: 英语词形与文本片段特征
5_456.description: 激活分散在多种语料中，较显眼的是 effective、regularly 等词及常见英文功能词；另覆盖哲学引文、NIH申请措辞、标题与专名的子词切分，以及数学问答，未形成单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 含有效/效果词的文本片段
patterns.context: 在描述目标、治疗方案、日常运作或惯常支持的句子中；effective 出现在 NIH 申请及医学摘要，regularly 出现在慈善报道和组织介绍中
patterns.domain: 科研申请、医学摘要、新闻与百科

patterns.name: 英文文本中的常见词与标点激活
patterns.context: 在连续英文 prose 或文档头部中出现，未见稳定的语义搭配

patterns.name: 哲学术语及引号括注
patterns.trigger: «indef»«init»«eness»；«dis»«j»«unctive» facts；«v»«ague identity»；«ind»«eterm»«in»«acy»；引号、方括号及引文标记
patterns.context: 术语被引号突出，并伴随引用页码、作者姓名

patterns.name: NIH 申请编号与行政项目措辞
patterns.context: 资助申请或项目说明，出现编号、目标与管理架构

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的异常词形/大小写
patterns.context: 标题、专名或代码注释中，词被分词器拆分成子词；触发不集中于单一词义

patterns.name: 教育数学问答格式
patterns.context: 以问句询问根的近似值，随后另起行给出数值答案

en.description: Activation is concentrated on two types of word-initial fragments, Environment and Pro, plus one instance of initial SNITCH; subsequent semantics and domains vary widely, making them difficult to explain together.

patterns.name: Environment-initial passages
patterns.context: A passage begins with Environment, followed by environment-related content such as environmental hazards, toxicants, and ecosystems; activation is concentrated on the word-initial fragment.
patterns.domain: Environmental science, toxicology, ecology abstracts, or project text

patterns.name: Pro-initial passages
patterns.context: A passage begins with a word starting with Pro-, with varying meanings, including Proposed, Produced, Prognostic, Proper, Prostanoids, and Proton.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, project text, and cultural institution descriptions

patterns.name: SNITCH string
patterns.context: A passage begins with an uppercase string tokenized as SN and ITCH, followed by Blu-ray Review.
patterns.domain: Online content or media review title

5_456.description: 激活集中于段首的 Environment、Pro 两类词首片段，另有一次段首 SNITCH；后续语义与领域差异很大，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 环境词首段
patterns.context: 段落开头出现 Environment，后接 environmental hazards、toxicants、ecosystems 等环境相关内容；激活集中在词首片段。
patterns.domain: 环境科学、毒理学、生态学摘要或项目文本

patterns.name: Pro-词首段
patterns.context: 段落开头出现以 Pro- 开头的词，词义不一，包括 Proposed、Produced、Prognostic、Proper、Prostanoids、Proton。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、项目文本及文化机构说明等

patterns.name: SNITCH 字符串
patterns.context: 段落开头出现被切分为 SN 与 ITCH 的大写字符串，后接 Blu-ray Review。
patterns.domain: 网络内容或媒体评论标题

en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of English words, proper nouns, and code identifiers from different domains, and also occur near comment delimiters; there is no stable semantic or domain pattern, suggesting sensitivity to specific character sequences and their boundaries.

patterns.name: Letter combinations within English words
patterns.context: Strong activations fall on letter fragments inside English words, often in the middle or at the end; word meanings and domains are inconsistent
patterns.domain: English text including patents, medical literature, and product titles

patterns.name: Fragments within proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on character fragments within proper nouns or project names, with variable fragment boundaries

patterns.name: Code identifiers and path fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within identifiers or path components in code; they are not restricted to a particular language or syntactic position

patterns.name: Comment or formatting delimiters
patterns.context: Short character fragments activate near code comments, document markup, or long separator lines

5_456.description: 激活散布于不同领域的英文词、专名及代码标识符内部片段，也见于注释分隔符；没有稳定的语义或统一领域，较像对特定字符序列及其边界的敏感。

patterns.name: 英文词中的字母组合
patterns.context: 强激活落在英文单词内部的字母片段上，常见于词的中段或结尾；上下文词义与领域不统一
patterns.domain: 专利、医学文献、产品标题等英文文本

patterns.name: 专名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名或项目名内部的字符片段，片段边界不固定
patterns.domain: 医学项目名、哲学家姓名

patterns.name: 代码标识符与路径片段
patterns.context: 代码中标识符或路径组成部分内部出现激活；并非仅限某种语言或语法位置
patterns.domain: C++ 头文件路径、JavaScript 代码

patterns.name: 注释或格式分隔符
patterns.context: 代码注释、文档标记或长分隔线附近的短字符片段激活

en.description: Apart from one passage containing webpage JavaScript search-box code, the rest are legal materials. Activations often occur near § and statute numbers, and also appear around legal citations, quotation marks, and fixed headings in judgments. Statutory citations are the most stable common thread.

patterns.name: JavaScript code and interface interaction
patterns.context: In a search-box keyboard event handler, around reading the input value and hiding result cards; activations fall on code symbols, keywords, and interface text.

patterns.name: Statute numbers and statutory citations
patterns.context: Legal text containing statute or section numbers prefixed by §, often alongside citations to the U.S. Code, Code of Federal Regulations, state laws, or case law; activations are especially concentrated on § and the following number characters.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and citation markers in legal text
patterns.context: Quotation marks, backticks, and square brackets occur when judgments or legal discussions quote definitions, phrases, passages, or contract rules; triggers may be adjacent to legal citation formatting.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments and citations in legal literature

patterns.name: Fixed headings in legal documents
patterns.context: A fixed heading in uppercase introduces the legal conclusions section of a court judgment.

patterns.name: Sections and case citations in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal arguments cite guideline sections, legal treatises, state codes, or legislative documents; they do not necessarily use the U.S. Code format.
patterns.domain: Judgments, legal guides, and legislative materials

patterns.name: Regulatory context for controlled medications
patterns.context: Discusses methadone take-home medication, regular follow-up visits, and federal regulations; the passage also contains statute numbers.

5_456.concept: 法律文本中的条文引述
5_456.description: 除一段含网页 JavaScript 搜索框代码外，其余均为法律材料；激活常出现在§及法规编号附近，也见法律引文、引号和判决固定标题。法规引述是最稳定的共同线索。

patterns.name: JavaScript 代码与界面操作
patterns.context: 搜索框键盘事件处理函数中，围绕输入值读取和隐藏结果卡片的代码；激活落在代码符号、关键字及界面文本上。

patterns.name: 法律条文编号与法条引述
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现带§的法规或条款编号，常伴随美国法典、联邦法规、州法或判例引述；激活尤其集中在§及其后的编号字符。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引号与引用标记
patterns.context: 判决或法律论述引用定义、短语、引文或合同规则时出现引号、反引号和方括号；其触发可能与法律引述格式相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律判决及法律文献引文

patterns.name: 法律文书固定标题
patterns.context: 法院判决中以大写固定标题引出法律结论部分。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的章节与判例引用
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用指南章节、法律著作、州法典或立法文件；不一定是联邦法典格式。
patterns.domain: 判决、法律指南和立法材料

patterns.name: 医学管制药物法规语境
patterns.context: 讨论美沙酮带回家用药、定期复诊及联邦监管规定；段内同时有法规编号。

en.description: Activations commonly occur in recommendations or obligations formed with “should” and broadly around HTML entities, tags, and escaped text. Other activations include all-caps emphasis, menu input examples, privacy tools, and several isolated technical or occupational words.

patterns.name: Recurring recommendation/obligation use of “should”
patterns.context: “Should” in recommendations or normative judgments, often paired with “you” or “I”; no fixed sentence position is required.
patterns.domain: HackerNews help requests, experience discussions, and general commentary

patterns.name: HTML entities and markup boundaries
patterns.context: HTML-encoded entities, tags, or fragments appear in webpage text, often adjacent to punctuation or formatting boundaries.
patterns.domain: Web corpora, forum text with HTML escaping

patterns.name: All-caps contrastive emphasis
patterns.context: An all-caps phrase emphasizes contrast or dissatisfaction.

patterns.name: Quoted input options
patterns.context: Discusses a command or option entered in a menu, with the example enclosed in quotation marks.

patterns.name: Privacy tools and service names
patterns.context: Lists privacy-protection scenarios and corresponding tools or services.

patterns.name: Scattered technical/occupational vocabulary activations
patterns.context: These words occur in different sentences, with no consistent local semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Web development, labor commentary, part-time work, and entrepreneurship discussions

5_456.description: 激活常见于 should 构成的建议或义务表达，也广泛落在 HTML 实体、标签及转义文本附近；另有全大写强调、菜单输入示例、隐私工具和若干孤立技术或职业词汇。

patterns.name: 反复出现的“should”建议/义务表达
patterns.trigger: “how should I proceed” / “you should be taking notes” / “you should never do” / “you should be patient”
patterns.context: 建议或规范性判断中的 should，常与 you/I 搭配；不要求句子固定位置。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 求助、经验讨论及一般议论

patterns.name: HTML 实体与标记边界
patterns.context: 网页文本中出现 HTML 编码实体、标签或其碎片；往往与标点或格式边界相邻。
patterns.domain: 网页语料、HTML 转义后的论坛文本

patterns.name: 大写转折强调
patterns.context: 用全大写词组突出转折或不满。

patterns.name: 引号括起的输入选项
patterns.context: 讨论菜单中输入的命令或选项，示例以引号括起。

patterns.name: 隐私工具与服务名称
patterns.context: 列举隐私保护场景及对应工具、服务。

patterns.name: 零散的技术/职业词汇激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在各自不同的句子中，未见一致的局部语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 网页开发、劳动议论、兼职与创业讨论

en.concept: Hyphen-delimited text fragments and code/entity boundaries
en.description: Primarily sensitive to title-like, hyphen-delimited slugs in URLs and their word boundaries; scattered activations also occur in template fields/attributes, “hack-a-shaq,” Upstart versions and commands, and the name Memcached.

patterns.name: Hyphen-delimited slugs in URLs
patterns.context: URL paths contain title-like or descriptive word strings separated by hyphens; activations usually concentrate on the hyphen and following words, especially at word boundaries
patterns.domain: Web links, technical and news headline URLs

patterns.name: Fields and values in template syntax
patterns.context: Form field declarations and attributes and values in Ruby/Rails-style templates

patterns.name: The compound “hack-a-shaq”
patterns.context: A hyphenated player nickname or play name in a basketball context

patterns.name: Upstart version strings
patterns.context: An IRC conversation mentions an Upstart version or related version-control commands

patterns.name: Product-name entity in a question
patterns.context: Asks whether a tool similar to a product exists; activation falls within the name Memcached

5_456.concept: 连字符分隔的文本片段及代码/实体边界
5_456.description: 主要对 URL 中连字符分隔的标题式 slug 及其词边界敏感；另在模板字段/属性、hack-a-shaq、Upstart 版本与命令、Memcached 名称中出现零散激活。

patterns.name: 链接 URL 中连字符分隔的 slug
patterns.trigger: URL 路径中如“using-a-pool-of-workers”“why-is-using-a-shell-loop-to”“three-students-built-a-100-device-to-blind”“qbox-releases-qes-elasticsearch-connector-for-magento”“why-sf-restaurants-are”“what-do-real-thugs-think-of-the-wire”等连字符及其后的词
patterns.context: 网址路径中出现以连字符分隔的标题或描述性词串；激活通常集中在连字符及其后的词，尤其是词边界
patterns.domain: 网页链接、技术与新闻标题 URL

patterns.name: 模板语法中的字段与值
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 风格模板中的表单字段声明及属性和值

patterns.name: hack-a-shaq 复合词
patterns.context: 篮球语境中以连字符拼成的球员昵称/战术名称

patterns.name: Upstart 版本字符串
patterns.context: IRC 对话中提及 Upstart 版本或相关版本控制命令

patterns.name: 问句中的产品名实体
patterns.context: 询问是否存在类似某产品的工具；激活落在 Memcached 名称内部

en.description: Activations are scattered across Tamil Nadu and other segmented proper nouns, English word fragments, and punctuation; they also occur around crop directions, a medical phrase, garbled email text, HIV, and music reviews, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Place name Tamil Nadu
patterns.context: The place name Tamil Nadu occurs in a sentence or category name; activations concentrate on segmented subword fragments.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and rare word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented proper nouns or rare word fragments, including place names, personal names, and fictional characters; there is no unified syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Forum text, historical entries, novel plots

patterns.name: Common English words and suffixes
patterns.context: Scattered occurrences on function words, suffixes, punctuation, or internal word fragments, across sentence types and without stable collocations.

patterns.name: Pixel crop direction expression
patterns.context: Indicates movement from left to right when describing the range of a crop window; the y-coordinate is fixed at 0.

patterns.name: Medical phrase about body weight
patterns.context: Describes a higher proportion of water by weight in a physiological comparison of newborns and premature infants.

patterns.name: Garbled or encoding-corrupted text
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented email addresses and string fragments that appear to be encoded or formatted.
patterns.domain: Addresses and structured text in Enron emails

patterns.name: HIV and medication adherence
patterns.context: Describes HIV-positive participants and treatment adherence in a randomized controlled trial abstract.

patterns.name: Pop music vocabulary in a review
patterns.context: Discusses whether an album subverts the foundational style of pop music; activations occur on segmented subword fragments.

5_456.description: 激活分散于 Tamil Nadu 及其他拆分专名、英文词片段和标点；另见裁剪方向、医学短语、邮件乱码、HIV 与音乐评论，缺乏统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: Tamil Nadu 地名
patterns.context: 地名 Tamil Nadu 在句中或分类名称中出现；激活集中在被拆分标记的词片段。
patterns.domain: 印度历史、维基百科分类

patterns.name: 专名与罕见词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拆分的专名或罕见词片段上，涉及地名、人名及虚构人物；没有统一句法条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、历史条目、小说情节

patterns.name: 英文常见词与词尾
patterns.context: 零散出现在语法词、词尾、标点或词内片段上；跨句子类型且无稳定搭配。
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论、医学、技术问答

patterns.name: 像素裁剪方向表达
patterns.context: 在说明裁剪窗口移动范围时，表示从左到右；y 坐标固定为 0。

patterns.name: 医学体重短语
patterns.context: 新生儿与早产儿生理比较中，描述体重中水分比例较高。

patterns.name: 乱码或编码异常文本
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的邮件地址及疑似编码、格式化的字符串片段中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的地址与结构化文本

patterns.name: HIV 与药物依从性
patterns.context: 随机对照试验摘要中，描述 HIV 阳性参与者及治疗依从性。

patterns.name: 评论中的流行音乐词汇
patterns.context: 讨论专辑是否颠覆流行音乐的基础风格；激活出现在拆分的词片段上。

en.description: Activations often fall on tokenized fragments of URLs, encoded strings, numerical identifiers, and proper nouns, and also occur sporadically around line breaks, directory boundaries, and ordinary words. The case number in the third passage fits the identifier pattern, but overall there is no single stable semantic feature.

patterns.name: URL/domain and web address fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on URLs, domains, paths, or encoded link characters, including email archive links, Reuters links, and website addresses.

patterns.name: Internal substrings in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to part of a proper noun rather than a complete word; examples include band locations, football clubs, and signature/name strings.

patterns.name: Numeric and alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur in continuous numbers or mixed codes such as legal case numbers, URL-encoded identifiers, article IDs, or GUIDs.
patterns.domain: Legal text, web links, code configuration

patterns.name: Ship names/ship-related word strings
patterns.context: Occurs in ship entries following a “Ships” heading and descriptions of service locations; activation may also fall on abbreviation boundaries.

patterns.name: Numbering and title boundaries in bibliographies/poetry catalogs
patterns.context: In a catalog of poetic works, activations occur near line breaks, the beginning of titles, and year/work information.

patterns.name: Character fragments in personal email addresses
patterns.context: After “E-mail me at,” activations concentrate on continuous fragments of a personal email username or address.

patterns.name: Isolated generic word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence describing people helping one another at work; the current fragment shows no apparent formatting condition in common with other triggers.

patterns.name: Isolated function word
patterns.context: Occurs in a business news website tagline; activation falls on ordinary prepositions and determiners, with no clear local formatting pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated poetic word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within the phrase “certain Poems”; the fragment alone is insufficient to identify a distinct semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Isolated paragraph/marker token
patterns.context: Activations occur at line breaks following links and at code/list structure boundaries; they may relate to structural separation, but evidence is limited.

5_456.concept: 结构化字符串中的片段
5_456.description: 激活多落在网址、编码串、数字标识符和专名的分词片段，也零散出现在换行、目录边界及普通词上；第3段案号符合标识符模式，但整体并无单一稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: URL／域名与网址片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 URL、域名、路径或编码后的链接字符上；包括邮件归档链接、Reuters 链接和网站地址。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、邮件归档、新闻

patterns.name: 专名中的内部子串
patterns.context: 激活对应专名的一部分，而非完整词；见于乐队地点、足球俱乐部和签名/姓名字符串。

patterns.name: 数字及混合字母数字标识符
patterns.context: 激活出现在法律案号、URL 编码标识、文章 ID 或 GUID 等连续编号/混合编码中。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、网页链接、代码配置

patterns.name: 船名／舰船相关词串
patterns.context: 出现在“Ships”标题之后的船舶条目及服役地点描述中；激活也可能落在缩写边界。

patterns.name: 书目／诗歌目录中的编号与标题边界
patterns.context: 诗歌作品目录中，换行、标题开头及年份/作品信息附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 个人邮件地址中的字符片段
patterns.context: 在“E-mail me at”之后，激活集中于个人邮箱用户名或地址的连续片段。

patterns.name: 孤立的通用词片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述互相协助工作的句子中，当前片段看不出与其他触发相同的格式条件。

patterns.name: 孤立的语法词
patterns.context: 出现在商业新闻网站宣传语中，激活落在普通介词和限定词上，未见明确局部格式规律。

patterns.name: 孤立的诗歌词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“certain Poems”一词内部，难以仅凭片段确定独立语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 孤立的段落／标记 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在链接后的换行及代码/列表结构边界处；可能与结构分隔有关，但证据有限。

en.description: Primarily responds to inferential expressions formed by “appears to” and “appears to be,” across commentary, academic, and news contexts; weaker or isolated patterns include to constructions, descriptions of patent components, and list-formatting symbols.

patterns.name: “appears to be” inferential frame
patterns.context: “appears to be” introduces a judgment about what something seems to be, its nature, or its state; it is followed by a noun phrase, adjective, or event. Common forms include “what appears to be” and “what … appears to be”.
patterns.domain: Prose such as news commentary, academic papers, research descriptions, and reports on employment relationships

patterns.name: Verb following “appears to”
patterns.context: “appears to” expresses that something seems possibly to be doing something or making a claim, rather than stating it directly; passage 3 has “appears to be a WordPress blog”, and passage 5 has “appears to be claiming”.

patterns.name: Other “to” words and following constructions
patterns.context: A strong “to” and its following word appear, but they do not form the “appears to be” frame: expressing an opinion (passage 6), purpose or advice (passage 8), and prepositional constructions (passages 8 and 10).

patterns.name: Direction and component words in a patent sentence
patterns.context: In a technical description, words near body parts, upward/downward directions, and air-intake structures trigger activation; this differs from the inferential expressions in other passages.

patterns.name: List and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Activation falls near formatting symbols for line breaks or numbered items, with no clear shared lexical trigger.
patterns.domain: HackerNews posts and Wikipedia article lists

5_456.description: 主要响应“appears to”及“appears to be”所构成的看似、推断式表述，横跨评论、学术与新闻语境；另有 to 结构、专利部件描述及列表排版符号等较弱或孤立模式。

patterns.name: “appears to be”推断框架
patterns.context: 以“appears to be”引出对某事物看似为何物、性质或状态的判断；后接名词短语、形容词或事件。常见形式为“what appears to be”，也包括“what … appears to be”。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、学术论文、科研描述、雇佣关系报道等散文

patterns.name: “appears to”后接动词
patterns.trigger: « appears»« to»« do» / « appears»« to»« be claiming»
patterns.context: “appears to”表达看起来可能在做某事或持某种主张，而不只是直接断言；段3为“appears to be a WordPress blog”，段5为“appears to be claiming”。

patterns.name: 其他“to”字及其后续结构
patterns.trigger: « to»« think»、« to»« paint»、« to»« a»
patterns.context: 出现较强的“to”及其后续词，但不构成“appears to be”框架：表达看法（段6）、目的或建议（段8），以及介词结构（段8、10）。

patterns.name: 专利句中的方向及部件词
patterns.trigger: « side»« of»« the»« body»« portion»；« of»« the»« air»« inlet»
patterns.context: 技术描述中，身体部件、上下方位及进气结构附近的词触发；与其他段的推断表达不同。

patterns.name: 列表与排版符号
patterns.context: 激活落在换行或编号条目的排版符号附近，缺乏明确共享的词义触发条件。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖文及 Wikipedia 条目列表

en.description: Primarily responds to the experiential description structure “what it is/was like to…,” often used to ask about or imagine firsthand experience. Weaker or isolated responses also occur in the judgment structure “what it appears to…,” the repeated “the inside of the” structure in a patent, and “corner of my eye.”

patterns.name: Experiential description pattern “what it is like to …”
patterns.context: Around what + it + is/was/’s + like + to/infinitive or experience, asking about or describing what it feels like to experience an activity, situation, or role; sometimes preceded by “wondered,” “imagine,” or similar.
patterns.domain: Web promotions, reviews, event descriptions, and personal narratives

patterns.name: “what it appears to …” in judgments of function or appearance
patterns.context: “What it appears to” is followed by “do” or “be” to express actual function or appearance; it does not contain the typical “it is like” experiential pattern.

patterns.name: Repeated determiners for an interior location
patterns.context: A technical description repeatedly uses “the”/“of” and “inside of the” to refer to the inside of a device; it is not clearly related to the experiential pattern in the other passages.

patterns.name: Possessive in a body-part phrase
patterns.context: A narrative describes seeing someone out of the corner of one’s eye; activations occur around “corner,” “my,” and “eye,” without the dominant “what-it-is-like” structure.

5_456.concept: 英语中的 what-it’s-like 体验句式
5_456.description: 主要响应 what it is/was like to… 这一体验描述结构，常用于询问或想象亲历某事。另对 what it appears to… 的判断结构、专利中的 the inside of the 重复结构及 corner of my eye 有较弱或孤立响应。

patterns.name: “what it is like to …”体验描述句式
patterns.trigger: “what it is like to sell a product”“what it was like to be there”“what it's like to see”“what it’s like to have”“what it's like to be”
patterns.context: 围绕 what + it + is/was/’s + like + to/动词不定式或经历，询问或描述亲历某种活动、处境或角色的感受；有时前接 wondered、imagine 等。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、评论、活动介绍及个人叙述

patterns.name: 功能或外观判断中的“what it appears to …”
patterns.trigger: “what it appears to do”“what it appears to be”
patterns.context: what it appears to 后接 do 或 be，表达实际功能或表象；不含典型的 it is like 体验句式。

patterns.name: 装置内部位置的重复限定词
patterns.trigger: “the inside of the depressurized chamber”“the inside of the apparatus”
patterns.context: 技术描述中连续出现 the/of，并用 inside of the 指称设备内部；与其他段的体验句式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 身体部位词组中的所有格
patterns.context: 叙事中描述从视线余光处看到某人；激活落在 corner、my、eye 一带，未呈现主导的 what-it-is-like 结构。

en.description: Most passages center on “what it’s/is/was like to” questions or descriptions of experience, covering experiences of identity, viewing, running a business, and loss; other patterns include patent separation terminology, the superlative structure “of all,” and the fixed expression “corner of my eye”.

patterns.name: Experiential “what it’s like to …” frame
patterns.context: Introduces a subjective description of the experience of an identity, activity, event, or state; followed by a verb or identity phrase.
patterns.domain: Q&A, promotional material, commentary, personal narrative, etc.

patterns.name: Superlative structure “of all”
patterns.context: Appears in “the most intriguing of all …”, expressing the highest degree within a set.

patterns.name: Components and separation description in patent claims
patterns.context: Describes a film/thermoplastic material structure and the conditions under which components are separated along a score line.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “corner of my eye”
patterns.context: Recounts accidentally seeing someone at the edge of one’s field of vision; activation is concentrated near “of”.

5_456.description: 多数段落集中于“what it’s/is/was like to”体验提问或描述，涵盖身份、观看、经营、失去等经历；另见专利分离术语、“of all”最高程度结构及“corner of my eye”固定表达。

patterns.name: “what it’s like to …”体验框架
patterns.trigger: “what it’s like to”及变体“what it is like to”“what it was like to”“what it’s like to be”
patterns.context: 引出对某种身份、活动、经历或状态的主观体验描述；后接动词或身份短语。
patterns.domain: 问答、宣传、评论、个人叙述等

patterns.name: “of all”最高程度结构
patterns.context: 出现在“the most intriguing of all …”中，表达在某一集合中的最高程度。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的部件与分离描述
patterns.context: 描述薄膜/热塑性材料结构，以及部件沿划痕线被分离的条件。

patterns.name: “corner of my eye”固定表达
patterns.context: 叙述偶然从视野边缘看见某人；激活集中在“of”附近。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the structure introducing an experiential description, “what it’s like to” and variants, across questions, recollections, reviews, and personal narratives. It also activates near technical device terms in one patent passage, which may be a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Experiential question structure “what it’s like to”
patterns.context: This structure introduces a description of the subjective experience of an event, identity, or activity; activation concentrates on “to,” followed by a verb or “be.”
patterns.domain: Web introductions, Q&A, personal narratives, news commentary, etc.

patterns.name: Device-component terms in a technical patent
patterns.context: Patent background text describes processing equipment, openings, and solution flow; this passage does not match the experiential question structure.

5_456.description: 主要对“what it’s like to”及变体中引出体验描述的结构强烈响应，涵盖询问、回忆、评论和个人叙述；另在一段专利设备术语附近激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: “what it’s like to”体验询问结构
patterns.trigger: “what it’s like to”及其变体“what it was like to”“what it is like to”
patterns.context: 该结构引出对某种经历、身份或活动的主观感受描述；激活集中在“to”上，后接动词或“be”。
patterns.domain: 网页介绍、问答、个人叙述、新闻评论等

patterns.name: 技术专利中的设备部件术语
patterns.trigger: “PS plate processor insertion aperture”以及“discharge aperture”
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中描述处理设备、开口和溶液流动；本段不符合体验询问结构。

en.description: Activation often occurs in contexts where all refers to an entire object, and also where what it’s like to introduces an experience; there is also a single passage using still for duration, plus sporadic activation around dialogue punctuation and SG.

patterns.name: all and following scenes or things
patterns.context: all is followed by a plural noun or general object, often in this/when constructions, indicating all the things or objects in question; however, all is not always adjacent to the activation token.
patterns.domain: HackerNews commentary, narrative text, medical reporting, etc.

patterns.name: like to construction imagining an experience
patterns.context: what it’s like to introduces an experience or activity; sometimes preceded by Ever wondered and followed by a specific description of the experience.
patterns.domain: Promotional copy, event descriptions, narrative text

patterns.name: Duration construction in sit still for
patterns.context: Describes a creator as unsuitable for being required to sit still for a long time; activation is concentrated on still and for.

patterns.name: Sporadic dialogue words and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation occurs near punctuation or line breaks in novel-like dialogue; triggers are unstable and cannot be clearly grouped with the other patterns.

5_456.description: 激活常见于 all 指向整体对象的语境，也见于 what it’s like to 引出某种体验；另有单段的 still for 持续时长用法及零散对话标点、SG 激活。

patterns.name: all 与之后的场景或事物
patterns.context: all 后接复数名词或概括性对象，常置于 this/when 等结构中，表示所涉及的全部事物或对象；但有时 all 与激活 token 并不紧邻。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、叙事文本、医疗报道等

patterns.name: 设想某种体验的 like to 结构
patterns.context: 以 what it’s like to 引出体验或活动；有时前接 Ever wondered，并继续具体说明体验内容。
patterns.domain: 宣传文案、活动介绍、叙事文本

patterns.name: sit still for 的持续时长结构
patterns.trigger: «still»« for»，附近有 «be»« made»« to» 与 «too»« long»
patterns.context: 描述创作者不适合被要求长时间静坐；激活集中在 still 和 for。

patterns.name: 零散对话词及标点
patterns.context: 小说式对话中标点或换行附近出现激活；触发上下文不稳定，无法与其他模式明确归并。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across “all” and its following constituents, “to” in experiential expressions, the phrase “sit still,” and “in” in a technical context. These local triggers have no reliable shared pattern.

patterns.name: “all” followed by a determiner, pronoun, or noun
patterns.context: In “when all …” temporal/event clauses, or when “all” is followed by constituents such as those/sites/appellees; strong activation falls on “all”.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, web comments, legal texts

patterns.name: Infinitival “to” in experiential expressions with “like”
patterns.context: Often appears in clauses asking or describing “what it feels like”; “to” introduces an experience, state, or encounter. Activation is mainly on “to”.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, game promotional copy, forum comments

patterns.name: The phrase “sit still”
patterns.context: Creative types are described as unsuited to remaining still for long periods; high activation falls on “still”.

patterns.name: Specific local collocation with the preposition “in”
patterns.context: In a technical discussion, recalling having been “in to it” two years earlier; the specific syntactic or semantic trigger is unclear.

5_456.description: 显著激活分散在 all 及其后续成分、体验表达中的 to、短语 sit still 和技术语境的 in to it；这些局部触发并无可靠共同规律。

patterns.name: all 后接限定词、代词或名词
patterns.trigger: “all»10 is over”“all»10 was starting”“all»9 those”“all»9 sites”“all»9 appellees”
patterns.context: 在 “when all …” 时间/事件从句中，或 all 后接 those/sites/appellees 等成分；强激活落在 all
patterns.domain: 论坛口语、网页评论、法律文本

patterns.name: 不定式 to 与 like 的体验表达
patterns.trigger: “to»9 ‘know’”“to»9 be the mayor”“to»9 have their children taken away”；另有 “what it’s like”
patterns.context: 常见于询问或描述“是什么感觉/像什么”的从句，to 引出体验、状态或遭遇；激活主要标在 to
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、游戏宣传文案、论坛评论

patterns.name: sit still 短语
patterns.context: creative types 被说成不适合长时间保持静止；高激活落在 still

patterns.name: 介词 in 的特定局部搭配
patterns.context: 技术讨论中回忆两年前“当时参与其中”；具体句法/语义触发条件不明确

en.concept: No unified concept; local token patterns
en.description: Activation is distributed across inconsistent local patterns: several passages use “to…have/like/when” expressions, while others involve URL characters, fragments of proper names, and activation near line breaks; some fragments do not fit a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: “to …” constructions
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “imagine an experience/know what something feels like”; there are also adjacent triggers in “when … all is over”, but the same syntax is not present every time.
patterns.domain: Personal narrative, emotional expression, forum text

patterns.name: URL and web address strings
patterns.context: In continuous web links or query parameters, activation falls on URL characters, separators, and numbers.
patterns.domain: Web-crawled text, weather links in emails

patterns.name: Internal fragments of personal names, place names, and proper nouns
patterns.context: When proper nouns are split into multiple tokens, activation is concentrated on internal name fragments; the triggering fragments are not consistent with one another.
patterns.domain: Web text, legal decisions, news reporting

patterns.name: Formatted lists and line-break markers
patterns.context: A small amount of activation occurs near line breaks or dividers, often at headings, discographies, or article separators.
patterns.domain: Web pages, encyclopedia entries, forum text

patterns.name: Other local fragments
patterns.context: Sporadically appears in motorcycle names/producers, album titles, and sentence fragments at passage beginnings; no common lexical or semantic trigger can be identified.

5_456.concept: 无统一概念；局部 token 模式
5_456.description: 激活分布于不一致的局部模式：几段中出现“to…have/like/when”表达，另有网址字符、专名切分片段和换行附近激活；部分片段无法归入统一语义类别。

patterns.name: “to …”结构
patterns.context: 出现在“想象某种经历/知道某事是什么感觉”一类表达中；也有“when … all is over”中的相邻触发，但并非每次都有相同句法。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、情感表达、论坛文字

patterns.name: URL及网址字符串
patterns.context: 连续的网页链接或查询参数中，激活落在网址字符、分隔符和数字上。
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本、邮件中的天气链接

patterns.name: 人名、地名及专名内部片段
patterns.context: 专名被切分成多个 token 时，激活集中在名称内部片段；触发片段彼此并不一致。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、法律判决、新闻报道

patterns.name: 带格式的列表及换行标记
patterns.trigger: «↵»及其附近的标题、列表分隔内容
patterns.context: 换行或分隔线附近有少量激活；常处在标题、唱片目录或文章分隔处。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科条目、论坛文本

patterns.name: 其他局部片段
patterns.context: 零星出现在摩托车名称/制作人、唱片标题及段首残句中，找不到共同的词法或语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across anatomy, sitting still, personal names, vehicle and electrical structures, LaTeX code, jazz discographies, and employment law. A few activations fall on subword fragments or common phrases; there is no stable semantic trigger spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Peritoneal and abdominal anatomy
patterns.context: Mentions an instrument inserted into the abdominal cavity and its contact with the peritoneum; nearby terms include “abdomen” and “abdominal contents”.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical or surgical technology

patterns.name: Scalp and muscle anatomy
patterns.context: Describes using the sharp edge of a scalp knife and separating the muscles beneath the skin.
patterns.domain: Surgical or anatomical description in legal testimony

patterns.name: Restlessness / difficulty sitting still
patterns.context: The phrase “sit still” describes a child or creative person unable to remain seated for long; one passage concerns childhood, another attention and noise.

patterns.name: Unusual word form in a personal name
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on subword fragments in the name “Kevin Kamekona”, amid a legal narrative about government informants.

patterns.name: Vehicle components and flexible structures
patterns.context: Describes a pedal bracket, a flexible portion deforming under pressure, and sliding contact with the side of a vehicle body.

patterns.name: Foot / leg connection structures
patterns.context: Introduces multiple feet on electrical system components and explains how the connection ends of each foot are labeled in a figure.
patterns.domain: Patent background, electrical equipment and figure descriptions

patterns.name: LaTeX typesetting commands and code
patterns.context: Embedded in LaTeX source containing commands such as \\parbox, \\linewidth, and \\today; activation falls on the string “CSE”.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A or typesetting code

patterns.name: Jazz musicians and album titles
patterns.context: Appears in a jazz discography involving members of Betty Carter’s band and song titles.

patterns.name: Control in an employment relationship
patterns.context: A final subword fragment in the name “Bechtel”; the context discusses whether an employer controls how work is done.

5_456.description: 激活分散于解剖、静坐、人名、车辆与电力结构、LaTeX代码、爵士唱片目录及劳动法语境；少数激活落在词内分词或常见短语上，未见贯穿所有段落的稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 腹膜及腹部解剖
patterns.context: 提及腹腔内插入器械及其与腹膜接触；邻近词包括 “abdomen”“abdominal contents”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，医疗或外科技术

patterns.name: 头皮与肌肉解剖
patterns.context: 描述使用头皮刀的锋刃，并分离皮肤下方的肌肉。
patterns.domain: 法律证词中的手术或解剖描述

patterns.name: 坐不住／难以静坐
patterns.context: 短语 “sit still”，描述儿童或创意人士无法长时间安坐；一处涉及童年，另一处涉及注意力与噪声。

patterns.name: 人名中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在姓名 “Kevin Kamekona” 的分词片段，周围是政府线人相关的法律叙述。

patterns.name: 车辆部件与柔性结构
patterns.context: 描述踏板支架、柔性部分受压变形并与车身侧面滑动接触。

patterns.name: 支脚／腿部连接结构
patterns.context: 介绍电力系统部件的多个支脚，并说明各支脚连接端在图中的标示。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，电力设备及附图说明

patterns.name: LaTeX排版命令与代码
patterns.context: 嵌在含有 \\parbox、\\linewidth、\\today 等命令的 LaTeX 源码中，激活落在 “CSE” 字符串。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答或排版代码

patterns.name: 爵士音乐人及唱片名
patterns.context: 出现在爵士乐唱片目录中，涉及 Betty Carter 乐队成员及歌曲名。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐家传记与唱片目录

patterns.name: 雇佣关系中的控制权
patterns.context: “Bechtel” 姓名中的末尾分词片段；上下文讨论雇主是否控制工作方式。

en.description: Activation is dispersed across numeric time/date and URL formats, medical anatomy terms, proper-name fragments, and a few genre-specific expressions (a stationary state, startup positioning, C++ assertions); there is no single stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers, times, and dates
patterns.context: Numbers, times, or dates appear in URL paths, time-calculation problems, and answers; activation is distributed across numbers, punctuation, and format elements such as AM/PM.

patterns.name: URL and path punctuation
patterns.context: Structural markers in URLs and their paths or query parameters; adjacent to URL content such as dates, book titles, or names.

patterns.name: Medical anatomical compounds
patterns.context: Describes abdominal cavity, peritoneum, or rectal surgery and infection; medical terms are often split across subwords or affixes.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of personal names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns appear in news, biographies, legal testimony, and other prose; activation sometimes falls on internal subwords of a name rather than the whole word.

patterns.name: Expressions about periods of time and being still
patterns.context: In a personal recollection of childhood, describes difficulty staying quiet or still.

patterns.name: Startup positioning language
patterns.context: Discusses product positioning and pricing for a target niche market, emphasizing not to make only a cheaper version of a competitor.

patterns.name: C++ template and assertion syntax
patterns.context: Template type parameters, assertions, and parentheses in C++ test code.

5_456.description: 激活分散于数字时间/日期与网址格式、医学解剖术语、专名片段，以及少数文体特有表达（静止状态、创业定位、C++断言）；没有单一稳定的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字、时间与日期
patterns.trigger: 数字串及其格式符号，如「2013」「00」「:」「-」「405 minutes after」「5:31 AM」「12:29 PM」「439 minutes after」
patterns.context: 数字、时间或日期出现在网址路径、时间计算题及答案中；激活分布在数字、标点和 AM/PM 等格式成分上。

patterns.name: 网址与路径标点
patterns.context: 网址及其路径、查询参数中的结构标记；与日期、书名或人名等 URL 内容相邻。

patterns.name: 医学解剖复合词
patterns.context: 描述腹腔、腹膜或直肠手术与感染，医学术语常跨子词或词缀切分。

patterns.name: 人名与专名内部片段
patterns.context: 专名出现在新闻、传记、法律证词等正文中；激活有时落在名字的内部子词，而非完整词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、音乐传记、法律文本

patterns.name: 时间段与静止状态表达
patterns.context: 个人回忆童年时，描述难以保持安静或静止。

patterns.name: 创业定位措辞
patterns.context: 讨论面向目标细分市场的产品定位和定价，强调不要只做竞品的廉价版本。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与断言语法

en.description: Activations occur across several text types: function words and component descriptions in patent sentences, time formats in arithmetic Q&A, segmented URL/proper-name/Scala-library fragments, specific word fragments in a few comments, and a news place name. No clear semantic pattern spans all passages.

patterns.name: Function words and body/component nouns in English patent text
patterns.context: Patent background or embodiment sentences describe component movement, deformation, contact, and measurement structures; activation falls on multiple function words and nouns.

patterns.name: Time formats in time-arithmetic Q&A
patterns.context: Questions such as “What is … minutes after …?”, “minutes before …?”, or queries about the interval between two times; activation often covers hour/minute digits, colons, and AM/PM.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in URLs and proper names
patterns.context: Names, places, paths, or words in news review headlines and URLs are split into multiple tokens; high activation also falls on fragments such as «10».

patterns.name: ScalaTest dependency configuration
patterns.context: Build configuration includes a ScalaTest description and dependency coordinates; activation concentrates on tokens from the segmented library name.

patterns.name: Sentence-final emphasis on a state of stillness
patterns.context: First-person account of being unable to sit still as a child; the target word occurs in “I couldn’t sit still.”

patterns.name: Adverbial suffix in sports commentary
patterns.context: In a sentence discussing a player’s performance, the adverbial suffix occurs in the quoted word “constantly burned”.

patterns.name: South African mining-region place name
patterns.context: A news account about the Lonmin platinum mine, striking workers, and police opening fire; the place name is split, with activation concentrated on an interior fragment of “Marikana”.

5_456.description: 激活分布在多个不同文本类型：专利句中的功能词及部件描述、时间算术问答的时刻格式、网址/专名与 Scala 库名的切分片段，以及少数评论中的特定词片段和新闻地名；没有贯穿全部段落的明确语义模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across number and symbol strings, determiners, lyrics and forum text, place names and directions, dream narratives, color experiments, and paper citations. patterns.context: C++/WinRT 接口的未实现异常文本内，处于接口成员名 AudioPlaybackConnection。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的分数与数字
patterns.context: 整除/因数判断题的分式及整数表达式中，激活集中在数字 token。

patterns.name: 天气链接中的 URL 字符
patterns.context: 天气预警邮件的 URL 查询串中，激活分布于域名及参数字符、数字片段。

en.description: Activations occur in mathematical true/false problems, code and SQL, URLs, English sentences, and technical patent text. They are distributed across numbers, symbols, identifiers, URL fragments, and ordinary words; there is no stable single semantic or morphological trigger.

patterns.name: Mathematical true/false questions and separators
patterns.context: Problems and True/False answer sequences involving mathematical expressions, factors/divisibility, or primality; activation is scattered across numbers, operators, and question text, rather than limited to a particular mathematical symbol.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax fragments
patterns.context: Identifiers, keywords, punctuation, and adjacent fragments in code or SQL; spans multiple languages and tasks.

patterns.name: URLs, paths, and their text
patterns.context: URLs, domains, or paths in code or text; activation covers character fragments of URLs and also occurs in code for retrieving web pages.

patterns.name: Scattered word activations in English natural language
patterns.context: Multiple common and content words are activated in coherent English sentences; the two passages differ in meaning and style and have no obvious shared keywords.
patterns.domain: EuroParl dialogue/parliamentary speech; Pile-CC sports commentary

patterns.name: Technical proper names and patent terminology
patterns.context: Technical explanatory text describing a digital PLL circuit and false-lock behavior.

patterns.name: Other fragmented strong activations
patterns.context: Beyond the themes of individual passages, the strongest activations fall on different proper names or content words; no unified condition can be inferred from these triggers alone.
patterns.domain: Web paths/image URLs; parliamentary names; sports commentary; patent technical text

5_456.description: 激活出现在数学真假题、代码与 SQL、URL、英文句子及专利技术文本中，分布于数字、符号、标识符、网址片段和普通词语；没有稳定的单一语义或词形触发特征。

patterns.name: 数学真假问答与分隔符
patterns.context: 数学表达式、因数/整除/素数判断组成的题目与 True/False 答案序列；激活散布在数字、运算符和问答文本上，并非只落在某个数学符号

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法片段
patterns.trigger: `err = gots.ErrSCTE35MissingOut`、`for _, d := range closed`、`if d.TypeID() != SegDescProgramStart`、`response, err := client.Get(...)`、`INSERT INTO ... VALUES`
patterns.context: 代码或 SQL 中的标识符、关键字、标点及其相邻片段；多个不同语言和任务

patterns.name: URL、路径及其组成文本
patterns.context: 代码或文本中出现网址、域名、路径；激活覆盖 URL 的字符片段，也伴随获取网页的代码

patterns.name: 英文自然语言中的分散词语激活
patterns.trigger: `could you try the other one`、`constructive talks`；`they are playing well`、`plenty of rubber`
patterns.context: 连贯英文句子中多个常见词和内容词均有激活；两段语义与文体不同，没有明显共同关键词
patterns.domain: EuroParl 对话/议会发言；Pile-CC 体育评论

patterns.name: 技术专名与专利术语
patterns.context: 描述数字 PLL 电路及错误锁定现象的技术性说明文本

patterns.name: 其他碎片化强激活
patterns.context: 除各段所体现的主题外，最强激活具体落在不同专名或内容词上；缺少能由这些触发词单独归纳的统一条件
patterns.domain: 网页路径/图片 URL；议会人名；体育评论；专利技术文本

en.description: Activations fall mainly on subword fragments in code identifiers, and also appear at structured-field boundaries in tables and email headers; a few common short words and SQL VALUES placeholders also activate, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of code identifiers
patterns.context: Word fragments in continuous code identifiers, especially within or toward the end of camel-case or long identifiers; activation falls on subwords, often alongside adjacent code symbols.

patterns.name: Field values or boundaries in structured text
patterns.context: In structured text such as date tables and email headers, activations concentrate on special values, field content, or address fragments rather than ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Frequent function words/phrases near sentence ends
patterns.context: Common short words in natural-language sentences, occurring in later parts of sentences; there are only a few examples, making finer semantic or syntactic conditions difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Data-value placeholder fragments in SQL statements
patterns.context: The VALUES clause and the formatted placeholders following it in SQL INSERT statements.

5_456.concept: 文本中的局部片段边界
5_456.description: 激活主要落在代码标识符的子词片段上，也出现在表格、邮件头等结构化字段边界；另有少量自然语言短词及 SQL VALUES 占位符激活，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.trigger: 标识符或驼峰命名内部的片段，如 «Prep»10«are»、«Program»7«Start»、«Playback»10«Connection»、«Instance»6«Ready»、«strings»6«hare»
patterns.context: 代码中连续标识符的词片段，尤其是驼峰名称或长标识符的内部/后部；激活落在子词上，常伴随相邻代码符号。

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的字段值或边界
patterns.context: 日期表格、邮件头等结构化文本中，激活集中在特殊值、字段内容或地址片段，而非普通叙述。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 表格与邮件元数据

patterns.name: 句末高频功能词/短语
patterns.context: 自然语言句子中的常见短词，出现在句子后段；仅有少数例子，难以确定更细的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: SQL 语句中的数据值占位片段
patterns.context: SQL INSERT 语句中，VALUES 子句及其后面的格式化占位符。

en.concept: Proper names and numeric fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations occur across code and LaTeX identifiers, numbers and operators in math problems, device documentation links, patent hierarchy fields, and coordinate values; no specific word class or domain explains all the spans.

patterns.name: Identifiers and API names in code
patterns.context: In code or LaTeX commands, activations often fall on internal case-based fragments, word endings, or parts of API names; no fixed language or particular identifier is required.

patterns.name: Prime-checking Q&A
patterns.context: A short math Q&A asks whether a number is prime and then gives True/False; activation also extends to digit strings and operators in the question.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Numbers are presented in fragments in math problems or arithmetic expressions; activations are dispersed across numeric fragments, symbols, and question text, not just prime-number problems.

patterns.name: Questions about digit places
patterns.context: Asks for the ones or tens digit of an expression, followed by a brief numeric answer.

patterns.name: Device command types and link markup
patterns.context: Explains the types of commands a device accepts and cites the type name using documentation link markup.

patterns.name: Patent hierarchy field descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the hierarchical meaning of a field value and references patent figures and profile information fields.

patterns.name: Coordinates and decimal values
patterns.context: Lists decimal values or coordinate-style data beginning with v; activations concentrate on numeric fragments.

5_456.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与数值片段
5_456.description: 激活分布于代码与LaTeX标识符、数学题的数字及运算符、设备文档链接、专利层级字段和坐标数值；没有一个特定词类或领域能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与 API 名称
patterns.context: 在代码或 LaTeX 命令中，激活常落在标识符内部的大小写片段、词尾或 API 名称各部分；不要求固定语言或某一特定标识符。

patterns.name: 素数判定问答
patterns.context: 短数学问答中提出某数是否为素数，随后给出 True/False；触发还延伸到题目里的数字串与运算符。

patterns.name: 算术题中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数学题或算术表达式中，数字被分段呈现；激活分散于数字片段、符号与问题文本，不限于素数题。

patterns.name: 数字位数问答
patterns.context: 询问表达式的个位或十位，之后给出简短数字答案。

patterns.name: 设备命令类型与链接标记
patterns.context: 说明设备可接受的命令类型，并以文档链接标记引用类型名。
patterns.domain: Github 技术说明/代码注释

patterns.name: 专利层级字段说明
patterns.context: 描述字段值对应的层级含义，并引用专利附图及 profile 信息字段。

patterns.name: 坐标与小数数值
patterns.context: 连续列出带小数的数值或以 v 开头的坐标样式数据；激活集中于数字片段。
patterns.domain: Github 中的数值/几何数据

en.description: Activations often fall on internal fragments of multi-token words or adjacent subwords, especially in code identifiers, personal names, and proper nouns; they also appear in common English words, academic terminology, and URLs/hashes. There is no stable semantic or syntactic theme.

patterns.name: Target substrings split within words
patterns.context: Strong activations concentrate on the latter parts of complete words or names, internal word fragments, and adjacent fragments; no specific syntactic position or semantic category is required

patterns.name: Identifiers and code fragments
patterns.context: Camel-case or underscore-separated identifiers, type names, constants, and function calls in code; activations fall on internal identifier fragments

patterns.name: URLs/hashes composed of digits and punctuation
patterns.context: Continuous non-lexical strings in URL paths, including digits, hexadecimal characters, and slashes

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of personal and proper names
patterns.context: Personal names split into multiple tokens; sometimes mixed with other ordinary text

patterns.name: Ordinary English words and phrases
patterns.context: Common words or phrases in natural language, including comments, dialogue, and parliamentary speech, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Academic terminology
patterns.context: Terms and their internal subword fragments in theoretical physics abstracts

5_456.description: 激活常落在多 token 词的内部片段或相邻子词上，尤见代码标识符、人名和专名；也出现在普通英文词、学术术语及 URL/哈希中。没有稳定的语义或句法主题。

patterns.name: 词内切分出的目标子串
patterns.trigger: 词内部的子词边界，如 «Prep»10«are»、«Program»8«Start»10、«Miss»5«ing»；也包括名字或术语的片段，如 «War»…«ne»、«Mink»…«owski»
patterns.context: 强激活集中在完整词或名称的后半部分、词内片段及其相邻片段上；不要求特定句法位置或语义类别

patterns.name: 标识符及代码片段
patterns.context: 代码中的驼峰式或下划线式标识符、类型名、常量和函数调用；激活落在标识符内部片段

patterns.name: 数字与标点构成的 URL/哈希
patterns.context: URL 路径中连续数字、十六进制字符及斜杠等非词汇串

patterns.name: 人名及专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名被切分成多个 token；有时与其他普通文本混杂
patterns.domain: 论坛、议会记录、娱乐文本

patterns.name: 英文普通词与短语
patterns.context: 自然语言中的普通词或短语，涵盖评论、对话及议会发言，未见一致语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 网页评论、论坛、议会文本

patterns.name: 学术术语
patterns.context: 理论物理摘要中的术语及其词内子词片段

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and arithmetic, segmented technical identifiers, rare words or proper-name fragments, some quantity phrases, and code-formatting markers. They span domains and lack a single stable semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers, arithmetic, and question punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers or symbols embedded in arithmetic, dates/times, identifiers, or questions; activation is not limited to numbers and also involves punctuation and neighboring tokens.
patterns.domain: Math problems, dates/times, and numbered text

patterns.name: Segmented tokens in technical identifiers
patterns.context: Strong activations occur when identifiers in code, field names, macros, or error messages are split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, software error logs, code

patterns.name: Quoted or proper-name fragments in colloquial narrative
patterns.context: Rare quoted words or names split into fragments appear in English narrative; activation falls on local tokens within words.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, people and entertainment content

patterns.name: Local emphasis in quantity or degree expressions
patterns.context: Natural-language sentences contain quantities, degree expressions, or noun phrases; activation concentrates on individual words in the phrase, with no stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Indentation, line breaks, and code formatting
patterns.context: Code or code-like text contains line breaks, indentation, and escape characters; formatting markers alone cannot explain all high activations.

5_456.concept: 混杂的局部 token 模式
5_456.description: 激活分布在数字与算式、被拆分的技术标识符、罕见词或专名片段，以及部分数量短语和代码排版标记；跨领域明显，缺少单一稳定语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字、算式与问句标点
patterns.context: 数字或符号嵌在算术、日期时间、编号或问句中，激活并不只落在数字上，也涉及标点和邻近 token
patterns.domain: 数学题、时间日期及编号文本

patterns.name: 技术标识符中的分段 token
patterns.trigger: “profile_tier_level”“dbCaps97Data”“SUB_CMD_ID_H2C_LOOPBACK”等带下划线、大小写切分或数字的串
patterns.context: 代码、字段名、宏或错误信息中，标识符被拆成多个 token 时出现强激活
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、软件错误日志、代码

patterns.name: 口语叙述中的引用或专名片段
patterns.context: 英文叙述中出现带引号的罕见词，或人名被拆分成片段；激活落在词内局部 token
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、人物与娱乐内容

patterns.name: 数量或程度表达中的局部强调
patterns.trigger: “plenty of rubber”“a tool box”“some nights they still”
patterns.context: 自然语言句子中出现数量、程度或名词短语，激活集中在短语中的个别词，未见稳定句法条件

patterns.name: 缩进、换行与代码排版
patterns.context: 代码或类代码文本带有换行、缩进和转义符；仅有排版标记不足以解释全部高激活

en.concept: Responses to short tokens and text fragments
en.description: Activations are dispersed across English word fragments, punctuation boundaries, and alphanumeric strings, spanning fiction reviews, patents, code, mathematics, and URLs. The examples lack stable semantics or consistent formatting; some patterns may be coincidental subword/token overlaps.

patterns.name: Cross-word fragments and word endings
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across ordinary words, proper nouns, and split subwords, without depending on a fixed word meaning; they commonly occur in a continuous sequence of tokens in text.

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Activations appear at punctuation, line breaks, and quotation boundaries; some strong activations are near sentence endings or colons, but not all boundaries consistently trigger them.
patterns.domain: Narrative, dialogue, quotations, code, and problem text

patterns.name: Alphanumeric and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Some short fragments activate in URLs/hashes, program identifiers, mathematical expressions, and digit strings; no unified semantic or formatting condition is evident.
patterns.domain: URLs, code, math problems, and text containing numbers

patterns.name: Natural-language function and common words
patterns.context: Appear sporadically in coherent English sentences; many unmarked words of the same types also occur in the same passages, so this does not establish a stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Possibly repeated subword strings
patterns.context: Some fragments occur in sentences, hyphenated proper names, URLs, or paths, but cross-context evidence is insufficient; they may simply be coincidental tokenizer fragment overlaps.

5_456.concept: 短 token 与文本片段响应
5_456.description: 激活分散于英文词片段、标点边界及字母数字串；跨小说评论、专利、代码、数学、网址等语域。各例缺少稳定语义或一致格式，部分模式可能只是子词/token 偶合。

patterns.name: 跨词片段与词尾
patterns.trigger: 多个词内部的子词片段，如 « they», « are», « playing»；以及词尾/续接片段如 «ies», «ne», «io»
patterns.context: 激活分布在普通词、专名和被拆分的子词上，并不依赖某个固定词义；常见于文本中连续出现的一串 token。

patterns.name: 标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 标点、换行和引文边界处可见激活；有些高激活紧邻句末或冒号，但并非所有边界都稳定触发。
patterns.domain: 叙述、对话、引用、代码及题目文本

patterns.name: 字母数字与标识符片段
patterns.context: 在网址/哈希、程序标识符、数学表达式和数字串中，若干短片段获得激活；未见统一的语义或格式条件。
patterns.domain: 网址、代码、数学题及含数字文本

patterns.name: 自然语言功能词及常见词
patterns.context: 在连贯英文句子中零散出现；同一批段落中也有大量未标记的相同类型词，不能据此认定稳定的词汇触发。

patterns.name: 疑似重复的子词串
patterns.trigger: « to»、«-»、«/» 等短 token 或片段
patterns.context: 部分片段可在句子、连字符专名、网址或路径中出现，但跨场景证据不足，可能只是偶然的 tokenizer 片段重合。

en.description: Activations are scattered across high-frequency words, phrases, and internal word fragments in English texts from many domains, with occasional abbreviations, questions, quotation formats, proper names, and code. Triggers across domain-specific vocabulary are sporadic; no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Consecutive words and common phrases
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across consecutive or adjacent words in natural language, often involving function words, phrase-internal words, and ordinary content words; there is no stable single lexical trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, forum discussions, comments, and narratives

patterns.name: English negation and contractions
patterns.context: Complete negative words or parts of apostrophe contractions and neighboring words are activated; activation is not limited to apostrophes or any one contraction form.
patterns.domain: Colloquial English, forum discussions, and narratives

patterns.name: Questions and interrogative contexts
patterns.context: Interrogative structures, modals, or question-related words are activated, but not all question words or question marks are consistently prominent.

patterns.name: Quotation and dialogue formats
patterns.context: Activations appear near forum quotations, replies, or line breaks; many also occur within quoted text, so the pattern cannot be reduced to formatting markers alone.

patterns.name: Proper names, titles, and internal word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations sometimes occur inside proper names or multiword names, often at token boundaries or near names; there is no common name category.
patterns.domain: Entertainment reviews, film bibliographies, software Q&A, and code

patterns.name: Code syntax and punctuation
patterns.context: Scattered activations near assignments, loops, conditions, fields or method calls, and operators in Go code blocks.

patterns.name: Subwords or boundary fragments within words
patterns.context: A part of a segmented word is marked individually, often alongside the complete word or neighboring fragments; examples show no stable semantic category.
patterns.domain: English text, proper names, and colloquial vocabulary

patterns.name: Hockey narrative vocabulary
patterns.context: Multiple activations occur in descriptions of team performance, goalies, and the puck during games, but these words have no clear connection to triggers in other passages.

patterns.name: Robots and tools
patterns.context: Phrase and action words are activated when discussing machine intelligence enabling robots to autonomously find and use tools.

patterns.name: Album and music reviews
patterns.context: Related nouns, adjectives, and neighboring words are activated when evaluating album versions, playback noise, and musical dynamics.

patterns.name: Policy and app discussions
patterns.context: Activations occur in discussions of policy, Apple, and restricting a particular messaging app; they resemble ordinary conversational word distributions and show no specialized semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Kite action vocabulary
patterns.context: A few activations occur in questions and quotations about kite activities, forces, and control actions.

patterns.name: Spirituality and bibliography vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations occur in contexts involving spiritual book recommendations and psychological-center awakening; no clear connection to patterns in other domains.

patterns.name: Recruitment and player contact
patterns.context: Activations occur while discussing whether a coach contacted or offered an opportunity to a player.

patterns.name: Software documentation and imports
patterns.context: Activations occur in questions about obtaining code, imports, and related documentation.

5_456.description: 激活散布于多领域英语文本的高频词、短语和词内片段，偶见缩写、问句、引述格式、专名及代码；各领域词汇触发零散，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 连续词语与常用短语
patterns.context: 激活分布在自然语言中连续或相邻的词语上，常见于功能词、短语内部及普通实词；没有稳定的单一词汇触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言、论坛对话、评论及叙述

patterns.name: 英语否定与缩写形式
patterns.context: 完整否定词或带撇号缩写中的一部分及其邻近词有激活；激活并不只落在撇号或某一种缩写上。
patterns.domain: 口语化英语、论坛讨论与叙述

patterns.name: 问句和疑问语境
patterns.trigger: “Was there a ...?”、“I can grab ...?”、“Is there anywhere I can find ...?”
patterns.context: 疑问句中的疑问结构、情态或问句相关词出现激活，但并非所有疑问词或问句标点都稳定突出。

patterns.name: 引述与对话格式
patterns.context: 论坛引用、回复或换行附近可见激活；但也有许多激活位于引述正文，无法归结为格式标记本身。

patterns.name: 专名、作品名及内部词界
patterns.context: 专名或多词名称内部有时出现激活，常在 token 拆分处或名称邻近位置；没有共同的名称类别。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、电影书目、软件问答和代码

patterns.name: 代码语法与标点
patterns.context: Go 代码块中，赋值、循环、条件、字段或方法调用及运算符附近有零散激活。

patterns.name: 词内子词或边界碎片
patterns.context: 拆分词的一部分被单独标记，常与完整词或相邻片段共同出现；不同例子之间未见稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 英语文本、专名及口语词汇

patterns.name: 冰球叙述词汇

No clear semantic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: Brigade following a numeric designation

patterns.name: polishing process
