en.description: Activations occur across varied corpora and word classes, often within words or at adjacent word boundaries. Identifiable local themes include polishing patents, mechanical fit, biomedicine, mathematical definitions, negotiations, encyclopedia narratives, and statements of purpose, but they lack a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments and adjacent word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation is inconsistently distributed across within-word fragments, whole words, or inter-word boundaries; these examples have no consistent lexical or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Mixed domains, including biomedicine, patents, encyclopedias, and administrative text

patterns.name: Polishing and planarization patent terminology
patterns.context: Describes polishing, planarization, and related equipment or slurry for workpieces or semiconductor surfaces.

patterns.name: Segmented biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Biomedical vocabulary is split into subword fragments, with activation at different positions within words.

patterns.name: Equipment components and fit in patents
patterns.context: Describes mechanical devices, rotating components, or the fit between a plug and socket after wear.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and geometric properties
patterns.context: Defines or precisely describes the geometric properties of convex bodies and optimal fitting.

patterns.name: Article titles and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on segmented proper names or title-character fragments; context is insufficient to determine more specific conditions.

patterns.name: Trade phrases in negotiation research
patterns.context: Discusses parallel bilateral negotiations and a case-study framework.

patterns.name: Organizations and quotations in encyclopedia narratives
patterns.context: Military-related narrative excerpts containing ranks, unit names, or introductions to quotations; the passage also includes company and product names.

patterns.name: Ordinal structure in statements of purpose
patterns.context: Outlines the purpose of a component and begins to enumerate its objectives.

5_702.concept: 词形/子词片段的混合响应

patterns.context: 出现在词内或词首附近，跨越不同词形和语境；不要求固定句法
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、生物医学摘要、歌曲/歌词标题

patterns.name: “three”数量词
patterns.context: “three”作为数量词，分别修饰 “important purposes” 和连字符复合词 “three-dimensional”

patterns.name: “dust”及其复合形式
patterns.context: 描述尘埃污染或无尘状态

patterns.name: 若干专利/技术词项
patterns.context: 这些词项各自出现于不同短语中，缺少共同的明显语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 学术谈判文本、网页短语

patterns.name: 技术文体中的分词激活
patterns.context: 与专利或技术描述相邻，但激活分散在多个普通词上，难以确认独立规则

en.description: Activations are scattered across the substring ok in proper names and technical terms, numbers and identifiers, legal docket formats, and different subwords in titles, research descriptions, patent descriptions, and encyclopedia articles. There is no single stable semantic or stylistic trigger.

patterns.name: The character fragment “ok” in proper names
patterns.context: The letter sequence ok occurs within a word, or at the beginning of the colloquial spelling “okay” in [2]; the surrounding text is often a personal name, place name, or biomedical term, and is usually a tokenizer-split subword. In [2], ok independently forms the beginning of a colloquial word.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic proper names, biomedical terms, email colloquialisms; in [2], ok is the beginning of an independent colloquial word.

patterns.name: Identifiers or number strings containing digits
patterns.context: Digits appear in titles, citation numbers, legal case/document numbers, or time expressions; they may be adjacent to punctuation, letters, or spaces.
patterns.domain: Web titles, legal documents, email timestamps.

patterns.name: Legal docket format markers
patterns.context: Space padding in legal records appears adjacent to Case/Document fields and numbers.

patterns.name: Word-initial subwords in titles or names
patterns.context: Activation falls near subword boundaries in title words; the unmarked remainder completes common English words.

patterns.name: Words in paper-style section prose
patterns.context: In formal prose in a technical description, a term at the start of a sentence is followed by a verb and a quantity expression.

patterns.name: Numerical legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers are adjacent to abbreviations and page numbers from federal case reporters, followed by a court name.

patterns.name: Model appearance in clothing/product descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background text describes the appearance or shape of a model figure.

patterns.name: Line-separated encyclopedia entry names
patterns.context: A person’s name or airport name appears as a title or entry, followed by a line break or blank line.

5_702.description: 激活分散于专名及术语中的 ok 子串、数字与编号、法律案卷格式，以及标题、科研说明、专利描述和百科条目中的不同子词；没有单一稳定的语义或文体触发器。

patterns.name: 专名中的「ok」字符片段
patterns.context: 词内出现字母序列 ok，或在[2]中出现在口语化拼写「okay」开头；周围常是人名、地名或生物医学术语，且多为分词器切分出的子词。
patterns.domain: 百科专名、生物医学术语、电子邮件口语；[2]中 ok 独立构成口语词首。

patterns.name: 含数字的编号或数字串
patterns.context: 数字出现在标题、引文编号、法律案件/文件编号或时间表达中；数字可与标点、字母或空格相连。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、法律文书、电子邮件时间。

patterns.name: 法律案卷格式标记
patterns.context: 法律记录中的空格填充与 Case/Document 字段及编号相邻。

patterns.name: 标题或名称中的词首子词
patterns.context: 激活落在标题词语的子词边界附近；未标记部分补全常见英文词。
patterns.domain: 网络标题或宣传性短句。

patterns.name: 论文式章节正文词语
patterns.context: 技术说明的正式散文句中，句首术语之后接动词和数量表达。

patterns.name: 数字化法律引文
patterns.context: 数字与联邦判例汇编缩写、页码相邻，随后出现法院名称。

patterns.name: 服装/产品描述中的人物造型
patterns.context: 专利背景文字描述模型人物的外形或形状。

patterns.name: 换行分隔的百科条目名称
patterns.context: 人名或机场名称以标题/条目形式出现，名称后有换行或空行。

en.description: All excerpts strongly activate at may; various verbs or auxiliary verbs can follow, expressing conjecture, possibility, reference, impact, composition, or reader prompts across diverse domains and syntactic complements.

patterns.name: Possibility expressions following modal may
patterns.context: Activates mainly on the modal verb may, especially when it introduces a statement about a subsequent event, property, or possible explanation; it can be followed directly by a verb or by auxiliaries such as have／be.
patterns.domain: News, research abstracts, patents, encyclopedias, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: may followed by be
patterns.context: be follows may directly, indicating a possible state, property, or result; seen in patent structural descriptions, medical statements, and informational descriptions.

patterns.name: may have been
patterns.context: The perfect form have been follows may to conjecture about a past cause or fact.

patterns.name: may play
patterns.context: play follows may to indicate that a factor may have a role.

patterns.name: may reduce
patterns.context: reduce follows may to propose that an intervention may lower risk.

patterns.name: may refer to
patterns.context: may refer to follows a person's name to introduce possible referents; activation also covers the preceding name and line-break formatting.

patterns.name: may pose
patterns.context: pose follows may to indicate that a process may present a challenge.

patterns.name: may contain
patterns.context: contain follows may to describe possible components of a device or carrier.

patterns.name: Low-intensity may recall
patterns.context: recall follows may in a reader-facing prompt suggesting that the reader might remember something; activation is weaker than the strongest triggers in this set.

5_702.description: 所有片段均在 may 处强激活；后续可接多种动词或助动词，表达推测、可能性、指代、影响、组成或读者提示，领域与句法补语多样。

patterns.name: 情态 may 后的可能性表达
patterns.context: 主要激活于情态动词 may，尤其是它引出对后续事件、属性或可能解释的陈述；可直接接动词，也可接 have/be 等助动词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科研摘要、专利、百科及一般说明文

patterns.name: may 后接 be
patterns.context: may 后直接接 be，表示可能状态、性质或结果；见于专利结构描述、医学陈述及信息描述。

patterns.name: may have been
patterns.context: may 后接完成式 have been，推测过去原因或事实。

patterns.name: may play
patterns.context: may 后接 play，说明某因素可能发挥作用。

patterns.name: may reduce
patterns.context: may 后接 reduce，提出某干预可能降低风险。

patterns.name: may refer to
patterns.context: 人物姓名后接 may refer to，引出名称的可能指代对象；激活也覆盖前面的姓名及换行格式。

patterns.name: may pose
patterns.context: may 后接 pose，指出某过程可能带来挑战。

patterns.name: may contain
patterns.context: may 后接 contain，描述设备或载体可能包含的组成。

patterns.name: 低强度 may recall
patterns.context: may 后接 recall，面向读者提示其可能记得某事；强度低于同批最强触发。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论或面向读者的叙述

en.concept: Normative follow-up actions in formal texts
en.description: The most stable trigger is shall expressing an obligation or command in legal documents, especially court procedures, filing deadlines, jurisdiction, acceptance, and issuance rules; other examples include partnership clauses, line-break formatting, and sporadic historical, popular-science, and abstract texts, which do not all fit a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Requirements or commands following shall
patterns.context: In legal documents, court orders, or rules, shall is followed by an action that a court, party, or clerk must perform; it also appears in the future-tense expression “we shall call” in a general paper.
patterns.domain: Primarily FreeLaw legal documents; also ArXiv abstracts

patterns.name: Formatting and phrasing in court procedural documents
patterns.context: Court orders, appellate procedures, rules, or decisions, often with line breaks, indentation, and formal procedural language; associated with shall triggers, but not every passage contains shall.

patterns.name: Timing, deadlines, and procedural arrangements
patterns.context: Describes filing deadlines, extensions, durations, or the start time of a procedure; often seen in court orders.

patterns.name: Formation clauses for property／partnership relations
patterns.context: Provides that a partnership is formed immediately when multiple people hold shares and is governed by an agreement.

patterns.name: Duration expression following a coronation
patterns.context: A historical account describes a person dying two and a half days after being crowned; no clear connection to the court-order pattern.

patterns.name: Court retains jurisdiction
patterns.context: An order provides that the court retains jurisdiction during a specified matter.

patterns.name: Record requires further development and response ordered
patterns.context: A criminal procedure ruling requires the record to be supplemented and directs the trial court to take further action.

patterns.name: Popular-science account of appetite and weight
patterns.context: Explains satiety signaling mechanisms and their relevance to suppressing appetite, weight, or eating problems.

patterns.name: Clerk accepts filings and court issues orders
patterns.context: Rules or regulations provide for a clerk to accept prisoner cases or for a court to issue an order after a complaint is filed.

5_702.concept: 正式文本中的规范性后续动作
5_702.description: 最稳定触发是法律文书中表示义务或命令的 shall，尤见法院程序、提交期限、管辖权、受理与签发规定；另有合伙条款、换行格式及零散的历史、科普和摘要文本，不能全归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: shall 后接规定或命令内容
patterns.context: 法律、法院命令或规则中，shall 后接法院、当事人或书记员必须执行的动作；也出现于一般论文中的将来表达 “we shall call”。
patterns.domain: 主要为 FreeLaw 法律文书；另见 ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 法院程序文书中的格式与措辞
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«     »、«¶» 及其邻近的法院／brief／motion／Court 等词
patterns.context: 法院命令、上诉程序、规则或判决文本，常有换行、缩进和正式程序表述；与 shall 触发相伴，但不要求每段都有 shall。

patterns.name: 时间、期限及程序安排
patterns.context: 叙述提交期限、延长期限、持续期间或程序启动时点；多见法院命令。

patterns.name: 产权／合伙关系的成立条款
patterns.context: 规定多人持有股份时合伙关系随即成立并受协议约束。

patterns.name: 冠礼及其后的时长表达
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述人物在加冕后两天半去世；与法律命令模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 法院保留管辖权
patterns.trigger: «Court of Common Pleas shall retain jurisdiction»
patterns.context: 命令规定法院在特定事项期间继续保有管辖权。

patterns.name: 记录需进一步完善及下令回应
patterns.trigger: «record should be further developed»；«trial court shall order»
patterns.context: 刑事程序裁定中要求补充记录，并指示审判法院采取后续行动。

patterns.name: 食欲与体重科普叙述
patterns.context: 说明饱腹信号机制及其对抑制食欲、体重或饮食问题的意义。

patterns.name: 书记员受理文件及法院签发命令
patterns.trigger: «Clerk shall accept»；«court shall issue an order»
patterns.context: 规则或法规规定书记员受理囚犯案件，或法院在提交诉状后签发命令。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 地方法规／程序规则

en.description: Activations are scattered across several local English collocations: the superlative closest, the encyclopedia disambiguation phrase may refer to, emphatic uses of ever, and specific phrases in legal, script, and license texts. There is no apparent shared theme or stable syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: English superlative closest followed by a noun
patterns.context: closest modifies a following noun to express the highest degree of relation or similarity; these two activations are concentrated on closest itself.

patterns.name: may refer to in entry-style definitions
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry title is followed by “may refer to,” introducing a disambiguation list of names, terms, or abbreviations.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of ever
patterns.context: ever appears in expressions emphasizing an extreme or continuing state; one instance occurs in a negative／threatening future expression, and another means as always.

patterns.name: The collocation mutually exclusive
patterns.context: mutually modifies exclusive to describe two configuration options that cannot both hold.

patterns.name: may not in file license terms
patterns.context: A license statement uses may not use to impose a restriction on use.

patterns.name: petitioners in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Refers to the three parties in a legal proceeding involving an involuntary petition.

5_702.description: 激活分散在若干英文局部搭配：closest 最高级、百科消歧句式 may refer to、ever 强调用法，以及法律、脚本和许可文本中的特定词组。没有明显共享的主题或稳定句法模式。

patterns.name: 英文最高级 closest 与后续名词
patterns.context: closest 修饰后续名词，表达关系或相似程度的最高级；这两处激活集中在 closest 本身。

patterns.name: 条目式释义中的 may refer to
patterns.context: 百科条目标题后接“may refer to”，引出名称、词项或缩写的消歧列表。

patterns.name: ever 的强调用法
patterns.context: ever 出现在强调极端或持续状态的表达中；一处嵌于否定/威胁式将来表达，一处表示一如既往。
patterns.domain: 法律判决引述；文学叙述

patterns.name: mutually exclusive 搭配
patterns.context: mutually 修饰 exclusive，描述两个配置项不能同时成立。
patterns.domain: GitHub shell 脚本错误提示

patterns.name: 文件许可条款中的 may not
patterns.context: 许可声明以 may not use 规定使用限制。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码版权/许可证头

patterns.name: 法律程序中的 petitioners
patterns.context: involuntary petition 的法律程序叙述中，指提出申请的三方。

en.description: All excerpts discuss constitutional issues in U.S. legal documents, with activation concentrated on the word “constitutional” and its legal context; specific collocations cover rights, issues, challenges, constitutional homesteads, and judicial authority.

patterns.name: Constitution-related terms
patterns.context: Legal discussion includes constitutional issues, rights, challenges, property regimes, or judicial authority; often occurs mid-sentence alongside legal terms
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

5_702.description: 所有片段都在美国法律文书中讨论宪法问题，激活集中在“constitutional”一词及其法律语境；其具体搭配涵盖权利、问题、挑战、宪法性宅地与司法权限。

patterns.name: 宪法相关术语
patterns.trigger: “constitutional”及其后接法律名词，如“constitutional question”“constitutional right”“constitutional challenge”“constitutional homestead”“constitutional power”
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现宪法问题、权利、挑战、财产制度或司法权限；常见于句中，前后带法律术语

en.description: Most examples come from legal documents, with activations on procedural and review language, party claims, and uses of subject／within; other examples include statements or quotations, subject in online comments, and a novel's call to parents, making a single semantic pattern difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Procedural phrasing in legal opinions
patterns.context: Activations fall on procedural language, standards of review, motions, or argumentative relations in legal documents; also includes “subject-intitle requirement” in a legal provision.
patterns.domain: Court decisions, appeals, and legal pleadings

patterns.name: Parties and case statements in legal pleadings
patterns.context: When legal documents describe party identities, burdens of proof, requests, or claims, activation often falls on words expressing obligation or connecting claims.

patterns.name: The word form subject and its contexts
patterns.context: subject and its compounds or fixed expressions occur in legal passages; paragraph 2 also contains “grasp of the subject,” with activation on subject.

patterns.name: within in noun phrases
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed expressions “the within motion” and “within the entire court-martial” in court rulings, referring respectively to the motion in the case and the overall context.

patterns.name: Quotation／citation contexts in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a text mentions or directly presents a passage, statement, or quotation; examples appear in both legal decisions and narrative texts.

patterns.name: subject in non-legal online comments
patterns.context: A commenter says that another person understands a topic; activation falls on subject and is not clearly related to the adjacent discussion of Islamophobia.

patterns.name: Word forms related to forms of address or possession
patterns.context: In a narrative, a child calls for their mother as the father is about to arrive; activation is concentrated on the address term Mother.

patterns.name: Possible formatting noise in legal documents
patterns.context: Paragraphs 4, 5, and 6 contain page numbers, paragraph markers, page breaks, or layout whitespace; weaker activations also occur at these positions, but there is no consistent semantic trigger.

5_702.concept: 法律文书措辞与局部搭配
5_702.description: 多数样例来自法律文书，激活落在程序与审查措辞、当事人主张及 subject/within 等用语；另见陈述或引语、网络评论中的 subject，以及小说对父母的呼喊，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的程序性措辞
patterns.trigger: “subject … requirement”“subject to … review”“within motion”“in light of [their] context within the entire court-martial”等
patterns.context: 激活落在法律文书的程序、审查标准、动议或论证关系用语上；也包括法律条文中的“subject-intitle requirement”。
patterns.domain: 法院判决、上诉及法律诉讼文书

patterns.name: 诉讼文书中的当事人及案件陈述
patterns.trigger: “must establish”“on behalf of the Estate”“Appellant seeks”“appellants, must believe”等
patterns.context: 法律文书中描述当事人身份、举证责任、请求或主张时，常激活在表示义务或连接主张的词上。

patterns.name: subject 词形及其语境
patterns.context: 法律段落中出现 subject 及其复合形式或固定搭配；第2段也有“grasp of the subject”，但激活在 subject。
patterns.domain: 法律文本；另有网络评论

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 within
patterns.context: 出现在法院裁定的固定表达“the within motion”以及“within the entire court-martial”中，分别指本案动议和整体语境。

patterns.name: 裁判意见中的引用／引述语境
patterns.context: 文本在提及或直接呈现某段话、陈述或引语时出现激活；法律判决与叙事文本均有例子。

patterns.name: 非法律网络评论中的 subject
patterns.context: 评论者称对方理解某个主题，激活落在 subject；与相邻的 Islamophobia 论述无明显关联。

patterns.name: 人物称谓或所有格相关词形
patterns.context: 叙事中孩子喊母亲、父亲将要到来；激活集中在称呼语 Mother。

patterns.name: 可能的法律文书格式噪声
patterns.context: 第4、5、6段包含页码、段落标记、分页符或排版空白；这些位置也有较弱激活，但缺乏一致语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 扫描／排版后的法律文本

en.description: Activations are concentrated on multiple uses of subject: legal jurisdiction, the entity governed by subject to, and a topic or research object; the word Objectors in conscientious objectors also activates strongly.

patterns.name: The legal term subject-matter jurisdiction
patterns.context: Appears in federal court litigation or decision narratives, often near want of, jurisdiction, suit, court, and related words; paragraph 4 contains the split-token form subject matter.

patterns.name: subject to meaning governed by or applicable to
patterns.context: subject is followed by to, introducing a person or thing governed by a rule, restriction, condition, or scope of applicability; the specific meanings differ across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedia entries, religious and folk-custom descriptions

patterns.name: subject(s) meaning topic or object
patterns.context: subject refers to a topic, research object, or object in philosophical ontology; includes a single-issue rule in a legal context and a title use of object-oriented.

patterns.name: conscientious objectors
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a guidebook for Jewish draft registrants, referring to people who conscientiously refuse military service; Objectors is an independent lexical sense, not an object-oriented use.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia bibliography, religion, and social issues

5_702.description: 激活集中于 subject 的多种用法：法律管辖权、subject to 的受约束对象、议题或研究对象；另对 conscientious objectors 一词中的 Objectors 强烈激活。

patterns.name: subject-matter jurisdiction 法律术语
patterns.context: 出现在联邦法院诉讼或判决叙述中，常与 want of、jurisdiction、suit、court 等词相邻；第4段是 subject matter 的分词断裂形式。

patterns.name: subject to 表示受制于或适用对象
patterns.context: subject 后接 to，引出受某规则、限制、条件或适用范围约束的人或事物；各段具体语义不同。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科条目、宗教民俗说明

patterns.name: subject(s) 表示议题或对象
patterns.context: subject 指议题、研究对象或哲学本体论中的对象；包括法律中的单一议题规则及 object-oriented 的标题用法。

patterns.name: conscientious objectors
patterns.context: 出现在犹太裔征兵登记者的指南书名中，指良心拒服兵役者；Objectors 是独立词义，不是 object-oriented 用法。
patterns.domain: 百科书目、宗教与社会议题

en.description: Activation fragments are scattered across law, academic catalogs, encyclopedias, blogs, and code. Prominent word forms include Object-related terms and Cross compounds, alongside formatting markers, judicial language, political chronologies, blog descriptions, and test code. No unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Object/Object-Oriented stems
patterns.context: The word or its compounds appear in bibliographic titles, academic discussion, code identifiers, or strings; no fixed syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: Cross compounds
patterns.context: “Cross” forms a hyphenated compound with the following word; it also occurs in legal judicial narratives.

patterns.name: Dense formatting markers and numbers
patterns.context: Catalog and bibliography excerpts with dense punctuation, numbers, and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Judicial language in court opinions
patterns.context: Legal opinions discuss parties, state immunity, and litigation jurisdiction.

patterns.name: Resignations and party changes in list entries
patterns.context: Political figures and their changes in office or party, listed by date.

patterns.name: Blog transitions and statements of purpose
patterns.context: A personal blog colloquially recounts experiences and then explains the blog’s purpose.

patterns.name: Test code and assertions
patterns.context: Assertions, test annotations, and related identifiers appear in test functions or test cases.

patterns.name: Column widths and spacing in formatting code
patterns.context: Code comments and function parameters discuss column widths, spaces, and minimum values.

patterns.name: Rhetorical commentary by researchers
patterns.context: Emphatic or sarcastic language is used when discussing researchers and views of knowledge.

5_702.description: 激活片段分散于法律、学术目录、百科、博客和代码；显著词形包括 Object/对象相关词及 Cross 复合词，也覆盖格式标记、司法措辞、政治年表、博客说明与测试代码，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Object/Object-Oriented 词干
patterns.context: 该词或其复合词出现在书目标题、学术论述、代码标识符或字符串中；不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 学术文献、文学批评、代码

patterns.name: Cross 复合词
patterns.context: “Cross”与后续词构成连字符复合词；也出现在法律裁判叙述中。

patterns.name: 密集格式标记及数字
patterns.trigger: “**Contents Vol. 25, 2016**”“No. 1”“1 Cross-Cultural Adaptation”；亦见“23, no. 3”“43, no. 2”
patterns.context: 目录、书目等排版或引文片段，标点、数字和格式标记密集。

patterns.name: 法院意见中的司法措辞
patterns.context: 法律意见讨论当事人、州豁免及诉讼管辖。

patterns.name: 名单条目的辞职与政党变动
patterns.context: 按日期列出的政治人物及其职务或党派变动。

patterns.name: 博客过渡与用途说明
patterns.trigger: “getting transitioned there”“This blog has two purposes”
patterns.context: 个人博客以口语回顾经历，继而说明博客用途。

patterns.name: 测试代码及断言
patterns.context: 测试函数或测试用例中出现断言、测试标注及相关标识符。

patterns.name: 排版代码中的空格列宽
patterns.trigger: “Always do at least MIN spaces”“COLUMN”“Lisp_Object col, minimum”
patterns.context: 代码注释与函数参数讨论列宽、空格和最小值。

patterns.name: 研究者修辞性评论
patterns.context: 论述研究者与知识观时使用强调或讽刺性措辞。

en.concept: Recognition of the word form Object
en.description: Most paragraphs activate on Object／object and its compounds or code identifiers, including code and object-oriented terminology; other sporadic activations include nature／subject in JSON, own in legal texts, and may in a quotation, which do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Object-related words
patterns.context: Forms vary in capitalization and code-identifier style; often occur in compounds, variable names, strings, or technical terms.
patterns.domain: Software code, computer-science academic texts, and literary criticism

patterns.name: JSON fields and category words
patterns.context: In JSON-style data, a field value or category name is marked; this differs from the Object word-form pattern.

patterns.name: own in a legal sentence
patterns.context: Appears in the possessive phrase “her own citizens.”

patterns.name: may in a quotation
patterns.context: Appears in a quotation about an individual possessing a weapon, expressing possibility or permission.

5_702.description: 多数段落在 Object/object 及其复合词或代码标识符处激活，涉及代码、面向对象术语等；另有 JSON 中的 nature/subject、法律文本 own、引文 may 等零散激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: Object 相关词
patterns.context: 大小写及代码标识符形式不一；常出现在复合词、变量名、字符串或技术术语中。

patterns.name: JSON 字段与类别词
patterns.context: JSON 样式数据中，字段值或类别名称被标记；与 Object 词形模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律句中的 own

patterns.name: 引文中的 may

en.concept: here (deictic reference to the current context)
en.description: Most passages highlight here, often referring to the current discussion or introducing what follows. Other sporadic activations include may, thoracic, discretion, crosshairs, numbers, and formatting fragments, which are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final here
patterns.context: here refers to the current discussion, situation, or material about to be explained; it often appears near the sentence end or in the “here are” construction.

patterns.name: Introducing the current example or statistic
patterns.context: here points to a following list, breakdown, or statistic; this pattern overlaps with the general use referring to the current situation.

patterns.name: Highlighted content with no clear relation to here
patterns.context: Activation occurs across different word classes and formats, with no stable shared trigger apparent in the local context.
patterns.domain: News links, code/configuration, bibliographies, and web text

5_702.description: 多数段落高亮 here，常指当前讨论或引出后文；另有 may、thoracic、discretion、crosshairs、数字及格式片段等零散激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 句末 here
patterns.trigger: “here”10，常见于 “Same experience here.”、“There are two issues here.”、“There are two possibilities here:” 和 “And here I was thinking…”
patterns.context: 句子或话语中用 here 指向当前讨论、当前情形或接下来要说明的内容；常靠近句末或出现在 “here are” 结构中。

patterns.name: 引出当前示例或统计
patterns.trigger: “here”10，后接 “are” 或其他说明内容，如 “here are the counts”
patterns.context: here 指向接下来的清单、拆解或统计；此模式与一般指当前处境的用法重叠。

patterns.name: 与 here 无明显关联的高亮内容
patterns.context: 激活出现在不同词类及格式中，局部上下文未显示稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻链接、代码/配置、书目及网页文本

en.description: The most prominent shared trigger is lowercase may, distributed across varied sentence structures and styles; other examples include Cross- in legal titles, a few addresses, sports terms, proper-name tokenization, layout boundaries, and sporadic common-word activations, with no clear semantic connection between these secondary patterns and may.

patterns.name: Positions containing may
patterns.context: Lowercase may appears mid-sentence, followed by a verb or adjective, expressing possibility, permission, or suggestion; occurs in both numbered entries and body text
patterns.domain: Various texts including news, encyclopedias, email, legal texts, and book reviews

patterns.name: Cross- terms in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal case titles or party listings, Cross- occurs within a compound litigation-role name

patterns.name: may near numeric or numbered boundaries
patterns.context: may is adjacent to a year, number, or other entry text, but the context remains an ordinary English sentence; boundaries and formatting vary

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in personal names or titles
patterns.context: Ordinary words in news headlines or body text, sometimes split into subword fragments; no stable semantic or syntactic conditions are apparent

patterns.name: Proper names and layout fragments
patterns.context: Proper-name tokenization and boundary tokens caused by web links, title line breaks, or encyclopedia entry formatting; activations are sporadic

patterns.name: Fifth in an address field

patterns.name: may 所在位置

patterns.name: 法律文书中的交叉上诉词

patterns.name: 数字或编号边界附近的 may

patterns.name: 人名或标题中的零散激活
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题或正文中的普通词，且有时被拆分成词片；未见稳定语义或句法条件

patterns.name: 专名与排版碎片
patterns.context: 网页链接、标题换行或百科条目格式造成的专名分词及边界 token；激活零散
