patterns.name: 项目符号及分隔线
patterns.context: 书籍/引文文本中的项目符号措辞或水平分隔线

en.description: Several passages activate on “Fourth/fourth” and its legal compound designations. Other activations involve numbers plus nouns, the tokenization of let’s, proper names in addresses, and several isolated word fragments; they cannot be grouped into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Spelling of the ordinal Fourth
patterns.context: Used as an ordinal modifier before a noun, or in short titles, dates, and labels; no specific meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Legal, news, encyclopedia, bibliographic, and general text

patterns.name: Fourth in legal phrases
patterns.context: Part of a litigant’s or court circuit’s name, often adjacent to a legal case title or citation.

patterns.name: Numeric or rank modifiers
patterns.context: A number, ordinal, or quantity word combines with a following noun; activation may fall on the following word and is not triggered only by Fourth.

patterns.name: Cross-token trigger in the English contraction let’s
patterns.context: A welcome message in a code string, where the apostrophe is split into a separate token; activation falls on let.

patterns.name: Numbers and word fragments in place-name addresses and proper names
patterns.context: Token fragments or numbers in addresses, floors, and organization names, with no stable local semantic relationship.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on isolated word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in a noun in an email, within a word in a religious history text, or in a phrase; no shared contextual condition is apparent.

5_702.description: 多段在“Fourth/fourth”及其法律复合称谓上激活；另有数字加名词、let’s 分词、地址专名和若干孤立词片激活，不能归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 序数 Fourth 的拼写
patterns.context: 在名词前作序数修饰语，或出现在简短标题、日期及标签中；不要求特定含义。
patterns.domain: 法律、新闻、百科、书目及一般文本

patterns.name: 法律短语中的 Fourth
patterns.context: 作为诉讼当事方或法院巡回区名称的一部分，常与法律案件标题或引注相邻。

patterns.name: 数字或等级修饰语
patterns.context: 数字、序数或数量词与后续名词组合；激活位置可落在后续词上，并非只由 Fourth 触发。

patterns.name: 英文分词 let’s 的跨 token 触发
patterns.context: 代码字符串中的欢迎语，撇号拆分成独立 token；激活落在 let 上。

patterns.name: 地名地址及专名中的数字、词片
patterns.context: 地址、楼层及机构名中的 token 片段或数字，缺乏稳定的局部语义关联。

patterns.name: 独立词片的零散激活
patterns.context: 分别处于邮件中的名词、宗教史文本中的词语内部或短语中，未见共同上下文条件。

en.description: Activations occur across diverse styles and topics, often on subword fragments within words or adjacent word segments. Local patterns include cricket first-class, criminal judgment wording, catalog entries, addresses, and discussions of firearms; they cannot be reduced to a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Specific word segments within phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall on part of a complete word or phrase, often with activation on the following segment as well; the triggering segments do not form a unified semantic category.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, Gutenberg novel catalogs, Enron emails, legal texts, and webpages

patterns.name: Cricket first-class matches
patterns.context: When describing historical cricket matches or player records, first-class modifies matches, competitions, or games.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports biographies and cricket history

patterns.name: Legal criminal judgment wording
patterns.context: Describes murder charges, life imprisonment without parole, appellate review, or criminal records in criminal cases.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of state names
patterns.context: Illinois appears split into subword fragments; one occurrence is in a place-name list and another in a link path.
patterns.domain: News link lists and Enron emails

patterns.name: Literary catalog entries
patterns.context: Bibliographic or catalog entries list titles and authors in aligned formatting.

patterns.name: Names, dates, and classical bibliography entries
patterns.context: Brief bibliographic entries give author, date, region, or work information.

patterns.name: Addresses in email signatures
patterns.context: The signature block after the email body contains an organization, street address, and floor.

patterns.name: Firearms and statements about personal discretion
patterns.context: Discusses the right and discretion to own or use firearms.

patterns.name: Doctrinal controversy and papal bulls
patterns.context: Describes controversy over the doctrine of apostolic poverty and how papal documents characterized it.

5_702.description: 激活分布在多种文体与主题中，常落在词语内部片段或相邻词段；可见板球 first-class、刑事判决措辞、目录条目、地址和枪支论述等局部模式，无法归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 短语内部的特定词段
patterns.trigger: “heresy”中的 «here»、«first-class» 中的 «first»、«May» 中的 «may»、以及 «struggle» 中的 «Stru»
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或词组的一部分，且通常紧随其后的词段也有激活；触发部分并不构成统一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、古腾堡小说目录、Enron 邮件、法律文本及网页

patterns.name: 板球 first-class 赛事
patterns.context: 描述历史板球比赛或球员履历时，first-class 修饰比赛、赛事或场次。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育传记与板球史

patterns.name: 法律刑事判决措辞
patterns.context: 刑事案件中说明谋杀罪名、无假释终身监禁、上诉审查或前科。

patterns.name: 州名的分词片段
patterns.context: Illinois 被拆成词段出现；一处在地名列表，一处在链接路径中。
patterns.domain: 新闻链接列表与 Enron 邮件

patterns.name: 文学作品目录条目
patterns.context: 书目或目录以作品名、作者名和对齐排版列出条目。

patterns.name: 人名、年代与古典书目条目
patterns.context: 简短参考书目条目给出作者、年代、地域或作品信息。

patterns.name: 邮件签名中的地址
patterns.context: 邮件正文结束后的签名栏包含机构、街道地址和楼层。

patterns.name: 枪支与个人裁量表述
patterns.context: 论述个人持有或使用枪支的权利及裁量。

patterns.name: 教义争议与教皇诏书
patterns.context: 描述基督贫穷教义争议及教皇文件对其定性。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal texts and several distinct contexts: first-degree charges, Cross- litigation roles, and judgment templates. Other local triggers include heretical/here it, portion of, first-class, may challenge, and course, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: first-degree legal phrase
patterns.context: Describes a defendant’s charge or conviction in a criminal case; first is especially prominent in the phrase.

patterns.name: cross-litigation role
patterns.context: Cross- is connected to the name of a litigation role in a case title or party field.

patterns.name: Emphasis on here
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a word containing here (heretical), or in the colloquial email phrase here it is; the two examples have very different contexts.

patterns.name: portion of
patterns.context: Refers to a period of time or part of an experience in a personal account.

patterns.name: first-class
patterns.context: Describes the level of a cricket match.

patterns.name: may after a party label
patterns.context: In a news-headline-style entry, may introduces a possible political challenge.

patterns.name: course in food instructions
patterns.context: An aside in parentheses notes that chickpeas are of course already cooked; course is parenthetical.

patterns.name: direct review in legal phrases
patterns.context: States that a criminal conviction and sentence were affirmed following direct review.

patterns.name: Administrative legal verbs and phrases
patterns.context: Describes prosecution, court, and charge in a criminal case; it belongs to the same legal corpus as the first-degree pattern, but has different trigger words.

patterns.name: Fixed title formats in legal documents
patterns.context: Template-based locations such as appellate case titles, judge information, or the opening of an opinion.

5_702.concept: 局部短语与法律文书格式
5_702.description: 激活分散于法律文本及若干独立语境：first-degree罪名、Cross-诉讼身份和判决模板；另见heretical/here it、portion of、first-class、may challenge与course等局部触发，未显示单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: first-degree legal phrase
patterns.context: 刑事案件的罪名或案情陈述中，描述被告被控或定罪；短语中的 first 特别突出。

patterns.name: cross-诉讼角色
patterns.context: 案件标题或当事人身份栏中，Cross- 与诉讼角色名称相连。

patterns.name: here 的强调
patterns.context: 在 here 开头的词内（heretical），或邮件口语短语 here it is 中；两例语境迥异。

patterns.name: portion of
patterns.context: 个人经历叙述中表示一段时间或部分经历。

patterns.name: first-class
patterns.context: 描述板球比赛级别的复合词。

patterns.name: 政党标签后的 may
patterns.context: 新闻标题式条目中，may 引出可能采取的政治挑战行动。

patterns.name: 食物说明中的 course
patterns.context: 括号内补充说明鹰嘴豆当然已煮熟；course 作插入语。

patterns.name: 法律短语中的 direct review
patterns.context: 说明刑事定罪及刑罚经直接审查后获维持。

patterns.name: 行政法律动词与语句
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述中陈述起诉、法院及罪名；与 first-degree 模式同属法律语料，但触发词不同。

patterns.name: 法律文书固定标题格式
patterns.context: 上诉案标题、法官信息或判决意见开头等模板化位置。

en.concept: Expressions of frequency and quantity of components
en.description: Primarily responds to component expressions like two parts/portions and frequency or multiplicative words such as once and twice. There are also sporadic triggers like before and here; some activations may jointly reflect counting semantics or local sentence structure.

patterns.name: “two parts/portions” structure
patterns.context: When introducing the components of a method, system, or software, the quantity word two is followed by parts/portions, often introducing an explanation of the components.

patterns.name: twice meaning two times or double
patterns.context: Describes something happening two times or a quantity being double another; activation falls on twice.

patterns.name: once meaning one time or formerly
patterns.context: Indicates a single occurrence or is used in a temporal expression meaning “formerly”; appears in narratives or legal arguments.

patterns.name: before meaning earlier or prior to
patterns.context: Indicates that an event occurred before another event, involving event order.

patterns.name: here pointing to the current object or location
patterns.context: Introduces the content being provided in a quoted email (“here it is”) or identifies the speaker’s role (“dev here”).

patterns.name: thought once how
patterns.context: A past thought recalled in literary poetry; beyond once, there is no clear shared triggering structure.

patterns.name: once but twice emphasizing repeated failure to act
patterns.context: A fixed contrastive phrase in a legal argument emphasizing that a party failed to act on two occasions.

patterns.name: Double counting in a paragraph
patterns.context: A personal narrative states that two roles each occurred twice; activation is on twice.

patterns.name: Twice as long multiplicative comparison
patterns.context: Compares the length of two bibliographies, expressing that the former is twice as long as the latter.

5_702.description: 主要响应 two parts/portions 的组成表达，以及 once、twice 等次数或倍数词；另有 before、here 等零散触发，部分激活可能由计数语义或局部句式共同造成。

patterns.name: “two parts/portions”结构
patterns.context: 在介绍方法、系统或软件组成时，数量词 two 后接 parts/portions，常引出组成说明。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、医学摘要

patterns.name: twice 表示两次或两倍
patterns.context: 描述某事发生两次，或某数量为另一数量的两倍；激活落在 twice 上。

patterns.name: once 表示一次或曾经
patterns.context: 表示一次发生，或用于“曾经”的时间表达；出现在叙述或法律论证中。

patterns.name: before 表示先前或此前
patterns.context: 表示某事件发生在另一事件之前，涉及事件顺序。

patterns.name: here 指示当前对象或所在处
patterns.context: 在邮件引述中引出当前提供的内容（“here it is”），或自我介绍所在身份（“dev here”）。

patterns.name: thought once how
patterns.context: 文学诗歌中回忆过去的一段思绪；除 once 外没有明显共享触发结构。

patterns.name: once but twice 强调重复错失
patterns.context: 法律论证中用固定对举短语强调某方两次未采取行动。

patterns.name: 段落中的双重计数
patterns.context: 个人经历叙述中并列说明两种身份各出现两次；激活在 twice。

patterns.name: Twice as long 的倍数比较
patterns.context: 比较两类书目长度，表达前者为后者两倍。

en.description: Activations are scattered across expressions of wishing with wish/would, once in narratives, legal procedure, and uses of portion(s) meaning “part/share.” Literary words and catalog titles also activate, with no single stable semantic or syntactic feature apparent.

patterns.name: Modal and verb after wish
patterns.context: After wish in a first-person expression of desire, activation falls on words such as wish and would; example [4] also involves the following you/knew.

patterns.name: once in recollection or evaluation contexts
patterns.context: once occurs near past experiences, opinions, or conversations in narration or reported speech.

patterns.name: Procedural words in legal questioning
patterns.context: A sequence of procedural expressions in a trial transcript concerning questioning, objections, and court rulings.

patterns.name: Part of a judgment
patterns.context: In discussion of an appeal, portion refers to the part of a judgment being contested or appealed.

patterns.name: portion meaning share or part
patterns.context: portion is followed by an of phrase and refers to part of a whole.

patterns.name: Quantity word followed by portions
patterns.context: In a description of the components of measurement software, two portions introduces the specific components.

patterns.name: Other lexical or formatting triggers
patterns.context: Activation falls on fear in a literary excerpt and on title words in catalog entries; no shared context can be inferred from these examples.

5_702.description: 激活分散在 wish/would 愿望表达、once 叙事、法律程序与 portion(s)“部分/份额”用法中；另有文学词语和目录标题激活，未见单一稳定语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: wish 后的情态与动词
patterns.trigger: “I just wish you knew”; “I wish a Stage would come by”
patterns.context: 在第一人称表达愿望的 wish 后，激活落在 wish、would 等词上；例[4]还涉及后续 you/knew。

patterns.name: once 出现于回忆或评价语境
patterns.trigger: “threw a party once”; “once someone signals”; “something once about”
patterns.context: once 位于叙述或转述中的过去经历、观点或谈话附近。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、邮件、口语叙事

patterns.name: 法律问答中的程序词
patterns.context: 庭审记录中，关于提问、反对及法院裁定的连续程序性表达。

patterns.name: 判决组成部分
patterns.context: 讨论上诉时，portion 指判决中被争议或上诉的部分。

patterns.name: portion 表示份额或部分
patterns.trigger: “a significant portion of human lifespan”; “a portion of an increase”
patterns.context: portion 后接 of 短语，指整体中的一部分。

patterns.name: 数量词后接 portions
patterns.context: 介绍测量软件的组成，two portions 引出具体组成部分。

patterns.name: 其他词汇或格式触发
patterns.context: 激活落在文学片段中的 fear，及目录条目中的标题词；无法从这些例子确定共同上下文。

en.description: Activations show diverse local lexical and structural patterns: expressions with things/thing, legal judgment terminology, think(s), parts, code assignment symbols, and first degree murder. There is no clear triggering pattern shared across all segments.

patterns.name: things followed by a clause or complement
patterns.context: Occurs in English expressions such as “one of the things …,” “6 things that …,” and “one thing in particular”; nearby complements or modifiers often include that, about, and to know.

patterns.name: Legal adjudication and appeal terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a judicial citation in a statutory list and in a judge’s opinion at the end of a judgment.

patterns.name: Use of think(s) in quotations
patterns.context: Appears in a quotation or paraphrase to express someone’s view; the former has “One of the” nearby, while the latter is in the first person.

patterns.name: Method divided into several parts
patterns.context: Describes the components of a research method, followed immediately by an introduction to the first part.

patterns.name: Assignment equals sign in code
patterns.context: Appears in a JavaScript assignment expression, with a function call on the right-hand side.

patterns.name: first degree in a criminal charge
patterns.context: Occurs with “degree murder” to describe the charge against a defendant.

5_702.description: 激活呈现多种局部词汇与结构：things/thing 的表达、法律判决术语、think(s)、parts、代码赋值符号及 first degree murder；没有明显覆盖所有段的统一触发模式。

patterns.name: things 后接从句或补语
patterns.context: 出现在英语表达 “one of the things …”“6 things that …”“one thing in particular” 等中；附近常有 that、about、to know 等补语或修饰语。

patterns.name: 法律裁判与上诉用语
patterns.context: 分别出现在法条枚举的司法引证和判决末尾的法官意见中。

patterns.name: 引文中 think(s) 的用法
patterns.context: 出现在引文或转述中，表达某人的看法；前者附近有 “One of the”，后者是第一人称表达。

patterns.name: 方法分成若干部分
patterns.context: 描述研究方法的组成，并紧接着介绍第一部分。

patterns.name: 代码中的赋值等号
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 赋值表达式中，右侧是函数调用。

patterns.name: 刑事罪名中的 first degree
patterns.context: 与 “degree murder” 连用，描述被告所受指控。

en.description: Activations are scattered across English word fragments, names and proper nouns, punctuation and line breaks, as well as code, formulas, experimental text, legal boilerplate, and list data. Trigger positions vary across examples, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Internal English word fragments and inflectional endings
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across within-word fragments, whole words, and inflectional suffixes, with no consistent meaning or syntactic position.
patterns.domain: English prose, legal texts, code, and encyclopedia entries across multiple fields

patterns.name: Substrings in proper names and personal names
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names such as personal names, organizations, or titles, in both complete names and name fragments.

patterns.name: Punctuation, formatting symbols, and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Marks the boundaries of list items, citations, or code/mathematical expressions; some activations fall on formatting tokens such as line breaks and parentheses.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists, legal citations, code, paper formatting

patterns.name: Function and variable assignment in code
patterns.context: Occurs in JavaScript-style function definitions and variable assignment expressions.

patterns.name: Mathematical physics symbols and formula formatting
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical notation and formula descriptions of particle-physics quantities and quantum numbers.

patterns.name: Scientific nomenclature and experimental methods
patterns.context: Occurs in experimental descriptions of protein mutant names and construction, PCR, and sequencing methods.

patterns.name: Lists, titles, and typographic separators
patterns.context: Near structural formatting in web pages or posts, such as separators, titles, excerpts, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Legal judgment boilerplate
patterns.context: In the conclusions of court opinions, judge signatures, and concurrence statements.

patterns.name: Numerical data in personal-name entries
patterns.context: Numerical fields such as birth and death years appear alongside names and identity descriptions in biographical entries.

patterns.name: Language fragments in quotations
patterns.context: A direct quotation contains colloquial language; activation falls on word fragments inside quotation marks and adjacent punctuation.

patterns.name: Religious legal discussion
patterns.context: In a statement discussing the weight of women’s testimony under Saudi Sharia; the trigger words are not limited to legal terminology.
patterns.domain: Online prose about religion and law

5_702.description: 激活散见于英文词片段、姓名与专名、标点换行，以及代码、公式、实验文本、法律套语和列表数据；各例触发位置多样，未见稳定共享的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 英文单词内部片段与词形结尾
patterns.context: 激活分布在词内片段、完整词及词形后缀上；没有一致的词义或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 多领域英文散文、法律文本、代码、百科条目

patterns.name: 专名及姓名中的子串
patterns.context: 出现在人物姓名、机构或头衔等专名中，既有完整名称也有名称片段。

patterns.name: 标点、格式符与结构边界
patterns.context: 标记列表项、引文或代码/数学表达式的边界；有些激活落在换行和括号等格式 token 上。
patterns.domain: 百科列表、法律引文、代码、论文排版

patterns.name: 代码中的函数与变量赋值
patterns.context: 处于 JavaScript 风格函数定义及变量赋值表达式中。

patterns.name: 数学物理符号与公式排版
patterns.context: 出现于 LaTeX 数学标记及粒子物理量、量子数的公式描述中。

patterns.name: 科学命名与实验方法
patterns.context: 蛋白质突变体名称与构建、PCR 和测序方法的实验叙述中。

patterns.name: 列表/标题及排版分隔
patterns.context: 网页或帖子中的分隔线、标题、摘录和换行等结构化排版附近。

patterns.name: 法律判决套语
patterns.context: 法院意见的结论及法官署名、附议语句中。

patterns.name: 数字及人名条目数据
patterns.context: 人物条目中的生卒年份、出生年份等数字字段，与姓名和身份说明并列。

patterns.name: 引文中的语言片段
patterns.context: 直接引语中出现口语表达，激活落在引号内词片段及其邻近标点。

patterns.name: 宗教法律论述
patterns.context: 讨论沙特伊斯兰教法下女性证词分量的陈述中；触发词并不只限于法律术语。
patterns.domain: 关于宗教与法律的网络散文

en.concept: Responses to local vocabulary and sentence structures
en.description: Activations are most concentrated on “in part” and part/parts, used for argumentative grounds or method components. There are also sporadic responses to local words or sentence structures such as exception, except that, subjecting, objected, wish, and things, across legal, academic, patent, and forum texts.

patterns.name: “part” and argumentative dependence
patterns.context: Appears in sentences explaining the basis of an argument or components of a method; “part(s)” itself and nearby words show marked activation.
patterns.domain: Legal arguments, philosophy papers, scientific method descriptions

patterns.name: “exception” and its sentence boundary
patterns.context: When reporting results, exception introduces an exception and is immediately followed by a period; the period is also marked as active.

patterns.name: “except that” qualifying a method
patterns.context: Describes an experimental design or method as matching an existing method, but with a qualifying difference.

patterns.name: Patent claims wording with “subjecting”
patterns.context: Appears in patent chemistry text, describing a compound being placed under some treatment or reaction.

patterns.name: Objection during questioning
patterns.context: In courtroom question-and-answer proceedings, the state's attorney objects to a question; the court then overrules the objection.

patterns.name: “wish” expressing a desire
patterns.context: In a social website discussion, a speaker expresses a wish for Facebook chat functionality.

patterns.name: “things” introducing a writing topic
patterns.context: In a quoted forum excerpt, “One of the things about writing” begins a discussion of the characteristics of writing.

5_702.description: 激活最集中于 “in part” 及 part/parts，用于论证依据或方法组成；另对 exception、except that、subjecting、objected、wish 和 things 等局部词语或句式有零散响应，跨越法律、学术、专利与论坛文本。

patterns.name: “part”与论证依赖关系
patterns.trigger: “in”后接“part”，如 “relies in part on”“relying in part on”“relied in part on”；另有 “parts”
patterns.context: 出现在说明论证依据或方法组成部分的句子中；“part(s)”本身及邻近词有显著激活。
patterns.domain: 法律论证、哲学论文、科学方法描述

patterns.name: “exception”及其句界
patterns.context: 报告结果时，以 exception 引出例外，并紧接句号；句号也被标记为激活。

patterns.name: “except that”方法限定
patterns.context: 描述实验构造或方法与既有方法相同、但存在限定差异。

patterns.name: “subjecting”专利权利要求用语
patterns.context: 出现在专利化学文本中，描述将化合物置于某种处理或反应之下。

patterns.name: 质询中的反对
patterns.context: 法庭庭审问答中，州方律师对问题提出异议；随后法院驳回异议。

patterns.name: “wish”表达愿望
patterns.context: 社交网站讨论中，发言者表达希望获得 Facebook 聊天功能。

patterns.name: “things”引出写作话题
patterns.context: 论坛引用摘录中，以 “One of the things about writing” 开始谈写作特点。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: exceptions and qualifications, legal procedure, expressions about love/marriage, and technical, email, parliamentary, and biomedical contexts. Many activations fall on function words or common words, so they cannot be reduced to a single stable trigger feature.

patterns.name: Exception/qualification modifier
patterns.context: A general situation, method, or claim is presented, followed by an exception or limitation; activation often falls on exception/except and adjacent function words.
patterns.domain: Paper results and methods, judicial opinions, general narrative

patterns.name: First-person quotations and emotional expressions
patterns.context: Involves first-person quotations or questions about love for someone, sexual orientation, or marital intentions; activation concentrates on emotional words and nearby words.

patterns.name: Case-procedure expressions in legal documents
patterns.context: Procedural contexts involving court cases, motions, charges, or rulings; some activations fall on common function words.

patterns.name: Technical term phase error
patterns.context: Discusses phase error and its correction in wireless communications; activation covers short words around the term.

patterns.name: Email recipient fields
patterns.context: Email headers containing recipient, cc, and subject fields; activation falls near field labels and address text.

patterns.name: Diverse society and forced migration
patterns.context: Discusses a country receiving people from different countries and distinguishes their reasons for migration.

patterns.name: Biomedical mutant construction
patterns.context: Describes confirming mutations by PCR and constructing mutants using primers; activations often fall on common words in the methods narrative.

5_702.description: 激活模式分散：例外与限定、法律程序、爱情／婚姻表述，以及技术、邮件、议会和生物医学语境。多处落在功能词或普通词上，无法归结为单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: 例外／限定修正
patterns.trigger: “exception”“except”及其后的限定内容；如 “one exception”“except as to costs”“except that”
patterns.context: 前文提出一般情况、方法或主张，随后指出例外或限制；激活常落在 exception/except 及相邻功能词上。
patterns.domain: 论文结果与方法、判决意见、一般叙述

patterns.name: 第一人称引语与情感表达
patterns.context: 涉及对某人的爱情、性取向或婚姻意图的第一人称引语或询问；激活集中在情感词及其邻近词。
patterns.domain: 问答叙述、法律庭审记录

patterns.name: 法律文书中的案件程序表达
patterns.trigger: “Before the Court”“motions for Summary Judgment”“charged”“conviction and sentence”
patterns.context: 法院案件、动议、指控或裁判等程序性语境；其中部分激活落在普通功能词。

patterns.name: 技术术语 phase error
patterns.context: 讨论无线通信中相位误差及其校正；激活覆盖术语周围的短词。

patterns.name: 邮件收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件头部，包含收件人、抄送与主题字段，激活落在字段标记及地址文本附近。

patterns.name: 多元社会与受迫迁徙
patterns.trigger: “The Netherlands is proud of its diversity”“some because they were persecuted”
patterns.context: 谈及国家接纳来自不同国家的人群，并区分迁徙原因。

patterns.name: 生物医学突变构建
patterns.context: 描述通过 PCR 确认、使用引物构建突变体；激活多落在方法叙述中的常用词。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: many examples center on thing followed by a comment or explanation; others include legal requests with seeking, clarification questions with mean, and a channel receive symbol and identifier try in code. They span domains, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: “thing” followed by a predicate
patterns.context: The noun “thing” serves as the topic, subject, or object in a discourse or sentence, followed by an explanation, evaluation, or elaboration; some examples use “Good thing” to introduce a comment.
patterns.domain: News, forums, Q&A, and everyday narratives

patterns.name: Legal relief introduced by “seeking”
patterns.context: Appears in court documents describing summary judgment motions, with “seeking” introducing the relief requested from the court.

patterns.name: “mean” introducing a clarification or definition question
patterns.context: Asks for confirmation or an explanation of preceding content; one example discusses international trade barriers, while another asks whether war includes ancient wars.

patterns.name: Receive operation in code
patterns.context: A channel receive expression in a Go concurrency example; activation falls on the receive symbol.

patterns.name: “try” in an identifier
patterns.context: Appears in the example code function or identifier name `defun org-try-merging-last-clock`, not as ordinary English.

5_702.description: 激活模式分散：多例集中在 thing 及其后续评论或说明，另有 seeking 法律请求、mean 澄清提问，以及代码中的通道接收符号和标识符 try。它们跨领域，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: “thing”及紧随其后的谓语
patterns.trigger: “thing”后接“happens”（[1]）、“we didn't have to…”（[3]）、“is how…”（[4]）、“that those graphs…”（[5]）、“about design…”（[10]）；另有反复出现的短语“Good thing”（[3]、[5]）
patterns.context: 名词“thing”作为话语或句子中的话题、主语或宾语，后面接说明、评价或补充内容；部分例子是“Good thing”引出的评论。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛、问答及日常叙述

patterns.name: “seeking”所引出的法律诉求
patterns.context: 出现在法院文件对 summary judgment motions 的描述中，“seeking”引出请求法院给予的救济。

patterns.name: “mean”引出澄清或释义问题
patterns.context: 对前文内容提出确认或解释性追问；一例谈国际贸易壁垒，另一例询问战争是否包括古代战争。

patterns.name: 代码中的接收操作
patterns.context: Go 并发接收器示例中的通道接收表达式；激活落在接收符号上。

patterns.name: 标识符中的“try”
patterns.context: 出现在示例代码的函数或标识符名称 `defun org-try-merging-last-clock` 内，并非普通英语用法。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、Emacs Lisp 代码

en.description: Activation is concentrated on thing or explanatory words following one/important thing, and on time, to, or upon following part; there are also local patterns in legal texts where one is followed by seeking or hand-written.

patterns.name: Strong modifiers or explanations after thing
patterns.context: thing is often preceded by one or important and followed by descriptive, explanatory, or qualifying material; activation centers on thing or the immediately following word.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including news, quotations, commentary, literary narrative, and email

patterns.name: part with prepositional phrases
patterns.context: part occurs in collocations such as “one part-time …” or “in part to/upon …”, surrounded by prepositions or compound structures.
patterns.domain: Startup discussions, philosophy papers, legal fact statements

patterns.name: one in legal documents
patterns.context: one introduces a specific matter or document description in a legal case; activation falls on subsequent words.

5_702.description: 激活主要落在 one/important thing 后的 thing 或说明词，以及 part 后的 time、to、upon；另有法律文本中 one 后接 seeking、hand-written 的局部模式。

patterns.name: thing 后接强修饰或说明
patterns.trigger: «thing»10« happens»4（1）；«one»3« thing»10（2）；«one»5« thing»9（4）；«important»2« thing»9« is»8（8）；«one»4« thing»9« that»3（10）
patterns.context: thing 前常有 one 或 important，后续接描述、解释或限定；激活集中在 thing 或紧随其后的词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、引语、评论、文学叙述及邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: part 与介词短语
patterns.context: part 出现在“one part-time …”或“in part to/upon …”等搭配中，周围有介词或复合词结构。
patterns.domain: 创业讨论、哲学论文、法律事实陈述

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 one
patterns.context: one 引出法律案件中的具体事项或文件描述，激活落在后续词上。

en.description: Activations occur across diverse local patterns: thing and predicates for events or surprises, except introducing exceptions, litigation procedure expressions, quantity phrases, code function assignments, and a French word-internal fragment. These patterns span domains, with no single unified trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: “thing(s) happens/surprises” expression
patterns.context: thing is followed by a predicate indicating that something happens or causes surprise; both examples occur in quotations or colloquial comments.

patterns.name: except exception/condition clauses
patterns.context: except introduces a methodological exception, applicability condition, or alternative operation, followed by a that-clause, prepositional phrase, or gerund.

patterns.name: Procedural terms in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes court cases, motions, and requests for relief; activations concentrate on procedural expressions such as alternative and seeking.

patterns.name: Quantity or proportion descriptions
patterns.context: Locally involves quantities, proportions, or one/thing phrases; in 1 it occurs in mortality statistics, while in 6 it appears within a quotation.

patterns.name: Function and assignment structures in code
patterns.context: At the beginning of a JavaScript function body, with braces, newline indentation, a variable declaration, and an assignment.

patterns.name: Accented-letter fragments within French words
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on subword fragments of French words, involving accented letters and word-final morphology; no clear shared syntactic condition is apparent.

5_702.description: 激活分布于多种局部模式：thing 与事件/意外谓语、except 引出例外、诉讼程序表达、数量短语、代码函数赋值及法语词内片段。模式跨领域，未见单一统一触发条件。

patterns.name: “thing(s) happens/surprises”表达
patterns.context: thing 后接表示发生或带来意外的谓语；均处于引述或口语化评论中。

patterns.name: except 例外/条件从句
patterns.context: except 引出方法上的例外、适用条件或替代操作，后续接 that 从句、介词短语或动名词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、学术论文

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的程序性词语
patterns.context: 描述法院案件、动议及救济请求；激活集中于 alternative、seeking 等程序性表达。

patterns.name: 数量或比例描述
patterns.context: 局部涉及数量、比例或 one/thing 短语；1 中为死亡统计，6 中嵌在引语内。

patterns.name: 代码中的函数与赋值结构
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数体开头，包含花括号、换行缩进、变量声明和赋值。

patterns.name: 法语词内部的重音字母片段
patterns.context: 激活标记落在法语单词的子词片段中，涉及重音字母及词尾构词；未见明确的共同句法条件。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to exceptions or qualifying structures introduced by except, and often activates when broad nouns such as thing(s) are followed by explanations; also occurs with that-clause connections and several sporadic word-level activations that resist a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Exception/exclusion clauses
patterns.context: Introduces exceptions, reservations, or qualifying conditions after a general rule, ruling, hypothesis, or scope has been stated; often occurs in parenthetical clauses or lists within long sentences.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions and pleadings, academic papers, and general narrative

patterns.name: thing(s) and follow-up explanations
patterns.context: thing(s) serves as a broad noun followed by an evaluation, explanation, experience, or relative clause; often occurs in conversational quotations or advice.
patterns.domain: Sports news, interview narratives, online articles

patterns.name: Clause connection with that
patterns.context: that functions as a clause connector or demonstrative, linking a prior judgment, suggestion, or main claim in a legal action to subsequent content; not all examples involve an exception structure.

patterns.name: Local activation of individual collocates
patterns.context: Each occurs in contexts involving temporal sequence, nonparticipation in an opinion, denial of a request, or descriptive phrases; no clear shared syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Philosophical discussion, judicial opinions, online articles

patterns.name: Residual activation outside shared patterns
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across different word forms, function words, and local phrases; some occur in the same passages as the patterns above, but the material does not establish a consistent trigger.
patterns.domain: Sports news, philosophy, academic, and legal texts

5_702.description: 主要对 except 引出的例外或限定结构敏感，也常在宽泛名词 thing(s) 后接说明时激活；另见 that 从句连接及若干分散的词项激活，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 例外/排除条款
patterns.trigger: «except»，以及相邻的逗号、介词或限定语，如“except the implied warranty claims”“except in specially mentioned cases”“except for form”“except with regard to”
patterns.context: 在先陈述一般规则、裁决、假设或范围后，引出例外、保留事项或限定条件；常见于长句中的插入性从句或列举
patterns.domain: 法律判决与诉讼文书、学术论文，也见一般叙述

patterns.name: thing(s)及后续说明
patterns.trigger: «thing»／“things”，尤其是“good thing happens”“biggest thing was”“obvious thing which is”一类结构
patterns.context: thing(s)作宽泛名词，后接评价、解释、经历或关系从句；常处于口语化引语或建议文字中
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、访谈叙述、网络文章

patterns.name: that 引导的从句连接
patterns.trigger: «that»，如“that’s precisely what”“that the motions”“that both parties agreed”
patterns.context: that 用作从句连接词或指示语，连接先行判断、建议或诉讼主句与后续内容；各例中并非都与例外结构相连

patterns.name: 个别搭配词的局部激活
patterns.trigger: «before»（“even before we make our decision”）；«participating»（“not participating”）；«denied»（“motions … be denied”）；«hand»（“confident hand”）
patterns.context: 各自出现在时间先后、意见不参与、驳回请求或描述性短语中；未见共同的明确句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、司法意见、网络文章

patterns.name: 未归入共同模式的残余激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在不同词形、功能词及局部短语中；部分与上列模式同段，但无法从材料确定一致触发条件
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、哲学、学术及法律文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across code syntax, the English phrases “one hand/one thing,” proportion expressions, legal motions, patent enumerations, and the French phrase “d'une part”; no single semantic or lexical pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: JavaScript functions and routing code
patterns.context: Occurs in JavaScript code locations such as function declarations, parameter lists, and variable assignments, often with indentation and line breaks.

patterns.name: JavaScript object methods and property access
patterns.context: Method definitions in object literals and access to this and properties.

patterns.name: one hand / on the one hand structures
patterns.context: Used in English prose as a contrastive discourse frame or to indicate an important matter; the exact collocation need not be fixed.

patterns.name: Part and proportion expressions
patterns.context: Describes statistical counts or proportions, with nearby death tolls and data sources.

patterns.name: Legal motions and requests
patterns.context: In court case statements, describes a party filing a motion and the relief sought.

patterns.name: English modal and conditional expressions
patterns.context: Used in news narrative to speculate or describe an expected identity, near a sports-reporting context.

patterns.name: Patent devices and component lists
patterns.context: Lists devices, circuits, or components in patent-claim-style language.

patterns.name: French part/aspect expression
patterns.context: In a French sentence, «d'une part» introduces one side of an argument.

5_702.description: 激活分散于代码语法、英语“one hand/one thing”、比例表达、法律动议、专利列举及法语“d'une part”等局部模式；没有单一语义或词形能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: JavaScript 函数与路由代码
patterns.context: 出现在函数声明、参数列表和变量赋值等 JavaScript 代码位置，常伴随缩进与换行。

patterns.name: JavaScript 对象方法与属性访问
patterns.context: 对象字面量中的方法定义及对 this 和属性的访问。

patterns.name: one hand / on the one hand 结构
patterns.context: 在英语散文中用作对照论述框架，或表示一个重要事项；不要求固定搭配完全一致。

patterns.name: 部分与比例表达
patterns.context: 描述统计数量或占比，周围出现死亡人数及数据来源。

patterns.name: 法律动议与请求
patterns.context: 法院案件陈述中说明当事方提出动议及其寻求的救济。

patterns.name: 英语情态与条件表达
patterns.context: 新闻叙述中用于推测或描述预期身份，邻近体育报道语境。

patterns.name: 专利装置与构成项
patterns.context: 专利权利要求式表述中列举装置、线路或部件。

patterns.name: 法语部分／方面表达
patterns.context: 法语句中 «d'une part» 用于提出一方面的论述。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to “one hand” in the fixed phrase “on the one hand,” used to introduce one side of an argument and establish a contrast; it also responds to the French equivalent “d’une part.” The pattern appears across disciplines and styles.

patterns.name: “on the one hand” contrastive structure
patterns.context: The phrase introduces one side or point, paired with another side, the other hand, or a contrast later in the text; sometimes the latter does not appear in the excerpt.
patterns.domain: Formal argumentation in academic papers, legal texts, and news discussions

patterns.name: French “d’une part”
patterns.context: Introduces one side of an argument, usually anticipating a contrast with another side or a subsequent result.

patterns.name: “on the one hand” for conceptual contrasts
patterns.context: Uses the phrase to organize a comparison between two sets of concepts; this example shares the fixed phrase with the other segments, but “and” follows it directly.

5_702.description: 主要对固定搭配“on the one hand”中的“one hand”强烈响应，用于引出论述的一方并建立对照；也响应法语对应表达“d’une part”。覆盖不同学科与文体。

patterns.name: “on the one hand” 对照结构
patterns.trigger: «one»« hand»，常见形式为“on the one hand”；[1]–[9]多在“hand”处最强
patterns.context: 该短语引出一方或一项，与后文另一方、另一方面或对照项并列；有时后文尚未出现在片段中
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律文本、新闻讨论等正式论述

patterns.name: 法语“d’une part”
patterns.context: 用于提出论述的一方，通常预示与另一面或后续结果形成对照

patterns.name: “on the one hand”用于概念对举
patterns.context: 以该短语组织两组概念的比较；本例与其他段落同样出现该固定搭配，但搭配后直接接“and”

en.concept: one introducing an item or one side of a contrast
en.description: The most stable pattern is the contrastive structure “on the one hand”; other examples use one to introduce an item, as in “one thing/one condition,” as well as “one seeking” in legal enumerations. Numbering [1a] may be a co-trigger.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “on the one hand”
patterns.context: Occurs in structures expressing contrast, comparison, or two-sided enumeration; often followed by “on the other hand”, but may also be followed by a parenthetical phrase or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain discussion, legal documents, academic texts, and literary criticism

patterns.name: “one thing” and its follow-up explanation
patterns.context: Introduces a specific event, condition, or important factor, followed by a predicate or explanation.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, legal texts, Q&A discussions

patterns.name: “one seeking” in an enumeration
patterns.context: In a description of multiple motions, specifies the legal relief sought by one of them.

patterns.name: “one hand” without preceding on
patterns.context: One side of a paired discourse structure appears, but the passage begins mid-sentence and does not show the full “on the”.
patterns.domain: Cognitive science discussion in a PubMed abstract

patterns.name: Positional numbers or clause symbols
patterns.context: Activation occurs near a numbering marker, alongside the “on the one hand” structure in the sentence; whether it triggers activation independently is uncertain.
patterns.domain: Citations or clause numbers in legal texts

5_702.description: 最稳定模式是对照结构“on the one hand”；另有“one thing/one condition”等以 one 引出单项内容，以及法律列举中的“one seeking”。编号[1a]可能是伴随触发。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“on the one hand”
patterns.context: 在表示对照、比较或列举两方的结构中；常紧接“on the other hand”，也可能后接插入语或标点。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的论述、法律文书、学术文本与文学评论

patterns.name: “one thing”及其后续说明
patterns.context: 引出一个具体事件、条件或重要因素，后面接谓语或说明。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、法律文本、问答讨论

patterns.name: 列举中的“one seeking”
patterns.context: 在描述多项动议时，说明其中一项所寻求的法律救济。

patterns.name: “one hand”但缺少前置 on
patterns.context: 出现成对论述结构的一侧，但本片段开头截断，未见完整的“on the”。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的认知科学论述

patterns.name: 位置编号或条款符号
patterns.context: 编号标记附近出现激活；与句中“on the one hand”结构同时出现，是否独立触发不确定。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的引文或条款编号

en.concept: the phrase “one hand” and local collocations
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the fixed phrase “on the one hand” in argumentative prose, especially “one hand”; isolated patterns also include legal “seeking dismissal”, conversational “one good thing happens”, and patent language “being a … single bond”.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “on the one hand”
patterns.context: “one hand” in the phrase is highlighted, followed by a comma or further contrastive discussion; appears in passages 2 and 5–10.
patterns.domain: Argumentative prose in academic, medical, and technical texts

patterns.name: “seeking dismissal” in a legal motion
patterns.context: “seeking dismissal” is prominent when a legal text introduces the purpose of certain summary judgment motions.

patterns.name: Positive event “one good thing happens”
patterns.context: A conversational quotation describes something good happening; activation is concentrated on “thing”.

patterns.name: “being a … single bond” in patent limitations
patterns.context: In a chemical structure definition, describes a bond represented by a dashed line and introduces a single-bond limitation with “being”.

5_702.description: 最一致的触发是论述性文本中的固定搭配“on the one hand”，尤其是“one hand”；另有法律“seeking dismissal”、口语“one good thing happens”及专利“being a … single bond”等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 固定短语“on the one hand”
patterns.context: 短语中的“one hand”高亮，后接逗号或继续展开对照、论述；第2、5–10段均出现。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学与技术文本中的论述性散文

patterns.name: 法律动议中的“seeking dismissal”
patterns.context: 法律文本中介绍部分简易判决动议的目的时，“seeking dismissal”突出。

patterns.name: 正向事件“one good thing happens”
patterns.context: 口语引语中描述某件好事发生；激活集中在“thing”。

patterns.name: 专利限定中的“being a … single bond”
patterns.context: 化学结构定义中，描述虚线所代表的键，并以“being”引出单键限制。

en.description: Activation often falls on the step marker “(a)”, and also occurs on one/one hand in enumerations and on subsequent predicates, sources, or case details; these patterns broadly involve local enumeration and supplementary explanation in text, but differ substantially in style and meaning.

patterns.name: Step markers in patent claims
patterns.context: Describes a method, invention, or experimental procedure in patent text; the trigger is the parenthesized step/item label “(a)”.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Relief sought in legal motions
patterns.context: In a court case narrative, explains what ruling one motion seeks after motions have been enumerated; activation centers on “seeking dismissal”.

patterns.name: Evaluative emphasis in conversational quotations
patterns.context: A direct quotation uses “the good thing happens” to express optimism or emphasis; the passage includes a comma and conversational filler.

patterns.name: Contrastive enumeration of memory mechanisms
patterns.context: An academic abstract uses “on the one hand” to introduce one mechanism or explanation in a contrastive argument.

patterns.name: Grouping by sample source
patterns.context: A clinical study report identifies samples as coming from a time period or group, using a source phrase such as “from pre-...”.

patterns.name: Enumeration of patents
patterns.context: A biographical narrative first mentions having received several patents, then uses “one was for” to introduce the purpose of one of them.

patterns.name: Single-case explanation of a disease
patterns.context: After reporting the number of cases, adds the age and identity of one case with “one in a ...-year-old man”.

5_702.description: 激活常落在“(a)”步骤标记，也出现在列举中的 one/one hand 及其后续谓语、来源或病例说明；共同涉及正文中的局部列举与补充说明，但文体和语义差异较大。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的步骤标记
patterns.context: 专利文本中描述方法、发明或实验流程，触发点是括号内的步骤/项目标号“(a)”
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术说明

patterns.name: 法律动议中的裁判请求
patterns.context: 法院案件叙述中，在列举动议后说明其中一项寻求何种裁判；激活集中于“seeking dismissal”

patterns.name: 口语引语中的评价性强调
patterns.context: 直接引语中以“the good thing happens”表达乐观或强调；该处有逗号和口语填充语

patterns.name: 记忆机制的对照列举
patterns.context: 学术摘要以“on the one hand”引出机制或解释的一面，形成对照式论述

patterns.name: 样本来源的分组表达
patterns.context: 临床研究报告样本来自某个时间阶段或分组，使用“from pre-...”一类来源短语

patterns.name: 专利数量的列举
patterns.context: 传记式叙述先提到获得若干专利，再用“one was for”引出其中一项用途

patterns.name: 疾病病例的单例说明
patterns.context: 报告病例数量后，以“one in a ...-year-old man”补充单个病例的年龄和身份

en.concept: Introducing an item in a list
en.description: Many patterns share one/One introducing and elaborating on one item among several: legal lists, statutory deadlines, sports colloquialisms, experimental conditions, and case reports; triggering contexts and styles vary.

patterns.name: Introducing an exception or individual item after a list in legal arguments
patterns.context: A legal text first states several motions, errors, reasons, judgment outcomes, or document contents, then uses one to introduce and elaborate on an item; it is often followed by of which, exception, or part.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw judgments, legal arguments, and legal documents

patterns.name: Parenthetical repetition of a deadline number in statutes
patterns.context: A statute first states a deadline of one year, then repeats the number of years in parentheses; the surrounding provisions concern contracts, residential exemptions, and written form.

patterns.name: Positive-event expression in sports quotations
patterns.context: In an interview quotation about an NFL rookie and what he anticipates, one good thing happens begins an example or reassuring expression.

patterns.name: Experimental groups and individual conditions
patterns.context: Research methods identify one of two groups or experimental parts and explain its treatment or experimental condition.

patterns.name: An individual case among a number of cases
patterns.context: A report on human cases of parasitic disease identifies one among several cases and describes the patient.

5_702.description: 多处模式共享 one/One 引出多个对象中的一项并展开说明：法律列举、法条期限、体育口语、实验条件和病例报告；触发语境及文体各异。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的列举后引出例外/个别项
patterns.context: 法律文本先陈述多个动议、错误、理由、判决结果或文件内容，再以 one 引出其中一项及其具体说明；后续常接 of which、exception 或 part。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决、法律论证及法律文件

patterns.name: 法条中期限数字的括号重复
patterns.context: 法条先写期限 one year，随后用括号数字重复年数；周围是关于契约、住宅豁免及书面形式的规范。

patterns.name: 体育引语中的积极事件表达
patterns.context: NFL 新秀及其期待的采访引语中，以 one good thing happens 开始举例或宽慰式表达。

patterns.name: 实验分组与单项条件
patterns.context: 研究方法中从两个组或两个实验部分中指出其中一个，并交代其处理方式或实验条件。

patterns.name: 病例数量中的单个病例
patterns.context: 报告寄生虫病的人类病例时，从多个病例中指出其中一例并描述患者。

en.description: The most stable pattern is using “one of which” or a similar structure after enumerating multiple objects to introduce one of them; legal terminology in judicial opinions also activates, and a few numeric list items may be related.

patterns.name: “one of which” clauses in legal opinions
patterns.context: After listing multiple matters, grounds, motions, or allegations, introduces one of them and provides a follow-up explanation; common in legal documents.

patterns.name: “one of which” referring to an enumerated item
patterns.context: Several photos, mechanisms, items, cases, or fields are mentioned, followed by a specification of one of them; legal context is not required.
patterns.domain: Expository texts such as encyclopedias, medical abstracts, technology reports, and Q&A

patterns.name: Case terminology and procedural words in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of judicial cases, procedural history, or reasoning; these words also show activation nearby but do not form a unified local trigger sequence.

patterns.name: Numbers and parenthetical list items
patterns.context: Numeric enumerations such as numbered allegations or case counts; may co-occur with an “one of them” structure in the text, but whether they independently trigger activation is uncertain.

5_702.description: 最稳定的模式是列举多个对象后用“one of which”或近似结构引出其中一项；法律判决中另有案件术语激活，少数数字列项也可能相关。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的「one of which」从句
patterns.trigger: «one»…«of»…«which»（如[1]“one of which merits discussion”，[2]“one of which was the above ground”，[3]“one seeking dismissal”，[4]“in part”后接论述）
patterns.context: 在前文列出多个事项、理由、动议或指控后，引出其中一项及其后续说明；法律文书中常见。

patterns.name: 「one of which」指代列举对象
patterns.trigger: «one»…«of»…«which»，如[5]“one of which was of him nude”、[6]“on the one hand”、[8]“one of which was the development”、[9]“one in a 36-year-old man”、[10]“one of them being id”
patterns.context: 前文提到多个照片、机制、项目、病例或字段，随后挑出其中一项作说明；不要求法律语境。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、科技报道、问答等说明性文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的案件术语与程序词
patterns.context: 出现在司法案件叙述、程序经过或裁判理由中；这些词周围也出现激活，但不构成统一的局部触发串。

patterns.name: 数字与括号式列项
patterns.context: 编号指控或病例数量等数字化列举；可能与所在文本的「其中一项」结构并存，是否独立触发不确定。

en.description: Activation often occurs after an enumeration when “one of them” is selected (especially “one of which” in legal texts). It also appears in legal citations, lists of litigant roles, quotation segmentation, contrast in medical discussion, news polling, and case counts; overall, it tends toward structured enumeration and relational linking, but the trigger forms are not uniform.

patterns.name: “one of which” relative clauses in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal argument or pleading first lists multiple grounds, allegations, motions, etc., then identifies one of them or its contents.

patterns.name: Paragraph markers in legal quotations
patterns.context: An opinion quotes statutes, contracts, or orders; quotation marks, colons, or line breaks may appear nearby.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, opinions and quotations from legal documents

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: In case citations, the court name, volume/page numbers, and reporter abbreviations appear adjacent to one another.

patterns.name: Lists of litigants and charges in legal cases
patterns.context: Introduces litigant roles, charges, or issues in a case summary or procedural paragraph.

patterns.name: Paired discourse markers in academic discussion
patterns.context: An academic abstract contrasts one mechanism with another aspect or mechanism; this example discusses memory processing and false memories.

patterns.name: Election polling statements in news
patterns.context: Reports on an election contest and summarizes differing results from multiple polling organizations.

patterns.name: Reporting case counts and positive/negative results in medical studies
patterns.context: Reports biomarker test results item by item using case counts.

5_702.description: 激活多出现在列举后选取“其中一项”（尤其法律文本的 one of which），也见法律引文、诉讼身份列举、引述分段，以及医学论述的对举、新闻民调和病例统计；整体偏向结构化列举与关系衔接，但触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的“one of which”关系从句
patterns.trigger: “one”后接“of which”，尤其是“one of which was/merits/seeking”
patterns.context: 法律论证或诉讼文书中先列举多个 grounds、allegations、motions 等，再指出其中一项或其内容。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的分段标记
patterns.context: 判决书转述法规、契约或命令内容，附近可见引号、冒号或换行排版。

patterns.name: 法律案件引证中的数字与标点
patterns.trigger: “Utah 2d 430, 491 P.”等并列数字、卷号及引证标点
patterns.context: 判例引证格式中，法院名、卷页号与报告集缩写相邻。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼当事人及罪名的列举
patterns.context: 案件介绍或程序性段落列出诉讼身份、指控或争点。

patterns.name: 学术论述中的成对论述标记
patterns.context: 学术摘要将某种机制与另一面或另一机制对举；本例讨论记忆加工与虚构记忆。

patterns.name: 新闻中的选举民调陈述
patterns.trigger: “one saying”后接机构名称与领先情况
patterns.context: 报道选举竞争，概述多家民调机构的不同结果。

patterns.name: 医学研究中病例数与阴阳性结果列报
patterns.context: 用病例计数逐项汇报标志物检测结果。

en.concept: fixed phrases and code structure boundaries
en.description: Most passages activate near the formal-text expression “on the one hand”, often used to introduce one side of an argument; there are also activations around punctuation, line breaks, indentation, and structural symbols in code snippets, which do not fit the phrase pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “on the one hand”
patterns.context: “one hand” is the main trigger in the phrase; it may be followed by a comma, by, etc., and often introduces one side of a reason, effect, method, or contrast. It may also form a contrast with subsequent material in an enumeration.
patterns.domain: Formal expository texts, including academic papers, patents, and legal documents

patterns.name: Structured token sequences in code
patterns.context: Activation is distributed near structural boundaries and formatting symbols in code; content includes JSON, C, or similar-language snippets. It has no apparent connection to the semantic pattern “on the one hand”.

5_702.concept: 固定短语与代码结构边界
5_702.description: 多数段落在正式文本的“on the one hand”表达附近激活，常用于引出论述的一方；另有代码片段中对标点、换行、缩进和结构符号的激活，无法归入该短语模式。

patterns.name: “on the one hand”固定短语
patterns.trigger: “on the one hand”及其局部变体，如“on the one hand,”、“on the one hand by”
patterns.context: 短语中“one hand”是主要触发处；可接逗号、by 等，常用于引出一方的理由、影响、方法或对照，也可在列举中与后续成分形成对照。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、法律文书等正式说明性文本

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化 token 序列
patterns.trigger: 标点、引号、换行、缩进及括号等序列，如“↵        {”、“while (1)↵    {”、“switch (line) {”
patterns.context: 激活分布在代码的结构边界和格式化符号附近；内容涉及 JSON、C 或类似语言的代码片段。与“on the one hand”语义模式无明显联系。

en.description: Most segments activate on “on the one hand” and nearby words in argumentative texts, including memory research, patents, biomedicine, astrophysics, pollution, and philosophy. There are also isolated activations in code structures and legal deed wording.

patterns.name: “on the one hand” sentence structure
patterns.context: Occurs in the paired contrast or exposition structure “on the one hand …”; sometimes the preceding on is unmarked, while punctuation or following words after hand may also be marked.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patents, legal texts, philosophy, and social science argumentation

patterns.name: Code or structured data snippet
patterns.context: In nested objects or JSON-like code/data structures, activations concentrate on field names, brackets, and indentation; the phrase “on the one hand” is absent.

patterns.name: Deed narrative in legal documents
patterns.context: In an account of a date, sheriff's certificate, and deed transfer, activation falls on quoted legal-document wording and phrase boundaries; the segment does not contain “on the one hand”.

5_702.description: 多数片段在论述性文本中激活于“on the one hand”及其邻近词，涵盖记忆研究、专利、生物医学、天体物理、污染与哲学等；另有代码结构和法律契据措辞两类孤立激活。

patterns.name: “on the one hand”句式
patterns.context: 处于成对对照或分述论证的“on the one hand …”结构中；有时前面的 on 未标记，有时也有 hand 后的标点或后续词被标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、法律文本、哲学与社会科学论述

patterns.name: 代码或结构化数据片段
patterns.trigger: «place»、«nested»、«{»、«chunks»等，周围有引号、冒号、下划线及缩进换行
patterns.context: 嵌套对象或类似 JSON 的代码/数据结构中，激活集中在字段名、括号和缩进处；未见“on the one hand”短语。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的契据叙述
patterns.context: 日期、警长证书及契据转让的叙述中，激活落在引述法律文书措辞和短语边界；该片段未出现“on the one hand”。

en.description: All passages contain the contrastive structure “on the one hand”; the neuron responds strongly mainly to “hand” in the phrase and also responds to “one”. The structure introduces two contrasting sides across academic, legal, and patent texts.

patterns.name: Fixed contrastive phrase “on the one hand”
patterns.context: Occurs in a contrastive structure introducing one side of a viewpoint, factor, method, or phenomenon; often ends with a comma and contrasts with a subsequent side. The other side need not appear in the excerpt.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain written language: academic papers, legal opinions, patent specifications

5_702.concept: 对比结构“on the one hand”
5_702.description: 所有片段都包含对比结构“on the one hand”；神经元主要对短语中的“hand”强烈响应，也响应“one”。该结构用于引出对照双方，跨学术、法律及专利文本。

patterns.name: 固定对比短语“on the one hand”
patterns.trigger: “on the one hand”，尤其是连续 token «one» 和 «hand»；多段中 “hand” 激活最强
patterns.context: 出现在引出一方观点、因素、方法或现象的对比结构中，常以逗号收尾，并与后续另一方形成对照；不要求另一方已出现在截取片段中
patterns.domain: 跨领域书面语：学术论文、法律判决、专利说明书

en.concept: Local structural markers and fixed phrases
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: “on the one hand” in academic argumentation, “in part” and motion terminology in legal texts, newlines, indentation, and syntax markers in code, and sample numbers in medical results. Local formatting and common phrases may also contribute.

patterns.name: on the one hand sentence structure
patterns.context: Occurs in an “on the one hand” contrastive or argumentative structure; activation concentrates on hand, and several instances also include the following comma.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, memory research; argumentative narratives in legal documents

patterns.name: in part in legal documents
patterns.context: In accounts of deed contents or citations of judgment provisions, the phrase is followed by a specific statement.

patterns.name: Structural newlines and indentation in code
patterns.context: Code/JSON-like text contains newlines, indentation, and nested structures; activations fall on tokens related to newlines and indentation.

patterns.name: Procedural phrases in legal cases
patterns.context: Procedural accounts of court cases, especially summaries of summary judgment motions and the relief they request.

patterns.name: Statistical figures in ophthalmology research results
patterns.context: The results section reports sample statistics by group, including patients, eyes, and sex.

patterns.name: Unexplained code snippet markers
patterns.context: A code output contains fragments resembling grid/boundary descriptions; the relationship between these markers and the main pattern cannot be determined from the excerpt.

patterns.name: Unexplained JSON field content
patterns.context: Field names and array contents appear within a JSON/configuration structure; activations mainly fall on newlines and indentation, while the field-level pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Unexplained program syntax fragment
patterns.context: Activations occur near C-style code control flow and parentheses/braces, but do not fully match the newline-indentation pattern.

5_702.concept: 局部结构标记与固定短语
5_702.description: 激活模式分散：学术论述中的“on the one hand”、法律文本中的“in part”及动议术语、代码里的换行缩进和语法标记、医学结果的样本数字。也可能受局部格式与常见短语影响。

patterns.name: on the one hand 句式
patterns.context: 出现在“on the one hand”对照或论述结构中；激活集中于 hand，多个实例还包含后续逗号
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、记忆研究；法律文书中的论证叙述

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 in part
patterns.context: 法律文件叙述契据内容或引用判决条款时，短语后接具体陈述

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性换行与缩进
patterns.context: 代码/类 JSON 文本中出现换行、缩进和嵌套结构；激活落在换行与缩进相关 token 上

patterns.name: 法律案件程序短语
patterns.context: 法院案件的程序性叙述，尤其概述简易判决动议及其请求

patterns.name: 眼科研究结果中的统计数字
patterns.context: 结果部分按组报告患者、眼数与性别等样本统计
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要/研究结果

patterns.name: 未解释的代码片段标记
patterns.context: 代码输出中出现类似网格/边界描述的片段；无法从片段确定这些标记与主模式的关系

patterns.name: 未解释的 JSON 字段内容
patterns.context: JSON/配置结构内的字段名和数组内容，激活主要落在换行及缩进，而字段本身的模式不清楚

patterns.name: 未解释的程序语法片段
patterns.context: C 风格代码控制流与括号/大括号附近出现激活，但不完全等同于换行缩进模式
