en.concept: Subwords after spaces and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on L subwords with a leading space and a few fixed subwords; it also covers formatting features such as code configuration, JSON, legal citations, years, names, and line breaks, with semantic domains scattered.

patterns.name: L characters in special formatting
patterns.context: The letter L appears as a standalone fragment or a subword with a leading space in structured text, names, citations, or medical terms; the following content varies.

patterns.name: Language model configuration marker
patterns.context: In GitHub code, the marker sequence occurs in a configuration-key-like structure, followed by DataKinds or FlexibleContexts

patterns.name: Substring within obtained
patterns.context: Appears in the hyphenated compound “-obtained”, preceded by “fraudulently-” or “as-”; the surrounding word meanings have no apparent shared theme with this substring

patterns.name: L. monocytogenes pathogen name
patterns.context: In a medical abstract, as part of the name of an infectious pathogen

patterns.name: L in legal citations
patterns.context: In statutory or legal citation formats, L. follows a volume-page citation

patterns.name: s in year numbers
patterns.context: The suffix s after a year number is marked in expressions such as “1190s in England”

patterns.name: Record structure in JSON data
patterns.context: Example data consists of objects, key-value pairs, and repeated names, including names and street addresses

patterns.name: L subwords in names
patterns.context: Names are tokenized into multiple subwords; activation falls on the initial surname fragment and subsequent subwords

patterns.name: End-of-line and whitespace line-break markers
patterns.context: Activation appears at line breaks after code snippets, entries, or names, often alongside consecutive blank lines

5_711.concept: 空格后子词与格式边界
5_711.description: 激活最一致地落在带前导空格的 L 子词及少数固定子词上；另涵盖代码配置、JSON、法律引注、年代、人名和换行等格式特征，语义领域分散。

patterns.name: 特殊格式中的 L 字符
patterns.context: 字母 L 作为独立片段或带前导空格的子词出现在结构化文本、姓名、引文或医学术语中；各处后续内容不同

patterns.name: 语言模型配置标记
patterns.context: GitHub 代码中，标记序列处于类似配置键的结构里，后接 DataKinds 或 FlexibleContexts

patterns.name: obtained 内部子串
patterns.context: 出现在连字符复合词“-obtained”中，前接“fraudulently-”或“as-”；周围词义与该子串无明显共同主题
patterns.domain: 法律文本、材料科学摘要

patterns.name: L. monocytogenes 病原体名称
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，作为感染病原体名称的一部分

patterns.name: 法律引注中的 L
patterns.context: 法条或法律引注格式中，L. 位于卷页引用之后

patterns.name: 年代数字中的 s
patterns.context: “1190s in England”一类年代表达中，年代数字后缀 s 被标记

patterns.name: JSON 数据中的记录结构
patterns.context: 示例数据以对象、键值对和重复姓名构成，包含姓名及街道地址

patterns.name: 姓名中的字母 L 子词
patterns.context: 人名被分词为多个子词；激活落在姓氏开头片段及后续子词

patterns.name: 行尾及空白换行标记
patterns.context: 激活出现于代码片段、条目或人名之后的换行位置，常伴随连续空行
patterns.domain: 代码、百科条目、数据文本

en.description: Activations fall mainly on uppercase L subwords and word-internal fragments that follow them, appearing in code labels, proper names, and abbreviations; other localized patterns include structured fields, year digits, and the obt substring after a hyphen. Contexts span multiple domains.

patterns.name: LANGUAGE in code labels
patterns.context: The highest activation centers on the uppercase L subword « L», often inside a language name, proper name, or text fragment; the context is not always a complete word
patterns.domain: Code, medicine, law, encyclopedias, and general text

patterns.name: JSON/structured-data fragments
patterns.context: Code or examples contain key-value fields, punctuation, and formatting structures; some activations fall on field names or adjacent text

patterns.name: L in legal case citations
patterns.context: Abbreviation of a legal reporter series, preceded by page numbers and a case citation

patterns.name: Year digits and sentence-initial fragments
patterns.context: A year is followed by England and a line break, after which a new paragraph begins

patterns.name: L subwords in names
patterns.context: Inside proper names beginning with uppercase L, with similar names recurring in the paragraph

patterns.name: obtained in acquisition terminology
patterns.context: The obt substring appears after a hyphen; both instances occur in relatively formal long sentences

5_711.description: 激活主要落在大写 L 子词及其后的词内片段，见于代码标签、专名和缩写；另有结构化字段、年代数字及连字符后的 obt 子串等局部模式，语境跨领域。

patterns.name: 代码标签中的 LANGUAGE
patterns.trigger: « L»，随后在[1]、[2]为 «ANG»«U»«AGE»；[3]为 «ister»；其他段落也出现 « L»
patterns.context: 最高激活集中在大写 L 子词 « L»，常处于语言名称、专名或文本片段的词中；上下文并不总是完整词
patterns.domain: 代码、医学、法律、百科及一般文本

patterns.name: JSON/结构化数据片段
patterns.context: 代码或示例中包含键值字段、标点与格式化结构；部分激活落在字段名或相邻文本
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与 StackExchange 示例

patterns.name: 法律判例引注中的 L
patterns.trigger: « L» 位于 «129 L.R.R.M.» 引注中
patterns.context: 法律引注的报告集缩写，前有页码及判例引注

patterns.name: 年代数字与句首残片
patterns.context: 年代数字后接 England 和换行，随后开始新段落

patterns.name: 姓名中的 L 子词
patterns.trigger: « L»，出现在 «L ecointre» 一类姓名拼写中
patterns.context: 大写 L 起始的专名内部，且段落重复出现相近姓名

patterns.name: 取得用语中的 obtained
patterns.context: 连字符后出现 obt 子串；两处都在较正式的长句中

en.description: The most stable signal is uppercase L after a space, appearing in multiple contexts; sporadic activations also occur on digits, text-box symbols, and fragments of long medical terms, possibly reflecting different tokenization or formatting features.

patterns.name: Token fragment of uppercase L
patterns.context: Uppercase L follows a space, usually as the beginning of a word or part of a name/abbreviation; subsequent tokens continue to form a word or abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Code, medical papers, legal text, encyclopedias, and web text

patterns.name: Digits in numbers and identifiers
patterns.context: Digits or years appear as character fragments, often in headings, entries, or identifier sequences; they have no apparent semantic connection to the L pattern.

patterns.name: Table/border symbols and structural markers
patterns.context: Repeated vertical bars, periods, hyphens, braces, and similar symbols form text-box, table, or comparable marked structures.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Long technical terms in medical abstracts are split into multiple subword fragments; aside from L, the fragments are scattered and show no stable shared trigger.

5_711.concept: 大写 L 分词片段
5_711.description: 最稳定的信号是空格后大写 L（多种语境均出现）；另有数字字符、文本框符号及医学长词片段等零散激活，可能反映不同的分词或格式特征。

patterns.name: 大写字母 L 的分词片段
patterns.context: 空格后出现大写 L，通常作为单词开头或姓名/缩写的一部分；后续 token 会继续拼成单词或缩写。
patterns.domain: 代码、医学论文、法律文本、百科与网页文本

patterns.name: 数字与编号中的数字字符
patterns.context: 数字、年代或编号的字符分段出现，常处于标题、条目或编号序列中；与 L 模式并无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 表格/边框符号与结构标记
patterns.context: 重复的竖线、点号、连字符、花括号等构成文本框、表格或类似标记的结构。
patterns.domain: 代码或纯文本格式化内容

patterns.name: 医学术语中的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要里的长专业词被拆分为多个子词片段；除 L 外，各片段分散，未显示稳定共同触发词。

en.description: Activation most consistently appears on uppercase L subword fragments after a space; what follows may belong to code keys, names, medical terms, email names, or legal abbreviations. Other instances include code metadata, year expressions, and miscellaneous line breaks.

patterns.name: L-prefix subword fragments
patterns.context: The letter L begins a following word or abbreviation, often adjacent to other segmented subword fragments; it sometimes occurs in proper names, institution names, or citations.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; including code, medicine, biographical entries, email, and legal citations

patterns.name: Language marker in code
patterns.context: Appears in YAML-like key-value metadata, followed by fields such as Data Kinds or Flexible Contexts.

patterns.name: Numbers and s in years
patterns.context: An s follows a sequence of digits to form the English year expression “1190s”, followed by a place and an event-entry format.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in line-broken name entries
patterns.context: Names are split into multiple subword tokens, appearing in entry titles, repeated names, or at the start of entries.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Multiple medical words are segmented into in-word fragments; the same passage also contains « L»isteria.

patterns.name: L.R.R.M. abbreviation in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears after page numbers and volume information in case citations.

patterns.name: L-initial portion of a name in email
patterns.context: Part of a possessive name, occurring in a request and attachment description.

patterns.name: Unmergeable line breaks and entry fragments
patterns.context: Multiple line breaks are adjacent to truncated fragments; no stable shared trigger can be determined from the fragments.

5_711.concept: 大写 L 起始片段
5_711.description: 激活最稳定地出现在空格后的大写 L 子词片段，后续可属于代码键、姓名、医学词、邮件人名或法律缩写；另有代码元数据、年代表达及换行杂项。

patterns.name: L 前缀子词片段
patterns.context: 字母 L 作为后续词或缩写的起始部分，常与其他被切分的子词片段相邻；有时处在专名、机构名或引文中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；代码、医学、人物条目、邮件和法律引文等

patterns.name: 代码中的 Language 标记
patterns.context: 出现在类似 YAML 的键值元数据中，后接 Data Kinds 或 Flexible Contexts 等字段。

patterns.name: 年份中的数字与 s
patterns.context: 数字序列后接 s，组成英语年代表达“1190s”，随后是地点和事件条目格式。
patterns.domain: 维基百科年代事件条目

patterns.name: 分行姓名条目中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 人名被拆成多个子词 token，出现在条目标题、重复姓名或条目开头。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 多个医学词被分词为词内片段；同一段也包含 « L»isteria。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 L.R.R.M. 缩写
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文的页码与卷册信息之后。

patterns.name: 邮件中人名的 L 起始部分
patterns.context: 作为所有格人名的一部分，位于请求及附件说明中。

patterns.name: 无法归并的换行及条目碎片
patterns.trigger: «BL»«3»«M»、« Floor»« L»«amp»，以及 «Share» 与随后标点
patterns.context: 多次换行和截断片段相邻；难以从片段确定稳定的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across contexts: a space followed by uppercase L stands out in format directives and also occurs frequently with numbers beginning with 0; other instances involve repeated text separated by line breaks and L in proper names. It is unclear whether these are driven by the same feature.

patterns.name: Uppercase L after a special marker
patterns.context: Code or text fragments begin with format directives such as `{-# LANGUAGE`; highlighting centers on a space followed by uppercase L.

patterns.name: Values in decimal format
patterns.context: Numbers begin with 0 and are followed by a decimal point or fractional part; this occurs in mathematical text and lines containing numbers.
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, ArXiv text, and code data

patterns.name: 0 in line-initial years or numbers
patterns.context: 0 appears within a digit string, possibly as the last digit of a year/value or the start of a number on a new line; the fragment alone does not establish a common meaning.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, code, and mathematical/academic text

patterns.name: Repeated headings and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Near headings, entries, or repeated text separated by line breaks; however, the activation may also fall on adjacent digits.

patterns.name: L in specific entities and proper names
patterns.context: Uppercase L occurs inside proper names or words, as in Floor Lamp and William L. Hadden; its form resembles the L in LANGUAGE, but the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Repeated Gordon proper name
patterns.context: The repeated phrase `Seton Gordon` appears across paragraph breaks.

5_711.concept: 大写 L 与数字/格式边界
5_711.description: 激活分散于不同语境：突出格式指令中的空格加大写 L，也常见于以 0 开头的数字；另有换行分隔的重复文本及专名中的 L，无法确定这些是否由同一特征驱动。

patterns.name: 特殊标记后的大写 L
patterns.context: 代码或文本片段以 `{-# LANGUAGE` 一类格式指令开头；高亮集中在空格加大写 L。

patterns.name: 小数格式的数值
patterns.context: 数字以 0 开头，后接小数点或小数部分；在数学文本和含数字的行中出现。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、ArXiv 文本及代码数据

patterns.name: 行首年份或数字中的 0
patterns.trigger: «0»10，前接 «119» 或逗号，后接小数点、小数位或换行
patterns.context: 0 出现在数字串中，可能是年份/数值的末位或新行数字的开头；仅凭片段无法确定统一语义。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、代码及数学/学术文本

patterns.name: 重复标题与段落分隔
patterns.context: 换行分隔的标题、条目或重复文本附近；但激活点也可能落在邻接数字上。

patterns.name: 特定实体名与专名中的 L
patterns.trigger: « L»9（«amp»、«. H»邻近），以及 « L»9 后接名称
patterns.context: 大写 L 出现在专名或词语内部，见 Floor Lamp、William L. Hadden；与 LANGUAGE 中的 L 形式相似，但语境不同。

patterns.name: Gordon 专名重复
patterns.context: 重复的短语 `Seton Gordon`，跨段落换行出现。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to occurrences of uppercase L: most prominently in FILED markers in legal documents, and also in configuration keys, legal abbreviations, and the initial letters of pathogen and personal names; triggering contexts span multiple text types.

patterns.name: FILED markers in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal-document layout, usually an all-caps filing marker at the top or margin of a page, with the court name “United States” nearby

patterns.name: L.R.R.M. in legal citations
patterns.context: A legal citation or rule abbreviation following the number “129”

patterns.name: L in configuration keys
patterns.context: In a Markdown-style configuration snippet, the first letter of the word “LANGUAGE”; nearby are option names such as “DataKinds” or “FlexibleContexts”

patterns.name: L in the name Listeria
patterns.context: In a medical abstract, the first letter of the pathogen name “Listeria monocytogenes”, appearing in a statement about infection

patterns.name: L in a personal name
patterns.context: The initial of the surname in the French name “François Lecointre”, in encyclopedia-style biographical text

patterns.name: L in a surname
patterns.context: The initial of the surname in the email name “TK Lohman's”, in a sentence about an attachment or request

5_711.description: 主要对大写字母 L 的出现敏感：法律文书的 FILED 标记中最突出，也出现在配置键、法律缩写以及病原体和人名的词首；触发背景横跨多种文本。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 FILED 标记
patterns.trigger: «F» I« L» E D（含分隔空格、换行及周围留白）
patterns.context: 法律文书版面中，通常作为页首或页边的全大写归档标记，附近可见法院名称“United States”

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 L.R.R.M.
patterns.context: 编号“129”之后的法律引文或规则缩写

patterns.name: 配置键中的 L
patterns.context: Markdown 风格的配置片段中，作为“LANGUAGE”一词开头的字母；附近有“DataKinds”或“FlexibleContexts”等选项名

patterns.name: Listeria 名称中的 L
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，作为病原体名称“Listeria monocytogenes”的首字母，出现在感染相关表述中

patterns.name: 人名中的 L
patterns.context: 法语人名“François Lecointre”姓氏开头，处于百科条目式人物文本中

patterns.name: 姓氏中的 L
patterns.context: 邮件中人名“TK Lohman's”的姓氏开头，处于附件或请求相关语句中

en.description: Activation often falls on uppercase L or subsequent character fragments, and also covers in-word fragments in multiple languages, names, and specialized texts; other triggers are scattered, with no unified semantics or stable contextual condition.

patterns.name: Uppercase letter L
patterns.context: Uppercase L appears in proper names, legal citations, or abbreviations, usually combining with following letters/characters to form a name or number; it also occurs in multilingual text.
patterns.domain: Proper names, legal documents, email, medical text, and multilingual text

patterns.name: Name suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-final or internal fragments in full names or Hungarian word forms, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Legal case citation format
patterns.context: Citation format for U.S. case reporter volumes and pages and legal reporter abbreviations.

patterns.name: Formulaic phrases in legal opinions
patterns.context: Lawyer status, judge listings, and per curiam formulaic statements in court opinions.

patterns.name: Medicaid card information page
patterns.context: Contact information, revision date, and usage-guide headings for a medical assistance card.

patterns.name: Email wording about attached files
patterns.context: Email stating that an electronic copy is provided as requested.

patterns.name: Italian discussion of business/entrepreneurship
patterns.context: Italian academic discussion of entrepreneurship, businesses, and the business world.

patterns.name: German discussion of limitations and opposition
patterns.context: German academic text discusses what is perceived or cognized, opposition, and limitations, using discourse connectors such as “während”.

patterns.name: Hungarian compound-word fragments
patterns.context: Hungarian sentences contain word forms related to complex problems, the international community, and schedules; strong activation falls on in-word fragments.

patterns.name: Swedish welcome and officials' names
patterns.context: A Swedish parliamentary speech welcomes people associated with EU topics and names committee members.

patterns.name: French names and word boundaries
patterns.context: The initial and internal fragments of the name François Lecointre; another Fran... follows.

patterns.name: L in a pathogen abbreviation
patterns.context: Uppercase L in the herpesvirus name abbreviation LHV-4.

5_711.concept: 字符/词片段与专名格式
5_711.description: 激活常落在大写 L 或其后续字符片段，也覆盖多语种词内片段、姓名和各类专门文本；其余触发分散，未见统一语义或稳定上下文条件。

patterns.name: 大写字母 L
patterns.context: 大写 L 出现在专名、法律引文或缩写中，且通常与后续字母/字符组成名称或编号；在多语种文本中也出现。
patterns.domain: 专名、法律文书、邮件、医学文本及多语种文本

patterns.name: 人名后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整姓名或匈牙利语词形中的词尾/内部片段，未见一致的词义条件。

patterns.name: 法律判例引文格式
patterns.context: 美国判例报告卷页及法律报告缩写的引文格式。

patterns.name: 法律意见书固定语句
patterns.context: 法院意见书中律师身份、法官列名及 per curiam 程式语句。

patterns.name: Medicaid 卡片说明页面
patterns.trigger: «AL»3«ASK»1«A»1 MED«ICA»3«ID»3 ... «How»10 to« Use»4« Your»5« Alaska»4« Medicaid»3« Card»3
patterns.context: 医疗补助卡的联系信息、修订日期及使用指南标题。
patterns.domain: 公共服务网页/说明材料

patterns.name: 随附文件邮件措辞
patterns.trigger: «Att»1«ached»3« pursuant»3« to»1 ... « request»4 is« an»4 electronic copy
patterns.context: 邮件说明附件系应请求提供的电子副本。

patterns.name: 意大利语企业/创业论述
patterns.context: 意大利语学术论述中谈创业、企业及商业世界。
patterns.domain: 学术论文/哲学社会科学

patterns.name: 德语限制与对立论述
patterns.context: 德语学术文字讨论被感受或认知、对立及限制，并使用“während”等论述连接词。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语复合词片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语句子中出现复杂问题、国际共同体及日程相关词形；强激活落在词内片段。

patterns.name: 瑞典语欢迎与官员姓名
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言欢迎欧盟议题相关人员，并点名委员会成员。

patterns.name: 法语姓名及词界
patterns.context: 姓名 François Lecointre 的首字母及姓名内部片段；后续另起一名 Fran...。

patterns.name: 病原体缩写中的 L
patterns.context: 疱疹病毒名称缩写 LHV-4 中的大写 L。

en.description: Strong activation falls on in-word fragments in multiple languages: rend (Finnish, Dutch, German, and Italian words), Italian cit, the email-domain fragment catalyt, and the title Fu; no unified semantic or stylistic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Italian rendo morpheme in words
patterns.context: In Italian, hits words related to “imprenditoriale / imprenditori” (business, entrepreneurs); in Dutch, hits “variërend” (varying)
patterns.domain: EU policy, economic, or parliamentary text

patterns.name: Finnish rend morpheme
patterns.context: A tokenized fragment of the Finnish agenda-related word “päivärendaku / päiväjärjend...”, occurring in agenda and meeting-scheduling contexts

patterns.name: cit in Italian citare
patterns.context: Italian discussion refers to citing something; surrounding content concerns its effects, science, and so on

patterns.name: catalyt in a company domain
patterns.context: A company email-domain fragment that appears repeatedly

patterns.name: Fu in an English name
patterns.context: A short title appears repeatedly, with the trigger being the name/title “Fu”

patterns.name: rend in a German word
patterns.context: Inside a German conjunction meaning “while”

5_711.description: 强激活落在多种语言的词内部片段：rend（芬兰语、荷兰语、德语及意大利语词）、意大利语 cit、邮箱域名 catalyt、标题 Fu；未见统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 意大利语词中 rendo 词素
patterns.context: 意大利语中命中“imprenditoriale / imprenditori”（企业、企业家）相关词；荷兰语中命中“variërend”（变化的）
patterns.domain: 欧盟政策、经济或议会文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语 rend 词素
patterns.context: 芬兰语议程相关词“päivärendaku / päiväjärjend...”的分词片段，出现在议程、会议安排语境

patterns.name: 意大利语 citare 词中 cit
patterns.context: 意大利语论述中谈及引用某物；周围内容涉及其影响、科学等

patterns.name: 公司域名中的 catalyt
patterns.context: 重复出现的公司邮箱域名片段

patterns.name: 英语人名中的 Fu
patterns.trigger: «Fu»10（第1段），处于“Rag Doll Kung Fu”标题末尾
patterns.context: 短标题重复出现，触发点是人名/名称“Fu”

patterns.name: 德语词中 rend
patterns.context: 德语句子中表示“当……时”的连接词内部

en.description: Activation repeatedly falls on the word-initial fragments “War” and “Ul”, but War also occurs in the surname Warren; other instances are scattered across English apostrophe contractions and an in-word fragment of lynching, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: War word beginning or stem
patterns.context: War-related categories, military service, military games, or accounts of military history; often at the beginning of noun phrases or headings.

patterns.name: War in the name Warren
patterns.context: “Warren” is tokenized as beginning with “War”, referring to the surname of a football-club player and unrelated to war.

patterns.name: Ul at the start of a proper name
patterns.context: The “Ul” at the beginning of a personal name is marked as a fragment; it appears in an Austrian name in a Mars report and a name in French news.

patterns.name: Apostrophes in English contractions
patterns.context: The apostrophe belongs to an English possessive or contraction, usually immediately followed by letters; scattered across dialogue and narration.

patterns.name: lyn stem in a song title
patterns.context: Occurs in the theme “lynching” sung in “Strange Fruit”, as an internal subword fragment.

5_711.description: 激活标记反复落在词首片段「War」和「Ul」，但War也覆盖姓氏Warren；其余命中分散于英语撇号缩略形式及lynching的词内片段，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: War词首或词干
patterns.context: 战争相关分类、服役经历、军事游戏或战争史叙述；多出现在名词短语或小标题的开头。
patterns.domain: 百科分类、传记、游戏讨论

patterns.name: Warren名字中的War
patterns.context: 「Warren」被分词标注为以「War」开头，指足球俱乐部球员姓氏，与战争无关。

patterns.name: 专名词首的Ul
patterns.context: 人名开头的「Ul」被切分标记；分别出现在火星报道中的奥地利姓名和法语新闻中的姓名。

patterns.name: 英语缩略形式中的撇号
patterns.context: 撇号属于英语所有格或缩略形式，后续字母通常紧邻；散见于对话与叙述。

patterns.name: 歌词题名中的lyn词干
patterns.context: 出现在《Strange Fruit》所唱主题「lynching」中，是单词内部子词片段。

en.description: Activation spans multiple languages and topics, mainly falling on in-word subword fragments; similar ov/ov- fragments and language-specific word forms occur, but there is no stable semantic or stylistic condition that explains all examples.

patterns.name: In-word final -ov- fragment
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on letter fragments within words resembling ov/ov-; specific words and positions vary, and the fragments are usually split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Multilingual; segment 1 is philosophical text, segments 2–10 are mainly European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Slavic word forms and endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of Slavic words, such as Slovak or Slovenian, often in inflected or derived forms; not all such words activate equally.

patterns.name: Hungarian accident-narrative vocabulary
patterns.context: Hungarian sentences contain words about a Romanian location, an accident, and injured people; strong activation is distributed across internal fragments of multiple words.

patterns.name: In-word Finnish fragments
patterns.context: Internal fragments of several words in Finnish sentences activate, concerning transport, agriculture, and obstacles.

patterns.name: In-word Portuguese fragments
patterns.context: In an introduction to a young philosopher and a journal, internal word fragments activate; the passage also has several weaker in-word activations.

patterns.name: Swedish fragments containing rådet
patterns.context: The word and its repeated occurrences activate in parliamentary discussion or council-speech contexts.

patterns.name: Czech procedural vocabulary
patterns.context: Multiple internal fragments of Czech words activate in discussions of EU rules and procedures.

patterns.name: In-word activation in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing abstract concepts such as dogmatism, finitude, and opposites; strong activation is concentrated within words and does not form an obvious topic-word trigger.

patterns.name: Dutch gender-equality vocabulary
patterns.context: Internal parts of related compounds activate in a presentation of a committee proposal on women's rights and gender equality.

patterns.name: Token boundaries and subword fragments
patterns.context: Across segments, activation generally falls on subwords or letter fragments within words; the substantial differences in language and meaning do not establish a unified semantic or grammatical trigger.

5_711.description: 激活跨多种语言与题材，主要落在词内的子词片段；可见相似 ov/ov- 片段及各语言特有词形，但缺少能解释全部样例的稳定语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 词内末尾 -ov- 片段
patterns.context: 较强激活落在词中包含类似 ov/ov- 的字母片段；具体词和位置不一，片段通常被拆分成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 多语种；第1段哲学文本，第2–10段以欧洲议会发言为主

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词形与词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在斯洛伐克语或斯洛文尼亚语等斯拉夫语词的内部片段，常见于词形变化或派生形式；并非所有此类词都同样激活。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种翻译文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语事故叙述词汇
patterns.context: 匈牙利语句子中出现罗马尼亚地点、事故及伤者等词汇；强激活分布在多个词的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言，事故陈述

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语句子中若干词的内部片段激活，涉及交通、农业及障碍等内容。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 介绍年轻哲学家及期刊时，词语内部片段激活；该段另有多处较弱的词内激活。

patterns.name: 瑞典语含 rådet 的片段
patterns.context: 在议会讨论或理事会发言语境中，该词及其重复出现的位置有激活。

patterns.name: 捷克语程序词汇
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟规则和程序时，多个捷克语词内部片段激活。

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的词内激活
patterns.context: 讨论教条主义、有限与相反者等抽象概念时出现；强激活集中在词内部，不构成明显的主题词触发。

patterns.name: 荷兰语性别平等词汇
patterns.context: 介绍委员会关于妇女权利与性别平等的提案时，相关复合词内部有激活。

patterns.name: token 边界与子词片段
patterns.context: 各段的激活普遍落在词内部的子词或字母片段上；由于语言和词义差异很大，不能据此确认统一的语义或语法触发条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across in-word fragments in multiple languages, English for phrases, and areas near numbers, digits, and structured metadata; open also occurs in trade text and its in quantum discussion. The corpora and trigger positions differ substantially, making it difficult to reduce them to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: In-word fragments and affixes
patterns.context: Activation falls in the middle of words or on affixes split into multiple tokens, including German word-form fragments and Portuguese in-word fragments; these examples alone do not establish a unified lexical condition.
patterns.domain: Multilingual philosophical text, Portuguese academic writing

patterns.name: for in phrases
patterns.context: The English preposition for is followed by a purpose, object, or scope of applicability; activation strength varies with the specific meaning and style.
patterns.domain: Online informal language, list entries, technical documentation

patterns.name: Near numbers or identifiers
patterns.context: Activation occurs near digits, page numbers, sequence numbers, dimensions, or DOI numbers; the trigger is not always the number itself, and no consistent boundary can be further inferred.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic information, technical materials, papers, and scientific text

patterns.name: Expressions of opening or initiating an action
patterns.context: A Dutch sentence calls for opening import quotas to avoid supply disruptions; activation is concentrated on the word meaning open and its ending.

patterns.name: Quantifiers and discussion of indeterminacy
patterns.context: Discusses numerical objectivity in quantum states as uncertain, rather than merely unknown to an observer; activation occurs on a possessive pronoun and nearby sentences.
patterns.domain: Analytic philosophy, philosophy of quantum physics

patterns.name: Quantities and labels in structured entries
patterns.context: Configuration parameters or project lists mix field names, sequence numbers, item names, and descriptions, unlike continuous prose.

patterns.name: Task markers in scientific text
patterns.context: Task categories are listed with numbers after a hypothesis or research objective; activation falls near the numbers and their punctuation.
patterns.domain: Neuroimaging research abstracts or project descriptions

patterns.name: Engineering dimensions and specification terms
patterns.context: Describes duct thickness, heat-transfer coefficients, insulation, and finished-product specifications; activation occurs locally around dimension numbers and specification terms.

patterns.name: Bibliographic metadata format
patterns.context: Publishers, page counts, journal information, and DOI numbers occur adjacent to one another in book or journal citations; activation is distributed over local markers and digit strings.
patterns.domain: Philosophy book reviews and academic citations

5_711.description: 激活分散于多语种词内片段、英语 for 短语，以及编号、数字和结构化元数据附近；另见贸易文本中的 open、量子论述中的 its。不同语料与触发位置差异明显，难以归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 词内片段及词缀
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分为多个 token 的词中部或词缀上，包含德语词形片段和葡萄牙语词内片段；不能仅凭这些例子确定统一词法条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种哲学文本、葡萄牙语学术文字

patterns.name: 短语中的 for
patterns.context: 英语介词 for 后接目的、对象或适用范围；激活强弱与具体语义和文体不同。
patterns.domain: 网络口语、列表条目、技术文档

patterns.name: 数字或编号邻接处
patterns.context: 数字、页码、序号、尺寸或 DOI 等数字串附近出现激活；触发位置并不总是数字本身，难以进一步归纳一致边界。
patterns.domain: 书目信息、技术资料、论文及科研文本

patterns.name: 开放或启动的动作表述
patterns.context: 荷兰语句中要求开放进口配额，以避免供应中断；激活集中在表示开放的词及其词尾。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会贸易政策文本

patterns.name: 量词与不定性论述
patterns.context: 讨论量子态中数值客观不确定、而非仅为观察者未知；激活出现在物主代词及附近句子。
patterns.domain: 分析哲学、量子物理哲学

patterns.name: 结构化条目中的数量与标签
patterns.trigger: «Max»2out size；«1»4« for»8；«MAC»1 Program；«Public»2 of Accounting Report
patterns.context: 配置参数或项目清单中，字段名、序号、项目名称与说明混排；与通常连续散文不同。
patterns.domain: 代码文档、教育项目列表

patterns.name: 科研文本中的任务标记
patterns.context: 假设或研究目标之后，以编号列出任务类别；激活落在编号及其标点附近。
patterns.domain: 神经影像研究摘要或项目描述

patterns.name: 工程尺寸与规格词
patterns.context: 描述风管厚度、热传递系数、绝热和成品规格；激活出现在尺寸数字及规格词的局部。

patterns.name: 书目元数据格式
patterns.context: 书籍或期刊引文中，出版社、页数、刊物信息和 DOI 等元数据相邻出现；激活分布在局部标记和数字串。

en.description: Activations are broadly distributed across multilingual word-internal fragments, word boundaries, and common phrases; they span philosophy, parliamentary, web, and email-directory text, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word-internal tokens and cross-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall inside words, near word boundaries, or on short common fragments; they do not consistently correspond to complete words or fixed meanings. The positions of high-intensity tokens vary by language and context.
patterns.domain: Multilingual and English text; spans all paragraphs

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in German philosophical discussion
patterns.context: In German philosophical discussion, fragments occur inside words in contexts involving abstract concepts and their argumentation; « w»3«icht»10«ig»3 also occurs in the context of a parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in parliamentary discourse
patterns.context: In multilingual parliamentary speeches or legislative discussions, activations occur inside ordinary words, not on a fixed language or clearly identifiable parliamentary term.

patterns.name: go and neighboring words in English phrases
patterns.context: English spoken persuasion includes go for it, while legal/insurance website text includes go up against; these phrases contain go but differ in meaning and style.
patterns.domain: Web text, spoken persuasion, and legal-services websites

patterns.name: Email addresses and directory formatting
patterns.context: Contact names, E-mail labels in parentheses, and lists of email addresses enclosed in angle brackets.

patterns.name: Web documents and language about cleaning materials
patterns.context: Describes old report materials being cleaned up and search results changing as new and old files go online or offline; activations fall on common verb phrases and surrounding word fragments.
patterns.domain: Reports and explanations of web search results

patterns.name: Latvian word fragments about forest fires
patterns.context: In formal parliamentary text about coordination issues and forest fires, trigger fragments occur inside Latvian words.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Polish visit descriptions
patterns.context: Describes a delegation’s three-day study visit to parliament; activations concentrate inside Polish words.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Latvian space-related topics
patterns.context: Discusses the suitability of principles and proposals concerning space and distant exploration; activations occur inside Latvian words.

5_711.concept: 多语种词片段/边界特征
5_711.description: 激活广泛分布于多语种词内片段、词边界和常见短语；涵盖哲学、议会、网页及邮件名录，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内分词与跨词片段
patterns.trigger: 多个词内部被标记的短片段，如« ver»5«ke»2«hr»；« w»3«icht»10«ig»；« go»4« for»10« it»；« E»1-mail
patterns.context: 激活常落在词的内部、词边界附近或短小的常见词片段上，并不稳定对应完整词或固定语义；高强度 token 所处位置随语言和上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本及英语文本；覆盖全部段落

patterns.name: 德语哲学论述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 德语哲学论述中，片段出现在抽象概念及其论证语境的词内；另有« w»3«icht»10«ig»3出现在议程发言语境。

patterns.name: 议会语篇中的词内片段
patterns.context: 多语种议会发言或法规讨论中，激活出现在普通词的内部，并非固定语言或某一明确议会术语。

patterns.name: 英语短语中的 go 及相邻词
patterns.trigger: « go»4« for»10« it»；« go»1« up»9« against»
patterns.context: 英语口语劝说中出现 go for it，或法律/保险网站文本中出现 go up against；这些短语含 go，但其含义和文体不同。
patterns.domain: 网络文本、口语化劝说及法律服务网页

patterns.name: 邮件地址与名录格式
patterns.context: 联系人姓名、括号中的 E-mail 标签及尖括号包围的邮箱地址列表格式。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件或联系人名录

patterns.name: 网页文档与材料清理用语
patterns.trigger: « clean»2 up、« go»4« up»9、« taken»3« down»4
patterns.context: 描述旧报告材料被清理、搜索结果随新旧文件上线或下架而变化；激活落在常见动词短语及周围词片段。
patterns.domain: 报告、网页搜索结果说明

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语林火词语片段
patterns.context: 有关协调问题和森林火灾的正式议会文本中，触发片段位于拉脱维亚语词语内部。

patterns.name: 波兰语访问描述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 描述代表团在议会进行为期三天的考察访问，激活集中于波兰语词内部。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语太空议题词内片段
patterns.context: 讨论太空及遥远探索领域的原则和提案是否合适，激活出现在拉脱维亚语词内部。

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and scattered local patterns
en.description: Strong activation often occurs on subword fragments inside Finnish and Latvian words; there is also one mathematical conditional phrase, along with scattered activation in ordinary English words, formula symbols, and code identifiers, with no unified trigger pattern yet apparent.

patterns.name: In-word Finnish subword fragments
patterns.context: Trigger markers fall inside Finnish words, especially tokenized fragments of long words; these words occur in EU policy, legal, and parliamentary-speech contexts.

patterns.name: In-word Latvian subword fragments
patterns.context: Markers occur inside Latvian words; the contexts concern the European Commission, parliamentary discussions, and policy issues.

patterns.name: Mathematical conditional expression
patterns.context: Introduces a necessary and sufficient condition for a transition in infection status in a mathematical paper, surrounded by variables, time subscripts, and formal definitions.

patterns.name: Ordinary words in English phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on common words or phrase components in English sentences; examples occur in conversational encouragement, film reviews, and scientific-paper descriptions, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Fragments adjacent to formulas and symbols
patterns.context: Activation occurs in text intermixing particle physics formulas, numbers, and mathematical symbols, without a stable word-meaning trigger.

patterns.name: Fragments in Italian interface strings
patterns.context: In the name field of an Android string resource, activation falls on an English-style identifier fragment; adjacent interface text is in Italian.

5_711.concept: 多语词片段与零散局部模式
5_711.description: 强激活多出现在芬兰语和拉脱维亚语词内部的子词片段；另有一次数学条件短语，以及英语普通词、公式符号和代码标识符中的零散激活，尚无统一触发规律。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 触发标记落在芬兰语词内部，尤其是长词的分词片段；这些词出现在欧盟政策、法律及议会发言语境。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 标记位于拉脱维亚语词内部；语境涉及欧盟委员会、议会讨论和政策议题。

patterns.name: 数学条件表达
patterns.context: 在数学论文中引出感染状态转变的充要条件，周围有变量、时间下标和形式化定义。

patterns.name: 英语短语中的普通词
patterns.context: 激活落在英语句子里的常见词或短语成分；分别见于口语鼓励、影评和科学论文描述，未见统一语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 与 ArXiv 英语文本

patterns.name: 公式和符号邻接片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在粒子物理公式、数字与数学符号交错的文本中，未显示稳定的词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 意大利语界面字符串中的片段
patterns.context: Android 字符串资源的名称字段中，激活落在英文式标识符片段；相邻界面文本为意大利语。

en.description: Activations span multilingual parliamentary text, English academic and technical text, and isolated proper names and years; they often occur on word-internal subwords, function words, symbols, or digit fragments, with no stable shared semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word-internal suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on subword fragments inside multilingual words, not always at the beginning; contexts vary across parliamentary speeches, dates and agendas, congratulations, and policy statements.
patterns.domain: Estonian, French, and mixed-language European Parliament text

patterns.name: English function words and local syntax
patterns.context: Activations occur near common words, word-internal fragments, and mathematical symbols in continuous English text; specific collocations and meanings vary across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Mathematical modeling papers, physics papers, and technology blogs

patterns.name: Numeric and year formats
patterns.context: Digit activations concentrate in year expressions such as “by the year 2,000” in population-growth projections.
patterns.domain: Explanatory text on US medical management

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on spelling fragments in the footballers’ names “Zbigniew Boniek” and “Józef Młynarczyk.”
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia biographies and football biographies

5_711.description: 激活跨多语种议会文本、英语学术与科技文本及单例专名和年份；常见于词内子词、功能词、符号或数字片段，未见稳定共享的语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在多语种词汇内部的子词片段，不总在词首；上下文分别涉及议会发言、日期与议程、祝贺或政策陈述。
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语、法语及混合语种的欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词与局部句法
patterns.trigger: « at»、«$»、«t»、« if»、« and»、« infected»、« the»、« in»、« where»、« law»、« finite»、« exists»
patterns.context: 激活出现在英语连续文本中的常见词、词内片段及数学符号附近；不同段落的具体搭配和语义各异。
patterns.domain: 数学建模论文、物理论文及科技博客

patterns.name: 数值与年份格式

patterns.name: English compound-word suffix fragments

5_711.description: 激活分散在多语种词内片段、英语 as if、增长表述及日期/数字格式中；较醒目的重复线索是数字29的拆分形式，但不足以解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内子词片段

patterns.name: 英语复合词后缀片段

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual corpora, often falling on short word-internal fragments, diacritic characters, digits, and identifiers; a few local word families or formats are identifiable, but there are no stable semantic or syntactic conditions across paragraphs.

patterns.name: Restricted substrings/word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall inside words, on affixes, or on short subword fragments, with no stable complete-word trigger; they may be influenced by tokenization boundaries and character positions
patterns.domain: Multilingual natural language and legal text

patterns.name: Numeric and identifier formats

patterns.name: Dutch sentence fragments

patterns.name: Czech diacritic characters and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Czech parliamentary speeches, activations are scattered across diacritic characters and fragments within ordinary words

patterns.name: French letter fragments and proper names
patterns.context: French narrative mentions an attacked journalist and the place name Jalalabad; markers fall on local parts of proper names or ordinary words

patterns.name: French medical word fragments

patterns.name: Page/document formatting and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs separately in web links/institution names and in Portuguese book-editor information; there is no shared semantic condition

patterns.name: Legal document markers

patterns.domain: US case law and legislative text

5_711.description: 激活分散于多语种语料，常落在词内短片段、变音字符、数字及编号上；少数局部词族或格式可辨，但跨段缺少稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 受限子串/词尾片段
patterns.trigger: 分词或局部字符片段，如 «f»、«in»、«l»、«é»、«gro»；有时后续片段也被标记，如 «f»«led»«ged»
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部、词缀或短小子词片段上，未见稳定的完整词触发条件；可能受分词边界和字符位置影响
patterns.domain: 多语种自然语言及法律文本

patterns.name: 数字及编号格式
patterns.context: 数字出现在日期、数量、引文或法条编号等格式中；激活位置并不一致，未显示统一的数字语义
patterns.domain: 网页文章、报告、判决及法规引文

patterns.name: 英文 grow 词族
patterns.context: 描述 managed care 的扩张或发展；同段还出现年份与数量
patterns.domain: 美国医疗保健市场报告

patterns.name: 荷兰语语句片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会发言中若干词的片段被标记，未见明确共享的句法或语义条件

patterns.name: 捷克语重音字符及词内片段
patterns.context: 捷克语议会发言中，激活分散在带变音符号的字符及普通词内片段

patterns.name: 法语字母片段与专名

patterns.name: 法语医学词片段

patterns.name: 页面/文档格式与专名片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在网页链接/机构名以及葡萄牙语书籍编者信息中；缺少共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 网页文章与书籍版权页

patterns.name: 法律文书标记
patterns.context: 出现在判决日期、页码/脚注标记及美国联邦量刑指南引用中

en.concept: Local features of subword fragments and digits
en.description: Activations often fall on intra-word fragments after tokenizer splitting: the «al» in Jalalabad and Jalili is repeatedly highlighted. It also responds to diacritic or long-vowel characters across languages, and to the digit 2 in dates, years, and thousands. Triggers span languages, proper names, and numbers, with no common semantics observed.

patterns.name: Numeric dates and following tokens
patterns.context: Digits in dates or years are split into multiple tokens; activation is concentrated on the digit 2.

patterns.name: Intra-word character fragments in Slavic languages
patterns.context: Words with diacritics in Eastern European languages are split by the tokenizer; activation falls on subword fragments containing diacritics, across different languages and words.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the place name Jalalabad
patterns.context: The place name Jalalabad is split into multiple tokens; activation is concentrated on the recurring internal «al» fragment in descriptions of geographic locations or attack sites.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia geography entries, French parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Jalili in organization or institution names
patterns.context: In the proper name Saeed Jalili, the split «al» fragment activates strongly; surrounding text introduces alumni and positions.

patterns.name: Júlia in Portuguese names
patterns.context: The name Júlia in Portuguese institutional staff lists is split, and the accented «ú» activates.

patterns.name: Long vowels and split fragments within Latvian words
patterns.context: Latvian words are split into subword fragments containing long-vowel marks; multiple intra-word fragments activate, rather than a single clearly meaningful word.

patterns.name: Digit 2 in thousands
patterns.context: When years or quantities in English statistical text are written as comma-separated thousands, the split fragment containing the digit 2 activates.

5_711.concept: 拆分词片段与数字的局部特征
5_711.description: 激活多落在 tokenizer 拆分后的词内片段：反复突出 Jalalabad、Jalili 中的 al；也响应多种语言的变音或长音字符，以及日期、年份和千位数中的数字 2。触发因素跨语种、专名和数字，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 数字日期及其后续 token
patterns.context: 日期或年份中的数字被拆分为多个 token；激活集中在数字 2。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内字符片段
patterns.trigger: 斯洛伐克语 «á»、«rá»、«ú»；捷克语 «é»、«í»、«í»；均出现在词内
patterns.context: 东欧语言中带变音符号的词被 tokenizer 拆分，激活落在带变音符号的子词片段；涉及不同语言和不同词。
patterns.domain: 斯洛伐克语、捷克语议会发言

patterns.name: 地名 Jalalabad 的内部片段
patterns.context: 地名 Jalalabad 被拆成多个 token；激活集中在重复出现的内部 «al» 片段，出现在对地理位置或袭击地点的叙述中。
patterns.domain: 英文百科地理条目、法语议会发言

patterns.name: 组织或机构名称中的 Jalili
patterns.context: 专名 Saeed Jalili 中，拆分出的 «al» 片段强烈激活；周围是校友及职务介绍。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语姓名中的 Júlia
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语机构人员名单中的人名 Júlia，被拆分后带重音的 «ú» 激活。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语学术机构介绍

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内的长元音及拆分片段
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语词被拆成含长音符号的子词片段；多处词内片段激活，而非单一明显词义。

patterns.name: 千位数中的数字 2
patterns.context: 英文统计文本中年份或数量写成带逗号的千位数时，数字 2 所在的拆分片段激活。
patterns.domain: 美国医疗管理研究摘要

en.description: Most paragraphs come from multilingual parliamentary text, with activations scattered across word-internal subwords, diacritic characters, and word boundaries; isolated examples also include medical growth and quantities, software operation instructions, and cloud-service descriptions, with no unified semantic or grammatical trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-language character-level fragments and word-internal subwords
patterns.context: Triggers are unstable and often fall on subwords across spaces or near word boundaries, stems, or diacritic characters; there is no consistent complete word or fixed syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament text; includes Czech, Latvian, Spanish, Slovak, Swedish, and other languages.

patterns.name: Growth and quantity statements
patterns.context: In a description of growth in US managed-care organizations and their membership, activations concentrate near growth words and quantity/time expressions.

patterns.name: Interface operation instructions
patterns.context: Command steps in email or software help documentation instruct users to empty the Deleted Items folder or disable logging; line-break markers also activate.
patterns.domain: Software operation instructions in Enron emails.

patterns.name: Cloud-service product phrase
patterns.context: In the product description “fully-fledged cloud-based subscription service,” activations fall inside compound adjectives; the preceding text also mentions a temporary need to add hardware, software, and skills.
patterns.domain: Business blog or promotional description of cloud services.

5_711.description: 多数段落来自多语种议会文本，激活分散在词内子词、重音字符及词边界附近；另有医疗增长与数量、软件操作指令、云服务描述等孤例，未见统一的语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 跨语言字符级碎片与词内子词
patterns.trigger: 激活分散在词内字符或子词片段上，如 [1] «é»、« po»、« vel»、«í»，[3] «u»、«at»、«bal»、«ra»，[4] «one»、«ct»、«arse»、«ró»，[6] «z»、«á»、«j»、«ed»，[7] «di»、«at»、«run»、«te»，[8] «j»、«aut»、«umu»、«ol»，[9] «driv»、«r»、«ve»、«v»
patterns.context: 触发不稳定，常落在跨空格或词边界的子词、词干、重音字符附近；没有一致的完整词或固定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会文本；涉及捷克语、拉脱维亚语、西班牙语、斯洛伐克语、瑞典语等。

patterns.name: 增长及数量表述
patterns.context: 美国管理式医疗组织及其会员数量增长的说明中，激活集中在增长词和数量、时间表达附近。
patterns.domain: NIH/美国医疗保健说明性文本。

patterns.name: 界面操作指令
patterns.context: 电子邮件或软件帮助文档中的命令步骤，要求清空已删除项目文件夹或关闭日志功能；也有换行标记激活。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的软件操作说明。

patterns.name: 云服务产品短语
patterns.context: “fully-fledged cloud-based subscription service”这一产品描述中，激活落在复合形容词内部；前文另有临时增加硬件、软件和技能的需求。
patterns.domain: 商业博客或云服务宣传性说明。

en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous positions: date-time and numeric formats, intra-word fragments in multilingual words with diacritics, a few Dutch/Polish fragments, and English forms of grow/doing. No common semantics or stable word-form rule is apparent across segments.

patterns.name: Numeric and time formats
patterns.context: In numeric expressions such as dates, times, years, or quantities, activation falls on digits and nearby punctuation or format fragments; appears in both email calendar arrangements and statistical text

patterns.name: Intra-word letter fragments in Baltic languages
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within non-English words, especially on letters with diacritics and adjacent subword fragments; no stable full word or fixed semantics is apparent

patterns.name: Slavic and Dutch word fragments
patterns.context: In European parliamentary speeches, signatures, and committee references, activation falls on intra-word or word-initial fragments

patterns.name: English word fragments related to ongoing action or change
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur around English forms such as growing, grow, and doing; however, other identical or similar words in the same segment do not activate consistently

5_711.description: 激活分布在异质位置：日期时间与数字格式、含变音符号的多语种词内片段、少量荷兰语/波兰语片段，以及英语 grow/doing 形式。跨段未见统一语义或稳定词形规则。

patterns.name: 数字与时间格式
patterns.context: 月日、时刻、年份/数量等数字表达式中，激活落在数字及其附近的标点或格式片段；邮件日历安排和统计文字中均出现

patterns.name: 波罗的海语种中的词内字母片段
patterns.trigger: 如拉脱维亚语「ī»10」「ī»9」「ā»9」及邻近的词内片段；另有捷克语「Z»5«í»10tra」
patterns.context: 激活分散在非英语词语内部，尤其含变音符号的字母及其相邻子词片段；未见稳定的完整词或固定语义

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语及荷兰语词片段
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言/署名和委员会称谓附近，激活落在词内或词首片段

patterns.name: 英语进行/变化相关词片段
patterns.trigger: "managed»1 care is« growing»1 rapidly"、"may« grow»2"、"for« doing»1"
patterns.context: 英语中 growing、grow、doing 等形式附近出现零散激活；但同段其他相同或相近词并非一致激活
patterns.domain: 医疗政策报告、网络讨论

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal subword fragments in multilingual text and also occur in numeric tables, code-comment identifiers, and English forum words; there is no stable cross-paragraph semantic theme or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Word-internal syllables and boundaries in Slavic languages
patterns.context: In Czech, Slovak, and other parliamentary speeches, activations fall on word-internal syllables or near word boundaries; they occur in ordinary narration and transitions.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in Baltic languages
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments inside Latvian and Lithuanian words, not just on a specific fixed word; they appear in policy and parliamentary narration.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Dutch/German
patterns.context: Occurs inside longer Dutch or German words, with activations distributed across multiple adjacent subword fragments.

patterns.name: Numeric and digit formats
patterns.context: Activations correspond to spaced numbers, dates, or numeric formats in tables; current samples are insufficient to determine whether a specific number matters.

patterns.name: Identifiers in code comments
patterns.context: Activations occur on identifiers and following heading text in documentation comments in code files; they may be related to identifier formatting.

patterns.name: English word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In English forum text, activations fall on subword fragments of ordinary words; no stable semantic or grammatical condition is evident.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Activations occur at multiple subword positions inside Finnish word forms, in text about product recalls and statistical data.

5_711.concept: 多语种子词片段与格式
5_711.description: 激活分散在多语种文本的词内子词片段，也见于数字表格、代码注释编号及英语论坛词语；没有跨段稳定的语义主题或句法条件。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内音节与词界
patterns.context: 在捷克语、斯洛伐克语等议会发言中，激活落在词内音节或词界附近；可见于普通叙述和转场语句。

patterns.name: 波罗的海语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拉脱维亚语、立陶宛语词语的内部片段，并非只对应某个固定词；出现在政策和议会叙述中。

patterns.name: 荷兰语／德语词内片段
patterns.context: 在较长的荷兰语或德语单词内部出现，激活分布于多个相邻子词片段。

patterns.name: 数字与数字格式
patterns.context: 激活对应表格中的带空格数字、日期或数值格式；当前样本不足以判断是否依赖特定数字。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的编号
patterns.context: 代码文件的文档注释中，编号及其后的标题文字出现激活；可能与编号格式有关。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段
patterns.context: 英语论坛文字中，激活落在普通单词的子词片段上；未见稳定的语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 在芬兰语词形内部多个子词位置激活，处于产品召回和统计数据叙述中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual intra-word subwords and punctuation boundaries, discourse continuation words, and verb fragments. There are also isolated cases involving legal citation formats, code paths, marketing terms, and game-scoring terms, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Intra-word subwords or punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments in multilingual words and boundary tokens such as underscores or parentheses; common in intra-word positions after splitting, rather than on complete semantic words.
patterns.domain: Czech, Slovak, code, and legal text

patterns.name: Discourse transition or continuation
patterns.context: Appears as paragraphs or sentences progress or connect to preceding text; includes cross-sentence contrast and conditional expressions, but the triggering tokens are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, news, and web articles

patterns.name: Verbs and their morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common verbs, verb phrases, or verb forms split into subwords; no stable single semantic category is apparent.
patterns.domain: English webpages, forums, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Citations, parentheses, and legal formats
patterns.context: Citations, legal clause numbers, and parenthetical context in legal rulings.

patterns.name: Separators in technical identifiers
patterns.context: When separating Go import paths or package names, activation falls near path punctuation and quotation marks.

patterns.name: Specific phrases and affixes
patterns.context: Expressions such as “so-called” and subsequent generational names; examples are few, making stable trigger conditions difficult to establish.

patterns.name: Spanish marketing word fragments
patterns.context: Intra-word accented-letter subwords in Spanish titles or keywords of website traffic promotion articles.

patterns.name: Achievement- and scoring-related words
patterns.context: When discussing achievements, scoring, or standardized protocols in games.

5_711.description: 激活散见于多语种词内子词与标点边界、句篇承接词、动词片段；另有法律引文格式、代码路径、营销词及游戏计分词等孤例，未呈现统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 词内子词或标点边界
patterns.context: 激活落在多语言词语的字母片段、下划线或括号等边界 token 上；常见于切分后的词内位置，而非完整语义词。
patterns.domain: 捷克语、斯洛伐克语、代码及法律文本

patterns.name: 句篇过渡或延续
patterns.context: 段落或句子推进、承接前文时出现；包含跨句转折和条件表达，但触发 token 并不一致。
patterns.domain: 议会发言、新闻及网页文章

patterns.name: 动词及其形态片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在常见动词、动词短语或被子词切开的动词形态上；未见稳定的单一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 英语网页、论坛及百科文本

patterns.name: 引文、括号与法律格式
patterns.context: 法律判决中的引文、法条条款编号和括号补充语境。

patterns.name: 技术标识符分隔符
patterns.context: 分隔 Go 导入路径或包名时，激活落在路径标点及引号附近。

patterns.name: 特定短语与词缀
patterns.context: “so-called”一类表达及其后代际名称；仅有少量例子，难以确认稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语营销词片段
patterns.context: 词内重音字母子词，出现在网站流量推广文章的西班牙语标题或关键词中。

patterns.name: 成就与计分相关词
patterns.context: 讨论游戏中的成就、计分或标准化协议时。

en.description: Activations vary across languages and code: three research-text passages highlight the fixed phrase “play a major role,” while other paragraphs mostly mark word-internal letter fragments, diacritics, code keywords, or positional digits in their respective languages, making it difficult to identify a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: é inside Czech words
patterns.context: In Czech parliamentary speeches, é occurs inside words such as “přesuneme” and “záležitostem”; marking concentrates on the diacritic é.

patterns.name: á, ú inside Slovak words
patterns.context: Stressed vowels within words in Slovak parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: English phrase “play a major role”
patterns.context: major is strongly marked in the fixed phrase; it occurs in sentences about protein function, nervous system development, and behavior/anxiety research.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter, biomedical and research grant text

patterns.name: Double consonants inside Finnish words
patterns.context: In Finnish parliamentary speeches, markers fall on double consonants or consonant combinations inside words.

patterns.name: Punctuation-split word fragments in Dutch
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary speeches, markers occur on short letter fragments at the start of or inside words, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments and sentence-initial digits in German
patterns.context: In German parliamentary speeches, markers fall on word-internal letter fragments; digit markers occur near the beginnings of new sentences.

patterns.name: import in Go code
patterns.context: In the package-import section of Go source code, the import keyword and nearby code positions are marked.

patterns.name: Word-initial consonant fragments and digits in Spanish
patterns.context: Near names, titles, and speaker labels at the end of parliamentary speeches; there is no clear lexical or syntactic trigger.

5_711.description: 激活跨多种语言及代码而异：三段科研文本突出固定短语“play a major role”，其余段落多标记各自语言中的词内字母片段、变音符号、代码关键字或位置数字，难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 捷克语词内的 é
patterns.context: 捷克语议会发言中，é 出现在词内部，如“přesuneme”“záležitostem”；标记集中在带变音符号的 é。

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语词内的 á、ú
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语议会发言中的词内重音元音。

patterns.name: 英语短语“play a major role”
patterns.context: 固定短语中 major 强标记；出现在关于蛋白质功能、神经系统发育及行为/焦虑研究的句子里。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter，生物医学与科研申请文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内的双写辅音
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会发言中，标记落在词内双写辅音或辅音组合上。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内的标点切分片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会发言中，标记的是词首或词内的短字母片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段及词首数字
patterns.context: 德语议会发言中，标记落在词内字母片段；数字标记出现在新句开头附近。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的 import
patterns.context: Go 源代码的包导入区，import 关键字及其附近的代码位置被标记。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词首辅音片段及数字
patterns.context: 议会发言结尾的姓名、职务和发言者标记附近；没有清楚的词义或句法触发条件。

en.concept: Heterogeneous triggers involving emphasis and boundaries
en.description: Activation has diverse sources: adjectives conveying magnitude or importance (huge, pivotal), that and newline boundaries, and intra-word fragments in French, Finnish, and German, as well as proper-name naming structures. No single semantic or stylistic explanation accounts for them.

patterns.name: Split-token activation of the degree word huge
patterns.context: huge is used as an adjective to describe the large scale of a problem, influx, or opportunity; often appears in a noun phrase, preceded by a.

patterns.name: Relative word that
patterns.context: that occurs in a clause or demonstrative expression, followed by way, a clause, or content; activation strength varies considerably.

patterns.name: Newlines at sentence or paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs on newline characters, sometimes at sentence endings, paragraph breaks, or near speaker labels.
patterns.domain: Web articles, parliamentary records, technical text

patterns.name: Emphasis word pivotal
patterns.context: Describes something as having a key role, followed by role; preceded by a.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation of French telle
patterns.context: In French comme telle (“as such”), activation falls on the latter part of telle.

patterns.name: Intra-word segments and accented fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Multiple activations fall within long Finnish words, especially subword fragments of turvallisuusasioissa, huolenaiheitaan, Tämä, and kaikki.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation in German
patterns.context: Activation falls within the German word aufachtet (pays attention, focuses); surrounding text concerns diplomacy and common foreign policy in parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Proper-name initials and municipality names
patterns.context: A new municipality is named Mureck; activation falls on called and the fragment containing the initial of the name.

patterns.name: Semantic neighbors of the degree word huge
patterns.context: Activation occurs in expressions of importance or notable scale, but the exact trigger positions differ; pivotal in [5] and huge in [3][4][10] may share only a degree of emphasis.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, parliamentary and technical text

5_711.concept: 强调与边界的异质触发
5_711.description: 激活来源多样：突出程度或重要性的形容词（huge、pivotal）、that 与换行边界，以及法语、芬兰语、德语词内片段和专名命名结构；无法由单一语义或文体解释。

patterns.name: 程度词 huge 的分词激活
patterns.context: huge 作形容词，表示问题、涌入或机会规模很大；常见于名词短语中，前有 a。

patterns.name: 关系词 that
patterns.context: that 出现在从句或指示性表达中，后接 way、从句或内容；强度差异明显。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、技术讨论、对话

patterns.name: 句末或段落边界换行
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行符，部分位于句末、段落分隔或发言人标记附近。
patterns.domain: 网页文章、议会记录、技术文本

patterns.name: 强调词 pivotal
patterns.context: 形容某事物具有关键作用，后接 role；前有 a。

patterns.name: 法语 telle 的词内分段
patterns.context: 法语 comme telle（“作为这样的”）中，激活落在 telle 的后半部分。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内分段及重音片段
patterns.context: 多个激活落在芬兰语长词内部，尤其是 turvallisuusasioissa、huolenaiheitaan、Tämä、kaikki 等词的子词片段。

patterns.name: 德语词内分段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语 aufachtet（注意、关注）一词内部；周围是外交与共同外交相关的议会发言。

patterns.name: 专名首字母及市镇名
patterns.context: 新市镇被命名为 Mureck，激活落在 called 和名称首字母片段。

patterns.name: 程度词 huge 的语义近邻
patterns.context: 在关键性或规模显著的表达中有激活，但具体触发位置不一致；[5] 的 pivotal 与 [3][4][10] 的 huge 仅可能共享强调程度。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、议会与技术文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages, genres, and lexical items: English function words and conversational expressions, subwords inside European-language words, German academic word forms, legal boilerplate, and mathematical symbols all occur; there is no single stable trigger word or semantic theme.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase continuation
patterns.context: Common function words in English sentences, especially where a phrase, clause, or sentence continues; triggers are scattered across different words, so no single lexical pattern can be confirmed
patterns.domain: English news, forum conversations, mathematical text, and legal text

patterns.name: Fragmented subwords across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall inside words split by the tokenizer and do not align with complete word boundaries; they are often accompanied by neighboring subwords or punctuation
patterns.domain: Czech, Slovak, and other European parliamentary text

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments and syntactic linking in German
patterns.context: In continuous German academic sentences, activations occur on word-internal subwords and syntactic links, especially conjunctions and inflected long words

patterns.name: Fixed collocations and identifier formats in legal provisions
patterns.context: In legislative phrasing describing a health department determination, physician certification, or immunization, activations also occur near provision identifiers

patterns.name: Symbol boundaries and limit descriptions in mathematics
patterns.context: Explanatory text after a formula takes a fixed variable to a limit; activations cover mathematical notation, variables, and English connectives

patterns.name: Common words in quotations, dialogue, and questions
patterns.context: Colloquial questions, hypotheses, and discussions in forum comments or quotations; activated words vary and overlap with the general English function-word pattern

patterns.name: Sporadic activations not covered by the above patterns
patterns.context: Words or word fragments in individual contexts, with no repeatable condition beyond general local lexical/syntactic context
patterns.domain: English news and Czech parliamentary text

5_711.description: 激活分散于多种语言、文体和词项：英语虚词与对话用语、欧洲语言词内子词、德语学术词形、法律套语和数学符号均有出现；未见单一稳定触发词或语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语虚词与短语延续
patterns.context: 英语句子中常见功能词，尤其短语、从句或句子继续展开的位置；触发分散在不同词上，无法确认单一词项规律
patterns.domain: 英语新闻、论坛对话、数学文本及法律文本

patterns.name: 跨词边界的碎片化子词
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词器切开的词内部，与完整词边界不一致；常伴随周边子词或标点
patterns.domain: 捷克语、斯洛伐克语等欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 德语词内片段与句法衔接
patterns.context: 连续德语学术句中，激活出现在词内子词及句法连接处，尤其有关联词、词形变化的长词

patterns.name: 法律条文中的固定搭配与编号格式
patterns.context: 法规句式中描述卫生部门认定、医师证明或免疫接种，并在条文编号附近出现激活

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号边界及极限叙述
patterns.context: 公式后接固定变量并取极限的推导文字，激活覆盖数学标记、变量及英文连接词

patterns.name: 引述、对话与疑问句中的常用词
patterns.context: 论坛评论或引述中的口语问句、假设和讨论；激活词项不固定，且与一般英语功能词模式重叠

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的零散激活
patterns.context: 个别上下文中出现的词或词片段，除一般局部词法/句法环境外缺乏可重复条件
patterns.domain: 英语新闻及捷克语议会文本

en.description: Primarily sensitive to left parentheses used for grouping formulas, code syntax, or legal clause numbering; there is also one activation on “that,” referring to direction in an MDMA context, and scattered activations on formula typesetting commands and Czech fragments with diacritics.

patterns.name: Left parentheses and parenthesized numbering
patterns.context: A left parenthesis begins a parenthetical expression, mathematical grouping, or clause number; often immediately followed by a digit, letter, or code content.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, parliamentary text, legal text, code, and emails; spans multiple genres

patterns.name: that in discourse
patterns.context: In the phrase “Will the conversation around MDMA go that way?”, that refers to the direction or development mentioned earlier.

patterns.name: LaTeX math typesetting commands
patterns.context: Spacing commands in formulas and the parentheses, variables, and other mathematical typesetting content that follow.

patterns.name: Czech intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Characters with diacritics or subword fragments within consecutive Czech words; no clear triggering condition matching the parentheses pattern is apparent.

5_711.description: 主要对左括号敏感，括号用于公式分组、代码语法或法律条款编号；另有一次 MDMA 语境中指代方向的“that”，以及公式排版命令和捷克语带变音符号片段的零散激活。

patterns.name: 左括号及括号编号
patterns.context: 左括号作为括号表达式、数学公式分组或条款编号的起始符；常紧邻数字、字母或代码内容。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、议会文本、法律文本、代码及邮件；覆盖多种文体

patterns.name: 话语中的 that
patterns.context: 短语“Will the conversation around MDMA go that way?”中，that 指代前文提及的方向或发展方式。
patterns.domain: 关于 MDMA 的新闻或对话语境

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令
patterns.context: 公式中的间距命令及其后的括号、变量等数学排版内容。

patterns.name: 捷克语词内片段
patterns.context: 捷克语连续词语中的带变音符号字符或子词片段，未见明显与括号模式相同的触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to fixed comparison questions asking which candidate value is largest, smallest, or a particular rank in math multiple-choice problems, especially ordinal words before biggest/smallest. Also includes one segment activated by the negative economic phrase “very real prospect” and one Polish intra-word subword activation.

patterns.name: Comparison query words in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in problems listing candidate answers and asking for a comparison of numerical magnitudes; activation concentrates on comparative or ordinal words and the nearby phrase “Which is the … value”.

patterns.name: Negative outlook expression in English
patterns.context: In sentences discussing declining income and its effects on families; activation concentrates on “very” and extends to nearby words such as “that” and “the”.

patterns.name: Intra-word Polish subword fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Polish text, activation falls on subwords segmented within words; there is no clear shared semantics with math comparison questions.

5_711.description: 主要响应数学选择题中询问候选值最大、最小或第几大的固定比较问句，尤其是 biggest/smallest 前的序数词。另有一段激活于英文“very real prospect”负面经济表述，及一段波兰语词内子词激活。

patterns.name: 数学题中的比较级查询词
patterns.trigger: “Which is the biggest value?”, “Which is the second biggest value?”, “Which is the smallest value?”, “Which is the second smallest value?”, “Which is the fifth smallest value?”
patterns.context: 出现在列出候选答案、要求比较数值大小的题目中；激活集中在比较级或序数词及其附近的“Which is the … value”短语。

patterns.name: 英文负面前景表达
patterns.trigger: “the very real prospect of lower incomes”
patterns.context: 在谈论收入下降及其对家庭影响的句子中；激活集中在“very”，并延伸到“that”“the”等邻近词。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 波兰语连续文本中，激活落在跨词内切分的子词上；与数学比较题没有明显共同语义。

en.description: All segments are DM mathematical ranking multiple-choice questions; activation marks equals signs in variable definitions, questions about rank and magnitude, and option parentheses, with scattered marking of expressions and numbers in answers.

patterns.name: Equals signs in variable assignments
patterns.context: A mathematical word problem first defines variables, functions, or intermediate quantities, then uses assignment expressions to construct values to compare; marked activations often appear around the equals sign.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and algebra multiple-choice questions

patterns.name: Asking for numerical rankings
patterns.context: After defining several values, the question asks for the largest, smallest, or nth-largest value; activation is concentrated on is, the ranking word, and value in the question, while rank and direction vary.

patterns.name: Option markers
patterns.context: Candidate answers follow a ranking question; the left parenthesis is prominent in all segments, while option letters are prominent in only some.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric fragments
patterns.context: Adjacent to variable definitions, expressions, and option values; marking is scattered across different numbers, with no visible fixed number, symbol, or value type.

5_711.description: 所有片段均为DM数学排序选择题；神经元标记变量定义中的等号、询问名次与大小的问句，以及选项括号，并零散标记表达式和答案中的数字。

patterns.name: 变量赋值中的等号
patterns.context: 数学文字题先定义变量、函数或中间量，随后用赋值表达式构造待比较的数值；等号前后常有标记激活。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，算术与代数选择题

patterns.name: 询问数值排序
patterns.context: 在定义若干数值后，询问最大、最小或第几大的值；激活集中在问句中的 is、排序词和 value，且排序名次和方向并不固定。

patterns.name: 选项标记
patterns.trigger: 选项开头的 «(»，以及部分题中的 «a»、«b»、«c»
patterns.context: 排序问题后列出候选答案；左括号在所有段落中突出，选项字母只在部分段落突出。

patterns.name: 数字与数字片段
patterns.context: 与定义变量、表达式及选项数值相邻；标记分散在不同数值中，没有可见的固定数字、符号或数值类型。

en.description: Primarily responds to DM Mathematics numerical ranking multiple-choice problems: variables are defined using arithmetic or equations, then the question asks which value is smallest or second smallest; it also responds to the option format of these problems. Segment 9 contains only the question ending and options.

patterns.name: “smallest” wording in numerical comparison problems
patterns.context: Appears after multiple variables have been defined using arithmetic expressions or equations, asking for a numerical comparison among the options; activation often falls on smallest, value, Which, and option markers.

patterns.name: Multiple-choice option markers
patterns.context: Immediately follows a question asking for the smallest or second-smallest value; options usually give variables, expressions, or numbers.

patterns.name: Variable definitions and algebraic operations
patterns.context: Setup for comparison problems; one or more equations assign values to variables for subsequent ranking.

patterns.name: Truncated question stem or option fragment from the same problem
patterns.context: Only the end of the problem is present, without variable definitions or a complete question; may be a truncated fragment of an adjacent math multiple-choice problem.

5_711.description: 主要响应 DM 数学数值排序选择题：先用算术或方程定义变量，再问哪个值最小或第二小；也响应此类题的选项格式。第9段仅保留题尾与选项。

patterns.name: 比较数值大小题中的“smallest”措辞
patterns.trigger: “Which is the second smallest value?”、“Which is the smallest value?”，尤其是 “smallest”
patterns.context: 出现在多个变量已由算术表达式或方程定义之后，要求从选项中比较数值；激活常落在 smallest、value、Which 和选项标记上。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的数值比较题

patterns.name: 选择题选项标记
patterns.trigger: “(a)”、“(b)”及其后选项中的变量或数值
patterns.context: 紧跟询问最小值或第二小值的问题；选项通常给出变量、表达式或数字。

patterns.name: 变量定义与代数运算
patterns.trigger: “Let … =”、“Let … be”、“Suppose”以及其中的负数、分数、乘法和加减表达式
patterns.context: 比较题的铺垫；通过一个或多个等式给变量赋值，供后续排序。

patterns.name: 残缺的同题题干或选项片段
patterns.context: 仅见题目末尾，没有变量定义或完整问题；可能是相邻数学选择题的截断片段。

en.description: Activation is mainly found in math comparison questions phrased as “smallest/second smallest value”; it also responds sporadically to very followed by evaluative adjectives and to located near in geographical descriptions. Segment 10 contains only a fragment of the problem options.

patterns.name: “second smallest” comparison wording
patterns.context: Asks for the second-smallest value in a set before multi-step numerical operations, variable definitions, or multiple-choice options.

patterns.name: “smallest value” comparison wording
patterns.context: After variables or several numerical operations are given, asks for the smallest value; usually followed by lettered options.

patterns.name: very followed by degree or evaluative phrases
patterns.context: «very» precedes an adjective to intensify the following evaluative description; one example concerns the risk of declining income, another the market positioning of cheap phones.

patterns.name: Geographical description with located near
patterns.context: Describes the location of a railway or attraction, followed by a place name; this segment also includes distance and direction information.

patterns.name: Options and numbers in a context fragment
patterns.context: Only the question mark and options at the end of a comparison problem remain; the fragment does not establish whether the question asks for the smallest value, second-smallest value, or another relation.

5_711.concept: 比较题措辞及局部短语
5_711.description: 激活主要见于数学比较题的“smallest/second smallest value”问法；另对 very 后接评价性形容词，以及地理描述中的 located near 有零星响应。第10段仅保留题目选项残片。

patterns.name: “second smallest”比较题措辞
patterns.context: 在多步数值运算、变量定义或选择题选项之前，询问一组值中第二小的值。

patterns.name: “smallest value”比较题措辞
patterns.context: 在给出变量或若干数值运算后，要求判断最小值；通常后接字母选项。

patterns.name: very 后接程度或评价性短语
patterns.context: «very»置于形容词之前，强化后续评价性描述；前者谈收入下降的风险，后者谈廉价手机市场定位。
patterns.domain: 新闻/评论与产品评测 prose

patterns.name: located near 的地理描述
patterns.context: 描述铁路或景点的位置，并接地名；此段还出现距离、方位信息。

patterns.name: 上下文残片中的选项与数值
patterns.context: 仅剩比较题末尾的问号和选项，无法由片段确定被问的是最小值、第二小值还是其他关系。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 残缺题目文本

en.description: Activation is concentrated in the mathematical multiple-choice comparison framework “Which is the [ordinal] smallest value?” and extends to preceding variable definitions and answer options. Formulas, values, and variable names vary; opening truncated fragments are difficult to interpret independently.

patterns.name: “Which is the smallest value?” question stem
patterns.context: After giving several variables, expressions, or values, asks which is the smallest; “Which,” “smallest,” “value,” and nearby tokens in the question stem activate.

patterns.name: Variable definitions in minimum-value questions
patterns.context: Variables or functions are defined in a series of arithmetic expressions, then used as variable names or expressions in the candidate values being compared; activation falls on definition statements and some variable names.
patterns.domain: Mathematical word problems, arithmetic and algebra

patterns.name: Answer-option format in minimum-value questions
patterns.context: Multiple-choice answers immediately follow the comparison question; option markers and candidate values also activate, with occasional activation on other option markers.

patterns.name: Ordinal comparisons other than the minimum
patterns.context: Still ranks several expressions, but asks for the second- or third-smallest rather than the smallest; shares the same question-stem framework.

patterns.name: Isolated fragments preceding options
patterns.context: Truncated text at the sample start or question boundary whose semantics cannot be determined from the fragment alone; may be a preceding question's option or formatting residue.

patterns.name: Expressions containing fractions, negative numbers, and operators
patterns.context: Questions construct candidate values using integers, decimals, minus signs, fractions, and variable expressions; expressions vary widely, with no stable trigger tied to a particular operation.

5_711.description: 激活集中于数学选择题中“Which is the [序数] smallest value?”的比较题框架，并扩展到前置变量定义及答案选项。算式形式、数值和变量名多变；开头截断碎片难以独立解释。

patterns.name: “Which is the smallest value?”题干
patterns.trigger: “Which is the smallest value?”；变体“Which is the second smallest value?”、“Which is the third smallest value?”
patterns.context: 在给出若干变量、表达式或数值后，询问这些量中最小的一个；题干中的“Which”“smallest”“value”及其邻近 token 均有激活。

patterns.name: 最小值题中的变量定义
patterns.trigger: “Let x =”、“Let n =”、“Let g =”、“Let z =”、“Let t be”、“Let u(z) =”、“Let l(z) =”
patterns.context: 变量或函数在连续的算术表达式中被定义，随后通过变量名或表达式作为候选项参与大小比较；激活落在定义语句及部分变量名上。
patterns.domain: 数学文字题、算术与代数

patterns.name: 最小值题的答案选项格式
patterns.context: 比较题干后紧接多项选择答案；选项标记和候选值也会激活，其他选项标记偶有激活。

patterns.name: 非最小项的序数比较
patterns.context: 仍是从若干表达式中排序，但要求第二小或第三小，而非最小；共享同一题干框架。

patterns.name: 孤立的选项前置碎片
patterns.context: 位于样本开头或题干边界的截断文本，无法仅凭片段确定其语义；可能是前一题选项或格式残留。

patterns.name: 含有分数、负数及运算符的算式
patterns.context: 题目通过整数、小数、负号、分数和变量表达式构造候选值；算式本身复杂多变，未见稳定的特定运算触发模式。

en.concept: Local word sequences and structural patterns
en.description: Activation appears in fixed expressions indicating an imminent event, such as very near future, as well as numerical comparison and algebra problems and local word fragments in different languages; it also includes product positioning and sporadic fragments in French and Dutch text, making it difficult to assign a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “very near future”
patterns.context: A time expression describing something about to happen or an upcoming product, technology, or investment decision; activation concentrates on very, with weaker marks on nearby the, near, future, and similar words.
patterns.domain: Technology news, business emails, European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Fraction and inequality comparison problems
patterns.context: Compares rational numbers in natural-language comparison questions or judgment problems, often accompanied by answers such as True/False.

patterns.name: Algebra equation-solving problems
patterns.context: Presents an algebraic equation with variables and asks for a solution; activation is distributed across variables, numbers, and arithmetic expressions, with no stable single trigger word.

patterns.name: Business description “available at the … end”
patterns.context: Describes a low-priced phone as being at the extreme end of the affordable sector; it appears in the same segment as an upcoming-launch claim, but is not the “near future” expression.

patterns.name: Prepositions in fixed French phrases
patterns.context: Phrases in French sentences meaning “currently” and “beyond …”; activation falls on prepositions and hyphenated fragments.

patterns.name: Dutch coast-related word fragments
patterns.context: Continuous Dutch text about coasts, coastal areas, and their pros and cons, with activation scattered across intra-word fragments.

5_711.description: 激活既出现在 very near future 等表示近期将发生的固定表达，也出现在数值比较、代数求解题和不同语言的局部词语片段中；还包括产品定位及法语、荷兰语文本中的零散片段，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“very near future”
patterns.trigger: « the»3« very»10« near»4 future；« in»4« the»4« very»9« near»3«-»2«term»2 future；« in»2« the»3« very»9« near»4 future
patterns.context: 描述某事即将发生或产品、技术、投资决策即将到来的时间表达；激活集中在 very，附近的 the、near、future 等也有较弱标记。
patterns.domain: 科技新闻、商业邮件、欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 分数与不等式比较题
patterns.trigger: « bigger»；« greater»；« less»；« as» big；含负号、分数与比较符号的算式
patterns.context: 在自然语言比较问句或判断题中比较有理数大小，常伴随 True/False 等答案。

patterns.name: 代数方程求解题
patterns.context: 给出含变量的代数方程并要求求解；激活分布在变量、数字和运算表达式中，未见稳定的单一触发词。

patterns.name: “available at the … end”商业描述
patterns.trigger: « available»« at»« the»« very»« extreme» end
patterns.context: 描述低价手机处于 affordable sector 的极端一端；与即将上市的说法同段出现，但并非“near future”搭配。

patterns.name: 法语固定短语中的介词
patterns.context: 法语句子中表示“目前”及“超出……范围”的短语；激活落在介词和连字符片段上。

patterns.name: 荷兰语海岸相关词语片段
patterns.context: 有关海岸、海岸带及其优缺点的荷兰语连续文本，激活分散在词内部片段。

en.concept: Local word forms and phrase patterns
en.description: The most consistent pattern is English very as an intensifier, especially in expressions such as “very near future”; it also activates in math comparison Q&A, poetic wording, geographical coordinate locations, and intra-word fragments in French au-delà, without a single semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Degree intensification by very
patterns.context: very is followed by an adjective, noun, or time expression and serves as an intensifier; examples include “the very extreme end”, “the very near future”, and “the very heart”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, technology, business, parliamentary text

patterns.name: Numbers and comparison judgments in math problems
patterns.context: Math Q&A compares numerical values or judges whether an equation is true; activation is distributed across questions, operators, numbers, and answers, with 0 and comparison wording recurring in particular.

patterns.name: Words related to form and direction
patterns.context: A poetry passage contains words expressing questions, cognition, or intention, as well as hyphenated words marked by segmentation; the connection to other highly activated segments is unclear.

patterns.name: Locations and coordinates in geographical entries
patterns.context: A geographical encyclopedia entry introduces a place name’s origin, then moves to a Geography section and gives coordinates.

patterns.name: Hyphens and intra-word fragments in a French phrase
patterns.context: In French parliamentary text, “au-delà de” is segmented, with activation concentrated on the hyphen and intra-word substrings.

5_711.description: 最一致的模式是英语 very 作强调词，尤其出现在“very near future”等搭配中；此外还激活于数学比较问答、诗歌措辞、地理坐标定位，以及法语 au-delà 的词内片段，未能由同一语义解释。

patterns.name: very 的程度强调
patterns.context: very 后接形容词、名词或时间表达，充当强化语；例有“the very extreme end”“the very near future”“the very heart”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、科技、商务、议会文本

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与比较判断
patterns.context: 数学问答中比较数值或判断等式；激活分布在问题、运算符、数字和答案之间，尤其反复出现 0 与比较表述。

patterns.name: 形式与方向相关的词语
patterns.context: 诗歌段落中出现疑问、认知或意愿词，以及被拆分标记的连字符词；与其他高激活段的联系不明显。

patterns.name: 地理词条中的位置与坐标
patterns.context: 地理百科条目介绍地名由来后，转入 Geography 小节并给出坐标。

patterns.name: 法语短语中的连字符与词内片段
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中，“au-delà de”一词被拆分，激活集中于连字符及词内子串。
