en.description: Primarily activates on very in intensifying constructions, especially very near future, and also very modifying extreme, real, huge, least, and desirable. There is also one strong activation on the relative pronoun whose, which cannot be directly unified with the very pattern.

patterns.name: very near future
patterns.context: In the phrase “very near future”, very modifies near, which expresses temporal proximity; one example uses the hyphenated compound near-term
patterns.domain: Technology commentary, business promotion, political energy discussions

patterns.name: Intensified noun phrases
patterns.context: very precedes a word expressing degree, evaluation, or scope to form an intensifying expression; examples include “very extreme end”, “very real prospect”, “very huge competitive threat”, and “at the very least”

patterns.name: very desirable
patterns.context: very modifies the positively evaluative adjective desirable within “the … direction”

patterns.name: High activation on the relative word whose
patterns.context: whose introduces a possessive relative clause referring to the previously mentioned bishops
patterns.domain: Written accounts of church history or religious institutions

5_711.description: 主要对强调结构中的 very 激活：尤其是 very near future，也包括 very 修饰 extreme、real、huge、least、desirable。另对关系代词 whose 有一次强激活，无法与 very 模式直接统一。

patterns.name: very near future
patterns.trigger: «very»10« near»4 future；«very»10« near»4-term future；«very»9« near»3 future
patterns.context: “very near future”短语中，修饰表示时间接近的 near；一例为连字符复合词 near-term
patterns.domain: 科技评论、商业宣传、政治能源议事

patterns.name: 程度强化的名词短语
patterns.context: very 后接程度、评价或范围词，构成强调表达；例中包括“very extreme end”“very real prospect”“very huge competitive threat”“at the very least”
patterns.domain: 新闻、经济评论、论坛讨论

patterns.name: very desirable
patterns.context: very 修饰表示正面评价的形容词 desirable，置于“the … direction”中

patterns.name: 关系词 whose 高激活
patterns.context: whose 引出所属关系从句，指代前文 bishops
patterns.domain: 教会史或宗教制度类书面叙述

en.description: Activation is most consistent on near-term prediction expressions such as “the very near future”; it also appears in mathematical truth/magnitude questions, Docker container descriptions, personal advice about slowing down and reading, and reports on new flagship phones.

patterns.name: “very near” time expression
patterns.context: Used to predict, promise, or explain that something will happen soon; common formats are “in the very near future” and, occasionally, “very near-term future.”
patterns.domain: News commentary, business emails, political/energy issues

patterns.name: Mathematical judgment markers
patterns.context: In consecutive math questions, judges whether values are greater, equal, or unequal; activation falls on operators, numbers, and format tokens near the question and answer.

patterns.name: Docker container execution phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses whether Docker runs a website or blog in its own container.

patterns.name: Time-consuming operations or processes
patterns.context: Describes doing things like reading documentation after energy declines; the two trigger words occur only in the same segment, with no stable shared syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Flagship phones and new-product news
patterns.context: Reports on smartphone specifications, brands following suit, and new-product releases; distinct from the “very near future” expression.

5_711.description: 激活最一致地落在“the very near future”这类近期预测表述；另在数学真假/大小判断题、Docker容器表述、个人建议中的慢下来与阅读，以及旗舰手机新品报道中激活。

patterns.name: “very near”时间表达
patterns.context: 用于预测、承诺或说明某事即将发生；常见格式为“in the very near future”，偶有“very near-term future”。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、商业邮件、政治/能源议题

patterns.name: 数学判断题标记
patterns.trigger: «=»、比较运算符及其附近的数值、分数或负号；判断题答案处有«True»/«False»
patterns.context: 在连续的数学问答中判断大小、相等或不等；激活落在题目与答案附近的运算符、数字和格式 token 上。

patterns.name: Docker 容器运行表述
patterns.context: 讨论 Docker 是否把网站或博客运行在自身的容器中。

patterns.name: 耗时较久的操作或过程
patterns.context: 描述精力下降后改做阅读文档等事情；两个触发词只在同一段出现，未见稳定的共同句法模式。

patterns.name: 旗舰手机及新品消息
patterns.context: 报道智能手机配置、品牌跟进及新品发布；与“very near future”表达不同。

en.concept: Local intensifiers and math Q&A formats
en.description: Activation involves degree intensification after “very” and Docker’s own-container phrasing, and is also concentrated in math Q&A: numerical comparisons or equation judgments, true/false answers, and algebraic equation solving.

patterns.name: Degree intensification with very
patterns.context: very is followed by an adjective expressing distance or degree, forming an intensifying phrase

patterns.name: Docker container ownership
patterns.context: Asks whether Docker runs a blog in its own container

patterns.name: Magnitude comparisons and true/false judgments
patterns.context: Compares rational or negative numbers, or judges whether an equation holds, and outputs a true/false or numerical answer

patterns.name: Algebraic equation solving
patterns.context: Gives a polynomial or equation containing a variable and asks for the unknown

5_711.concept: 局部强调词与数学问答格式
5_711.description: 激活既涉及“very”后的程度强调和 Docker 自有容器表述，也集中于数学问答：数值大小或等式判断、真假作答，以及代数方程求解。

patterns.name: very 加强程度表达
patterns.context: very 后接表示距离或程度的形容词，形成强调短语

patterns.name: Docker 容器归属
patterns.context: 询问 Docker 是否在自己的容器中运行博客

patterns.name: 大小比较与真假判断
patterns.context: 比较有理数、负数或等式是否成立，并输出真假或数值答案

patterns.name: 代数方程求解
patterns.context: 给出含变量的多项式或方程，要求求未知数

en.description: Primarily responds to “at the very + noun” and intensifying constructions such as very least, very extreme, and very near; it also appears near comparison words, relational symbols, and numbers in math comparison Q&A, with weaker responses to needs to action sentences and several sporadic words.

patterns.name: Intensifying or lower-bound expressions with “very”
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on very, especially in collocations such as very least, very end, and very near; it often appears in at/in the very + noun phrases to emphasize degree, position, or time.

patterns.name: Comparison or equation symbols in math questions
patterns.context: In sequences of numerical comparisons, fractions, or true/false problems, comparison words, relational symbols, and some nearby numbers activate; activation is not limited to a single word.

patterns.name: “Need” followed by an action
patterns.context: needs is followed by a to-infinitive, expressing the need to take action or stating that something is necessary.

patterns.name: “At least” as a minimum expression
patterns.context: at the very least indicates a minimum; at the very heart also appears, suggesting activation may involve the local structure at the very + noun rather than only least.

patterns.name: Other sporadic vocabulary or local triggers
patterns.context: These marks are scattered across different contexts, with insufficient evidence to infer a stable, independent semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Product descriptions, article fragments, math Q&A

5_711.description: 主要响应“at the very + 名词”及 very least、very extreme、very near 等强调结构；也出现在数学比较问答的比较词、关系符号和数字附近，并对 needs to 行动句及若干零散词有较弱响应。

patterns.name: “very”结构中的强调或下限表达
patterns.trigger: « at»5« the»2« very»10« extreme»2« end»3« of»2；« at»5« the»2« very»9« least»；« in»3« the»2« very»9« near»4« future»1
patterns.context: 激活集中在 very，尤其 very least、very end、very near 等搭配；常位于 at/in the very + 名词短语中，用于强调程度、位置或时间。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻讨论、产品介绍

patterns.name: 数学问句中的比较或等式符号
patterns.trigger: « bigger»5«:»4；« greater»4«:»4；« =»9；« >»3；« at»5« most»2；« at»5« least»3
patterns.context: 成串出现的数字比较、分数或真假判断题中，比较词、关系符号及部分数字邻近位置被激活；激活并不只落在单一词上。
patterns.domain: 自动生成的数学问答/练习题

patterns.name: “需要”及其后续行动
patterns.trigger: « needs»2 to« start»2« sending»2；« it»1« needs»1« to»1 be pointed out
patterns.context: needs 后接 to 不定式，表达采取行动或指出某事的必要性。

patterns.name: “at least”作为最低限度表达
patterns.trigger: « at»4« the»2« very»9 least；« at»5« the»2« very»9 least；« at»2« the»1« very»9« heart»4
patterns.context: at the very least 表示最低限度；另有 at the very heart，显示激活也可能涉及 at the very + 名词这一局部结构，而非只认 least。

patterns.name: 其他零散词汇或局部触发
patterns.trigger: « Which»3；« expected»2；« available»2；« praised»2；« much»2« more»2；« True»1、« False»1
patterns.context: 这些标记分散于不同语境，缺少足够证据归纳为稳定、独立的语义模式。
patterns.domain: 产品介绍、文章片段、数学问答

en.description: Primarily responds to intensifying degree or location phrases following very, as well as comparison, equation judgments, and algebraic setups in math Q&A; it also occurs in Docker-container and software-platform expansion contexts. Some activation falls on problem numbers and answers.

patterns.name: Degree or spatial-location expressions following ‘very’
patterns.context: very occurs within a noun phrase, followed by an adjective or a noun expressing location or scope, and serves to intensify or strengthen degree; corresponding activation concentrates on very and adjacent words
patterns.domain: Pile-CC news/commentary style and HackerNews discussions

patterns.name: Comparison and magnitude judgment templates in math Q&A
patterns.context: Math exercises use questions to check the magnitude, equality, or inequality of fractions, negative numbers, or algebraic expressions; answers often appear on a new line as True/False or a number. Activation is scattered across problem tokens and near numbers and comparison symbols
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics automatically generated or formatted math Q&A

patterns.name: Expressions related to Docker containers and runtime environments
patterns.context: A joking HackerNews question about whether Docker is used to run a website blog; activation falls particularly on components such as “in”, “its”, and “own”

patterns.name: Platform compatibility and future expansion
patterns.context: Describes platforms currently supported by software and possible future ports to other platforms; some activation falls on platforms, prepositions, and near very near future

patterns.name: Algebraic equations and variable-relation problems
patterns.context: Asks whether an equation or inequality holds after variables are defined or linear relations are listed; belongs to math Q&A like comparison problems, but triggers also include setup conditions and variable expressions

patterns.name: Other math problem fragments (sporadic activation near question stems or answers)
patterns.context: Within the same batch of math judgment problems, activation sometimes falls on answer markers or numbers, without a stable, specific trigger condition independent of comparison questions

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on sentence-initial or local collocations
patterns.context: Appears in different grammatical contexts; may involve common math-problem stem words or ordinary English collocations, but these fragments alone do not establish an independent pattern
patterns.domain: Math Q&A and general English text

5_711.description: 主要响应 very 后的强调性程度或位置短语，以及数学问答中比较、等式判定和代数设定；另有 Docker 容器与软件平台扩展语境。部分激活落在题目数值和答案上。

patterns.name: ‘very’ 后接程度或空间位置表达
patterns.trigger: 「the very extreme end」「the very near future」「the very heart」；另有「the very affordable sector」中的 very
patterns.context: very 位于名词短语内，后接形容词或表示位置、范围的名词，起强调或加强程度作用；对应激活集中在 very 及相邻词
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 新闻/评论语体及 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 数学问答中的比较与大小判定模板
patterns.trigger: 「Which is bigger:」「Which is greater:」「at least」「as big as」「less than or equal to」「Does … = …?」
patterns.context: 数学练习以问句检查分数、负数或代数表达式的大小、等式或不等式，答案常在换行后给出 True/False 或数值；激活散布在题目 token 与数字、比较符号附近
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 自动生成或格式化的数学问答

patterns.name: Docker 容器及运行环境相关表达
patterns.context: HackerNews 对 Docker 是否用于运行网站博客的调侃式提问；激活特别落在「in」「its」「own」等短语成分上

patterns.name: 平台兼容性与未来扩展
patterns.trigger: 「runs on the Open Pandora Linux Handheld」「portable」「spread to other platforms」「in the very near future」
patterns.context: 描述软件当前支持的平台及未来可能移植到其他平台；部分激活落在平台、介词和 very near future 附近

patterns.name: 代数方程与变量关系题
patterns.context: 在定义变量或列出线性关系后询问等式、不等式是否成立；与比较题同属数学问答，但触发点也包括设定条件和变量表达式

patterns.name: 其他数学题片段（题干或答案附近的零散激活）
patterns.context: 同一批数学判定题中，激活有时落在答案标记或数值上，未显示稳定且独立于比较问句的具体触发条件

patterns.name: 句首或局部搭配的零散激活
patterns.context: 出现在不同语法环境中；可能是数学题常见题干词或普通英语搭配，单凭这些片段无法确认为独立模式
patterns.domain: 数学问答与一般英语文本

en.description: Most segments activate the English emphasis structure “the very …”, especially at the very least and in the very near future/term, as well as very extreme end and very heart. Mathematical truth questions and Docker-related phrasing form two other local patterns.

patterns.name: Fixed emphasis collocation with very
patterns.context: Activation centers on very, usually between the definite article the and a following noun, adjective, or time expression; collocations can convey extreme degree, centrality, a minimum, or near-term time. In segment 1, very is followed by extreme; in segment 2, by heart; segments 3 and 4 use at the very least; segments 6, 8, and 10 use in the very near future/term.
patterns.domain: English prose, including news commentary, technical discussions, parliamentary text, and business emails

patterns.name: True/False judgment format in math problems
patterns.context: In math exercises, an independent True/False answer follows a question and numeric expression; activation involves not only the judgment word but also question symbols, newlines, and numeric tokens.
patterns.domain: Mathematical Q&A or automatically generated exercises

patterns.name: Docker and possession/execution phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses whether Docker runs a blog in its own container; activation is distributed near relational expressions such as in, its, and own.

5_711.concept: 英语高频搭配与格式触发
5_711.description: 多数段落激活英语强调结构“the very …”，尤其是 at the very least、in the very near future/term，也包括 very extreme end 与 very heart。数学真假题和 Docker 所属表达是另外两类局部模式。

patterns.name: very 固定强调搭配
patterns.trigger: “at the very extreme end”、“at the very heart”、“at the very least”、“in the very near future”、“in the very near-term future”；另有“the very affordable sector”附近
patterns.context: 激活集中在 very，通常位于定冠词 the 与后续名词、形容词或时间表达之间；搭配可表示极端程度、核心位置、最低限度或近期时间。第1段的 very 后接 extreme，第2段后接 heart，第3、4段为 at the very least，第6、8、10段为 in the very near future/term。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、科技讨论、议会文本、商业邮件等英语散文

patterns.name: 数学题目中的真假判断格式
patterns.trigger: “False”、“True”以及相邻的题目格式，如“Which is bigger:”、“Is … less than or equal to”、“Does 0 = …?”
patterns.context: 数学练习中，问题与数值表达式后出现独立的 True/False 答案；激活不只落在判断词，也涉及题目符号、换行和数字 token。
patterns.domain: 数学问答或自动生成的练习题

patterns.name: Docker 与所属/运行关系表达
patterns.context: 谈论 Docker 是否在自身容器中运行博客；激活分布在 in、its、own 等关系表达附近。

en.description: Activation primarily corresponds to the intensifying construction “at the very + extreme position, degree, or boundary expression” and the fixed expression “in the very near future” meaning soon; there is also one example of scattered activation in a Docker-container question.

patterns.name: very + extreme degree/boundary expression
patterns.context: The continuous construction “at the very + noun/adjective” emphasizes position, degree, or a deadline; activation mainly concentrates on “very”, with some following words also marked
patterns.domain: Commentary, news, business emails, political discussions, segments 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7

patterns.name: Fixed expression very near future
patterns.context: in is followed by very near future, meaning soon
patterns.domain: Technology forums, business emails, European Parliament text, segments 3, 9, 10

patterns.name: Docker container question
patterns.context: Asks whether a service runs in its own Docker container; activation is distributed across the preposition, possessive, and the word container

5_711.description: 激活主要对应强调结构“at the very + 极端位置、程度或边界表达”，以及“in the very near future”表示近期的固定搭配；另有一例分散激活于 Docker 容器提问。

patterns.name: very + 极端程度/边界表达
patterns.trigger: “at the very extreme end”, “at the very heart”, “at the very least”, “at the very latest”
patterns.context: 连续结构“at the very + 名词/形容词”，用于强调位置、程度或最后期限；激活主要集中在“very”，部分后续词也标记
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、商业邮件、政治讨论，段1、2、4、5、6、7

patterns.name: very near future 固定搭配
patterns.context: 介词 in 后接 very near future，表示不久之后
patterns.domain: 科技论坛、商业邮件、欧洲议会文本，段3、9、10

patterns.name: Docker 容器提问
patterns.trigger: “in its own docker container? If so”
patterns.context: 询问某服务是否运行在自己的 Docker 容器中；激活分布在介词、所有格及 container 一词上

en.description: Activation primarily occurs in the fixed degree/boundary expression “at the very,” followed by different boundary terms; it also occurs on equals signs in mathematical material, which cannot be explained by that phrase pattern.

patterns.name: “at the very …” degree/boundary expression
patterns.context: “very” in the phrase is an intensifier or boundary marker; the following word specifies an extreme, minimum, near, or latest limit.
patterns.domain: Commentary, technology news, forum posts, business emails

patterns.name: Equals-sign tokens in math problems
patterns.context: Occurs in math exercises or algebraic expressions; activation is concentrated on the equals sign, with no observed co-occurrence with the “at the very” phrase.

5_711.description: 主要激活于“at the very”这一固定程度/界限表达，后接不同边界词；另在数学材料的等号处激活，无法由该短语模式解释。

patterns.name: “at the very …”程度/界限表达
patterns.context: 短语中的“very”是程度或边界强调词；后续词给出极端、最低、临近或最迟界限。
patterns.domain: 评论、科技新闻、论坛发言、商务邮件

patterns.name: 数学题中的等号 token
patterns.context: 出现在数学练习或代数表达式中；激活集中于等号，未见其与“at the very”短语共现。

en.concept: Specific English subword fragments and title endings
en.description: Activations fall mainly on the ending of the uppercase section title DISCUSSION and biological replication; also seen on the fra subword fragment in infrared, in subfractions, and in garbled text containing fra. The surrounding context in paragraph 1 does not explain the pattern.

patterns.name: Discussion heading
patterns.context: The ending portion of the uppercase heading “DISCUSSION” is marked; it is often preceded by a Roman-numeral section number and may be followed by an anchor or body text.
patterns.domain: Section headings in formal writing, such as papers and legal decisions

patterns.name: replication ending
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences about virus or DNA replication; the trigger is the complete word replication.

patterns.name: infrared word-initial fragment
patterns.context: The word infrared is split across tokens, with activation on the initial fragment fra; the same paragraph also mentions infrared radiation.

patterns.name: fra fragment and line-break fragments
patterns.context: The fra substring occurs in paragraph 1 after a line break, hyphen, and likely garbled text or fragments; in paragraph 6 it appears in the word “sub-«fra»ctions”.
patterns.domain: Mixed: incomplete strings in forum text and subfractions in biomedical text

patterns.name: Anomalous formatted heading markers
patterns.context: A section heading is adjacent to a Markdown-like anchor marker; activation covers both the title ending and sec in the anchor.
patterns.domain: Structured text from PubMed Central articles

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify legal-heading activation
patterns.context: The ending appears in legal section headings such as “II. DISCUSSION” or “III. LAW AND DISCUSSION”; adjacent body topics are inconsistent.

5_816.concept: 英文特定词片段与标题词尾
5_816.description: 激活主要落在大写章节标题 DISCUSSION 的词尾和生物学 replication；另见 infrared 的 fra 词片段及 subfractions、乱码中的 fra。第1段其余上下文无法解释。

patterns.name: Discussion 标题
patterns.context: 大写标题“DISCUSSION”中的词尾部分被标记；前面常有罗马数字章节编号，后面可能跟锚点或正文。
patterns.domain: 论文、法律判决等正式文体的章节标题

patterns.name: replication 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在有关病毒或 DNA 复制的句子中；触发的是完整单词 replication。

patterns.name: infrared 词首片段
patterns.context: 词语 infrared 被跨 token 拆分，激活落在词首片段 fra；同段还谈到 infrared radiation。
patterns.domain: 红外成像与专利技术描述

patterns.name: fra 片段及跨行碎片
patterns.context: 出现 fra 子串；第1段位于换行、连字符和疑似乱码/碎片之后，第6段则在单词“sub-«fra»ctions”中。
patterns.domain: 混合：论坛文本中的残缺串、生物医学文本中的 subfractions

patterns.name: 异常的版面标题标记
patterns.context: 讨论章节标题与类似 Markdown 的锚点标记相邻；激活同时覆盖标题词尾及锚点中的 sec。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文章的结构化文本

patterns.name: 难以归类的法律标题激活
patterns.context: 作为法律判决章节标题“II. DISCUSSION”或“III. LAW AND DISCUSSION”的词尾；相邻正文主题并不一致。

en.concept: Specific word-form fragments and section headings
en.description: Strongly activates on the word replication and its word-form fragments, and also responds to the fra fragment in infrared, sub-fractions, and the anomalous sfrails; it additionally activates on the latter part of the all-caps section heading DISCUSSION.

patterns.name: Replication-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses virus or DNA replication in biomedical text; triggers occur in contexts involving the replication process, replication capacity, or related vectors.

patterns.name: Fragment within infrared
patterns.context: When “infrared” is split into tokens, activation falls on the initial fragment “Infra”; the surrounding context explicitly concerns infrared information or radiation.

patterns.name: Fragment within subfractions
patterns.context: Occurs within “sub-fractions” in the context of separating and analyzing membrane samples; “synaptosomal” also appears nearby in the same context.

patterns.name: Fragment within sfrails
patterns.context: Anomalous or corrupted text in a HackerNews snippet; the “fra” fragment itself activates, but the context is insufficient to determine its semantic role.

patterns.name: DISCUSSION heading
patterns.context: An all-caps section heading in a paper or legal document; activation corresponds to the latter part of “DISCUSSION,” not to the meaning of discussion in ordinary prose.

5_816.concept: 特定词形片段与章节标题
5_816.description: 主要对 replication 一词及其词形片段产生强激活，也会响应红外、sub-fractions、异常的 sfrails 中的 fra 片段；另对全大写章节标题 DISCUSSION 的后半部分激活。

patterns.name: replication 相关词汇
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中讨论病毒或 DNA 的复制；触发可出现在复制过程、复制能力或相关载体的语境中。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、病毒学论文

patterns.name: 红外线词内片段
patterns.context: “infrared”被分词拆开时，激活落在词首片段“Infra”；之后语境明确涉及红外信息或辐射。

patterns.name: subfractions 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“sub-fractions”一词内部，涉及膜样本的分离和分析；同一上下文附近还出现“synaptosomal”。

patterns.name: sfrails 词内片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 片段中的异常或损坏文本，片段本身“fra”被激活；其上下文不足以确定语义作用。

patterns.name: DISCUSSION 标题
patterns.context: 论文或法律文书中的大写章节标题；激活对应单词“DISCUSSION”的后半部分，而非一般正文中的讨论语义。

en.concept: Replication-related word forms and sporadic substrings
en.description: Strong activation primarily falls on replication (especially DNA and viral replication and related damage responses); the fra/Fra substring also appears across forums, logs, infrared patents, and experimental texts, and activation occurs on the latter part of a discussion heading. These branches are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: DNA or viral replication
patterns.context: Occurs in biomedical sentences discussing viral replication, retroviral vectors, bacterial DNA replication, or DNA damage responses; includes cases where replication is preceded by a hyphen.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, virology, and cancer biology

patterns.name: fra substring
patterns.context: Appears as a continuous character substring across different texts: once in 「------↵s«fra»ils」 and twice embedded in hostnames of the form 「-«2»1-«fra»10«1」; no biological meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Forum text, technical logs, and other text

patterns.name: Another instance of the fra substring
patterns.context: Embedded in the word 「In«Fra»10«red」, forming the beginning of infrared, with an uppercase F.

patterns.name: Synaptosomal fractions
patterns.context: Occurs in a methods description of synaptosomal membrane isolation and experimental classification in brain tissue; the triggering substring is within fractions.

patterns.name: DISCUSSION heading
patterns.context: Occurs in the all-caps section heading 「DIS«CUSSION»」, with the activation marker covering the latter part of the word.

5_816.concept: 复制相关词形与零散子串
5_816.description: 强激活主要落在 replication（尤指 DNA、病毒复制及相关损伤反应）上；另有 fra/ Fra 子串跨论坛、日志、红外专利及实验文本出现，并在讨论标题后半部激活。这些旁支难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: DNA或病毒复制
patterns.context: 出现在讨论病毒复制、逆转录病毒载体、细菌DNA复制，或DNA损伤反应的生物医学句子中；包括 replication 前有连字符的情况。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、病毒学、癌症生物学

patterns.name: fra 子串
patterns.context: 在不同文本中作为连续字符子串出现：一处为「------↵s«fra»ils」，另两处嵌在「-«2»1-«fra»10«1」一类主机名中；不要求有生物学语义。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、技术日志、其他文本

patterns.name: fra 子串的另一实例
patterns.context: 嵌在单词「In«Fra»10«red」中，构成 infrared 的开头，大小写为大写 F。

patterns.name: synaptosomal fractions
patterns.context: 出现在关于脑组织突触体膜分离与实验分类的方法描述中；触发子串位于 fractions 一词内部。

patterns.name: DISCUSSION 标题
patterns.context: 出现在大写章节标题「DIS«CUSSION»」中，激活标记覆盖单词后半部。

en.description: Strong responses mainly to replication and its split forms, across virus, DNA, and treatment-related contexts; sporadic activations also occur for Cuba, Soltan, file extensions, and likely identifiers in forums, possibly unrelated to the main pattern.

patterns.name: replication tokenization and hyphenated forms
patterns.context: Biomedical text contains replication, especially referring to replication in viruses, DNA, or cells; the word is split into subwords or joined with hyphens in multiple examples.
patterns.domain: Virology, molecular biology, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Subword split in the proper noun Cuba
patterns.context: The country name Cuba at the start of a sentence is split into C and uba; the sentence mentions the 2017 World Aquatics Championships.

patterns.name: Repeated splitting of the name Deh-e Soltan
patterns.context: The place name Deh Soltan and variants recur after line breaks, with activation concentrated on the split Soltan subword.

patterns.name: PDF filename or extension fragments
patterns.context: Isolated filename fragments containing typesetting or graphics extensions such as .tex and .eps; full context is insufficient.

patterns.name: Likely garbled text or code fragments
patterns.context: Fragments resembling filenames, identifiers, or garbled text appear after a separator in HackerNews text; their meaning cannot be determined from the fragments.

5_816.concept: 不规则子词片段响应
5_816.description: 主要对 replication 及其拆分形式强烈响应，覆盖病毒、DNA与治疗相关语境；另有 Cuba、Soltan、文件扩展名及论坛中的疑似标识符等零散激活，可能与主模式无关。

patterns.name: replication 分词及连字符形式
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中出现 replication，尤其指病毒、DNA 或细胞中的复制；多处该词被切成子词或与连字符相连。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、分子生物学与医学摘要

patterns.name: Cuba 专名的子词切分
patterns.context: 句首国家名 Cuba 被拆为 C 与 uba；所在句提及 2017 年世界游泳锦标赛。

patterns.name: Deh-e Soltan 名称的重复切分
patterns.context: 地名 Deh Soltan 及其变体在换行后重复出现，激活集中于被拆分的 Soltan 子词。

patterns.name: PDF 文件名或扩展名片段
patterns.context: 孤立的文件名片段，包含 .tex 与 .eps 等排版或图形文件扩展名；完整上下文不足。

patterns.name: 疑似乱码或代码片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 文本中的分隔线后出现类似文件名、标识符或乱码的片段，无法据片段确定语义。

en.description: Activation often falls on the initial C and following letter fragments (Coupling, Cotton, Cobalt, CFCY), and also appears in event titles, LaTeX file fragments, and two types of medical abstracts; trigger positions vary across examples.

patterns.name: Initial C followed by splits such as Co/Cot/Cob/CFC
patterns.context: High activation is concentrated on uppercase C and its following letter fragments, which can form Coupling, Cotton, Cobalt, and CFCY. Usually word-initial, sometimes in headings or proper names.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain vocabulary; includes PubMed, patent background, and Wikipedia

patterns.name: Sporting event names
patterns.context: Country, event organizer, or sport names appear in event titles; the initial C and the following part of Cuba at the beginning of a passage also activate strongly.

patterns.name: LaTeX file extension fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in strings resembling filenames or paths, containing .tex and .eps fragments; activation falls on several scattered substrings.

patterns.name: Biomedical replication and genome description
patterns.context: Discusses replication of the hepatitis B virus genome; strong activation is concentrated on Replication.

patterns.name: Ophthalmic imaging terminology and diagnosis
patterns.context: Focuses on optical coherence tomography findings, followed by tamoxifen retinopathy.

5_816.concept: 词首字母与专名片段
5_816.description: 激活既常落在词首C及其后续字母片段（Coupling、Cotton、Cobalt、CFCY），也见于赛事标题、LaTeX文件片段及两类医学摘要；各例触发位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 词首 C 后续拆分为 Co/Cot/Cob/CFC 等
patterns.trigger: 段首或词首的 «C»6，随后常见 «ou»8、«ot»8、«ob»8，或 «FC»8
patterns.context: 高激活集中在大写 C 及其后续字母片段；片段可组成 Coupling、Cotton、Cobalt、CFCY。通常处于词首，部分位于标题或专名。
patterns.domain: 跨领域词汇；含 PubMed、专利背景和 Wikipedia

patterns.name: 运动赛事名称
patterns.trigger: «C»6«uba»10，以及 «World»2«Aqu»2«atics»1« Championships»；另有 «NCAA»5« Division»8« II»3« Soccer»4« Championship»
patterns.context: 赛事标题中出现国家、赛事组织或项目名称；段首的 C 与 Cuba 的后续部分也有强激活。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 体育赛事条目标题

patterns.name: LaTeX 文件扩展名片段
patterns.context: 出现在类似文件名或路径的字符串中，含 .tex 与 .eps 片段；激活落在多个分散的子串上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档或源文件文本

patterns.name: 生物医学复制与基因组描述
patterns.context: 讨论乙肝病毒基因组的复制；强激活集中在 Replication。

patterns.name: 眼科影像学术语与诊断
patterns.context: 以光学相干断层扫描发现为主题，后接他莫昔芬视网膜病变。

en.description: Activations are scattered across text types: prominent at line breaks, mathematical brackets, and expressions; also found in year-and-event headings, name lists, Dutch parliamentary headings, descriptions of medical institutions, and alphabetically labeled numerical options.

patterns.name: Line/paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Line breaks themselves activate strongly across text types; they often occur at line endings or between structural blocks.

patterns.name: Parentheses in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Parentheses are nested in symbols, variables, or function expressions; activation may fall on the opening parenthesis or near a closing parenthesis.

patterns.name: Power/operator structures in formulas
patterns.context: Expressions or answer lines made up of mathematical variables, numbers, and operators; for example, «-24*w**2», «-144*o**2».

patterns.name: Years and event headings
patterns.context: A year appears in the name of a sports team or event, often next to a heading-style phrase.

patterns.name: Names and name sequences
patterns.context: Name fragments in names or personnel lists; may appear in article titles or publication credits/production lists.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia articles and publication front matter

patterns.name: Dutch speech heading format
patterns.context: A heading is followed by a line break and «De Voorzitter», in the format of a parliamentary speech or meeting minutes.

patterns.name: Uppercase field labels and specialist institution names
patterns.context: An institution’s full name and abbreviation follow a field label in an abstract-style description.

patterns.name: Table options and numerical lists
patterns.context: Candidate values are listed with letter labels, followed by a question asking for the minimum.

5_816.concept: 结构边界与格式标记
5_816.description: 激活分散于多种文本：显著落在换行边界、数学括号及运算表达式，也见于年份赛事标题、人名名单、荷兰语议会标题、医学机构描述和字母编号数值选项。

patterns.name: 换行/段落边界
patterns.context: 换行符本身在多种文本中强激活；常出现在行末或结构块之间。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的括号
patterns.context: 括号嵌套在符号、变量或函数表达式中；激活可落在左括号或闭合括号附近。

patterns.name: 公式中的幂次/运算符结构
patterns.context: 数学变量、数值与运算符组成的表达式或答案行；如 «-24*w**2»、«-144*o**2»。

patterns.name: 年份及赛事标题
patterns.context: 年份出现在体育队伍或赛事名称中，常与标题式短语相邻。

patterns.name: 人名及姓名序列
patterns.context: 人名或人员名单中的姓名片段；可能是条目标题或出版物署名/制作名单。
patterns.domain: 百科条目与出版物前置信息

patterns.name: 荷兰语演讲标题格式
patterns.context: 标题后接换行及 «De Voorzitter»，呈现议会发言或会议记录格式。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语 EuroParl 议事文本

patterns.name: 大写字段标签与专业机构名称
patterns.trigger: «DESCRIPTION (adapted from the Abstract):»、«Undersea and Hyperbaric Medical Society»
patterns.context: 摘要式说明字段标签后跟机构全称及缩写。
patterns.domain: NIH 数据库/医学机构描述

patterns.name: 表格选项与数值列表
patterns.context: 按字母编号列出候选数值，随后提出最小值问题。

en.concept: Heterogeneous character fragments and symbol strings
en.description: Activations occur in K-F letter combinations and in Simplify and sqrt expressions in math problems; also seen in WO patent numbers, chemical-bond terminology, and forthcoming in philosophical bibliography. The pattern spans domains and is not unified.

patterns.name: K-F letter combinations
patterns.context: K is immediately followed by F, which may be followed by proper names, numbers, dates, line breaks, or other alphanumeric strings; the trigger does not depend on a fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, PubMed, encyclopedia articles, or numbered text

patterns.name: Math simplification prompt
patterns.context: Occurs in math-problem text containing radicals, fractions, or expressions, often after a line break.

patterns.name: Square-root expressions
patterns.context: Radicals alternate with arithmetic operators, often in long expressions to be simplified.

patterns.name: Patent document numbers
patterns.context: Occurs in citations to WO documents in patent background sections.

patterns.name: Chemical-bond interaction terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in a scientific sentence comparing single-electron bonds and their interaction patterns between Na and H.

patterns.name: German publication-information fragment
patterns.context: A token fragment of the word “forthcoming”, adjacent to publication or bibliographic information such as Graz and Philosophische.

5_816.concept: 异质字符片段与符号串
5_816.description: 激活既出现在 K-F 字母组合，也出现在数学题的 Simplify 与 sqrt 算式；另见 WO 专利编号、化学键术语及哲学书目中的 forthcoming，模式跨领域且不统一。

patterns.name: K、F 字母组合
patterns.context: K 紧接 F，后续可跟专名、编号、日期、换行或其他字母数字串；触发不依赖一个固定词义。

patterns.name: 数学化简提示
patterns.context: 出现在含根式、分数或算式的数学题文本中，常位于换行后。

patterns.name: 平方根表达式
patterns.trigger: «sqrt»，尤其是 «sqrt» 后接括号、数字或分数
patterns.context: 根式与算术运算符交错，常处在要求化简的长算式中。

patterns.name: 专利文献编号
patterns.trigger: «WO» 后接年份和斜线编号，如 «WO» « 2010»«/»«076»
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景中对 WO 文献的引用。

patterns.name: 化学键相互作用术语
patterns.context: 在比较 Na 与 H 的单电子键及其相互作用模式的科学句子中。

patterns.name: 德语出版信息片段
patterns.context: 作为“forthcoming”一词的分词片段，邻近 Graz、Philosophische 等出版或书目信息。

en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is the tokenized fragment of Utilization; other activations are scattered across chemical formulas, title words, specific uppercase strings, and p18(Hamlet), with no common semantic trigger covering them.

patterns.name: Utilization word form
patterns.context: The word is split at a token boundary into Util + ization, appearing at the start of a sentence or prepositional phrase; different words such as of and a follow it.

patterns.name: Numbers and element symbols in chemical formulas
patterns.context: Element symbols, numbers, and parentheses are split and marked in chemical formulas or substance names; multiple parts within a formula may activate.

patterns.name: Fragments in paper titles or names
patterns.context: Title-style text in headings, titles, or abstract openings; activations fall on fragments of words such as Science and Optical in titles, without a shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Paper titles on religion and science; medical paper titles

patterns.name: KMAZ-LP string
patterns.context: The specific uppercase string KMAZ (followed by a hyphen and LP in the second occurrence); activation mainly falls on K and MA.

patterns.name: p18(Hamlet) fragment
patterns.context: A string containing p18(Hamlet), with activation concentrated on the opening parenthesis and split fragments of Hamlet; followed by mediates different p253.

5_816.concept: none
5_816.description: 最强且重复的模式是 Utilization 的分词片段；其余激活分散在化学式、标题词、特定大写字符串及 p18(Hamlet) 中，未见能覆盖它们的共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Utilization 词形
patterns.context: 单词由分词边界拆成 Util + ization，出现在句首或介词短语开头；后接 of、a 等不同词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 化学式中的数字与元素符号
patterns.context: 化学式或化学物质名称中，元素符号、数字及括号等被拆分标记；化学式内部多个部分可激活。

patterns.name: 论文标题或题名中的片段
patterns.context: 标题、题名或摘要开头的标题式文本；激活分别落在标题中的 Science 和 Optical 等词片段，未显示统一词义。
patterns.domain: 宗教与科学主题的论文题名、医学论文题名

patterns.name: KMAZ-LP 字符串
patterns.context: 特定大写字母串 KMAZ（第二处后接连字符和 LP）；主要激活落在 K 与 MA。

patterns.name: p18(Hamlet) 片段
patterns.context: 含 p18(Hamlet) 的字符串，激活集中在左括号及 Hamlet 的拆分片段；随后接 mediates different p253。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要或数据库文本

en.description: Activations occur mainly in dense mathematical formulas and scientific notation, and also cover code paths and identifiers, as well as a colloquial comment about website functionality; the commonality is broadly technical text and specialized terms or symbols.

patterns.name: Complex formulas and symbolic formatting
patterns.context: Activations occur in formulas or formula-dense text, including standalone mathematical expressions and paragraphs where formulas are adjacent to prose.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical science papers

patterns.name: Technical proper names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Occurs in scientific paper abstracts, research findings, or specialist catalog-like text, especially near subscripts, chemical formulas, or specialized names.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, medical and biological materials

patterns.name: Web code and path text
patterns.context: Code, file paths, and natural-language explanations are mixed; activation is concentrated on code identifiers, path fragments, and configuration comments.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in a functional website comment
patterns.context: A colloquial comment describes a website as simple and useful, with ordinary English sentences around the key words.

5_816.concept: 技术记号与专业术语
5_816.description: 激活主要见于密集的数学公式及科学专业记号，也覆盖代码路径与标识符，以及一段关于网站功能性的口语评论；共同点偏向技术文本和特殊术语、符号。

patterns.name: 复杂公式与符号化排版
patterns.trigger: 数学符号、希腊字母及公式标记，如“\partial”“\lambda”“\pm”“\rho”“\chi”“\frac”“_{”和“^{”
patterns.context: 激活出现在公式或公式密集文本中；既包括独立数学表达式，也包括公式与正文相邻的段落。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论科学论文

patterns.name: 技术性专名与缩写
patterns.trigger: 专业术语、缩写或特殊标记，如“I-O”“NMR”“DFT”“IR”“νas”“swpa”“POD”“Ig”“AFC”
patterns.context: 出现在科学论文摘要、研究结果或专业目录式文字中，尤其邻接上下标、化学式或专门命名。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、医学与生物学资料

patterns.name: 网页代码与路径文本
patterns.context: 代码、文件路径与自然语言说明混排；激活集中于代码标识符、路径片段和配置注释。

patterns.name: 功能性网站评论中的强调词
patterns.context: 口语化评论中评价网站简朴、实用，重点词前后有普通英文句子。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code identifiers, version paths, fragments within natural-language words, proper names and URLs, and product brands; the commonality is weak, mainly reflecting sensitivity to specific string fragments and their boundaries.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and path fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of mixed-case identifiers in code, class names, paths, or filenames; often adjacent to slashes, underscores, periods, parentheses, or HTML tags.

patterns.name: Version numbers and dependency paths
patterns.context: Ruby gem/library paths, version numbers, and error-stack information are mixed; activations occur around version digits, path separators, and library names.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Ruby error messages

patterns.name: Inflected Estonian words
patterns.context: Activation is embedded within words in continuous Estonian prose, often on word endings or internal subword fragments; there is no code formatting.

patterns.name: Character fragments in proper names and links
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper names, URL domains, and paths in Hacker News quotes or links; often surrounded by URL punctuation and Markdown links.

patterns.name: Fragments within product names and technical terms
patterns.context: Activation occurs within product names, website names, or technical terms in Hacker News technical discussions, mixed with natural language and camel-case/spelling variants.

patterns.name: Base product copy and payment brands
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near product or brand names in commercial service descriptions; the text discusses contracts, contacts, email, and payments.

5_816.concept: 字符串片段与标识符边界
5_816.description: 激活分散在代码标识符、版本路径、自然语言词内片段、专名及网址、产品品牌等位置；共同点较弱，主要表现为对特定字符串片段及其边界敏感。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与路径片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码、类名、路径或文件名中的大小写混合标识符片段；常邻接斜杠、下划线、点号、括号或 HTML 标记。

patterns.name: 版本号与依赖路径
patterns.context: Ruby gem/库路径、版本号和错误栈信息混排；激活分布在版本数字、路径分隔符及库名附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Ruby 错误信息

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语屈折词
patterns.context: 激活嵌在爱沙尼亚语连续正文的词内，常见词尾或词中子词片段；没有代码格式。

patterns.name: 专名及链接中的字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Hacker News 引用或链接中的专名、网址域名与路径；常被 URL 标点和 Markdown 链接包围。

patterns.name: 产品名与技术词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 Hacker News 技术讨论里的产品名、网站名或技术词内部，夹杂自然语言与驼峰/拼写变体。

patterns.name: Base 产品文案及支付品牌
patterns.context: 激活集中于商业服务描述中的产品或品牌名称附近；正文谈合同、联系人、邮件与付款。
patterns.domain: 商业产品说明/营销文案

en.description: Activations are scattered across URL and link fragments, split English words, code identifiers, and technical terms; they also occur in hiring, experience advice, and aerospace discussions. These examples show no stable shared semantics or clear single contextual condition.

patterns.name: Fragments in URLs and search links
patterns.context: Query parameters or encoded URL fragments in search-engine or webpage links; numbers and letters are split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: Rocket tests and video links
patterns.context: Discussion of rocket-booster tests followed by a YouTube link; the link itself is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Experience and learning advice
patterns.context: Advice to readers to build experience over time, learn, and improve performance on different tasks.

patterns.name: Compound identifiers in code
patterns.context: Variables, modules, and class names composed of multiple words occur in Python/Django route configuration.

patterns.name: URLs and split English words
patterns.context: Ordinary words in titles and URLs are split into subwords by the tokenizer, with no clear semantic condition shared with other fragments.

patterns.name: String-processing function names
patterns.context: A JavaScript export object lists string-conversion functions and their module paths.

patterns.name: Hiring evaluations and candidate comparisons
patterns.context: Asks whether candidates meet expectations and can compete with peers, and mentions candidates for logistics roles.

patterns.name: Web-development terminology and Bootstrap
patterns.context: The question title and body discuss dynamically creating a modal using Jade, JavaScript, Express, and Bootstrap.

patterns.name: Virtualization and security terminology
patterns.context: Compares containers and virtual machines, and discusses security isolation, running as a regular user, and security policies.

patterns.name: Types and functions in C++/graphics code
patterns.context: A C++ expression contains graphics-library types, an angle-conversion function, and a conditional expression.

5_816.concept: none
5_816.description: 激活散布于 URL 与链接碎片、拆分的英语词、代码标识符及技术术语，也见招聘、经验建议和航天讨论；这些例子没有稳定的共同语义或明确的单一上下文条件。

patterns.name: URL 与搜索链接中的碎片
patterns.context: 搜索引擎或网页链接的查询参数、编码后的 URL 片段；数字与字母被拆成子词 token。

patterns.name: 火箭测试与视频链接
patterns.trigger: «They» also tested an emergency escape from the booster near maximum dynamic «pressure»；«y» «out» «u» «be» «ES»
patterns.context: 讨论火箭助推器测试，随后附 YouTube 链接；链接本身被拆分为多个 token。

patterns.name: 经验与学习建议
patterns.context: 劝告读者通过时间积累经验、学习并提升不同任务的表现。

patterns.name: 代码中的复合标识符
patterns.context: Python/Django 路由配置中出现由多个词组成的变量、模块与类名。

patterns.name: 网址与被拆分的英文词
patterns.context: 标题与网址中的普通词被 tokenizer 切成子词，未见明显与其他片段相同的语义条件。

patterns.name: 字符串处理函数名
patterns.context: JavaScript 导出对象中列出字符串转换函数及其模块路径。

patterns.name: 招聘评价与候选人比较
patterns.context: 询问候选人是否符合预期、能否与同侪竞争，并提及物流岗位候选人。

patterns.name: 网页开发术语与 Bootstrap
patterns.context: 问题标题和正文讨论用 Jade、JavaScript、Express 与 Bootstrap 动态创建模态框。

patterns.name: 虚拟化与安全术语
patterns.context: 比较容器与虚拟机，并谈及安全隔离、普通用户运行及安全策略。

patterns.name: C++/图形代码中的类型与函数
patterns.context: C++ 表达式中出现图形库类型、角度转换函数及条件表达式。

en.description: Activation falls on various local strings: identifiers in code and configuration, mathematical formulas or labels, disease abbreviations, and fragments of ordinary question words; trigger positions and semantics differ markedly.

patterns.name: LC/CSV conversion in Ruby
patterns.context: Discusses Ruby lacking LC and needing to convert data to OP; mentions flat_map, map, and a feature request.

patterns.name: etal and slide citation filenames
patterns.context: Occurs in a URL filename; highlights are concentrated on the author surname ending etal and substrings related to slides.

patterns.name: it differently in a mathematical edge case
patterns.context: Explains that when an angle takes certain values and the cosine is ±1, it needs to be handled differently.

patterns.name: Logarithm and formula labels
patterns.context: Occurs in a mathematical derivation containing an integral and an asymptotic function g(T), as part of a formula label.

patterns.name: AutoCSR class name and code symbols
patterns.context: In a Python class definition, the triggering fragment is embedded in the class name and base-class identifier.

patterns.name: BF physical formula label
patterns.context: Occurs in formula labels containing a Pi tensor, an external field, and an integral equation.

patterns.name: AutoUV configuration key
patterns.context: Serialized configuration field name m_AutoUVMaxDistance, followed by a value.

patterns.name: Questions about founders and funding
patterns.context: Asks how long a startup's funding will last, whether co-owners need to contribute, and what experience the founders have.

patterns.name: C header-file macro name
patterns.context: In a C/C++ preprocessor header guard macro, activation falls on a project-specific uppercase abbreviated identifier.

patterns.name: Disease abbreviation and patients
patterns.context: Describes DiGeorge/velocardiofacial syndrome and patients' craniofacial and cardiac abnormalities.

5_816.concept: 混合的局部字符串片段
5_816.description: 激活落在多种局部字符串：代码与配置中的标识符、数学公式或标签、疾病缩写，以及普通问答词片段；各段触发位置和语义差异明显。

patterns.name: Ruby 中的 LC/CSV 转换
patterns.context: 讨论 Ruby 没有 LC，需将数据转换成 OP；提到 flat_map、map 及功能请求。

patterns.name: etal 与幻灯片引用文件名
patterns.context: 出现在链接 URL 的文件名中；高亮集中于作者姓氏末尾 etal 及 slides 相关子串。

patterns.name: 数学边界情形中的 it differently
patterns.context: 说明在角度取若干特定值、余弦为 ±1 时，需要用不同方式处理。

patterns.name: 对数和公式标签
patterns.context: 出现在含积分、渐近函数 g(T) 的数学推导中，作为公式标签的一部分。

patterns.name: AutoCSR 类名及代码符号
patterns.context: Python 类定义中，触发片段嵌在类名和基类标识符内。

patterns.name: 物理公式标签 BF
patterns.context: 出现在含 Pi 张量、外场与积分方程的公式标签中。

patterns.name: 配置键 AutoUV
patterns.context: 序列化配置字段名 m_AutoUVMaxDistance，后接数值。

patterns.name: 创始人及融资问句
patterns.context: 询问创业公司资金能维持多久、共同所有者是否需出资，以及创始人的经验。

patterns.name: C 头文件宏名
patterns.context: C/C++ 预处理器头文件保护宏中，触发落在项目特定的大写缩写标识符。

patterns.name: 疾病缩写及患者
patterns.context: 描述 DiGeorge/velocardiofacial 综合征及患者的颅面和心脏异常。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments within words, compound identifiers, and URL characters; they also occur on punctuation, forum reply words, and uppercase directory text. The examples span domains and similar characters do not activate consistently, making it difficult to assign a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Word-internal suffixes and subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on contiguous character fragments within words or identifiers; initial or neighboring characters are often unmarked, and examples span natural-language words, proper names, and code identifiers.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, code, titles, and links

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural symbols
patterns.context: Symbols occur at structural boundaries in compound words, function calls, SQL statements, preprocessor directives, or links; activation is not consistent for all instances of the same punctuation.

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in formatted code
patterns.context: Long identifiers or calls are split into multiple subword fragments, some of which activate strongly; no stable semantic category is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names, terminology, and titles
patterns.context: Fragments within proper names or academic and title words are hit, but the meanings and contexts of these words vary substantially.
patterns.domain: Biographical entries, academic text, forum titles, encyclopedia articles

patterns.name: URL and link characters
patterns.context: Some characters or fragments in URLs and video IDs are marked; the same characters do not always activate elsewhere.

patterns.name: Q&A and reply formats
patterns.context: A few common words in forum replies are marked, with no consistent syntactic or discourse function.

patterns.name: All-caps display text
patterns.context: Words in uppercase headings or advertising-style directory text are split into uppercase fragments; this may reflect character fragments rather than an uppercase feature.

5_816.concept: 局部子词/字符片段
5_816.description: 激活分散在词内子词片段、复合标识符及URL字符上，也见于标点、论坛回复词和大写目录文字；跨领域且同类字符并不稳定，难归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 词内后缀与子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词或标识符内部的连续字符片段上；词首或邻近字符常未标记，且跨自然语言词、专名和代码标识符。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本、代码、标题和链接

patterns.name: 标点及结构符号
patterns.context: 符号处于复合词、函数调用、SQL语句、预处理指令或链接等结构边界；激活并非对所有同类标点一致。

patterns.name: 格式化代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 长标识符或调用语句被分成多个子词片段，部分片段强激活；未显示稳定的语义类别。

patterns.name: 专名、术语及标题片段
patterns.context: 命中专名或学术、标题词内部的片段，但这些词的语义和上下文差异明显。
patterns.domain: 人物介绍、学术文本、论坛标题、百科条目

patterns.name: 链接与URL字符
patterns.context: URL及其视频ID中若干字符/片段被标记；相同字符并非处处激活。

patterns.name: 问答与回复格式
patterns.context: 论坛回复中的少量常见词被标记，未见一致的句法或话语功能。

patterns.name: 全大写展示文字
patterns.context: 大写标题或广告式目录文字中，词被切分成大写片段；也可能只是字符片段而非大写特征。

en.concept: Segment boundaries and symbols in text
en.description: Activation is distributed across compound identifiers in code and their internal token boundaries, and also appears in URL separators, formulas and paper citations, English function words, German proper names, music links, and newline-separated number formats. Beyond local boundary or segmentation features, there is no stable semantic condition covering all examples.

patterns.name: Compound identifiers and segmented tokens in code
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments, case boundaries, underscores, or token boundaries in identifiers in code, paths, or proper names; these are mostly long compound names, with no fixed programming language observed.
patterns.domain: Source code in various programming languages, namespaces, APIs, and database identifiers

patterns.name: Link and URL structure
patterns.context: Occurs in URLs or links, especially near protocol separators; some activation also falls on segments of URL paths or domains.
patterns.domain: Web links, technical documentation, and forum text

patterns.name: Short symbols and formula boundaries in mathematical text
patterns.context: Near formulas, mathematical expressions, or code-like mathematical operations; evidence is limited, and trigger positions vary.
patterns.domain: Numerical computing source code and mathematics papers

patterns.name: English function words and ordinary text fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across Q&A, licenses, encyclopedia-style introductions, and forum text; no clear shared syntactic or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: English natural language and text mixed with code

patterns.name: Formatting boundaries and repeated digit strings
patterns.context: Near newline characters, digit strings, or delimiter formats; the digit-string example occurs only once and shows no stable condition.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in a German proper name
patterns.context: Occurs in a word-internal segment of the German university name `Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität`.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a music title or text link
patterns.context: Occurs in a YouTube link parameter value, adjacent to a list of song titles.

patterns.name: Quantifier and academic cross-reference fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within a cross-reference label for a theorem or corollary in a paper.

patterns.name: Fragments not easily grouped into the patterns above
patterns.context: Embedded separately in ordinary prose, code examples in URLs, or product names; no clear shared condition with the other activations.

5_816.concept: 文本中的分段边界与符号
5_816.description: 激活分布在多种代码复合标识符及其内部词元边界，也见于网址分隔符、公式与论文引用、英语功能词、德语专名、音乐链接和换行数字格式；除局部边界或分段特征外，没有能覆盖所有例子的稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 代码中的复合标识符与分段词元
patterns.context: 激活落在代码、路径或专名中标识符的内部片段、大小写边界、下划线或词元边界附近；多为较长的复合名称，未见固定编程语言
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言源码、命名空间、API 与数据库标识符

patterns.name: 链接与网址结构
patterns.trigger: `https«://»`；网址中还出现 `«.»`、`«/»` 及域名片段
patterns.context: 出现在网址或链接中，尤其是协议分隔符附近；部分激活也落在网址路径或域名的分段上
patterns.domain: 网页链接、技术文档与论坛文本

patterns.name: 数学文本中的短符号与公式边界
patterns.context: 公式、数学表达式或代码式数学运算附近；证据有限，触发位置不完全一致
patterns.domain: 数值计算源码与数学论文

patterns.name: 英语功能词及普通文本片段
patterns.context: 散见于问答、许可证、百科式介绍和论坛文本；没有明显统一的句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 英语自然语言及其与代码混排的文本

patterns.name: 格式边界与重复数字串
patterns.context: 换行符、数字串或分隔格式附近；数字串例子只出现一次，未显示稳定条件

patterns.name: 德语专名中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在德国大学名称 `Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität` 的词内分段
patterns.domain: 人物介绍或学术传记文字

patterns.name: 音乐标题或文本链接中的名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在 YouTube 链接的参数值中，邻接歌名列表

patterns.name: 量词与学术交叉引用片段
patterns.context: 出现在论文中定理或推论的交叉引用标签内

patterns.name: 不易归入上述模式的片段
patterns.context: 分别嵌在普通论述、网址中的代码示例或产品名中；与其他激活没有清晰共同条件

en.concept: Fragments and boundaries in mixed text
en.description: Activations span multiple languages and code: Latvian stems, endings, and spaces are prominent; the rest are scattered across code identifiers, macros, namespaces, SQL, proper names, terminology, English Q&A, and URL fragments, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Inflected Latvian words
patterns.context: Continuous Latvian vocabulary and inflected endings appear, especially spaces and internal subword fragments; this is not a single obvious semantic word.

patterns.name: Latvian vocabulary and endings
patterns.context: Stems, endings, and inter-word spaces of multiple words are marked in Latvian sentences; content concerns European Commission information, procurement, and price analysis.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax symbols
patterns.context: Marks are scattered across mixed-case class names, namespaces, punctuation, and code fragments; there is no clear pattern specific to an API.
patterns.domain: Python/PyQt code and explanations on StackExchange

patterns.name: SQL keywords and identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur in SQL statements, database object names, and their case and underscore-separated segments.

patterns.name: PHP namespaces and type names
patterns.context: Activation falls on backslash-separated namespaces, class names, and library-identifier fragments, including separators.

patterns.name: C macros and hardware identifiers
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on macro-name fragments composed of uppercase letters, digits, and underscores in preprocessor directives.

patterns.name: Proper-name and terminology fragments in technical text
patterns.context: Marks occur in reference-author names and years; the same passage also contains physics topic phrases, but the marks are mainly distributed across proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Academic compounds and proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur sporadically in discipline terms, compound proper names, and their internal or inter-word fragments, without a unified semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Ruby version-compatibility Q&A
patterns.context: Marks occur sporadically in ordinary English Q&A about Ruby version compatibility; the tool name RuboCop also appears.

patterns.name: URLs and video identifiers
patterns.context: Marks are distributed across fragments of URLs, paths, numbers, and video IDs, near links and parenthetical text.

5_816.concept: 混合文本中的片段与边界
5_816.description: 激活覆盖多种文字与代码：拉脱维亚语词干、词尾和空格较突出；其余散布于代码标识符、宏、命名空间、SQL、专名、术语、英语问答及URL片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语屈折词
patterns.trigger: «t»5«ās»2« var»3« p»2«avir»2«š»1«i»2« att»1iek«ties»4 pret« v»6ajad«z»2«ī»1«g»3«aj»3«iem»3« »5«ieg»4«uld»1«ī»1«j»2«um»1«iem»2« c»10ilvē«ku»2« res»5«urs»6«os»3
patterns.context: 连续出现拉脱维亚语词汇及屈折词尾，尤其是空格与词内子词片段；不是单个明显语义词。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词汇与词尾
patterns.trigger: «no»1«zes»2 Kom«is»…«ij»2«as»2…« iz»3m«anto»2«jam»4 šo« inform»3ā«c»4iju…« c»9«enu»2…« att»1ī«st»2ī«bas»5
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语句子中，多个词的词干、词尾和词间空格被标记；内容涉及欧委会信息、采购和价格分析。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法符号
patterns.context: 标记散布于大小写混合的类名、命名空间、标点和代码词片段；没有明显只针对某个 API 的规律。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 Python/PyQt 代码及说明

patterns.name: SQL关键字与标识符
patterns.context: 激活出现在 SQL 语句、数据库对象名及其大小写和下划线分段中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 SQL 脚本

patterns.name: PHP命名空间与类型名
patterns.context: 激活落在反斜线分隔的命名空间、类名和库标识符片段上，并包括分隔符。

patterns.name: C宏与硬件标识符
patterns.context: 激活集中在预处理指令中的大写、数字和下划线组成的宏名片段。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的专名与术语片段
patterns.context: 参考文献作者名和年份中出现标记；同段还包含物理学主题短语，但标记主要分布于专名片段。

patterns.name: 学术复合词与专名
patterns.context: 激活零散出现在学科词、复合专名及其词内/词间片段，未形成统一语义触发词。

patterns.name: Ruby版本兼容性问答
patterns.trigger: « at»« the»…« make»…« sure»…« with»…« Yes»…Rubo«Cop»…Ruby« which»
patterns.context: 普通英语问答文字中零散标记，围绕 Ruby 版本兼容性；另有工具名 RuboCop。

patterns.name: URL与视频标识符
patterns.context: 标记分布在网址、路径、数字和视频 ID 的片段中，附近有链接及括号文字。

en.concept: No stable semantics; biased toward local subword/character patterns
en.description: Activation spans languages and code contexts, often falling on tokenized identifiers or character substrings: Qt/PyQt, PHP namespaces, JS constants, Latvian c, URL video IDs, author surnames, English articles, and TeX mathematical notation; no single stable semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Tokenization of Qt/PyQt identifiers
patterns.context: In Qt class names or API identifiers, especially when module names, type names, and signal names are split into subwords; does not require a single code format.

patterns.name: PHP namespaces and class names
patterns.context: PHP code namespaces, import statements, and class names; backslash-separated names and mixed-case identifiers are especially prominent.

patterns.name: C/CART substrings in JavaScript constant names
patterns.context: In the uppercase underscore naming of the JavaScript exported constant ADD_TO_CART, activation falls on C/CART-related subwords; also appears in a code question about an implementation issue.

patterns.name: c within Latvian words
patterns.context: The letter c occurs within or at the beginning of ordinary words in continuous Latvian text; the fragments concern EU information, price analysis, and civil protection mechanisms.

patterns.name: C in a URL/video ID
patterns.context: After describing a one-time token generated by a device, the text gives a YouTube link as an example; activation falls mainly on the character sequence of the video ID.

patterns.name: Specific spelling substring in a personal name
patterns.context: Tokenized spelling of the Russian surname Kozyrev in an ArXiv reference; the same passage also lists other authors and years.

patterns.name: Initial substring of the article the
patterns.context: An ordinary definite article appears in continuous English prose; the passage concerns formal epistemology, philosophy of science, and a professorship.

patterns.name: TeX/LaTeX mathematical typesetting notation
patterns.context: After a mathematical formula ends, prose and a cross-reference follow; includes formula delimiters, backslash commands, and Cor/Corollary reference labels.

5_816.concept: 无稳定语义，偏向局部子词/字符模式
5_816.description: 激活跨语言与代码情境，常落在分词后的标识符或字符子串：Qt/PyQt、PHP 命名空间、JS 常量、拉脱维亚语 c、URL 视频 ID、作者姓氏，以及英文冠词和 TeX 数学标记；未见单一稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: Qt/PyQt 标识符分词
patterns.context: Qt 类名或 API 标识符中，尤其是模块名、类型名和信号名按子词切分时；不要求一定是同一种代码格式。

patterns.name: PHP 命名空间及类名
patterns.context: PHP 代码的命名空间、导入语句及类名；反斜杠分隔的名称和大小写混合标识符尤其突出。

patterns.name: JavaScript 常量名中的 C/CART 子串
patterns.context: JavaScript 导出常量 ADD_TO_CART 的大写下划线命名中，激活落在 C/CART 相关子词；同时出现于关于实现问题的代码提问。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内的 c
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语连续文本中，c 字母出现在普通词的词内或词首；片段涉及欧盟信息、价格分析及民防机制。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: URL/视频 ID 中的 C
patterns.context: 说明设备生成的一次性令牌后，以示例展示 YouTube 链接；激活主要落在视频 ID 的字符序列。

patterns.name: 人名中的特定拼写子串
patterns.context: ArXiv 参考文献中俄语姓氏 Kozyrev 的分词拼写；同段还列有其他作者和年份。

patterns.name: 冠词 the 的词首子串
patterns.context: 英文连续散文中出现普通定冠词；该段关于形式认识论、科学哲学及教授职位。

patterns.name: TeX/LaTeX 数学排版标记
patterns.context: 数学公式结束后接正文和交叉引用，包含公式定界、反斜杠命令及 Cor/Corollary 引用标签。

en.description: Activation covers code/API and namespace identifiers, LaTeX formulas, descriptions of paper structure, and academic terms/proper names. There is no single stable semantic trigger; it appears more sensitive to structured technical text and its segmented fragments.

patterns.name: Qt/PyQt API identifiers
patterns.context: Qt GUI API identifiers in code, composed of namespaces, class names, and method names, often appearing in camel case or segmented forms.

patterns.name: Structured identifiers and paths in code
patterns.context: Package names, namespaces, module names, and generated-code markers in code or repository paths; activation falls on identifier fragments segmented by punctuation.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, paths, and license comments

patterns.name: Mathematical typesetting and formula symbols
patterns.context: Formula symbols, commands, and variables are marked in LaTeX math environments; triggers are scattered across multiple locations in formulas and are not limited to a particular variable.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics/physics papers and PubMed mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Section transitions and exposition in paper text
patterns.context: Expository sentences in academic prose describing the paper's structure, research steps, or discussion of results; not all activated words form the same fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and compounds
patterns.context: Terms in discussions of finite-temperature QCD, Polyakov loops, and related physics; activation falls on words or subword fragments in the terms.

patterns.name: Fragments of academic names and institutions
patterns.context: Fields, titles, and university names in biographies; activation is concentrated in subword fragments of longer words.

5_816.concept: 结构化技术文本片段
5_816.description: 激活覆盖代码/API 与命名空间、LaTeX 公式、论文结构叙述及学术术语/专名；没有单一稳定语义触发词，较像对结构化技术文本及其切分片段敏感。

patterns.name: Qt/PyQt API 标识符
patterns.context: 代码中由命名空间、类名和方法名组成的 Qt 图形界面 API 标识符，常以驼峰或分段形式出现。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化标识符与路径
patterns.context: 代码或仓库路径中的包名、命名空间、模块名及生成代码标记；激活落在由标点切分的标识符片段上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码、路径及许可证注释

patterns.name: 数学排版与公式符号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学环境中，公式符号、命令及变量被标记；触发散布在公式多个位置，不限于某个特定变量。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/物理论文与 PubMed 数学公式

patterns.name: 论文正文中的章节/论述衔接
patterns.context: 学术正文中说明文章结构、研究步骤或结果讨论的叙述语句；并非所有激活词都构成同一固定短语。

patterns.name: 物理学术术语与复合词
patterns.context: 有限温度 QCD、Polyakov loop 等物理讨论中的术语，激活落在术语的词或子词上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 高能物理/理论物理论文

patterns.name: 学术人名与机构名称片段
patterns.context: 人物简介中的学科、职称和大学名称，激活集中在较长词的子词片段。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 人物传记/学术简介

en.concept: Proper names and compound fragments in structured text
en.description: Covers code identifiers and namespaces, URL/filename fragments, and physical terminology, mathematical symbols, and LaTeX structures in papers. The commonality is weak; activation often falls on tokenized fragments of proper names, compound words, and structured text.

patterns.name: Class and signal identifiers in Qt/PyQt code
patterns.context: Occurs in Qt interface code class names, type names, signal declarations, or connection statements, often in camel-case identifiers spanning multiple tokens;
patterns.domain: Python and Qt code in StackExchange/GitHub

patterns.name: Swift SDK code identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs near Swift repository paths, filenames, export/import statements, or SDK code comments;
patterns.domain: GitHub, Swift source code, and code repository metadata

patterns.name: Backslash-separated namespaces and type paths
patterns.context: In PHP code, namespaces or class names are joined by backslashes, with markers spanning compound identifiers;

patterns.name: Web links and image filename fragments
patterns.context: In URLs or Markdown image links, domain names, paths, and filenames are tokenized;

patterns.name: Theoretical physics terminology and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical physics papers, including terminology, compound words, or split word forms;

patterns.name: LaTeX structure and symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Activation falls on formulas, LaTeX commands, their delimiters, or variables; some markers lie at the boundary between a formula and prose;
patterns.domain: StackExchange mathematics content and ArXiv mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Symbols and prose transitions in statistical physics formulas
patterns.context: Formulas contain integration variables, constants, and barred variables, followed by prose such as “In normal humans”;
patterns.domain: PubMed Central mathematical and biomedical text

5_816.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与复合片段
5_816.description: 覆盖代码标识符与命名空间、URL/文件名片段，以及论文中的物理术语、数学符号和LaTeX结构。共同点较弱，激活多落在专名、复合词和结构化文本的分词片段上。

patterns.name: Qt/PyQt 代码中的类与信号标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 Qt 界面代码的类名、类型名、信号声明或连接语句中，常是跨 token 拼成的驼峰标识符；
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub 中的 Python、Qt 代码

patterns.name: Swift SDK 代码标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 Swift 仓库路径、文件名、导出导入语句或 SDK 代码注释附近；
patterns.domain: GitHub，Swift 源码及代码仓库元数据

patterns.name: 反斜杠分隔的命名空间与类型路径
patterns.context: PHP 代码中以反斜杠连接命名空间或类名，且标记横跨复合标识符；

patterns.name: 网页链接与图片文件名片段
patterns.context: URL 或 Markdown 图片链接中，域名、路径及文件名被分词标记；

patterns.name: 理论物理术语与词形片段
patterns.context: 在数学物理论文叙述中出现，包含术语、复合词或被拆分的词形；

patterns.name: 数学公式的 LaTeX 结构与符号
patterns.context: 激活落在公式、LaTeX 命令及其分隔符或变量上；有些标记夹在公式与正文交界处；
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学内容及 ArXiv 数学公式

patterns.name: 统计物理公式中的符号与正文衔接
patterns.context: 公式里出现积分变量、常数和带横线变量，后接“In normal humans”一类正文；
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 数理生物医学文本

en.concept: make sure phrase and sporadic technical identifiers
en.description: Primarily activates on “make sure” across line breaks or in ordinary sentence structures; there are also two Qt identifier code segments and three unrelated ArXiv passages on formulas, stochastic processes, and geometric measure theory, with no shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: make sure phrase
patterns.context: Means to confirm or ensure something in an infinitive or imperative construction; often appears at the end of a sentence or across a line break.
patterns.domain: Natural-language text in forums, Q&A, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Qt class names and API identifiers
patterns.context: Namespaces, class names, or API identifiers in Python/Qt code; activation is distributed across multiple tokens within identifiers.
patterns.domain: GitHub code and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Specific symbol fragments in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Fractions, powers, and summation notation in formula expressions; no apparent natural-language phrase condition.

patterns.name: Stochastic processes and supersymmetry terminology
patterns.context: Theoretical physics passages discussing Langevin equations, fermion fields, and stochastic actions.

patterns.name: Geometric measure theory terminology
patterns.context: Theorems or mathematical arguments describing a set covered by parallel hyperplanes, accompanied by measure inequalities.

5_816.concept: make sure 短语与零散技术标识
5_816.description: 主要对跨换行或常规句式中的“make sure”激活；另有两个 Qt 标识符代码段，以及三段互不相同的 ArXiv 公式、随机过程和几何测度论内容，未见共同触发模式。

patterns.name: make sure 短语
patterns.context: 在不定式或祈使式结构中，表示确认、确保某事；常出现在句末或跨换行处。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答及技术说明中的自然语言文本

patterns.name: Qt 类名与 API 标识符
patterns.context: Python/Qt 代码里的命名空间、类名或 API 标识符；激活分散在标识符内部多个 token。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定符号片段
patterns.context: 公式表达式中的分式、幂和求和记号；没有明显自然语言短语条件。

patterns.name: 随机过程与超对称术语
patterns.context: 讨论 Langevin 方程、费米场和随机作用量的理论物理段落。

patterns.name: 几何测度论术语
patterns.context: 定理或数学论证中描述集合被平行超平面覆盖，并伴随测度不等式。

en.concept: Ensure (with heterogeneous activations involving the letter c)
en.description: Most passages activate near make sure (sometimes across a line break), expressing that something should be ensured; other cases involve c in technical text—as a constant or function parameter in mathematical formulas, or in a CMake identifier—with no confirmed link to the primary pattern.

patterns.name: Ensure / make certain
patterns.context: In the phrase make sure, sure is usually the main trigger, often followed by a that-clause, object, or omitted complement, expressing action taken to ensure an outcome; [1] contains a line break in between.
patterns.domain: Forums, email, web content, and explanatory prose

patterns.name: sure in other local contexts
patterns.context: [2] contains make sure, but with an intervening line break; in [3] and [10], strong activation falls on the letter c in mathematics or formulas, not natural-language sure, and may reflect a different local pattern.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, mathematical derivations, and physical formulas

patterns.name: c in a CMake configuration identifier
patterns.context: A code identifier is tokenized into multiple fragments, with activation concentrated on C and related substrings; the phrase make sure is absent.

5_816.concept: 确保（兼有字母 c 的异质激活）
5_816.description: 多数段落在 make sure（有时跨换行）附近激活，表示确保某事发生；另有技术文本中的 c：数学公式里的常数或函数参数、CMake 标识符，无法确认与主模式相关。

patterns.name: 确保/保证
patterns.context: 短语 make sure 中 sure 通常是主要触发点，常接 that 从句、宾语或省略补语，表达采取行动以确保结果；[1]中间有换行。
patterns.domain: 论坛、邮件、网页内容、说明文

patterns.name: sure 出现在其他局部上下文
patterns.context: [2]出现 make sure，但有插入换行；[3]、[10]中强激活落在数学或公式里的字母 c，并非自然语言 sure，可能是不同的局部模式。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、数学推导与物理公式

patterns.name: CMake 配置标识符中的 c
patterns.context: 代码标识符被分词为多个片段，激活集中在 C 与相关子串；没有 make sure 短语。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答／CMake 代码

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical formulas and SO group notation, Qt/Python identifiers, Go hashes, HTML/CSS/URLs, colloquial phrases, and fragments of the scientific name of rice; there is no consistent semantic trigger across domains.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlights in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical paper formulas or nearby text; trigger locations vary, including backslashes, Greek letters, variables, formula symbols, and word fragments.

patterns.name: SO group notation in formulas
patterns.context: When discussing spacetime manifolds, rotational symmetry, or critical bubbles, activation falls on partial tokens in group notation and related expressions.

patterns.name: Qt/Python identifiers in source code
patterns.context: Identifiers in code or code diffs are split into multiple subword tokens; punctuation, line breaks, and local identifiers also activate.

patterns.name: Go checksum strings
patterns.context: Appears in long checksum hashes in go.mod, where multiple alphanumeric fragments activate; no stable connection to code semantics is apparent.

patterns.name: HTML/CSS/URL fragments
patterns.context: Links, resource paths, and file extensions in webpage source code; activation is mainly distributed across segmented URL and punctuation fragments.

patterns.name: Short words and line breaks in informal English narration
patterns.context: In an informal personal narrative with quoted speech, activation is concentrated on the phrase “make sure you get” and a line break; other nearby words do not activate.

patterns.name: Species-name fragments in a botanical abstract
patterns.context: Some word fragments activate after the rice scientific name Oryza sativa is split; a few activations also occur in nearby text on salt-stress research.

5_816.concept: none
5_816.description: 激活分散于数学公式及 SO 群记号、Qt/Python 标识符、Go 哈希、HTML/CSS/URL、口语短语和水稻学名片段；缺乏跨领域一致的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的零散高亮
patterns.context: 出现在数学论文公式或公式邻近文本中；触发点并不一致，包括反斜杠、希腊字母、变量、公式符号和单词片段。

patterns.name: 公式中的 SO 群记号
patterns.context: 讨论时空流形、旋转对称性或临界泡时，激活落在群记号的部分 token 以及相关表述上。

patterns.name: 源码中的 Qt/Python 标识符
patterns.context: 代码或代码差异中，标识符被拆成多个子词 token；另有标点、换行和局部标识符也激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 与 StackExchange 编程内容

patterns.name: Go 校验和字符串
patterns.context: 出现在 go.mod 的校验和哈希长串中，多个字母数字片段被激活；看不出与代码语义的稳定联系。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS/URL 片段
patterns.context: 网页源码中的链接、资源路径与文件扩展名；激活主要分布在拆分后的 URL 和标点片段。

patterns.name: 英语口语叙述中的短词与换行
patterns.context: 一段带引语的非正式个人叙述中，激活集中于短语“make sure you get”及换行；其他邻近词未激活。

patterns.name: 植物学摘要中的物种名片段
patterns.context: 水稻学名 Oryza sativa 被拆分后，部分词片段激活；附近的盐胁迫研究文本另有少量激活。

en.concept: English expressions of assurance and sporadic contextual triggers
en.description: Most passages activate strongly in the expression make sure, meaning to ensure something; other cases include it helps explanations, it referring to something liked, and terminology in a mathematical paper, with no matching phrase trigger.

patterns.name: make sure assurance
patterns.context: The phrase make sure means to verify or ensure something; activation is concentrated on sure and commonly appears in make sure to/that or make sure I/we.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English; news, technical documentation, forums, and email

patterns.name: it helps explanation
patterns.context: The author hopes an example will help explain a problem, before or after a code example; the highlight is concentrated on it.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and code discussions

patterns.name: Liking something
patterns.context: The pronoun it refers to work described earlier, in a passage about whether someone likes the job.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of people in Enron email

patterns.name: Mathematical paper terminology
patterns.context: Academic discussion of fractional exclusion statistics and finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces; activation falls on terminology and name fragments.

5_816.concept: 英语确认表达及零散语境触发
5_816.description: 多数段落在 make sure 确保某事的表达中强烈激活；另有 it helps 解释、喜欢某事中的 it，以及一段数学论文术语激活，未显示出与主模式相同的短语触发。

patterns.name: make sure 确认
patterns.context: 短语 make sure 用来表示确认、确保某事；激活集中在 sure，常见于 make sure to/that 或 make sure I/we。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语；新闻、技术文档、论坛、邮件

patterns.name: it helps 解释
patterns.context: 代码示例前后，作者希望示例有助于解释问题；高亮集中在 it。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及代码讨论

patterns.name: 喜欢某事
patterns.context: 代词 it 指代前文所述工作，处于对某人是否喜欢这份工作的叙述中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的人物描述

patterns.name: 数学论文术语
patterns.context: 分数排斥统计及有限维 Hilbert 空间的学术论述；激活落在术语和姓名片段上。

en.concept: Suggestions and reminders to ensure something
en.description: The most prominent cue is sure: it commonly appears in suggestions and reminders such as just be sure to/that, and also in make sure that. Other activations include that, technical suggestions, physics group symbols, and sporadic activations in personal narratives, which cannot all be assigned to the same semantic pattern.

patterns.name: sure followed by a suggestion
patterns.context: sure is followed by to or a that-clause introducing a precaution, suggestion, or reminder; activation is concentrated on sure, with weaker activation on some adjacent function words.

patterns.name: make sure to confirm something
patterns.context: make sure is followed by a setting, action, or condition to confirm or ensure; sure activates most strongly, while make, that, and other words also activate.

patterns.name: that introducing a proposition or relative clause
patterns.context: that occurs in a longer clause or connects an earlier action with a result; it shows no unified semantic function and may be a broader local word-form trigger.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, machine-learning discussions, theoretical physics

patterns.name: Gratitude in English suggestions
patterns.context: The questioner expresses thanks at the end of a StackExchange question; activation here is weak.

patterns.name: Group symbols in theoretical physics
patterns.context: Symbols representing a group and its definition in mathematical formulas; nearby symbols and parentheses activate, with no apparent semantic connection to sure-based suggestions.

patterns.name: Practice recommendation for promise callbacks
patterns.context: In a JavaScript programming Q&A, should always introduces a practical recommendation about a callback's return value; it expresses a suggestion like the sure constructions, but has a different trigger form.

patterns.name: Moving on in a personal narrative
patterns.context: Describes handling emotions after a breakup, letting go, and moving on; this differs from the technical-suggestion usage.

5_816.concept: 建议中的确保与提醒
5_816.description: 最突出的线索是 sure：常见于 just be sure to/that 的建议提醒，也见 make sure that。另有 that、技术建议、物理群符号及个人叙述中的零散激活，不能完全归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: sure 与后续建议
patterns.context: sure 后接 to 或 that 引导的注意事项、建议或提醒；激活集中在 sure，部分相邻功能词也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 问答、技术讨论、创业建议

patterns.name: make sure 确认事项
patterns.context: make sure 后接需要确认或保证的设置、行为或条件；sure 激活最强，make、that 等也激活。

patterns.name: that 引出的命题或关系从句
patterns.context: that 出现在较长从句中，或连接前文动作与结果；未呈现统一的语义功能，可能是较宽泛的局部词形触发。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、机器学习讨论、理论物理

patterns.name: 英文建议中的回报语
patterns.context: 提问者在 StackExchange 问题结尾表达感谢；此处激活较弱。

patterns.name: 理论物理中的群符号
patterns.context: 数学公式中表示群及其定义；相关符号和括号附近激活，未见与 sure 建议句式的明显语义联系。

patterns.name: promise callback 的规范建议
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码问答中，以 should always 提出 callback 返回值的实践建议；与 sure 句式相似地表达建议，但触发形式不同。

patterns.name: 个人叙述中的继续前行
patterns.context: 叙述分手后的情绪处理，表示不再纠缠、继续生活；与技术建议用法不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to sure and the structures make/be sure to: they occur when suggesting actions, checking settings, confirming signals, or discussing payment, across technical Q&A, advice, and email. The second passage contains only make sure to select, related to the expression but with sure unmarked.

patterns.name: “make sure” expressions of confirmation
patterns.context: Sure in the phrase is especially prominent when giving advice, checking settings, or stating intent; contexts often involve confirming something is correct, avoiding omissions, or ensuring an outcome.
patterns.domain: Q&A, technical discussions, advice, and email

patterns.name: be sure to in selection or action advice
patterns.context: Introduces an action to take in an imperative or advisory tone, such as “keep the data…to a minimum,” “select vinyl printing inks,” or “diversify away…”; can also describe an outcome one can be confident of when making an allocation.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, startup advice, and printing advice

patterns.name: Variants of make sure
patterns.context: Words may be inserted between make and sure, including that, pronouns, or modal constructions; the meaning remains to verify, ensure, or confirm ability. The sentence in passage 10 is truncated.

5_816.concept: 确保/确认表达
5_816.description: 主要对 sure 及 make/be sure to 结构起反应：在建议行动、核实设置、确认信号或支付等语境中出现，跨技术问答、建议和邮件。第2段仅见 make sure to select，与该表达相关但 sure 未标出。

patterns.name: “make sure”确认表达
patterns.trigger: “make sure”及其紧邻续接，如 “Just be sure to”“want to make sure that/if”
patterns.context: 在提出建议、核查设置或说明意图时，短语中的 sure 尤其突出；上下文常为确认某事正确、避免遗漏或确保结果。
patterns.domain: 问答、技术讨论、建议与邮件

patterns.name: 选择或操作建议中的 be sure to
patterns.context: 以祈使或建议口吻引出需要采取的行动，如 “keep the data…to a minimum”“select vinyl printing inks”“diversify away…”；也可用于说明分配时可确信的结果。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、创业建议、印刷建议

patterns.name: make sure 的变体用法
patterns.trigger: “make … sure”，包括 “make sure that setting…” 和 “just to make sure I can tell…”
patterns.context: 词语间可插入 that、代词或情态结构，仍表达核实、确保或确认能力；第10段句子截断。

en.description: Activation appears in URLs and domains, the unit mph, Latvian fragments, sure expressions of certainty, mathematical symbols, hyphenated physics terminology, imperative phrases, and academic institutional addresses; no single semantic pattern accounts for these heterogeneous fragments.

patterns.name: com in URLs and domains
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in domain and path characters in URLs or image links; domains may also be split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Web, social media, or forum text

patterns.name: mph wind-speed unit
