patterns.context: Appears after a numerical wind speed, describing strong winds during photography and their impact on the camera.

patterns.name: Latvian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous Latvian text about work or system development; activation is scattered within and between words.

patterns.name: sure expressing certainty
patterns.context: Appears in the “be sure that” construction, expressing passengers' desire to ensure that a driver will also bear the consequences if an accident occurs during autonomous driving.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula tokens
patterns.context: Embedded in mathematical formulas about local Minkowski manifolds and groups; activation spans symbols, numbers, and some formula tokens.

patterns.name: Fragments of laser-cooling terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the molecular physics experimental technique “laser cooling and magneto-optical trapping.”

patterns.name: sure as a marker of certainty
patterns.context: Appears in the “you can be sure” construction, emphasizing that an initial large memory allocation will obtain memory from the allocator.

patterns.name: Imperative emphasis with do it
patterns.context: After a direct form of address, “do it!” urges Sundar to take action; activation covers the phrase and exclamation mark.

patterns.name: Fragments of institutional addresses and place names
patterns.context: Appears in lists of institutions, cities, and postal addresses for mathematics authors; the same passage contains multiple locations and institution names.

patterns.name: “want to be sure” construction expressing a desire
patterns.context: “want to be sure that” describes people's desire to confirm safety when operating an autonomous subway; it shares sure with the seventh example, but differs in meaning and context.

5_816.concept: none
5_816.description: 激活分布在网址与域名、mph单位、拉脱维亚语片段、sure确定性表达、数学符号、物理术语连字符、祈使短语及学术机构地址中；没有单一语义模式能覆盖这些异质片段。

patterns.name: 网址域名中的 com
patterns.context: 激活集中在网址或图片链接的域名与路径字符中；域名也可能被切分成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 网页、社交媒体或论坛文本

patterns.name: mph 风速单位
patterns.context: 出现在数字风速之后，描述摄影时的强风及其对相机的影响。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词形片段
patterns.trigger: «ē»、«ma»、«pat»，以及« darbojas»、« sistēmas»等相邻词形片段
patterns.context: 处于连续的拉脱维亚语正文中，涉及工作或系统发展；激活散布于词内及词间片段。

patterns.name: sure 的确定性表达
patterns.context: 出现在“be sure that”结构中，表达乘客希望确保自动驾驶时若发生事故，司机也会承担后果。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、自动驾驶讨论

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式 token
patterns.context: 嵌在局部 Minkowski 流形及群的数学公式中，激活覆盖符号、数字和部分公式 token。

patterns.name: 激光冷却术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在“laser cooling and magneto-optical trapping”这一分子物理实验技术表述中。

patterns.name: 确定性语气词 sure
patterns.context: 出现在“you can be sure”结构中，强调初始大内存分配会从分配器取得内存。

patterns.name: 祈使强调 do it
patterns.context: 在直接呼语后，用“do it!”敦促 Sundar 采取行动；激活覆盖短语及感叹号。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、科技产品讨论

patterns.name: 机构地址与地名片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学作者单位的机构、城市与邮政地址列表中；同段包含多个地点和机构名。

patterns.name: 表达被驱动的 be sure 句式
patterns.context: “want to be sure that”描述人们希望自动驾驶地铁时确认安全；与第7段的 sure 同词，但此处语义和上下文不同。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、自动驾驶讨论

en.concept: that in subordinate clauses and technical explanations
en.description: Primarily responds to technical explanations, conditional or purpose clauses introduced by that, especially instructions and predicates after so that; also appears in advisories, Promise/callback explanations, mathematical judgments, and SO group formulas. The trust me phrase and workplace narrative in segment 3 cannot be connected to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Conditional clauses after that
patterns.context: that introduces an explanatory, conditional, or purpose clause followed by a subject and predicate, especially in “so that” constructions. Activations often occur near that, the, and the following predicate.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, software documentation, papers, and forum discussions

patterns.name: Ensure/advisory-style instructions
patterns.context: Explains operational or implementation requirements, often using an imperative or should; includes advisory expressions such as be sure that and should always.

patterns.name: Trust and employment-history narratives
patterns.context: First-person accounts of work experience and future employment choices; strong responses concentrate on trust me and the following text.

patterns.name: Mathematical truth-value judgments
patterns.context: Presents consecutive number-theory problems and gives a brief judgment or answer using False.

patterns.name: Manifolds and group notation
patterns.context: SO groups and definitions of their parameters, groups, or subgroups appear in mathematical papers; tokenization of the symbols may contribute to activation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers (geometry, topology, and group theory)

patterns.name: Localized intensity in then/callback explanations
patterns.context: Explains that a then callback in a JavaScript Promise chain should return a value; partially overlaps with the general subordinate-clause pattern.

patterns.name: Object-menu implementation explanations
patterns.context: Explains why an object in a drop-down window must implement a particular interface to appear in a menu; besides the that clause, the interface name and implementation explanation also show localized activation.

patterns.name: Incoherent local triggers in technical contexts
patterns.context: A sentence contains a purpose or result clause with so that, and the response spans several tokens after that; possibly a specific form of the main conditional-clause pattern.

patterns.name: Other localized terms and numeric formats
patterns.context: One-off mathematical terms, numbers, or ordinary words, with no stable, independent trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Papers, math problems, and technical Q&A

5_816.concept: 从句与技术说明中的 that
5_816.description: 主要响应于 that 引导的技术性解释、条件或目的从句，尤其 so that 后的指令与谓语；也见建议语气、Promise/callback说明、数学判断及SO群公式。段3的 trust me 和职场叙述无法与主模式相连。

patterns.name: that 后的条件从句
patterns.trigger: «that»10« the»（段1、2；另见段7、8、9中 that 后出现情态或一般动词）
patterns.context: that 引导解释、条件或目的从句，后接主语和谓语；尤其在“so that”结构中。激活常落在 that、the 及其后的谓语附近。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、程序说明、论文及论坛讨论

patterns.name: 确保/建议式指令
patterns.trigger: «be»5« sure»8« that»9（段5）；«be»5« sure»7« that»9（段9）；«You»2« should»2« always»4« return»4（段7）
patterns.context: 说明操作或实现要求，常以祈使句或 should 引出；包含 be sure that、should always 等指导性表达。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 HackerNews 技术建议

patterns.name: 信任与任职经历叙述
patterns.trigger: «trust»4« me»9 -« at»4« any»2« future»1 role I« will»1 look
patterns.context: 第一人称回顾工作经历并谈未来任职选择；强响应集中在 trust me 及其后续语句。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 个人经历/职场讨论

patterns.name: 数学真伪判断
patterns.trigger: «False»（段6）；«Is j composite?»、«Is n a prime number?»
patterns.context: 连续提出数论计算题，并用 False 作简短判断或答案。

patterns.name: 流形与群符号
patterns.context: 数学论文中出现 SO 群及其参数、群或子群的定义；符号 token 化可能贡献激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文（几何、拓扑与群论）

patterns.name: 局部强度集中于 then/callback 说明
patterns.context: 说明 JavaScript Promise 链中 then 回调应返回值；与一般条件从句模式部分重叠。

patterns.name: 对象菜单实现说明
patterns.context: 解释下拉窗口中的对象为何需实现特定接口以供菜单显示；除 that 从句外，接口名称及实现说明也有局部激活。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 软件开发文档/讨论

patterns.name: 技术语境中的非连贯局部触发
patterns.trigger: «choose»4« the»5…« so»4« that»10（段1）；«correct»3« them»4« so»4« that»10（段2）
patterns.context: 句中存在 so that 目的或结果从句，响应跨越到 that 后若干 token；可能是主要条件从句模式的具体形式。
patterns.domain: 量子计算说明、监控指标问答

patterns.name: 其余局部词项与数值格式
patterns.context: 单次出现的数学术语、数字或普通词，未显示稳定且独立的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论文、数学题及技术问答

en.description: Activation falls mainly on that as a clause connector, especially when stating conditions, purposes, or constraints in technical contexts; it also responds to fixed expressions such as Trust me and Make sure, and to skeptical forum questions, spanning colloquial and Q&A text.

patterns.name: that in imperative technical suggestions
patterns.context: In technical explanations, a that-clause connects a preceding operation, design, or requirement with a subsequent result or condition.
patterns.domain: Quantum computing, software development, and programming Q&A

patterns.name: Request for trust in colloquial emphasis
patterns.context: The speaker uses “trust me” to ask the listener to believe their experience or judgment, usually followed by a personal experience, judgment, or warning.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, online Q&A, and informal discussion

patterns.name: Operational instructions in answers
patterns.context: A Q&A answer uses “Make sure” to give a clear check or caution, followed by specific operational details.

patterns.name: Skeptical or rhetorical restatement
patterns.context: A fixed expression first restates the other person's request, with a skeptical or displeased tone.

patterns.name: that in mathematical text
patterns.context: Mathematics/physics papers use relative clauses to describe properties satisfied by an object; this differs from colloquial fixed expressions.

5_816.concept: 语篇衔接与强调短语
5_816.description: 激活主要落在 that 从句连接词上，尤其是技术语境中说明条件、目的或约束；另有对 Trust me、Make sure 等固定表达及论坛质疑句的响应，覆盖口语与问答文本。

patterns.name: 命令式技术建议中的 that
patterns.trigger: “so that”中的“that”：[4] “so that”引出必要条件；[8] “so that”引出实现目的；[10] “ensure that”引出需满足的条件
patterns.context: 技术说明中 that 从句连接前面的操作、设计或要求与后续结果/条件。
patterns.domain: 量子计算、软件开发与编程问答

patterns.name: 口语强调语中的信任请求
patterns.context: 说话者以“trust me”要求听者相信其经验或判断，通常接个人经历、判断或警告。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、网络问答与非正式论述

patterns.name: 回答中的操作指令
patterns.context: 问答答案以“Make sure”提出明确的检查或避免事项，后接具体操作细节。

patterns.name: 质疑或反问式复述
patterns.trigger: “Let me get this straight, you want us to…”：[7]
patterns.context: 先用固定表达复述对方要求，语气带有质疑或不满。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 that
patterns.context: 数学/物理论文用关系从句说明对象满足的性质；与口语固定表达不同。

en.description: Activations often occur in first-person emphasis such as “Trust me” and operational instructions such as “make sure you”; sporadic patterns also appear in paper hypotheses, prescriptive code comments, Latvian quotations, and reference-list names.

patterns.name: “Trust me” expression
patterns.context: Used by a first-person speaker to emphasize experience, offer assurance, or introduce a personal judgment; across several segments, the trigger is concentrated on me.
patterns.domain: Forums, comments, Q&A, and other conversational or semi-conversational text

patterns.name: “make sure you” instruction
patterns.context: Offers the reader operational advice, a precaution, or a way to avoid something; activation falls on you.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, tutorials, and code comments

patterns.name: Qualification/hypothesis in paper discourse
patterns.context: States an assumption, limits the scope of discussion, or introduces a specific case in academic discourse.

patterns.name: Prescriptive prompt in code comments
patterns.context: A code comment specifies a standard practice to follow; here, it calls for using the canonical host.

patterns.name: First-person quotation in Latvian
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence reporting or quoting a personal statement; activation is concentrated in the subword fragment within teicu.

patterns.name: Author-name fragment in references
patterns.context: Occurs in an author list in an academic paper’s in-text citation; it is a name, not an ordinary discourse word.

5_816.concept: 强调与指示性话语片段
5_816.description: 激活常见于“Trust me”一类第一人称强调，以及“make sure you”式的操作指示；另见论文假设、规范性代码注释、拉脱维亚语引语和参考文献姓名等零星模式。

patterns.name: “Trust me”表达
patterns.context: 第一人称说话者用来强调经验、保证或引出个人判断；在多段中触发点集中于 me。
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论、问答等口语或半口语文本

patterns.name: “make sure you”指示语
patterns.context: 面向读者提出操作建议、注意事项或避免某种情况；激活落在 you 上。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、教程和代码注释

patterns.name: 论文论述中的限定/假设
patterns.context: 学术论述中陈述假设、限定讨论范围或引入特定情形。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的规范化提示
patterns.context: 代码注释里说明应采用某种规范做法；此处要求使用 canonical host。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语第一人称引语
patterns.context: 出现在转述或引述个人说法的句中；激活集中在 teicu 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 拉脱维亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 参考文献作者名片段
patterns.context: 位于学术论文的文内引文作者列表中，属于姓名而非普通论述词。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on me/teicu in first-person emphasis or self-narration; there are also localized responses to a proper name in a license address, Octal code, case in a paper, and the challenge phrase straight. The triggers across segments are not the same word form.

patterns.name: First-person emphasis/self-narration
patterns.context: English passages contain the colloquial emphatic phrase “trust me,” or Latvian contains “kā es teicu,” meaning roughly “as I said”; also includes first-person narration in the same segment. The trigger occurs near me or teicu.

patterns.name: Specific proper names and legal-text formatting
patterns.context: These words occur in the fixed copyright notice, foundation mailing address, and URL of the GNU Affero General Public License. In repeated notices, the strongest activation is on the street name Street.

patterns.name: Octal code identifier
patterns.context: Octal/Octal bitmask occurs in code comments or identifiers, especially in code about strict mode and escape behavior.

patterns.name: Use of case in papers
patterns.context: A mathematical physics paper uses “the case where” to introduce the parameter conditions under study, alongside formal discussion such as system size and J > 0.

patterns.name: Challenging response about instructions/services
patterns.context: The colloquial phrase “Let me get this straight” challenges or confirms the other party’s request, followed by discussion of payment and providing instruction.

5_816.concept: 混合的局部词汇触发
5_816.description: 激活主要集中于第一人称强调或自述中的 me／teicu；另对许可证地址的专名、Octal 代码、论文中 case 及质疑句式 straight 有局部响应。各段触发并非同一词形。

patterns.name: 第一人称强调／自述
patterns.trigger: «me»10« -»3« at»4« any»3 future role« I»1；«Trust»1« me»10«；«trust»1« me»9« when»2；«k»1ā« es»5« te»3«ic»10«u»2；«k»2ā« j»2«au»1« te»2«ic»9«u»3
patterns.context: 英语段落中出现口语强调短语“trust me”，或拉脱维亚语中相当于“正如我所说”的“kā es teicu”；也包括同段第一人称叙述。触发点落在 me 或 teicu 附近。
patterns.domain: 论坛／问答口语；议会发言

patterns.name: 特定专名与法律文本格式
patterns.context: GNU Affero General Public License 的固定版权声明、基金会邮寄地址及 URL 中出现这些词。重复声明中街道名 Street 的激活最强。

patterns.name: Octal 代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码注释或标识符中出现 Octal／Octal bitmask，尤其讲 strict mode 与转义行为的代码上下文。

patterns.name: 论文中的 case 用法
patterns.context: 数学物理论文以“the case where”引出所研究的参数条件，紧邻 system size、J > 0 等形式化讨论。

patterns.name: 指令／课程的争议性回应
patterns.context: “Let me get this straight”这一质疑或确认对方诉求的口语句式，后接付费与提供 instruction 的讨论。

en.description: Activation is scattered across second-person suggestions/instructions, first-person comments, imperative expressions such as ensure that, and a few technical word fragments; there are also Latvian intraword fragments, URL slashes, and author-surname fragments, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: you in colloquial text
patterns.context: The second-person pronoun appears in casual suggestions or instructions, especially after expressions like «ensure that».

patterns.name: we in sentence-final or quoted text
patterns.context: we functions as the subject followed by a verb or copula; it appears in technical explanations or comments.

patterns.name: I in quoted speech
patterns.context: The first-person singular appears in personal experiences or colloquial comments.

patterns.name: Latvian first-person expression
patterns.context: A Latvian first-person expression meaning “I say/tell”; activation falls on the verb forms and surrounding pronouns.

patterns.name: Imperative sentences in code suggestions
patterns.context: Provides a specific fix or precaution using the make sure that suggestion construction.

patterns.name: ensure in technical steps
patterns.context: Asks the reader to ensure that a configuration or action holds, often followed by we/you.

patterns.name: Discourse marker emphasizing seriousness
patterns.context: Asks the other person to take an argument seriously, appearing in a rhetorical question or direct advice.

patterns.name: this in technical text
patterns.context: Refers to the current problem, approach, or technical object, usually in an explanatory or evaluative sentence.

patterns.name: Web/script technical terms
patterns.context: Code terms that appear in HTML/JavaScript technical discussions; the specific activation locations vary.

patterns.name: Slash in URL/version strings
patterns.context: The slash occurs within a download URL or path/version number, as part of continuous code or command text.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in institutional author addresses
patterns.context: A surname in the author list is split into tokens, surrounded by names and institution locations.

patterns.name: Latvian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Intraword subword fragments in continuous Latvian text; they do not clearly correspond to the English pronoun/imperative pattern.

5_816.concept: 人称与指令式话语线索
5_816.description: 激活分散于第二人称建议/指令、第一人称评论、ensure that 等指令式表达及少数技术词片段；另有拉脱维亚语词内片段、URL斜杠和作者姓氏片段，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 口语中的 you
patterns.context: 第二人称代词出现在随意建议或指令中，尤其在 «ensure that» 一类表达后。

patterns.name: 句末/引述中的 we
patterns.context: we 作主语，后接动词或系动词；出现在技术说明或评论中。

patterns.name: 引用话语中的 I
patterns.context: 第一人称单数出现在个人经历或口语评论中。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语第一人称表达
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语中“我说/我告诉”的第一人称表达；激活落在分词及周边代词上。

patterns.name: 代码建议中的祈使句
patterns.context: 给出具体修复或注意事项，采用 make sure that 的建议句式。

patterns.name: 技术步骤中的 ensure
patterns.context: 要求读者确保某个配置或行为成立，常接 we/you。

patterns.name: 强调认真的话语标记
patterns.context: 要求对方认真看待论点，出现在反问或直接劝告中。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 this
patterns.context: 指代当前问题、做法或技术对象，通常处于解释或评价句中。

patterns.name: 网页/脚本技术词
patterns.context: HTML/JavaScript 技术讨论中出现的代码术语；激活具体落点不完全一致。

patterns.name: URL/版本字符串中的斜杠
patterns.context: 斜杠位于下载 URL 或路径/版本号内部，属于连续的代码或命令文本。

patterns.name: 机构作者地址中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 作者名单中的姓氏被分词切开，周围是姓名及机构所在地。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文作者信息

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语连续正文中的词内子词片段；与英语代词/祈使模式不明显对应。

en.description: Activations cover ensure/instruction wording in code, array length, Octal identifiers, control enabled states, and Neidle in an attribution. The patterns are distributed across code, Q&A, and papers, with no unified trigger condition beyond localized code fragments.

patterns.name: Ensure/make a condition hold
patterns.context: Imperative structures in instructions or explanations, and “ensure/make sure + subject + verb” structures; highlights often fall near the subject you/we or ensure/sure

patterns.name: Length and property access
patterns.context: length as a collection or array property, usually in code before an assignment or loop

patterns.name: Octal identifier segmentation
patterns.context: Octal appears in code identifiers or strings such as StrictOctal or 'Octal', surrounded by strict-mode and escape-handling logic

patterns.name: Enabling a control
patterns.context: Calls setEnabled to update a UI control’s state; true/false indicate enabling or disabling

patterns.name: Fragment in a proper name
patterns.context: Spelling fragment in the name Neidle, appearing in a list of authors and institutional locations

5_816.concept: none
5_816.description: 激活覆盖代码中的确保／指令措辞、数组 length、Octal 标识符、控件启用状态，以及署名中的 Neidle。不同模式分散于代码、问答和论文，除局部代码词片外缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 确保／让条件成立
patterns.trigger: «we»10« can»8« also»3« see»3；«Make»5« sure»6« you»9；«ensure»4« we»10« use»7；«ensure»5« that»9
patterns.context: 指令或说明中的祈使结构，以及“ensure/make sure + 主语 + 动词”结构；高亮常落在主语 you/we 或 ensure、sure 附近

patterns.name: 长度及其属性访问
patterns.context: length 作为集合或数组属性，通常位于赋值或循环前的代码中

patterns.name: Octal 标识符拆分
patterns.context: Octal 出现在 StrictOctal、'Octal' 等代码标识符或字符串中，周围是严格模式与转义处理逻辑

patterns.name: 启用控件
patterns.context: 调用 setEnabled 更新界面控件状态，true/false 表示启用或禁用

patterns.name: 专名中的词片
patterns.context: 姓名 Neid le 的拼写片段，处于作者及机构地点列表中

en.description: The main pattern is a response to “Make sure (that) you/we…” checking instructions in technical Q&A and code discussions. Other patterns include correctness and feasibility wording such as correct/possible, as well as sporadic serious/seriously and wish it were a patterns in HN.

patterns.name: “Make sure” instruction
patterns.context: In an answer or technical explanation, introduces a check, precaution, or confirmation with “Make sure (that) you/we…”; especially when followed by you/we. This fixed phrase occurs across different sentence forms.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Github technical discussions

patterns.name: Emphasizing seriousness
patterns.context: The imperative “Please, be serious” urges the other person to take the issue seriously.

patterns.name: Emphasis about a wish or proportion
patterns.context: Expresses a wish that a situation occur more often or account for a larger share; activation is concentrated on it were a after wish.

patterns.name: Certainty/feasibility wording
patterns.context: Asks whether an operation is correct, or asserts in a code discussion that something is feasible; differs from the “Make sure” construction.

patterns.name: serious as an intensifier
patterns.context: Modifies a question about whether an action will occur (“Twitter seriously going to…”); related to, but syntactically different from, the imperative “be serious.”

5_816.concept: 确认与强调措辞
5_816.description: 主模式是在技术问答与代码讨论中对“Make sure (that) you/we…”检查指令的响应。另有correct/possible等正确性与可行性措辞，以及HN中serious/seriously和wish it were a等零散模式。

patterns.name: “Make sure”指令句
patterns.context: 在回答或技术说明中，以“Make sure (that) you/we…”引出检查、避免或确认某事；尤其该短语后接 you/we。该固定搭配跨多个句式出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 技术讨论

patterns.name: 强调严肃认真
patterns.context: 祈使句“Please, be serious”，带有催促对方认真对待问题的语气。

patterns.name: 对愿望或比例的强调
patterns.context: 表达希望某种情况更常见或占比更高；激活集中在 wish 后的 it were a。

patterns.name: 确定性／可行性措辞
patterns.context: 在提问中询问操作是否正确，或在代码讨论中断言某事可行；与“Make sure”搭配不同。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、Github 代码讨论

patterns.name: 强调程度的 serious
patterns.context: 修饰对某项行为是否会发生的质疑（“Twitter seriously going to…”）；与祈使语气“be serious”相邻但句法不同。

en.description: Activations are distributed across common words, imperative advice, and code punctuation; they also favor length, technical-discussion vocabulary, and path identifiers in code. The examples show no single stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Common words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in different syntactic positions; sometimes in imperatives or advice (such as “Make sure you…”), sometimes in ordinary narration or code.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structure
patterns.context: Occurs near operators, calls, block structures, or assignments in code; activations are distributed across punctuation itself and neighboring tokens.

patterns.name: Length-related code fragments
patterns.context: The variable or property name length appears in code, especially when reading a length or computing based on it.

patterns.name: Reminders, advice, or imperative wording
patterns.context: Offers the reader advice, asks them to check a condition, or calls for action; not every segment uses the same instruction structure.
patterns.domain: Code comments, technical Q&A, and forum comments

patterns.name: Conversational expressions of trust or emphasis
patterns.context: Used in conversational forum text to reinforce personal experience or a claim.

patterns.name: Path and generated-code identifiers
patterns.context: Segmented identifiers and delimiters occur in long package paths, file paths, or generated-code names.

patterns.name: HTML document declaration
patterns.context: Discusses a missing document type declaration on the first line of an HTML page and recommends adding one.

patterns.name: File copying and connection state
patterns.context: Asks about possible reasons a file remains in use or a connection stays open after copying a file.

patterns.name: Transactions and technical position
patterns.context: Discusses database transaction support and the view that transaction logic should be placed in the application layer.

patterns.name: Technical-topic fragments
patterns.context: Forum discussion of formal verification, parallel computing, and distributed systems; there is no clear shared semantic trigger condition with the other activation fragments.

patterns.name: Localized vocabulary in natural-language narration
patterns.context: Appears separately in a work-history narrative and a recollective comment, and cannot be reduced to a stable topic or syntactic condition.

5_816.concept: 常见 token 与代码片段
5_816.description: 激活分散在常见词、祈使建议及代码标点中；也偏向代码里的 length、技术讨论词汇与路径标识符。各例未显示单一稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 常见词与短语片段
patterns.context: 触发词出现在不同句法位置；有时是祈使句或建议（如“Make sure you…”），有时只是普通叙述或代码。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构
patterns.context: 出现在代码中的运算符、调用、块结构或赋值附近；激活分散在标点本身及其邻近 token。

patterns.name: 长度相关代码片段
patterns.context: 变量或属性名 length 出现在代码中，尤其是读取长度或基于长度计算的表达式。

patterns.name: 提醒、建议或指令式措辞
patterns.context: 对读者提出建议、要求检查条件或采取行动；并非每段都出现相同的指令结构。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、技术问答与论坛评论

patterns.name: 信任或强调性口语表达
patterns.context: 论坛口语中用来加强个人经验或主张。

patterns.name: 路径与生成代码标识符
patterns.context: 长的包路径、文件路径或生成代码名称中出现分段标识符与分隔符。
patterns.domain: Github 生成代码/路径字符串

patterns.name: HTML 文档声明
patterns.context: 讨论网页 HTML 首行缺少文档类型声明，并建议补上。

patterns.name: 文件复制与连接状态
patterns.context: 提问文件复制后仍被占用或连接未关闭的可能原因。

patterns.name: 事务与技术立场
patterns.context: 讨论数据库事务支持及将事务逻辑放到应用层的观点。

patterns.name: 技术主题词片段
patterns.context: 关于形式化验证、并行计算和分布式系统的论坛论述；缺乏与其他激活片段明确相同的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 自然语言叙述中的局部词汇
patterns.context: 分别出现在工作经历叙述和回忆性评论中，不能归结为稳定的主题或句法条件。

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to “Make/make sure you/that…” in technical Q&A suggestions, especially imperative confirmation of conditions. There are also weaker answer labels, numbers/symbols in code paths, and sporadic activations in a personal narrative.

patterns.name: Imperative phrase Make sure
patterns.context: In an answer or technical suggestion, “Make sure (you/that/it)… ” introduces a check or operation; it is often followed immediately by you and may include an emphatic element.

patterns.name: Local collocation sure you
patterns.context: Occurs in an imperative or suggestive sentence asking the reader to confirm a condition; overlaps with the fixed-phrase pattern above, but activation is concentrated on you.

patterns.name: A: at the start of an answer
patterns.context: A StackExchange answer label; it appears only before the answer text, activates weakly, and is absent from some highly activated passages.

patterns.name: Number 12 in code identifiers
patterns.context: Embedded in a username or number string in a GitHub path, with no clear semantic association.

patterns.name: Numbers and letter fragments in proto paths
patterns.context: Appears in escaped directory names or path fragments in strings related to generated code.

patterns.name: Square brackets in code
patterns.context: Appears at the start of an Objective-C message expression; only one instance, with no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: First-person and future expressions in a Hacker News narrative
patterns.context: A personal account of plans for a future job after leaving one; it does not contain the Make sure phrase.

5_816.concept: 技术建议中的 Make sure
5_816.description: 主要在技术问答建议语中对“Make/make sure you/that…”强烈响应，尤其是指令式确认条件。另有较弱的答案标签、代码路径数字/符号及一段个人叙述中的零散激活。

patterns.name: Make sure 祈使短语
patterns.context: 在回答或技术建议中，以“Make sure (you/that/it)… ”引出检查或操作；常紧接 you，并可能带强调成分。

patterns.name: sure you 的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: «sure»« you»，尤其 «you» 后接 don’t、have 或 are
patterns.context: 处于指令性或建议性句子中，要求读者确认某条件；与上面的固定短语模式重叠，但激活集中在 you。

patterns.name: 答案开头 A:
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答标签；只在回答正文前出现，激活较弱，且不见于所有高激活段。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的数字 12
patterns.context: 嵌在 GitHub 路径的用户名或数字串中，缺少明显语义关联。

patterns.name: proto 路径中的数字与字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在生成代码相关路径字符串的转义目录名或路径片段中。

patterns.name: 代码中的方括号
patterns.context: 出现在 Objective-C 代码的消息表达式开头；仅此一例，未显示与主模式的明确联系。

patterns.name: Hacker News 叙述中的第一人称与未来表达
patterns.context: 个人叙述离职后对未来职位的打算；没有 Make sure 短语。

en.concept: Ensuring and collaboration prompts in technical contexts
en.description: Primarily responds to “Make sure you/we” instructions to check or ensure something in technical contexts; also includes the collaborative expression “we can,” hope it helps in code comments, and ensure we.

patterns.name: “Make sure” instruction
patterns.context: Suggests checking or ensuring something in an answer, explanation, or code comment; high activation often falls on you/we.

patterns.name: “we can” collaborative expression
patterns.context: Introduces an ability, possibility, or test with we can; activation is distributed across we, can, and nearby words.

patterns.name: “hope it helps” in a programming example
patterns.context: A comment in a code example expresses hope that the example helps explain something; activation is concentrated on it.

patterns.name: Isolated ensure comment
patterns.context: A code comment says to ensure that the proxy uses the canonical host; no make sure construction appears.

5_816.concept: 技术语境中的确保与协作提示
5_816.description: 主要响应技术语境中提出检查或确保事项的“Make sure you/we”指令；另见“we can”的协作表达、代码注释中的 hope it helps，以及 ensure we。

patterns.name: “Make sure”指令
patterns.context: 在回答、解释或代码注释中提出检查、确保某事的建议；高激活常落在 you/we 上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答及 Github 注释

patterns.name: “we can”协作表述
patterns.context: 以 we can 引出能力、可能性或测试；激活分布在 we、can 及邻近词。

patterns.name: 编程示例中的“hope it helps”
patterns.context: 代码示例中的注释，表达示例有助于解释；激活集中在 it。

patterns.name: 孤立的 ensure 注释
patterns.context: 代码注释中说明要确保代理使用规范主机；未出现 make sure 句式。

en.description: Activations often occur on it/we/you and following clauses in expressions of hope, advice, or assurance; code identifier fragments and imperative comments also trigger, along with an internal fragment of Octal. The examples reflect both English function words and code contexts.

patterns.name: should you/we infinitive construction
patterns.context: Often occurs near subjects such as it/we/you in contexts expressing willingness, hope, advice, assurance, or trust; strong trigger tokens are often in the following clause or pronouns such as it, we, you, were.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, email, and natural language in code comments/documentation

patterns.name: Fragments within code identifiers
patterns.context: Activation occurs near common lexical fragments or identifier boundaries in mixed-case, hyphenated, or dot-separated identifiers; contexts are typically code, package names, or configuration data.
patterns.domain: Github source code, JSON, StackExchange code examples

patterns.name: Instructional tone in code comments
patterns.context: Comments or technical explanations state conditions, operational requirements, or validation steps; often co-occurs with we/you, sure, use, load, and similar terms.

patterns.name: Localized Octal fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the StrictOctal identifier and code explanations about strict mode and octal bits; activation is concentrated in a subword fragment within the word.

5_816.concept: 不定式/指令语境中的功能词
5_816.description: 激活常见于希望、建议、保证等表达中的 it/we/you 及后续从句；代码标识符片段和指令式注释也会触发，另有 Octal 词内片段。各例受英文功能词及代码语境共同影响。

patterns.name: should you/we 不定式结构
patterns.trigger: [1] “wish it «were» a larger percentage”；[2] “i «hope» it helps”；[5] “I «hope» it gets there”；[7] “thing you can «do» to improve”；[8] “ensure «we» use”；[9] “Make sure «we» can also see”；[10] “trust me”
patterns.context: 在表达意愿、希望、建议、保证或信任的语境中，较常见于 it/we/you 等主语附近；强触发 token 多是后续从句或指代词，如 it、we、you、were。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、邮件及代码注释/文档中的自然语言

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 大小写混合、连字符或点号分隔的标识符中，激活落在常见词法片段或标识符边界附近；上下文通常是代码、包名或配置数据。
patterns.domain: Github 源码、JSON、StackExchange 代码示例

patterns.name: 代码注释中的指令语气
patterns.trigger: [4] “If not in strict mode”；[6] “As always, before byte-compiling… be sure you load”；[8] “ensure we use”；[9] “Make sure we can”
patterns.context: 注释或技术说明中提出条件、操作要求或验证步骤；常与 we/you、sure、use、load 等搭配。

patterns.name: 局部词片段 Octal
patterns.context: 处在 StrictOctal 标识符及关于 strict mode、octal bit 的代码说明中；激活集中于词内子词片段。

en.concept: Personal pronouns and common discourse frames
en.description: Activations often fall on personal pronouns such as you/we/I/me, especially in instructions like make sure you/we and be sure you, and wish expressions such as hope/wish it; there are also a few isolated code identifiers, version numbers, and trust me examples.

patterns.name: make sure we can/you combinations
patterns.context: When confirming or recommending something, the neuron mainly falls on first- or second-person pronouns, often followed by a verb.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, code comments, and Q&A

patterns.name: it in expressions of hope
patterns.context: Expresses hope that something will happen, succeed, or improve; it refers to an event or thing mentioned earlier.

patterns.name: Localized activation at pronoun positions
patterns.context: A pronoun occurs in a sentence, often introducing advice, ability, experience, or personal attitude; make sure or hope need not appear.

patterns.name: HTML attributes and search-focus handling
patterns.context: Event handling and focus state for a webpage search input; activations are distributed across attribute names and focus-related identifiers.

patterns.name: Price interface and explanatory comment
patterns.context: Uses a currency example to explain an interface or code; hope/it in a comment co-occurs with the remaining code.

patterns.name: HN expression of a wish
patterns.context: A commenter wishes that a type of content made up a larger share; similar to hope sentences in other segments, but does not use hope it.

patterns.name: JSON dependency version identifier
patterns.context: A dependency package version string in a JSON configuration; activation is concentrated near the version-number symbols.

patterns.name: Ensuring and negation in technical instructions
patterns.context: Recommends improving shadow precision by avoiding an excessively small near plane; “sure you” resembles a common confirmation phrase but includes a negative condition.

patterns.name: Lisp instruction before building
patterns.context: Explains that the source file defining a macro must be loaded before compilation; sure you continues the instructional use.

patterns.name: Address and email hope
patterns.context: After mailing a card, expresses hope that the mail will arrive; it refers to the card and also appears with a result complement after get.

patterns.name: Documentation change recommendation
patterns.context: Recommends recording a change in index.php, followed by a degree modifier such as well.

patterns.name: Personal expression of trust
patterns.context: After describing a departure from a job, uses me to emphasize personal experience or offer assurance; distinct from the technical-instruction pattern.

5_816.concept: 人称代词及其常见话语框架
5_816.description: 激活常落在 you/we/I/me 等人称代词，尤见 make sure you/we、be sure you 等指令，以及 hope/wish it 等愿望表达；另有少量代码标识符、版本号及 trust me 等孤例。

patterns.name: make sure we can/you 组合
patterns.context: 确认或建议某事时，神经元主要落在第一人称或第二人称代词上；后面常接动词。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、代码注释与问答

patterns.name: 希望句中的 it
patterns.context: 表达希望某事发生、成功或有所改善，it 指代前文事件或事物。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、邮件、代码注释

patterns.name: 代词位置的局部激活
patterns.context: 代词处于句中，常引出建议、能力、经历或个人态度；不一定有 make sure 或 hope。

patterns.name: HTML 属性与搜索焦点处理
patterns.context: 网页搜索输入框的事件处理及焦点状态；激活分布在属性名和焦点相关标识符。

patterns.name: 价格接口与解释性注释
patterns.context: 用货币单位示例说明接口或代码；注释中的 hope/it 与其余代码同现。

patterns.name: HN 愿望表达
patterns.context: 评论者希望某类内容占比更大；与其他段的希望句相似，但措辞并非 hope it。

patterns.name: JSON 依赖版本标识
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 配置中的依赖包版本字符串，激活集中于版本号符号附近。

patterns.name: 技术指令中的确保与否定
patterns.context: 建议通过避免过小 near plane 改善阴影精度；“sure you”与常见确认句相似，但含否定条件。

patterns.name: Lisp 构建前指令
patterns.context: 说明编译前需加载定义宏的源文件；sure you 延续指令性用法。

patterns.name: 地址与邮件希望
patterns.context: 寄卡片后希望邮件送达，it 指代卡片；同时出现 get 的结果补语。

patterns.name: 文档变更建议
patterns.context: 建议在 index.php 中记录变更，后接 well 等程度修饰。

patterns.name: 个人信任表达
patterns.context: 叙述离职经历后以 me 强调个人经验或保证；与技术指令模式不同。

en.description: The most prominent pattern is “make sure you/your…” and variants in suggestion or imperative contexts, often asking the reader to verify a technical condition; other activations include sporadic forum formulas, expressions of desire, explanatory phrases, and code event handlers, with several activations on ordinary function words or code markers.

patterns.name: make sure you construction
patterns.context: In an imperative or suggestive sentence, asks the other person or oneself to confirm something; “sure” and the following personal pronoun, auxiliary, or verb often occur consecutively.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, code review, forum advice

patterns.name: sure followed by a person and auxiliary
patterns.context: Confirms a condition, configuration, or resource state, often for troubleshooting or prevention.
patterns.domain: Game development, programming Q&A, technical advice

patterns.name: trust me in a narrative
patterns.context: In a first-person forum narrative, trust me introduces personal experience or assurance.

patterns.name: wish it were
patterns.context: Expresses dissatisfaction with the current situation or a wish; were introduces a counterfactual expectation.

patterns.name: it helps explanation
patterns.context: After a code example or explanatory comment, it helps explains the purpose of the content.

patterns.name: UI search event handler
patterns.context: Focus and blur event handlers in HTML attributes, each passed a Boolean value.

patterns.name: making in technical terminology
patterns.context: When describing technical features such as formal verification, making introduces a result or effect.

patterns.name: Other local colloquial or suggestive expressions
patterns.context: Common colloquial collocations or suggestions occur in forum text; these do not fully match the main make sure pattern.

patterns.name: Common function words and ordinary code markers
patterns.context: Appear in code, technical explanations, and forum prose; the local collocations differ across examples, so no single trigger pattern can be established.

5_816.concept: 确认条件的建议表达
5_816.description: 最突出模式是建议或祈使语境中的“make sure you/your…”及其变体，常要求核验技术条件；另有零散论坛套语、愿望表达、说明性短语和代码事件处理器，若干激活落在普通功能词或代码标记上。

patterns.name: make sure you 句式
patterns.trigger: “make sure you”及变体“Make sure we”“make sure i”
patterns.context: 祈使或建议语句中，要求对方或自己确认某事；“sure”与后续人称代词、助动词或动词常连续出现。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、代码评审、论坛建议

patterns.name: sure 后接人称及助动词
patterns.trigger: “make sure i have”“make sure you don’t have”“make sure your … are”
patterns.context: 确认某个条件、配置或资源状态，常用于排错或避免问题。
patterns.domain: 游戏开发、编程问答、技术建议

patterns.name: 叙事中的 trust me
patterns.context: 第一人称论坛叙述中，以 trust me 引出个人经验或保证。

patterns.name: wish it were
patterns.context: 表达对现状的不满或愿望，were 引出反事实期望。

patterns.name: it helps 说明
patterns.context: 代码示例或解释性注释之后，以 it helps 说明内容用途。

patterns.name: UI 搜索事件处理器
patterns.context: HTML 属性中的焦点、失焦事件处理器，分别传入布尔值。

patterns.name: 技术术语中的 making
patterns.context: 描述形式化验证等技术特性时，making 引出结果或效果。

patterns.name: 其他局部口语或建议表达
patterns.trigger: “the simplest thing you can do”“need to run”“make 4 months of work”
patterns.context: 论坛文字中出现常见口语搭配或建议表达；与主要 make sure 模式不完全一致。

patterns.name: 常见功能词和普通代码标记
patterns.context: 在代码、技术说明及论坛散文中均出现；各例的局部搭配不同，无法据此确立单一触发模式。

en.concept: Instructions and help expressions in technical contexts
en.description: The most prominent repeated pattern is “make sure you” in advisory contexts, with two instances of “hope it helps” as answer closings. Remaining activations are distributed across wishes, technical wording, and JSON, HTML, code, and path fragments, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: “make sure you” instruction phrase
patterns.context: In advice, operational instructions, or code comments, asks the reader to confirm or perform a follow-up action; the continuation differs across segments.
patterns.domain: Forum answers, technical discussions, code comments

patterns.name: “hope it helps” closing
patterns.context: After a code example or explanation, expresses in the first person the hope that the answer is helpful.

patterns.name: “Hope it helps!” closing
patterns.context: A polite wish at the end of an answer; similar to the previous pattern, but differs in capitalization and sentence form.

patterns.name: Wish and concession expressions
patterns.context: Expresses a wish that a proportion of content were different.

patterns.name: Conversational “thing you can do”
patterns.context: Describes a simple action that can be taken, followed by a solution to a technical problem.

patterns.name: JSON field name and value
patterns.context: Appears in a JSON snippet of package metadata; the field value is a package name with a version number.

patterns.name: Search-box markup and attributes
patterns.context: Near identifiers, a Chinese search prompt, and the accesskey attribute in HTML input code.

patterns.name: “make toggle” phrase and macro explanation
patterns.context: Introduces an Emacs Lisp macro whose name contains a hyphen, and notes that the definition file should be loaded before compilation.

patterns.name: Operators and type names in code
patterns.context: A Swift function declaration and the comment following it; activation words are distributed across code and natural-language explanation.

patterns.name: Bicycle parts and condition description
patterns.context: Discusses whether a new bicycle has been serviced and whether its wheels turn freely or rub.

patterns.name: Paths, filenames, and admin-interface code
patterns.context: After a GitHub file URL and PHP filename, recommends placing the code in index.php.

5_816.concept: 技术语境中的指令与帮助表达
5_816.description: 最突出的重复模式是建议语境中的“make sure you”，另有两处“hope it helps”式回答收尾。其余激活分散于愿望表达、技术措辞及 JSON、HTML、代码、路径等片段，缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: “make sure you”指令短语
patterns.context: 在建议、操作说明或代码注释中，要求读者确认或执行后续事项；不同段落后续内容不同。
patterns.domain: 论坛回答、技术讨论、代码注释

patterns.name: “hope it helps”结尾
patterns.context: 代码示例或解释之后，以第一人称表达希望答案有帮助。

patterns.name: “Hope it helps!”结尾
patterns.context: 回答末尾的礼貌祝愿；与上一模式近似，但大小写和句式不同。

patterns.name: 愿望与让步表达
patterns.context: 谈论内容比例时表达希望某种情况有所不同。

patterns.name: 口语化“thing you can do”
patterns.context: 说明可采取的简单做法，后接技术问题的处理建议。

patterns.name: JSON 字段名与数值
patterns.context: 出现在 package 元数据的 JSON 片段中，字段值为带版本号的包名。

patterns.name: 搜索框标记与属性
patterns.context: HTML 输入框代码中，标识符、中文搜索提示和 accesskey 属性附近。

patterns.name: 短语“make toggle”及宏说明
patterns.context: 介绍 Emacs Lisp 中一个命名含连字符的宏，并提示编译前加载定义文件。

patterns.name: 代码中的运算符与类型名
patterns.context: Swift 函数声明及其后的注释；激活词分散在代码和自然语言说明中。

patterns.name: 自行车部件与状态描述
patterns.context: 讨论新自行车是否经过保养，以及车轮是否能自由转动或摩擦。

patterns.name: 路径、文件名与管理界面代码
patterns.context: GitHub 文件 URL 和 PHP 文件名之后，给出把代码放入 index.php 的建议。

en.concept: Assurance and expectation expressions in English
en.description: The most stable cue is an operational assurance sentence with sure/be sure followed by you/we; other local expressions include hope it…, wish it were, and it doesn’t…. Remaining activations are scattered across code, comments, HTML attributes, and URL boundaries, making them difficult to group into the same semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “sure you …” confirmation/suggestion expression
patterns.context: In technical explanations or operational suggestions, you/we after sure/be sure introduces an action that needs to be confirmed, performed, or ensured; high activation falls on you/we.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, code review, and tutorials

patterns.name: First-person explanation in code comments
patterns.context: A comment uses the first person to express hope that an example or explanation is helpful; activation is concentrated on hope.

patterns.name: “wish it were” expression of desire
patterns.context: An editorial comment expresses a wish about a proportion or current situation; activation falls on it/were.

patterns.name: Expectation of delivery
patterns.context: An email discusses a sent card and expresses hope that the email or item will arrive; activation is concentrated on it, with gets/there also activating strongly afterward.

patterns.name: “it … doesn’t” explanation of an outcome or object
patterns.context: In a technical bug report, it refers to .NET or a system and describes its inability to resolve an object; activation falls on it.

patterns.name: Quote boundaries in HTML attributes/event handlers
patterns.context: In an HTML tag, an attribute value encloses a JavaScript event handler in quotation marks; multiple boundaries and identifier fragments are marked.

patterns.name: Specific word segments in code identifiers
patterns.context: A code example contains price-related fields and explanatory comments; the only prominent activation so far falls on hope in the comment.

patterns.name: GitHub URL path fragments
patterns.context: A repository file link is pasted directly into an answer; activation is scattered across the domain and path components.

patterns.name: Code prefixes and lexical boundaries
patterns.context: Swift-style code is embedded in a discussion of compatibility and lookup logic; activation is concentrated on we and assurance sentences, while the code itself activates sporadically.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on technical terms and ordinary words
patterns.context: These passages contain local markers, but beyond the explicitly listed sentence/format patterns, no shared and stable trigger condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Graphics, computer discussions, Lisp, Python/MongoDB, and .NET Q&A

5_816.concept: 英语中的保证与期望表达
5_816.description: 最稳定的线索是 sure/be sure 后接 you/we 的操作保证句；另有 hope it…、wish it were、it doesn’t…等以 it/hope/wish 构成的局部表达。其他激活分散在代码、注释、HTML属性和URL边界中，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: “sure you …”确认/建议表达
patterns.trigger: “sure”后接“you”并继续说明应执行的操作，如 “make sure you don't” / “Make sure we can” / “be sure you load” / “make sure you document”
patterns.context: 技术说明或操作建议中，sure/be sure 后的 you/we 引出需要确认、执行或保证的动作；高激活落在 you/we 上。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、代码评审与教程

patterns.name: 代码注释中的第一人称解释
patterns.context: 注释以第一人称表达希望示例或说明有帮助，激活集中在 hope。

patterns.name: “wish it were”愿望表达
patterns.context: 编辑评论中表达对某种情况比例或现状的愿望；激活在 it/were。

patterns.name: 送达结果的期望表达
patterns.context: 邮件正文谈及寄出的卡片，表达希望邮件或物件送达；激活集中在 it，后续 gets/there 也较强。

patterns.name: “it … doesn’t”对结果或对象的说明
patterns.trigger: “it doesn’t know how to resolve it”
patterns.context: 技术故障说明中，it 指代 .NET 或系统，描述其无法解析对象；激活在 it。

patterns.name: HTML 属性/事件处理器中的引号边界
patterns.context: HTML 标签内，属性值以引号包围 JavaScript 事件处理器；多个边界及标识符片段被标记。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的特定词段
patterns.trigger: “gold”“copper”“helps”等代码/注释词段；尤其注释中的“i hope it helps explain”
patterns.context: 代码示例包含价格类字段及解释性注释；目前唯一突出的激活落在注释的 hope。

patterns.name: GitHub URL路径片段
patterns.context: 回答中直接粘贴仓库文件链接，激活分散在域名和路径组件。

patterns.name: 代码前缀与词法边界
patterns.trigger: `prefix func >>> (rhs: Double) {}` 附近的括号、参数名及类型；另有 “unambiguous”
patterns.context: 讨论兼容性和查找逻辑时嵌入 Swift 风格代码，激活集中在 we 与保证句，代码本身呈零散激活。

patterns.name: 技术术语及普通词的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些段落中存在局部标记，但除明确列出的语句/格式模式外，未见共同且稳定的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 图形学、计算机讨论、Lisp、Python/MongoDB及.NET问答

en.description: The most consistent response is to patent-field boilerplate, especially “methods” introducing methods, and also frameworks such as “This/present invention relates to … and/for.” There are also sporadic activations on legal citation numbers, a split Italian title, and “methods” in research projects.

patterns.name: “methods” in patent field-of-invention boilerplate
patterns.context: Appears in “invention relates to … methods” or similar structures, often coordinated with “apparatus,” “systems,” “and,” or “for”; may also occur in longer patent-abstract-style passages.

patterns.name: Relational and coordinating words in patent boilerplate
patterns.context: Fixed legal-technical phrasing around the subject of an invention, especially when introducing methods, systems, or devices to which the invention relates; weaker than “methods,” but repeated across passages.

patterns.name: Numbers and paragraph markers in legal citations
patterns.context: Numbered citations or case-number fragments in legal text, immediately followed by a line break and “UNITED”; no clear shared context with patent boilerplate.

patterns.name: An Italian title split into tokens
patterns.context: A title or phrase is split into irregular subwords, forming spelling fragments; identifiable as text such as “ITALO TESTA SKEPTISCHE …,” though the cause of activation is uncertain.

patterns.name: Methods terminology in research projects
patterns.context: “Methods” appears alongside research techniques in descriptions such as “project uses … methods to study …”; lacks patent-style invention boilerplate.

5_1000.description: 最一致的反应是专利发明领域套语，尤其是引出方法的 methods，并兼及 This/present invention relates to … and/for 等框架。另对法律引文数字、拆分的意大利语标题和科研项目中的 methods 有零星激活。

patterns.name: 专利发明领域套语中的 methods
patterns.context: 出现在“invention relates to … methods”或近似结构中，常与 apparatus、systems、and、for 并列；也可能出现在更长的专利摘要式表述中。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/发明领域描述

patterns.name: 专利套语中的关系与并列词
patterns.context: 围绕发明主题的固定法律技术写法，尤其是引出发明涉及的方法、系统或设备时；激活强度低于 methods，但在多段中重复出现。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术描述

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与段落标记
patterns.context: 法律文本中的数字化引文或案号片段，紧接换行和“UNITED”；与专利套语无明显共同上下文。

patterns.name: 被分词拆开的意大利语标题
patterns.context: 标题或短语被切成不规则子词，形成拼写片段；可辨认为“ITALO TESTA SKEPTISCHE …”一类文本，但激活成因不确定。

patterns.name: 科研项目中的方法用语
patterns.context: “项目 uses … methods to study …”科研项目描述中，methods 与研究手段并列出现；缺少专利式发明套语。

en.concept: Functional descriptions of methods and apparatus
en.description: Primarily responds to patent boilerplate defining invention scope with “methods” alongside systems and apparatus, followed by a use introduced by for; also covers specific patent topics such as image correction, measurement, and tissue anchoring. There are also sporadic activations in scientific methods, legal citations, and uppercase token fragments.

patterns.name: Patent-style statement of invention scope
patterns.context: Methods, systems, or apparatus are followed by for to introduce a use or function; common in background or field-of-invention sections.

patterns.name: The word methods itself
patterns.context: In lists of methods alongside systems, apparatus, or other items; paragraph 9 also uses it in a research-methods context.

patterns.name: Image-correction description of an invention
patterns.context: Describes technology for correcting images; specific technical content beyond patent-style methods/apparatus wording.

patterns.name: Measurement apparatus and methods
patterns.context: Methods and apparatus are used to measure object dimensions.

patterns.name: Anchoring within tissue
patterns.context: Apparatus and methods are used to position and secure anchors within tissue or tissue folds.

patterns.name: Numbering and legal citation format
patterns.context: Court case citation numbers with line breaks; no clear connection to patent method wording.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in Italian text
patterns.context: Uppercase text is split into unusual subword fragments, possibly from a name or title; no clear methods or patent semantics.

patterns.name: Research methods in a scientific project
patterns.context: Methods are used to study a new model of status epilepticus, rather than describing a patented invention’s use.

5_1000.concept: 方法与装置的功能描述
5_1000.description: 主要响应专利文本中“methods”及其与 systems、apparatus 并列、再由 for 引出用途的发明范围套语；还覆盖图像校正、测量、组织锚固等具体专利主题。另有科研方法、法律引文和大写分词片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: 专利式发明范围表述
patterns.trigger: “methods”及“systems / apparatus”与“for”连用；“This invention relates…”或“The present invention relates…”
patterns.context: 方法、系统或装置由 for 引出用途或功能；多见于发明背景或领域段落。

patterns.name: 方法一词本身
patterns.context: 在方法与系统、装置或其他对象的并列列表中；段 9 也在研究方法语境中出现。

patterns.name: 发明主题的图像校正描述
patterns.trigger: “image processing technologies”“image correcting apparatuses, methods and programs”
patterns.context: 描述对图像进行校正的技术；非专利式方法/装置措辞之外的具体技术内容。

patterns.name: 测量装置与方法
patterns.context: 方法和装置用于测量物体尺寸。

patterns.name: 组织内锚固
patterns.context: 装置与方法用于在组织或组织褶皱内定位、固定锚。

patterns.name: 编号与法律引文格式
patterns.context: 带换行的法院判例引文编号；与专利方法表述无明显联系。

patterns.name: 意大利语文本的分词片段
patterns.context: 大写文本被拆成异常的子词片段，可能来自姓名或标题；无明显方法/专利语义。

patterns.name: 科研项目中的研究方法
patterns.context: 方法用于研究癫痫持续状态的新模型，而非专利发明用途描述。

en.description: The most stable pattern is strong activation on “methods” in USPTO invention-introduction templates; other isolated high-activation words occur in NIH research methods, legal citations, segmented Italian text, and chemical abstracts.

patterns.name: “methods” in a patent abstract template
patterns.context: Introduces methods related to an invention and their uses in a patent background or invention description; even when adjacent words vary, activation centers on “methods” in this template

patterns.name: Research methods in a project
patterns.context: Describes methods used to conduct research; preceded by “electrophysiological and biochemical methods” and followed by “to study”

patterns.name: Legal citation with numbers and line breaks
patterns.context: Case citations or reporter volume and page numbers in legal text, appearing as combinations of numbers and abbreviations

patterns.name: Character-segmented Italian phrase
patterns.context: Characters are split into multiple tokens; the phrase’s meaning and its connection to other high-activation patterns are difficult to determine from the fragments alone

patterns.name: unusual in a chemical rearrangement description
patterns.context: Describes the chemical rearrangement of a substituted cage structure; activation falls on the latter part of the split word unusual

5_1000.description: 最稳定的模式是在 USPTO 发明介绍模板中对“methods”强激活；另见 NIH 研究方法，以及法律引文、分段意大利语文本和化学摘要中各自孤立的高激活词。

patterns.name: 专利摘要模板中的“methods”
patterns.trigger: “methods”10；常与“This invention relates to”或“The present invention relates to”及“and systems/apparatus”同现
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明描述中，介绍发明涉及的方法及其用途；即使紧邻“methods”的其他词变化，触发仍集中在该模板中的“methods”

patterns.name: 研究项目中的研究方法
patterns.context: 说明项目使用某类方法开展研究，前有“electrophysiological and biochemical methods”，后接“to study”

patterns.name: 带数字和换行的法律引文
patterns.context: 法律文本中的案件引文或报告卷页编号，数字与缩写组合出现

patterns.name: 字符分段的意大利语短语
patterns.trigger: “A”9（位于分段串“ITALO TESTA SKEPTISCHE ANTIN”中）
patterns.context: 字符被切分成多个 token；仅凭片段难以确定短语含义或与其他高激活模式的联系

patterns.name: 化学重排描述中的 unusual
patterns.context: 描述取代笼状结构的化学重排；激活落在被拆分的 unusual 后半部分

en.concept: Document titles and patent method descriptions
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on “methods” and related invention descriptions in patent overviews; there are also responses to legal citations, “Unusual” at the start of abstracts, and event titles beginning with “2015.”

patterns.name: Patent method/device abstract phrasing
patterns.context: Describes methods, systems, or devices to which an invention relates in patent backgrounds or invention overviews; “methods” is especially prominent.

patterns.name: Image correction methods in patents
patterns.context: Introduces image-processing techniques, especially image correction devices, methods, and programs.

patterns.name: Legal case-number/citation format
patterns.context: Case citations or case-number formats at the beginning of legal text, followed by a line break and “UNITED.”

patterns.name: Abstracts beginning with “Unusual”
patterns.context: An abstract or title begins with “Unusual”; the two examples concern chemical rearrangement and vascular developmental anomalies, with unrelated topics.

patterns.name: Titles with the year 2015
patterns.context: An event name or entry title beginning with a year, followed by a line break.

5_1000.concept: 文档标题与专利方法表述
5_1000.description: 激活主要集中于专利概述中的“methods”及相关发明描述；另对法律引文、摘要开头的“Unusual”和以“2015”起始的赛事标题也有响应。

patterns.name: 专利方法/装置摘要句式
patterns.trigger: “methods”在[2]–[5]中激活为10；常见框架为“This invention relates to … methods … for”
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明概述中，描述发明涉及的方法、系统或装置；其中“methods”尤为突出。

patterns.name: 专利中的图像校正方法
patterns.context: 介绍图像处理技术，尤其是图像校正装置、方法和程序。

patterns.name: 法律案号/引文格式
patterns.trigger: “648 F.2d 5, 498”一类编号与报告集缩写
patterns.context: 法律文本开头的判例引文或案号格式，后接换行和“UNITED”。

patterns.name: Unusual 开头的摘要词
patterns.context: 摘要或标题以“Unusual”开头；两例分别谈化学重排和血管发育异常，主题并不相同。

patterns.name: 年份 2015 的标题
patterns.context: 以年份开头的赛事名称或条目标题，后续出现换行。

en.description: Activation occurs in titles, entry openings, and fixed patent introductory phrases. Examples include event years and names, place names, personal names and citation formats, as well as biomedical, materials chemistry, and chemical reaction terms; it also responds to the patent topic word methods.

patterns.name: Year and event name
patterns.context: A year appears in an event title, entry title, or repeated text following the title

patterns.name: Legal citation numbers
patterns.context: Case citations composed of numbers and letters, followed by a line break and court or case text

patterns.name: Biomedical terms in titles
patterns.context: Antibodies, lipids, and disease names in medical research titles

patterns.name: Materials chemistry titles
patterns.context: Titles describing doped materials and their photocatalytic properties

patterns.name: Place names and repeated entry titles
patterns.context: A place name is repeated at the beginning of an entry, followed by a line break

patterns.name: Personal names and place abbreviations
patterns.context: An all-uppercase personal or place name is followed by a state abbreviation, parentheses, and subsequent annotation

patterns.name: Invention topics in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph introduces a methods, apparatus, or systems topic using a fixed phrase; topics include inserting angle brackets and extracting text from documents

patterns.name: Chemical reaction terms in titles
patterns.context: An abstract title describes the rearrangement reaction of a substituted cage compound

5_1000.description: 激活分布于标题、条目开头及专利固定引介句：包括赛事年份和名称、地名、人名与引证格式，以及生物医学、材料化学和化学反应术语；另对专利主题词 methods 有反应。

patterns.name: 年份与赛事名称
patterns.context: 年份出现在赛事标题、条目标题或标题后的重复文本中

patterns.name: 法律引证编号
patterns.context: 数字和字母组成的判例引证，后接换行及法院或案件正文

patterns.name: 生物医学术语标题
patterns.trigger: «IgA antibody to lipid A»；«alcoholic liver disease»
patterns.context: 医学研究标题中的抗体、脂质及疾病名称

patterns.name: 材料化学标题
patterns.context: 标题中描述掺杂材料及其光催化性质

patterns.name: 地名及重复条目标题
patterns.context: 地名在条目开头重复出现，且标题后有换行

patterns.name: 人名与地点缩写
patterns.context: 全大写姓名或地名后接州名缩写、括号及后续标注

patterns.name: 专利背景中的发明主题
patterns.context: 专利背景段落以固定句式引出方法、装置或系统主题；主题分别为插入角板、从文档提取文本

patterns.name: 化学反应标题术语
patterns.context: 摘要标题描述取代笼状化合物的重排反应

en.description: Primarily responds to uppercase underscore identifiers, macros, header guards, and file paths in C/C++ source code; also covers cmd naming, device command declarations, debugging code, concurrency comments, and endianness macros. Repeated Wikipedia place-name fragments are unexplained by these patterns.

patterns.name: C/C++ identifiers, macros, and segmented uppercase names
patterns.context: In C/C++ source code, especially macros, constants, header guards, and command names; activation often falls on identifier fragments and underscores.

patterns.name: File paths and extensions
patterns.context: Near path separators, periods, and header-file extensions in filenames, header paths, or glob patterns.

patterns.name: Command identifiers and their explanatory text
patterns.context: In functions, command macros, or debugging text, “cmd” is part of a command-related name; local triggers also involve explanatory comments for device commands.

patterns.name: Header guard structure
patterns.context: Conditional-compilation guard blocks at the beginning of headers; activation is distributed across preprocessor directives and guard identifiers.

patterns.name: Repeated proper-name text
patterns.context: The proper name “Parque Palermo” is repeated on adjacent lines, with activation concentrated on fragments of the place name.

patterns.name: Integer declarations and debugging calls
patterns.context: Local variables, debugging macro calls, and their string arguments inside function bodies.

patterns.name: Concurrency and semaphore descriptions
patterns.context: A comment explains a counting semaphore shared by competing threads; activation falls on concurrency terminology and words related to “thread.”

patterns.name: Device command function declarations
patterns.context: Consecutive declarations of void command methods in a class or struct interface.

patterns.name: Endianness macro and argument expression
patterns.context: A macro call that converts data to little-endian byte order, including constants and pointer-offset arguments.

5_1000.description: 主要响应 C/C++ 源码中的大写下划线标识符、宏、头文件保护符及文件路径；也覆盖 cmd 命名、设备命令声明、调试代码、并发注释和字节序宏。Wikipedia 地名重复片段无法由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: C/C++ 标识符宏与分段大写名称
patterns.trigger: 如 «_»«PA»«IR»«_»«T»«_»«CPP»、«_»«CMD»«_»«TI»、«_»«BYTE»；多段 token 共同构成带下划线的大写标识符
patterns.context: 在 C/C++ 源码中，尤其是宏、常量、头文件保护符和命令名；激活常落在标识符片段及下划线上
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 代码

patterns.name: 文件路径与扩展名
patterns.context: 文件名、头文件路径或 glob 模式中，路径分隔符、点号和头文件扩展名附近
patterns.domain: CMake 配置与 C/C++ 头文件

patterns.name: 命令标识符及其说明文字
patterns.trigger: «cmd»«10»，以及 «Init»«iator»« cmd»；同段还出现命令宏与注释 «Init… cmd complete sequence»
patterns.context: 函数、命令宏或调试文本中，cmd 作为命令相关名称的组成部分；局部触发还涉及设备命令的说明注释
patterns.domain: 嵌入式/设备代码与 C 注释

patterns.name: 头文件保护结构
patterns.trigger: «#»«define»，以及 «#»«ifndef» 后的保护符片段，如 «M»«_»«h»、«FIL»«M»«_»«H»
patterns.context: 头文件开头的条件编译保护块；激活分布在预处理指令和保护符标识符

patterns.name: 重复的专名文本
patterns.context: 专名“Parque Palermo”在相邻行重复出现，激活集中于地名各词片段

patterns.name: 整数类型声明及调试调用
patterns.context: 函数体内的局部变量、调试宏调用及其字符串参数

patterns.name: 并发与信号量说明
patterns.context: 注释解释线程竞争共享的计数信号量，激活落在并发术语及 thread 相关词上

patterns.name: 设备命令函数声明
patterns.context: 类或结构体接口中连续列出的 void 命令方法声明
patterns.domain: 设备驱动/硬件接口 C++ 代码

patterns.name: 字节序宏与参数表达式
patterns.context: 把数据转换为小端字节序的宏调用，包含常量和指针偏移参数

en.description: Activations appear in mathematical-paper formulas and symbols, subscripted objects, and technical terms, as well as uppercase underscore identifiers and assignments in code; additional local patterns involve mechanical tension, particle decays, fractal dimension, and the maximum principle.

patterns.name: Noncommutative polynomials and variable notation
patterns.context: Introduces noncommutative variables, polynomials, or related decompositions in mathematical papers; activation is distributed across terms and subscripted mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Subscripted mathematical objects and formula structure
patterns.context: Paper passages containing formulas, subscripted objects, sets, or inequalities; the specific mathematical topics vary.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical science papers, ArXiv

patterns.name: Uppercase underscore macro identifiers
patterns.context: Commands/identifiers composed of uppercase letters, digits, and underscores in C preprocessor macro definitions; activation falls on multiple internal identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Tension notation and mechanics descriptions
patterns.context: A mechanics explanation discussing equal tension at both ends of a rope, an object's acceleration, and the reference direction.

patterns.name: Particle symbols in baryon decays
patterns.context: Lists baryons containing beauty/bottom quarks and their decays; activation covers particle symbols and related terminology.

patterns.name: Build variables and assignments
patterns.context: Uppercase underscore variables related to paths or builds assigned with := in Makefile-style configuration.

patterns.name: Self-similar dimension formula
patterns.context: Discusses the self-similarity of the von Koch curve and gives a logarithmic-ratio formula for boundary dimension.

patterns.name: Theorem statement for the maximum principle
patterns.context: Introduces a proof of the maximum principle on a bounded domain using a named theorem and a cited author.

5_1000.description: 激活出现在数学论文公式及符号、带下标对象、专业术语，也出现在代码中的大写下划线标识符与赋值；另见力学张力、粒子衰变、分形维数和最大值原理等局部模式。

patterns.name: 非交换多项式与变量记号
patterns.context: 数学论文中介绍非交换变量、多项式或相关分解；激活分布在术语及带下标的数学符号上。

patterns.name: 带下标的数学对象与公式结构
patterns.context: 含有数学公式、下标对象、集合或不等式的论文片段；具体数学主题并不相同。

patterns.name: 大写下划线宏标识符
patterns.context: C 预处理器宏定义中由大写字母、数字和下划线组成的命令/标识符，激活落在标识符内部多个片段。

patterns.name: 张力符号与力学表述
patterns.context: 讨论绳索两端张力相同及物体加速度、参考方向的力学解释。

patterns.name: 重子衰变中的粒子符号
patterns.context: 列举含 beauty/bottom 夸克的重子及其衰变，激活涵盖粒子符号和相关术语。

patterns.name: 构建变量与赋值
patterns.context: Makefile 风格配置中，路径或构建相关的大写下划线变量通过 := 赋值。

patterns.name: 自相似维数公式
patterns.context: 论述 von Koch 曲线的自相似性，并给出边界维数的对数比公式。

patterns.name: 最大值原理的定理陈述
patterns.context: 以命名定理及引文作者引出有界区域上的最大值原理证明。

en.description: Primarily responds to the consecutive letters `inc` inside words across code, encyclopedia, and research text; examples include increase, indicates, incipient, incisions, incidences, and incense. There are also court titles and isolated token activations of unclear relation.

patterns.name: `inc` subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the `inc` substring inside words, commonly in forms such as `increase/increased`, `indicates`, `incipient`, `incisions`, and `incidences`; it does not respond only to one complete word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including code and academic articles

patterns.name: Code fields containing `inc`
patterns.context: A code comment describes a readback value for delay status and a case where that value is used to set a parameter.

patterns.name: `inc` in a `incense` entry
patterns.context: `incense` appears in a disambiguation page listing entries beginning with C.

patterns.name: Academic uses of words derived from `inc`
patterns.context: Appears as a consecutive letter fragment inside ordinary words in varied contexts: increased iron stores, indicating evidence, an emerging epidemic, surgical incisions, disease incidence, and so on.

patterns.name: High activation without an evident match
patterns.context: Activation in the passage is concentrated on individually split uppercase tokens in a court name.

patterns.name: Other unexplained activations
patterns.context: Activation falls on local tokens such as `’s` and `prov`; these examples alone do not establish a connection to the main pattern.

5_1000.description: 主要响应单词内部的连续字母 `inc`，跨代码、百科与科研文本出现；对应 increase、indicates、incipient、incisions、incidences、incense 等。另有法院标题及局部 token 激活，关联不明。

patterns.name: `inc` 词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 `inc` 子串上，常见于 `increase/increased`、`indicates`、`incipient`、`incisions`、`incidences` 等不同词形；并非只响应某一个完整单词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，含代码与学术文章

patterns.name: 带 `inc` 的代码字段
patterns.context: 代码注释中描述 delay status 的 readback 值，以及使用该值设置某项参数的场景。

patterns.name: `incense` 条目中的 `inc`
patterns.context: 消歧页面列举以 C 开头的词条时，出现 `incense`。

patterns.name: `inc` 派生词的学术用法
patterns.context: 作为普通词内部的连续字母片段出现，语境各异：铁储量增加、证据指出、疫情初起、手术切口、疾病发生率等。

patterns.name: 无明显对应的高激活
patterns.trigger: 未见清楚的 `inc` 字串或共同词形线索
patterns.context: 该段激活集中在法院名称的逐字拆分大写 token 上。

patterns.name: 其他未解释的激活
patterns.trigger: 未见稳定对应的 `inc` 子串或共同触发条件
patterns.context: 激活分布在 `’s`、`prov` 等局部 token；难以仅凭这些例子确认与主模式有关。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（机器学习、网络科学）

en.description: Responses are distributed across proper names and their subword fragments, legal document titles and formatting, `inc` fragments within words, code identifiers, and bibliographic entries/names; there is no unified semantic trigger, and names and layouts from different domains can all activate.

patterns.name: Proper names and internal name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper names or fragments within them, possibly institutions, people, or works, and may cross subword boundaries; different names show no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Mixed: school names, U.S. military branches, literary works, people, and legal cases

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and titles
patterns.context: In court opinions, case captions, or litigation-related text, activation occurs on document titles, status labels, and procedural terms; often accompanied by all-caps headings, indentation, and divider lines.

patterns.name: The `inc` fragment within words
patterns.context: Appears in different words: «inc»arceration, «inc»/ce, and «inc»estuous; no stable meaning or contextual condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, code comments, film/TV descriptions

patterns.name: School names and their typography
patterns.context: A school name appears in title case, and «Wall» is the strongest trigger fragment in this example.

patterns.name: Military branch name typography
patterns.context: The U.S. Marine Corps name appears as a formal all-caps, line-broken heading; the strongest response is concentrated on NAV.

patterns.name: Bibliographic entries and author names
patterns.context: Work titles, author names, and publishers appear in bibliographic-style entries or literary discussions; activation is concentrated on proper-name fragments, without a consistent bibliographic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Repeated personal name
patterns.context: A name is repeated consecutively in the passage, and the surname is split into multiple subwords; activation mainly falls on surname fragments and nearby line breaks.

patterns.name: Legal personnel and law-firm lists
patterns.context: A list of counsel comprising lawyers, firms, locations, and other names; different name fragments all respond.
patterns.domain: Attorney information in bankruptcy or other legal documents

patterns.name: Judicial officials in a court-opinion heading
patterns.context: A judge's name and title are listed in the closing or signature heading of an opinion, accompanied by status markers such as “Ret.”

patterns.name: Relationship terms in film/TV plot descriptions
patterns.context: When describing a TV plot and character relationships, activation falls inside “incestuous”; the same passage also includes “emotionally abusive relationship.”
patterns.domain: TV plot summaries or entertainment reporting

patterns.name: “incarceration” in a legal narrative
patterns.context: A line-broken “incarceration” appears in an account of a legal case, within a description of trial and detention history.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and comments
patterns.context: Identifiers, slash abbreviations, and delay-status descriptions appear in Python-style code and field documentation; the precise meaning of inc/ce is unclear.

5_1000.description: 响应分散在专名及其子词片段、法律文书标题和格式、inc词内片段、代码标识符与书目/人名等处；没有统一语义触发条件，且不同领域的名称与版式都能激活。

patterns.name: 专名及专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专有名称或其词内片段上，可能是机构、人名、作品名，也可能跨子词边界；多种不同名称之间没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 混合：学校名称、美国军种、文学作品、人物与法律案件

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与标题
patterns.context: 法院意见书、案件抬头或诉讼程序相关文本中，激活于文书标题、身份标签及程序名称；常伴随全大写标题、缩进和分隔线。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 inc
patterns.context: 出现在不同词中：«inc»arceration、«inc»/ce、«inc»estuous；未见稳定的词义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、代码注释、影视描述

patterns.name: 校名及学校名称排版
patterns.context: 学校名称以标题式大小写出现，且该例中 «Wall» 是最强触发片段。

patterns.name: 军种名称排版
patterns.context: 美国海军陆战队名称以全大写、分行的正式抬头形式出现；强响应集中于 NAV。

patterns.name: 书目与作者姓名
patterns.context: 作品名、作者名及出版者出现在书目式条目或文学讨论中；激活集中于专名片段，未形成一致书目触发模式。

patterns.name: 重复出现的人名
patterns.context: 姓名在片段中连续重复，且姓氏被拆成多个子词；激活主要落在姓氏片段及换行附近。

patterns.name: 法律人员与律所名单
patterns.context: 律师、律所、地点等姓名和组织名组成的代理律师名单；不同姓名片段均有响应。
patterns.domain: 破产或其他法律文件中的律师信息

patterns.name: 法院意见抬头中的司法人员
patterns.context: 意见书末尾或署名抬头中列出法官姓名和职衔，伴随“Ret.”等身份标记。

patterns.name: 影视剧情描述中的关系词
patterns.context: 描述电视剧剧情与角色关系时，激活落在“incestuous”一词内部；同段也出现“emotionally abusive relationship”。
patterns.domain: 电视剧情简介或娱乐报道

patterns.name: 法律叙事中的 incarceration
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述中出现跨行断开的“incarceration”，位于审判和拘押经历描述内。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及注释
patterns.context: Python 风格代码与字段说明中出现标识符、斜线缩写及延迟状态描述；inc/ce 的具体指代不明。
patterns.domain: Github 代码及 API 注释

en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word subword segmentation, punctuation and formatting boundaries, figure/literature citations, scientific notation, and proper names; there is little stable semantic or syntactic commonality across corpora, and the feature may mainly reflect local token forms and boundaries.

patterns.name: Suffixes -er / -ers and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented subwords ending in or containing letters such as er/ry; surrounding word meanings and contexts vary widely, and some are within-word fragments caused by BPE subword boundaries.

patterns.name: String segmentation and adjacent special symbols
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur near code, identifiers, punctuation, or line breaks, possibly related to subword segmentation and formatting boundaries; there is no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Figure numbering and citation formats
patterns.context: When patents or papers cite figures or references in forms such as FIG. 1C/1D or Ref. 3, activation is distributed across abbreviations, periods, and number subwords.

patterns.name: Scattered fragments in numbers, units, and scientific notation
patterns.context: Activations occur near physical quantities, timescales, mathematical symbols, and formulas, but the hit locations vary and show no unified numerical or formula pattern.

patterns.name: Occasional subword activations within names
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented fragments of brand names, usernames, or product names; beyond their subword forms, the referents and contexts have no shared semantics.

patterns.name: Statutory citations and legal argument phrasing
patterns.context: In legal opinions, activation occurs near statutory numbers, contrastive phrasing, and the proper name Fabre; however, strong activation is concentrated on subsequent subwords of Fab, without a consistent legal-concept trigger.

5_1000.description: 激活分散在词内子词切分、标点和格式边界、图表/文献引用、科学符号及专名中；不同语料之间缺少稳定的语义或句法共同点，可能主要反映局部 token 形态与边界。

patterns.name: 后缀 -er / -ers 的分词或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 er/ry 等字母结尾或包含这些字母的切分子词上；周围词义和语境差异很大，部分是 BPE 子词边界导致的词内片段。

patterns.name: 字符串切分与特殊符号邻接
patterns.context: 代码、标识符、标点或换行附近出现零散激活，可能与子词切分和格式边界有关；没有稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 图示编号与引用格式
patterns.context: 专利或论文中以 FIG. 1C/1D、Ref. 3 等形式引用图表或文献时，激活分布在缩写、句点和编号的子词上。

patterns.name: 数值、量纲及科学记号中的零散片段
patterns.context: 物理量、时间尺度、数学符号和公式附近有激活，但命中位置不一致，未呈现统一的数值或公式模式。

patterns.name: 名称或专名内部的偶发子词激活
patterns.context: 激活位于品牌、用户名或产品名的切分片段；除子词形式外，所指对象和上下文没有共同语义。

patterns.name: 法条引用及法律论证措辞
patterns.context: 法律判决文本中，法条编号、转折措辞及 Fabre 专名附近激活；但强激活集中于 Fab 的后续子词，未显示一致的法律概念触发。

en.description: Activations occur in code identifiers and in fragments of proper names, technical terms, and ordinary words; markers often fall on within-word substrings or word-segment boundaries, but vary across corpora, semantics, and syntactic positions, making it difficult to infer a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Name/compound identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Occurs in code identifiers, member access, function calls, or type names; trigger points are often at capitalization or word-segment boundaries, or within an identifier, with no unified semantic or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names or technical terms
patterns.context: Markers fall within proper names, news headlines/company names, or biological taxonomy terms, possibly as within-word substrings; context shows no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Word fragments in legal text
patterns.context: Markers are distributed across ordinary words, disease names, and personal-name segments in legal arguments; adjacent words in the same passage may be unmarked, and trigger conditions are inconsistent.

5_1000.description: 激活出现在代码标识符及普通文本的专名、术语和词语片段中；标记常落在词内子串或词段边界，但跨语料、语义和句法位置均不一致，难以归纳为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 代码中的名称/复合标识符片段
patterns.trigger: 标记的标识符内部片段，如 «B»、«A»、«Br»、«Declared»、«Ac»、«Pref»、«Un»、«Br»；另有 «Room»、«Player»、«VendorPrefix» 等相邻代码标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符、成员访问、函数调用或类型名中；触发点常是大小写边界、词段边界或标识符的一部分，未见统一的语义或语法位置

patterns.name: 专名或术语内部片段
patterns.context: 标记落在专名、新闻标题/公司名或生物分类术语中，可能是词内子串；上下文不显示稳定的词义条件

patterns.name: 法律文本中的词语片段
patterns.context: 标记分布在法律论述中的普通词、疾病名及人名词段；同一段内也有未标记的相邻词，触发条件不统一

en.description: Activation occurs on code identifiers and APIs, named entities, code and formatting symbols, and formula variables; a few ordinary words also activate. It spans corpora and genres, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Identifiers and API names in code
patterns.context: Occurs in code, code comments, or technical Q&A; activation often falls on type names, method names, property names, library/language keywords, and their component words.
patterns.domain: Software engineering, programming Q&A, and code repositories

patterns.name: Proper names and entity names
patterns.context: When specific personal names, place names, or organization/product names appear in narrative or commentary, fragments within entity names are more likely to activate.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, news discussions, and online comments

patterns.name: Structural symbols and formatting markers
patterns.context: Symbols occur in code syntax, Markdown separators, or mathematical typesetting; some activations fall on punctuation, line breaks, and LaTeX structural symbols.
patterns.domain: Code, forum text, and mathematical papers

patterns.name: Physical symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Typeset formulas contain variables with subscripts or superscripts, Greek letters, and operators; activation covers variable letters and formula delimiters.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on ordinary words
patterns.context: Occasional activation in natural-language sentences or titles, with no stable lexical meaning, syntactic position, or topic condition.

5_1000.description: 激活分布在代码标识符和 API、实体专名、代码与排版符号及公式变量上；另有少量普通词激活。跨语料、跨文体，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与 API 名称
patterns.context: 处于代码、代码注释或技术问答中；激活常落在类型名、方法名、属性名、库/语言关键字及其组成词上。
patterns.domain: 软件工程、编程问答与代码仓库

patterns.name: 专名与实体名称
patterns.context: 叙述或评论中出现具体人名、地名、组织/产品名时，实体名称中的词片段较易激活。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、新闻讨论与网络评论

patterns.name: 结构性符号与格式标记
patterns.context: 符号位于代码语法、Markdown 分隔或数学排版中；有些激活落在标点、换行及 LaTeX 结构符号上。
patterns.domain: 代码、论坛文本与数学论文

patterns.name: 数学公式中的物理符号
patterns.context: 公式排版中出现带上下标的变量、希腊字母及算符；激活覆盖变量字母和公式分隔符。

patterns.name: 普通词语的零散激活
patterns.context: 自然语言句子或标题中偶发激活，未显示稳定的词义、句法位置或主题条件。

en.concept: Within-word fragments of proper names and identifiers
en.description: Activations often fall on short letter fragments within proper names, brands, identifiers, or other words; the fragments themselves are inconsistent. One example also falls on a LaTeX formula command fragment, and several examples include accompanying punctuation or separator activations.

patterns.name: Within-word letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments within names, brands, proper names, or code identifiers, especially capitalization boundaries, affixes, or name components; fragments vary across words and show no stable single-character pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: code, reviews, encyclopedia text, papers, and font copyright text

patterns.name: Typesetting markers in formulas
patterns.context: In a quantum optics formula, activation falls near LaTeX math commands and formula symbols; this differs from the ordinary word-fragment pattern.
patterns.domain: ArXiv physics paper, LaTeX mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: Punctuation and separators
patterns.context: A few activations fall on sentence-final punctuation, code comment/import markers, or formula line breaks; these markers vary in location and function and may be accompanying activations for the within-word fragment pattern.
patterns.domain: Code comments, web text, encyclopedia text, and mathematical typesetting

5_1000.concept: 专名及标识符的词内片段
5_1000.description: 激活多落在专名、品牌、标识符或其他词语内部的短字母片段，片段本身不统一；另有一例落在LaTeX公式命令片段，若干例伴随标点或分隔符激活。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在名称、品牌、专名或代码标识符内部的字母片段上，尤其是大小写边界、词缀或名字组成部分；不同词的片段并不一致，也没有稳定的单一字符模式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：代码、评论、百科、论文及字体版权文本

patterns.name: 公式中的排版标记
