patterns.context: 量子光学公式中，激活落在 LaTeX 数学命令及公式符号附近；此处与普通词语片段模式不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 物理论文、LaTeX 数学排版

patterns.name: 标点与分隔符
patterns.context: 少数激活落在句末标点、代码注释/导入标记或公式换行附近；这些标记出现的位置和用途不统一，可能是词内片段模式的伴随激活。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、网页文本、百科及数学排版

en.description: Activation is scattered across English function words, LaTeX mathematical symbols, code identifiers and line breaks, numbers and punctuation, CSS color values, and subword fragments of personal and place names; there is no clear unified semantics, and some activations appear to respond to local tokens or formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: In English sentences, especially near spaces and punctuation and in ordinary narrative or explanatory text; some activations fall on common conjunctions, prepositions, and articles.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and symbol sequences
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical expressions, quantum-state notation, or formulas in theorem proofs; activation centers on formula tokens, subscripts, and a few nearby connective words.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and code structure
patterns.context: Code snippets containing camelCase identifiers, operator lookup, or pointer indirection; activation may also occur where code ends and a question description begins.
patterns.domain: GitHub code and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and structured numerical strings
patterns.context: Structured data consisting of coordinates or numbers separated by commas and parentheses; insufficient context to determine what the numbers mean.

patterns.name: CSS property values and hexadecimal colors
patterns.context: Hexadecimal color strings in CSS rules repeatedly use the letter f; the same passage also contains property declarations and document citations, but these are not clearly the main trigger.
patterns.domain: Web frontend code and technical documentation

patterns.name: Proper names, intraword fragments, and entity names
patterns.context: Names such as personal names, team names, place names, and category titles are split into subword tokens; activation falls on name fragments rather than consistent whole-word forms.

patterns.name: Proper names and entity mentions in legal narratives
patterns.context: In legal case narratives, activation occurs on subword fragments of party names and company names, alongside ordinary legal narrative.

patterns.name: String splits or character-level local fragments
patterns.context: Activation sometimes falls on subword tokens inside words or strings rather than on whole words; this may relate to tokenization boundaries or local character patterns, but there is insufficient evidence to identify a shared rule.
patterns.domain: Code, proper names, and mixed text

5_1000.concept: 局部 token 与格式片段
5_1000.description: 激活分散在英语功能词、LaTeX 数学符号、代码标识符与换行、数字标点、CSS 颜色值，以及人名地名等被切分的子词上；没有明显统一语义，部分像是局部 token 或格式边界响应。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语边界
patterns.trigger: «for»、« of»、« is»、« as»、« in»、« the»、« and»、« when»、« on» 等
patterns.context: 英语句子中，尤其是词间空格、标点附近及普通叙述或说明文字；部分激活落在常见连接词、介词和冠词上。

patterns.name: 数学公式与符号序列
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式、量子态记号或定理证明中的公式；激活集中在公式 token、下标及公式周围的少量连接文字。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与代码结构
patterns.context: 代码片段中含有驼峰式标识符、运算符查找或指针间接层级；激活也可出现在代码结束后转入问题描述的位置。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码、StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 数字、标点与结构化数值串
patterns.context: 一串由坐标或数值构成、以逗号和括号分隔的结构化数据；没有足够上下文确定数值含义。

patterns.name: CSS 属性值与十六进制颜色
patterns.context: CSS 样式规则中，十六进制颜色字符串重复使用字母 f；同段还出现属性声明与文档引用，但未明显成为主要触发点。
patterns.domain: 网页前端代码及技术文档

patterns.name: 专名、词内片段与实体名称
patterns.context: 人名、球队名、地名及分类标题等专名被切分成子词 token；激活落在名称片段而非统一的完整词形上。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物传记与分类条目

patterns.name: 专名与法律叙事中的实体提及
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述中，激活出现在当事人姓名和企业名称的子词片段；同时夹杂普通法律叙述。

patterns.name: 字符串拆分或字符级局部片段
patterns.trigger: «f»«18»«f»«18»（«#f8ff»），以及上述专名中的多种不完整子词
patterns.context: 激活有时落在词语或字符串内部的子词 token，而非完整词；可能与分词边界或局部字符模式有关，但样本不足以确定共同规则。

en.description: Activation locations are scattered: they include Spanish football proper names, code identifiers and CSS hexadecimal values, quantum formula subscripts, chemical energy symbols, and within-word fragments in names and email. Apart from local character or symbol fragments, domains and contexts vary widely.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Spanish words or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented Spanish words and proper-name fragments; the clearest examples are club and league names in football category entries.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and capitalization fragments
patterns.context: In code, technical discussions, or accompanying explanations, activation falls on local parts of identifiers, API names, variable names, or color hexadecimal values; it is not tied to one fixed identifier.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and subscript fragments
patterns.context: In quantum-state and transformation formulas, activation falls on subscript and numeral fragments in LaTeX notation, usually embedded in ket notation.

patterns.name: Chemical energy symbols
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on thermodynamic symbols following Delta and their aqueous-state notation, in an abstract describing an energy surface.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in names
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within an author's name in a copyright notice; there is no evidence that it is specific to a particular name or copyright text.

patterns.name: Document names and transaction-document word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal letter fragments in what appears to be a platform or document-service name in an email, which also mentions SOP and document numbers.

5_1000.description: 激活位置分散：包括西语足球专名、代码标识符及 CSS 十六进制值、量子公式下标、化学能量符号，以及姓名和邮件中的词内片段。除局部字符或符号片段外，领域与上下文差异很大。

patterns.name: 西语词或专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的西班牙语词、专名片段中；最明显的是足球分类条目中的俱乐部和联赛名称。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及其大小写片段
patterns.context: 代码、技术讨论或代码附带的说明中，激活落在标识符、API 名称、变量名或颜色十六进制值的局部；不是固定同一标识符。

patterns.name: 数学符号与下标片段
patterns.context: 量子态和变换公式中，激活落在 LaTeX 数学记号的下标及数字片段，通常嵌在 ket 记号中。

patterns.name: 化学能量符号
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Delta 后的热力学量符号及其水相标注，出现在描述能量面的摘要中。

patterns.name: 姓名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在版权声明中的作者姓名内部片段，没有证据表明它是特定姓名或版权文本的专属反应。

patterns.name: 文档名和交易文书词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在邮件中疑似平台或文档服务名称的内部字母片段，周围提到 SOP 和文档编号。

en.description: Activation is scattered across code and identifiers, subword fragments of English proper names or ordinary words, quantum physics formula symbols, and medical terminology. Some fragments appear in category labels, enumerations, or cited method names, but these contexts do not reveal a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: When quantum states, transformations, or entangled-state expressions appear in mathematical or physical formulas; activation is distributed across formula symbols and nearby fragments

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Word or subword fragments in English prose, proper names, or code; trigger locations are scattered, with no unified semantic or lexical condition
patterns.domain: Web prose, encyclopedia entries, forum discussions, and CSS

patterns.name: Categories, enumerations, and code identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers and their component fragments are highlighted in Wikipedia category lines or code/enum definitions

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in titles
patterns.context: Initial or internal word fragments of terms in medical paper titles and abstracts

patterns.name: Test method references
patterns.context: When discussing test-case dependencies, activation appears on method names in single quotes and nearby numbers

5_1000.description: 激活散布于代码与标识符、英语专名或普通词的子词片段，以及量子物理公式符号和医学术语；部分片段可见于分类标签、枚举或引用的方法名，但这些上下文未呈现统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: LaTeX数学符号与公式
patterns.context: 数学或物理公式中出现量子态、变换或纠缠态表达式时；激活分布在公式符号与其邻近片段

patterns.name: 英语词语内部子词片段
patterns.context: 英语正文、专名或代码文本中的词语/子词片段；触发位置分散，未显示统一的语义或词法条件
patterns.domain: 网页正文、百科条目、论坛讨论与 CSS

patterns.name: 分类、枚举与代码标识符
patterns.context: 维基条目分类行或代码/枚举定义中，标识符及其组成片段被突出
patterns.domain: 维基百科分类、StackExchange 代码说明

patterns.name: 标题中的专名片段
patterns.context: 医学论文标题及摘要中的术语开头或内部词片段

patterns.name: 测试方法引用
patterns.context: 讨论测试用例依赖关系时，单引号中的方法名及邻近编号出现激活

en.concept: Subword fragments and proper-name recognition tendency
en.description: Broad and uneven activation: most examples contain proper names or intra-word fragments, especially football figures and club biographies. Other isolated patterns include Wikipedia categories, dates and numbers, code enumerations, patent figure-number hierarchies, informal reflections, dance experience, and email document references.

patterns.name: English word-initial/subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on multiple subword fragments of split proper names or common words; some fragments require adjacent letters to be combined to identify the complete word.
patterns.domain: Primarily Wikipedia biographies, football clubs, and emails

patterns.name: Football figures and club entries
patterns.context: Appears in player biographies, career histories, match debuts, or football category entries; no fixed sentence structure is required.

patterns.name: Category and category-entry format
patterns.context: Activation appears in Wikipedia category lists, followed by nationality, position, league, or club categories.

patterns.name: Prepositions and relational words
patterns.context: Embedded in narrative sentences connecting places, teams, dates, or events; these common words are not activated in every instance.

patterns.name: Time and numbers in football contexts
patterns.context: Numbers or dates occur in biographical information about player seasons, transfer/debut dates, or the year a political figure was elected.

patterns.name: Code enumeration and bit-flag explanation
patterns.context: After an indented, code-like enumeration on separate lines, explains why Like is parsed as LessThan or GreaterThan.

patterns.name: Patent figure numbers and hierarchical constraints
patterns.context: Patent-style technical text references figure numbers and describes main contours, additional hierarchical constraints, and their relationships.

patterns.name: Informal abbreviations and reflections on life
patterns.context: Informal first-person text discusses colleagues, the value of life, and miracles, using colloquial abbreviations and reflective language.

patterns.name: Personal achievements and dance experience
patterns.context: A personal profile mentions success reported in the media and experience with salsa/bachata dancing.

patterns.name: Document references in emails
patterns.context: A brief email tells the recipient where an SOP is located and includes a document number; activation also falls on internal name fragments.

5_1000.concept: 词片段与专名识别倾向
5_1000.description: 激活广泛且不均匀：多数例子含专名/词内碎片，尤其足球人物与俱乐部传记；另有维基分类、日期数字、代码枚举、专利图号层级、口语感悟、舞蹈经历及邮件文档提及等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 英语词首/子词片段
patterns.trigger: 多处词内碎片，如 «B» in DealB ench、«T»/«Hot»/«sp»/«ur» in Tottenham Hotspur、«Atl»/«é»/«tico»、«W»/«ande»/«rers»、«Cl»/«un»/«ie»
patterns.context: 激活常落在被拆分的专名或普通词的多个子词片段上；有些片段需与相邻字母合并才能识别完整词。
patterns.domain: 以维基百科人物、足球俱乐部和传记为主，也有邮件

patterns.name: 足球人物与俱乐部条目
patterns.trigger: «Football»、«Club»、«footballers»、«football midfield»、«players»、«debut»、«career»、«played»，以及 Tottenham Hotspur、Bolton Wanderers、Hearts、St Johnstone 等名称
patterns.context: 出现在球员生平、效力经历、比赛首秀或足球分类条目中；不要求某个固定句式。
patterns.domain: 维基百科足球传记及分类

patterns.name: 分类与类别条目格式
patterns.context: 激活出现在维基百科分类列表中，后接国籍、位置、联赛或俱乐部类别。

patterns.name: 介词与关系词
patterns.context: 嵌在叙述性句子中，连接地点、球队、日期或事件；这些常见词并非所有实例都激活。

patterns.name: 足球语境中的时间与数字
patterns.context: 数字或日期位于球员赛季、转会/首秀时间或政治人物当选年份等生平信息中。

patterns.name: 代码枚举与位标志说明
patterns.context: 换行缩进的类似代码/枚举列表之后，解释 Like 被解析为 LessThan 或 GreaterThan 的原因。

patterns.name: 专利图号与层级限制描述
patterns.context: 专利式技术文字引用图号，并说明主轮廓、附加层级限制及其相互关系。

patterns.name: 口语缩写与人生感悟
patterns.context: 非正式第一人称文字中谈及同事、生命价值和奇迹，出现口语缩写和反思性表达。

patterns.name: 人物成就与舞蹈经历
patterns.trigger: «success»、«Fasting»（与 Intermittent Fasting 连用）、«dancer»、«competitive Salsa dancer»
patterns.context: 人物介绍提及媒体报道的成功，以及萨尔萨/巴恰塔舞蹈经历。

patterns.name: 邮件中的文档提及
patterns.context: 简短邮件告知对方某个 SOP 位于某处，并带有文档编号；激活也落在名称内部碎片。

en.concept: Relations and structural markers in technical text
en.description: Activation is scattered across text from multiple domains, often falling on prepositions, conjunctions, punctuation, and structural elements such as table/figure numbers and method names; there are also some proper-name or content-word fragments, without a single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Functional prepositions and relational links
patterns.context: Appears in continuous technical text describing numerical values, locations, dependencies, comparisons, or compositional relationships; some prepositions and relational words are marked, but not every occurrence in the same context activates.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, medical papers, forum discussions, news, and patents

patterns.name: Structural labels, tables, and numbered references
patterns.context: Table/figure numbers, panel names, method names, and cross-references in technical or academic text; activation falls on some labels or components of numbers.

patterns.name: Local grammatical markers and short function words
patterns.context: Connectives, modifiers, prepositional structures, and sentence-boundary or parenthetical punctuation in ordinary sentences or lists; no clear specialized semantic condition.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names and technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on partial tokens within proper names, terms, or identifiers rather than on a stable whole-word meaning; no consistent lexical category is evident.
patterns.domain: News, medicine, code discussions, medical tables

patterns.name: Descriptive modifiers or lexical emphasis
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically in patent figure descriptions, admission schedules, software property descriptions, and historical naming narratives; difficult to group under a shared semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, software documentation, encyclopedia narratives

5_1000.concept: 技术文本中的关系与结构标记
5_1000.description: 激活分散于多领域文本，常落在介词、连接词、标点及表格/图号、方法名等结构成分；也有若干专名或内容词片段，缺乏单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 功能性介词与关系连接
patterns.context: 出现在说明数值、位置、依赖关系、比较或组成关系的连续技术文本中；部分介词及关系词被标记，但同一上下文中并非每次出现都标记。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、医学论文、论坛讨论、新闻及专利等

patterns.name: 结构标签、表格及编号引用
patterns.context: 技术或学术文本中的表格/图编号、面板名称、方法名与交叉引用；激活落在部分标签或编号组成部分上。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利、软件问答

patterns.name: 局部语法标记及短功能词
patterns.context: 普通句子或列表中的连接、限定、介词结构和句界/括号标点；没有明显统一的专门语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文与技术文本

patterns.name: 专名与专门术语中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、术语或标识符内部的部分 token，而非稳定的完整词义；未见一致的词汇类别。
patterns.domain: 新闻、医学、代码讨论、医学表格

patterns.name: 描述性修饰语或词汇强调
patterns.context: 分别出现在专利图示说明、入院时间表、软件属性描述和历史命名叙述中；仅零星出现，难以归为同一语义触发。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、软件文档、百科叙述

en.description: Peaks are scattered across place names, terminology, operators, time words, and proper-name fragments; text domains and trigger forms are inconsistent, so these examples do not establish a common mechanism.

patterns.name: Place-name prepositions in political biographies
patterns.context: In a political biography, when mentioning the region represented by the person upon election

patterns.name: Letter fragments in tumor-sequencing terminology
patterns.context: Within an abbreviation or proper name for a sequencing panel

patterns.name: Names of code comparison operators
patterns.context: Explains why Like in code is parsed as LessThan or GreaterThan

patterns.name: Bacterial serogroup names
patterns.context: Describes the capsular polysaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis group A

patterns.name: Electromagnetic field categories
patterns.context: In technical descriptions of frequency bands and field-strength parameters such as ELF and VLF

patterns.name: Naming action in aviation history
patterns.context: Parenthetical clarification that a place was later renamed Edwards AFB

patterns.name: Temporal relation words in experimental figures
patterns.context: Describes current amplitude changing over time and compares before and after leptin treatment

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in a historical place name
patterns.context: An internal subword fragment of the proper name Arimathea
patterns.domain: Directory of ancient British Christian history

patterns.name: Administrative division in a legal name
patterns.context: Repeatedly lists school district names in Marion County, Indiana

patterns.name: Name fragments in fantasy narratives
patterns.context: In a narrative about the characters Nero and the evil spirit Reshef, activation falls on internal name fragments

5_1000.description: 峰值分散于地名、术语、运算符、时间词及专名片段；文本领域与触发形式均不一致，无法从这些例子确定共同机制。

patterns.name: 政治人物条目中的地名介词
patterns.context: 政治人物传记中，提及其当选所代表的地区时

patterns.name: 肿瘤测序术语中的字母片段
patterns.context: 测序面板名称的缩写或专名内部
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 代码比较运算符名称
patterns.context: 解释代码中的 Like 被解析为 LessThan 或 GreaterThan 的原因

patterns.name: 细菌血清群名称
patterns.context: 描述脑膜炎奈瑟菌 A 群荚膜多糖
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／生物医学

patterns.name: 电磁场类别名称
patterns.context: ELF、VLF 等频段和场强参数的技术描述中
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／工程技术

patterns.name: 航空史中的命名动作
patterns.context: 括号内补充说明地点后来改名为 Edwards AFB

patterns.name: 实验图表中的时间关系词
patterns.context: 描述电流幅度随时间变化，并比较瘦素处理前后

patterns.name: 历史地名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 专名 Arimathea 的内部子词片段
patterns.domain: 古代英国基督教史目录

patterns.name: 法律名称中的行政区划
patterns.context: 反复列举印第安纳州 Marion County 的学区名称

patterns.name: 奇幻叙述中的名字片段
patterns.context: 人物 Nero 与邪灵 Reshef 的叙述中，触发落在名字内部的片段
patterns.domain: 网络文本／奇幻游戏介绍

en.concept: Subword boundaries in proper names and identifiers
en.description: Activation occurs on intraword subword fragments, mixed-case/number identifiers, and their boundaries; especially common in place names, institutions, names and titles, code variables, and formatted headings. Contexts share segmentation and a high density of proper names, but no single stable semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Word/subword fragment boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words or on words composed of multiple subword tokens, often alongside nearby punctuation, spaces, or case boundaries; however, the fragments’ meanings and contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, code, and legal documents

patterns.name: Lists of place names and institutions
patterns.context: Dense proper-name usage, especially repeated “township, county, state” structures and court jurisdiction headings in court documents.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, place names, and institution names

patterns.name: Personal names and roles/biographies
patterns.context: Personal names co-occur with judicial appointments, political identity, legislative service, or judicial titles.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, parliamentary records, and legal documents

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and code syntax
patterns.context: Variable names, class names, keywords, or operators are split into subwords; contexts explain circuit parameters, programming idioms, parsing rules, or data classes.

patterns.name: List/entry formatting and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Fragments with clear formatting boundaries such as entries, tables, line breaks, indentation, or legal document headings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists, code examples, court documents

patterns.name: Alphanumeric and mixed-case forms in proper names
patterns.context: Names or identifiers contain case changes, numbers, hyphens, or unusual spelling, resulting in irregular tokenization.
patterns.domain: Game reviews, patent text, legal and code text

patterns.name: General grammatical words and explanatory prose
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary English narrative, causal explanations, or biographical sentences; no consistent semantic trigger condition is evident that would summarize it on its own.

patterns.name: Proper-name segmentation in Portuguese parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Personal names and the place name Strasbourg are split into multiple subword fragments in Portuguese speeches.

patterns.name: Game titles and fictional characters
patterns.context: Game reviews mention game titles, the character Nero, and the demon Resheph.

5_1000.concept: 专名与标识符的子词边界
5_1000.description: 激活分布于词内子词片段、大小写/数字混合标识符及其边界；尤见地名机构、人名职务、代码变量和格式化标题。不同语境共享切分与专名密集特征，但没有单一稳定语义触发词。

patterns.name: 词语/子词片段边界
patterns.trigger: 跨段出现的词内片段，如 «Res»«he»«f»、«Each»、«V»«set»、«Township»、«Bur»«go»、«ASS»«ACH»、«Less»«Than»«Greater»、«dat»«ac»«lass»
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部或由多个子词 token 拼成的词上，常与相邻标点、空格或大小写边界一起出现；但各片段词义和语境差异很大。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本、代码与法律文书

patterns.name: 地名与机构名称列举
patterns.context: 专名密集出现，尤其是重复的“某镇区、某县、某州”结构，以及法院文件中的法院辖区标题。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、地名和机构名称

patterns.name: 人名与职务/履历
patterns.context: 人物姓名与法院任职、政治身份、议会任职或法官头衔同现。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、议会记录、法律文书

patterns.name: 技术标识符与代码语法
patterns.context: 变量名、类名、关键字或运算符被子词切分；上下文解释电路参数、编程惯用法、解析规则或数据类。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、编程问答

patterns.name: 列表/条目格式与标点边界
patterns.context: 条目、表格、换行、缩进或法律文书标题等格式边界明显的片段。
patterns.domain: 百科列表、代码示例、法院文件

patterns.name: 专名中的字母数字与混合大小写
patterns.context: 名称或标识符包含大小写转换、数字、连字符或罕见拼写，token 切分不规则。
patterns.domain: 游戏评论、专利文本、法律与代码文本

patterns.name: 一般语法词及解释性叙述
patterns.context: 普通英文叙述、原因解释或履历句中出现；未见一致且足以单独概括的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 葡语议会发言中的专名切分
patterns.context: 葡语发言中人名及地名 Strasbourg 被拆分成多个子词片段。

patterns.name: 游戏名及虚构人物
patterns.context: 游戏评论提及游戏标题、角色 Nero 与邪灵 Resheph。

en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous contexts, including political elections and legislators, legal documents, proper-name tokenization, code identifiers, programming operators, statistical numbers, and mathematical abstracts; no single stable word sense or domain covers all examples.

patterns.name: Parliamentary elections and legislators
patterns.context: Describes electoral systems, elected legislators, and their constituencies or parties
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on political figures and elections

patterns.name: Court document formatting
patterns.context: Case captions and formatted titles of appellate court documents

patterns.name: Tokenization or word boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names split into multiple tokens, including intra-word boundaries; fragments also occur in ordinary English contexts

patterns.name: Code identifiers and camel case
patterns.context: Code contains identifiers, method names, and calls composed of multiple words or displayed in split form

patterns.name: Bitwise enumerations and comparison operators
patterns.context: Lists integer flag values and explains how comparison operators are parsed

patterns.name: Numbers, time, and statistics
patterns.context: Dates, years, or experimental statistics embedded in prose

patterns.name: Specific mathematical notation topic
patterns.context: An abstract describes the decomposition of finite groups and their representations

patterns.name: Entry titles and entity disambiguation
patterns.context: A disambiguation entry titled with a name lists institutions sharing that name and identifies the entities

patterns.name: Fragmentary text and layout artifacts
patterns.context: Context is truncated or mixed with formatting, lists, or transcription noise; no common semantic trigger can be confirmed

5_1000.description: 激活分布于政治选举与议员、法律文书、专名分词、代码标识符、编程运算、统计数字和数学摘要等异质语境；没有单一稳定的词义或领域能覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 议会选举与议员
patterns.context: 描述选举制度、当选议员及其选区或政党
patterns.domain: 百科全书政治人物与选举条目

patterns.name: 法院文书格式
patterns.trigger: “Appellee”“v.」「Defendant, Appellant”“APPEAL FROM THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT”
patterns.context: 法院案件标题及上诉法院文书的格式化标题

patterns.name: 专名中的分词或词界
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个 token，包含词内边界；片段同时有普通英文语境

patterns.name: 代码标识符与驼峰命名
patterns.context: 代码中出现由多个词构成或拆分显示的标识符、方法名及调用

patterns.name: 位运算枚举与比较运算符
patterns.context: 列举整数标志值，并解释比较操作符的解析

patterns.name: 数字与时间、统计量
patterns.context: 日期、年份或实验统计结果嵌在叙述中

patterns.name: 特定数学表示主题
patterns.context: 摘要描述有限群及其表示的分解

patterns.name: 词条标题及实体消歧
patterns.context: 以名称为题的消歧词条，列举同名机构并定位实体

patterns.name: 残缺文本与版式碎片
patterns.trigger: “ko suggested Sunday …”及段首/段尾的截断片段
patterns.context: 上下文被截断或混有格式、列表、转录噪声；没有可确认的共同语义触发条件

en.concept: Local word fragments in technical text
en.description: Activation is distributed across text from multiple domains; the more stable commonality is the English function word “the” and technical nouns, symbols, and identifiers nearby. There are also encyclopedia proper names and code identifiers, without a single clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English definite article “the” and adjacent structures
patterns.context: Appears in technical sentences, often before nouns, relational elements, or descriptive phrases; activates across multiple domains and grammatical positions

patterns.name: Local fragments in fixed abbreviations, symbols, and numbers
patterns.context: Technical identifiers composed of letters, numbers, and punctuation in patent text; activation locations are inconsistent
patterns.domain: Patent standard citations, circuit and chemical patents

patterns.name: Word fragments in proper names and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs in encyclopedia entry titles, personal names, or organization names

patterns.name: Mathematical/scientific terms and symbolic expressions
patterns.context: In discussions of abstract mathematics, physics, or differential equations, activation is distributed across terms and variable expressions

patterns.name: Code method calls and column names
patterns.context: Method calls, type names, and their explanatory text in example code

5_1000.concept: 技术文本中的局部词片段
5_1000.description: 激活分布于多领域文本，较稳定的共同点是英语功能词“the”及技术名词、符号和标识附近；另见百科专名与代码标识，未形成单一清晰语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语定冠词“the”及邻接结构
patterns.trigger: « the»，另有« that/than/whether»等邻近功能词
patterns.context: 出现在技术句子中，常位于名词、关系成分或描述性短语前；多个领域与语法位置都有激活

patterns.name: 固定缩写、符号与编号中的局部片段
patterns.trigger: «3»G« TS»、«25»、«R»、«T»等符号或编号附近的片段
patterns.context: 专利文本中由字母、数字、标点组成的技术标识；激活位置不统一
patterns.domain: 专利标准引用、电路与化学专利

patterns.name: 专名及实体名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在百科条目标题、人名或组织名称中

patterns.name: 数学/科学术语及符号表达
patterns.context: 在抽象数学、物理或微分方程论述中，激活分散于术语和变量表达

patterns.name: 代码方法调用与列名
patterns.context: 示例代码中方法调用、类型名及其说明文字

en.concept: Heterogeneous detection of word and phrase boundaries
en.description: Activations are scattered across heterogeneous texts, notably English function words and phrase boundaries, and also cover spatial terms, numbers, and proper-name tokenization. Other local word sequences occur in mathematical terminology and historical, entertainment, game, and urban narratives, with no unified topic or stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Grammatical function words and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs at noun phrases, coordinated structures, prepositional phrases, or sentence transitions; often adjacent to a following noun or place name, but with no fixed collocation
patterns.domain: General and academic English in mixed texts

patterns.name: North and directional nouns
patterns.context: Used as a regional name or directional modifier, usually adjacent to a place name, landform, or city description

patterns.name: Greek letter iota and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Embedded in formulas or operator expressions, adjacent to functions, variables, and mathematical symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, partial differential equations or operator theory

patterns.name: Structures expressing binary choices or contrasts
patterns.context: Compares the values of two Xs or X's and lists different allocations of oxygen/sulfur
patterns.domain: Chemical or materials variable definitions in patent background text

patterns.name: Proper-name and terminology fragments in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Describes group representations, finite groups/modules, and related mathematical objects in abstracts or main text

patterns.name: Random matrix ensembles and scaling-limit terminology
patterns.context: Discusses locally uniform convergence, kernels, and limits of different ensembles

patterns.name: Mathematical theorem names and distance terminology
patterns.context: An abstract states a result about a type of hyperbolicity and the Kobayashi distance
patterns.domain: Complex geometry or mathematical paper abstracts

patterns.name: Numbers, currency, and statistical values
patterns.context: Values are associated with pound amounts, regions, or per-capita statistics
patterns.domain: Regional economic data in news or commentary

patterns.name: Affix boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Occurs in tokenized fragments of personal names, company names, or loanwords

patterns.name: Historical figures and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Describes a person's surrender, actions, or death, with proper names appearing in tokenized form

patterns.name: Game characters and work-title fragments
patterns.context: Discusses game plots, characters, and evil spirits, with proper names split into subwords

patterns.name: TV programs and company-name fragments
patterns.context: A television station and production company collaborate to adapt an Argentine TV series

patterns.name: Urban redevelopment and flattening terrain
patterns.context: Describes leveling hills and modifying terrain for urban development

5_1000.concept: 词与短语边界的异质检测
5_1000.description: 激活散布于异质文本，显著涉及英语功能词与短语边界，也覆盖方位词、数字和专名分词；另有多种数学论文术语及历史、娱乐、游戏、城市叙述中的局部词串，缺少统一的主题或稳定词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 语法功能词与短语边界
patterns.context: 出现在名词短语、并列结构、介词短语或句子衔接处；常与后续名词或地名相邻，但没有固定搭配
patterns.domain: 混合文本中的一般英语及学术英语

patterns.name: North及方位名词
patterns.context: 作为地区名称或方向修饰语，通常邻接地名、地貌或城市描述
patterns.domain: 英国地区统计、历史地理叙述

patterns.name: 希腊字母 iota 与数学符号
patterns.context: 嵌入公式或算子表达式中，邻接函数、变量及数学符号
patterns.domain: 数学论文，偏微分方程或算子理论

patterns.name: 表示二元选择或对照的结构
patterns.context: 比较两个 X 或 X's 的取值，并列举氧/硫的不同分配
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的化学或材料变量定义

patterns.name: 数学论文中的专名与术语片段
patterns.context: 在论文摘要或正文中描述群表示、有限群/模及相关数学对象

patterns.name: 随机矩阵系综与缩放极限术语
patterns.context: 讨论局部一致收敛、核及不同系综的极限
patterns.domain: 数学物理或概率论论文

patterns.name: 数学定理名称及距离术语
patterns.context: 摘要中陈述关于某种双曲性及 Kobayashi 距离的结果
patterns.domain: 复几何或数学论文摘要

patterns.name: 数字、货币与统计数值
patterns.context: 数值与英镑金额、地区或人均统计相连
patterns.domain: 新闻或评论中的区域经济数据

patterns.name: 专名中的词缀边界
patterns.context: 出现在人名、公司名或外来词的分词片段中

patterns.name: 历史人物与专名片段
patterns.context: 叙述人物投降、行动或死亡，专名以分词形式出现

patterns.name: 游戏人物与作品名片段
patterns.context: 讨论游戏剧情、角色及邪灵，专名被拆分成子词

patterns.name: 电视节目与公司名片段
patterns.context: 电视台与制作公司合作改编阿根廷电视剧

patterns.name: 城市改造与地形改平
patterns.context: 描述为城市建设削平山丘、进行地形改造

en.description: Activation is scattered across long sentences of various kinds: variable enumerations and device structures in patents, academic terminology and formulas, code identifiers and acknowledgments, and lists of place names and proper names. Many passages share frequent connectives, determiners, and comma-separated coordination, but their topics are not unified.

patterns.name: Alternating symbols and variables in patent formulas
patterns.context: In patent claims or background technology, variables, options, and coordinated conditions are linked by commas, and/or, and similar forms; repeated symmetrical structures or enumerations are common.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent technical text, including signal processing and chemical structures

patterns.name: Patent device structures and effect descriptions
patterns.context: Describes semiconductor device layers, components, and their relative positions, then states the structural advantages.

patterns.name: Proper names, personal names, and entity names
patterns.context: Personal, organization, or other proper names appear in lists, acknowledgments, or narratives; some names are split by tokenization.
patterns.domain: GitHub acknowledgments/code text, encyclopedias, and legal text

patterns.name: Terms, symbols, and definitions in academic text
patterns.context: Paper passages introduce mathematical concepts, theorems, or properties, with terms accompanied by proper names, compounds, and formula symbols.

patterns.name: Lists of place names and directions
patterns.context: Geographic narratives list directions, administrative divisions, or locations in sequence, often linked by and, commas, and prepositions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography text and legal factual narratives

patterns.name: Identifiers, parameters, and formatting markers in code
patterns.context: GitHub text contains function-style formatting, code identifiers, or explanations of parameter names; identifiers may use mixed case.

patterns.name: General connectives and function words
patterns.context: These words recur in multiple local structures across long sentences, coordinated lists, and subordinate clauses on different topics; they may be shared local triggers across the patterns above.

5_1000.description: 激活分散于多类长句：专利中的变量枚举、器件结构，学术术语与公式，代码标识符和署名，以及地名、专名串列。多段共享高频连接词、限定词及逗号并列结构，但主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 专利公式中的交替符号与变量
patterns.trigger: “cos…inusoidal signal”“I cos ω − Q sin ω”及“all oxygen or all sulfur”“one X is sulfur while the other…are oxygen”
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或背景技术中，变量、选项及并列条件通过逗号、and/or 等连接，常出现重复的对称结构或枚举。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利技术文本，涉及信号处理和化学结构

patterns.name: 专利器件结构与效果描述
patterns.trigger: “GaAs active layer”“gate electrode”“source electrode”“The advantage of this recess and offset structure”
patterns.context: 描述半导体器件的层、部件及其相对位置，再说明结构优势。

patterns.name: 专名、姓名与实体名称
patterns.trigger: “Ger… Thomson”“Christian Stocker, Rob Richards”“Brien stable”“Hans Holbein”“Great American Bank”
patterns.context: 人名、组织名或其他专名在列表、署名、叙述中出现；部分姓名被分词拆开。
patterns.domain: GitHub 署名/代码文本、百科及法律文本

patterns.name: 学术文本中的术语、符号与定义
patterns.context: 论文段落介绍数学概念、定理或性质，术语伴随专名、复合词与公式符号。

patterns.name: 地名及方位串列
patterns.trigger: “east and north”“Sichuan, Qinghai, Gansu and Yunnan”“to the southwest”“Arizona”
patterns.context: 地理叙述中连续列举方位、行政区或地点，常用 and、逗号及介词连接。
patterns.domain: 百科地理文本及法律事实叙述

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符、参数与格式标记
patterns.context: GitHub 文本中出现函数式格式、代码标识符或对参数名称的说明，标识符可能采用大小写混合。

patterns.name: 通用连接词与功能词
patterns.context: 不同主题的长句、并列列表和从句中，这些词在多个局部结构内反复出现；可能是上述模式共有的局部触发因素。

en.description: Activations occur in directional place names, code identifiers, mathematical formulas and terminology, dimensional descriptions in papers, and medical classification sentences; common semantic cues are unstable, and some highlighted spans are split word fragments or common words.

patterns.name: Direction, relative location, and orientation descriptions
patterns.context: Directions and relative positions of places or terrain, often in geographical descriptions; also appears in state and place names in legal documents

patterns.name: Word fragments in compound identifiers
patterns.context: Code or variable names split into multiple tokens; activation falls on identifier components

patterns.name: Variables and operators in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Symbols, variable names, and operator terms occur in derivations or programming explanations

patterns.name: Properties in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Academic discussion introducing metric measure spaces, operators, and their properties

patterns.name: Word forms related to dimensions
patterns.context: Discusses incorporating the time dimension into an algorithm or dimensionality reduction; word forms may be split across tokens

patterns.name: Categories and their distinctions
patterns.context: Divides a result into different categories and describes each separately

patterns.name: Local triggers not classifiable under the above patterns
patterns.context: There is insufficient evidence around the activation to support a more specific common semantic pattern

5_1000.description: 激活分布于方位地名、代码标识符、数学公式与术语、论文中的维度表述，以及医学分类句；共同语义线索不稳定，且部分高亮落在拆分词片段或普通词上。

patterns.name: 方向、相对位置与方位描述
patterns.trigger: « south»、« north»、« of»；« southeastern»、« north» of
patterns.context: 地点或地形的方向、相对位置，常出现在地理描述中；另见司法文书中的州名地名

patterns.name: 复合标识符中的词片段
patterns.context: 代码或变量名被拆分成多个 token；激活落在标识符组成部分上

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量与运算符
patterns.context: 符号、变量名及运算词出现在公式推导或编程解释中

patterns.name: 数学论文中的性质术语
patterns.context: 介绍度量测度空间、算子及其性质的学术论述

patterns.name: 维度与维数相关词形
patterns.context: 讨论把时间维度纳入算法，或维度约简；词形可能跨 token 拆分

patterns.name: 分类类别及其区分
patterns.context: 将某种结果划分为不同类别，并分别描述

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的局部触发
patterns.context: 激活周围没有足够证据支持更具体的共同语义模式

en.description: Most passages use “To the best of our knowledge” and variants in academic contexts to introduce assessments of the literature or claims of research novelty; other examples include code identifier comparisons and the title and party format at the beginning of legal decisions.

patterns.name: “To the best of our knowledge” formula
patterns.context: This phrase introduces researchers’ assessments of prior work, often followed by “this is the first…,” “all previous work…,” or a statement of a gap in the literature; activation concentrates on positions such as “To / the / best / of / our knowledge” within the phrase.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research abstracts, and literature reviews

patterns.name: “LessThan/GreaterThan” in technical comparisons
patterns.context: Appears as a code identifier when explaining enum values and their bitwise OR operation.

patterns.name: Legal case titles and party designations
patterns.context: Formatted information at the beginning of court decisions, including titles, party identities, and the source of an appeal.

5_1000.description: 多数段落在学术语境中使用“To the best of our knowledge”及其变体，引出文献判断或研究新颖性；另有代码标识符比较，以及法律判决开头的标题和当事人格式。

patterns.name: “To the best of our knowledge”套语
patterns.trigger: “To the best of our knowledge”及变体“to the best of 10/9 our knowledge”
patterns.context: 该短语用于引出研究者对既有工作的判断，常接“this is the first…”、“all previous work…”或说明文献缺口；激活集中在短语中“To / the / best / of / our knowledge”等位置。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、研究摘要及文献综述

patterns.name: 技术比较中的“LessThan/GreaterThan”
patterns.context: 在解释枚举值及其按位或运算时，作为代码标识符出现。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与当事人称谓
patterns.trigger: “MICHAEL DAVID GRANT”、“Defendant and Appellant”、“APPEAL from”、“Superior Court”
patterns.context: 法院判决文书开头的标题、当事人身份及上诉来源等格式化信息。

en.concept: Academic set phrase “to the best of our knowledge”
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the fixed phrase “to the best of our knowledge” in academic texts, often introducing claims about prior work, novelty, or being the first study; other examples include medical statistics, technical Q&A, historical geography, and code fragments, with no apparent shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “to the best of our knowledge”
patterns.context: The phrase introduces a paper or research statement, usually followed by a judgment about prior work, novelty, or being the first study; activation concentrates on multiple words in the phrase, especially best, of, and knowledge.

patterns.name: Causal explanation sentence structure
patterns.context: Explains why a parsing result or behavior occurs, followed by a specific mechanism and example; not the fixed phrase above.

patterns.name: Quantity, rate, and person-year statistics
patterns.context: Describes mortality rates and age-group statistics during a study period; the academic fixed phrase does not occur.

patterns.name: Urban terrain modification and place names
patterns.context: Recounts the historical leveling of hills in Seattle, including directions, years, and place names; no clear relation to the academic phrase pattern.

patterns.name: Operator values and node reduction in code
patterns.context: Code comments and branch conditions describe the reduction of expression-tree nodes; the academic phrase does not occur.

5_1000.concept: 学术固定短语“to the best of our knowledge”
5_1000.description: 主要对学术文本中的固定短语“to the best of our knowledge”强烈响应，常引出既有研究、新颖性或首次研究声明；另有医学统计、技术问答、历史地理和代码片段，未见共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 固定短语“to the best of our knowledge”
patterns.trigger: “To the best of our knowledge”及大小写变体 “to the best of our knowledge”
patterns.context: 该短语作为论文或研究陈述的引导语，通常后接关于既有工作、新颖性或首次研究的判断；激活集中在短语中的多个词，尤其 best、of 和 knowledge。

patterns.name: 因果解释句式
patterns.context: 解释某种解析或行为为何发生，后接具体机制和例子；并非上述固定短语。

patterns.name: 数量、率与人年统计表达
patterns.context: 描述研究期间的死亡率及年龄分组统计；没有出现学术固定短语。

patterns.name: 城市地形改造与地名
patterns.context: 叙述西雅图历史上的削平山丘工程，包含方位、年份和地名；与学术短语模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 代码中的运算符值与节点缩减
patterns.trigger: “children[0].value == '*'”、“value == '+'”、“reduce to None”、“reduce to a single occ…”
patterns.context: 代码注释和分支条件描述表达式树节点的缩减；没有出现学术短语。

en.description: Activations cover several local patterns: directional phrases “to the …” in geographic descriptions, the German Erfolg stem, case labels in code switches, bitwise operations/register macros, and mathematical dual-pairing notation. They occur across different languages and styles, with no clear unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Directional or goal-oriented use of English preposition to
patterns.context: Describes location, direction, or movement in geographic passages; to often appears next to the and a directional term

patterns.name: German Erfolgs stem and morphological fragments
patterns.context: Forms such as Erfolg/Erfolgssystem occur in German parliamentary speech; activation falls on subword fragments of the stem

patterns.name: case branch labels in code
patterns.context: Introduces branches in switch statements, especially case labels and the constants, strings, or values that follow

patterns.name: Hardware register macros and bitwise expressions
patterns.context: Combinations of macros for register fields, masks, and offsets, or explanations of bitwise OR; activation does not always fall on the same operator

patterns.name: Mathematical dual-pairing notation
patterns.context: Angle brackets denote pairings between a space and its dual in mathematical papers

5_1000.description: 激活覆盖多种局部模式：地理叙述中的方向短语“to the …”，德语 Erfolg 词干，代码 switch 的 case 标签，以及位运算/寄存器宏和数学对偶配对符号；它们出现在不同语种与文体中，缺少统一的明显语义触发点。

patterns.name: 英语介词 to 的方向/趋向用法
patterns.context: 地理描述中说明位置、方向或移动趋向；to 常紧邻 the 和方位词

patterns.name: 德语 Erfolgs 词干及构词片段
patterns.context: 德语议会发言中出现 Erfolg/Erfolgssystem 一类词形，激活落在被拆分的词干片段上

patterns.name: 代码中的 case 分支标签
patterns.context: switch 语句中引入分支，尤其是 case 标签及其后面的常量/字符串和值

patterns.name: 硬件寄存器宏与位运算表达式
patterns.context: 寄存器字段、掩码、偏移量等宏组合，或解释按位 OR；激活并不总落在同一运算符上

patterns.name: 数学对偶配对符号
patterns.context: 数学论文中用角括号表示空间及其对偶之间的配对

en.concept: Academic formula: to the best of our knowledge
en.description: Responds to the academic-writing formula “To the best of our knowledge” (and capitalization variants), especially “the best of” within the phrase, often used to introduce claims of novelty or gaps in the literature; all passages fit.

patterns.name: “to the best of our knowledge” formula
patterns.context: The phrase appears at the beginning or within a sentence to qualify the authors’ knowledge of existing research; it is often followed by claims of novelty, first reports, or gaps in the literature. Strong activation concentrates on “the,” “best,” and “of” within the phrase, extending to “our” and “knowledge.”
patterns.domain: Academic papers, including computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, and biomedicine

5_1000.concept: 学术惯用语：据我们所知
5_1000.description: 对学术写作中惯用语“To the best of our knowledge”（及大小写变体）反应，尤其是短语内的“the best of”，常用于引出新颖性或文献空缺判断；所有段均符合。

patterns.name: “to the best of our knowledge”惯用语
patterns.trigger: “To the best of our knowledge”及大小写变体 “to the best of our knowledge”
patterns.context: 该短语出现在句首或句中，用来限定作者对现有研究的了解；后面常接研究新颖性、首次报告或文献空缺的陈述。强激活集中在短语内部的 “the”“best”“of”，并延伸到 “our”“knowledge”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，涵盖计算机科学、数学、工程、物理和生物医学等领域

en.concept: Conventional expressions and markers in academic text
en.description: Primarily activates on the academic formula “To the best of our knowledge”; other weaker lexical and formatting patterns include proper names and place names, bold mathematical headings, roster years, ordering with “the order of,” and abstract-format markers.

patterns.name: Formulaic expression “To the best of our knowledge”
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning or within a sentence to qualify novelty, priority, or the researchers' knowledge; may be followed by a comma, period, or continuation of the research conclusion.

patterns.name: Place names and their components
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across word fragments or complete place names, including spellings split across tokens; context introduces a location, route, or institutional location.

patterns.name: Bold academic term headings
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on terms in bold headings and the heading format; the following text continues with a definition of the term.

patterns.name: Years in lists or tables
patterns.context: Years occur in an annual list under a roster heading, surrounded by line breaks and list formatting.

patterns.name: “Order” in quantitative results
patterns.context: The phrase introduces a ranking by decreasing emission volume; activation falls on “order.”

patterns.name: Quantum-system paper abstract formatting
patterns.context: Occurs in the separator and field labels at the beginning of an abstract; activation also covers subsequent general academic abstract text, with no more specific lexical trigger.

5_1000.concept: 学术文本中的惯用表达与标记
5_1000.description: 主要对“To the best of our knowledge”学术套语激活；另见专名与地名、粗体数学标题、名册年份、“the order of”排序，以及摘要格式标记，呈现多种较弱的词汇和版式模式。

patterns.name: “To the best of our knowledge”公式表达
patterns.context: 出现在句首或句中，用来限定新颖性、优先性或研究者认知；有时后接逗号、句点或续接研究结论。

patterns.name: 地名及地名组成部分
patterns.context: 激活分散在地名或专名的词片段、完整地名中，包含跨 token 拼写；语境在介绍地点、路线或机构所在地。

patterns.name: 粗体学术术语标题
patterns.context: 激活集中在粗体标题中的术语及标题格式，后文以定义该术语的正文衔接。

patterns.name: 列表或表格中的年份
patterns.context: 年份位于名册标题下的逐年列表中，周围有换行及列表式排版。

patterns.name: 量化结果中的“order”
patterns.context: 短语引出发射量递减的排序；激活落在“order”上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/化学研究摘要

patterns.name: 量子系统论文摘要格式
patterns.context: 出现在摘要开头的分隔线和字段标签；激活也覆盖后续一般学术摘要文本，缺乏更特定的词汇触发。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据及摘要

en.description: Activations occur in several types of structured technical text: code punctuation, paper equations and academic prose, encyclopedia categories and proper nouns, and clinical abstracts. The triggering features differ across examples, with no stable shared lexical item or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Special delimiters in markup and code
patterns.context: In code or code-like text, activation often falls near colons, arrows, brackets, quotation marks, underscores, and following line breaks or indentation; this occurs in only a few examples and cannot explain the others.

patterns.name: Symbols and typesetting in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Formulas and symbol-dense mathematical or scientific text; activation is distributed across formula symbols and surrounding technical terms, with no fully consistent trigger location.

patterns.name: Place names and category labels in category listings
patterns.context: Entry- or category-list-style text, often with newline-separated categories containing locations, category names, and years; activation occurs near multiple category fields.

patterns.name: Token fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: In text where proper nouns are split into multiple tokens, components of the names activate; there are too few examples to determine whether these fragments themselves are triggers.

patterns.name: Academic phrasing in English research abstracts
patterns.context: In continuous prose in English paper abstracts, activation occurs near ordinary academic sentence structures, logical connectors, and technical terms; it may differ from formula-driven activations in other paper passages.

patterns.name: Treatment and trial wording in clinical research
patterns.context: Occurs in medical abstracts describing treatment, study design, and groups; this is unique to this example and cannot be grouped with other observed patterns.

5_1000.description: 激活出现在多种结构化技术文本中：代码标点、论文公式与学术叙述、百科分类和专名，以及临床摘要。各处触发特征不同，尚无稳定的共同词项或句法模式。

patterns.name: 标记语言与代码中的特殊分隔符
patterns.context: 在代码或类似代码的文本中，激活常落在冒号、箭头、括号、引号、下划线及其后的换行或缩进附近；只有少数样本出现，不能解释其他段。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号与排版
patterns.context: 公式、符号密集的数学或科学文本；激活分布在公式符号及周围技术术语，具体触发位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 分类目录中的地名与类别标签
patterns.context: 条目或分类目录式文本，常以换行分隔类别，并包含地点、类别名和年份；多个类别字段附近激活。

patterns.name: 专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个 token 的文本中，名称组成部分有激活；样例不足以确定这些片段本身是否是触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文科研摘要中的学术表述
patterns.context: 英文论文摘要的连续叙述中，激活落在普通学术句式、逻辑连接词和专业词附近；与其他论文段落的公式型激活未必相同。

patterns.name: 临床研究中的治疗与试验措辞
patterns.context: 医学摘要叙述治疗、研究设计和分组时出现；本例独有，无法归入其他已见模式。

en.concept: Proper nouns and notation in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across code identifiers, enums and API names, program comments, and mathematical formulas/LaTeX notation. Specific triggers differ across passages, with no single stable semantic or morphological pattern.

patterns.name: Mode/Mode enums in identifiers
patterns.context: Type names, enum names, or members in program code; Mode often appears with configuration options or behavior modes.

patterns.name: _h header guards in code
patterns.context: #ifndef/#define macro guards at the top of C/C++ header files, with identifiers formed by concatenated words and ending in _h.

patterns.name: Mathematical inner products and bracket notation
patterns.context: Angle brackets in LaTeX mathematical text denote inner products or subspaces spanned by vectors.

patterns.name: Convolution kernel sizes and channel parameters
patterns.context: Describes the kernel size, number of channels, and use of two-dimensional convolution filters.

patterns.name: Octal escapes and flags
patterns.context: Code selects octal escapes according to a Strict context branch or sets an Octal flag.

patterns.name: Conditional insertion methods for Java Map
patterns.context: Explains alternative ways to compute or insert key-value pairs as needed in Java 8 and older versions.

patterns.name: Bitwise AND and PHP hexadecimal notation
patterns.context: Distinguishes PHP bitwise and logical AND and discusses hexadecimal value representation.

patterns.name: Purpose statements and parameterized formulas in mathematics papers
patterns.context: Summarizes research aims in a paper abstract or main text, involving the Milnor conjecture, counterexamples, and signatures of quadratic forms.

patterns.name: Probability iterators and boundary characters
patterns.context: C++ loops over a probabilities container; code is preceded by a string of equals signs resembling a heading separator.

5_1000.concept: 技术文本中的专名与记号
5_1000.description: 激活分散在代码标识符、枚举和 API 名称、程序注释及数学论文公式／LaTeX 记号中。各段具体触发形式不同，未见单一稳定的语义或词形模式。

patterns.name: 标识符中的 Mode／Mode 枚举
patterns.context: 程序代码中的类型名、枚举名或成员名；Mode 常与配置选项或行为模式连用。

patterns.name: 代码中的 _h 头文件保护符
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件顶部的 #ifndef/#define 宏保护，标识符由多个词拼接并以 _h 结尾。

patterns.name: 数学内积与括号记号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学文本中用角括号表示内积或由向量张成的子空间。

patterns.name: 卷积核尺寸和通道参数
patterns.context: 说明二维卷积滤波器的核大小、通道数及其用途。

patterns.name: 八进制转义与标志位
patterns.context: 代码按 Strict 上下文分支选择八进制转义，或设置 Octal 标志。

patterns.name: Java Map 的条件插入方法
patterns.context: 解释 Java 8 与旧版本中按需计算或插入键值的替代写法。

patterns.name: 按位 AND 与 PHP 十六进制
patterns.context: 区分 PHP 的按位与逻辑 AND，并讨论十六进制数值表示。

patterns.name: 数学论文目的句式与参数化公式
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文概述研究目的，涉及 Milnor 猜想、反例和二次型签名。

patterns.name: 概率迭代器及界线字符
patterns.context: C++ 循环遍历 probabilities 容器；代码前有类似标题分隔线的等号串。

en.description: Activation is distributed across “The purpose of” in statements of research aims, compound code identifiers, webpage table headers, lists of state names in news, and a passage on probability philosophy; no clear shared semantic or syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Research-purpose statements introduced by purpose
patterns.context: Appears in academic paper text, followed by a research goal, operation, or method; sometimes carries over from preceding text across sentences or paragraphs.

patterns.name: Code members and property names
patterns.context: In code or API identifiers, activation falls on components of camel-case compound names, especially Mode.

patterns.name: Table and column headers
patterns.context: Column or table headers in webpages or encyclopedia entries, separated by newlines or spaces and often accompanied by lists, seasons, or category information.

patterns.name: Lists of place names
patterns.context: News reports list state names after “including”; activation concentrates on multiple place names and their components.

patterns.name: Probability notation and conditional updating
patterns.context: Philosophical arguments discussing degrees of belief, conditioning, and probability updating.

5_1000.description: 激活模式分散：论文目的句中的“The purpose of”、代码复合标识符、网页表格标题、新闻中的州名列举，以及一段概率哲学术语；没有明显共同的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: purpose 引导的论文目的陈述
patterns.context: 出现在学术论文正文中，后接研究目的、操作或方法；有时跨句或跨段承接前文。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（计算机科学、数学、物理）

patterns.name: 代码成员与属性名
patterns.context: 代码或 API 标识符中，激活落在驼峰式复合名称的组成部分，尤其是 Mode。

patterns.name: 表格与栏目标题
patterns.context: 网页或百科条目中以换行、空白分隔的栏目/表格标题，常伴随名单、赛季或分类信息。

patterns.name: 地名列表
patterns.context: 新闻报道中，在“including”之后列出州名；激活集中于多个地名及其组成词。

patterns.name: 概率符号及条件化更新
patterns.context: 讨论信念度、条件化和概率更新的哲学论证。

en.description: Activations are scattered across punctuation and document boundaries, numbers and alphanumeric identifiers, split technical words or proper names, and a few paper-structure and explanatory phrases; they span code, encyclopedias, and biomedical texts, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Structural markers and boundary symbols
patterns.context: Activations occur near line breaks, separators, and punctuation in code diffs, lists, or document structures; paragraphs also contain ordinary prose or code, with no single fixed symbol combination.
patterns.domain: Code, technical documents, and paper section formatting

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers occur in different contexts such as patch line numbers, enumeration values, measurements, years, or formula parameters; numbers themselves and adjacent punctuation are also activated.
patterns.domain: Code, encyclopedias, Q&A, and academic texts

patterns.name: Technical proper names and alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Technical identifiers such as genes, proteins, viral genes, and code symbols combine letters and numbers or segmented abbreviations; this is not restricted to one domain.
patterns.domain: Code, molecular biology, and medical research

patterns.name: Tokenization and transliteration fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Personal or place names are split into multiple subword tokens; activation falls on local parts of proper names rather than sentence meaning.

patterns.name: Technical terms and terminology subwords
patterns.context: Technical terms or file names are split into subwords, with activation distributed across local fragments; implementation explanations or method descriptions often surround them.
patterns.domain: Software engineering and machine learning papers

patterns.name: Comparison operations and logical explanations
patterns.context: When explaining how enumeration values or operators are parsed, comparison-operation names and their components are highlighted.

patterns.name: Geographic area and unit expressions
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry gives a region's area, a value, and a parenthetical conversion between imperial and metric units.

patterns.name: Paper organization and statements of purpose
patterns.context: Near paper section headings, research-purpose sentences, and methods or related-work sections.

patterns.name: General function words and phrases
patterns.context: Common words in sentence-opening or explanatory structures receive sporadic activation across genres, without forming a stable independent semantic pattern.

5_1000.concept: 异质的结构与子词特征
5_1000.description: 激活分散于标点与文档边界、数字和字母数字标识符、被拆分的技术词或专名，以及少量论文结构和解释性短语；跨代码、百科与生物医学文本，缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 结构化标记与边界符号
patterns.context: 代码差异、列表或文档结构中，换行、分隔符及标点附近出现激活；段内同时有普通叙述或代码，未见单一固定符号组合。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术文档与论文小节格式

patterns.name: 数字与编号串
patterns.context: 数字出现在补丁行号、枚举值、测量数据、年份或公式参数等不同语境；数字本身与邻近标点也有激活。
patterns.domain: 代码、百科、问答及学术文本

patterns.name: 技术专名与字母数字标识符
patterns.context: 基因、蛋白、病毒基因、代码符号等技术标识符中，字母与数字或分段缩写组合出现；并非只限某个领域。
patterns.domain: 代码、分子生物学与医学研究

patterns.name: 专名中的分词与转写片段
patterns.context: 人名或地名被切成多个子词 token；激活落在专名局部而非整句语义上。

patterns.name: 技术词与术语子词
patterns.context: 技术术语或文件名被拆成子词，激活分布在术语的局部片段；周围常有实现说明或方法描述。
patterns.domain: 软件工程与机器学习论文

patterns.name: 比较运算与逻辑解释
patterns.context: 解释枚举值或运算符如何解析时，比较操作名称及其组成词被突出。

patterns.name: 地理面积及单位表达
patterns.context: 百科条目给出地区面积、数值和英制/公制单位的括号换算。

patterns.name: 论文组织与目的表述
patterns.context: 论文小节标题、研究目的句以及方法或相关工作段落附近。

patterns.name: 通用功能词与短语
patterns.context: 常见句首或解释性结构中的词有零散激活，跨体裁出现，未形成稳定独立语义模式。

en.concept: Compound words and structured text fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across mixed-case proper nouns, identifiers and code fragments, as well as formula numerals and symbols and encyclopedia headings. The common pattern is weak, but activations often occur in compound words split by tokenization or in structured text.

patterns.name: Mixed capitalization and type identifiers
patterns.context: An HTML document fragment embeds a Java interface declaration; markers surround public, generic/HTML tags, and camel-case type names. Multiple lexical fragments activate in this passage, with no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: Numbers and mathematical notation
patterns.context: Numbers in formulas, values, units, or arithmetic in multiple-choice questions; activation is distributed across symbols, numbers, and adjacent text.

patterns.name: Numbered intervals with I and range notation
patterns.context: Layer indices denote interval ranges in physics papers, with numbers interspersed with mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Place names and category headings
patterns.context: Category lists in encyclopedia entries, around names of places, landforms, protected areas, and other categories; activation specifically concentrates on place names and heading words.

patterns.name: Hungarian team names and competition terms
patterns.context: Football-season descriptions involving Hungarian league names and promotion contexts; activation is distributed across tokenized fragments of proper nouns.

patterns.name: Proper names of ecclesiastical offices
patterns.context: Historical passages mention prince-archbishops and place names such as Mainz; proper nouns activate in subword fragments.

patterns.name: C# properties and preprocessor macros
patterns.context: Code comments, access modifiers, property declarations, and conditional compilation macros; activation falls on code keywords and macro-name fragments.

patterns.name: Production companies and regional names
patterns.context: Film industry introductions mention regions, families, and production companies; regional proper nouns and regional adjectives activate.

patterns.name: SQLite Blob code identifiers
patterns.context: Function calls and switch/case branches for handling SQLite Blob values; activation falls on library names, identifiers, and fragments of uppercase enum constants.

5_1000.concept: 复合词与结构化文本片段
5_1000.description: 激活分散于混合大小写的专名、标识符与代码词片段，也覆盖公式数字符号及百科标题；共同规律不稳，常见于被分词切开的复合词或结构化文本。

patterns.name: 混合大写与类型标识符
patterns.context: HTML 文档片段中嵌入 Java 接口声明，标记围绕 public、泛型/HTML 标签和驼峰式类型名；此段表现为多类词法片段共同激活，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 数字与数学记号
patterns.context: 公式、数值、单位或选择题中的数字运算；激活分布在符号、数字及其邻接文本上。
patterns.domain: 天体物理学论文、数学题

patterns.name: 带 I 的编号及范围记号
patterns.context: 物理论文中用层索引表示区间范围，数字与数学符号混排。

patterns.name: 地名与分类标题
patterns.context: 百科条目中的分类列表，围绕地名、地貌及保护区域等分类名称；具体激活集中在地名及标题词。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语球队名与赛事词
patterns.context: 足球赛季叙述，出现匈牙利联赛名称及升级语境；激活分散在被拆分的专名片段。

patterns.name: 主教职位专名
patterns.context: 历史叙述中谈及选帝侯大主教及美因茨等地名，专名被分词片段激活。

patterns.name: C# 属性与预处理宏
patterns.context: 代码注释、访问修饰符、属性声明及条件编译宏；激活落在代码关键词和宏名片段。

patterns.name: 制片公司与地域名称
patterns.context: 电影产业介绍中出现地区、家族及制片公司相关叙述，地域专名和区域形容词激活。

patterns.name: SQLite Blob 代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码中处理 SQLite Blob 值的函数调用与 switch/case 分支；激活落在库名、标识符及大写枚举常量片段。

en.description: Activations occur in several types of structured text: code identifiers and branches, Hindi time labels, historical proper nouns, cosmological symbols, chemical structural formulas, and encyclopedia category listings.

patterns.name: Structured identifiers in code
patterns.context: Occurs in program code, especially identifiers composed of mixed-case fragments, underscores, or digits, as well as conditional compilation directives and method calls

patterns.name: Hindi time-judgment branches
patterns.context: Occurs in if/else if branches comparing meridiem strings and then returning or checking the hour
patterns.domain: GitHub code, time-handling logic with Hindi strings

patterns.name: Historical proper nouns and ecclesiastical jurisdictions
patterns.context: Proper nouns comprise multiple word fragments and appear in historical accounts of medieval ecclesiastical politics or dynastic figures

patterns.name: Cosmological parameter notation
patterns.context: Appears in cosmology papers, where mathematical symbols and values list the Hubble constant and cosmological parameters

patterns.name: Geographic categories in encyclopedia category listings
patterns.context: Lists of place names and their landform, protected-area, and other categories at the end of an entry or in a directory section

patterns.name: Bonds and molecular fragments in chemical structural formulas
patterns.context: Appears in names of molecules or complexes in chemistry papers, with bonds described using parentheses, element symbols, and text

patterns.name: Railway categories in encyclopedia category listings
patterns.context: Lists of categories for stations, including lines, transport type, region, and opening year

5_1000.description: 激活见于多类结构化文本：代码标识符与分支、印地语时间标签、历史专名、宇宙学符号、化学结构式，以及百科分类目录。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化标识符
patterns.context: 出现在程序代码中，尤其是由大小写片段、下划线或数字组成的标识符，以及条件编译指令和方法调用

patterns.name: 印地语时间判断分支
patterns.context: 位于比较 meridiem 字符串的 if/else if 分支中，并据此返回或判断小时
patterns.domain: Github 代码，时间处理逻辑，含印地语字符串

patterns.name: 历史人物与教会辖区专名
patterns.context: 专名由多个词片段组成，处于中世纪教会政治或王朝人物的历史叙述中
patterns.domain: 历史散文、百科全书条目

patterns.name: 宇宙学参数符号
patterns.context: 出现在宇宙学论文中，以数学符号和数值列举哈勃常数及宇宙学参数

patterns.name: 百科分类目录中的地理类别
patterns.context: 条目末尾或目录区域连续列出地名及其地貌、保护区等分类
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 分类列表

patterns.name: 化学结构式中的键与分子片段
patterns.context: 出现在化学论文的分子或配合物名称中，以括号、元素符号和文字描述化学键

patterns.name: 百科分类目录中的铁路类别
patterns.context: 连续列出车站所属线路、交通类型、地域和启用年份等分类
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 分类列表

en.description: Activations are distributed across code control symbols, identifiers and shell conditions, Wikipedia categories and entity names, and biomedical terminology, historical accounts, and sports biographies; no stable semantic trigger unifies these heterogeneous fragments.

patterns.name: Control structures and punctuation in code
patterns.context: Occurs in code rather than natural language, especially near conditionals, branches, and shell test expressions; activation often falls on structural symbols and adjacent tokens
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, JavaScript, Bash, etc.

patterns.name: Category labels and colon formatting
patterns.context: Category labels listed line by line after a colon at the end of Wikipedia entries

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper nouns and entity names
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across subword fragments of code identifiers, non-English strings, and proper nouns such as personal names, place names, and competition names, with no significant consistency in meaning or context
patterns.domain: Source code, scientific abstracts, encyclopedia text, and categories

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and configuration commands
patterns.context: Adjacent to program variables, constants, commands, or configuration items; some activations fall on identifier fragments
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and shell configuration

patterns.name: English category descriptions and biographical facts
patterns.context: Sports categories, awards, or life events in biographical entries; appears in continuous prose as well as category lists

patterns.name: Biological experimental terminology and mutant notation
patterns.context: Protein/gene abbreviations and mutant combinations occur when discussing vacuole morphology or fission defects

patterns.name: Inheritance and sieges in historical accounts
patterns.context: Encyclopedic accounts of personal lineages and medieval political and military events

patterns.name: Duration boundary comparisons
patterns.context: Function code that compares values with upper and lower bounds and handles boundary cases

5_1000.description: 激活分布于代码控制符号、标识符与 shell 条件、维基百科分类和实体名称，以及生物医学术语、历史叙述与体育履历；未见能统一解释这些异质片段的稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码中的控制结构与标点
patterns.trigger: “} else if”, “[[”, “then”, “]”; 另有代码中的括号、花括号及分号
patterns.context: 出现在代码而非自然语言中，尤其是条件判断、分支和 shell 测试表达式附近；激活常落在结构符号及其相邻 token 上

patterns.name: 类别标签及冒号格式
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾以冒号引出、逐行罗列的分类标签

patterns.name: 专名及实体名称中的切分片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在代码标识符、非英语字符串和人名、地名、赛事名称等专名的子词片段上，没有显著一致的词义或上下文条件
patterns.domain: 源码、科学摘要、百科正文及分类

patterns.name: 技术标识符和配置命令
patterns.context: 与程序变量、常量、命令或配置项相邻；部分激活落在标识符片段上
patterns.domain: Github 源码和 shell 配置

patterns.name: 英文类别描述与履历事实
patterns.trigger: “American male freestyle swimmers”“silver medalists”“Road incident deaths”；“won the silver medal”
patterns.context: 人物条目中的运动类别、奖项或生平事实；除分类列表外，也出现在连续叙述中

patterns.name: 生物学实验术语与突变体记法
patterns.context: 讨论液泡形态或分裂缺陷时，出现蛋白/基因缩写和突变体组合记法

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的继承与围城
patterns.trigger: “Son or grandson of Abu Yaqub Yusuf”, “succeeded in 1307”, “laying siege”
patterns.context: 人物世系和中世纪政治军事事件的百科叙述

patterns.name: 时长边界比较
patterns.context: 把数值与上下限常量比较并进行边界处理的函数代码

en.description: Activations are scattered across code boundary symbols, tokenized proper names and identifiers, encyclopedia categories and personal names, astronomical formula notation, and biological abbreviations; they span domains and have unstable trigger forms, so no single pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Marker boundaries or structural symbols
patterns.context: In code or text with structural markers, activation occurs near boundary symbols such as line breaks or closing parentheses; the specific symbols differ across examples

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on subword fragments of tokenized proper names or identifiers; there is no stable shared word form

patterns.name: Category and regional terms
patterns.context: Around place, transport-category, or country names in encyclopedia category entries

patterns.name: Astronomical parameter notation
patterns.context: Near cosmological parameters and numerical formulas, including Greek-letter variables and LaTeX notation

patterns.name: Biological abbreviations and mutation names
patterns.context: Biomedical abstracts involving vacuole fission, proteins, or mutants; gene names and abbreviations are tokenized

patterns.name: Time words and time-of-day conditions
patterns.context: Code uses Hindi time-of-day words to check the current hour

patterns.name: Fragments in English titles
patterns.context: Compound titles such as Prince-Archbishop appear in historical narratives, with activation concentrated on tokenized word fragments

patterns.name: Numerical units and cosmological notation
patterns.context: Observational units, parameter symbols, and exponential notation in astrophysics texts

patterns.name: Sports figures and club names
patterns.context: In personal profiles, nationalities and team names are split into multiple subword fragments

5_1000.description: 激活分散在代码边界符号、切分后的专名与标识符、百科类别和人物名称、天文公式记号及生物学缩写等处；跨领域、触发形式不稳定，无法由单一模式解释。

patterns.name: 标记边界或结构符号
patterns.context: 代码或带结构标记的文本中，激活落在换行、闭括号等边界符号附近；不同样例具体符号并不一致
patterns.domain: Github 代码及结构化文本

patterns.name: 专名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名或标识符被切分后的子词片段；没有稳定的共同词形

patterns.name: 类别与地域名词
patterns.context: 百科分类条目中，围绕地点、交通类别或国家名称

patterns.name: 天文参数记号
patterns.context: 宇宙学参数及数值公式附近，包含希腊字母变量和 LaTeX 标记

patterns.name: 生物学缩写与突变名
patterns.context: 涉及液泡分裂、蛋白或突变体的生物医学摘要；基因名与缩写被分词

patterns.name: 时间词与时段条件
patterns.context: 代码用印地语时段词判断当前小时

patterns.name: 英文职衔中的片段
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现选帝侯大主教等复合职衔，激活集中于切分词片段

patterns.name: 数值单位与宇宙学记号
patterns.context: 天文物理文本中的观测单位、参数符号及指数记法

patterns.name: 体育人物与俱乐部名称
patterns.context: 人物简介中，国籍与球队名称被切分为多个子词片段

en.description: Activations appear in code syntax boundaries, identifiers/constants, numerical ranges and proper nouns, and also cover biology, astrophysics, and spin-transport terminology. The commonality is weak, with a possible preference for technical symbols and labels in structured text.

patterns.name: Syntax/punctuation boundaries in structured source code
patterns.context: Triggers occur in structured code or configuration text, often near statement, branch, assignment, or field boundaries; however, the specific syntactic roles differ across passages.

patterns.name: Numerical and unit/range expressions
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in parameters, hardware identifiers, constant bounds, or mathematical ranges; no unified numeric type or fixed position is apparent.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, hardware code, and program constants

patterns.name: Category labels and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs in encyclopedia category lists or code identifiers, with activation covering labels, proper nouns, and nearby text in varied forms.

patterns.name: Biological proper nouns and mutant notation
patterns.context: Appears in sentences describing vacuole fission, deletion mutants, and phenotypes in experimental results.

patterns.name: Cosmological parameter notation
patterns.context: Adjacent to cosmological constants, density parameters, and their values in descriptions of paper parameters.

patterns.name: Spin-transport terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in physical descriptions of layered systems and scattering regions, also containing mathematical layer-index ranges.

patterns.name: Indian-language terms
patterns.context: Occurs as a string literal compared with meridiem to select hour-handling logic; activation falls near Devanagari terms and punctuation.

patterns.name: Range-oriented limit constants
patterns.context: A function compares an input value with upper and lower bounds and returns a clamped value; activation concentrates near constant names and comparison logic.

5_1000.description: 激活散见于代码语法边界、标识符/常量、数值范围与专名，也覆盖生物学、天体物理及自旋输运术语；共同点较弱，似偏好结构化文本中的技术性符号与标签。

patterns.name: 结构化源码中的语法/标点边界
patterns.trigger: 代码中的分号、花括号、箭头、冒号、等号、括号及换行，如「;」「} else if」「->」「=」
patterns.context: 触发点位于结构化代码或配置文本中，常在语句、分支、赋值或字段边界附近；但不同段落中的具体语法角色并不一致。
patterns.domain: Github 与 StackExchange 的源码/技术文本

patterns.name: 数值与单位/范围表达
patterns.trigger: 数字及其相邻符号或单位，如「$H_0=71」「0.3」「0.7」「RF5390」「MINIMUM_DURATION」「1\leq I\leq N」
patterns.context: 数值嵌在参数、硬件编号、常量上下限或数学范围中；没有显示出统一的数值类型或固定位置。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、硬件代码及程序常量

patterns.name: 类别标签与实体名称
patterns.trigger: 「Category:」「Airport railway stations」「UN」及「St. Louis County, Missouri」等专名/标签
patterns.context: 出现在百科分类列表或代码标识符中，激活覆盖标签、专名及其附近文本，形式各异。

patterns.name: 生物学专名及突变记法
patterns.context: 出现在描述液泡分裂、缺失突变及表型的实验结果句中。

patterns.name: 宇宙学参数记法
patterns.context: 与宇宙学常数、密度参数及其数值相邻，位于论文参数说明中。

patterns.name: 自旋输运领域术语
patterns.context: 出现在分层系统及散射区的物理描述中，附近还含数学层索引范围。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 凝聚态/自旋电子学论文

patterns.name: 印度语词项
patterns.context: 作为字符串字面量，与 meridiem 比较并选择小时逻辑；激活落在天城文词项及其标点附近。

patterns.name: 面向区间的限制常量
patterns.context: 函数把输入数值与上下限比较并返回限制值；激活集中在常量名和比较逻辑附近。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of proper names, code identifiers, scientific symbols, and license markers, with no obvious shared semantic topic. At most, they share sensitivity to specialized names or formatted strings.

patterns.name: Countries, regions, and place names in proper names
patterns.context: Place or administrative-region names occur in prose, case captions, or category entries; activation often falls on words that make up the place name.
patterns.domain: Historical narratives, legal entries, railway categories

patterns.name: Code identifiers and structured syntax
patterns.context: Programming text contains identifiers, member names, enumeration values, file names, or syntax markers; activation is scattered across code symbols and their components.
patterns.domain: Code, code comments, software documentation, and change descriptions

patterns.name: Scientific parameters and mathematical notation
patterns.context: An astrophysics paper lists cosmological parameters, with activation near symbols, subscripts, and numerical expressions.

patterns.name: GPL license marker
patterns.context: A license name and link follow a file-header copyright notice.

5_1000.concept: 专门标记与命名字符串
5_1000.description: 激活分布在多类专名、代码标识符、科学符号和许可证标记上；没有明显共享的语义主题。共同点至多是对专门命名或格式化字符串较敏感。

patterns.name: 专名中的国家、地区与地名
patterns.trigger: “Elector-Archbishops of Mainz, Cologne”“Western Australia”“St. Louis County, Missouri”“United States”
patterns.context: 地名或行政区域名出现在正文、判例标题或分类条目中；激活常落在组成地名的词上。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、法律条目、铁路分类

patterns.name: 代码标识符与结构化语法
patterns.context: 编程文本中出现标识符、成员名、枚举值、文件名或语法标记；激活分散在代码符号及其组成部分上。
patterns.domain: 代码、代码注释、软件文档与变更说明

patterns.name: 科学参数与数学记号
patterns.context: 天体物理论文句子中列举宇宙学参数，激活紧邻符号、下标及数值表达式。

patterns.name: GPL 许可证标记
patterns.context: 文件头版权声明后出现许可证名称及链接。
patterns.domain: 开源软件版权/许可证文本

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and formatting features
en.description: Activations are scattered across local word forms and formatting: the fixed phrase with information, audio/streaming contexts, code indentation and modified, as well as isolated examples such as legal numbering, long time, and medical terminology; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: information collocations
patterns.context: Appears in phrases such as “For information about…” or “For your information.”; often preceded by For and followed by about or sentence-final punctuation.

patterns.name: audio and streaming
patterns.context: Discusses audio formats, audio input, or streaming services; related passages also contain words such as streaming, format, and Line In.

patterns.name: Legal provision number format
patterns.context: A fragment composed of numbers, letters, and punctuation resembling a clause or statute number, followed by a newline and uppercase NOT.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase long time
patterns.context: Occurs in “For a long time,” followed by a time adverbial and a medical-history narrative.

patterns.name: Indented code and modified identifier
patterns.context: Indented spaces and the modified identifier appear in code or source-file comments; the two occurrences have different syntax.

patterns.name: Pathology terminology fragment
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple subword fragments that form a medical term similar to refractory periodontitis; followed by a description related to abnormal white blood cell phagocytosis and smoking.

5_1121.concept: 多种局部词形与格式特征
5_1121.description: 激活分散于多种局部词形与格式：information 固定搭配、音频/流媒体语境、代码缩进与 modified，以及法律编号、long time 和医学术语等孤例；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: information 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在“For information about…”或“For your information.”一类短语中；前面常有 For，后接 about 或句末标点。

patterns.name: audio 与流媒体
patterns.context: 谈及音频格式、音频输入或流媒体服务；相关段落中也出现 streaming、format、Line In 等词。

patterns.name: 法律条文数字格式
patterns.context: 数字、字母和标点组成类似条款或法条编号的片段，后接换行及大写 NOT。

patterns.name: long time 固定搭配
patterns.context: 位于“For a long time”中，后接时间状语及医学史叙述。

patterns.name: 缩进代码与 modified 标识符
patterns.context: 代码或源文件注释中出现缩进空格及 modified 标识符；两处所在语法不同。

patterns.name: 病理学术语片段
patterns.context: 词被切分成多个子词，组成类似 refractory periodontitis 的医学术语；后接与异常白细胞吞噬作用和吸烟相关的描述。

en.description: Activation covers multiple local cues: information-giving phrasing, audio-technology terms and “long time,” legal numbering, modified in code and comment formatting, and medical term fragments. These cues are scattered and do not indicate a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: information collocations
patterns.context: Appears in “For information about ...” or “For your information.”; activation concentrates on information, with weaker activation on nearby For/your/about.
patterns.domain: General explanatory text, such as notices and emails

patterns.name: Long-time and audio-related terms
patterns.context: Appears separately in “a long time” and in technical contexts about streaming, audio formats, or Line In; trigger locations are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Medical narratives and audio/streaming technology text

patterns.name: Legal numbering and abbreviated punctuation
patterns.context: Combinations of numbers, letters, and periods in statutes or legal text; the specific numbering format is unclear.

patterns.name: modified identifier in code
patterns.context: Appears as a variable name or in project license text; in code it has an underscore, while in comments it appears as an ordinary word.
patterns.domain: Source code and software license comments

patterns.name: Comment delimiters and indentation
patterns.context: Opening and closing delimiters of C-style comments and alignment spaces within comments.

patterns.name: Medical word fragments and inflammation context
patterns.context: Subword fragments combine into the medical term “Refractory periodontitis,” in a discussion of leukocyte phagocytosis and smoking.

5_1121.description: 激活覆盖多种局部线索：信息告知句式、音频技术词及 long time、法律编号、代码中的 modified 与注释排版，以及医学术语片段；这些线索分散，未显示统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: information 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在“For information about ...”或“For your information.”中；触发集中在 information，周围的 For/your/about 也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 通知、邮件等一般说明性文本

patterns.name: 长音频相关词
patterns.context: 分别出现在“a long time”和关于流媒体、音频格式或 Line In 的技术语境中；触发位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学叙述及音频/流媒体技术文本

patterns.name: 法条编号与缩写标点
patterns.context: 法条或法律文本中的数字、字母和句点组合，具体编号格式不明。

patterns.name: 代码中的 modified 标识符
patterns.context: 作为变量名或项目许可文本中的词出现；在代码中带下划线，在注释中作为普通单词。
patterns.domain: 源代码与软件许可注释

patterns.name: 注释分隔符与缩进
patterns.context: C 风格注释的开闭分隔符与注释中的对齐空格。

patterns.name: 医学词语片段与炎症语境
patterns.context: 词片段跨接成医学术语“Refractory periodontitis”，并处于白细胞吞噬作用和吸烟的讨论中。

en.description: Activation is scattered across information notices, emails, audio-technology text, legal citations, medical time expressions, license disclaimers, and code comments. Some spans may be triggered by common words or formatting fragments, making them difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “For information” notices
patterns.context: Begins a sentence with “For information about...” to introduce details about inquiries, renewals, or scholarships.

patterns.name: Information notices in email
patterns.context: An email begins with “For your information.” followed by a recipient or forwarded content.

patterns.name: Audio-related text
patterns.context: Contains audio in contexts involving audio formats, playback volume, or audio input.

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers and abbreviations form a statute or legal citation format; followed by the new-paragraph marker “NOT”.

patterns.name: Time-duration expression
patterns.context: “For a long time” introduces a situation that has persisted over time.

patterns.name: Emphasis in license disclaimers
patterns.context: The license text emphasizes a disclaimer in uppercase and continues with warranty terms.

patterns.name: Modification and distribution terms in code comments
