patterns.context: Project license notes specify that files may be modified or distributed, or identify modified status in code.
patterns.domain: Software source code and license comments

5_1121.description: 激活分散于信息提示语、邮件、音频技术文本、法律引文、医学时间表达、许可证免责声明及代码注释；若干段可能由常见词或格式片段触发，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: “For information”信息提示语
patterns.context: 句首以“For information about...”引出咨询、续期或奖学金信息。

patterns.name: 邮件中的信息告知
patterns.context: 邮件开头使用“For your information.”，后接收件人或转发内容。

patterns.name: audio 音频相关文本
patterns.context: 出现 audio，并处于音频格式、播放音量或音频输入等语境。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与缩写
patterns.context: 数字和缩写构成法条或法律引用格式；后接新段落标记“NOT”。

patterns.name: 时间长度表达
patterns.context: “For a long time”引出过去持续发生的情况。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明中的强调词
patterns.context: 许可证正文以大写强调免责声明，并继续说明担保条款。
patterns.domain: 软件许可证与代码注释

patterns.name: 代码注释中的修改与分发条款
patterns.context: 项目许可说明规定文件可修改、分发，或标识代码中的 modified 状态。
patterns.domain: 软件源码与许可证注释

en.concept: Multiple local word-string and subword patterns
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: they include the phrase “For information,” audio-related words, split proper names, and local strings in legal citations, medical narratives, and license disclaimers; there is no single stable triggering feature.

patterns.name: “information” phrase
patterns.context: “For” introduces an informational explanation; information may be preceded by about/your and followed by a period or other text

patterns.name: Audio formats and processing
patterns.context: Discusses audio formats, streaming loudness processing, or codecs and controllers

patterns.name: Proper names / within-word segmentation
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple subword fragments; includes names or product names such as Nelson Stepanyan and YETI Colster

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: Numbers and abbreviations form a U.S. case citation, followed by a newline and “NOT”

patterns.name: Medical history narrative
patterns.context: Begins with a time adverbial and describes how medical history is recorded

patterns.name: License disclaimer
patterns.context: Warranty disclaimer in a software license; activation is concentrated on the contrastive word but and uppercase emphasis

5_1121.concept: 多种局部词串与子词模式
5_1121.description: 激活模式分散：包含“For information”词组、音频相关词、被拆分的专名，以及法律引文、医学叙述和许可证免责声明中的局部词串；没有单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: “information”词组
patterns.trigger: «For» … «information»，包括 “For information about” 和 “For your information”
patterns.context: “For”引出信息说明，information 前可有 about/your，后可接句点或其他内容

patterns.name: 音频格式与处理
patterns.trigger: «audio»，以及与其相邻的 “Opus”“format”“Loudness Penalty”“audio codec”“audio controller”
patterns.context: 讨论音频格式、流媒体响度处理或编解码器及控制器

patterns.name: 专名/词内分段激活
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词片段；含 Nelson Stepanyan、YETI Colster 等人名或产品名

patterns.name: 法条引文格式
patterns.context: 数字与缩写构成美国判例引文，后接换行及 “NOT”

patterns.name: 病史叙述
patterns.trigger: «For» «a» «long» «time»，后接 “medical history was written by physicians”
patterns.context: 以一段时间状语开头，叙述医学史记录方式

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明
patterns.trigger: “NormalmapGenerator is distributed in the hope that it will be useful”及«but»«WITHOUT» … «WARRANTY»
patterns.context: 软件许可证中的无担保免责声明；激活集中于转折词 but 及大写强调语

en.description: Activation concentrates on internal subword fragments (such as Gynecologist, Combined, and Architecture), and also responds to the notice wording “For information” and a string of digits and letters; triggers span domains and have limited semantic coherence.

patterns.name: Numeric and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Sequences mixing digits, spaces, and single letters or short letter strings; the fragment is followed by a newline and “NOT”.

patterns.name: Information notice wording
patterns.context: Begins with “For information” or “For your information,” followed by a specific matter or email content.

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-initial or internal subword fragments in several words; meanings and continuations vary, with no unified semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, medical paper abstracts, and encyclopedia entries

en.description: Activations are distributed across code and natural language: the Go type string, source-code identifiers, two English phrases, and an HTTP error message. The marked-token positions and meanings vary substantially, making it difficult to identify a single stable feature.

patterns.name: string in code identifiers
patterns.context: In Go function parameters or return-value declarations, string appears as a type name; [3] also contains the Java identifier RecordStringConverterLoader, but not a standalone string type.

patterns.name: HTTP error text in code
patterns.context: In an HTTP protocol response error message, not has the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and terminal error output

patterns.name: The English phrase not try too hard
patterns.context: In an informal suggestion, hard ends the phrase try too hard; the preceding text discusses whether to make a project link public.

patterns.name: Ongoing activity introduced by English while
patterns.context: while appears in a clause describing rapid iteration and a drawing workflow; quickly iterating also appears nearby in the segment.

patterns.name: Parameter or variable names in code
patterns.context: Function parameters or variable identifiers are marked in code from different languages; there is no clear shared semantic category.
patterns.domain: Java, Go, C++, Java, and other code

patterns.name: Code tokens not grouped into a stable pattern
patterns.context: Types, methods, members, and operators occur in varied code positions; the samples do not establish a common trigger condition.

5_1121.description: 激活分散在代码与自然语言中：Go 的 string 类型、源码标识符，以及两处英语短语和一处 HTTP 错误文本。标记 token 的位置与语义差异较大，难以归为单一稳定特征。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 string
patterns.context: Go 函数参数或返回值的类型声明中，string 作为类型名出现；[3] 也有 Java 标识符 RecordStringConverterLoader，但并非独立的 string 类型。

patterns.name: 代码中的 HTTP 错误文本
patterns.context: HTTP 协议响应错误信息中，not 处激活最强。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及终端错误输出

patterns.name: 英语短语 not try too hard
patterns.context: 口语化建议中，hard 是短语 try too hard 的结尾，前文讨论是否公开链接项目。

patterns.name: 英语 while 引导的进行中活动
patterns.context: while 位于描述快速迭代、绘图流程的从句中；本段附近还出现 quickly iterating。

patterns.name: 代码中的参数名或变量名
patterns.context: 不同语言代码中，函数形参或变量标识符被标记；没有明显统一的语义类别。

patterns.name: 未归入稳定模式的代码 token
patterns.context: 代码中的类型、方法、成员或操作符位置各异，无法由样本确认共同触发条件。

en.concept: Mixed fast and technical code fragments
en.description: There is more than one activation pattern: several passages highlight fast and comparisons of speed or intensity; others involve HTTP errors, Android date-time callbacks, Go functions and endpoint status, or explanations of C pointers.

patterns.name: fast in comparative or speed contexts
patterns.context: Describes speed or intensity, often in structures such as “fast as …”, “as fast as …”, or “pages fast enough”; fast is directly marked in multiple passages.
patterns.domain: News, book reviews, game instructions, aviation narratives

patterns.name: HTTP and protocol terminology
patterns.context: Concerns the HTTP protocol and its version in a StackExchange curl command or error message.

patterns.name: Android time-picker callback
patterns.context: A callback name, Picker type, and parameters in a Java method declaration.

patterns.name: Cookie signing function declaration
patterns.context: A Go function signature with parameters including string and time.Time.

patterns.name: Endpoint marked down
patterns.context: Go code marks a cluster endpoint as unavailable.

patterns.name: C pointers and explanation of variable addresses
patterns.context: Explains pointer assignment and taking the address of a variable itself.

5_1121.concept: 混合的 fast 与技术代码片段
5_1121.description: 激活模式不止一种：多段突出 fast 及速度、力度比较；其余分别落在 HTTP 错误、Android 日期时间回调、Go 函数与 endpoint 状态、C 指针解释等代码或技术语境。

patterns.name: Cookie 签名函数声明
patterns.context: Go 语言函数签名，参数含 string 和 time.Time

patterns.name: C 指针与变量地址说明
patterns.context: 解释指针赋值及取变量自身地址

en.concept: Expressions of speed and force (with code noise)
en.description: Activations occur most consistently on expressions of speed or force such as fast and hard, and also on words related to button operations. They additionally cover code/API text, error tracebacks, and mixed Chinese-English technical text; the latter categories lack a unifying semantic cue.

patterns.name: Expressions of speed/force
patterns.context: The trigger word describes speed, force, or degree; it sometimes occurs in comparative or sufficiency constructions.
patterns.domain: Narrative, game instructions, news quotations, and commentary

patterns.name: Buttons, clicks, and interface controls
patterns.context: Buttons, keys, clicks, and their responses appear in interface code or usage instructions.

patterns.name: Specific code/API identifiers
patterns.context: API, protocol, encoding names, and identifier fragments in code or technical Q&A; no consistent local semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Tracebacks and file information
patterns.context: The traceback heading and file and line-number entries in Python error output.

patterns.name: Mixed Chinese-English text and Chinese character fragments
patterns.context: Chinese content is split into several tokens, appearing in code comments or URL-encoding Q&A examples.

patterns.name: Page-turning action
patterns.context: In reading-related narratives, “turn the pages” describes page-turning and emphasizes speed.

5_1121.concept: 速度与力度表达（兼有代码噪声）
5_1121.description: 激活最稳定地落在 fast、hard 等速度或力度表达，也见于按钮操作相关词；另覆盖代码/API、错误回溯和中英文混合技术文本，后几类缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: 快速/用力程度表达
patterns.trigger: «fast»；«hard»，尤其是“as fast as possible”“as fast as they have”“as hard as I could”“push hard enough”
patterns.context: 触发词用于描述速度、力度或程度；有时处于比较或足够条件结构中
patterns.domain: 叙述、游戏说明、新闻引语、评论

patterns.name: 按钮、点击与界面控件
patterns.context: 界面代码或操作说明中出现按钮、按键、点击及其响应

patterns.name: 特定代码/API 标识符
patterns.context: 代码或技术问答中的 API、协议、编码名和标识符片段；未见统一的局部语义条件
patterns.domain: Github 与 StackExchange 技术文本

patterns.name: 追踪回溯与文件信息

patterns.name: 中英文混合及中文字符片段
patterns.context: 中文内容被拆成若干 token，出现在代码注释或 URL 编码问答示例中

patterns.name: 翻页动作
patterns.context: 阅读叙述中以“turn the pages”表达翻页，并强调速度

en.description: Activation primarily occurs on the opening brace of code function bodies, function signatures, and nearby syntax; it also appears in “as…as” degree comparisons. There are scattered activations on HTTP error text and several code identifiers and parameter symbols.

patterns.name: “as … as” comparative structure
patterns.context: The preposition as introduces a degree comparison, followed by an adjective or adverb, then another as introducing the comparison target or degree.
patterns.domain: Narrative prose and patent technical text

patterns.name: C++ function definition and brace
patterns.context: A C++ function or method declaration is followed by the function body; activation concentrates on the opening brace and nearby types and symbols.

patterns.name: Go method declaration and function body
patterns.context: A Go method signature is followed by an opening brace that begins the function body, surrounded by types, method name, and return type.

patterns.name: Rust function signature and function body
patterns.context: A public function signature and parameter list within a Rust impl block; activation falls near the comma after self.

patterns.name: HTTP error response text
patterns.context: A command-line tool reports an HTTP protocol error; activation falls on not.

patterns.name: Function name in an ellipsis
patterns.context: A method named list is declared after a web routing annotation; activation concentrates on the method name and nearby syntax.

patterns.name: Technical field name FieldSelector
patterns.context: The C-style function name contains FieldSelector, surrounded by a typed parameter list.

patterns.name: Scattered structural markers in code
patterns.context: Code identifiers, type names, scope symbols, or object names; apart from patterns such as function-body openings, the examples lack a shared local trigger condition.

patterns.name: close in technical text
patterns.context: A measurement or titration description calls for a measurement result as close as possible to a turning-point value.

5_1121.description: 激活主要出现在代码函数体左大括号、函数签名及其邻近语法，也见于“as…as”程度比较；另有 HTTP 错误文本与若干代码标识符、参数符号的零散激活。

patterns.name: “as … as”比较结构
patterns.trigger: [1] “as hard as I could”；[5] “as close as possible”
patterns.context: 介词 as 引出程度比较，后接形容词或副词，再以 as 引出比较对象或程度

patterns.name: C++函数定义与大括号
patterns.context: C++函数或方法声明后进入函数体；激活集中于左大括号及其邻近类型、符号

patterns.name: Go方法声明与函数体

patterns.name: Rust函数签名与函数体

patterns.context: Rust impl 块中的公开函数签名与参数列表；激活落在 self 后的逗号附近

patterns.name: HTTP错误响应文本

patterns.name: 省略号中的函数名

patterns.name: 技术字段名 FieldSelector
patterns.context: C 风格函数名中出现 FieldSelector，周围为类型化参数列表

patterns.name: 代码中的零散结构性标记
patterns.context: 代码标识符、类型名、作用域符号或对象名称；除函数体起始等模式外，各例缺乏共同的局部触发条件

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 close
patterns.context: 测量或滴定描述中要求测量结果尽可能接近某个转折点数值
patterns.domain: 专利背景、化学测量说明

en.concept: Opening braces and locally informative words
en.description: Strong responses occur in several local patterns: opening braces in code and nearby function signatures, as well as identifiers such as rest, Selector, and discretization. Text also contains scattered expressions such as fast enough, batted, far as you can, not allowed, and push hard enough, with little stable semantic connection among them.

patterns.name: Opening braces and the start of code blocks
patterns.context: An opening brace in code for a function, method, or implementation block, often after the signature; [1] also has a following newline and indentation.

patterns.name: rest / Rest in code identifiers
patterns.context: The C++ method name RestartDemux is split into a subword containing rest; it also occurs near a method definition and opening brace.

patterns.name: Pages and expressions of speed
patterns.context: Narrative context describing a reader reading very fast and eager to turn pages.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, book reviews or narrative prose

patterns.name: Cricket terminology
patterns.context: Describes a team winning the toss and batting first; activation falls on the stem of batted.

patterns.name: Event type names and parameters
patterns.context: The parameter list of a touch-event handler ends, followed by the function body.

patterns.name: Wording about out-of-bounds reads
patterns.context: Discusses how a lack of safety can cause out-of-bounds reads across modules; Rust-style implementation code also appears nearby.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, software security discussion and code

patterns.name: Searching backward and as far as possible
patterns.context: An email requests searching as far back or as far out as possible in a database for relevant records.

patterns.name: Selector in an API identifier
patterns.context: The function name contains FieldSelector, followed by a parameter list; strong activation also occurs at the opening brace in the function body.

patterns.name: HTTP error response wording
patterns.context: curl reports receiving a disallowed HTTP/0.9 response; strong activation falls on not.

patterns.name: Pushing hard and bending
patterns.context: Using a straw as an example, describes how pushing hard enough will make it bend; activation is concentrated on hard.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, analogy explaining a physical phenomenon

patterns.name: Discretization parameter
patterns.context: The discretization parameter at the end of a C++ function signature and its closing parenthesis, followed by the start of the function body.

5_1121.concept: 左花括号与局部高信息词
5_1121.description: 强响应落在多类局部模式：代码块左花括号及邻近函数签名，也包括 rest、Selector、discretization 等标识符；文本中则散见 fast enough、batted、far as you can、not allowed、push hard enough 等表达，彼此缺少稳定语义联系。

patterns.name: 代码中的开括号与块体起始
patterns.context: 代码中函数、方法或实现块的左花括号，常出现在签名之后；[1] 还紧接换行和缩进

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 rest / Rest
patterns.context: C++ 方法名 RestartDemux 被拆成带有 rest 的子词；同时处于方法定义与左花括号附近

patterns.name: 页面与速度表达
patterns.context: 描述读者读得很快、急于翻页的叙述语境

patterns.name: 板球比赛术语
patterns.context: 描述球队赢得掷币并先击球；激活落在 batted 的词干部分

patterns.name: 事件类型名与参数
patterns.context: 触摸事件处理函数的参数列表结束，随后进入函数体

patterns.name: 越界读取相关措辞
patterns.context: 讨论缺少安全性会导致跨模块越界读取；附近还有 Rust 风格的实现代码

patterns.name: 往回查找并尽可能远
patterns.trigger: « back»4 as« far»9« as»1« you»3« can»3（[6]）
patterns.context: 邮件中要求在数据库里尽可能往前或往远处查找相关记录

patterns.name: API 标识符中的 Selector
patterns.context: 函数名包含 FieldSelector，后接参数列表；强激活另出现在函数体左花括号

patterns.name: HTTP 错误响应措辞
patterns.context: curl 报告收到不被允许的 HTTP/0.9 响应；强激活落在 not

patterns.name: 用力推动与弯折

en.description: Primarily responds to code-block opening braces, newline indentation, types and identifiers, and syntactic punctuation across multiple languages; also activates on Chinese code comments, HTML compatibility comments, and file-parsing documentation. There is also a segment of colloquial song lyrics.

patterns.name: Code-block opening brace
patterns.context: An opening brace starts a code block after a function, method, or property declaration in multiple languages; often accompanied by a newline and indentation.

patterns.name: Code newlines and indentation
patterns.context: Newlines, tabs, or space indentation in code structures, often near declarations, comments, or block boundaries.

patterns.name: Programming-language types and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Type names, variable names, method names, or parts of identifiers in code; occurs across languages and naming styles.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and syntactic boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation and delimiters at the ends of code expressions, parameter lists, declarations, or statements.

patterns.name: Writing and emotion words in natural language
patterns.context: Colloquial commentary discusses writing and despair, and includes “glimmer of resolve” when quoting lyrics; this segment does not fit the code patterns.

patterns.name: Chinese comment text

patterns.name: HTML comments and browser compatibility notes
patterns.context: An HTML comment describes HTML5 Shim, media queries, and limitations when opening a page via file://.

5_1121.description: 主要响应代码块左花括号、换行缩进、类型和标识符及语法标点，跨多种语言；也激活于中文代码注释、HTML兼容注释和文件解析文档。另有一段口语歌词文本。

patterns.name: 代码块左花括号
patterns.context: 多种语言的函数、方法或属性声明之后，左花括号开启代码块；常伴随换行和缩进。

patterns.name: 代码换行与缩进

patterns.name: 编程语言类型与标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码中的类型名、变量名、方法名或标识符组成部分；不同语言与命名风格均有出现。

patterns.name: 代码标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 代码表达式、参数列表、声明或语句结尾处的标点及分隔符。

patterns.name: 自然语言中的写作与情绪词
patterns.context: 口语化评论谈及写作和绝望，并在引述歌词时出现“glimmer of resolve”；此段不符合代码模式。

patterns.name: 中文注释文本
patterns.context: 代码块内的文档注释描述按钮单击处理；同时伴有注释格式和代码缩进。

patterns.name: HTML注释与浏览器兼容说明

en.concept: Code blocks and member declaration boundaries
en.description: Primarily responds to the opening brace `{` that begins a code block after a declaration or function signature, especially at the start of a function body. It also activates on `{`, property names, and get/set accessors in C# property declarations. A generic type name is activated in one other instance.

patterns.name: C# properties and property accessors
patterns.context: Near property names and accessors in C# class member declarations; activation often falls on the opening brace, and also occurs on property-name and accessor tokens.

patterns.name: Opening brace in a function or method definition
patterns.context: At the start of a code block or function body, immediately after the signature; sometimes the function name, return type, or parentheses also activate.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple programming languages (C, C++, Python, PowerShell)

patterns.name: Type boundaries in generic declarations
patterns.context: In C# generic property declarations, activation also occurs near type names inside and outside angle brackets; this co-occurs with the property-accessor pattern.

5_1121.concept: 代码块与成员声明边界
5_1121.description: 主要对代码中声明或函数签名之后开启代码块的左花括号 `{` 起反应，尤见函数体开头；也激活 C# 属性声明中的 `{`、属性名及 get/set 访问器。另在一处泛型类型名附近激活。

patterns.name: C# 属性与属性访问器
patterns.trigger: `{` 后跟 `get; set;`、`get { ... }` 或属性名，如 `LabelRule`、`operatingSystem`、`ImageName`、`Arguments`
patterns.context: C# 类成员声明中，属性名及属性访问器附近；激活常落在左花括号，也出现在属性名和访问器 token 上

patterns.name: 函数或方法定义的左花括号
patterns.trigger: 函数/方法签名后换行的 `{`，如 `spx_resource_stats_wall_time(void)`、`Get-TargetResource`、`restartDemux()`、`main()`，以及 `epyxfastload_roml_read(...)`
patterns.context: 代码块或函数体的开头，签名之后紧接左花括号；有时函数名、返回类型或括号也激活

patterns.name: 泛型声明中的类型边界
patterns.context: C# 泛型属性声明中，尖括号内外的类型名附近也有激活；与属性访问器模式同时出现

en.description: The strongest activation in every snippet falls on the code opening brace “{”, primarily at the start of function or method bodies, and also at the start of property accessors; languages and function types vary.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a function or method body
patterns.context: A function, method, or property-accessor declaration ends in code, immediately followed by its implementation body; occurs across multiple languages and function types.

patterns.name: Opening brace in a property accessor
patterns.context: A class property or property accessor implementation begins; in some examples, get or code follows directly after the brace.

patterns.name: Opening brace in a code structure (incomplete context)
patterns.context: Appears at a code-structure boundary, but the local context provided is insufficient to determine whether it is a function body or another code block.

5_1121.description: 所有片段的最强激活都落在代码左花括号“{”上，主要位于函数或方法体开头，也包括属性访问器开头；语言和函数类型各异。

patterns.name: 函数或方法体的起始大括号
patterns.trigger: 函数签名或声明后的 «{»10；常伴随 «↵» 或缩进
patterns.context: 代码中函数、方法或属性访问器的声明结束，紧接着进入实现体；跨多种语言和函数类型出现。

patterns.name: 属性访问器中的左花括号
patterns.context: 类属性或属性访问器实现开始；有的样例中花括号后直接出现 get 或代码。

patterns.name: 代码结构中的左花括号（上下文不完整）
patterns.context: 处在代码结构边界，但给出的局部上下文不足以确定它是函数体还是其他代码块。

en.description: Primarily responds to opening braces that begin code blocks after declarations; also commonly occurs in function parameter lists, type/generic declarations, and indented structures following newlines, across multiple programming languages.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a method or function body
patterns.context: After a function, method, or property-accessor declaration in code, usually followed by a newline into the body; occurs across multiple languages.

patterns.name: Parentheses and parameters in function declarations
patterns.context: A parameter list follows a function or method name, often adjacent to the return type and the function body's opening brace.
patterns.domain: C, C++, Go, Objective-C, and other source code

patterns.name: Type declarations and angle-bracket generics
patterns.context: C# property or collection type declarations; a property name, accessor, or generic closing symbol follows the type name.

patterns.name: Multiline source structure and indentation
patterns.context: After a declaration, comment, or code snippet ends with a newline, the next structure begins; activation often falls near the newline or start of the line.

5_1121.description: 主要响应源码中声明之后开启代码块的左花括号；也常见于函数参数列表、类型/泛型声明及换行后的缩进结构，跨多种编程语言。

patterns.name: 方法或函数体的左花括号
patterns.context: 代码中函数、方法或属性访问器声明之后，通常紧接换行进入函数体；多种语言均出现。

patterns.name: 函数声明中的括号与参数
patterns.trigger: «(»、«)»，以及 «args»、«addr»、«void» 等参数或类型 token
patterns.context: 函数名或方法名后出现参数列表，常与返回类型及函数体左花括号相邻。

patterns.name: 类型声明与尖括号泛型
patterns.context: C# 属性或集合类型声明；类型名后接属性名、访问器或泛型闭合符号。

patterns.name: 跨行源码结构与缩进
patterns.trigger: «↵»及其后的缩进、代码块起始位置
patterns.context: 声明、注释或代码片段换行后进入下一段结构；激活常落在换行或行首附近。

en.description: Primarily responds to opening braces and accessor structures in class-member property declarations or getters; it also responds to struct return types and local variables in Go test functions, and to opening braces that begin function bodies after C/C++ function signatures. The shared cue is declaration boundaries and braces in code.

patterns.name: C# property declarations and accessors
patterns.context: Property declarations or getter implementations in C# class members; activation is concentrated on the opening brace and near getter.

patterns.name: Struct slices in Go test helper functions
patterns.context: A function in Go test code that converts API resources into struct resources.

patterns.name: Start of C/C++ function definitions
patterns.context: The function signature ends and the function body begins; activation is concentrated on the opening brace.
patterns.domain: C/C++ source code; segment 9 is image-processing code with Portuguese comments, and segment 10 is an Android monitor API

5_1121.concept: 代码声明与花括号边界
5_1121.description: 主要响应类成员属性声明或 getter 中的左花括号及访问器结构；也响应 Go 测试函数的结构体返回类型与局部变量，以及 C/C++ 函数签名后开启函数体的左花括号。共同线索是代码中的声明边界和花括号。

patterns.name: C# 属性声明及访问器
patterns.trigger: `{ get; set; }`、`{ get { ... } }`、`{ get; private set ... }`；附近常有 `public`、属性名和类型
patterns.context: C# 类成员中属性声明或 getter 实现；激活集中于左花括号及 getter 附近
patterns.domain: Github/StackExchange 中的 C# 代码

patterns.name: Go 测试辅助函数中的结构体切片
patterns.context: Go 测试代码中把 API 资源转换为结构体资源的函数
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Go 测试代码

patterns.name: C/C++ 函数定义开头
patterns.context: 函数签名结束并开始函数体；激活集中在左花括号
patterns.domain: C/C++ 源码；段9为葡萄牙语注释的图像处理代码，段10为 Android 监视器 API

en.description: Primarily responds to declarations or accessors where a property name is followed by braces, especially C# properties; also covers Go function signatures with map parameters, comment boundaries, a specific label field, and a Java audio-list method.

patterns.name: C# property declaration and accessors
patterns.context: A property is declared in C#, usually with a type and property name, followed by braces and accessors; snippets may also contain only the start of a property accessor.

patterns.name: Map type in a Go function signature
patterns.context: A Go function declaration whose parameter is a map and whose return value is a string slice.
patterns.domain: Go test or implementation code in Github

patterns.name: Repeat-count property and its documentation
patterns.context: A comment describes an existing repeat count, followed by a C# integer property and getter.
patterns.domain: C# source code with XML documentation comments in Github

patterns.name: Comment markers and documentation-comment boundaries
patterns.context: The closing or opening positions of XML or block comments in code; adjacent to property declarations.

patterns.name: Chinese label-rule field
patterns.context: A Chinese comment says label IDs must be unique, followed by a list property mapped to JSON.

patterns.name: Audio file list method
patterns.context: A public method returns a list of audio files associated with a broadcast account, preceded by English documentation.
patterns.domain: Java source code and comments in StackExchange

5_1121.concept: 源代码成员声明与结构
5_1121.description: 主要响应代码中属性名后接花括号的声明或访问器，尤其是 C# 属性；另覆盖 Go 映射参数函数签名、注释边界、特定标签字段及 Java 音频列表方法。

patterns.name: C# 属性声明及访问器
patterns.trigger: `public ... {`、属性名后的`{9`，以及 `get`/`set` 访问器附近
patterns.context: C# 中声明属性，通常有类型与属性名，后接花括号和访问器；片段也可能只含属性访问器的开头。
patterns.domain: Github/StackExchange 中的 C# 源码

patterns.name: Go 函数签名中的映射类型
patterns.trigger: `func extractNestedKeys(v map[string]interface{}) []string {`，尤其是 `map` 和方括号类型语法
patterns.context: Go 函数声明中参数为映射、返回字符串切片。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Go 测试或实现代码

patterns.name: 重复次数属性及其文档
patterns.trigger: `SFTR epetitionsUsed`（原文为 `SFTRepetitionsUsed`）及 `number of existing repetitions`
patterns.context: 注释说明现有重复次数，后接 C# 整数属性与 getter。
patterns.domain: Github 中带 XML 文档注释的 C# 源码

patterns.name: 注释标记与文档注释边界
patterns.context: 代码中 XML 或块注释的闭合、开始位置；与属性声明相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C# 源码

patterns.name: 中文标签规则字段
patterns.context: 中文注释描述标签 ID 不可重复，随后是 JSON 映射的列表属性。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C# 数据模型代码

patterns.name: 音频文件列表方法
patterns.context: 公开方法返回广播账户关联的音频文件列表，前文有英文文档说明。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 Java 源码与注释

en.concept: Opening brace at the start of a code member body
en.description: Primarily responds to the opening brace where a property declaration enters its body, especially C# property {, get/set, and their newline formatting; also responds to opening braces that begin function bodies after C and Objective-C function signatures.

patterns.name: C# property declaration and accessors
patterns.context: In C# class members, a property declaration enters its body or its get/set accessors; property types and names vary widely.

patterns.name: Opening brace in a C# property body
patterns.context: A property accessor uses a multiline format with the opening brace on its own line; it may be followed by get or return.

patterns.name: Opening brace in a C/C++ function definition
patterns.context: The function body begins immediately after the signature ends, with the opening brace adjacent to a closing parenthesis.

patterns.name: Opening brace in an Objective-C function definition
patterns.context: A static function signature is followed by a newline and the start of the function body.

5_1121.concept: 代码成员体起始大括号
5_1121.description: 主要响应属性声明进入属性体的左大括号，尤其是 C# 属性的 {、get/set 及其换行格式；也响应 C、Objective-C 函数签名后开启函数体的左大括号。

patterns.name: C# 属性声明与访问器
patterns.trigger: public ... { get ...; set; }、public ... { get { ... } }，尤其是属性名后的 «{»9 或访问器附近的 «{»10
patterns.context: C# 类成员中，属性声明后进入属性体或 get/set 访问器；属性类型和名称变化很大。
patterns.domain: Github/StackExchange 上的 C# 源码

patterns.name: C# 属性体左大括号
patterns.trigger: 属性名后紧接换行与 «{»9，或 get 后的 «{»6
patterns.context: 属性访问器采用多行格式，左大括号单独成行；可能进一步跟随 get 或 return。
patterns.domain: C# 源码格式与语法结构

patterns.name: C/C++ 函数定义左大括号
patterns.context: 函数签名结束后立即进入函数体，左大括号与右括号相连。
patterns.domain: C 源码，葡萄牙语注释

patterns.name: Objective-C 函数定义左大括号
patterns.context: 静态函数签名后换行并开始函数体。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is an opening brace after a declaration in source code: it appears strongly in function/method bodies and also in C# property bodies. It is accompanied by code syntax such as types, method names, and accessors from different languages.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a function or method body
patterns.context: After a function, method, or constructor signature, a newline and indentation lead into the function body; occurs across different languages.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a property body
patterns.context: A property body begins after a C# property declaration, often followed by get/set accessors; it is not necessarily a function body.

patterns.name: C/C++ types and declaration words
patterns.context: Near function signatures, return types, parameters, or declarations; primarily co-occurs with an opening brace for a function body.
patterns.domain: C/C++ and syntactically similar source code

patterns.name: C# method signatures and route annotations
patterns.context: A public method is declared after a Web API route attribute, then an opening brace begins the method body.

patterns.name: C# property declarations and accessors
patterns.context: A property body begins after a typed property name and contains get/set or a getter; the brace remains a salient trigger.

patterns.name: Objective-C initializer method body
patterns.context: A method body begins after an Objective-C method signature with parameters.

5_1121.description: 最稳定的触发是源代码中声明之后的左花括号：函数/方法体中强烈出现，C# 属性体中也出现。伴随不同语言的类型、方法名及访问器等代码语法。

patterns.name: 函数或方法体左花括号
patterns.context: 函数、方法或构造器签名后，换行并缩进进入函数体；不同语言中均出现。

patterns.name: 属性体左花括号
patterns.context: C# 属性声明后开启属性体，常跟着 get/set 访问器；不一定是函数体。

patterns.name: C/C++ 类型与声明词
patterns.context: 函数签名、返回类型、参数或声明附近；主要与函数体开括号共同出现。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 及类似语法的源代码

patterns.name: C# 方法签名与路由标注
patterns.context: Web API 路由属性之后声明 public 方法，随后以左花括号开启方法体。

patterns.name: C# 属性声明与访问器
patterns.context: 类型化属性名之后开启属性体，包含 get/set 或 getter；大括号仍是显著触发点。
patterns.domain: C# 数据模型与属性代码

patterns.name: Objective-C 初始化方法体
patterns.context: 带参数的 Objective-C 方法签名后开启方法体。

en.description: Primarily responds to C# public property declarations and their accessor blocks, especially the opening brace of the property body after the type name; property types and names vary. A few related code snippets also involve a toString method, a constructor base initializer, and XML-serialization properties.

patterns.name: C# member declarations
patterns.context: Declares public properties in C# classes, with varied property names and types; activation often covers public, the type name, and part of the property name.

patterns.name: Property accessors and braces
patterns.context: An accessor block follows the property declaration; activation is especially strong on the opening brace and nearby get/set.

patterns.name: String conversion method
patterns.context: A public method named toString is followed by the return type String and a method body; this is not a property declaration.

patterns.name: Constructor initializer
patterns.context: A constructor calls a base-class constructor, surrounded by parameters and assignment code; activation is distributed across parameters, punctuation, and initializer fragments.

patterns.name: XML-serialization-generated property
patterns.context: A bool property composed of an attribute and a specified field name in code related to generation or serialization.

patterns.name: Property documentation comments
patterns.context: An XML documentation comment appears before a property declaration; the comment itself seems to be neighboring context, with no stable evidence of an independent trigger.

5_1121.concept: C# 属性声明与访问器
5_1121.description: 主要响应 C# public 属性声明及其访问器块，尤其类型名之后的属性体左花括号；属性类型与名称多样。另见 toString 方法、构造函数基类初始化器及 XML 序列化属性等少数相关代码片段。

patterns.name: C# 成员声明
patterns.trigger: public；public 后接 String、bool、List<...>、Stream、接口或自定义类型等类型名
patterns.context: C# 类中声明 public 属性，属性名及类型多样；激活常覆盖 public、类型名和属性名的一部分。

patterns.name: 属性访问器与花括号
patterns.context: 属性声明后出现访问器块；尤以左花括号及其后的 get/set 附近激活强。

patterns.name: 字符串转换方法
patterns.context: public 方法名为 toString，后接返回类型 String 和方法体；并非属性声明。

patterns.name: 构造函数初始化器
patterns.context: 构造函数调用基类构造函数，周围包含参数与赋值代码；激活分布在参数、标点和初始化器片段。

patterns.name: XML 序列化生成属性
patterns.context: 生成或序列化相关代码中，以属性标注和指定字段名组成的 bool 属性。

patterns.name: 属性文档注释
patterns.context: 属性声明前出现 XML 文档注释；该注释本身似乎只是邻近上下文，未见稳定独立触发证据。

en.description: The strongest activation consistently falls on opening braces in code declarations or function bodies, especially C# property accessor bodies; several weaker activations are scattered across identifiers, type names, and punctuation, with no stable pattern.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a C# property accessor
patterns.context: An opening brace after a property declaration, often followed by get, set, or a property body; activation concentrates on the brace itself.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a C# method or function body
patterns.context: An opening brace after a method signature or function declaration, followed by the function body; includes similar structures in code from other languages.

patterns.name: Code-block opening brace, exact trigger position unclear
patterns.context: The strongest activation appears at a code-block boundary; the snippet is insufficient to determine whether it is a property or method body.

patterns.name: Other punctuation and identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Besides the strongly activated opening brace, several tokens have weaker marks, distributed across code declarations, type names, and local statements, without a stable shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: C#, C++, and Portuguese code comments

5_1121.description: 最强激活一致落在代码声明或函数体左花括号，尤其是 C# 属性的访问器体；若干较弱激活分散于标识符、类型名和标点，缺乏稳定模式。

patterns.name: C# 属性访问器左花括号
patterns.context: 属性声明后的左花括号，常接 get、set 或属性体；激活集中在左花括号本身。

patterns.name: C# 方法或函数体左花括号
patterns.context: 方法签名或函数声明后的左花括号，后续进入函数体；包括不同语言代码中的类似结构。

patterns.name: 代码块左花括号，精确触发位置不明
patterns.context: 代码块边界处出现最强激活；片段不足以确定它是否为属性体或方法体。

patterns.name: 代码中的其他标点与标识符片段
patterns.trigger: «=»、« Stream»、« String»、« operating»、« List»、« Label»、« Cart»、«SF»等
patterns.context: 除最强激活的左花括号外，若干 token 也有较弱标记，分布在代码声明、类型名及局部语句中，未显示稳定的共同触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to boundaries where functions, methods, or properties in source code enter a code block, especially newlines, indentation, and opening braces; accompanied by type, visibility, and identifier fragments. Also activates on scattered code details such as comments, routes, strings, and pointers.

patterns.name: Start of a C/C++ function definition
patterns.context: A function return type, name, and parentheses are followed by a newline into the function body; in multiple snippets, the opening brace after main() is strongest («{»10).

patterns.name: Start of a C# property or method declaration
patterns.context: Near class member declarations and their method bodies or property accessors; combinations of types, identifiers, parentheses, or opening braces occur.

patterns.name: Start of a Java method declaration
patterns.context: A public method definition, with an opening brace immediately after the method name and parameter list.

patterns.name: Start of a Java Web API method body
patterns.context: A public controller method and its method body after an HTTP route annotation.

patterns.name: Start of a generic method definition
patterns.context: A public generic method signature and its opening brace, with type parameters interleaved with the parameter list.

patterns.name: Declaration and initialization inside a function body
patterns.context: Declares and initializes a local variable inside the main function body.

patterns.name: C/C++ external function declaration
patterns.context: After a header file, an extern "C" declaration introduces a function with parameters.

patterns.name: API comments and route markers
patterns.context: A comment and route attribute before a controller method, adjacent to the subsequent method declaration.

patterns.name: Local fragments in string content
patterns.context: Ordinary English fragments in an HTML example string, with no clear relationship to code-structure triggers.

patterns.name: C# XML documentation and identifier splitting
patterns.context: After a property's XML documentation comment, identifier splitting occurs near the start of the property accessor.
patterns.domain: Github C# code and documentation comments

patterns.name: Portuguese identifier splitting
patterns.context: Portuguese error messages and a property name composed of multiple fragments, followed by a property accessor.

patterns.name: Start of a Java string literal
patterns.context: Assigns a string variable inside a toString method body; the string literal begins with Whe.

patterns.name: C/C++ pointers and return statements
patterns.context: A function snippet before main declares a character double pointer and returns a pointer.

patterns.name: Code blocks and indented newlines
patterns.context: A newline and indentation lead into a code block after a function or method signature; occurs in snippets from different languages.

5_1121.description: 主要响应源代码中函数、方法或属性声明转入代码块的边界，尤其是换行、缩进和左花括号；伴随类型、可见性与标识符词片。也激活于注释、路由、字符串和指针等零散代码细节。

patterns.name: C/C++ 函数定义开头
patterns.context: 函数返回类型、函数名与括号后换行进入函数体；多段中 main() 后的左花括号最强（«{»10）。

patterns.name: C# 属性或方法声明开头
patterns.context: 类成员声明及其方法体或属性访问器附近；类型、标识符、括号或左花括号组合出现。

patterns.name: Java 方法声明开头
patterns.context: public 方法定义，方法名和参数列表后紧接左花括号。

patterns.name: Java Web API 方法体开头
patterns.context: HTTP 路由注解后的 public 控制器方法及其方法体。

patterns.name: 泛型方法定义开头
patterns.context: public 泛型方法签名及左花括号，类型参数和参数列表交织。

patterns.name: 函数体中的声明与初始化
patterns.context: main 函数体内声明局部变量并初始化。

patterns.name: C/C++ 外部函数声明
patterns.context: 头文件之后以 extern "C" 声明带参数的函数。

patterns.name: API 注释与路由标记
patterns.context: 控制器方法前的注释及路由属性，与后续方法声明相邻。

patterns.name: 字符串内容中的局部词片
patterns.context: HTML 示例字符串中的普通英文词片，没有明显代码结构触发关系。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 HTML/字符串示例

patterns.name: C# XML 文档及标识符拆分
patterns.context: 属性的 XML 文档注释后，标识符分词及属性访问器开始处。
patterns.domain: Github C# 代码与文档注释

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语标识符拆分
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语错误消息及由多个词片组成的属性名，后接属性访问器。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 C# 代码

patterns.name: Java 字符串字面量开头
patterns.context: toString 方法体内为字符串变量赋值，字符串字面量以 Whe 开始。

patterns.name: C/C++ 指针与返回语句
patterns.context: main 之前的函数片段中声明字符双指针并返回指针。

patterns.name: 代码块及缩进换行
patterns.context: 函数或方法签名后换行并缩进进入代码块；不同语言片段都出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to the start of function/method bodies in multilingual source code, especially opening braces; also responds to signature parentheses, declaration types, newline indentation, and some structural punctuation. A few language fragments, comments, and Perl-specific words have no stable commonality.

patterns.name: Code-block opening brace
patterns.context: In C#, Java, Perl, JavaScript, Objective-C, and other code, a newline leads into a function body after a function, method, or control-structure declaration; activation concentrates on the opening brace.
patterns.domain: Programming code, especially function or method definitions

patterns.name: Function signatures and parameter parentheses
patterns.context: Near function names, method names, or parameter lists; common in declarations or definitions, usually adjacent to a newline and the function body's opening brace.

patterns.name: Function and type declaration keywords
patterns.context: Occurs when code declares a function, method, return type, or collection type; type names and declaration keywords often appear near a function signature or body.

patterns.name: Indentation after code newlines
patterns.context: A code line ends and a new line begins, especially at the start of a function body, an indented code block, or a property declaration; activation falls specifically on newline and whitespace tokens.

patterns.name: Other code-structure punctuation
patterns.context: Appears in structures such as code declarations, generic types, parameter lists, property annotations, or Objective-C method signatures; does not consistently correspond to a single syntax construct.

patterns.name: Identifier or word fragments
patterns.context: A few ordinary English fragments in code, code comments, or strings also activate, without a stable semantic or lexical category.
patterns.domain: Code mixed with English text, comments, or strings

patterns.name: Perl syntax markers
patterns.context: Near module imports or subroutine declarations in Perl files; occur alongside function-body structure signals, but these words appear only in that segment.

patterns.name: Natural-language and non-Latin text fragments
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur near Portuguese explanations, English questions, or Chinese comments, without a shared semantic pattern beyond code structure.

5_1121.description: 主要响应多语言源代码中的函数/方法体起始，尤其左花括号；也响应签名括号、声明类型、换行缩进及部分结构标点。少量语言词片段、注释和Perl专属词无稳定共性。

patterns.name: 代码块左花括号
patterns.context: C#、Java、Perl、JavaScript、Objective-C 等代码中，函数、方法或控制结构声明后换行进入函数体时；触发集中在左花括号。
patterns.domain: 编程代码，尤其是函数或方法定义

patterns.name: 函数签名与参数括号
patterns.context: 函数名、方法名或参数列表附近；常见于声明或定义的签名，通常紧邻换行和函数体左花括号。

patterns.name: 函数及类型声明关键词
patterns.context: 代码声明函数、方法、返回类型或集合类型时出现；类型名和声明关键词往往邻近函数签名或函数体。

patterns.name: 代码换行后的缩进
patterns.context: 代码行结束后进入新行，尤其是函数体开始、缩进代码块或属性声明处；具体激活落在换行和空白 token 上。

patterns.name: 其他代码结构标点
patterns.context: 出现在代码声明、泛型类型、参数列表、属性标注或 Objective-C 方法签名等结构中；并非固定对应某一种语法。

patterns.name: 标识符或词片段
patterns.trigger: «Some»、« more»、« over»、« GET»、« api»、« cr»、« hard»
patterns.context: 少数代码或代码注释、字符串中的普通英文词片段也有激活，未呈现稳定语义或词汇类别。
patterns.domain: 代码混合的英文文本、注释或字符串

patterns.name: Perl 语法标记
patterns.context: Perl 文件的模块导入或子程序声明附近；与函数体结构信号同时出现，但这些词本身只见于该段。

patterns.name: 自然语言及非拉丁文字片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语说明、英文提问或中文注释附近零星激活，未显示与代码结构之外的共同语义模式。

en.description: Primarily activates on function or method definitions and their opening-brace structure in code, across C#, C/C++, Java, and Objective-C; it also responds to properties/accessors, local type declarations, annotations, comments, and a few natural-language subword fragments.

patterns.name: C# method declaration and method-body start
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the method signature and the following newline and opening brace; common in public methods, especially when the signature ends with an empty parameter list.

patterns.name: C/C++ main function entry point
patterns.context: A main function definition in a C/C++ example; activation falls on the return type, function name, empty parameter list, and start of the function body.

patterns.name: Other C/C++ function entry points
patterns.context: An ordinary C function definition, not main; the function body begins immediately after the signature.

patterns.name: Objective-C method/function definition
patterns.context: A static function definition in Objective-C source; the function name uses camel case, and the function body starts with an opening brace.

patterns.name: Property declarations or accessors
patterns.context: Near property definitions and their accessors; some examples split the property name into multiple tokens, but activation still falls on the declaration and accessor structure.

patterns.name: Type declarations inside method bodies
patterns.context: Local type or variable declarations within a function body; these do not immediately follow a public method signature but remain in a code context.

patterns.name: updateHTML in a mixed HTML/text context
patterns.context: C# method code follows HTML content; the activated ordinary words do not form an obvious function-declaration pattern.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, mixed HTML and C#

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Portuguese text
patterns.context: In Portuguese explanatory text and a credit-card property example, activation falls on natural-language words or their subword fragments rather than solely on code syntax.

patterns.name: English explanatory subword fragments in C# code
patterns.context: English words in method comments or explanatory text also activate and cannot be fully grouped under the method-signature feature.

patterns.name: C# routing/attribute annotations
patterns.context: HTTP routing and attribute annotations before a method declaration; activation is weak and distributed.

patterns.name: Java annotations and generic method signatures
patterns.context: Java generic return type and method declaration after path and produces annotations; activation falls on type-name fragments and method structure.

patterns.name: Zero-value assignment and loop fragment
patterns.context: A local C++ code fragment after a thread loop; there is no clear evidence that it shares the function-entry pattern.

patterns.name: Objective-C dictionary type fragment
patterns.context: Near the return type and function name in a static function signature; similar to method definitions in other languages, but with language-specific structure.

5_1121.description: 主要对代码中的函数或方法定义及其左花括号起始结构激活，覆盖 C#、C/C++、Java 和 Objective-C；也响应属性/访问器、局部类型声明、注解、注释及少量自然语言词片。

patterns.name: C# 方法声明与方法体起始
patterns.trigger: «public»、返回类型如 «List»/«string»、方法名、«()»，随后是 «↵» 和 «{»
patterns.context: 激活集中在方法签名及紧随其后的换行、左花括号；常见于 public 方法，尤其签名以空参数列表结束。

patterns.name: C/C++ main 函数入口
patterns.context: C/C++ 示例中的 main 函数定义，激活落在返回类型、函数名、空参数列表及函数体开头。

patterns.name: 其他 C/C++ 函数入口
patterns.context: 普通的 C 函数定义，不是 main；函数签名后立即进入函数体。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法/函数定义
patterns.context: Objective-C 源码中静态函数定义，函数名采用驼峰式命名，函数体以左花括号开始。

patterns.name: 属性声明或访问器
patterns.context: 属性定义及其访问器附近；部分示例把属性名拆为多个 token，激活仍落在声明和访问器结构上。

patterns.name: 方法体中出现的类型声明
patterns.context: 函数体内部的局部类型或变量声明；此处并非紧随公共方法签名，但仍处于代码上下文。

patterns.name: HTML/文本混合上下文中的 updateHTML
patterns.trigger: «Some»、« more»、« over»，并邻近未标记的 HTML 与 «update»«HTML» 方法名
patterns.context: HTML 内容之后切换到 C# 方法代码；激活的普通词不构成明显的函数声明模式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，HTML 与 C# 混合

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语文字中的词片
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语说明文字及信用卡属性示例中，激活落在自然语言词语或其子词片，而非仅落在代码语法上。

patterns.name: C# 代码中的英文说明词片
patterns.context: 方法注释或说明性文本中的英文词语也出现激活，无法完全归入方法签名特征。

patterns.name: C# 路由/属性标注
patterns.context: 方法声明之前的 HTTP 路由和属性标注处，激活较弱且分散。

patterns.name: Java 注解及泛型方法签名
patterns.context: 路径与 produces 注解之后的 Java 泛型返回类型和方法声明；激活落在类型名片段及方法结构上。

patterns.name: 零值赋值和循环片段
patterns.context: C++ 线程循环后的局部代码片段；未见明确证据表明它与函数入口模式相同。

patterns.name: Objective-C 字典类型片段
patterns.context: 静态函数签名中的返回类型和函数名附近；与其他语言方法定义相似，但语言特有结构不同。

en.description: Every snippet highlights an opening brace near a method body or property accessor in object-oriented code, commonly in the form of a signature followed by a newline, indentation, and “{”; languages and specific structures vary.

patterns.name: Opening brace in a C# or Java method/property declaration
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the opening brace of a method body or property accessor; it usually follows a method signature, property declaration, or get.
patterns.domain: C#, Java, and other object-oriented code

patterns.name: End of a C# method signature
patterns.context: A newline, indentation, and opening brace follow the method parameter list; some examples also contain public, a return type, or a method name, but these vary.

patterns.name: C# property declaration and accessor boundary
patterns.context: A newline and brace occur after a property type and name or near the property accessor get; braces also appear in getter method bodies.

patterns.name: Start of a C/Objective-C method body
patterns.context: A newline follows an Objective-C method signature and starts the method body; the signal is more concentrated at the newline and brace marking the start of the body.

patterns.name: Start of a Java method body
patterns.context: A newline and opening brace follow a method signature and throws exception declaration.

patterns.name: Ambiguous code-fragment boundary
patterns.context: An opening brace is present, but the snippet context is insufficient to determine whether it corresponds to a method, property, or other structure.

5_1121.description: 所有片段都在面向对象代码中突出方法体或属性访问器附近的左花括号，常见形式是签名、换行缩进后接「{」；语言和具体结构各异。

patterns.name: C# 或 Java 方法/属性声明中的左花括号
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在方法体或属性访问器的左花括号；通常紧跟方法签名、属性声明或 get 之后。

patterns.name: C# 方法签名的结束位置
patterns.context: 方法参数列表后的换行、缩进和左花括号；部分例子还出现 public、返回类型或方法名，但各不相同。

patterns.name: C# 属性声明与访问器边界
patterns.context: 属性类型和名称之后，或属性访问器 get 附近的换行与花括号；也有 getter 方法体中的花括号。
patterns.domain: C# 属性及访问器代码

patterns.name: C/Objective-C 方法体起始
patterns.context: Objective-C 方法签名之后换行并开始方法体；信号更偏向方法体起始处的换行与括号。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Objective-C 代码

patterns.name: Java 方法体起始
patterns.context: 方法签名及 throws 异常声明之后，换行并出现左花括号。

patterns.name: 不明确的代码片段边界
patterns.context: 同样是左花括号，但片段上下文不足以进一步确定该括号对应的方法、属性或其他结构。

en.concept: Code member declarations and block starts
en.description: Primarily responds to member-definition structures in object-oriented code, especially public members, method signatures, and their opening braces; it also covers properties/get-set accessors. Weaker or localized activations occur in generic types, routing annotations, comments, identifiers, and Perl subroutines.

patterns.name: C# public member definitions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near member declarations in classes or interfaces, often adjacent to the opening brace of a property, method, or accessor; triggers are not limited to one member type.

patterns.name: Method declarations and method-body starts
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a method name, parameter list, or return type is followed by an opening brace for the method body; sometimes activation is concentrated on the brace and following newline indentation.

patterns.name: Property and accessor definitions
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a property body follows the property name or type, or when get/set accessors appear; includes auto-properties and properties with explicit accessors.

patterns.name: Type names and generic return types
patterns.context: Types, generic return types, and their member names appear in method or member declarations; activation is distributed across type names, identifiers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Web/API routes and HTTP annotations
patterns.context: HTTP method comments, route attributes, or API paths appear before a method declaration; the same segment is followed by a public method returning a list.

patterns.name: HTML strings and update-related identifiers
patterns.context: The identifier updateHTML, HTML content fragments, and string-processing code appear together; this segment also contains a C# public method declaration.
patterns.domain: C# and HTML examples in StackExchange

patterns.name: Credit-card validation property and Portuguese text
patterns.context: A string property is declared and its property body begins after a Portuguese CreditCard validation error message.
patterns.domain: C# data annotation example on StackExchange

patterns.name: Audio-file method and comments
patterns.context: A comment describes returning a list of audio files associated with a broadcast account, followed by a public List<String> method signature and method body.

patterns.name: Query-result method declaration
patterns.context: A public generic query method is declared after path and produces annotations, followed by an exception declaration and the start of the method body.

patterns.name: Stream property and local initialization
patterns.context: A description of converting data to a memory stream is followed by a string stream variable declaration and a public Stream property.

patterns.name: Perl subroutine and module imports
patterns.context: A subroutine definition appears after Perl module imports, strict/warnings directives, and package-level variables; this is a similar block-start signal in non-C# code.

patterns.name: String-formatting method
patterns.context: A toString method is defined after loop logic and its body begins, followed by a string variable declaration and the start of a string literal.

patterns.name: Return description in documentation comment and count property
patterns.context: A documentation comment describes the current duplicate count, followed by a count property declaration and entry into a getter.
patterns.domain: C# code and XML documentation comments on GitHub

patterns.name: Constructor and parameter property
patterns.context: A constructor calls base(command) and assigns a parameter, then defines a SelectArguments property and getter.
patterns.domain: C# data-source component code on GitHub

5_1121.concept: 代码成员声明与块起始
5_1121.description: 主要对面向对象代码中的成员定义结构起反应，尤其是 public 成员、方法签名及其开括号，也覆盖属性/get-set 访问器；泛型类型、路由注解、注释、标识符和 Perl 子程序中也有较弱或局部激活。

patterns.name: C# 公共成员定义
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在类或接口的成员声明附近，常紧邻属性、方法或访问器的起始大括号；触发并不局限于一种成员类型。
patterns.domain: C# 及相近的面向对象代码

patterns.name: 方法声明与方法体起始
patterns.context: 可见的方法名、参数列表或返回类型后接方法体开括号时激活；有时激活集中在开括号及换行缩进处。

patterns.name: 属性及访问器定义
patterns.context: 属性名或类型后进入属性体，或出现 get/set 访问器时激活；包括自动属性和带显式访问器的属性。

patterns.name: 类型名与泛型返回类型
patterns.context: 类型、泛型返回类型及其成员名出现在方法或成员声明中；激活分散在类型名、标识符和标点上。

patterns.name: Web/API 路由与 HTTP 标注
patterns.context: 方法声明前出现 HTTP 方法注释、路由属性或 API 路径；同一段随后是公共列表返回方法。

patterns.name: HTML 字符串与更新相关标识符
patterns.context: 标识符 updateHTML、HTML 内容片段及字符串处理代码相邻出现；此段同时含 C# 公共方法声明。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 C# 与 HTML 示例

patterns.name: 信用卡校验属性与葡萄牙语文本
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语 CreditCard 校验错误消息之后声明字符串属性并开启属性体。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 C# 数据注解示例

patterns.name: 音频文件方法及注释
patterns.context: 注释说明返回广播账号关联音频文件列表，随后出现公共 List<String> 方法签名和方法体。

patterns.name: 查询结果方法声明
patterns.context: 路径与 produces 注解之后声明公共泛型查询方法，并以异常声明及方法体开始收尾。

patterns.name: Stream 属性与局部初始化
patterns.context: 先说明将数据转换为 memory stream，随后声明字符串流变量及公共 Stream 属性。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 C# 数据处理代码

patterns.name: Perl 子程序及模块导入
patterns.context: Perl 模块导入、strict/warnings 指令和包级变量之后出现子程序定义；是非 C# 代码中的相似块起始信号。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Perl 代码

patterns.name: 字符串格式化方法
patterns.context: 循环逻辑后定义 toString 方法并开启方法体，随后创建字符串变量并开始字符串字面量。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 Java/C# 风格代码

patterns.name: 文档注释中的返回描述与计数属性
patterns.context: 文档注释描述现有重复次数，之后声明计数属性并进入 getter。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C# 代码及 XML 文档注释

patterns.name: 构造函数与参数属性
patterns.context: 构造函数调用 base(command) 并赋值参数，随后定义 SelectArguments 属性及 getter。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C# 数据源组件代码

en.description: Activations are scattered across several terms: ads, Loop, clarification, case-precedent classification terms, and wolf and Sweet in names or titles; no unified context is apparent beyond local terms.

patterns.name: Advertising-related terms
patterns.context: Activates when discussing ad insertion, advertising business models, or classified ads placed by readers.

patterns.name: Loop in code examples
patterns.context: Appears as the name of a loop construct in a PHP example.

patterns.name: Clarification wording
patterns.context: Introduces an explanation in an email with “a clarification”.

patterns.name: Case-precedent marker
patterns.context: Appears in the precedent classification column of a court-decision list.
patterns.domain: Third Circuit Court of Appeals decision index

patterns.name: wolf string
patterns.context: Appears in a username or software name; no clear shared semantic context.

patterns.name: Sweet in a name
patterns.context: Appears as part of an email recipient's name.

5_1172.description: 激活分散在若干词项上：ads、Loop、clarification、判例先例分类词，以及人名或名称中的 wolf、Sweet；除局部词项外未见统一语境。

patterns.name: 广告相关词
patterns.context: 讨论广告插入、广告商业模式或读者刊登的小广告时激活。

patterns.name: 代码示例中的 Loop
patterns.context: 作为 PHP 示例中循环结构的名称出现。

patterns.name: 澄清用语
patterns.context: 邮件中以“a clarification”引出说明。

patterns.name: 判例先例标记
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决列表的先例性质分类栏。
patterns.domain: 第三巡回上诉法院判决索引

patterns.name: wolf 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在用户名或软件名中；没有明显共享语义语境。

patterns.name: Sweet 姓名
patterns.context: 作为邮件收件人姓名的一部分出现。

en.description: Activation is polysemous and scattered: ads in advertising contexts, wolf in names, legal case-effect labels, and a few code and email terms. No shared semantics appear to explain all fragments.

patterns.name: Advertising-related terms
patterns.context: When discussing ad insertion, charges, or effects on user perception; [1] also mentions filtering or ranking by emotional sentiment.

patterns.name: wolf substring
patterns.context: Appears in usernames or software names, with activation concentrated on the wolf substring.

patterns.name: Legal case-status labels
patterns.context: Case-status classifications in lists of U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit decisions; case titles and dates appear in the same formatted header.

patterns.name: Loop in a code example
patterns.context: An example demonstrating how to generate content with a PHP loop.

patterns.name: clarification in email
patterns.context: An email body opens by clarifying a matter, then mentions an existing agreement.

5_1172.description: 激活呈多义分散：广告语境中的 ads、名称中的 wolf、法律判例效力标签，以及少数代码和邮件词语；未见能统一解释全部片段的共同语义。

patterns.name: 广告相关词
patterns.context: 讨论广告的插入、收费或对用户感知的影响时；[1]还提到按情绪情感过滤或排序。

patterns.name: wolf 子串
patterns.context: 出现在用户名或软件名称中，激活集中于 wolf 子串。

patterns.name: 法律判例标签
patterns.context: 美国第三巡回上诉法院判决列表中的判例效力分类；判决标题与日期也处于同一格式化页眉中。

patterns.name: 代码示例中的 Loop
patterns.context: 介绍用 PHP 循环生成内容的示例。

patterns.name: 邮件中的 clarification
patterns.context: 邮件正文以澄清事项开头，随后提及已有协议。

en.description: Activation is scattered across loops/Loop, U.S. court of appeals decision headers, advertising-related expressions, wolf/werewolf terms, and a narrative about family members and cancer. These span domains and show no unified trigger.

patterns.name: Loop-related forms
patterns.context: Appears when discussing program loops for generating content or the place name “inner Loop”; there is no evidence that the two uses share a semantic condition.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A; Wikipedia radio station description

patterns.name: U.S. federal court of appeals decision header
patterns.context: A formatted decision-document header composed of court, circuit, date, and case information; multiple fields and layout spaces activate.

patterns.name: Advertising and ad-related terms

5_1172.description: 激活分散于多领域文本，常落在常见词或词形片段；另有信号、疾病、光学、机械、预测、代码、算法等局部触发，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 字母或词形片段
patterns.trigger: « such»、« most»、« are»、« be»、« to»、« in»、« New»、«line»、«Id»、«Signal»、«Switch»、« bronchial»、«mus»、«car»、«inic»
patterns.context: 对常见词、词缀或标识符中的局部片段有激活；不同位置和语义环境都出现，未显示一致的词义条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、代码、一般文本

patterns.name: 随机调制信号描述
patterns.trigger: « random»、« modulated»、« signals»，以及« periodically» « key»«ed»
patterns.context: 描述周期性密钥化、随机调制信号的传输与检测。

patterns.name: AD细胞易感性论述
patterns.context: 讨论阿尔茨海默病中细胞易感性及确定相关生化、解剖表型的研究。

patterns.name: RSV呼吸道疾病
patterns.context: 陈述健康成人感染RSV后主要发生上呼吸道疾病。

patterns.name: 光学空间分离
patterns.context: 描述以非垂直入射使反射光束空间分离，从而消除干涉。

patterns.name: 刚性构件机械耦合
patterns.context: 说明装卸码头防护棚的刚性侧构件与顶梁等部件相连。

patterns.name: 容易作出预测
patterns.context: 谈及根据消费者购物情况作出较容易且有根据的预测。

patterns.name: 流切换信号标识符比较
patterns.context: 代码中读取并比较两个流切换信号标识符。

patterns.name: 换行转义与记录分隔
patterns.context: 说明文本输入中的换行和反斜杠转义机制，以及换行作为记录分隔符的解释。

patterns.name: 算法接近性比较
patterns.context: 比较模型生成极向磁场的方法，并指出其中一种最接近所引入的算法。

patterns.name: 毒物作用部位
patterns.context: 提及有机磷中毒对毒蕈碱受体的作用。

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical symbols and formulas, code and data operations, legal conditional clauses, patent device descriptions, and informal forum language. Punctuation sequences such as periods and commas also appear in several places. There is no stable, single semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Ellipses and punctuation at truncation points
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on repeated periods, commas, and other punctuation sequences, especially in mathematical expressions, patent figure descriptions, or truncated text; no particular semantics is required.
patterns.domain: Mixed domains: mathematics, patents, law, and forum text

patterns.name: Formula and symbol adjacency
patterns.context: In symbolic formulas or code, activation occurs at parentheses, operators, and nearby positions; the specific symbols differ between examples.

patterns.name: Low-resolution recognition and candidates
patterns.context: A conditional statement in image-recognition patent text describing failure to recognize an item at low resolution and consideration of candidates instead.

patterns.name: Legal conditional clauses and evidentiary judgments
patterns.context: Conditions, standards of proof, or decision rules in legal arguments or decisions; activated terms do not form a fixed legal term.

patterns.name: Code and data operations
patterns.context: Code examples and technical Q&A discussing files, spreadsheet data, or database records.

patterns.name: Device components and operation in patents
patterns.context: Patent specifications describing device connections, operating states, or paper-feed processes.

patterns.name: Informal forum language and expression
patterns.context: Informal discussions containing evaluations, laughter, or colloquial judgments.

patterns.name: General mathematics / coding descriptions
patterns.context: Coding or mathematical objects described using variables and length; there is insufficient evidence here that these share a specific semantics with other triggers.

5_1172.concept: 混合文本边界与结构标记
5_1172.description: 激活分散在数学符号与公式、代码和数据操作、法律条件句、专利设备描述及论坛口语中；多处也出现句点、逗号等标点序列。没有稳定的单一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 省略号与截断处标点
patterns.context: 激活集中在重复句点、逗号等标点序列，尤其是数学表达、专利附图描述或文本被截断的位置；不要求特定语义
patterns.domain: 混合领域，数学、专利、法律及论坛文本

patterns.name: 公式与符号邻接
patterns.context: 符号公式或代码中，激活出现在括号、运算符及其邻近位置；各例的具体符号并不相同

patterns.name: 低分辨率识别与候选项
patterns.context: 图像识别专利文本中，描述低分辨率下无法识别并转而考虑候选项的条件句

patterns.name: 法律条件句与证据判断
patterns.context: 法律论证或判决文本中的条件、证明标准或判断规则；激活词并不形成固定法律术语

patterns.name: 代码与数据操作
patterns.context: 讨论文件、表格数据或数据库记录的代码示例与技术问答

patterns.name: 专利中的设备部件与操作
patterns.context: 专利说明书描述装置连接关系或设备运行状态、纸张输送过程

patterns.name: 论坛口语与表达
patterns.context: 非正式讨论中带有评价、笑语或口语化判断

patterns.name: 一般数学／编码描述
patterns.context: 以变量和长度描述编码或数学对象；此处没有足够证据显示与其他触发词共享特定语义

en.description: Activations have no single semantic theme: they include easier, bounded, line, and approach, as well as patent components, medical terminology, legal clear, and payment-card phrases. Some patterns recur across styles, while others depend on their respective technical contexts.

patterns.name: Easier / more easily
patterns.context: Describes a solution, product, or process as easier to integrate, detect, or carry out; excerpt 1 has “easier to integrate”, and excerpt 8 has “easier to pick up”.
patterns.domain: Forum discussion; software integration and payment security

patterns.name: bounded
patterns.context: Mathematical or theoretical statements describe solutions, probabilities, or graph families as subject to boundedness constraints.
patterns.domain: Academic papers: causal inference, algorithms, combinatorics

patterns.name: line and its spatial relations
patterns.context: Occurs with line and its modifiers or spatial/geometric relations; includes statistical anatomical analysis and equipment-conveyance layouts.

patterns.name: approach / method
patterns.context: Discusses a method, design, or approach to a problem, usually in a noun phrase.

patterns.name: Compound terms for technical components
patterns.context: Patent text describes equipment, components, and their functions or connections; activations are distributed across component phrases rather than a single fixed term.

patterns.name: minimax terminology
patterns.context: Appears with theoretical terms such as solution, optimal, and causal function in discussions of minimax solutions and their properties.
patterns.domain: Academic papers: causal inference and optimization

patterns.name: Medical anatomical/imaging terminology
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving patients, lesions, fissures, and imaging-group analysis; activations center on subword fragments of technical terms.

patterns.name: Clear conditions in legal text
patterns.context: When interpreting legal text, whether the text is clear is used as a condition for whether to proceed with further analysis.

patterns.name: Conveyance layout and edge portions
patterns.context: Describes the positions of a bag and nozzle on the same conveying line and their edge portions.

patterns.name: Card transaction types
patterns.context: Asks about classifying or identifying card-present transactions, card-not-present transactions, and fraud.
patterns.domain: Forum discussion: payment and transaction security

patterns.name: Bound argument in probability/search
patterns.context: Bounds the escape probability of a single depth-first search by reducing or shortening the process.

patterns.name: Mathematical graph-theory theorem statement
patterns.context: A theorem gives a boundedness property of a family of plane segment graphs and a more precise formulation.

5_1172.description: 激活没有单一语义主题：包括 easier、bounded、line、approach 等词，以及专利部件、医学术语、法律 clear 和支付卡词组；部分模式跨文体重复，其余依赖各自专业上下文。

patterns.name: 容易/更容易（easier）
patterns.context: 描述某种方案、产品或流程更易整合、检测或执行；第1段为“easier to integrate”，第8段为“easier to pick up”。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论；软件集成与支付安全

patterns.name: bounded / 有界
patterns.context: 数学或理论陈述中说明解、概率或图族受到有界性约束。
patterns.domain: 学术论文：因果推断、算法、组合数学

patterns.name: line / 线及其位置关系
patterns.context: 出现 line 及其限定或空间、几何关系；含统计解剖分析和设备输送布局。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要；专利技术描述

patterns.name: approach / 方法方案
patterns.context: 谈论一种做法、设计或处理问题的方案，通常置于名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论；专利背景技术

patterns.name: 技术部件名称中的复合词
patterns.context: 专利文本中描述设备、部件及其功能或连接关系；激活分布在部件词组，而非单一固定术语。

patterns.name: minimax 术语
patterns.context: 与 solution、optimal、causal function 等理论术语共同出现，讨论最小最大解及其性质。
patterns.domain: 学术论文：因果推断与优化

patterns.name: 医学解剖/影像术语
patterns.context: 在患者、病灶、裂隙及影像分组分析语境中出现；激活集中于专业术语的分词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 clear 条件
patterns.context: 解释法律文本时，以文本是否清楚作为是否继续分析的条件。

patterns.name: 传送布局与边缘部位
patterns.context: 描述袋体与喷嘴在同一输送线上的位置及其边缘部分。

patterns.name: 卡片交易类型
patterns.context: 询问记录卡交易、非现场交易及盗刷的分类或识别。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论：支付与交易安全

patterns.name: 概率/搜索中的 bound 论证
patterns.context: 通过规约或缩短过程来界定单次深度优先搜索的逃逸概率。

patterns.name: 数学图论定理陈述
patterns.context: 定理环境中给出平面线段图族的有界性质及更精确表述。

en.concept: Terms and definitional expressions in technical text
en.description: Primarily responds to definitional constructions and term introductions in technical text, especially structures such as “is called,” “is said to be,” and “if” in mathematics. It also activates on patent device descriptions, specific technical terms, code examples, and paper metadata.

patterns.name: Terms in definitions or classification statements
patterns.context: Introduces definitions, properties, or classifications in mathematical or technical text, often ending with an italicized term; strong activation often falls on the term itself or the definitional construction.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and theoretical computer science

patterns.name: Local activation on mathematical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a technical sentence describing sparse representation possibilities in a finite dictionary and cases where they fail; activation concentrates within the term.
patterns.domain: ArXiv signal processing or sparse representation

patterns.name: Patent apparatus and material descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background explaining the structure or operation of packaging materials, support rollers, guides, and filling equipment.

patterns.name: Memory fault handling in patents
patterns.context: Reviews prior approaches to handling defective small loops, describing chip storage and error mapping.

patterns.name: Extracting unique rows in code
patterns.context: A StackExchange Q&A shows matrix data and code for extracting unique rows using a command.

patterns.name: Literature metadata and algebraic terminology
patterns.context: End matter or metadata-style content lists a title, authors, bibliography file, and keywords.
patterns.domain: ArXiv literature metadata, formal languages and ordinals

5_1172.concept: 技术文本中的术语与定义表达
5_1172.description: 主要响应技术文本中的定义句式和术语引入，尤其是数学中“is called”“is said to be”“if”等结构；另对专利设备描述、特定技术词、代码示例及论文元数据也有激活。

patterns.name: 定义或判定语句中的术语
patterns.trigger: “is called” / “is said to be” / “is ... if” / “is [finite] if”
patterns.context: 在数学或技术文本中引入定义、性质或分类，常以斜体术语收尾；强激活常落在术语本身或定义句式上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论计算机科学

patterns.name: 数学术语的局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在描述有限字典中稀疏表示可能性及其失败情形的技术句子中；激活集中于术语内部。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 信号处理或稀疏表示

patterns.name: 专利装置与材料描述
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明包装材料、支撑滚轮、导向及填充设备的结构或操作。

patterns.name: 专利中的存储器故障处理
patterns.trigger: “bubble memory chip” / “on chip error map loop”
patterns.context: 回顾处理缺陷小环路的既有方案，描述芯片及错误映射的存储方式。

patterns.name: 代码中的唯一行提取
patterns.context: StackExchange 问答中展示矩阵数据及用命令提取唯一行的代码。

patterns.name: 文献元数据与代数术语
patterns.context: 文末或元数据式内容列出题名、作者、参考文献文件和关键词。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文献元数据，形式语言与序数

en.description: Activations cover transport routes and planning, mathematical objects and properties, whether a legal dispute remains live, and expressions of design methods and purposes in patents. No specific lexical or syntactic trigger unifies the domains.

patterns.name: Railways and transport routes
patterns.context: Descriptions of railways, roads, routes, or transport services; some excerpts concern route locations or planning.

patterns.name: Properties or values of mathematical objects
patterns.context: Mathematical discussion introduces mappings, spaces, vectors, or their properties; no single mathematical term serves as a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Whether a legal dispute remains live
patterns.context: Discusses federal court jurisdiction and whether a dispute remains live during proceedings.

patterns.name: Purpose or method phrasing in patent text
patterns.context: Describes how mechanical components are designed and their intended effects.

5_1172.description: 激活覆盖交通线路与规划、数学对象及性质、司法争议存续，以及专利中的设计方式和目的表达；跨领域未见统一的具体词汇或句法触发。

patterns.name: 铁路及交通线路
patterns.context: 铁路、道路、路线或交通服务的描述；部分段落涉及线路位置或线路规划。

patterns.name: 数学对象的性质或取值
patterns.context: 数学论述中介绍映射、空间、向量或其性质；没有统一的单一数学术语触发。

patterns.name: 司法争议是否仍然存在
patterns.trigger: “appeal is moot”“actual controversy must be … extant”
patterns.context: 讨论联邦法院管辖权，以及审理期间争议是否仍然存在。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的目的或方式表达
patterns.trigger: “in such a way as to increase”
patterns.context: 描述机械部件的设计方式及其预期效果。

en.description: Primarily responds to constructions for defining, naming, and determining properties. It also reacts to mathematical terms such as finite, subset, random, and volume-preserving, as well as patent capability descriptions, medical data sharing, and compressibility-proof contexts.

patterns.name: Definition or term-introduction sentence
patterns.context: Formally introduces, names, or defines mathematical objects and properties, often followed by an italicized term or conditional clause.

patterns.name: Mathematical term “finite”
patterns.context: Mathematical contexts such as finite graphs or finite fields; no fixed construction is required.

patterns.name: Mathematical term “subset”
patterns.context: Formulaic expressions of set inclusion, typically involving sets, lattices, or tiling objects.

patterns.name: Mathematical term “random”
patterns.context: Describes vectors sampled from a uniform distribution.

patterns.name: Mathematical term “volume preserving”
patterns.context: Describes a property of a mapping.

patterns.name: Theorem references and converse propositions in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: States a converse or inverse result to a theorem and introduces a subsequent definition.

patterns.name: Capability and smoothness descriptions in technical patents
patterns.context: Describes process effects or performance that materials or components can achieve.

patterns.name: Data sharing and access information in research papers
patterns.context: Discusses willingness to share health data, privacy, or online access to research data.

patterns.name: Compressibility and counterexample proof context
patterns.context: Discusses compressibility, substructures, or connectivity with a matrix or space as the subject.

5_1172.description: 主要响应定义、命名与性质判定句式；另对有限、子集、随机、保体积等数学术语，以及专利能力描述、医学数据共享和可压缩性证明语境有反应。

patterns.name: 定义或术语引入句
patterns.trigger: “is called” “is said to be” “is denoted by” “is … if” “we say that”
patterns.context: 形式化地引入、命名或定义数学对象与性质，常接斜体术语或条件从句

patterns.name: 数学术语“finite”
patterns.context: 图的有限性或有限域等数学语境；不要求固定句式

patterns.name: 数学术语“subset”
patterns.context: 集合包含关系的公式表达，通常涉及集合、格或平铺对象

patterns.name: 数学术语“random”
patterns.context: 描述向量按均匀分布抽取

patterns.name: 数学术语“volume preserving”
patterns.context: 描述映射的性质

patterns.name: 数学定义中的定理引用与反向命题
patterns.context: 陈述定理的逆向或反向结果，并引入后续定义

patterns.name: 技术专利中的能力与顺畅性描述
patterns.trigger: “can be smoothly released” “can be well dyed”
patterns.context: 描述材料、部件能够实现的工艺效果或性能

patterns.name: 研究论文中的数据共享与访问信息
patterns.context: 讨论健康数据分享意愿、隐私或研究数据的在线获取
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学/公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 可压缩性及其反例证明语境
patterns.context: 以矩阵或空间为对象讨论可压缩性、子结构或连通性

en.description: Activations occur in mathematical definitions and terminology, format or category labels, place-name fragments, and encyclopedia section/location descriptions. They also appear in ordinary assertion words and comparative expressions; no single stable trigger pattern spans domains.

patterns.name: Naming a term in a definition
patterns.context: Formally defining or explaining what an object is called, especially a term following a copular construction

patterns.name: Technical terms or concepts in mathematical prose
patterns.context: Definitions, property statements, or proofs in mathematical discussion, with terms embedded in technical sentences

patterns.name: Format, category, or attribute labels
patterns.context: Classifying a data transmission method or object by its format, category, or attribute

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in proper and place names
patterns.context: A word-form fragment appears in a place name, district name, or location name, rather than as an independent concept in a sentence

patterns.name: Section, navigation, and reference labels
patterns.context: Section headings or navigation content near the end of an encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Location- or road-related expressions
patterns.context: Describing where a place is located, roads, or routes for visiting

patterns.name: General explanatory assertions and result expressions
patterns.context: Stating conditions, conclusions, or causal relationships; these words occur in ordinary prose across different fields
patterns.domain: Mathematical arguments, patent descriptions, encyclopedias, and forum text

patterns.name: Comparatives and expressions of degree
patterns.context: Describing comparisons or changes in cost, degree, or scale

5_1172.description: 激活分布在数学定义与术语、格式或类别标签、地名片段及百科栏目/位置描述，也见普通断言词和比较表达；跨领域缺少单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 定义句中的术语命名
patterns.trigger: “is called” / “is said to be” 后接术语，如 «called»、«is»、«said to be»、«regular»、«canonical»
patterns.context: 正式定义或说明某对象被称作什么，尤其是系词结构后给出术语

patterns.name: 数学正文中的专业术语或概念成分
patterns.context: 数学论述中的定义、性质陈述或证明，术语嵌在技术性句子中

patterns.name: 格式、类别或属性标签
patterns.context: 把数据传输方式或对象归入某种格式、类别或属性
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、数学定义

patterns.name: 专名及地名中的词形片段
patterns.context: 词形片段出现在地名、区名或地点名称中，并非句子中的独立概念

patterns.name: 标题、导航与参考资料标签
patterns.context: 百科条目尾部的栏目标题或导航内容

patterns.name: 位置或道路相关表达
patterns.context: 描述地点所在位置、道路或到访路线
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、旅游信息

patterns.name: 通用说明性断言与结果表达
patterns.context: 说明条件、结论或因果关系；这些词在不同领域的普通叙述中出现
patterns.domain: 数学论证、专利说明、百科与论坛文本

patterns.name: 比较级及程度表达
patterns.context: 描述成本、程度或规模的比较及变化

en.description: Primarily responds to definitions or properties introduced by copulas in academic text and to technical compound adjectives. Other scattered patterns include degree expressions, negative restrictions, medical-method terms, and web copy. Some short-word activations are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: Definitional predicate “is/are said/called …”
patterns.context: In academic definitions or property statements, a copula introduces a term, category, or property; the trigger position is often before the noun or term.

patterns.name: Complex adjectives or property terms
patterns.context: In technical text, adjectives or compound modifiers describe the properties, structure, or form of an object; local activation falls on components of the compound term.

patterns.name: Degree and ease-of-use expressions
patterns.context: A degree word modifies an adjective to describe difficulty, accessibility, or ease.

patterns.name: Negation, restriction, or non-current state
patterns.context: Negation, restriction, or failure to enter a process is expressed around access permissions or current status.

patterns.name: Literature search and evaluation process terms
patterns.context: Describes study quality assessment, systematic reviews, or database search methods in medical research.

patterns.name: Everyday goods and making suggestions
patterns.context: Web copy for general readers lists products, audiences, or simple modification ideas.

patterns.name: Titles or marked metadata
patterns.context: A title, label, or supplementary-material reference enclosed in square brackets appears near the body text.

patterns.name: Local activation near general conjunctions and connectives
patterns.context: Trigger positions in these instances are scattered across mathematical derivations and ordinary academic sentences, with no shared local syntactic or semantic condition.

5_1172.description: 主要响应学术文本中系词引出的定义或性质，以及技术复合形容词；另有程度表达、否定限制、医学方法术语和网页文案等零散模式。部分短词激活难以统一解释。

patterns.name: “is/are said/called …”定义式谓语
patterns.trigger: “is called *regular*”[1]；“is … said to be *norm continuous*”[6]；“is a [*finite*]”[8]
patterns.context: 学术定义或性质陈述中，系词后引出术语、类别或性质；触发位置常在名词或术语之前。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、形式化学术写作

patterns.name: 复杂形容词或性质术语
patterns.context: 技术文本中，形容词或复合修饰语描述对象的性质、结构或形式；局部激活落在复合术语成分上。

patterns.name: 程度与易于性表述
