patterns.context: 用程度词修饰形容词，描述操作难度、可访问性或简易程度。
patterns.domain: 生活方式网页、医学论文、专利

patterns.name: 否定、限制或非当前状态
patterns.trigger: “denying data access”[2]；“not currently on any legislative fast-track”[10]
patterns.context: 围绕访问权限或当前状态表达否定、限制或未进入某种进程。

patterns.name: 文献检索与评估流程术语
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述研究质量评估、系统综述或数据库检索方法。

patterns.name: 日常商品与制作建议
patterns.trigger: “cool stuff for guys”[4]；“cool stuff to buy”[4]；“replacing a cushion”[4]
patterns.context: 面向普通读者的网页文案，列举商品、受众或简单改造做法。

patterns.name: 标题或标记性元数据
patterns.context: 正文附近出现方括号包裹的标题、标签或补充材料引用。

patterns.name: 一般连词、连接词附近的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些实例的触发位置分散于数学推导和普通学术句子，缺少共同的局部句法或语义条件。

en.description: Activations center on several local expressions: information available online, network outage status reports, spread-spectrum terminology, television tuning, sports rankings, real-world care, and “top” in lists. The patterns span domains, with no unified trigger feature.

patterns.name: Information available online
patterns.context: Describing materials, lists, or information that can be viewed online; “online” occurs at the end of a phrase or where a URL is introduced

patterns.name: Network status reports and outages
patterns.context: In a network service status list, INTER NET is followed by a colon and a report that there is no scheduled downtime; the same email passage recurs in different samples

patterns.name: Spectrum and signal terminology
patterns.context: Technical context discussing the transmission, concealment, or detection of data streams using spread-spectrum formats

patterns.name: TV tuning and OTA broadcasts
patterns.context: Explaining that a TV can be tuned to receive OTA digital or analog programming, following descriptions of cable TV and video equipment

patterns.name: Sports rankings and season predictions
patterns.context: Discussing a team’s performance during a player’s absence and predicting its league ranking

patterns.name: Real-world care implementation
patterns.context: Describing the integration of evidence-based treatment into real-world care settings at child mental health agencies

patterns.name: Rankings in lists
patterns.context: Asking which kind of gift should rank first on a list; may relate to the use of “top” in sports rankings, but the context differs

5_1172.description: 激活集中于若干局部表达：online信息可查、网络停机状态报告、扩频术语、电视调谐、体育排名、现实世界护理，以及榜单中的top；模式跨领域，未见统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 在线信息可查看
patterns.context: 描述资料、名单或信息可在网上查看，online 位于短语末尾或网址引出位置

patterns.name: 网络状态报告与停机
patterns.context: 网络服务状态清单中，INTER NET 后接冒号，报告没有计划停机；相同邮件段落在不同样本中重复

patterns.name: 频谱与信号术语
patterns.trigger: «spread»« spectrum»7；后文再次出现«spread»« spectrum»10« format»6
patterns.context: 讨论以扩频格式传输、隐藏或检测数据流的技术背景

patterns.name: 电视调谐及OTA广播
patterns.context: 说明电视可调谐接收OTA数字或模拟节目，处于有线电视与录像设备介绍之后

patterns.name: 体育排名与赛季预测
patterns.context: 讨论球队在球员缺阵期间的表现，并预测其联赛排名

patterns.name: 现实世界护理实施
patterns.context: 描述将循证治疗整合进儿童心理健康机构的现实护理环境

patterns.name: 榜单排名表达
patterns.context: 询问某类礼物应在榜单中居于首位；与体育排名中的 top 用法可能相关，但语境不同
patterns.domain: 消费科技/社交媒体文章

en.description: Activation covers sentence-final judgments of the “or not” type, online accessibility, positional descriptions, and local patterns involving mathematical finiteness, spread-spectrum formats, sports ranking predictions, and access to legal information. No single stable semantics runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Negative question ending in “not”
patterns.context: “or not” appears sentence-finally to express uncertainty, ask a question, or make a judgment.

patterns.name: Online accessibility
patterns.context: Describes material, information, or content as available online or convenient for readers to access.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, book descriptions, encyclopedia articles

patterns.name: Upper-left position
patterns.context: Specifies a position or display location in a worksheet or selection.

patterns.name: Finiteness in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: A graph-theoretic definition specifies that a graph's vertex set is finite.

patterns.name: Spread-spectrum signal format
patterns.context: Describes data transmitted in a spread-spectrum format and its difficulty of detection.

patterns.name: Ranking and top-two predictions
patterns.context: Predicts a team's season ranking based on recent performance.

patterns.name: Legal information obtainable from other sources
patterns.context: When discussing whether formal discovery is necessary, assesses whether information can be obtained from other sources.

5_1172.description: 激活涵盖“or not”式句末判断、在线可访问性、方位描述，以及数学有限性、扩频格式、体育排名预测和法律信息获取等局部模式；未见单一稳定语义贯穿全部段落。

patterns.name: “not”结尾的否定问句
patterns.trigger: “if this is free or not” [4]；“widespread or not” [8]
patterns.context: “or not”用于句末，表达不确定、询问或判断

patterns.name: 在线可访问性
patterns.context: 描述资料、信息或内容可在线获取或方便读者查阅
patterns.domain: 学术写作、书籍介绍、百科条目

patterns.name: 上左方位
patterns.context: 说明工作表或选区中位置、显示位置

patterns.name: 数学定义中的有限性
patterns.context: 图论定义中说明图的顶点集有限

patterns.name: 扩频信号格式
patterns.context: 描述以扩频格式传输数据及其难以检测

patterns.name: 排名与前二预测
patterns.context: 根据近期表现预测球队赛季排名

patterns.name: 法律信息可从其他来源取得
patterns.context: 讨论正式证据开示是否必要时，评估信息能否从其他来源获得

en.description: Activations are concentrated on “accessible” and contexts involving online lookup, especially “easily accessible.” Other sporadic patterns include online purchasing and duration phrases, sentence-final “not” in comments, HN formatting fragments, and “top jobs.” Styles range across academic, web, legal, and commentary text, so they cannot be fully attributed to a single trigger.

patterns.name: easily accessible
patterns.context: Describing information, resources, or services as easy for a group to reach, obtain, or consult; [4] is followed by “to this population,” [7] by “online,” and [10] by “at the [Bureau of Prisons”
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research methods, legal documents

patterns.name: Information available online
patterns.context: Describing policies, supplementary materials, or entries as available online; [5] is also immediately followed by a website address

patterns.name: Verbal uncertainty and negation
patterns.context: A commenter expresses uncertainty with “I’m not sure if … or not”; activation is concentrated on the sentence-final “not.”

patterns.name: Time span or duration
patterns.context: Time units or frameworks are highlighted in numeric or duration phrases: the online purchase period for insurance and a project delivery time frame

patterns.name: Rankings or top positions
patterns.context: “Top” modifies jobs in a discussion of connections, university graduation, and employment opportunities

patterns.name: Formatting and filtering parameters in links/citations
patterns.context: Web text such as HN page parameters, comment separators, and quoted news headlines; no clear unified local semantic trigger

patterns.name: Generic promotional web phrase
patterns.context: An insurance advertisement describes arranging temporary vehicle insurance as quick, convenient, and purchasable online

patterns.name: Delivery timelines in risk lists
patterns.context: Describes project risks or business assumptions alongside factors such as production, equipment, and personnel

patterns.name: unexplained: Discussion of research subjects/accessibility
patterns.context: A medical abstract lists treatment options for infected people and compares accessibility; it contains “accessible” but not “online,” so its correspondence with other patterns is uncertain

patterns.name: unexplained: Accessibility of social media content
patterns.context: A news headline summary states that Holocaust-denial content is available on multiple platforms; it contains “accessible” but not “easily accessible,” and the context is cross-platform distribution

patterns.name: unexplained: Data policy and website address
patterns.context: An explanation of a research questionnaire and data access policy is followed by a website; it matches the online pattern, but whether it has the same trigger mechanism is unclear

patterns.name: unexplained: Online encyclopedia entry
patterns.context: States that a list of award winners can be found online, with no clear specific semantic condition

patterns.name: unexplained: Exposure of private information
patterns.context: A legal document states that sensitive information is easily accessible due to a lack of review; this aligns with accessibility phrases, but highlights privacy exposure

patterns.name: unexplained: Connections and networking
patterns.context: Discusses parental connections, university, and employment opportunities; only “top jobs” is locally highlighted, with no stable accessibility or time pattern

5_1172.description: 激活最集中于“accessible”及线上可查语境，尤其是“easily accessible”；另有在线购买与期限短语、评论中的句末 not、HN 排版片段及“top jobs”等零散模式。文体横跨学术、网页、法律与评论，不能完全归为单一触发。

patterns.name: easily accessible（易于访问）
patterns.context: 形容信息、资源或服务容易被某群体接触、获取或查阅；[4]后接“to this population”，[7]后接“online”，[10]后接“at the [Bureau of Prisons”
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究方法、法律文书

patterns.name: online 信息可查
patterns.context: 描述政策、补充材料或条目可在网上查阅；[5]还紧接网站地址

patterns.name: 言语不确定与否定
patterns.trigger: «sure»4« if»2« this»2« is»3« free»7« or»3« not»10«.»2
patterns.context: 评论者以“I’m not sure if … or not”表达不确定；激活集中在句末“not.”

patterns.name: 时间跨度或期限
patterns.context: 数字或期限短语中突出时间单位/框架：保险在线购买期限、项目交付时间框架
patterns.domain: 商业网页、企业风险描述

patterns.name: 排行或顶尖职位
patterns.context: “top”修饰职位，处于关于人脉、大学毕业与就业机会的讨论中

patterns.name: 链接/引用文本的排版与筛选参数
patterns.context: HN 页面参数、评论分隔符及引用新闻标题等网页文本；没有明显统一的局部语义触发条件

patterns.name: 普通网页宣传短语
patterns.context: 保险广告中描述临时车辆保险办理迅速、方便、可在线购买

patterns.name: 风险清单中的履约时间
patterns.context: 与生产、设备、人力等因素并列，说明项目风险或经营假设

patterns.name: unexplained: 研究对象/可及性讨论
patterns.context: 医学摘要列举感染者的治疗方案并比较可及性；虽含“accessible”，但缺少“online”，与其他模式的对应关系不确定

patterns.name: unexplained: 社交媒体内容可及
patterns.trigger: «readily»4« accessible»10« across»2 Twitter, YouTube and Reddit
patterns.context: 新闻标题转述中说明否认大屠杀的内容可在多个平台获取；有“accessible”但不是“easily accessible”且语境为跨平台传播

patterns.name: unexplained: 数据政策与网站地址
patterns.context: 研究问卷和数据访问政策的说明，随后给出网站；在线模式吻合，但是否为同一触发机制不明确

patterns.name: unexplained: 在线百科条目
patterns.context: 说明获奖者名单可在线找到，未见明显特定语义条件

patterns.name: unexplained: 隐私信息暴露
patterns.context: 法律文书称敏感信息因缺乏审查而可被轻易获取；与可及性短语相合，但突出的是隐私泄露

patterns.name: unexplained: 连接与人脉
patterns.context: 讨论父母关系、大学与就业机会；只有“top jobs”局部高亮，未见稳定的可及性或时间模式

en.description: Activation is cross-domain and varied in form: it involves negation and yes/no judgments, later parts of compound expressions, programming-context words, LaTeX symbols, spread-spectrum terminology, and the abbreviation ASAP. No single stable semantic or lexical pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Negative judgments and either-or questions
patterns.context: In colloquial or comment contexts such as “free or not” and “widespread or not,” judgments concern truth, whether something is the case, or whether it is widespread; [2] also has “not straight forward,” but its negation is weaker.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, technology news, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Final words in degree or state complements
patterns.context: Appears in later parts of multiword terms, fixed expressions, or sentence-final state descriptions, often as a later word in a compound, noun phrase, or predicate complement; the semantics vary.
patterns.domain: General explanations, business risk, patent technology, machine learning papers, job postings

patterns.name: Semantic recurrence of sense and context
patterns.context: Discusses whether words make sense in their original or reconstructed context when naming or understanding code; the same passage repeats sense/context.

patterns.name: Local structure of mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: Activation falls on fractions, set/vector-space notation, and adjacent symbols in LaTeX mathematical expressions; no natural-language semantic trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics or machine learning papers

patterns.name: spectrum in a technical term
patterns.context: When describing a spread-spectrum signal format, the latter part of the compound technical term is highlighted; it has no evident semantic connection to activated words in other passages.

patterns.name: Job-posting abbreviation AS-AP
patterns.context: The abbreviation “ASAP” appears in a start-date field in a job posting; activation concentrates on its letters.

5_1172.description: 激活分布跨域且触发形式多样：涉及否定与是否判断、复合表达后段、编程语境词、LaTeX符号、扩频术语及ASAP缩写，未见单一稳定的语义或词形模式。

patterns.name: 否定判断与二选一疑问
patterns.context: 在“free or not”“widespread or not”等口语或评论语境中，围绕真假、是否、是否普遍作判断；[2]也有“not straight forward”，但其否定强度较弱。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、科技新闻及一般说明文

patterns.name: 程度或状态补语的收尾词
patterns.context: 出现在多词术语、固定表达或句末状态描述的后段，常是复合词、名词短语或谓语补语中的后续词；语义类型不一。
patterns.domain: 一般说明、商业风险、专利技术、机器学习论文、招聘启事

patterns.name: sense 与 context 的语义复现
patterns.context: 讨论代码命名或理解时，词语是否在原有或重建的语境中说得通；同段含 sense/context 的重复。

patterns.name: 数学符号及公式局部结构
patterns.context: 激活落在 LaTeX 数学表达式中的分数、集合/向量空间记号及其相邻符号上；没有可见的自然语言语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或机器学习论文

patterns.name: 技术名词中的 spectrum
patterns.context: 描述扩频信号格式时，复合技术术语的后半部分受到突出；与其他段落的激活词并无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 职位缩写 AS-AP
patterns.context: 招聘公告的开始日期字段中出现缩写“ASAP”；激活集中于缩写字母。

en.concept: Mixed feature of formal notation and sentence-final “not”
en.description: Activations occur across two relatively clear cues: high-dimensional spaces, superscript exponents, sets, and technical terms in mathematical papers; and sentence-final negation in colloquial “if … or not” expressions. Other sporadic patterns include corporate delivery deadlines, web parameters, and comments about device failures, which cannot be unified by a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Sentence-final alternative-question construction
patterns.context: In colloquial speech or online comments, expressing uncertainty and ending with “or not”; activation is concentrated on “not.”

patterns.name: Dimension superscripts in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical papers, symbolic expressions for sets, spaces, or vectors; superscript numbers or variables show strong activation
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Time deadlines in contract language
patterns.context: Mentioning delivery by an agreed deadline while listing project execution, supplier performance, or similar risks or capabilities

patterns.name: Preposition “of” at a fragmentary sentence start
patterns.context: A fragment of corporate text extracted from a clause, beginning with a prepositional phrase and missing preceding syntactic content

patterns.name: Specialized terminology in mathematical research
patterns.context: Terms adjacent to formal notation in definitions, propositions, or technical descriptions in mathematical papers; activations are distributed across terms and symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematics, theoretical computer science, and control papers

patterns.name: Encoding formats in web parameters
patterns.context: URL/query parameter fragments before comment text, involving encoding and filter fields

patterns.name: Broken-screen descriptions in technical product reviews
patterns.context: A user reports that a review device’s screen broke shortly after use and asks whether the problem is common

patterns.name: Abstract formal symbol strings
patterns.context: Dense mathematical notation for variables, indices, vectors, and parameters in papers; the specific semantics are difficult to determine from the fragment alone

5_1172.concept: 形式化符号与句末 not 的混合特征
5_1172.description: 激活分布于两类较明确线索：数学论文中的高维空间、上标指数、集合与技术术语；以及口语“if … or not”的句末否定。另有企业履约期限、网页参数和设备故障评论等零散模式，无法由单一词义统一解释。

patterns.name: 句末选择疑问结构
patterns.trigger: “if this is free or not”“if this is widespread or not”
patterns.context: 口语或网络评论中，表达不确定并以“or not”收尾；激活集中在“not”。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的维数上标
patterns.context: 数学论文中，集合、空间或向量的符号化表达；上标数字/变量部分出现强激活。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 合同措辞中的时间期限
patterns.context: 列举项目执行、供应商履约等风险或能力指标时，提及按约定期限交付。

patterns.name: 碎片化句首的介词“of”
patterns.trigger: 段首“of and continuity of metals”
patterns.context: 从句中截取的企业文本片段，开头为介词短语，缺少前置句法内容。

patterns.name: 研究数学中的专门术语
patterns.context: 数学论文的定义、命题或技术说明中，术语与形式化记号相邻；激活分散在术语及符号内部。
patterns.domain: 数学、理论计算机科学与控制论文

patterns.name: 网页参数中的编码格式
patterns.context: 评论正文之前的 URL/查询参数片段，涉及编码和筛选字段。

patterns.name: 技术产品评论中的坏屏描述
patterns.trigger: “Galaxy Fold review unit”“screen … completely broken”“two days in”
patterns.context: 用户报告评测设备短时间内屏幕损坏，并追问问题是否普遍。

patterns.name: 抽象形式化符号串
patterns.context: 论文中变量、索引、向量及参数的密集数学记号；具体语义仅凭片段难以确定。

en.description: The most prominent pattern is LaTeX mathematical formulas and dimensional notation in ArXiv. Other instances include blog/comment-section webpage templates, scattered English phrases, and device-feature lists. Activation has no consistent semantic feature spanning all examples.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and vector-dimension notation
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across mathematical formulas, especially subscripts, sets, dimensions, and nearby symbols; it is not limited to any fixed variable name.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and LaTeX mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Comment and navigation text on blogs or web pages
patterns.context: Appears in comment or navigation areas of web pages, blog posts, or discussion pages; paragraph 3 also contains a comment-section user's post.

patterns.name: Time/degree phrases in English text
patterns.context: Activation falls on several phrases in ordinary English narrative or business text, including time and degree expressions; these examples have no evident shared topic.

patterns.name: Device features and operation descriptions
patterns.context: Product descriptions list operations a stylus can perform and the objects it controls; trigger words are distributed across a sequence of parallel feature descriptions.

5_1172.description: 最显著的模式是 ArXiv 中 LaTeX 数学公式及维度记号；另见博客/评论区网页模板、零散英语短语和设备功能列表。激活没有覆盖全部例子的一致语义特征。

patterns.name: 数学公式与向量维度记号
patterns.trigger: “$n_i$”“$A_i \in \mathbb{R}^{n_i \times d}$”“$\mathcal{X}_c \in \mathbb{R}^{c \times f}$”“$\mathbb{R}^{m \times d}$”“$\{0,1\}^{B/\delta}$”等公式中的 LaTeX 符号和维度表达
patterns.context: 激活分散在数学公式中，尤其是下标、集合、维度及其附近的符号；并非只对某个固定变量名有反应。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及 LaTeX 数学表述

patterns.name: 博客或网页中的评论与导航文本
patterns.trigger: “not sure if this is free or not”“Related Post”“Share this post”“Post a Comment”“Disclaimer”
patterns.context: 出现在网页评论、博客文章或帖子页面的评论与导航区域；第 3 段也包含评论区用户发言。

patterns.name: 英语文本中的时间/程度短语
patterns.trigger: “on agreed time frame”“large percentage of executives”“right now”
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语叙述或商业文本中的若干短语，包括时间表达和程度表达；这些例子没有明显共同主题。

patterns.name: 设备功能与操作描述
patterns.trigger: “navigate, scroll, and control PowerPoint Presentations, Web pages, and documents”
patterns.context: 产品介绍中列举手写笔可执行的操作及其控制对象；触发词分布在一串并列功能描述中。

en.description: The activation patterns are diverse: uncertainty questions of the “or not” type, online availability of network content or services, and a few special cases involving contract delivery times, blog interfaces, and EU obligations in Estonian. No single trigger pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Sentence- or phrase-final “not”
patterns.context: Often occurs at the end of questions or uncertainty expressions, such as “free or not,” “widespread or not,” and “reasonable or not”; the “not” at the end of passage 2 activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Website or network availability and accessibility
patterns.context: Web content, data, or services are described as available, accessible, or online; activation often falls on words related to the internet or platforms.
patterns.domain: Web copy, legal text, online publishing

patterns.name: Time frame and fulfillment
patterns.context: Describes a contracting party providing services or goods within an agreed time; activation is concentrated on the time-frame phrase.
patterns.domain: Corporate project and risk disclosure text

patterns.name: Blog comment-section formatting
patterns.context: A blog page contains layout elements such as related posts, sharing, comment counts, and a comment form; “guarantee” also activates in this passage.

patterns.name: Estonian legal expression
patterns.context: An Estonian sentence discusses fulfillment of obligations at the EU level; activation is distributed within morphologically rich words.

5_1172.description: 激活模式较杂：包括“or not”式不确定问句、网络内容或服务在线可用，以及合同履约时间、博客界面和爱沙尼亚语欧盟义务等少数特例。没有单一触发模式覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 句末或短语末的 not
patterns.context: 常出现在疑问或不确定表达的末尾，如 “free or not”“widespread or not”“reasonable or not”；第2段末尾的 not 激活最强。

patterns.name: 网页或网络可用性、可访问性
patterns.context: 网页内容、数据或服务被描述为可用、可访问或在线；激活常落在 internet 或平台相关词上。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、法律文本、网络出版

patterns.name: 时间框架及履约
patterns.context: 描述合同方按约定时间提供服务或商品，激活集中在时间框架一词组。
patterns.domain: 企业项目及风险披露文本

patterns.name: 博客评论区格式
patterns.context: 博客页面包含相关帖子、分享、评论数和评论表单等版式元素；本段还激活 guarantee。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语法律表达
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子谈及欧盟层面的义务履行；激活分布在形态丰富的词内部。

en.description: Activations are distributed across web, legal, medical, email, and policy texts. Visible local triggers include available, the upper-right corner of a webpage, time expressions, and page-template wording, but there is no clear shared pattern across all samples.

patterns.name: Availability of information or data
patterns.context: Describes whether data, information, resources, or delivery options are available, often with degree adverbs or source information
patterns.domain: Web descriptions, medical patent background, legal opinions, business texts

patterns.name: Upper-right position in a web interface
patterns.context: Directs users to operate or view content in the upper-right area of a page or website interface

patterns.name: Time or urgency expressions
patterns.context: Appears in expressions about deadlines or requests to make contact as soon as possible

patterns.name: Education and children's nutrition obligations
patterns.context: Estonian sentences discuss EU member states' obligations to support children's nutrition education

patterns.name: Account and login operations
patterns.context: After logging in, click the account link and find it in the upper-right corner of the page

patterns.name: Free community registration and features
patterns.context: Invites users to join a community, emphasizing that registration is quick, easy, and free

patterns.name: Blog comments and disclaimers
patterns.context: Related posts, sharing, comments, and disclaimers about information accuracy on blog pages

patterns.name: Request to make contact promptly in an email
patterns.context: The sender asks the recipient to get in touch as soon as possible after learning about the matter

patterns.name: Unexplained local triggers
patterns.context: Activation of an individual word or phrase may relate to local collocation, tokenization, or position; the available samples are insufficient to determine a unified condition

5_1172.description: 激活分散于多种网页、法律、医疗、邮件和政策文本；可见局部触发包括available、网页右上角、时间表达及页面模板用语，但没有贯穿全部样本的清晰共同模式。

patterns.name: 信息或数据的可获得性
patterns.context: 描述数据、信息、资源或配送选项能否取得，常带程度副词或来源说明
patterns.domain: 网页说明、医疗专利背景、法律意见、商业文本

patterns.name: 网页界面中的右上角位置
patterns.context: 指引用户在页面或网站界面右上方操作或查看内容

patterns.name: 时间或紧迫性表达
patterns.context: 出现在时间期限或要求尽快联系的表达中
patterns.domain: 商业风险披露、商务邮件

patterns.name: 教育与儿童营养义务
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子讨论欧盟国家履行支持儿童营养教育的义务

patterns.name: 账户与登录操作
patterns.context: 登录后点击账户链接并在页面右上角找到它
patterns.domain: 体育票务网站操作说明

patterns.name: 注册免费社区及功能
patterns.context: 邀请用户注册社区，强调注册快速、简单且免费

patterns.name: 博客评论与免责声明
patterns.context: 博客页面的相关帖子、分享、评论和信息准确性免责声明

patterns.name: 邮件中的尽快联系请求
patterns.context: 发件人要求收件人获知相关事项后尽快联系

patterns.name: 未充分解释的局部触发
patterns.trigger: «right»（[4][9]以外的模式无法解释其他高亮）；«internet»（[2]）；«time» «frame»（[3]）
patterns.context: 单个词或词组的激活可能与局部搭配、分词或位置有关，现有样本不足以确定统一条件

en.description: Activations occur mainly in web copy prompting users to click links or controls, and in contexts describing rankings of products, teams, warehouses, and other items. There are also isolated activations within Estonian words and in a question about automatic file transfer.

patterns.name: Link or button prompts
patterns.context: Prompts readers to click a page link, icon, or control; may be followed by purposes such as reporting abuse, getting more information, or unsubscribing

patterns.name: Rankings and placement expressions
patterns.context: Describes the position, ranking, or popularity of a team, app, warehouse, or league; often includes top, rank(ed), or a number
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, technology discussions, sports, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Fragment within an Estonian word
patterns.context: In an Estonian sentence, strong activation falls within lubaduste (promises); word-form segmentation is visible, but there are too few examples to determine a more specific condition

patterns.name: Description of daily automatic transfer
patterns.context: Asks how to use a cron job to automatically transfer files to a server; activation falls within transfered

5_1172.description: 激活主要出现在网页引导点击链接或控件的文案，以及描述产品、球队、仓库等排名的语境；另有爱沙尼亚语词内激活和自动传文件问答中的孤例。

patterns.name: 链接或按钮的操作提示
patterns.context: 引导读者点击页面链接、图标或控件；有时后接报告滥用、获取更多信息或退订等用途。
patterns.domain: 网页界面文案、电子邮件营销

patterns.name: 排名及名次表达
patterns.context: 描述球队、应用、仓库或联赛的名次、排名或热门位置，常出现 top、rank(ed)、数字。
patterns.domain: 百科、科技讨论、体育与产品介绍

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子中，强激活落在 lubaduste（承诺）的词内部；可见词形切分，但没有足够例子确定更具体条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 每日自动传输的描述
patterns.context: 询问用 cron job 将文件自动传到服务器；激活落在 transfered 的词内。

en.concept: English function words and webpage-position expressions
en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple text types. Prominent recurring cues include the English preposition in, the negation not, and position and interface words in webpage contexts. Other sporadic patterns include word-internal segmentation, sentence-final evaluations, and comment-moderation language; the Estonian passages are difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Preposition in in text
patterns.context: A preposition in English sentences indicating location, scope, time, or membership in a set; also appears in URLs and mathematical expressions.
patterns.domain: Web text, law, medicine, academic mathematics, Q&A

patterns.name: Adverb not in text
patterns.context: Appears in negation, probability, or degree expressions, usually within a sentence rather than in a heading or standalone phrase.

patterns.name: Direction and position words in web interfaces
patterns.context: Describes the location, access method, or status of webpages, controls, or website content; trigger words are distributed and do not all appear in every passage.
patterns.domain: Web content, blog comment instructions, website Q&A

patterns.name: Inflectional endings and internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Words across languages or in English are split into multiple tokens; no clear unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Estonian parliamentary records, English webpages, and medical texts

patterns.name: Sentence-final evaluative or interrogative words
patterns.context: A paragraph ends with a disclaimer about information accuracy, or a Q&A poses a question about feasibility.

patterns.name: Comment or dialogue management language
patterns.context: Discusses rules for reader comments, comment boxes, and reporting behavior.

patterns.name: Unrelated content words and formatting triggers
patterns.context: A few tokens may activate due to local spelling or formatting; the samples do not confirm a shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: URLs, legal documents, mathematical formatting, music articles, and proper names

5_1172.concept: 英语功能词及网页位置表达
5_1172.description: 激活分散在多类文本中，较突出的重复线索是英语介词 in、否定词 not，以及网页语境中的位置和界面词；另有词内切分、句末评价和评论管理用语等零散模式，爱沙尼亚语段难以解释。

patterns.name: 文中介词 in
patterns.context: 英语句子中表示位置、范围、时间或集合归属的介词；也出现在网址和数学表达式里。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、法律、医学、学术数学、问答

patterns.name: 文中时间/程度副词 not
patterns.context: 否定、概率或程度表达中，通常处在句子内部而非标题或独立短语。

patterns.name: 网页界面中的方向与位置词
patterns.context: 描述网页、控件或网站内容的位置、访问方式与状态；触发词分散，并非每个词都出现在所有段落。
patterns.domain: 网页内容、博客评论说明、网站问答

patterns.name: 屈折词尾及分词内部片段
patterns.context: 跨语言或英语词语被切分成多个 token；没有明显统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语议会记录、英语网页及医学文本

patterns.name: 句末评价或疑问词
patterns.context: 段落末尾对信息正确性作免责声明，或在问答中提出可行性疑问。

patterns.name: 评论或对话管理用语
patterns.context: 谈及读者评论的规范、评论框及举报行为。

patterns.name: 无关内容词与格式触发
patterns.trigger: «at» URL前缀、«right»角落、数学定义中的«in»，以及专名、姓名或格式标记
patterns.context: 少数 token 可能因其局部拼写或排版而激活，无法从样本确认有共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网址、法律文书、数学排版、音乐文章及专名

en.description: Activations concentrate on the webpage link cue here and end-of-entry encyclopedia markers such as External links/Category. A few additional contexts include film entries, parking maps, net worth copy, charitable fundraising, and campus event coverage.

patterns.name: Link word here
patterns.context: A webpage link cue at the end of a sentence or phrase, often followed by for more information, a period, or a URL
patterns.domain: Web copy, news, and explanatory text

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry-structure markers
patterns.context: Appears at the end of an entry, often adjacent to References, Category, line breaks, and film information

patterns.name: Film entry and category templates
patterns.context: Lists films, box office figures, or year categories in film entries, often alongside encyclopedia-style sections and line breaks

patterns.name: Parking map link
patterns.context: Informs readers about parking options near an event location and directs them to a map

patterns.name: net worth and internet phrases
patterns.context: Describes data provided by a website and its accuracy, highlighting the phrases net worth and internet

patterns.name: Donation and fundraising information
patterns.context: Calls for donations or provides links to fundraising and donation information

patterns.name: Phone extension and click-through instructions
patterns.context: Provides volunteer contact information and uses a link to direct readers to more information

patterns.name: Homecoming events and fundraising coverage
patterns.context: Reports on homecoming king and queen events and charity fundraising, with a read-more link

5_1172.concept: 网页链接与条目结构标记
5_1172.description: 激活集中于网页中的 here 链接指示词及百科条目末尾的 External links/Category 等结构标记；另有电影条目、停车地图、net worth 文案、公益募款和校园活动报道等少量语境。

patterns.name: 链接词 here
patterns.context: 作为句末或短语中的网页链接指示词，常接 for more information、句号或 URL
patterns.domain: 网页文案、新闻与说明文字

patterns.name: 百科条目结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在条目末尾，常与 References、Category、换行及电影资料相邻

patterns.name: 电影条目及分类模板
patterns.context: 电影条目中列举影片、票房或年份分类，常与百科式分节和换行并存

patterns.name: 停车地图链接
patterns.context: 告知活动地点附近停车选择，并引导读者查看地图

patterns.name: net worth 与 internet 词组
patterns.context: 描述网站提供的数据及其准确性，突出 net worth 和 internet 词组

patterns.name: 捐款与募款信息
patterns.context: 呼吁捐款，或提供募款、捐赠信息链接

patterns.name: 电话分机与点击指引
patterns.context: 提供志愿者联络方式，并以链接引导获取更多信息

patterns.name: 回家节活动与筹款报道
patterns.context: 报道返校节王后、国王及为慈善筹款的活动，附阅读更多链接

en.concept: Web prompts to continue searching or viewing
en.description: The main responses are to web or forum expressions prompting readers to keep looking, such as “Find/Read more” and “out there,” often at the end of a passage, as well as descriptions of publicly available data. There are also sporadic activations in Estonian fragments; the rest of passages 8 and 10 cannot reliably be assigned to the main pattern.

patterns.name: “More / see here” links to web content
patterns.context: Phrases in web body text or recommendations that prompt readers to continue viewing, learn more, or visit a link; triggers often fall on more, here, there, and nearby words
patterns.domain: Web promotion, blogs, news, and content recommendations

patterns.name: Publicly available data and resources
patterns.context: Mentions publicly available data or resources, or collection and analysis based on these materials; may relate to internet or research data

patterns.name: End-position links or references to locations/objects
patterns.context: Says that something or information can be found online, or asks whether a relevant tool exists; often appears at the end of a sentence or near a link prompt

patterns.name: “There” in sentence-final questions
patterns.context: Uses an existential construction to ask whether a type of tool or resource exists; activation is concentrated on there and nearby words in the question

patterns.name: Estonian word endings/word-form fragments
patterns.context: A continuous Estonian word fragment is segmented into multiple tokens; activation appears within a word in the sentence, rather than in English web-prompt contexts

5_1172.concept: 网页中的继续查找／查看导引
5_1172.description: 主要响应网页或论坛中引导读者继续查看的“Find/Read more”“out there”等表达，常见于段落末尾；也响应公开可用数据的描述。爱沙尼亚语片段另有零星激活；第8段及第10段其余部分无法可靠归入主模式。

patterns.name: 网页内容的“更多／查看这里”链接
patterns.context: 在网页正文或推荐文字末尾，出现引导读者继续查看、了解更多或访问链接的短语；触发常落在 more、here、there 及其前后词上。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、博客、新闻与内容推荐

patterns.name: 公开可用的数据与资源
patterns.context: 提及可公开获取的数据、资源，或基于这些材料进行搜集、分析；可能与互联网数据或研究数据相关。

patterns.name: 末尾的地点／对象链接或指向
patterns.context: 表达某物或资料可在网络上找到，或询问是否存在相关工具；常出现在句末或链接导引处。

patterns.name: 末尾问句中的“there”
patterns.context: 以存在句询问是否有某类工具或资源，激活集中在疑问句中的 there 及邻近词。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词尾／词形片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续词片段被切分为多个 token；激活出现在句中词形，而非英语网页导引语境。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，爱沙尼亚语

en.description: Most passages contain webpage referral phrases such as “out more” or “Read More,” often at the end of an excerpt or promotional copy. Other distinct trigger contexts include online availability, privacy definitions, legal mootness, and webpage concatenation followed by an Echo report.

patterns.name: Promotional “out more” link
patterns.context: Directs readers to click, continue reading, or learn more in webpage copy, often at the end of a sentence and followed by a link, website address, or heading; capitalization varies slightly.
patterns.domain: Website promotional copy, content summaries, and webpage navigation

patterns.name: “on the internet”
patterns.context: Describes data or resources as findable online; the phrase occurs in promotional sentences emphasizing that they are the most accurate, up to date, and widely available.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols in a differential privacy definition
patterns.context: Formalizes whether a randomized algorithm satisfies differential privacy, embedded among LaTeX mathematical expressions and database conditions.

patterns.name: moot in a judicial context
patterns.context: Discusses whether an appeal has become moot because the dispute no longer has practical significance; the word appears in legal reasoning.

patterns.name: Excerpt after an analysis display followed by a device report
patterns.context: After a webpage summary or entry ends, a line break is followed by another item about Amazon Echo; the device report is adjacent to the preceding smart-agent overview.

5_1172.description: 多数片段含网页导流短语“out more”或“Read More”，常位于摘要、宣传文案末尾；另有网上可得性、隐私定义、法律 moot 及网页拼接后接 Echo 报道等独立触发情境。

patterns.name: “out more”宣传式链接
patterns.trigger: « out»2« more»9；« Find»4/5« out»2« more»9；« Read»4« More»9
patterns.context: 网页文案中引导读者点击、继续阅读或了解详情，常处于句末并跟随链接、网站地址或标题；大小写略有变化。
patterns.domain: 网站宣传文案、内容摘要及网页导航

patterns.name: “on the internet”
patterns.context: 描述数据或资源可在网上找到，短语位于强调“最准确、最新、到处可见”的宣传句中。

patterns.name: 差分隐私定义中的数学符号
patterns.context: 形式化定义随机算法是否满足差分隐私，夹在 LaTeX 数学表达式与数据库条件中。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学论文、数学定义

patterns.name: 司法语境中的 moot
patterns.context: 讨论上诉是否因争议已无实际意义而失去审理必要性；词语出现在法律论证中。

patterns.name: 解析展示后接设备报道的片段
patterns.trigger: « Read»4« More»9 后接 «↵»7«↵»5The« Amazon»1 Echo
patterns.context: 网页摘要或条目结束后换行，紧接另一条关于 Amazon Echo 的内容；该设备报道与前面的智能代理概述相邻。
patterns.domain: 网页内容拼接／科技文章摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to phrases involving internet/web, search rankings, online visibility, and traffic, commonly in SEO copy, directories, and webpage introductions. Other, more sporadic patterns include full-article links, compliance/privacy definitions, technology devices, and game reviews.

patterns.name: Internet and search exposure
patterns.context: Activates when describing how data, directories, content, or products appear online, are searchable, or generate traffic; also includes statements that online content is available.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web promotional copy, SEO copy, and Wikipedia internet content

patterns.name: Web referrals and “read more”
patterns.context: Continue-reading links, line breaks, or traffic guidance at the end of a webpage article excerpt; often accompanied by truncated body text.

patterns.name: Legal applicability and compliance
patterns.context: Mentions whether an activity is legal and which jurisdiction applies, or uses a formal definition of differential privacy; trigger words do not fully overlap.

patterns.name: Consumer technology and devices
patterns.context: Discusses competing smart-home devices or device features such as media playback and speed control.

patterns.name: Genre and evaluation in game reviews
patterns.context: Reviews visual novels by evaluating common tropes, presentation, and the relative merits of similar works.

patterns.name: Game news and screenshot circulation
patterns.context: Reports that a game map leak was quickly taken down, screenshotted, and circulated.

patterns.name: Mathematical definition of privacy algorithms
patterns.context: Mathematically defines differential privacy conditions between algorithms and databases.

patterns.name: Encoding fragment with no clear match
patterns.context: The context begins with an apparently random string, then shifts to instructions for changing YouTube video playback speed; a connection between the string and the body text is unclear.
patterns.domain: Github text/code and media playback instructions

patterns.name: Political scandal and sexual assault reporting
patterns.context: Reports that a documentary about Polish clergy sexually abusing minors is available online; activation centers on the statement of online availability.

5_1172.concept: 互联网可见性与网页导流
5_1172.description: 主要响应网页中 internet/web、搜索排名、在线可见性及流量等词句，常见于SEO文案、目录和网页导读；另有阅读全文链接、合规/隐私定义、科技设备与游戏评论等较零散模式。

patterns.name: 互联网与搜索曝光
patterns.context: 在描述数据、目录、内容或商品如何在网上出现、被搜索到、带来流量时激活；也包括网上内容可获取的表述。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页宣传、SEO 文案及 Wikipedia 网络内容

patterns.name: 网页导流与“阅读全文”
patterns.context: 网页文章片段末尾的继续阅读链接、换行或流量引导；常伴随被截断的正文。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文章/链接文案

patterns.name: 法律适用与合规
patterns.context: 提及活动是否合法、适用辖区，或以形式化定义说明差分隐私；触发词并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 投资免责声明、计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 消费科技与设备
patterns.context: 谈论智能家居竞争设备或媒体播放、语速控制等设备使用功能。

patterns.name: 游戏评论中的类型与评价
patterns.context: 评论视觉小说时评价常见套路、呈现效果及同类作品优劣。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 游戏/视觉小说相关条目

patterns.name: 游戏新闻与截图传播
patterns.context: 报道游戏地图泄露后迅速撤下、被截屏并传播。

patterns.name: 隐私算法的数学定义
patterns.context: 数学化定义算法及数据库之间的差异隐私条件。

patterns.name: 无明显对应的编码片段
patterns.context: 上下文开头为似随机字符串，后续转为 YouTube 视频倍速播放说明；难以确认字符串与正文之间的触发联系。
patterns.domain: Github 文本/代码与媒体播放说明

patterns.name: 政治丑闻与性侵报道
patterns.context: 报道关于波兰神职人员性侵未成年人的纪录片已在网上提供；激活集中在网络可获取表述。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物与社会事件条目

en.description: The most prominent recurring cue is a “Read More”-style link following webpage text, along with copy about the internet, search, and website traffic. Other local triggers occur across webpage topics and in legal and mathematical text, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: More links in webpage content
patterns.context: A webpage link to continue reading or view more appears after body text or a summary; capitalization varies
patterns.domain: Web articles, news, or content pages

patterns.name: Internet and search exposure language
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing online data, search rankings, directory listings, or web traffic; common in reader-facing promotional webpage copy

patterns.name: moot in legal text
patterns.context: In legal arguments about mootness or whether an appeal has lost practical significance, activation falls on a spelling fragment related to moot

patterns.name: Variable x in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: The variable x appears near norms, differences, and subscript expressions in formulas
patterns.domain: Mathematics or theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Investment transaction compliance disclaimer
patterns.context: Reminds visitors to confirm that trading activities and related entities are legal in their jurisdiction

patterns.name: Promotional copy for accurate, up-to-date data
patterns.context: Introduces data sources and emphasizes accuracy, timeliness, or broad coverage

patterns.name: Search trends and keyword stacking
patterns.context: Describes search interest around a specific keyword, with conspicuous keyword repetition in the syntax

patterns.name: Smart-home and voice-device coverage
patterns.context: Introduces voice-controlled devices and companies launching competing products, followed by a webpage read-more link

patterns.name: Webpage Cookie privacy notice
patterns.context: Explains that Cookie and other technologies are used for information storage, service improvement, or advertising, and directs readers to learn more

patterns.name: Genre evaluation in a commercial review
patterns.context: Evaluates a type of work and notes that better alternatives exist; activation falls on comparative wording

patterns.name: Further-reading prompt in news
patterns.context: Directs readers to view additional content at the end of a news excerpt

patterns.name: University directory promotional copy
patterns.context: Invites institutions to submit information to an online directory to increase relevance and traffic

5_1172.description: 最突出的重复线索是网页正文后的“Read More”类延伸链接，以及互联网、搜索和网站流量相关文案；另有多种网页主题和法律、数学文本中的局部触发，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 网页内容中的 More 链接
patterns.context: 正文或摘要之后出现继续阅读、查看更多的网页链接；大小写有变化
patterns.domain: 网页文章、新闻或内容页面

patterns.name: 互联网与搜索曝光用语
patterns.trigger: «internet»10、«search»7« google»6« search»3« engine»9、«relevance»2« on»4« the»3« internet»8、«web»6
patterns.context: 谈论在线数据、搜索排名、目录收录或网络流量时；常见于面向读者的宣传性网页文案

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 moot
patterns.context: mootness／上诉是否失去实际意义的法律论述中，激活落在 moot 相关拼写片段

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量 x
patterns.context: 公式中变量 x 出现在范数、差值及下标表达式附近
patterns.domain: 数学或理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 投资交易合规免责声明
patterns.context: 提醒访客确认交易活动及相关实体在其所在司法辖区是否合法

patterns.name: 准确、最新的数据宣传
patterns.context: 自我介绍数据来源，并强调数据准确、及时或覆盖面广

patterns.name: 搜索趋势与关键词堆叠
patterns.context: 围绕某个具体关键词描述搜索热度，句法呈现明显的关键词重复

patterns.name: 智能家居与语音设备报道
patterns.context: 介绍语音控制设备及企业推出竞争产品，随后接网页阅读链接

patterns.name: 网页 Cookie 隐私说明
patterns.context: 说明 Cookie 等技术用于信息存储、服务改进或广告，并引导阅读更多

patterns.name: 商业评论中的类型评价
patterns.context: 评价某类作品，指出存在更好的替代作品；激活落在比较性措辞

patterns.name: 新闻中的阅读延伸提示
patterns.context: 新闻报道片段末尾引导读者查看后续内容

patterns.name: 高校目录推广文案
patterns.context: 邀请机构提交信息进入在线目录，以增加相关性和访问流量

en.concept: Common web fragments and SQL JOIN
en.description: Activations occur in word fragments and common web phrasing, especially traffic-driving expressions such as “out there,” “more,” and “internet.” Several StackExchange passages center on SQL INNER JOIN, ON, and id fields. Other contexts include comments, product recommendations, local news, and promotional copy, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Compound-word fragments at English word boundaries
patterns.context: Often appears at the end of a word, phrase, or sentence, and also within technical terms; activation position is unstable and includes different parts of speech
patterns.domain: Web text, comments, tutorials, and code-mixed text

patterns.name: SQL INNER JOIN and related fields
patterns.context: An SQL query combines tables using INNER JOIN and links them via id fields; these are mostly code examples, but also include explanations of JOIN
patterns.domain: StackExchange database Q&A and SQL code

patterns.name: Web traffic-driving and promotional copy aimed at readers
patterns.context: Web copy prompts readers to see more, visit links, submit information, or follow internet traffic; no specific topic is required
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web copy, promotions, and directory descriptions

patterns.name: Evaluation contexts for digital products and fictional works
patterns.context: Compares or evaluates optional works or products, using phrases such as “there are better…” or product-recommendation language

patterns.name: Specific join query in an SQL example
patterns.context: Joins two tables using their id fields; activation here is especially concentrated near the field identifiers

patterns.name: Count queries in database descriptions
patterns.context: Joins description and question tables, counts by description, and filters questions; triggers include fields and SQL clauses

patterns.name: Local news coverage of back-to-school events
patterns.context: Local news reports on a back-to-school event and fundraising, with a further-reading link at the end

patterns.name: Buying advice for shaving products
patterns.context: Offers recommendations and product reviews for scissors, safety razors, and trimmers

patterns.name: Video editing and service promotion
patterns.context: Describes a service’s security and features and directs users to visit via a URL

patterns.name: SQL JOIN tutorial prompt
patterns.context: Provides a JOIN example with product and agent tables and recommends reviewing JOIN syntax

patterns.name: Joining and filtering medical tables
patterns.context: Joins patient and medication records, counts patients, and filters by medication category

patterns.name: Online directories and traffic promotion
patterns.context: Invites users to submit information to improve directory relevance and website traffic

5_1172.concept: 网页常见词片段与SQL JOIN
5_1172.description: 激活分布于词内片段和常见网页措辞，尤见于“out there”“more”“internet”等导流表达；若干 StackExchange 段则集中在 SQL INNER JOIN、ON 与 id 字段。另有评论、产品建议、地方新闻及推广文案等语境，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语词边界处的复合词片段
patterns.trigger: 词内拆分后被标记的后缀或片段，如 «net»«worth»、«inner»«JOIN»、«identi»«cal»；另有 «internet»、«there»、«more» 等完整词
patterns.context: 常出现在词语、短语或句子末尾，也会出现在技术词内部；激活位置并不稳定，且包括不同词类
patterns.domain: 网页文本、评论、教程及代码混合文本

patterns.name: SQL 的 INNER JOIN 及其关联字段
patterns.trigger: «INNER JOIN»、«ON»、«id»，以及「products … agent … id」等表名和连接字段
patterns.context: SQL 查询中以 INNER JOIN 合并表，并用 id 字段建立连接；多为示例代码，也包括围绕 JOIN 的解释
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数据库问答与 SQL 代码

patterns.name: 面向读者的网页导流与推广措辞
patterns.context: 网页文案引导读者查看更多、访问链接、提交信息或关注互联网流量；不要求特定主题
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文案、宣传及目录介绍

patterns.name: 数字产品与虚构作品的评价语境
patterns.context: 比较或评价可选作品、产品，出现“there are better…”或产品推荐式措辞
patterns.domain: 游戏评论、消费建议网页

patterns.name: SQL 示例中的特定连接查询
patterns.trigger: «id» 及其前后的「SELECT * FROM … INNER JOIN … ON …」
patterns.context: 以表的 id 字段连接两张表；此处激活尤其集中在字段标识符附近

patterns.name: 数据库描述计数查询
patterns.context: 连接描述与问题表，并按 description 计数、筛选问题；触发点包括字段和 SQL 子句

patterns.name: 地域性返校活动报道
patterns.trigger: «more» «here»，其前文提到 Homecoming Court、募款和慈善
patterns.context: 地方新闻报道返校活动及募捐，末尾提供进一步阅读入口

patterns.name: 剃须用品的选购建议
patterns.context: 围绕剪刀、安全剃刀和修剪器提供选择建议及产品评测
patterns.domain: 消费指南或产品评测网页

patterns.name: 视频编辑与服务推广
patterns.context: 介绍服务的安全性与功能，并用网址引导访问

patterns.name: SQL JOIN 教学提示
patterns.context: 给出产品与代理人表的 JOIN 示例，并建议复习 JOIN 语法

patterns.name: 医疗表的连接与筛选
patterns.context: 连接患者和用药记录，统计患者并按药物类别筛选
patterns.domain: StackExchange 医疗数据库 SQL 示例

patterns.name: 网络目录与流量宣传
patterns.context: 邀请用户提交资料以提高目录相关性和网站流量
patterns.domain: 机构或地区目录网页宣传

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous content: “out there/anywhere” indicating a broad range of options in recommendation copy, identifiers and structural symbols in code, legal disclaimers, mathematical formulas, and biomedical statistics. There is no unified semantic trigger pattern yet.

patterns.name: Recommendation/promotional phrasing with “out there”
patterns.context: Describes products, content, data, or books available to choose from, often in an evaluative, recommendatory, or promotional tone; activation centers on phrases indicating broad availability or points of comparison.
patterns.domain: Reviews, business website copy, book promotion

patterns.name: Identifiers and operators in code and queries
patterns.context: Appears in code or database queries, marking fields, tables, attributes, and relationships; activation often falls on identifier fragments or connectors such as periods.

patterns.name: Jurisdiction wording in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: Reminds readers to independently verify that a trading entity is legal in their jurisdiction, as part of a liability and risk disclaimer.

patterns.name: Variables and set notation in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in formulas composed of multivariable norms and set notation, with no apparent natural-language trigger condition.

patterns.name: Statistical values and percentages in paper results
patterns.context: Compares incidence rates for experimental outcomes such as embryo fusion and cleavage, including significance tests and proportions.

5_1172.description: 激活分布于多类异质内容：推荐文案中表示广泛选择的“out there/anywhere”，代码中的标识符与结构符号，法律免责声明、数学公式和生物医学统计数据；尚无统一的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: “out there”的推荐／宣传语句
patterns.trigger: “better visual novels out there”“anywhere on the internet”“products out there”“nothing else out there like this book”中的“out there”或“anywhere”
patterns.context: 描述可供选择的产品、内容、数据或书籍，常带有评价、推荐或宣传语气；激活集中在表示广泛可得或比较对象的短语上。
patterns.domain: 评论、商业网站文案、书籍宣传

patterns.name: 代码与查询中的标识符和运算符
patterns.context: 出现在代码或数据库查询中，标记字段、表、属性及关系；激活常落在标识符片段或句点等连接符上。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的司法辖区措辞
patterns.context: 提醒读者自行确认交易实体在所在司法辖区是否合法，属于责任与风险免责声明。
patterns.domain: 金融／在线交易网站文案

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量与集合记号
patterns.trigger: “x”“y”“bm”“mathrm”“B”及范数、集合表达式中的符号
patterns.context: 出现在多变量范数和集合记号构成的公式中，无明显自然语言触发条件。

patterns.name: 论文结果中的统计数值与百分比
patterns.context: 比较胚胎融合、卵裂等实验结果的发生率，包含显著性检验及比例数据。

en.description: Primarily responds to sentence-final “out there” referring to external options or resources and nearby existence constructions, common in reviews, recommendations, and help-seeking questions. Other sporadic activations include code identifiers, mathematical notation, and quantum-computing terms.

patterns.name: “out there” followed by evaluation or inquiry
patterns.context: At or near the end of a sentence, indicates that something exists among external options, resources, or in the market; the preceding text often evaluates, compares, or recommends, or asks whether a usable option exists.
patterns.domain: Reviews, product and service promotions, Q&A, forum discussions

patterns.name: “there” in general locative or existential constructions
patterns.context: Activation may also fall on ordinary existential sentences or locative uses, not necessarily forming the fixed phrase “out there”; for example, there in “there are better visual novels out there” and “there is really nothing else out there.”

patterns.name: PHP/SQL database query identifiers
patterns.context: In SQL queries within WordPress PHP code, table aliases, field names, and join statements are marked; this differs from the natural-language “out there” pattern.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and natural-number set notation
patterns.context: In formal mathematical papers, appears in mathematical statements about metric spaces and mappings; activation is distributed across tokens composing the mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Quantum-computing terms
patterns.context: Related terms activate in discussions of quantum programmers, quantum computers, and whether they can reliably replace ordinary computers; the passage contains no clear “out there” wording.

5_1172.description: 主要对句末表示外部可选资源或产品的“out there”及邻近存在句式反应，常见于评论、推荐和求助提问；另有代码标识符、数学记号和量子计算词语等零散激活。

patterns.name: “out there”及其后接评价或询问
patterns.trigger: «out»« there»；常见后续包括 «better»« visual»« novels»« out»« there»、«any»« good»« software»« out»« there»、«tools» «out»« there»
patterns.context: 在句末或接近句末，用来表示某物存在于外部选项、资源或市场中；前文常有评价、比较、推荐，或询问是否存在可用选择。
patterns.domain: 评论、产品与服务宣传、问答、论坛讨论

patterns.name: “there”作一般地点或存在结构
patterns.context: 激活也可能落在普通存在句或地点用法中，不一定形成固定的“out there”短语；例如“there are better visual novels out there”中的 there，以及“there is really nothing else out there”。

patterns.name: PHP/SQL 数据库查询标识符
patterns.context: 在 WordPress PHP 代码中的 SQL 查询里，表别名、字段名及连接语句被标记；与自然语言的“out there”模式不同。

patterns.name: 数学符号与自然数集合记号
patterns.context: 在形式化数学论文中，出现在度量空间及映射的数学陈述里；激活分布于数学记号的组成 token。

patterns.name: 量子计算相关词语
patterns.context: 在讨论量子程序员、量子计算机及其替代普通计算机是否可信时，相关词语有激活；段内没有明显的“out there”字样。

en.description: Most concentrated on SQL table joins, field references, and query structure. Also responds to skeptical expressions such as “remotely plausible,” “out there” in copy and internet promotions, and evaluative phrases about works, indicating multiple local patterns.

patterns.name: SQL table joins and field references
patterns.context: Joins tables, specifies join conditions, or references fields in SQL queries; often co-occurs with code blocks, line breaks, indentation, and JOIN examples.
patterns.domain: StackExchange database Q&A and SQL code

patterns.name: Other SQL query structures
patterns.context: Selection, filtering, aggregation, or grouping parts of SQL queries; JOIN need not appear.
patterns.domain: StackExchange database Q&A and SQL code

patterns.name: “remotely plausible” expression
patterns.context: Skeptically evaluates whether a claim, idea, or vision is credible; one example splits plausible across a line break.

patterns.name: Internet phrases in website promotional copy
patterns.context: Promotes or introduces a type of data resource, claiming it is unavailable anywhere else on the internet or is the most comprehensive; activation centers near “on the internet.”

patterns.name: Evaluative ending in a review
patterns.context: Ends a negative evaluation of a work with an expression like “there are better ... out there.”

patterns.name: Product-selection copy
patterns.context: Introduces consumer goods and promotes buying advice or product reviews; activation falls near “out there.”

5_1172.description: 最集中地响应 SQL 表连接、字段引用及查询结构；另对“remotely plausible”怀疑表达、文案中的“out there”及互联网宣传、作品评价短语有响应，呈现多种局部模式。

patterns.name: SQL 表连接与字段引用
patterns.context: SQL 查询中连接表、指定连接条件或引用字段；常与代码块、换行缩进和 JOIN 示例同现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数据库问答及 SQL 代码

patterns.name: SQL 查询中的其他结构
patterns.context: SQL 查询的选择、筛选、聚合或分组部分；不一定出现 JOIN。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数据库问答及 SQL 代码

patterns.name: “remotely plausible”表达
patterns.context: 对某种主张、设想或愿景是否可信作怀疑性评价；其中一例跨换行拆分 plausible。

patterns.name: 网站宣传文案中的互联网短语
patterns.context: 宣传或介绍某类数据资源，声称其在互联网上无处可及或最全面；激活集中在「on the internet」附近。

patterns.name: 评论中的评价性收尾
patterns.context: 对作品作负面评价后，以「there are better ... out there」一类表达收束。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目中的作品评论

patterns.name: 产品选购文案
patterns.context: 介绍消费品并宣传选购建议或产品评测；激活落在「out there」附近。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 商业／产品推荐文案

en.description: Activations are distributed across emphasis on locations or scope in web copy, calls to read or learn more, interface location instructions, the code field id, and “remotely” in negation. No single word form or topic explains all passages.

patterns.name: Web-copy emphasis at “there”
patterns.context: In web descriptions or promotional copy, points to a place, scope, or availability; often emphasizes location or scope at the end of a sentence or phrase

patterns.name: “More” call-to-action link copy
patterns.context: Call-to-action/link text at the end of web content or promotional text, encouraging readers to continue reading or learn more
patterns.domain: Web marketing, news, or product content

patterns.name: Location word in comment-box instructions
patterns.context: Explains that users can click in the upper-right corner of the comment box to report inappropriate content

patterns.name: SQL identifier and field access
patterns.context: In a PHP database query, an SQL JOIN condition compares id fields from two tables; activation is concentrated on the field name id

patterns.name: “Remotely” emphasizing a negative judgment
patterns.context: Appears with “I don't think this is even,” reinforcing the rejection of the claim that quantum computers could replace ordinary computers

5_1172.concept: 网页文本中的强调性片段
5_1172.description: 激活分散在网页文案的地点或范围强调、阅读/了解更多的链接号召、界面位置说明，以及代码字段 id 和否定句中的 remotely；没有一个词形或主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: “there”位置的网页文案强调
patterns.context: 网页描述或宣传文案中，指向某处、范围或可获得性；常在句末或短语末尾强调地点、范围

patterns.name: “More”号召式链接文案
patterns.context: 网页内容或宣传文字结尾处的行动号召／链接文字，促使读者继续阅读或了解
patterns.domain: 网页营销、新闻或产品内容

patterns.name: 评论框界面中的位置词
patterns.context: 说明在评论框界面中点击右上角以举报违规内容
patterns.domain: 网站使用说明、社区规范

patterns.name: SQL 标识符及字段访问
patterns.context: PHP 数据库查询中，SQL JOIN 条件比较两张表的 id 字段；触发集中在字段名 id

patterns.name: “remotely”强调否定判断
patterns.context: 与 “I don't think this is even” 连用，强化对量子计算替代普通电脑这一说法的否定

en.concept: Extension and recommendation expressions in web text
en.description: Activations often occur in webpage copy around “more” links, generic location references, and recommendations or evaluations. There is also a PHP/SQL code passage and a quantum-computing discussion. The remaining activations are distributed across internal fragments of different words, with no shared semantic cue.

patterns.name: “more” links in webpage promotional content
patterns.context: A link in webpage copy or page navigation to continue reading, learn more, or view categorized content; triggering may involve formatting markers around the link
patterns.domain: Web promotion, editorial content, and navigation

patterns.name: Generic expressions in online reviews and recommendations
patterns.context: Emphasizes that better content, products, or information exist elsewhere, or emphasizes uniqueness; common in promotional copy and reviews

patterns.name: SQL queries and variable identifiers in code
patterns.context: Executes an SQL query through a WordPress database object in PHP code and iterates over the results

patterns.name: Quantum-computing terms and negative judgments
patterns.context: Discusses whether quantum computers will replace conventional computers and negatively evaluates that prediction

patterns.name: Sentence-final or phrase-final spelling fragments in English words
patterns.context: In multiple contexts, activation falls on a subword fragment of a complete word; no shared semantic or stable syntactic condition is apparent
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; the fragments alone do not indicate a common genre

5_1172.concept: 网页文本中的延伸与推荐表达
5_1172.description: 激活较多见于网页文案里的“more”链接、地点泛指与推荐评价；另有一段 PHP/SQL 代码和一段量子计算讨论。其余激活分散在多种词的内部片段，缺少共同语义线索。

patterns.name: 网页推广内容中的“more”链接
patterns.trigger: “MORE”或“more”（如 “READ MORE”“Find out more”“More in Sports”）以及邻近的换行、链接文本
patterns.context: 网页文案或页面导航中，作为继续阅读、了解详情或查看分类内容的链接；触发可能涉及链接前后的排版标记
patterns.domain: 网页推广、编辑内容及导航

patterns.name: 网络评价与推荐语中的泛指表达
patterns.trigger: “there”“anywhere”“else”等词，如 “out there”“anywhere on the internet”“anywhere else”
patterns.context: 强调某处存在更好的内容、产品或信息，或强调独特性；常见于宣传文案与评价

patterns.name: 代码中的 SQL 查询与变量标识符
patterns.context: PHP 代码中通过 WordPress 数据库对象执行 SQL 查询并遍历结果

patterns.name: 量子计算相关词语及否定判断
patterns.context: 讨论量子计算机是否会取代普通计算机，并对这种预测作否定评价

patterns.name: 英语词语的句末或短语末尾拼写部分
patterns.trigger: “used”“rolling”“figure”“talent”“scissors”“razors”“trimmers”“Cramer”“AdYoYo”“topics”“defamatory”等词内部被拆分标注的词段
patterns.context: 多个不同语境中，激活落在完整词的某个子词片段上；未见共同语义或稳定句法条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域；词段本身不足以归为同一文体

en.description: Activations concentrate on emphatic words in phrases or at sentence ends in web copy or instructions, such as more, out there, and right here. There are also local patterns involving remotely (a negative feasibility judgment) and found on the (finding information); no unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final focus words in information-search or recommendation text
patterns.context: A word at the end of a sentence or phrase activates in web copy or instructions that summarize, recommend, or prompt further reading; its position varies across passages
patterns.domain: Commercial websites, product or content recommendations, explanatory text

patterns.name: Sentence-final word in a feasibility or possibility judgment
patterns.context: In a negative judgment, an intensifying adverb appears at a line break at the end of the sentence, followed by the adjective being judged

patterns.name: Expression of missing performance information
patterns.context: States that no performance dates can be found for a region; the phrase is followed by a website or page name

5_1172.concept: 网页文案中的强调性短语
5_1172.description: 激活集中在网页文案或说明中短语、句末的强调性词语，如 more、out there、right here；另有 remotely（否定可行性判断）及 found on the（查找信息）等局部模式，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 信息检索或推荐语句的句末重点词
patterns.context: 网页文案或说明文字在总结、推荐或引导继续阅读时，句末/短语末尾的词激活；不同段中位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 商业网页、产品或内容推荐、说明文

patterns.name: 可行性与可能性判断的句末词
patterns.context: 否定判断中，程度副词位于句末换行处，后接被判断的形容词。

patterns.name: 演出信息缺失表达
patterns.context: 说明某区域没有可查到的演出日期，短语后接网站或页面名称。
patterns.domain: 音乐演出相关网页文本

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and formatting cues
en.description: Activations are scattered: code exception handling and returns, email-style openings, question marks, and Q&A formats are most prominent. Also present are medical terms, mathematical terminology, football statistics, and a haiku title, with no stable semantic feature spanning the examples.

patterns.name: Answer-style code returns and exception handling
patterns.context: Handling payloads, module loading, or exceptions in code blocks; segment 1 also has a `=>` function body and indentation structure

patterns.name: Conversational opening
patterns.context: Opening a message or introducing a plan in email or informal communication; activations cluster at the beginning of sentences

patterns.name: Question-mark punctuation
patterns.context: At the end of questions; segment 4 is followed immediately by a newline, while segments 6 and 9 use a question-and-answer format
patterns.domain: Q&A, math problems, and web headlines

patterns.name: Headline-style rhetorical question
patterns.context: A short question followed by a newline and continuation text; activation peaks on the question mark

patterns.name: Biomedical noun phrase
patterns.context: A core noun in a description of a small-cell lung carcinoma membrane antigen

patterns.name: Number-theory true-or-false questions
patterns.context: Natural-language questions about primes, composites, or divisibility, followed by True/False; numbers are split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: Sports-statistics narration
patterns.context: Adjacent to numbers in statistical lists of American football players’ seasonal performance

patterns.name: Haiku error-message headline
patterns.context: A Hacker News link headline phrased as a question, followed by a URL

5_1308.concept: 多种局部词法与格式线索
5_1308.description: 激活线索分散：代码异常处理与返回、邮件式开场、问号及问答格式最明显；另见医学名词、数学术语、橄榄球统计和俳句标题，缺乏贯穿各段的稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 回答式代码返回与异常处理
patterns.context: 代码块中处理 payload、模块加载或异常；第 1 段还有 `=>` 函数体和缩进结构

patterns.name: 会话式开场语
patterns.context: 邮件或非正式交流中开启发言、提出计划；激活集中在句首

patterns.name: 问句标点
patterns.context: 问句结尾处；第 4 段紧接换行，第 6、9 段是逐项问答格式
patterns.domain: 问答、数学题及网页标题

patterns.name: 标题式反问
patterns.context: 短问句后换行，接续内容；激活最高在问号

patterns.name: 生物医学名词短语
patterns.context: 作为肺小细胞癌膜抗原描述中的核心名词

patterns.name: 数论判断题
patterns.context: 以自然语言询问素数、合数或整除关系，并给出 True/False；数字被切分为多个 token

patterns.name: 体育统计叙述
patterns.context: 美式橄榄球运动员赛季表现的统计列表中，紧邻数字

patterns.name: 俳句错误消息标题
patterns.context: 以问句形式出现的 Hacker News 链接标题，后接 URL

en.description: Activation patterns are dispersed: they cover code exception handling, email-style openings, line breaks after questions, and mathematical true/false questions, as well as biomedical terminology, football statistics, film-viewing instructions, and webpage titles. There is no single stable semantic feature.

patterns.name: Informal opening phrase
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or topic, followed by an explanation of a personal attempt, plan, or similar.

patterns.name: Error-handling structure in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript code, returns a status or attempts to load a module within an exception-handling branch.

patterns.name: Line break after a question mark
patterns.context: A line break follows a question; seen in sequences of mathematical true/false questions and in ordinary text titles.

patterns.name: Mathematical true/false question
patterns.context: Short questions about primes, composites, divisibility, or multiples, followed by True/False.

patterns.name: Specific biomedical terminology
patterns.context: A term in a paper abstract, followed by a reference to small cell lung cancer.

patterns.name: American football statistics narrative
patterns.context: A player's season performance narrative listing defensive statistics and mentioning receiving yards.

patterns.name: Haiku error-message title
patterns.context: A short question resembling a HackerNews link title, followed by a link.

patterns.name: Film title and viewing instruction
patterns.context: A short suggestion or instruction, with the title “Silence” capitalized.

5_1308.description: 激活模式分散：覆盖代码异常处理、邮件式开场、问句换行与数学真假题，也包括生物医学术语、橄榄球统计、影视观看指令及网页标题。没有单一稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 口语化开场语
patterns.context: 句首或话题开头，后接个人尝试、计划等说明。

patterns.name: 代码中的错误处理结构
patterns.trigger: “return”以及“catch (err)”；缩进换行的 try/catch 代码块
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中，异常处理分支里返回状态或尝试加载模块。

patterns.name: 问号后的换行
patterns.trigger: “?”后紧跟“↵”，尤其形成连续的问答或标题行
patterns.context: 问句结束后换行；可见于数学判断题序列，也见于普通文本标题。

patterns.name: 数学真假判断问句
patterns.trigger: “Is … prime?”, “Is … composite?”, “Does … divide …?”, “Is … a multiple of …?”
patterns.context: 关于质数、合数、整除或倍数的短问句，后接 True/False。

patterns.name: 特定生物医学术语
patterns.context: 作为论文摘要中的术语，后续提及小细胞肺癌。

patterns.name: 美式橄榄球统计叙述
patterns.context: 球员赛季表现叙述，列出防守数据并提到接球码数。

patterns.name: 俳句错误消息标题
patterns.context: 像 HackerNews 链接标题的简短提问，后接链接。

patterns.name: 影视标题与观看指令
patterns.context: 短句式建议或指令，标题“Silence”大写。

en.description: Activations are dispersed across email-initial Ok, code catch, medical antigen, question marks, fraction slashes, technical URLs, catch in a sports context, and fragments of names in signatures; apart from question marks, there is no shared clear semantic or formatting trigger.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Ok”
patterns.context: Used as an opening response in email or conversation, introducing a proposal, plan, or explanation; activation is concentrated on Ok, not what follows

patterns.name: catch in JavaScript error handling
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript-style try/catch code, where an exception is caught and state is returned

patterns.name: Medical phrase antigen
patterns.context: Used with membrane, small cell carcinoma, and lung in a noun phrase from a medical title or abstract

patterns.name: Question mark
patterns.context: At the end of a question or short query; the sixth passage also includes mathematical classification questions such as “prime?” and “composite?”

patterns.name: Fraction slash in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: Appears in signed arithmetic expressions, joining numerator and denominator, such as “-1046/5 + 8383/40”

patterns.name: The word “URL”
patterns.context: Appears in a technical Q&A about fetching a parent product URL through the Magento API

patterns.name: catch as a sports term
patterns.context: Appears in “yards per catch,” referring to receiving statistics; player position and season statistics are nearby

patterns.name: Name fragment in an acknowledgments line
patterns.context: Appears in an ebook production credit line; activation falls on a tokenized name fragment

5_1308.description: 激活分散在邮件句首 Ok、代码 catch、医学 antigen、问号、分数斜线、技术 URL、体育语境 catch 及署名人名片段上；除问号外，没有共同的清晰语义或格式触发因素。

patterns.name: 句首“Ok”
patterns.trigger: «Ok»；第1段后接“I've taken a stab at #”，第2段后接“, here's the plan”
patterns.context: 作为邮件或对话中的句首回应，引出后续提议、计划或说明；激活集中在 Ok，而非其后的内容

patterns.name: JavaScript 错误处理中的 catch
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 风格的 try/catch 代码中，捕获异常后返回 state

patterns.name: 医学短语 antigen
patterns.context: 与 membrane、small cell carcinoma、lung 连用，属于医学标题或摘要中的名词短语

patterns.name: 问号
patterns.trigger: «?»10；第5段为“What if?”，第6段多个问题以问号结尾
patterns.context: 问句或短问题的末尾；第6段还包括“prime?”、“composite?”等数学判定题

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的分数斜线
patterns.context: 出现在带符号的算术表达式中，连接分子与分母，如“-1046/5 + 8383/40”

patterns.name: URL 一词
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento API 获取父商品链接的技术问答中

patterns.name: catch 作为运动术语
patterns.context: 出现在“yards per catch”中，指接球统计；附近还有球员位置与赛季数据

patterns.name: 致谢行中的人名碎片
patterns.context: 出现在电子书文本的制作署名行中；激活落在被分词的人名片段上

en.description: Activations occur across various text boundaries and local fragments: email-initial Ok, question marks/newlines, sentence-initial Here, and medical terminology, mathematical symbols, names, headline subword fragments, and code comments. Apart from several opening markers, there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Ok
patterns.context: An email or conversation response beginning with Ok, followed by a greeting or a plan.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial questions and question-mark line breaks
patterns.context: A question or headline-style phrase ends with a question mark; in one segment, the newline after the question mark is also marked.

patterns.name: Newlines and subsequent text boundaries
patterns.context: The beginning of text paragraphs, headings, or code comments; the newline itself is repeatedly activated, but the following content varies considerably.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Here
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Here, followed by a place and explanatory content.

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: An internal word fragment in the term membrane antigen and the subsequent medical description.

patterns.name: Mathematical negatives and operators
patterns.context: Minus and plus signs in expressions, between numbers or fractions.

patterns.name: Character fragments in names
patterns.context: Names in book production credits are tokenized into multiple fragments; activation falls on characters within names.

patterns.name: Proper-name or domain fragments in headlines
patterns.context: Proper names, domains, or internal fragments of common words in web headlines or questions; activation positions do not form a consistent meaning.

patterns.name: Code comment openings and version numbers
patterns.context: The opening of a block comment in a CSS/JavaScript library, including the project name and version number.

5_1308.description: 激活分布在多种文本边界与局部片段：邮件句首 Ok、问号/换行、句首 Here，以及医学术语、数学符号、人名、标题词片段和代码注释。除若干开头标记外，缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 句首 Ok
patterns.context: 邮件或对话中以 Ok 开始回应，后续可接称呼或计划说明。

patterns.name: 句首疑问与问号换行
patterns.context: 问句或标题式短语以问号结束；问号后的换行在一段中也被标记。

patterns.name: 换行及其后的文本边界
patterns.context: 文本段落、标题或代码注释的开头；换行本身反复激活，但其后内容差异较大。

patterns.name: 句首 Here
patterns.context: 句子以 Here 起始，后接地点及说明性内容。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 术语 membrane antigen 中的词内片段及其后续医学描述。

patterns.name: 数学负数与运算符
patterns.context: 算式中的负号和加号，夹在数字或分数之间。

patterns.name: 姓名中的字符片段
patterns.context: 书籍制作署名中的人名被分词成多个片段；激活落在姓名内部字符上。

patterns.name: 标题中的专名或域名片段
patterns.context: 网页标题或问题文本中的专名、域名或普通词内部片段；触发位置不构成一致词义。

patterns.name: 代码注释开头及版本号
patterns.context: CSS/JavaScript 库的块注释开头，包含项目名和版本号。

en.description: Activations occur in email-initial “Ok,” question punctuation and subsequent line breaks, comments and copyright formatting in code file headers, and the biomedical phrase “antigen.” These triggers belong to different genres, with no single clear semantics.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Ok”
patterns.context: A brief response or introduction to a subsequent plan or proposal; the latter example also has multiple line breaks.

patterns.name: Question punctuation and line breaks
patterns.context: A blank line after a question, or a new sentence beginning with a capitalized word after a line break; question marks also appear near webpage titles.

patterns.name: Code-comment file header
patterns.context: Near a block comment, library name, or copyright notice at the start of a code file; several passages use similar file-header formatting.

patterns.name: “antigen” phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a noun phrase about small cell lung cancer.

5_1308.description: 激活见于邮件句首“Ok”、问句标点及其后的换行、代码文件头的注释与版权格式，以及生物医学短语“antigen”。这些触发分属不同文体，未见单一明确语义。

patterns.name: 句首“Ok”
patterns.context: 作为简短回应或引出后续计划、提议；后一例还伴随多个换行。

patterns.name: 问句标点与换行
patterns.context: 问句后空行，或换行后以大写词开始新句；在网页标题附近也有问号。

patterns.name: 代码注释文件头
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的块注释、库名或版权声明附近；多段均是类似的文件头格式。

patterns.name: “antigen”短语
patterns.context: 出现在关于肺小细胞癌的名词短语中。

en.description: Activations cluster around the line-initial discourse marker “Ok” and around newlines, indentation, comment asterisks, and headline-style text in source code or documents. They also span distinct content such as copyright notices, licenses, configuration fields, and legal headings.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Ok”
patterns.context: “Ok” appears at the beginning of a message as a discourse marker opening a response or introducing what follows; activation falls mainly on Ok, while subsequent words are not a stable trigger.

patterns.name: Code comment opening format
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of block comments in source files, often introducing file descriptions, copyright, or license text.

patterns.name: Spaces and asterisk formatting in code comments
patterns.context: Line-initial indentation and asterisks form a repeated formatting template within comments or license blocks; associated with high activation in several examples.

patterns.name: Copyright notice
patterns.context: Identifies a copyright year and an individual or organization in a code comment, often near the beginning of the comment.

patterns.name: License title and body formatting
patterns.context: License text appears with uppercase titles, newlines, and indentation.

patterns.name: Configuration items or property lists
patterns.context: Newlines and indented key-value items or field mappings; colons or equals signs are followed by values such as numbers or identifiers.
patterns.domain: Github configuration, code, or data definitions

patterns.name: Court document heading
patterns.context: A formal heading rendered as an uppercase institutional name and newline, preceded by substantial indentation.

5_1308.description: 激活集中在行首语篇标记“Ok”，以及源码或文档中的换行、缩进、注释星号和标题式文本；另覆盖版权、许可证、配置字段及法律抬头等不同内容。

patterns.name: 句首“Ok”
patterns.trigger: «Ok»，后接口语称呼或计划说明，如 “Ok guys I've taken a stab at” 和 “Ok, here's the plan”
patterns.context: “Ok”位于消息开头，作为开启回应或引出后续内容的语篇标记；激活主要落在 Ok，本身的后续词并非稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、非正式商务交流

patterns.name: 代码注释起始格式
patterns.trigger: «/*!» 或 «/**»，随后是换行及注释行标记 « *»
patterns.context: 出现在源码文件的块注释开头，常引出文件说明、版权或许可证文本。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的空格与星号排版
patterns.trigger: 注释行中的缩进空格 «    »、« *»，以及 «↵»
patterns.context: 注释或许可证块内，行首缩进和星号构成重复的排版模板；在若干示例中与高激活相关。

patterns.name: 版权声明
patterns.trigger: «Copyright»，以及年份和版权所有者文本；另有 «(C)»、«(c)»
patterns.context: 代码注释中标明版权年份与个人或组织，常位于注释开头附近。

patterns.name: 许可证标题与正文格式
patterns.trigger: «GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE»、«Version»及其周围缩进
patterns.context: 许可证文本以大写标题、换行和缩进排版出现。

patterns.name: 配置项或属性清单
patterns.context: 换行、缩进的键值项或字段映射；冒号或等号后接数值、标识符等值。
patterns.domain: Github 配置、代码或数据定义

patterns.name: 法院文件抬头
patterns.trigger: «UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT»、«FOR THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA»
patterns.context: 以大写机构名称和换行呈现的正式抬头，前有大量空格缩进。

en.description: Activations are distributed across web markup, mathematical symbols, email openings, technical forum terms, and various code fragments. Locally they often fall on plus signs, newline indentation, code markers, and adjacent tokens; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: English entries and HTML/markup boundaries
patterns.context: In web or structured text, title/field markers, quotation marks, plus signs, empty tags, arrows, and adjacent newlines; “Entries Tag ged” appears before and is followed by Google

patterns.name: l and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variable l, numbers, and multiplication, division, addition, or subtraction symbols densely interleave, often with newlines or incomplete expressions

patterns.name: Conversational email opening
patterns.context: An email begins with Ok, introducing an address to a group, an action already taken, or a plan

patterns.name: Plus signs and numeric/pointer arguments in code
patterns.context: Plus signs connect numbers or expressions in formatting calculations and code calls involving container sizes or indices

patterns.name: Code block endings and newline indentation
patterns.context: In multiline code, return statements, closing braces, and indentation on the next line recur

patterns.name: moneyFormatFloor call
patterns.context: JavaScript-style code applies moneyFormatFloor to tempValue, either directly or after adding 0.1

patterns.name: Technical terms in a web help post
patterns.context: A help seeker looks for people with real project experience to discuss React and Node.js applications

patterns.name: C/C++-style assertion and out-of-bounds text
patterns.context: An assertion macro checks a list pointer and the result of modules.size() plus a constant, with an out-of-bounds error string

patterns.name: Russian text and Python newline string
patterns.context: Russian text is followed by Python Q&A code; a function concatenates string s with a newline and returns it

patterns.name: Build-script-generated comment and filename
patterns.context: A shell script header notes that it is machine-generated and must not be edited, and records an identifier related to the build command

5_1308.description: 激活分布在网页标记、数学符号、邮件开场、论坛技术词和多种代码片段中；局部常落在加号、换行缩进、代码标记及相邻 token 上，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文条目与 HTML/标记边界
patterns.context: 网页或结构化文本中，标题/字段标记、引号、加号、空标签、箭头和换行相邻；前面出现“Entries Tag ged”，后接 Google
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本或格式化条目

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 l 与运算符
patterns.context: 变量 l、数字和乘除加减等符号密集交错，常夹有换行或不完整表达式

patterns.name: 邮件中的口语开场
patterns.trigger: «Ok»；«Ok»后接 «guys» 或逗号，再接邮件计划内容
patterns.context: 邮件开头以 Ok 引出对群体的发言、已采取的行动或计划

patterns.name: 代码中的加号及数值/指针参数
patterns.context: 加号连接数值或表达式，出现于格式化计算、容器大小/索引等代码调用中

patterns.name: 代码块结束与换行缩进
patterns.context: 多行代码中，return 语句、右花括号和下一行缩进反复出现

patterns.name: moneyFormatFloor 调用
patterns.context: JavaScript 风格代码中，对 tempValue 执行 moneyFormatFloor，并出现直接传入及加 0.1 后传入的形式

patterns.name: 网页求助帖中的技术名词
patterns.context: 求助者寻找有真实项目经验的人，讨论 React、Node.js 应用

patterns.name: C/C++ 风格断言及越界文本
patterns.context: 断言宏调用列表指针与 modules.size() 加常数的结果，并附越界错误字符串

patterns.name: 俄文片段与 Python 换行字符串
patterns.context: 俄文文字后出现 Python 问答代码，函数把字符串 s 与换行符拼接并返回

patterns.name: 构建脚本生成注释与文件名
patterns.context: shell 脚本文件头注明机器生成、不可编辑，并记录构建命令相关标识

en.description: Activations appear in sequence-term problems and mathematical expressions containing negatives and minus signs, as well as in Greek word forms, money-formatting code, modulo loops, and numeric-sorting instructions. No single clear trigger pattern covers these heterogeneous texts.

patterns.name: Finding a sequence’s general term
patterns.context: A math problem asks for the kth, rth, uth, or pth term, or the general term, from several sequence values; the sequence may follow a quadratic or simple increasing pattern

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative numbers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign appears in formulas, arithmetic expressions, or surrounding sequence-problem text; it may indicate a negative number or subtraction

patterns.name: Greek word forms
patterns.context: Characters or subword fragments in continuous Greek text; activation clusters on Greek-letter sequences rather than mathematical or code contexts

patterns.name: JavaScript money-formatting code
