patterns.context: A function branch calls a money-formatting method, handling the original value and the value increased by 0.01 separately

patterns.name: JavaScript loops and modulo
patterns.context: A loop iterates over i and uses modulo to test divisibility before appending a string; a comment says the original number will always be included

patterns.name: Numeric sorting instruction
patterns.context: An instruction asks for several given numbers to be sorted in descending order, followed by more numbers or calculations

5_1308.concept: 异质文本中的局部片段
5_1308.description: 激活分布于数列通项题及含负数、减号的数学表达式，也出现在希腊语词形、金额格式化代码、取模循环和数值排序指令中；未见能覆盖这些异质文本的单一明确触发模式。

patterns.name: 数列通项求解题
patterns.trigger: “What is the …'th term of”以及随后给出的逗号分隔数列；常伴有以变量表示的多项式答案
patterns.context: 数学题目要求从若干数列项推断第 k、r、u 或 p 项，或求通项；数列可能呈现二次规律或简单递增规律

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的减号与负数
patterns.context: 减号出现在公式、算术表达式或数列题的前后文中，既可能表示负数，也可能表示减法

patterns.name: 希腊语词形
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中的词语字符或子词片段；触发集中在希腊字母序列，而非数学或代码语境

patterns.name: JavaScript 金额格式化代码
patterns.context: 函数分支中调用金额格式化方法，分别处理原值与加上 0.01 的值

patterns.name: JavaScript 循环与取模
patterns.context: 循环遍历 i，并通过取模判断整除后追加字符串；注释说明总会包含原数

patterns.name: 数值排序指令
patterns.context: 要求将给定的若干数值按降序排列，后文继续给出数值或计算内容

en.description: Activations occur across many text types, often on tokenized symbols, identifiers, or uppercase word fragments. They appear in mathematical formulas, code, JSON, database names, and colloquial text, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Symbol and punctuation activations under special tokenization
patterns.context: Activations often fall on non-ordinary subwords, punctuation, or uppercase/specially formatted fragments; the examples share no common local semantic condition.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and formal symbols
patterns.context: Appears near mathematical formulas, variable subscripts, relation symbols, or LaTeX commands.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math, physics, and theory papers

patterns.name: Camel-case identifiers and type fragments in code
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ declarations, member names, type names, or method calls; activation may fall on subwords within identifiers.

patterns.name: JSON key-values and database constraint identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in quoted JSON field names, random strings, or all-uppercase, underscore-separated configuration or constraint names.
patterns.domain: Structured data, configuration, and database test code

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in uppercase English colloquial text
patterns.context: Activation occurs in uppercase, subword-tokenized conversational advertising/dialogue, rather than formula or code structure.
patterns.domain: Colloquial or advertising content in FreeLaw text

patterns.name: Graph theory terminology in abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract introduces random walks or pursuit problems on graphs; visible activation currently falls mainly on split word fragments.
patterns.domain: ArXiv abstracts, graph theory or probability

5_1308.description: 激活分布于多种文本中，常落在被拆分的符号、标识符或大写词片段；数学公式、代码、JSON、数据库名及口语文本均出现，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 特殊分词下的符号与标点激活
patterns.trigger: 多处触发集中在被拆分或混合编码的符号串，如 [1] «T»、«$»、«_»；[3] «otimes»、«oplus»；[5] JSON 字符串与随机键；[7] AUTO_INCREMENT；[8] 全大写口语；[9] std::ostream
patterns.context: 激活常落在非普通词汇的子词、标点或大写/特殊格式片段上；各段缺乏共同的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学及形式化符号
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式、变量下标、关系符号或 LaTeX 命令附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 代码中的驼峰/标识符与类型片段
patterns.context: 位于 C++ 声明、成员名、类型名或方法调用中；激活点可能是标识符内部子词。

patterns.name: JSON 键值和数据库约束标识符
patterns.context: 出现在引号括起的 JSON 字段名、随机字符串或全大写下划线分隔的配置/约束名中。
patterns.domain: 结构化数据、配置与数据库测试代码

patterns.name: 英语大写口语文本的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在大写、按子词切分的对话式广告/对白，而非公式或代码结构。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 文本中的口语或广告式内容

patterns.name: 摘要中的图论术语
patterns.context: 摘要介绍图上随机游走/追捕问题；目前可见激活主要落在被拆分的词片段。

en.description: Activations appear in three heterogeneous text types: operators, coefficients, and question wording in automatically generated algebra problems; identifiers and member/property syntax in code; and LaTeX formula commands and symbols in papers. No single stable cross-domain trigger substring is apparent.

patterns.name: Signed-coefficient expressions in math problems
patterns.context: After an algebraic expression or function definition, the text asks for a polynomial function value or a sum of products; activations are scattered across operators, numbers, variables, and problem wording
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, automatically generated algebra problems

patterns.name: Identifiers and member access in code
patterns.context: Identifiers, member access, method calls, and type/property configuration statements in Go or C# code; no clearly consistent single code-syntax trigger

patterns.name: Formula markers and symbols in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Around commands, Greek letters, and mathematical relation symbols in LaTeX formulas, integrals, or representation-theoretic expressions

5_1308.concept: 数学符号与结构化表达式
5_1308.description: 激活见于三类异质文本：自动代数题中的运算符、系数与提问语句，代码中的标识符和成员/属性语法，以及论文 LaTeX 公式命令与符号。未见跨领域稳定的单一触发子串。

patterns.name: 数学题中的带符号系数表达式
patterns.trigger: «-»、«+»及相邻的数字、变量或乘法项；常与«What is»、«Determine»、«Calculate»及«*»相邻
patterns.context: 代数式或函数定义后，询问多项式函数值或若干乘积之和；激活散布在运算符、数字、变量和题目措辞上
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，自动生成的代数题

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与成员访问
patterns.context: Go 或 C# 代码中，标识符、成员访问、方法调用及类型/属性配置语句；没有显然一致的单一代码语法触发点

patterns.name: 数学论文中的公式标记与符号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式、积分或表示论式表达式中，命令、希腊字母和数学关系符号周围

en.description: Activations are scattered across code/SQL syntax boundaries, mathematical formula structure and symbols, English with-phrases, Japanese descriptions of exceptions, and tokenized names in encyclopedic text. Some triggers may be local word forms or marker boundaries, but no unified semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Code and syntax-structure boundaries
patterns.context: Keywords, identifiers, and adjacent spaces, punctuation, and structural boundaries in code or queries; includes C++, PHP, and SQL.

patterns.name: Separators and structural symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Near formula punctuation, set/norm symbols, parentheses, or LaTeX structure in math-paper formulas and proofs; activation is not limited to one operation.

patterns.name: English relational word with
patterns.context: Connects entities with their attributes, members, or holders in English noun phrases; appears in biographies of people with surnames and in legal factual accounts.

patterns.name: Japanese exception wording and explanation of causes
patterns.context: A Japanese sentence discusses an exception and its specific cause; nearby text also describes service-status updates.

patterns.name: Paciotti in a name
patterns.context: The surname Paciotti is marked as a split fragment at the word ending; appears in lists of people and biographical introductions.

patterns.name: von Ahrensberg in a name
patterns.context: The compound surname recurs in biographies and cast lists, with activation near tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia biographies and film/TV articles

patterns.name: Numeric-threshold phrase
patterns.context: A legal account describes people holding less than a specified number of shares; this activation is weak and isolated.

5_1308.description: 激活分散于代码/SQL语法边界、数学公式结构与符号、英文with关系短语，以及日文异常表述和百科人名分词；部分触发可能是局部词形或标记边界，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 代码与语法结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或查询语句中的关键字、标识符及其相邻空格、标点和结构边界；涉及 C++、PHP、SQL。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的分隔与结构符号
patterns.context: 数学论文公式及证明中，公式标点、集合/范数符号、括号或 LaTeX 结构附近；激活不局限于某一种运算。

patterns.name: 英文关系词 with
patterns.context: 英文名词短语中连接实体与其属性、成员或持有人；出现于姓氏人物介绍和法律事实叙述。

patterns.name: 日文异常词语及原因说明
patterns.context: 日文句子谈到异常发生及其具体原因，附近还出现服务状态更新等说明。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Paciotti
patterns.context: 姓氏 Paciotti 在词尾被拆分标记；出现在人物名单及人物介绍中。

patterns.name: 人名中的 von Ahrensberg
patterns.context: 复合姓氏在人物介绍和演员名单中重复出现，分词边界附近激活。
patterns.domain: 英文百科人物与影视条目

patterns.name: 数字阈值短语
patterns.context: 法律事实中描述持股数量低于特定门槛的人群；该激活较弱且孤立。

en.concept: Multiple local orthographic and formatting features
en.description: Activations are distributed across subword fragments of proper nouns such as names, C++ syntax, shell redirection, PHP opening tags, and fixed patent phrasing; there are also line-break spaces in titles or code. No single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and continuation across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on partial subwords of proper nouns, especially middle or final name fragments; found across different languages and tokenization schemes.
patterns.domain: Texts such as biographies, encyclopedias, email, and educational profiles

patterns.name: C++ template and namespace syntax
patterns.context: Appears near namespaces, template declarations, and type names in C++ code; activation covers syntax tokens and identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Redirection symbols
patterns.context: In shell commands that redirect standard output and standard error to /dev/null, activation is concentrated on > and &.

patterns.name: Patent phrasing “described in”
patterns.context: In patent background sections, described in introduces a previously mentioned patent or technical document.

patterns.name: PHP tag and line break
patterns.context: When PHP code begins after a Q&A body, activation falls on the PHP opening tag and the following line break.

patterns.name: Whitespace and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Some activation falls on consecutive line breaks near titles or on indentation and line breaks in C++ code formatting; it may be related to code structure or formatting around proper nouns.

5_1308.concept: 多类局部词形与格式特征
5_1308.description: 激活分布于人名等专名的子词片段，以及 C++ 语法、shell 重定向、PHP 起始标记和专利固定表述；另有标题或代码中的换行空白。没有单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 专名与词边界延续
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的部分子词上，尤其是姓名中间或末尾的子词片段；不同语言和分词方式均有出现。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、百科、邮件及教育简介等文本

patterns.name: C++模板与命名空间语法
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 代码中的命名空间、模板声明及类型名附近；激活覆盖语法 token 与标识符片段。

patterns.name: 重定向符号
patterns.context: shell 命令中将标准输出和标准错误重定向到 /dev/null 时，激活集中于 > 与 &。

patterns.name: “described in”专利表述
patterns.trigger: « described»10« in»5 the« aforementioned»2 Jordan« patent»1
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，以 described in 引出前述专利或技术文献。

patterns.name: PHP 标记及换行
patterns.context: 问答正文之后开始 PHP 代码时，激活落在 PHP 起始标记和紧随的换行。

patterns.name: 空白与换行格式
patterns.trigger: «↵»5«↵»3（段3）；代码中的空白与换行，如段4、6
patterns.context: 激活部分落在标题附近的连续换行，或 C++ 代码排版中的缩进与换行；可能与代码结构或专名周围的格式有关。
patterns.domain: 百科标题布局、源码排版

en.description: Primarily responds to public base classes introduced by a colon in C++ class declarations and to C++ constructor initializer lists; also appears in Dart super initialization. C++ template code and an internal fragment in a Wikipedia passage may be secondary or incidental patterns.

patterns.name: Colon in C++ inheritance declarations
patterns.context: A colon after a class name in a C++ `class` declaration introduces one or more base classes; activation is concentrated on the colon and nearby `public`.

patterns.name: C++ constructor member initializer lists
patterns.context: An initializer list after a C++ constructor declaration and before the function body; the colon is followed by members or base classes and parenthesized arguments.

patterns.name: Dart constructor super initialization
patterns.context: A Dart constructor calls the parent constructor after its parameter list using a colon, passing named arguments.

patterns.name: Template declarations and template metaprogramming
patterns.context: C++ template definitions or template parameter lists; snippets include type deduction/metaprogramming code and multiline template parameters.

patterns.name: Letter fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within English/French names or words, rather than an evidently independent syntactic structure.

5_1308.concept: 冒号引出的继承或初始化结构
5_1308.description: 主要响应 C++ 类声明中冒号引出的 public 基类，以及 C++ 构造函数初始化列表；也见于 Dart 的 super 初始化。另有 C++ 模板代码和一段维基百科词内片段，可能是次要或偶然模式。

patterns.name: C++ 继承声明中的冒号
patterns.trigger: `:9« public`，后接基类名；如 `: public WindowEx`、`: public FilterPolicy`、`: public RefCounted`
patterns.context: C++ `class` 声明的类名之后，以冒号引出一个或多个基类；激活集中落在冒号及 `public` 附近。

patterns.name: C++ 构造函数成员初始化列表
patterns.context: C++ 构造函数声明后、函数体开始前的初始化列表；冒号后接成员或基类及括号参数。

patterns.name: Dart 构造函数的 super 初始化
patterns.context: Dart 构造函数参数列表后，以冒号调用父类构造函数，并传入命名参数。

patterns.name: 模板声明与模板元编程
patterns.context: C++ 模板定义或模板参数列表；片段包含类型推导/元编程代码及跨行模板参数。

patterns.name: 英语词内的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语/法语人名或词语内部的子词片段，而非显然独立的语法结构。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several text types: internal fragments in proper nouns and webpage titles, English apostrophes, and punctuation and structural symbols in code or formulas; there is also a nonzero comparison. They show no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in English proper nouns
patterns.context: Trigger points occur inside text such as personal names, place names, titles, and URLs; some words are split into multiple subword tokens.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and syntactic structures
patterns.context: Appears in program code or mathematical typesetting, often adjacent to identifiers, types, template parameters, or formula structures; the triggering character is not restricted to one punctuation mark.
patterns.domain: C++/Dart code and LaTeX mathematical text, [2][3][4][5][6][9][10]

patterns.name: English possessive and contraction apostrophes
patterns.context: An apostrophe joins word-form fragments in English possessives or contractions.
patterns.domain: English titles, advertising copy, and webpage titles, [7][8]

patterns.name: Numeric comparison with zero
patterns.context: Code checks whether a count or state is nonzero by comparing it with zero.

5_1308.description: 激活分布于多类文本：专名和网页标题中的词内片段、英文撇号，以及代码或公式中的标点与结构符号；另有非零比较。它们未显示出单一稳定的语义触发器。

patterns.name: 英文专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于人名、地名或标题、网址等文本的内部；部分词被拆成多个子词 token。
patterns.domain: 百科传记与新闻/网页标题，[1][8]

patterns.name: 代码标点与语法结构
patterns.context: 出现在程序代码或数学排版中，常邻接标识符、类型、模板参数或公式结构；触发字符并不固定为单一种标点。

patterns.name: 英文所有格与缩写撇号
patterns.context: 撇号连接英文所有格或缩写的词形片段。
patterns.domain: 英文标题、广告文案及网页标题，[7][8]

patterns.name: 数字零值比较
patterns.context: 代码中以不等于零判断计数或状态是否非零。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code-structure punctuation and identifier fragments, parliamentary transcript attributions and multilingual word fragments, and apostrophes and headline hyphens in English copy. No single word meaning or stable context spans all examples.

patterns.name: Control-flow or code-block boundaries
patterns.context: In source code, especially structural boundaries of functions, conditionals, or module wrappers; activations fall on punctuation, whitespace, and adjacent code tokens, without being limited to one language

patterns.name: Word fragments and case boundaries within identifiers
patterns.context: Activation may fall on camel-case identifiers, name fragments, or word endings; there is no consistent meaning or fixed position

patterns.name: European Parliament speaker-attribution format
patterns.context: In EuroParl transcripts, speaker names often appear in attribution positions after a newline, followed by a language marker or a new speech

patterns.name: Apostrophes in English promotional slogans
patterns.context: Contraction apostrophes in short English retail slogans; activation falls mainly on the apostrophe character

patterns.name: Hyphens in headlines
patterns.context: Connects compound modifiers in English headlines

patterns.name: Accented or Greek-letter fragments within non-English words
patterns.context: Markers fall on internal characters or subwords in non-English words; these examples vary in language and meaning and show no stable grammatical or semantic condition
patterns.domain: Swedish, Danish, and Greek political text

5_1308.description: 激活分散在代码结构标点与标识符片段、议会逐字稿的署名和多语种词片段，以及英文文案的撇号、标题连字符；没有贯穿全部样本的单一词义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 控制流或代码块边界
patterns.context: 在源代码中，尤其是函数、条件语句或模块包装器的结构边界；激活落在标点、空白及相邻代码 token 上，不局限于某一种语言

patterns.name: 标识符内部的词片与大小写边界
patterns.trigger: `LogItemThread::LogItemThread()`、`Toussas`、`Hannan`、`Ricardo` 等标识符或专名中被标记的片段
patterns.context: 激活可落在驼峰式标识符、名字片段或词尾；没有一致的词义或固定位置
patterns.domain: 代码标识符及人名文本

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言人署名格式
patterns.trigger: `Daniel Hannan`（[6]、[9]）；另见 `Georgios Toussas`（[5]）及其后的 `↵(EN)` 或发言正文
patterns.context: EuroParl 逐字稿中，发言人名字常出现在换行后的署名位置，并接语言标记或新发言
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种转录文本

patterns.name: 英文宣传语中的撇号
patterns.context: 英文零售宣传短句中的缩写撇号；激活主要落在撇号字符

patterns.name: 标题中的连字符
patterns.context: 英文标题里连接复合修饰语

patterns.name: 非英语词内部的重音或希腊字母片段
patterns.trigger: 瑞典语 `säker`、`vårt`、`närvarande`；丹麦语 `tilgængelig`；希腊语 `Ουγγαρία`、`επιτροπή` 中被标记的子词片段
patterns.context: 标记落在非英语词的内部字符或子词上；这些例子语言与语义各异，未显示稳定的语法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 瑞典语、丹麦语、希腊语政治文本

en.description: The response pattern is mixed: names split across tokens, typographic spaces and line breaks, court-header fields, source-code syntax markers, and Greek parliamentary titles. Several activations may stem from formatting or tokenization boundaries; there is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Name spelling and name endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on components of names split across token boundaries, commonly at paragraph ends, in signatures, or in biographical descriptions; the types of names vary.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speech attributions, encyclopedia biographies, court-document headers, news, conversational parliamentary text

patterns.name: Indentation whitespace and typographic alignment
patterns.context: Appears in code indentation, court-document headers, or other column-aligned text; whitespace length varies and usually occurs near line breaks or structured fields.
patterns.domain: Source code, legal documents, and formatted text

patterns.name: Line breaks and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Activation often occurs next to line breaks, especially near signatures, header fields, or code blocks following a line break; not all line breaks behave alike.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary records, legal documents, source code, LaTeX documents

patterns.name: Fixed court-document header fields
patterns.context: These fields are in court case-file headers and appear alongside dates, case numbers, clerk information, and extensive aligned whitespace.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting structures in source code
patterns.context: Activations are distributed around code syntax markers, property access, and iterator expressions, with indentation whitespace also within passages; no single operator is consistent.
patterns.domain: Github source code (JavaScript and C++-style snippets)

patterns.name: Formal proper nouns/titles in Greek parliamentary text
patterns.context: Titles or formal forms of address in Greek parliamentary records, surrounded by line breaks and parliamentary proceedings; Greek word tokenization may also be involved.

5_1308.description: 响应模式混杂：跨分词的人名、排版空格与换行、法院页眉字段、源码语法标记及希腊语议会标题。若干激活可能来自格式或分词边界，未见单一稳定语义触发器。

patterns.name: 人名拼写与姓名末尾
patterns.trigger: 分词姓名片段，如 «Jos»«é»« Ign»«acio»« Sal»«a»«fr»«anca»« S»«án»«chez»；«Ric»«ardo»；«T»«ouss»«as»；«L»«yle»« W»«.»« Cay»«ce»；以及«ai»
patterns.context: 激活落在跨分词边界的人名组成部分上，常见于段落末尾、签名或人物介绍；覆盖的姓名类型不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 议会发言署名、百科人物介绍、法院文书页眉、新闻、对话议会文本

patterns.name: 缩进空白与排版对齐
patterns.context: 出现在代码缩进、法院文书页眉或其他按列对齐的文本中；空白长度不一，通常邻接换行或结构化字段。
patterns.domain: 源码、法律文书及排版文本

patterns.name: 换行及结构边界
patterns.context: 激活常紧邻换行，尤其是换行后的署名、页眉字段或代码块；并非所有换行都以同等方式出现。
patterns.domain: 议会记录、法律文书、源码、LaTeX 文档

patterns.name: 法院文书固定页眉字段
patterns.context: 这些字段处于法院案卷页眉，和日期、案号、书记员及大量对齐空白共同出现。

patterns.name: 源码中的标点与格式结构
patterns.context: 激活分布在代码语法标记、属性访问和迭代器表达式周围，段内也有缩进空白；没有一致的单一运算符。
patterns.domain: Github 源码（JavaScript 与 C++ 风格片段）

patterns.name: 希腊语议会文本中的形式化专名/标题
patterns.context: 希腊语议会记录中的标题或正式称谓，周围有换行和议事文本；可能同时涉及希腊语词的分词。

en.concept: Boundaries and formatting in structured text
en.description: Activations fall mainly on indentation whitespace, compound identifiers, and syntax boundaries in code, commonly around class and function structures. Other localized patterns include aligned headers in court documents, parliamentary transcript formatting, log separators, indentation checksums, and SVG attribute code.

patterns.name: Indentation and whitespace in C++/C# code
patterns.context: Indentation, blank lines, and alignment positions in code structures are marked; they commonly occur near braces, declarations, or member functions

patterns.name: Compound names in types or identifiers
patterns.context: Programming-language identifiers composed of multiple subword fragments, commonly appearing in class, member, or variable declarations

patterns.name: Code punctuation and syntax boundaries
patterns.context: Boundaries in code syntax structures; some activations fall on punctuation itself or on surrounding spaces

patterns.name: Near initialization and constructors
patterns.context: Class constructor declarations or definitions, and the beginning of initializer lists or constructor bodies

patterns.name: Court document headers, case numbers, and layout whitespace
patterns.context: Headers or post-page-break case metadata in court opinions, with conspicuous centered-alignment whitespace

patterns.name: Estonian parliamentary speech and speaker labels
patterns.context: Speeches, chair interruption notes, and speaker name/country labels in parliamentary transcripts

patterns.name: Formatting tags in documentation comments
patterns.context: Closing tags in C# XML documentation comments, appearing before class declarations

patterns.name: Separators in strings and log output
patterns.context: Log output statements containing quoted lines of equals signs, followed by loop processing

patterns.name: Indentation-length validation
patterns.context: Assertions or validation logic comparing the actual and expected lengths of indentation text

patterns.name: SVG length attribute access
patterns.context: Function implementation that reads length attribute information from an SVG element

5_1308.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与排版
5_1308.description: 激活主要落在代码中的缩进空白、复合标识符及语法边界，常见于类与函数结构；另覆盖法院文书的对齐页眉、议会记录排版，以及日志分隔线、缩进校验和 SVG 属性代码等局部模式。

patterns.name: C++/C# 代码中的缩进与空白
patterns.trigger: 多处缩进空格，如「    」(2、5、8)、「                        」(4、7)，以及换行后的代码块
patterns.context: 代码结构中的缩进、空行和对齐位置被标记；常与花括号、声明或成员函数附近出现
patterns.domain: 源代码（主要是 GitHub，也含 StackExchange）

patterns.name: 类型或标识符中的复合命名
patterns.trigger: 「LogItemThread」「UpdateWindow」「actualOffsetIndentText」「laPlaceFilter」「LengthAttributesInfo」等名称中的大小写边界及连续标识符
patterns.context: 编程语言标识符由多个词片段构成，常出现在类、成员或变量声明中

patterns.name: 代码标点与语法边界
patterns.trigger: 「::」「()」「{」「}」「:」及「.»等标点，尤其是紧邻函数声明、构造函数或成员访问处
patterns.context: 代码语法结构边界；部分激活落在标点本身或其前后的空格上

patterns.name: 初始化与构造函数附近
patterns.context: 类构造函数声明或定义，以及初始化列表/构造函数体开头

patterns.name: 法院文书页眉、案号与排版空白
patterns.trigger: 「Case:」「Document:」「Fourth Court of Appeals」「MEMORANDUM OPINION」「No.」及其周围长空格
patterns.context: 法院意见书的页眉或分页后的案件元数据，文本带有明显居中对齐空白

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会发言与说话人标记
patterns.context: 议会记录中的发言、主席打断说明及发言人姓名/国别标记
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录（爱沙尼亚语片段）

patterns.name: 文档注释中的格式标签
patterns.context: C# XML 文档注释的结束标签，出现在类声明之前

patterns.name: 字符串中的分隔线与日志输出
patterns.context: 日志输出语句包含引号内的等号分隔线，后接循环处理

patterns.name: 缩进长度校验
patterns.context: 比较实际与期望缩进文本长度的断言或校验逻辑

patterns.name: SVG 长度属性访问
patterns.context: 读取 SVG 元素长度属性信息的函数实现

en.concept: Formatting and boundary markers in structured text
en.description: Activations occur mainly in the heading, filing area, and line-break and indentation formatting of Fifth Circuit court documents; there are also code loops and comparison operators, as well as technical loanwords in a Japanese question about a Gmail plugin.

patterns.name: Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals heading
patterns.context: The heading on the first page of a court document; often accompanied by line breaks, indentation, and mixed capitalization

patterns.name: Court clerk filing date and case information
patterns.context: The filing area of a Fifth Circuit document, with dates, case numbers, clerk names, and other information arranged in indented lines

patterns.name: Java/C++ iteration loops and comparison operators
patterns.context: Code that loops over a container or array, including initialization, a condition check, and increment; may also contain null comparisons

patterns.name: Loanword notation in Japanese technical Q&A
patterns.context: A Japanese question discussing Gmail plugin development and input-field behavior, mixing Japanese with Latin-script technical terms

5_1308.concept: 结构化文本中的格式与边界标记
5_1308.description: 主要激活于第五巡回法院文书的抬头、登记区及其换行缩进格式；另见代码循环和比较运算符，以及一段日文 Gmail 插件问题中的技术借词。

patterns.name: 第五巡回上诉法院抬头
patterns.trigger: “IN THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS”“FOR THE FIFTH CIRCUIT”“United States Court of Appeals”“Fifth Circuit”
patterns.context: 法院文书首页抬头；常伴随换行、缩进和大小写混排

patterns.name: 法院书记官盖录日期与案件信息
patterns.context: 第五巡回法院文书的登记区，日期、案号、书记官姓名等按行缩进排布

patterns.name: Java/C++ 迭代循环与比较运算符
patterns.context: 代码中循环遍历容器或数组，包含初始化、条件判断、递增；也可能出现空值比较

patterns.name: 日文技术问答中的借词表记
patterns.context: 日文提问讨论 Gmail 插件开发及输入框行为，日文与拉丁字母技术词混用

en.description: Activations occur mainly in court document title areas, especially the names of federal courts of appeals and their centered layout. Other activations occur near input-control terms in a single Japanese Gmail question and near punctuation, keywords, and identifier boundaries in various C++ source files; no shared semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: U.S. federal court of appeals titles
patterns.context: Appearing on the first page or in a header, often alongside document numbers, dates, line breaks, and centered-layout spaces; also includes some court titles with clerk, filing date, and other heading information.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw court document headings and layout

patterns.name: Fourth Circuit memorandum opinion titles
patterns.context: Court document title area; court name, location, document type, and case number are arranged on centered lines.

patterns.name: Input-control terms in Gmail and Japanese text
patterns.context: A Japanese question discusses Gmail TextInput behavior; activations occur near Japanese particles/subword fragments and the word Gmail.

patterns.name: C++ container and iterator code
patterns.context: C++ code clears and resizes a container, then traverses it with an iterator; activations cluster near brackets, assignment, and iterator syntax.

patterns.name: C++ function and loop syntax
patterns.context: A function takes a reference to a vector of strings and traverses it with a for loop; activations occur near the function signature and loop-control syntax.

patterns.name: WebCore C++ constructors and member initialization
patterns.context: A C++ constructor definition in the WebCore namespace, with a class-qualified name, parameters, and a member initializer list.

5_1308.description: 主要激活于法院文件标题区，尤其是联邦上诉法院名称及其居中排版；另在单条日语 Gmail 问答和多种 C++ 源码的标点、关键字、标识符边界附近激活，未见共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 美国联邦上诉法院标题
patterns.trigger: «UNITED» STATES COURT« OF» «APPEALS»、«FOR» «THE» FIFTH CIRCUIT、«IN THE»
patterns.context: 出现在文件首页或页眉中，常与文档编号、日期、换行及居中排版空格共同出现；也包括部分法院标题与书记员、提交日期等标题信息。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法院文件标题与版式

patterns.name: 第四上诉法院备忘录意见标题
patterns.context: 法院文件标题区；法院名称、地点、文书类型和案号以分行居中形式排列。

patterns.name: Gmail 与日语文本中的输入控件词
patterns.context: 日语问答在讨论 Gmail 的 TextInput 行为；激活落在日语助词/词内片段和 Gmail 字样附近。

patterns.name: C++ 容器与迭代器代码
patterns.context: C++ 代码中清空并调整容器大小后，以迭代器遍历容器；激活集中在括号、赋值和迭代器语法附近。

patterns.name: C++ 函数与循环语法
patterns.context: 函数接收字符串向量引用并通过 for 循环遍历；激活落在函数签名及循环控制语法附近。

patterns.name: WebCore C++ 构造函数与成员初始化
patterns.context: WebCore 命名空间中的 C++ 构造函数定义，带有类限定名、参数和成员初始化列表。
patterns.domain: Github WebKit 风格 C++ 源码

en.description: Most passages are code, especially method declarations, return positions, assignment initialization, and boundaries in compound identifiers; a few activations fall on Swedish names, court signatures, or segmentation of Japanese loanwords. No unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Java/C# method declarations and block structure
patterns.context: Code containing a class or method definition, often with indentation, braces, and a subsequent return; activations occur around declaration boundaries and method names.
patterns.domain: Github object-oriented code, including Java and C#

patterns.name: Method return type or return statement
patterns.context: Return positions in method documentation comments, signatures, or method bodies; triggers may fall on return, the return type, or nearby text.
patterns.domain: Github code and API documentation comments

patterns.name: Property assignment and dependency service calls
patterns.context: Construction or initialization code assigning a parameter or service instance to a field or property; activation is mainly on the assignment operator or the call on the right-hand side.
patterns.domain: StackExchange and Github programming Q&A and source code

patterns.name: Case or morpheme boundaries within identifiers
patterns.context: When code identifiers consist of multiple words, abbreviations, or case-based fragments, activation occurs near subword boundaries; not all identifiers trigger equally.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and name segmentation
patterns.context: Proper nouns appear as multiple subwords or non-obvious fragments; this pattern is not clearly the same as code method declarations.
patterns.domain: Swedish parliamentary text, U.S. court opinion signatures

patterns.name: Japanese compound words and loanword segmentation
patterns.context: Loanwords or compound words in Japanese text are split by character or subword; activation is prominent in word segments such as 「アドオン」. The passage also involves a Gmail development Q&A context.

patterns.name: C++ scope and type names
patterns.context: Near definitions of members qualified by a C++ namespace or class, activation is concentrated on type names, scope operators, and function names.

5_1308.description: 多数段落是代码，尤其方法声明、返回位置、赋值初始化及复合标识符的边界；少数激活落在瑞典语人名、法院署名或日文外来语分段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Java/C# 方法声明与块结构
patterns.context: 代码中出现类或方法定义，常伴随缩进、花括号及后续 return；激活分布在声明边界和方法名附近。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Java、C# 等面向对象代码

patterns.name: 方法返回类型或返回语句
patterns.context: 方法文档注释、签名或方法体中的返回位置；触发可落在 return、返回类型及其附近。
patterns.domain: Github 代码及 API 文档注释

patterns.name: 属性赋值与依赖服务调用
patterns.context: 构造或初始化代码中将参数或服务实例赋给字段、属性；主要激活在赋值符号或右侧对象调用处。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 Github 编程问答、源代码

patterns.name: 标识符内部的大小写或词素边界
patterns.context: 代码标识符由多个词素、缩写或大小写片段组成时，子词边界附近出现激活；并非所有标识符都同样触发。

patterns.name: 专名与人名的切分
patterns.context: 专名以多个子词或非直观片段呈现；该模式与代码方法声明并不明显相同。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语议会文本、美国法院判决署名

patterns.name: 日文复合词及外来语分段
patterns.context: 日文文本中的外来语或复合词按字符/子词拆分，激活突出在「アドオン」等词段；该段还包含 Gmail 开发问答语境。

patterns.name: C++作用域与类型名
patterns.context: C++ 命名空间或类限定的成员函数定义附近，激活集中在类型名、作用域符号和函数名。

en.concept: Code declarations and block structure (with legal headers)
en.description: Primarily responds to structural markers near class/function declarations in code: public, parentheses after method names, opening braces, newline indentation, and the start of method bodies. Covers getters, regular methods, class declarations, and loop headers. There is also an isolated response to a legal opinion header.

patterns.name: Java/C++ method declarations and method-body beginnings
patterns.context: Code within a class or function body; activations often fall on parentheses after method names, opening braces, newline indentation, and extend to the beginning of the method body. Some examples include getters/return statements, while others contain loops, so the pattern is not limited to getters.
patterns.domain: Java and C++ code on Github

patterns.name: Class declarations and access modifiers
patterns.context: Near class definitions or class members, especially access modifiers and declaration structures; overlaps with the method-declaration pattern but is not identical.
patterns.domain: C++ and Java code on Github

patterns.name: Legal opinion headers
patterns.context: Centered headers in court rulings or memorandum opinions; no code structure is apparent.

5_1308.concept: 代码声明与块结构（兼有法律页眉）
5_1308.description: 主要响应代码中类/函数声明附近的结构标记：public、方法名后的括号、左花括号、换行缩进及方法体开头；覆盖 getter、普通方法、类声明和循环头。另对法律意见书法院页眉有孤立响应。

patterns.name: Java/C++ 方法声明与方法体开头
patterns.trigger: `public`、方法名、`()`，随后 `{`、换行缩进及 `return`，例如 `public ... getX509DataType() {`、`getHandler()`、`getName()`；也有 `for (...)` 循环头
patterns.context: 代码处于类或函数体中；激活常落在方法名后的括号、左花括号、换行缩进等结构 token 上，并延续到方法体起始处。部分例子包含 getter/返回语句，另有循环结构，不能只归结为 getter。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Java、C++ 代码

patterns.name: 类声明及访问修饰符
patterns.trigger: `class SSLConfigServicePref : public ...`、`public:`；另见 `public class PinyinComparator implements ...`
patterns.context: 类定义或类体成员区附近，尤其是访问修饰符与声明结构；与方法声明模式有重叠，但不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++、Java 代码

patterns.name: 法律意见书页眉
patterns.trigger: `Fourth Court of Appeals`、`San Antonio, Texas`、`MEMORANDUM OPINION`、`No. 04-20-00060`
patterns.context: 法院判决或备忘录意见书的居中排版页眉；未见代码结构。

en.concept: Member definitions in object-oriented source code
en.description: Most passages show member-function or constructor declarations, parameter lists, and method-body starts in object-oriented source code, often accompanied by class declarations, assignments, or return statements. Other code patterns include API names, comments, C++ directives, and fields; the configuration-field assignment in [1] is prominent but still represents code initialization.

patterns.name: Method/constructor declarations and method-body starts
patterns.context: Appears in classes or structs, especially where a member declaration transitions into a method body; activation is prominent at the start of the body and near return statements.
patterns.domain: Object-oriented code in multiple languages (Java, C#, C++, etc.)

patterns.name: Object initialization and member assignment
patterns.context: In constructors or initialization code, writes parameters, service objects, or configuration to members; also includes field assignments in configuration objects.

patterns.name: Type/class inheritance declarations
patterns.context: Near class or namespace declarations, access modifiers, and inheritance relationships; may appear in the same passage as method definitions.
patterns.domain: C++, C#, and other source code

patterns.name: Specific APIs and domain terms
patterns.context: API, type, or member identifiers are themselves split into multiple subwords; these instances are embedded in code member declarations or calls and share no domain semantics.
patterns.domain: Code involving XML/X.509, mobile, authentication, data sources, games, and other areas

patterns.name: Interface/dependency retrieval call
patterns.context: First resolves a device dependency, then retrieves a media selector and uses a member of the resolved device as a fallback value.
patterns.domain: C# mobile application code on StackExchange

patterns.name: C++ preprocessor directives and namespaces
patterns.context: Include directives at the beginning of a C++ file and adjacent namespace declarations.

patterns.name: Return descriptions in documentation comments
patterns.context: A documentation comment before a method describes the return type or links to a related type, followed by a getter implementation.
patterns.domain: Java source code in JavaDoc style

patterns.name: Struct fields and numeric members
patterns.context: Character arrays and several floating-point fields are listed before a function definition, followed by a constructor declaration.

patterns.name: SSL configuration service comment and declaration
patterns.context: Describes updating SSL configuration when preferences change and declares a class inheriting from a network SSL configuration service.

5_1308.concept: 面向对象源码成员定义
5_1308.description: 多数段在面向对象源码中呈现成员函数或构造函数声明、参数列表和方法体起始，常伴随类声明、赋值或返回语句。另有 API 名称、注释、C++ 指令及字段等代码模式；[1] 的配置字段赋值较突出，但仍属代码初始化。

patterns.name: 方法/构造函数声明及方法体起始
patterns.trigger: «public»、方法名或构造函数名、参数列表，以及 «{»、«:»、«return»
patterns.context: 出现在类或结构体中，尤其是成员声明后进入方法体；方法体开头及返回语句附近激活显著。
patterns.domain: 多种语言的面向对象代码（Java、C#、C++等）

patterns.name: 对象初始化与成员赋值
patterns.context: 构造函数或初始化代码中，将参数、服务对象或配置写入成员；也包括配置对象的字段赋值。

patterns.name: 类型/类继承声明
patterns.context: 类或命名空间的声明、访问修饰符及继承关系附近；可与方法定义同段出现。

patterns.name: 特定 API 与领域名词
patterns.context: API、类型或成员标识符本身被切分成多个子词；这些实例都嵌在代码成员声明或调用中，没有共同的领域语义。
patterns.domain: XML/X.509、移动端、认证、数据源、游戏等代码

patterns.name: 接口/依赖获取调用
patterns.context: 先解析设备依赖，再获取媒体选择器并以解析出的设备成员作为回退值。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 C# 移动应用代码

patterns.name: C++ 预处理指令及命名空间
patterns.context: C++ 文件头部的 include 指令以及相邻命名空间声明。

patterns.name: 注释文档中的返回描述
patterns.context: 方法前的文档注释描述返回类型或链接到相关类型，随后出现 getter 实现。
patterns.domain: JavaDoc 风格的 Java 源码

patterns.name: 结构体字段与数值成员
patterns.context: 函数定义前列出字符数组及多个浮点型字段，随后出现构造函数声明。

patterns.name: SSL 配置服务注释与声明
patterns.context: 说明偏好设置变化时更新 SSL 配置，并声明继承自网络 SSL 配置服务的类。
patterns.domain: 浏览器/网络相关 C++ 代码

en.description: Primarily responds to declaration and structural markers in object-oriented code: classes/access modifiers, braces beginning function bodies after method or constructor signatures, and inheritance and base-constructor syntax. Sporadic activations also occur around comment endings, assignment and null fallback, Python file context managers, C++ namespaces, and compound identifiers. The configuration snippet in the first segment does not fit a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Opening brace after a function or method declaration
patterns.context: In C#, Java, C++, PHP, and other code, a function, constructor, or class method declaration ends and the function body begins; parentheses and a return type or inheritance information have often appeared beforehand

patterns.name: Class declarations and access modifiers
patterns.context: At the beginning of a class definition or near class member declarations, especially where modifiers, class names, and inheritance/constructor syntax occur together

patterns.name: Delimited parameter or configuration assignment
patterns.context: Configuration initialization, object property assignment, or parameter-selection expressions; occurs only in specific code snippets
patterns.domain: Assignment and configuration expressions in source code

patterns.name: C# base-constructor call
patterns.context: A C# constructor declaration calls a base-class constructor after a colon, then enters the function body

patterns.name: Documentation comments and return descriptions
patterns.context: End of a documentation comment before a code declaration, including return-value or type-link descriptions

patterns.name: Python file context manager
patterns.context: Python code opens a CSV file and binds the file handle to a variable, then runs indented write-related code

patterns.name: C# null fallback expression
patterns.context: When service resolution may return null, a property on an existing device object is used as a fallback value

patterns.name: C++ namespaces and constructor definitions
patterns.context: A class constructor with a member initializer list is defined inside nested C++ namespaces

patterns.name: Class inheritance declarations
patterns.context: A C++ class declaration specifies public inheritance from a base class, followed by a public member section

patterns.name: Case boundaries in strings, type names, and member names
patterns.context: Code identifiers consist of multiple case-separated segments; this appears across several segments and is not a unique stable trigger

5_1308.description: 主要响应面向对象代码中的声明与结构标记：类/访问修饰符、方法或构造函数签名后进入函数体的花括号，以及继承和基类构造语法；另对注释收尾、赋值与空值回退、Python文件上下文管理器、C++命名空间及复合标识符有零散激活。第1段配置片段难以归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: 函数或方法声明后的左花括号
patterns.trigger: 方法名与参数列表后的「{」，如「SelectingEventArgs (DbCommand command, DataSourceSelectArguments argument)」后的「{」
patterns.context: C#、Java、C++、PHP 等代码中，函数、构造函数或类的方法声明结束，紧接着进入函数体；通常括号和返回类型或继承信息已出现

patterns.name: 类声明与访问修饰符
patterns.trigger: 「class」「public」「private」「explicit」以及类名、继承关系和访问符号「:」「extends」
patterns.context: 类定义开头或类成员声明附近，尤其是修饰符、类名和继承/构造语法相邻

patterns.name: 带分隔符的参数或配置赋值
patterns.trigger: 「=」「:」「??」及附近的变量、属性名，例如「self.client = client」「partition: region?.partition ?? partition」
patterns.context: 配置初始化、对象属性赋值或参数选择表达式；仅在特定代码片段中出现
patterns.domain: 源代码中的赋值与配置表达式

patterns.name: C# 基类构造调用
patterns.context: C# 构造函数声明后通过冒号调用基类构造函数，再进入函数体

patterns.name: 文档注释与返回说明
patterns.context: 代码声明之前的文档注释收尾，包含返回值或类型链接说明

patterns.name: Python 文件上下文管理器
patterns.context: Python 中打开 CSV 文件并将文件句柄绑定到变量，之后缩进执行写入相关代码

patterns.name: C# 空值回退表达式
patterns.context: 依赖服务解析结果可能为空时，使用已有设备对象上的属性作为回退值

patterns.name: C++ 命名空间与构造函数定义
patterns.context: C++ 中嵌套命名空间内定义带成员初始化列表的类构造函数

patterns.name: 类继承声明
patterns.context: C++ 类声明通过 public 继承指定基类，后接 public 成员区

patterns.name: 字符串、类型名及成员名中的大小写边界
patterns.context: 代码标识符由多个大小写分段组成；多段中同时出现，未显示为唯一稳定触发条件

en.description: Responds mainly to function or constructor declarations and closing parameter-list boundaries in code; there are also localized responses to Python file-opening statements, path/string concatenation, and documentation-comment closures.

patterns.name: Function/constructor declarations and parameter lists
patterns.context: Function or constructor declarations and definitions in code; several passages show activation concentrated at the end of the parameter list, often alongside access modifiers, types, and member initialization
patterns.domain: Code in multiple programming languages (C++, Java, C#, etc.)

patterns.name: File opening and context managers
patterns.context: In Python, opens a file and binds a file object, often for writing or appending; activation appears near the context-management statement

patterns.name: Path construction and string concatenation
patterns.context: In Python, constructs file paths or concatenates strings; occurs alongside file-handling code but may also be an independent local trigger

patterns.name: Comment or documentation-comment closure
patterns.context: A method declaration or definition immediately follows the end of a documentation comment

5_1308.description: 主要响应代码中的函数或构造函数声明及参数列表闭合；另对 Python 文件打开语句、路径/字符串拼接，以及文档注释闭合有局部响应。

patterns.name: 函数/构造函数声明及参数列表
patterns.trigger: `)`（常紧接函数参数列表），以及 `public`、`(`、`)` 等声明标记
patterns.context: 代码中函数或构造函数的声明、定义；多段激活集中在参数列表闭合处，常伴随访问修饰符、类型和成员初始化
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言代码（C++、Java、C# 等）

patterns.name: 文件打开与上下文管理器
patterns.context: Python 中打开文件并绑定文件对象，常用于写入或追加；激活出现在上下文管理语句附近

patterns.name: 路径拼接与字符串连接
patterns.context: Python 中构造文件路径或拼接字符串；与文件处理代码同现，但也可能是独立的局部触发

patterns.name: 注释或文档注释闭合
patterns.context: 文档注释结束后紧接方法声明或定义

en.description: Primarily responds to closing parentheses at the end of function, method, and constructor parameter lists, especially when immediately followed by the opening brace of a function body. Also responds to opening braces for classes, conditional blocks, and other code blocks, along with nearby newline indentation, across multiple programming languages.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis in function/method signatures
patterns.context: At the end of the parameter list in a function, method, or constructor declaration, often followed by a return type or method body, or immediately by the opening brace of the method body; occurs across multiple languages

patterns.name: Opening brace of a method body
patterns.context: At the start of a function or constructor definition; also appears near the beginning of class definitions or code blocks

patterns.name: Opening brace of a class/code block
patterns.context: After a class, namespace, or conditional-block declaration/control structure; not necessarily a function body

patterns.name: Code line endings and indented newlines
patterns.context: A new line begins after a declaration, comment, or statement; adjacent to structural boundaries near braces

5_1308.description: 主要响应函数、方法和构造函数参数列表结束的右括号，尤其紧接函数体左花括号；也响应类、条件块等代码块左花括号及其附近的换行缩进，跨多种编程语言。

patterns.name: 函数/方法签名的右括号
patterns.trigger: `)`，各段中在签名参数列表末尾出现，并作为最高激活 token
patterns.context: 函数、方法或构造函数声明的参数列表结束处，常接返回类型/方法体，或紧接方法体左花括号；跨多种语言

patterns.name: 方法体左花括号
patterns.trigger: `{`，常与前一模式的 `)` 连续出现，如 `) {`；第6段为换行后单独出现
patterns.context: 函数或构造函数定义开始处；也见于类定义或代码块开头附近

patterns.name: 类/代码块左花括号
patterns.context: 类、命名空间或条件块的声明/控制结构之后；不一定是函数体

patterns.name: 代码行结束与缩进换行
patterns.context: 声明、注释或语句结束后开始新行；与花括号附近的结构边界相邻

en.concept: Code Structure Boundaries and Local Word Fragments
en.description: Most high activations occur at the closing parenthesis of code function/constructor parameter lists and at the start of function bodies; Python file-operation `with…as` variable bindings are also prominent. Sporadic within-word activations also occur in the Java identifier `face` and the encyclopedia place names Springlands and Sevier, which are difficult to attribute to a single mechanism.

patterns.name: Opening parenthesis in a function or constructor
patterns.context: A function or constructor declaration is followed by a closing parameter-list parenthesis and an opening function-body brace; in Python file context-manager statements, the colon in `as f:` also activates strongly.

patterns.name: Python context-manager binding
patterns.context: The variable name after `as` in a `with open(...) as variable:` structure; `as f:` also appears in other Python code.

patterns.name: face in a class or type identifier
patterns.context: `face` appears in the Java class or type names TypeFaceSpan and CustomTypeFaceSpan; strong activations occur within the identifiers.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Springlands
patterns.context: A word-initial fragment in the place name Springlands, before a description of a heritage listing.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Desert
patterns.context: A subword fragment within the place name `Sevier`, in a description of a Utah desert.

5_1308.concept: 代码结构边界与局部词形片段
5_1308.description: 多数高激活落在代码函数/构造器参数列表闭合处及函数体起始；Python 文件操作的 with…as 变量绑定也显著。另有 Java 标识符中的 face，以及百科地名 Springlands、Sevier 的零散词内激活，难归为同一机制。

patterns.name: 函数或构造器的左括号
patterns.context: 声明或定义函数、构造器后紧接参数列表闭括号及函数体左花括号；在 Python 文件上下文管理语句中，`as f:` 的冒号也强激活。

patterns.name: Python 上下文管理器绑定
patterns.trigger: «with»2« open»2«(»2newfile«,»2 'w«')»2« as»10« f»1«:»5«、«with»1 open«(»3filename«,»2 'wb«')»2« as»10 pdf_file«:»5«、«with»2« open»3«(»3file« +»4 "stats.txt«",»2 'a+«')»3« as»10« f»1«:»4«
patterns.context: `with open(...) as 变量:` 结构中 `as` 后的变量名位置；其他 Python 代码也出现 `as f:`。

patterns.name: 类或类型标识符中的 face
patterns.context: `face` 出现在 Java 类名或类型名 TypeFaceSpan、CustomTypeFaceSpan 中；强激活分布于标识符内部。

patterns.name: Springlands 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名 Springlands 的词首片段，位于遗产名录介绍之前。

patterns.name: Desert 词内片段
patterns.context: `Sevier` 地名内部的词片段，描述犹他州沙漠。

en.description: Primarily responds to block boundaries, indentation, and braces in code, often alongside conditions or class/member declarations; also appears in HTML script templates. Activations also occur at subsection-heading boundaries in two encyclopedia passages, which are difficult to explain through the code pattern.

patterns.name: Block beginnings and opening braces in code
patterns.context: Activations often fall near code-block boundaries, especially after declarations, conditions, or function headers; markers may also cover surrounding whitespace and adjacent tokens.

patterns.name: Control-flow conditional structures
patterns.context: Occurs in code control-flow statements, commonly around parenthesized conditions and the code blocks that follow.

patterns.name: JavaScript documentation script template
patterns.context: Script snippets near the head/body of HTML documents; segments 5 and 8 have highly similar contexts.

patterns.name: Object-oriented declarations and member code
patterns.context: Class, constructor, or member declarations and their code-block boundaries; activations are not limited to one language.
patterns.domain: C++, Java, C#, and other code

patterns.name: Subsection boundaries in Wikipedia articles
patterns.context: Natural-language articles transition from a paragraph to a subsection heading; the provided context has no corresponding code structure.

5_1308.description: 主要响应代码中的块边界、缩进及花括号，常伴随条件或类/成员声明；也出现在 HTML 脚本模板。另在两段百科文本的小节标题边界激活，难以由代码模式解释。

patterns.name: 代码中的块起始与左花括号
patterns.trigger: 行首或缩进后的「{」，以及代码块开始处的换行
patterns.context: 激活常落在代码块边界附近，尤其是声明、条件或函数头之后；标记也可能覆盖周边空白和相邻 token。

patterns.name: 控制流条件结构
patterns.trigger: 「if」；条件后接「{」，或以检查表达式构成条件
patterns.context: 处于代码控制流语句中，常见括号条件及其后的代码块。

patterns.name: JavaScript 文档脚本模板
patterns.context: HTML 文档 head/body 附近的脚本片段；第 5、8 段是高度相似的上下文。
patterns.domain: 生成的 HTML/JavaScript 文档代码

patterns.name: 面向对象声明与成员代码
patterns.context: 类、构造器或成员声明及其代码块边界；激活不局限于某一种语言。

patterns.name: 维基百科条目中的小节边界
patterns.trigger: 「Conservation」「Heritage listings」前后的换行或小节标题
patterns.context: 自然语言条目在段落转向小节标题处；所给上下文没有对应代码结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to constructor declarations within class bodies, especially the end of the parameter list and start of the function body; it also responds to object-oriented structures such as fields and class declarations. A few activations occur in PHP `isset` conditions and getter declarations.

patterns.name: Constructor declaration and empty function body
patterns.context: Code inside a class definition declaring a constructor; activations are especially concentrated at the end of the parameter list «)» and the start of the function body «{», with no language requirement.
patterns.domain: Multilingual software source code: Java, C++, C#, PHP, etc.

patterns.name: Member-variable and class-member declarations
patterns.context: Structured declarations within a class body, near modifiers, types, identifiers, and similar elements; not necessarily within a constructor.

patterns.name: PHP file-upload check
patterns.context: PHP form-handling code checks whether the user submitted a file; activation appears at the closing point «))» of the condition expression.

patterns.name: PHP configuration property and section check
patterns.context: PHP reads a configuration property and checks whether an array contains a section key; activation is concentrated at the end of the condition expression.

patterns.name: API documentation getter
patterns.context: A getter method declaration and the start of its function body in a PHP class with a documentation comment.

5_1308.concept: 面向对象代码声明边界
5_1308.description: 主要响应类体中的构造函数声明，尤其参数列表结束及函数体起始处；也响应字段、类声明等面向对象结构。少数激活落在 PHP 的 isset 条件和 getter 声明。

patterns.name: 构造函数声明及空函数体
patterns.trigger: 类名后的「()」或带参数的构造函数声明，常紧接「{」；包括「DSAParameterGenerator() {」「MockFaviconService() : FaviconService(nullptr」「MyData() { }」「TestPane() {」「RecordStringConverterLoader() {」「CustomerEditedHandler() {」「CustomTypefaceSpan(String family, Typeface type) {」
patterns.context: 代码处于类定义内部，正在声明构造函数；激活尤集中在参数列表闭合处「)」及函数体起始处「{」，不要求特定语言。
patterns.domain: 多语言软件源码：Java、C++、C#、PHP 等

patterns.name: 成员变量及类成员声明
patterns.trigger: 「private int seedLen」「private SecureRandom random;」「private string myDataProperty;」「private ImageIcon animatedGif;」「public final class RecordStringConverterLoader」「public class CustomerEditedHandler」
patterns.context: 类体中声明字段或类，修饰符、类型、标识符等结构化声明附近；不一定处于构造函数中。

patterns.name: PHP 文件上传检查
patterns.context: PHP 表单处理代码检查用户是否提交了文件，激活出现在条件表达式闭合处「))」。

patterns.name: PHP 配置属性与 section 检查
patterns.context: PHP 中读取配置属性并检查数组是否含有 section 键；激活集中在条件表达式结束处。

patterns.name: API 文档 getter
patterns.context: PHP 类中带文档注释的 getter 方法声明及其函数体起始处。

en.concept: Code Structure Boundaries and Conditional Syntax
en.description: Primarily responds to conditional checks, parentheses, and code-block boundaries in source code, often alongside method signatures and exceptions in failure branches; it also responds to HTML tag boundaries. Additional activations occur around word segmentation and section headings in two encyclopedia passages.

patterns.name: Conditional checks in control flow
patterns.context: A conditional branch appears in a code block, often with parentheses, braces, negation, or comparison operators; examples span Java, JavaScript, PHP, PHPDoc/PHP-style code, TypeScript, and Android Java code.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Exception handling after a failed condition
patterns.context: An exception is thrown when a condition check fails; occurs in method implementations or parameter-validation code.

patterns.name: HTML tag closure and script markers
patterns.context: Near HTML document tag boundaries, including embedded JavaScript; [4] and [6] are nearly identical script fragments.

patterns.name: Java method declarations and type signatures
patterns.context: Visibility modifiers, return types, parameters, and braces appear around a method declaration or call.

patterns.name: Braces and comment closure at control-block endings
patterns.context: Closing boundaries of code blocks or comments; some passages also contain conditional branches, while others show only local closing markers.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Encyclopedia article body and section headings
patterns.context: After mentioning a species or place in the encyclopedia body, the text transitions to a conservation-status or heritage-listing section; activations occur near segmented words and section boundaries.

5_1308.concept: 代码结构边界与条件语法
5_1308.description: 主要响应源代码中的条件判断、括号与代码块边界，并常伴随方法签名及失败分支异常；也响应 HTML 标签边界。另有两段百科条目中词语切分和栏目标题附近的激活。

patterns.name: 控制流中的条件判断
patterns.trigger: «if»、«if»前后的括号及条件表达式；[8] 另有«if» (!this.visibleElements.has«(»3options«))»9«
patterns.context: 代码块中出现条件分支，常伴随括号、花括号、否定或比较运算；涵盖 Java、JavaScript、PHP、PHPDoc/PHP 风格、TypeScript 和 Android Java 代码。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源代码

patterns.name: 条件成立后的异常处理
patterns.context: 条件检查失败时抛出异常；位于方法实现或参数校验代码中。

patterns.name: HTML 标签闭合及脚本标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档标签边界附近，包含嵌入式 JavaScript；[4]、[6] 是近乎相同的脚本片段。

patterns.name: Java 方法声明及类型签名
patterns.trigger: «protected» void engineInit«(»...«)»；«public»« function» getArgument«(»...«)»；«private» addToVisible«(»...):»6 void；«protected» void« onCreate»
patterns.context: 方法声明或调用周围出现可见性修饰符、返回类型、参数及花括号。

patterns.name: 控制块结束处的花括号和注释闭合
patterns.context: 代码块或注释的结束边界；有些段同时包含条件分支，有些仅呈现为局部的闭合标记。

patterns.name: 百科词条正文与栏目标题
patterns.context: 百科正文提及物种或地名后，转入保护状态或遗产名录栏目；激活落在被切分显示的词及栏目边界附近。

en.description: Primarily responds to the opening brace after the parameter list closes in Java declarations, especially at the beginning of methods or constructors; also responds more weakly to public, field, and class declarations. Android onCreate is a common subcase, but not the only pattern.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a Java method or constructor
patterns.context: An opening brace immediately follows the closing parameter list of a method or constructor declaration; this is the strongest trigger position in most examples.
patterns.domain: Java source code, including Android, ordinary classes, and test/library code

patterns.name: public declarations and constructor signatures
patterns.context: The public keyword at the start of a class member or constructor declaration, followed by a type name, method name, or constructor name; usually weaker than the opening brace after the parameter list.

patterns.name: Android lifecycle method onCreate
patterns.context: The onCreate method declaration in Activity- or View-related classes, with a Bundle savedInstanceState parameter; nearby @Override, super.onCreate, and similar elements are also common.
patterns.domain: Android Java code and related StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Class declarations and inheritance
patterns.context: public class or extends at class definitions, especially near the beginning of Java file examples; activations at these positions are weaker.

patterns.name: Member-variable declarations
patterns.context: Field declarations in a class body, commonly including a type, modifier, and variable name; also includes field initialization and comments.

5_1308.description: 主要响应 Java 声明中参数列表闭合后的左花括号，尤其是方法或构造器起始处；也对 public/字段/类声明有较弱响应。Android onCreate 是常见子类场景，但并非唯一模式。

patterns.name: Java 方法或构造器的左花括号
patterns.context: 方法或构造器声明的参数列表闭合后，紧接着出现左花括号；这是多数样本中最强的触发位置。
patterns.domain: Java 源码，覆盖 Android、普通类及测试/库代码

patterns.name: public 声明与构造器签名
patterns.context: 类成员或构造器声明开头的 public 关键字，以及紧随其后的类型名、方法名或构造器名；强度通常低于参数列表后的左花括号。

patterns.name: Android 生命周期方法 onCreate
patterns.context: Activity 或 View 相关类中，onCreate 方法声明及其 Bundle savedInstanceState 参数；相邻的 @Override、super.onCreate 等也常见。
patterns.domain: Android Java 代码及相关 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 类声明与继承
patterns.context: 类定义处出现 public class 或 extends，尤其是在 Java 文件示例开头；这些位置的激活较弱。

patterns.name: 成员变量声明
patterns.context: 类体中的字段声明，常见类型、修饰符及变量名；也包括字段初始化和注释。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on source-code structure markers: HTML/JavaScript tags and conditional checks, as well as Java/C# class members, access modifiers, and constructors; activations also occur on public getters following JavaDoc.

patterns.name: HTML scripts and conditional checks
patterns.context: Embedded JavaScript in an HTML document checks whether a URL contains a parameter; the fragment recurs, with tag boundaries and line breaks around the code.

patterns.name: Java/C# class members and constructors
patterns.context: Access modifiers, fields, or service members appear in a class definition, followed by a constructor; includes the constructor body and initialization code.
patterns.domain: Java and C# source code from Github/StackExchange

patterns.name: JavaDoc return type and getter
patterns.context: A public getter and return statement immediately follow a documentation comment.

5_1308.description: 激活集中于源码结构标记：HTML/JavaScript 的标签与条件判断，以及 Java/C# 类成员、访问修饰符和构造函数；另对 JavaDoc 后的公开 getter 激活。

patterns.name: HTML 脚本与条件判断
patterns.context: HTML 文档中嵌入 JavaScript，检查 URL 是否包含参数；片段重复出现，代码周围包含标签边界和换行。

patterns.name: Java/C# 类成员与构造函数
patterns.context: 类定义中出现访问修饰符、字段或服务成员，随后是构造函数；包括构造函数体和初始化代码。

patterns.name: JavaDoc 返回类型与 getter
patterns.context: 文档注释结束后紧接公开 getter 和 return 语句。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Java/XML 绑定代码

en.description: Strongly responds to structure boundaries and member declarations in source code (spaces, parentheses, braces, and following tokens), as well as a repeated HTML external-link detection script; also covers a C++ const-reference method declaration.

patterns.name: JavaScript external-link detection script
patterns.context: A script at the head/body boundary of an HTML document checks whether a URL substring indicates an external link; the same code recurs across multiple fragments.

patterns.name: Code member declarations and initializer boundaries
patterns.context: Near class, field, constructor, or method declarations; activations often occur on spaces, parentheses, braces, or tokens following declarations.
patterns.domain: Object-oriented source code such as C#/Java

patterns.name: C++ const-reference method declaration
patterns.context: A member accessor returning a const reference is declared in a class's private section.

5_1308.description: 强烈响应源码中的结构边界与成员声明（空格、括号、花括号及其后的 token），并响应重复出现的 HTML 外链检测脚本；另覆盖一条 C++ const 引用方法声明。

patterns.name: JavaScript 外链判断脚本
patterns.context: HTML 文档的 head/body 交界处，包含用 URL 子串判断是否外链的脚本；同一代码在多个片段中重复。

patterns.name: 代码成员声明与初始化器边界
patterns.trigger: `private`、`public`、`class`、`{`、`()`，以及成员声明后的初始化或后续代码边界，如 `_dbUser`、`random;`、`InitializeComponent`
patterns.context: 类、字段、构造函数或方法的声明附近；激活常落在空格、括号、花括号或声明后的 token 上。

patterns.name: C++ const 引用方法声明
patterns.context: 类的 private 区域中声明返回 const 引用的成员访问方法。

en.description: Primarily responds to the Android Java `onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)` lifecycle callback and its declaration context; it also responds to script and URL-checking fragments in HTML/JavaScript documents, and activates in an orchid encyclopedia passage. The latter two patterns are less strongly related to the primary one.

patterns.name: Android Activity lifecycle method
patterns.context: A lifecycle callback definition in a Java/Android Activity or similar class; a common form is @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {, often followed nearby by super.onCreate(...).
patterns.domain: Android/Java code from StackExchange and GitHub

patterns.name: Script and conditional check in an HTML document
patterns.context: An HTML/JavaScript document fragment with a script near the head/body that checks whether the URL contains a specific string

patterns.name: Classification description after an orchid name
patterns.context: An encyclopedia article first describes an orchid's habitat and distribution, then transitions to its conservation-status classification

5_1308.concept: 代码结构标记（主为 Android onCreate）
5_1308.description: 主要响应 Android Java 中 onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) 生命周期回调及其声明上下文；也响应 HTML/JavaScript 文档的脚本与 URL 判断片段，并在一段兰花百科文字中激活，后两类与主模式关联较弱。

patterns.name: Android Activity 生命周期方法
patterns.context: Java/Android 代码中 Activity 或类似类的生命周期回调定义；常见形式为 @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {，附近往往跟着 super.onCreate(...)
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 GitHub 中的 Android/Java 代码

patterns.name: HTML 文档中的脚本及条件判断
patterns.context: HTML/JavaScript 文档片段中，脚本位于 head/body 附近，检测 URL 是否含特定字符串
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 HTML/JavaScript 代码

patterns.name: 兰花名称后的分类描述
patterns.context: 百科条目先描述兰花的生境和分布，随后转入保护状态分类

en.description: Most activations fall on boundaries around class members or method declarations in code: newline indentation, access modifiers, annotations, parentheses, method names, and opening braces. A few occur at accessor and constructor boundaries in generated code. One activation occurs at the “Conservation” subsection heading in an orchid article and cannot be unified with the code pattern.

patterns.name: Statement boundaries in Java/Android method bodies
patterns.context: Code near class members, annotations, or method declarations, where a newline followed by indentation begins a member or method body; activations often fall at varying positions such as newlines, spaces, access modifiers, method names, or opening braces.

patterns.name: C# member declarations and constructor boundaries
patterns.context: Near class members or constructor declarations, especially access modifiers, constructor parameters/initializers, method bodies, or newlines between members.

patterns.name: Accessor declarations in generated code
patterns.context: Property accessor declarations in generated XML/protocol types; the activation occurs at the opening brace after the accessor method name.

patterns.name: Cryptography-class constructor boundary
patterns.context: A no-argument constructor with an empty method body follows a field declaration.

patterns.name: Paragraph transition in a Wikipedia article
patterns.context: A standalone heading introduces conservation-status content after a paragraph describing species distribution.

5_1308.description: 多数激活落在代码中类成员或方法声明的边界：换行缩进、访问修饰符、注解、括号、方法名及左花括号；少数落在生成代码访问器和构造函数边界。另有一例激活于兰花条目的“Conservation”小标题，无法与代码模式统一解释。

patterns.name: Java/Android 方法体中的语句边界
patterns.trigger: «↵»、缩进空白及紧随其后的 «public»、«protected»、«private»、«@Override»、方法名或 «{»
patterns.context: 代码处于类成员、注解或方法声明附近，换行后出现缩进并开始一个成员或方法体；激活常落在换行、空格、访问修饰符、方法名或左花括号等不同位置。

patterns.name: C# 成员声明与构造函数边界
patterns.context: 类成员或构造函数声明附近，尤其是访问修饰符、构造函数参数/初始化器、方法体或成员之间的换行。

patterns.name: 生成代码中的访问器声明
patterns.context: XML/协议类型生成代码的属性访问器声明，激活出现在访问器方法名后的左花括号。

patterns.name: 密码学类构造函数边界
patterns.context: 字段声明后出现无参构造函数及其空方法体。

patterns.name: Wikipedia 条目中的段落转折
patterns.context: 物种分布描述段落之后，以单独小标题引出保护状况内容。

en.description: Activations occur broadly at line breaks and structure boundaries; they also respond separately to an HTML external-link checking script, C# class construction, Android view code, Wikipedia section headings (demographics, judicial service), and an orchid conservation entry. There is little shared structure across these domains.

patterns.name: Line breaks and section/paragraph separators
patterns.context: Line breaks in text, especially when followed by a section heading, code block, or new paragraph; activations occur at and near the line break.

patterns.name: HTML script tags and external-link checking code
patterns.context: JavaScript embedded in an HTML document checks whether `location.href` contains is-external=true and executes conditional logic accordingly; multiple fragments have nearly identical structure.

patterns.name: C# class and constructor declaration
patterns.context: Windows Forms-style code declares a class inheriting from Panel and its constructor, including a container parameter and component initialization.

patterns.name: Android click listener and view creation
patterns.context: Android Java code implements a click listener and defines `onCreateView`, with parameters for a layout inflater, parent view, and saved state.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia section headings and demographic content
patterns.context: After a line break, an encyclopedia article enters sections on administrative divisions, demographics, or ethnic groups, with clear activations near the headings.

patterns.name: Federal judicial service section
patterns.context: A biography transitions to an account of federal judicial service under this section heading, possibly followed by an appointment narrative.

patterns.name: Orchid species and conservation classification
patterns.context: A plant article describes an orchid's distribution and habitat, then moves to its conservation-status classification; `orchid` is split across tokens in the fragment.

5_1308.concept: 结构边界与章节/代码标记
5_1308.description: 激活广泛出现在换行及结构边界；此外分别响应HTML外链检查脚本、C#类构造、Android视图代码，以及百科章节标题（人口统计、司法任职）和兰花保护条目。跨领域共同规律较弱。

patterns.name: 换行及章节/段落分隔
patterns.context: 文本中的换行，尤其是换行后出现章节标题、代码块或新段落时；激活落在换行及其邻近位置。

patterns.name: HTML脚本标签及外链检查代码
patterns.context: HTML文档嵌入 JavaScript，检查 location.href 是否含有 is-external=true，并据此执行条件逻辑；多个片段结构近乎相同。

patterns.name: C#类及构造函数声明
patterns.context: Windows Forms风格代码中声明继承自 Panel 的类及构造函数，包含容器参数和组件初始化。

patterns.name: Android点击监听器与视图创建
patterns.context: Android Java代码中实现点击监听器并定义 onCreateView，参数包含布局加载器、父视图和保存状态。

patterns.name: 百科章节标题与人口统计内容
patterns.context: 百科条目在换行后进入行政区划、人口统计或族群等章节，标题附近激活明显。

patterns.name: 联邦司法任职章节
patterns.context: 人物传记条目以该章节标题转入联邦司法任职经历，标题之后可能接任命叙述。

patterns.name: 兰花物种与保护分类
patterns.context: 植物条目描述兰花的分布、生境，并转入保护状况分类；片段中的 orchid 被跨 token 切分。

en.description: Primarily responds to Android Java Activity lifecycle code, especially the `onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)` method declaration and its class/field context; it also responds to HTML/JavaScript external-link detection fragments and the Wikipedia `Demographics` section heading.

patterns.name: Android Activity `onCreate` declaration
patterns.context: Appears in an Android Java class, usually as an Activity lifecycle method declaration; the method body is immediately followed by «super.onCreate(»; this is the most stable and recurring pattern across passages.

patterns.name: Activity class and member declarations
patterns.context: The class header or field area of an Android Activity, often appearing with an `onCreate` declaration; some fragments show only members or the class header.

patterns.name: External-link detection in a web script
patterns.context: A JavaScript conditional in an HTML page checks whether the URL contains is-external=true, then enters a conditional code block.

patterns.name: Demographics heading in a Wikipedia article
patterns.context: A standalone section heading appears after the article body, followed by regional population information; it has no clear connection to the code pattern.

patterns.name: HTML body tag
patterns.context: The body opens after the head ends in an HTML document; the sample also contains a script, but the tag itself is not part of the Android code pattern.

patterns.name: JavaScript `if` conditional syntax
patterns.context: A script branches based on the result of checking `location.href`; co-occurs with external-link detection.

5_1308.description: 主要响应 Android Java Activity 生命周期代码，尤其是 onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) 方法声明及其类、字段上下文；另响应 HTML/JavaScript 外链检测片段和 Wikipedia 的 Demographics 章节标题。

patterns.name: Android Activity 的 onCreate 声明
patterns.context: 出现在 Android Java 类中，通常是 Activity 的生命周期方法声明，方法体紧接着是 «super.onCreate(»；最稳定、跨多段重复的模式。

patterns.name: Activity 类及成员声明
patterns.context: Android Activity 类的类头或字段区域，常与 onCreate 声明同现；部分片段只呈现成员或类头。

patterns.name: 网页脚本中的外链检测
patterns.context: HTML 页面内的 JavaScript 条件判断，检测 URL 是否包含 is-external=true，随后进入条件代码块。

patterns.name: Wikipedia 条目中的人口统计标题
patterns.context: 条目正文后出现独立的章节标题，后续转入地区人口信息；与代码模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: HTML body 标签
patterns.context: HTML 文档中 head 结束后开启 body；样本还包含脚本，但该标签本身不属于 Android 代码模式。

patterns.name: JavaScript 的 if 条件语法
patterns.context: 脚本中根据 location.href 的检测结果执行分支；与外链检测同现。

en.description: Activations occur near code classes, methods, constructors, and braces, as well as at line breaks, section headings, and transitions in some encyclopedia entries about plants, geography, and people; no single meaning explains them.

patterns.name: Android Java lifecycle method
patterns.context: An Activity `onCreate` method declaration appears in a Java/Android class; activations concentrate near the end of the method parameters and the opening brace

patterns.name: Structure markers near Java/C# class or member declarations
patterns.context: Near a class, constructor, or member declaration and the following code block; not limited to Android

patterns.name: Section headings and line breaks in Wikipedia articles
patterns.context: A Wikipedia article transitions from its body to a section heading, blank lines between headings, or content following a heading

patterns.name: Proper-noun classification heading in a geographic article
patterns.context: A subheading on administrative divisions appears after an introduction to a town's geography or population

patterns.name: Orchid-family plant name fragment
patterns.context: An orchid species article transitions from its distribution description to conservation status or species information

patterns.name: Constructor declaration and initialization block
patterns.context: A constructor and its code block in a C# class, including component initialization

patterns.name: X509 type property accessor
patterns.context: After a Java documentation comment, a getter returning X509DataType is declared and returns a field

patterns.name: Temporal transition in a judge's service history
patterns.context: A biography ends its account of private practice and transitions to federal judicial service

5_1308.description: 激活分布于代码的类、方法、构造器及花括号附近，也出现在百科条目换行、章节标题和少数植物、地理与人物条目内容转折处；无法由单一词义解释。

patterns.name: Android Java 生命周期方法
patterns.context: Java/Android 类中出现 Activity 的 onCreate 方法声明；激活集中在方法参数结尾及左花括号附近

patterns.name: Java/C# 类或成员声明附近的结构标记
patterns.context: 类、构造函数或成员声明及其后续代码块附近；并非只限 Android

patterns.name: Wikipedia 条目中的章节标题与换行
patterns.context: 百科条目正文转入章节标题、标题间空行或标题后内容的位置

patterns.name: 地理条目中的专名分类标题
patterns.context: 介绍城镇地理或人口资料后，出现行政区划小节标题

patterns.name: 兰科植物名称片段
patterns.context: 兰花物种条目在分布描述后转入保护状态或物种说明

patterns.name: 构造函数声明与初始化代码块
patterns.context: C# 类中构造函数及其代码块，包含组件初始化

patterns.name: X509 类型属性访问器
patterns.context: Java 文档注释结束后，声明返回 X509DataType 的 getter 并返回字段

patterns.name: 法官任职经历叙述的时间转折
patterns.context: 人物传记中私人执业经历结束并进入联邦司法任职叙述

en.description: Activations occur at code block boundaries and declarations across multiple languages, especially public, opening braces after method signatures, and return; Android onCreate is also included. Activations in two encyclopedia passages fall near subsection headings and cannot be unified with the code pattern.

patterns.name: return in method return values
patterns.context: Occurs in a method body, followed by a field or property value and ending in a semicolon; segment 1 also has @return in a documentation comment.
patterns.domain: Java, PHP code, and API documentation comments

patterns.name: public modifier and method/class definitions
patterns.context: Visibility modifiers in code declarations, commonly appearing in class, constructor, or method declarations.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple object-oriented languages

patterns.name: Opening brace after a method or constructor declaration
patterns.context: A code block begins after a method, constructor, or class declaration in Java/C#/PHP and other code; the brace condition is not obvious in segments 2 and 3.

patterns.name: Android onCreate lifecycle method
patterns.context: In Activity or UI code, commonly following @Override, protected void, and a call to super.onCreate.
patterns.domain: Android Java example code and Q&A

patterns.name: C# control constructor and container parameter
patterns.context: A parameterless constructor or a constructor that takes a container parameter in a Panel subclass.

patterns.name: PHP Google API getter
patterns.context: A PHP class method returns an object of type Google_Service_Appengine_CreateVersionMetadataV1Beta.
patterns.domain: PHP API client code and documentation comments

patterns.name: Java serializer class and byte method
patterns.context: A generic serializer implementation defines a getBytes method and declares IOException.

patterns.name: Conservation heading in an orchid article
patterns.context: A standalone conservation-status subsection heading in an encyclopedia article about the distribution of soldier's crest orchid.

patterns.context: Describes an athlete entering their senior year after college experience and serving as captain.

patterns.name: Polite request
patterns.context: An email asks the recipient to perform a deletion after confirmation.

5_1359.description: 激活主要集中在句首 Design；另对奖杯名称、家族分支、比较性措辞、运动员 senior 阶段及邮件中的礼貌请求有零散响应。

patterns.name: 句首 Design
patterns.context: 出现在段落或标题开头，后接动名词、过去分词或 of 短语。
patterns.domain: 说明文、百科条目标题、学术论文标题

patterns.name: 特定名称中的 Trophy
patterns.context: 出现在“World Team Trophy”赛事名称中。

patterns.name: 家族分支表述
patterns.context: 描述家族的主要分支及其地产、宅邸关联。
patterns.domain: 英国贵族与地方史百科

patterns.name: 数量比较表达
patterns.context: 项目摘要中表达增加证据数量及改善证据质量的需求。

patterns.name: 运动员生涯阶段
patterns.context: 描述运动员大学经历后进入 senior 年级并担任队长。

patterns.name: 礼貌请求
patterns.context: 邮件中请求对方在确认后执行删除操作。

en.description: Strong activation occurs mainly on tokens beginning with capitalized Inter, across multiple domains and with diverse following stems; activation also occurs on a segmented form of Frankfurt and the Right identifier in game interface code.

patterns.name: Inter-initial fragments
patterns.context: Words begin with capitalized Inter, with activation concentrated on the initial token; following stems vary.

patterns.name: Segmented proper name Frankfurt
patterns.context: Frankfurt is split into two tokens and appears in repeated names or possessive phrases.

patterns.name: Game control properties
patterns.context: In game interface code, Right appears near control identifiers, properties, or labels and is repeated within the same passage.

5_1359.description: 主要对词首大写 Inter 的 token 产生强激活，覆盖多领域且后接词干多样；另对 Frankfurt 拆分形式及游戏界面代码中的 Right 标识符有激活。

patterns.name: Inter 词首片段
patterns.context: 单词以大写 Inter 起始，激活集中于词首 token；后续词干各异。

patterns.name: Frankfurt 专名拆分
patterns.context: Frankfurt 被拆分成两个 token，出现在重复的名称或所有格短语中。

patterns.name: 游戏控件属性
patterns.context: 游戏界面代码中 Right 出现在控件标识符、属性或标签附近，且同段重复。

en.description: Activation spans legislative word forms, the polite emphasis very much, favour expressions of support or choice, and greatly modifying appreciated or affect; triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Legislative institution word forms
patterns.context: The stem legisl- appears in words referring to legislative institutions or lawmaking; in both examples it continues into a suffix.
patterns.domain: UK parliamentary news; human rights policy reporting

patterns.name: Polite expression very much
patterns.context: In thanks or polite replies, very much is followed by thanks, greetings, or a reason for gratitude.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches; business email; forum comments

patterns.name: favour and surrounding wording
patterns.context: Expresses support, preference, or choice; sometimes adjacent to vote or of, and sometimes followed by a policy object in in favour of.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates; historical architecture accounts; patent system commentary

patterns.name: Polite formula greatly appreciated
patterns.context: In email, greatly appreciated expresses thanks after a request for assistance.

patterns.name: greatly affect
patterns.context: greatly modifies affect, describing a topic's major impact on authority.

5_1359.description: 激活分布于议会/立法词形、礼貌强调语 very much、favour 支持或取舍表达，以及 greatly 修饰 appreciated 或 affect；触发点并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 立法机构词形
patterns.context: 词干 legisl- 出现在表示议会机构或制定法律的词中；两例中都延续为后缀。
patterns.domain: 英国议会新闻；人权政策报道

patterns.name: very much 礼貌表达
patterns.context: 在致谢或礼貌回应中，very much 后接感谢、致意或感谢原因。
patterns.domain: 议会发言；商务邮件；论坛评论

patterns.name: favour 及其周边措辞
patterns.context: 表达支持、偏向或取舍；有时紧邻 vote、of，有时在 in favour of 后接政策对象。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论；历史建筑记述；专利制度评论

patterns.name: greatly appreciated 礼貌套语
patterns.context: 邮件中在请求协助后，以 greatly appreciated 表达感谢。

patterns.name: greatly affect
patterns.context: greatly 修饰 affect，描述某话题对权威的重大影响。

en.description: Activation is scattered across to/ate, function words in legal clauses, HTML navigation anchors, and numbers and unusual fragments in forum posts; it spans domains and genres, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Strong activation adjacent to the preposition to
patterns.context: Across several samples, activation appears near English to or Romanian ate subword fragments; some strong activations fall on following words. The trigger does not correspond to a single word sense or syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Historical narrative, forums, parliamentary text, research funding, energy email, medical research; multiple genres

patterns.name: Function words and structures in legal text
patterns.context: In US constitutional clauses, activation concentrates near recurring function words and parallel structures in legal phrasing.

patterns.name: HTML navigation markers and anchor fields
patterns.context: In HTML navigation or API documentation table fragments, activation falls on underscores, anchor markers, and field names such as summary, detail, and method.

patterns.name: Numbers and unusual fragments in forum text
patterns.context: In forum text, activation appears on anomalous strings or number fragments near separators and line breaks; the two passages show no obvious consistent semantic trigger.

5_1359.description: 激活分散于 to/ate、法律条文功能词、HTML 导航锚点，以及论坛中的数字和特殊片段；跨领域、跨文体，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 紧邻介词 to 的强激活
patterns.trigger: «to»3 «further»10（1）；«To»3 «get»10（2）；«to»4«ate»9（3）；«to»2« cover»5« the»2« expenses»5« of»1« approximately»10（4）；«in»9« terms»（5、6）
patterns.context: 多个样本中，激活出现在英语 to 或罗马尼亚语 ate 等子词片段附近；部分强激活落在其后续词上。触发并非只对应单一词义或句法功能。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、论坛、议会文本、科研资助、能源邮件、医学研究；多种文体

patterns.name: 法律文本中的功能词与结构
patterns.context: 美国宪法条文中，激活集中在重复的法律句式功能词及并列结构附近。

patterns.name: HTML 导航标记与锚点字段
patterns.context: HTML 导航或 API 文档表格片段中，激活落在下划线、锚点标记及 summary、detail、method 等字段名上。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的数字与特殊片段
patterns.context: 论坛文本中，激活出现在分隔线、换行附近的异常字符串或数字片段；两段没有明显一致的语义触发条件。

en.concept: “On the basis of” phrase and sporadic fragments
en.description: The main pattern is the fixed phrase “On the basis of” in academic text; other activations are scattered across intra-word fragments, punctuation, numbers, and several common words in multiple genres, making them difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “On the basis of”
patterns.context: The prepositional phrase “On the basis of” occurs in sentences, typically introducing conclusions drawn from evidence or findings; capitalization and following words may vary.
