patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on punctuation, intra-word fragments, or numbers, with inconsistent local contexts; no semantic condition shared with the main phrase is evident.
patterns.domain: Web page titles, Italian parliamentary text, legal text, XML/code, etc., paragraphs 1, 3, 6, 7, 8, 10

patterns.name: Other sporadic words and phrases
patterns.context: Activates in their respective sentences, but there is no clear consistent contextual condition shared with one another or with “On the basis of.”

5_1359.concept: “On the basis of”短语及零散片段
5_1359.description: 主要模式是学术文本中的固定短语“On the basis of”；其余激活分散在词内片段、标点、数字及若干普通词语上，跨多种文体，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 固定短语“On the basis of”
patterns.context: 句中出现介词短语“On the basis of”，通常用于引出根据某些证据或发现得出的结论；大小写及其后续词语可变。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（医学、物理等），覆盖段落2、4、5

patterns.name: 字符串内部的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在标点、词内切分片段或数字上，局部上下文并不一致；未见与主短语相同的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、意大利语议会文本、法律文本、XML/代码等，覆盖段落1、3、6、7、8、10

patterns.name: 其他零散词语与短语
patterns.context: 在各自句子中激活，但彼此之间及与“On the basis of”均缺乏清楚一致的上下文条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across English function words from multiple domains, common French words, code and metadata fragments, numbers, and sporadic fixed expressions; trigger forms vary, with no clear unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or medial function words
patterns.context: Common English function words are marked in various syntactic positions; the specific triggering words differ across passages

patterns.name: Common French words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speeches, whole words or tokenized word-form fragments are marked

patterns.name: Technical markers and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Short tokens, word fragments, and formatting symbols are marked in technical or metadata text, including XML/OWL code and paper author names

patterns.name: Numbers or numerical expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur in numbers, percentages, and adjacent numerical expressions, but marked positions are sporadic and no stable numerical format is evident

patterns.name: Negation or emphasis expressions
patterns.context: The final word of a phrase is marked in fixed expressions or phrases with negative meaning

patterns.name: Non-English word forms across languages
patterns.context: These may be abbreviations, word-initial fragments, or tokenized fragments; their shared trigger condition cannot be determined from the fragments alone
patterns.domain: French parliamentary text and technical/academic text

5_1359.description: 激活分散在跨领域英文功能词、法语常见词、代码与元数据片段、数值及零散固定搭配上；触发词形多样，缺少清晰统一的语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 句末或句中功能词
patterns.context: 常见英文功能词在多种句法位置中被标记；各段触发的具体词并不一致

patterns.name: 法语常见词与词形片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，完整词或被分词的词形片段被标记

patterns.name: 技术标记与专名片段
patterns.context: XML/OWL 代码及论文作者名等技术或元数据文本中，标记了短 token、词片段和格式符号

patterns.name: 数字或数值表达
patterns.context: 数字、百分数及相邻数值表达中出现激活，但标记位置零散，未见稳定的单一数值格式

patterns.name: 否定或强调表达
patterns.context: 固定搭配或带否定意味的短语中，短语末端词被标记

patterns.name: 多种语言中的非英语词形
patterns.context: 可能是缩写、词首或分词片段；仅凭片段无法确认共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 法语议会文本及技术/学术文本

en.description: Activation mainly occurs on “Out of,” often introducing a quantity, proportion, or previously mentioned set; it also responds to Italian word-form fragments in all’inizio and iniziativa, and sporadically activates near Russian meta keywords and forum separators.

patterns.name: “out of” phrase
patterns.context: Used as a prepositional phrase to introduce a set, total, or previously mentioned referent, followed by a number, noun, or pronoun; it can occur across sentences in this group.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research, forums, and social issues text

patterns.name: Italian word-form fragment “all’inizio”
patterns.context: Appears in subword fragments of the Italian word “all’inizio” (at the beginning of), in an in-sentence temporal expression.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment “iniziativa”
patterns.context: Appears in subword fragments of the Italian word “iniziativa” (initiative), near mentions of transportation or improvement.

patterns.name: Isolated multilingual/character fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively near line breaks/separators in forum text and in subword fragments of Russian words among HTML meta keywords; no clear semantic condition shared with the other patterns is evident.

5_1359.description: 激活主要落在“Out of”中，常用于引出数量、比例或先前集合；另对意大利语 all’inizio 与 iniziativa 的词形片段有反应，并零星激活于俄语 meta 关键词及论坛分隔符附近。

patterns.name: “out of”短语
patterns.context: 作为介词短语引出集合、总量或先前提及对象，后接数字、名词或代词；本组中可跨句出现。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研、论坛及社会议题文本

patterns.name: “all’inizio”意大利语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词“all’inizio”（在……开始时）的分词片段中，处于句中时间表达。

patterns.name: “iniziativa”词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词“iniziativa”（倡议、举措）的分词片段中，附近提及交通或改善。

patterns.name: 孤立的多词/字词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在论坛文本的换行/分隔符附近，以及 HTML meta 关键词中俄语词汇的子词片段；未见与其他模式相同的明确语义条件。

en.concept: Multilingual internal word fragments and common expressions
en.description: Activations span English, Italian, and Romanian. They occur both on internal fragments of Italian parliamentary honorifics such as honor(evole) and on English to, the statistical expression out of, newscasts, and Romanian rezultatele; no unified semantics or single domain is evident.

patterns.name: Parliamentary honorific honorável
patterns.context: In Italian parliamentary speeches, used as an honorific for a member of parliament or speaker, usually before a name; activations concentrate on internal fragments of honor(evole).

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Romance-language words
patterns.context: In continuous Italian or Romanian text, activations fall on several internal subword fragments; this does not fully match the parliamentary honorific pattern in segments 4–6.

patterns.name: English to and neighboring expressions
patterns.context: English sentences contain to, especially in phrases such as Back to the point; another activation occurs on say. The trigger conditions are not sufficiently consistent.

patterns.name: of in numerical or statistical contexts
patterns.context: After a number, proportion, or count, out of expresses a fraction; one other instance continues with them.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, public health text, and web text

patterns.name: Internal fragments of English newscasts
patterns.context: A fragment within newscasts activates strongly, surrounded by a television station channel description.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Romanian result-related words
patterns.context: In a Romanian election context, activations fall on internal fragments of rezultatele (results).

5_1359.concept: 多语词内片段与常见表达
5_1359.description: 激活跨英语、意大利语和罗马尼亚语，既落在议会敬称 honor(evole) 等意大利语词内片段，也出现在英语 to、统计表达 out of、newscasts 及罗马尼亚语 rezultatele；未见统一语义或单一领域。

patterns.name: 议会称谓 honorável
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中，作为对议员或报告人的敬称，通常出现在姓名之前；激活集中在 honor(evole) 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会记录

patterns.name: 罗曼语词内片段
patterns.context: 在意大利语或罗马尼亚语连续文本中，激活落在词内部的若干子词片段；与段 4–6 的议会敬称模式不完全相同。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语、罗马尼亚语文本

patterns.name: 英语 to 及其邻接表达
patterns.context: 英语句子里出现 to，尤其是 Back to the point 这种短语；另一次激活在 say。触发条件不够一致。

patterns.name: 数字或统计语境中的 of
patterns.context: 数字、比例或计数之后，出现表示其中比例的 out of；另有一次延续为 them。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生文本及网页文本

patterns.name: 英语词内片段 newscasts
patterns.context: 词 newscasts 的词内片段获得强激活，周围是电视台频道说明。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语结果相关词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语选举语境中，落在 rezultatele（结果）的词内片段上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会文本

en.description: The most stable feature is recognition of the English “out of” construction, especially “out of + quantity/determiner,” used to count or identify a subset from a whole; there is also one instance of “of the + category” introducing a scope, along with sporadic local activations.

patterns.name: “out of” introducing a quantity or subset of a whole
patterns.context: A number, pronoun, or definite article follows “out of,” indicating that something is taken from, counted within, or described as part of a total; activation often falls on “of,” and sometimes also on nearby “the / this / these / every.”
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository text, statistical narrative, and dialogue; covers nearly all corpus types

patterns.name: “of the” introducing a specific whole or category
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, “of the + noun” defines the scope under discussion, followed by its composition or proportion; “Out of the forested land” also appears later in the same passage.

patterns.name: Local common collocations or lexical triggers
patterns.context: A few markers are scattered through sentences and do not form a stable pattern repeated across passages that can be independently confirmed; they may reflect incidental collocations or other local features.

5_1359.concept: 英语 out of 结构
5_1359.description: 最稳定的特征是识别英语“out of”结构，尤其“out of + 数量/限定词”，用于从总体中统计或指出子集；另有一次“of the + 类别”引出范围，以及零散局部激活。

patterns.name: “out of”引出数量或总体中的子集
patterns.context: 在“out of”之后接数字、代词或定冠词，表示从某个总量中取出、统计或描述其中一部分；激活常落在“of”，有时邻近的“the / this / these / every”也激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、统计叙述及对话；覆盖几乎全部语料类型

patterns.name: “of the”引出特定总体或类别
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头用“of the + 名词”限定讨论范围，随后给出该类别内部的构成或比例；此处同段稍后也出现“Out of the forested land”。
patterns.domain: 百科地理、土地利用比例说明

patterns.name: 局部的常见搭配或词汇触发
patterns.context: 少数标记分散在句中，未形成跨段重复、可独立确认的稳定模式；可能是偶发搭配或其他局部特征。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to out/of in the English quantity expression out of and to t in French surtout; also shows internal subword activations in several multilingual words, including an Italian honorific, a Spanish proper name, and sporadic French word fragments, with no shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: of in the English phrase “out of”
patterns.context: The trigger is out of in English quantity or proportion expressions; activation sometimes falls on out and sometimes on of.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia, forum, and general narrative text

patterns.name: t in French “surtout”
patterns.context: In French sentences, surtout is split into multiple tokens, with strong activation on the internal t; it means “especially/particularly” in different contexts.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary text, French medical papers

patterns.name: Word fragments in Italian honorific “Onorevole”
patterns.context: Occurs in parliamentary forms of address, where Onorevole is tokenized; high activations fall on the initial and subsequent word fragments.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Spanish proper name “Alencar”
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of Brazilian politician José Alencar, with activations concentrated on internal segments of the surname.
patterns.domain: Political proper names in English encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Word fragments in Spanish “inédito”
patterns.context: Occurs in a Spanish book description, with activations concentrated on internal segments of the adjective inédito.

patterns.name: Word fragments in English proper name “Newscasts”
patterns.context: Occurs as a subsection heading in a television station entry, with activations concentrated on internal segments of Newscasts.

patterns.name: French word endings and internal segmentation
patterns.context: Besides surtout, several common French words show weaker or moderate activations; these segments span word beginnings, middles, and endings, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Internal subword segmentation across languages
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across internal subword fragments of French, Italian, and Spanish words or proper names; specific trigger conditions are unclear and activation strengths vary.

5_1359.description: 主要对英语数量表达 out of 中的 out/of，以及法语 surtout 中的 t 强烈响应；另见若干多语种词内子词激活，包括意大利语称谓、西班牙语专名和零散法语词段，缺少共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 英语短语“out of”中的 of
patterns.context: 触发点是英语数量或比例表达中的 out of；有时激活落在 out，有时落在 of。
patterns.domain: 英语百科、论坛及一般叙述

patterns.name: 法语“surtout”中的 t
patterns.context: 法语句中 surtout 被分成多个 token，强激活集中在词中 t；语义上分别表示“尤其/特别”。
patterns.domain: 法语议会文本、法语医学论文

patterns.name: 意大利语称谓“Onorevole”中的词段
patterns.context: 位于议会发言称呼中，称谓 Onorevole 被分词；高激活落在词首及后续词段。

patterns.name: 西班牙语专名“Alencar”中的词段
patterns.context: 出现在巴西政治人物 José Alencar 的姓名中，激活集中在姓氏的词内分段。
patterns.domain: 英语百科中的政治人物专名

patterns.name: 西班牙语“inédito”中的词段
patterns.context: 出现在西班牙语书籍介绍句中，激活集中在形容词 inédito 的词内分段。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学／书籍介绍

patterns.name: 英语专名“Newscasts”中的词段
patterns.context: 出现在电视台条目中作为小节标题，激活集中在 Newscasts 的内部词段。

patterns.name: 法语词尾与词内分段
patterns.context: 除 surtout 外，法语中的多个常见词也有较弱或中等激活；这些分段跨越词首、词中和词尾，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 多语种内部子词分段
patterns.context: 激活散布在法语、意大利语和西班牙语单词或专名的内部子词片段；具体触发条件不清楚，且强度不一。

en.concept: Prepositional structures expressing source, scope, or exclusion
en.description: Primarily activates out/of in English “out of” structures and their following complements, covering proportions, selection from a whole, and source or scope. Also activates fragments of the French “en dehors de” and the Italian parliamentary honorific “Onorevole”.

patterns.name: “out of” structures
patterns.context: In English, expresses proportions (“out of 100”, “out of 5316”), selection from a whole or composition (“out of which”, “out of these compounds”), and scope or source (“out of state”); no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: English news, legal, forum, medical, and academic texts

patterns.name: French “en dehors de”
patterns.context: Word fragments in the French phrase “en dehors de” (outside of / apart from).

patterns.name: Italian honorific word fragment
patterns.context: The Italian honorific for a member of parliament in European Parliament speeches, occurring after “Presidente” and before a name.

5_1359.concept: 表示来源、范围或排除的介词结构
5_1359.description: 主要对英语“out of”结构中的 out/of 及后续补语激活，涵盖数量比例、整体中的选取及范围来源。另对法语“en dehors de”及意大利语议会敬称“Onorevole”的片段激活。

patterns.name: “out of”结构
patterns.trigger: “out« of»”及其后续成分，如“out« of»10”“out« of»« which»”“out« of»« these»”
patterns.context: 英语中表示数量比例（“out of 100”“out of 5316”）、从整体中选取或说明组成（“out of which”“out of these compounds”），以及范围或来源（“out of state”）；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 英语新闻、法律、论坛、医学论文、学术文本

patterns.name: 法语“en dehors de”
patterns.context: 法语短语“en dehors de”（在……之外／除……之外）中的词语片段。

patterns.name: 意大利语敬称词片段
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言中对议员的意大利语敬称，出现在“Presidente”之后及人名之前。

en.concept: The “out of” phrase and local fragments
en.description: Most passages activate around “out of” and its continuation, covering quantities, ranges, samples, and fixed idioms. Other instances include ordinary “of” collocations and isolated fragments in server terminology, addresses, and author names, which are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “out of” quantity or range expressions
patterns.context: The phrase indicates a proportion, part of a set, sample range, or test category; “out” and “of” are the main trigger locations.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, technology discussions, and research text

patterns.name: Fixed expression “out of the blue”
patterns.context: A fixed idiom meaning suddenly or unexpectedly; activations concentrate on “out of” in the phrase.

patterns.name: Ordinary preposition “of” or local collocations
patterns.context: “of” appears without forming a clear quantity or range expression; preceding tokens, contexts, and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Internal word or spelling fragment “sp”
patterns.context: Embedded within the word “Inspired” in the phrase “inspired by”; it has no clear connection to the “out of” pattern in other segments.

patterns.name: Character fragments in addresses and place names
patterns.context: Activations occur within the spelling of a place name in an institutional address; no clear general semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Character fragments in biomedical names
patterns.context: Activations occur within a cited author’s surname, surrounded by content about antibodies and leukemia research; a specific word form or tokenized fragment may be the trigger.

5_1359.description: 多数段落在“out of”及其后续成分处激活，涵盖数量、范围、样本和固定习语；另有普通“of”搭配，以及服务器术语、地址和作者姓名中的孤立片段，难以归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: “out of”数量或范围表达
patterns.trigger: “out of”及后续成分，如“out of 10 contract players”“out of a total of 640”“out of sample testing”
patterns.context: 短语用于表示比例、集合中的部分、样本范围或测试类别；“out”与“of”附近是主要触发位置。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、科技讨论与研究文本

patterns.name: “out of the blue”固定表达
patterns.context: 固定习语，表示突然、出乎意料；激活集中在该短语中的“out of”。

patterns.name: 普通介词“of”或其局部搭配
patterns.trigger: “of many occasions”“of course”“of their Topock location”
patterns.context: 出现“of”，但不构成清晰的数量或范围表达；前置 token、上下文和语义各异。

patterns.name: 词内或拼写片段“sp”
patterns.context: 嵌在“Inspired”一词内部，句中为“inspired by”；与其他段的“out of”模式没有明显联系。

patterns.name: 地址及地名中的字符片段
patterns.context: 激活位于机构地址中的地名拼写内部；没有明显的通用语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 生物医学名称中的字符片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在引文作者姓氏内部，周围是抗体与白血病研究内容；可能是特定词形或分词片段触发。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、生物医学文本

en.concept: out of phrases and sporadic intraword fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the English phrase “out of”, appearing with quantities, sets, sources, and fixed expressions; the following element varies. There is also one intraword fragment in Italian “Inoltre”, difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: out of followed by a quantity, set, or selected item
patterns.context: Primarily the phrase “out of” followed by a noun or pronoun, indicating something from a range, set, or source; the fixed expression “out of the way” also occurs. Activation does not require a specific following part of speech or meaning.
patterns.domain: English corpora including encyclopedia entries, game reviews, stories, social issue articles, and entertainment reviews

patterns.name: Italian intraword fragment
patterns.context: The fragment occurs inside the Italian word “Inoltre” (furthermore), surrounded by Italian policy text; it differs from the English “out of” pattern.
patterns.domain: Italian text from the European Parliament

5_1359.concept: out of 短语及偶发词内片段
5_1359.description: 主要响应英文短语“out of”，从数量范围、集合、来源到固定搭配均有出现，后接成分不固定；另有一次意大利语“Inoltre”词内片段，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: out of 后接数量、集合或选择对象
patterns.trigger: [1] “out« of»10”中 “of” 最强；[2] “out« of»10 contract players”；[3] “Out« of»9« this»4 meeting”；[4] “Out« of»9« the»6 260« episodes”；[5] “out« of»9 Gradius Rebirth”；[6] “out« of»9« the»5 darkness”；[7] “out« of»9« a»4« total»2« of»3 640”；[8] “Out« of»9« them»2”；[10] “out« of»9« the»6« way»4”
patterns.context: 主要是短语 “out of” 后接名词或代词，表示从某个范围、集合、来源中；也见固定表达 “out of the way”。触发强度不要求后接特定词类或语义。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、游戏评论、故事文本、社会议题文章、娱乐评论等英文语料

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 片段位于意大利语 “Inoltre”（此外）一词内部，周围是意大利语政策说明文本；与英文 “out of” 模式不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语文本

en.description: Most passages activate near the English phrase “out of,” followed by numbers, determiners, or nouns, with varied semantic uses; there are also tokenized Paris street names and an internal fragment in Bulgarian “върху,” which are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase out of
patterns.context: The phrase out of appears in continuous context; activations concentrate on “of” or the immediately following token, followed by numbers, determiners, or nouns, as in “out of 10,” “out of the blue,” “out of this meeting,” “out of passing unfamiliarity,” and “out of the forested land.”
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, including encyclopedias, game reviews, and forum discussions

patterns.name: Tokenization in proper names
patterns.context: When Paris street names are listed as Boulevard de…, place names are split into multiple tokens; activation is especially strong on the “u” in Reuilly.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Bulgarian
patterns.context: In a Bulgarian sentence, activation falls on an internal subword fragment of върху; this segment does not show the evident English out of pattern.

5_1359.description: 多数段落在英文短语“out of”附近激活，后接数字、限定词或名词，语义用法多样；另见巴黎街道名分词和保加利亚语“върху”词内片段，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 固定短语 out of
patterns.context: 连续上下文中出现短语 out of；激活集中在 “of” 或其后紧邻的 token，后续成分可为数字、限定词或名词，如 “out of 10”、“out of the blue”、“out of this meeting”、“out of passing unfamiliarity”、“out of the forested land”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本，包括百科、游戏评论、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 专名中的分词 token
patterns.trigger: “Boulevard de la Chapelle”、“Boulevard de Reuilly”；激活落在 “de”“la”“Re”
patterns.context: 法国巴黎街道名以 Boulevard de… 列举时，地名被拆分为多个 token；激活尤其强于 Reuilly 中的 “u”。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语句子中，激活落在词 върху 的词内子词片段；该段没有明显的英文 out of 模式。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、保加利亚语

en.description: Primarily activates on English out, especially out of followed by nouns for source, cause, scope, or space, and including out of the blue; also has sporadic activations on a virus keyword, a Bulgarian word fragment, and a French place-name fragment.

patterns.name: English phrase out of
patterns.context: “out of” indicates something originating from a source or caused by a circumstance, followed by a noun phrase.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the blue
patterns.context: Fixed idiom meaning that something happens suddenly or unexpectedly.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the project
patterns.context: Indicates leaving or being excluded from a project; here it describes an actor withdrawing from casting.

patterns.name: English phrase out of fear
patterns.context: Indicates that an action was taken because of fear, followed by a noun for an emotion or motive.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the episodes
patterns.context: Indicates some items among a given total, followed by a quantity or set.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the darkness
patterns.context: Indicates emerging from darkness; a literal spatial image used in narrative.

patterns.name: Other uses of English out
patterns.context: The verb phrase find out (discover) and out of meaning outside a range; these differ from the main out of phrase pattern.

patterns.name: Virus keyword metadata
patterns.context: The keyword list contains virus and its variants; the activation fragment also includes a Russian virus word form.

patterns.name: Bulgarian intraword fragment
patterns.context: The activation falls on a subword fragment of a segmented Bulgarian word; this example does not establish a link to English out/out of.

patterns.name: French place-name intraword fragment
patterns.context: The activation occurs on a subword fragment of a Paris street name, with no evident English out phrase context.

5_1359.description: 主要激活于英语 out，尤其 out of 后接来源、原因、范围或空间名词，也包括 out of the blue；另有病毒关键词、保加利亚语词片段及法语地名片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of
patterns.context: “out of”表示从某来源产生、由某情况导致，后接名词短语。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the blue
patterns.context: 固定习语，表示突然、出乎意料地发生。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the project
patterns.context: 表示离开或被排除出某个项目；此处描述演员退出选角。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of fear
patterns.context: 表示因恐惧而采取某行动，后接情绪或动机名词。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the episodes
patterns.context: 表示在给定总数中、就其中某些项目而言，后接数量或集合。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the darkness
patterns.context: 表示从黑暗中出现；字面空间意象用于叙事。

patterns.name: 英语 out 的其他用法
patterns.context: 分别是动词短语 find out（查明）和 out of 表示不在某范围内；与主要的 out of 短语模式不同。

patterns.name: 病毒关键词元数据
patterns.context: 关键词列表中包含 virus 及其变体；激活片段还含有俄语病毒词形。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的保加利亚语词片段中，无法从该例确认它与英语 out/out of 有关。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 法语地名词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在巴黎街道名称的子词片段中，没有明显的英语 out 短语语境。

en.concept: Common multilingual word fragments and English of
en.description: Primarily responds to of in the English phrase out of; it also responds to the in/iz fragments within Italian inizio, ър within Bulgarian върху, and the number 10 in one proportion phrase. The instances occur in natural phrases in each language, with limited cross-lingual consistency.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation out of
patterns.context: English out of phrases expressing proportions, ranges, or idiomatic expressions; the following element may be a quantity or noun phrase.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedias, forums, and legal text

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Italian inizio
patterns.context: Subword fragments within the Italian word inizio (beginning), occurring in time expressions referring to a point in time, such as “all’inizio del 2009” and “All’inizio di gennaio”.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Bulgarian върху
patterns.context: Within the Bulgarian preposition върху (on/upon; effect on), used in expressions about the impact of a policy or agreement on something.

patterns.name: Number 10
patterns.context: The number 10 occurs in the proportion expression “9 times out of 10”; activation is marked on the number.

5_1359.concept: 多语种常见词片段及英语 of
5_1359.description: 主要响应英语 out of 短语中的 of；也响应意大利语 inizio 内的 in/iz 片段、保加利亚语 върху 内的 ър，以及一次比例短语中的数字10。各语言实例均处于自然词句中，跨语种一致性有限。

patterns.name: out of 固定搭配
patterns.context: 英语中表示比例、范围或惯用表达的 out of 短语；后续成分可为数量或名词短语。
patterns.domain: 英语百科、论坛及法律文本

patterns.name: 意大利语 inizio 的词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语词 inizio（开始）内部的子词片段，出现在表示某时点的时间表达中，如“all’inizio del 2009”“All’inizio di gennaio”。
patterns.domain: 意大利语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 保加利亚语 върху 的词内片段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语介词 върху（在……上／对……的影响）内部；用于政策或协议对某事物产生影响的表达。
patterns.domain: 保加利亚语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 数字 10
patterns.context: 数字10出现在“9 times out of 10”这一比例表达中；激活标记落在数字上。

en.concept: out of phrases and cross-lingual local word forms
en.description: Most English examples activate in out of quantity or set constructions; cause, contract, and committee uses also occur. The remaining examples are Bulgarian policy word forms and Spanish date subword tokens, which do not fit a single clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English collocation out of
patterns.context: The phrase out of is followed by a quantity, set, institution, or personal pronoun, often meaning “among”; activation concentrates on out of and the following word.

patterns.name: Other English uses of out of
patterns.context: out of forms expressions of cause, contract status, and committee procedure; the same phrase is present, but semantic and syntactic relations vary.

patterns.name: Bulgarian competitiveness-related word forms
patterns.context: Bulgarian parliamentary sentences about competitiveness and the specific object being emphasized; activation is distributed within subword-tokenized words.

patterns.name: Bulgarian parliamentary and agreement word forms
patterns.context: Sentences about the compatibility of an agreement with WTO rules and parliamentary questions; activation falls within words at the subword-token level, not on English out of.

patterns.name: Bulgarian conditional and jurisdictional word forms
patterns.context: A conditional sentence about a permanent representative office or an authorized consul and related matters; activation falls within Bulgarian words.

patterns.name: Spanish date structure
patterns.context: Wording for the effective date of the Lisbon Treaty; activation covers the date preposition and several subword tokens in the month.

5_1359.concept: out of 短语及跨语种局部词形
5_1359.description: 多数英语样例在 out of 数量或集合结构中激活，也见原因、合同和委员会用法；其余为保加利亚语政策词形及西班牙语日期子词元，不能归入同一明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语搭配 out of
patterns.context: 短语 out of 后接数量、集合、机构或人称代词，常表示“在……之中”；激活集中在 out of 及紧随其后的词。

patterns.name: 英语其他 out of 用法
patterns.trigger: “out« of»10 fear”“out« of» contract players”“reported out« of» the Senate Judiciary Committee”
patterns.context: out of 分别构成原因表达、合同状态表达及委员会程序表达；仍包含同一词组，但语义和句法关系各异。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语竞争力相关词形
patterns.context: 保加利亚语议会语句中竞争力及其具体强调对象的词语，激活分布在被子词元切分的词内部。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语议会与协议词形
patterns.context: 关于协议与世贸规则相容性、议会问题的句子；激活落在词内子词元，并非英语 out of。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语条件与管辖词形
patterns.context: 条件句中谈及常驻代表机构或有权领事及相关事务；激活落在保加利亚语词内部。

patterns.name: 西班牙语日期结构
patterns.context: 里斯本条约生效日期的表述，激活覆盖日期介词及月份的若干子词元。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，西班牙语议会发言记录

en.concept: out of phrase and its context
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the phrase “out of” and its continuation: it often indicates extraction or counting from a set or quantity, and also occurs in the idioms “out of the darkness” and “out of the blue.” Activations in a French formal parliamentary address are also present but are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: out of quantity/set
patterns.context: Indicates extraction, counting, or specifying members from a quantity, sample, or set; may be followed by this, the, them, contract, etc., and occur at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence

patterns.name: Fixed expression out of the darkness
patterns.context: Combines with emerge to mean appearing from the darkness

patterns.name: Fixed expression out of the blue
patterns.context: An idiom modifying something that happens or is proposed suddenly

patterns.name: French parliamentary speech format
patterns.context: Formal French forms of address and polite speech formulas; no evident triggering substring shared with the English out of pattern

5_1359.description: 主要对短语“out of”及其后续结构敏感：常表示从集合或数量中取出、统计，也出现在习语“out of the darkness”“out of the blue”中。另有法语正式议会称呼套语激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: out of 数量/集合
patterns.context: 表示从一个数量、样本或集合中取出、统计或限定其成员；可接 this、the、them、contract 等，位置可在句首或句中
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、评论、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 固定表达 out of the darkness
patterns.context: 与 emerge 搭配，表示从黑暗中出现

patterns.name: 固定表达 out of the blue
patterns.context: 作为习语，修饰突然发生或提出的事情

patterns.name: 法语议会发言格式
patterns.trigger: «Monsieur le Président, Mesdames et Messieurs les Députés» 等
patterns.context: 法语正式称呼及礼貌发言套语；未见明显与英语 out of 模式相同的触发子串

en.concept: Mixed responses to local patterns of “out of” and Bulgarian subword fragments
en.description: Most passages activate on English “out of”, often introducing a set, quantity, or circumstance, though the following structures and meanings vary. Two Bulgarian parliamentary texts activate on sporadic subword fragments such as “върху”; their relation to the English pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of”
patterns.context: “out of” occurs at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence, followed by a quantity, demonstrative, or determiner; the numbers 10 and 9 may themselves form part of the continuous phrase.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, reviews, forums, blogs, and research texts

patterns.name: Part of a proportion or set
patterns.context: Identifies members, sources, outcomes, or occurrences from a set, total, or circumstance; the semantic functions are not entirely the same.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, online articles, forums, and research texts

patterns.name: Word-form activations in Bulgarian fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Bulgarian text, activation falls on subword fragments of several words; “върху” appears twice, while the other activated fragments are sporadic.

5_1359.concept: 对短语“out of”的局部模式及保加利亚语子词片段的混合响应
5_1359.description: 多数段落激活英文“out of”，常引出集合、数量或情境，但后续结构和语义各异；两段保加利亚语议会文本则激活“върху”等分散子词片段，和英文模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of”
patterns.context: 句首或句中出现“out of”，后接数量、指示词或限定词；数字 10、9 本身也可能是连续短语的一部分。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括百科、评论、论坛、博客及科研文本

patterns.name: 比例或集合中的部分
patterns.trigger: “Out of”后接“this meeting”“the 260 episodes”“them”“the darkness”“the blue”“all the cookies”“these compounds”等
patterns.context: 从某个集合、总量或情境中指出其成员、来源、结果或发生情况；语义功能并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、网络文章、论坛及科研文本

patterns.name: 保加利亚语片段中的词形激活
patterns.context: 保加利亚语连续文本中，激活落在若干词的子词片段上；可见“върху”出现两次，但其他激活片段分散。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

en.concept: of in the phrase out of
en.description: Primarily activates on “of” in the phrase “out of,” especially when it introduces a subset of a quantity or set; also covers fixed uses of out of expressing motivation, origin, or state.

patterns.name: Proportion/subset within a quantity or set
patterns.context: “Out of” is followed by a set or quantity, then identifies objects originating from, selected from, or counted within it, as in “Out of them,” “Out of the 260 episodes,” “out of 100 publishers,” “Out of these compounds,” and “Out of all the cookies.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, forums, research, and general narration

patterns.name: Fixed phrase out of respect
patterns.context: “Out of” introduces the noun phrase “respect for the victims,” expressing motivation or reason rather than a proportion within a set.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase out of the darkness
patterns.context: “Out of” denotes emerging from an environment or state; it is followed by a place/state noun and paired with “emerge” to describe the appearance.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase out of fear
patterns.context: “Out of” introduces fear as a motivation; the following text explains the feared consequences.

patterns.name: out of contract
patterns.context: “Out of” and “contract” form a state expression modifying a player, indicating that their contract has expired or that they are not under contract.

5_1359.concept: out of 短语中的 of
5_1359.description: 主要对短语“out of”中的“of”激活，尤其常见其引出数量或集合的子集；另涵盖表示动机、来源或状态的 out of 固定用法。

patterns.name: 数量或集合中的比例/子集
patterns.context: “out of”后接集合或数量，继续指出其中产生、被选出或统计到的对象，如“Out of them”“Out of the 260 episodes”“out of 100 publishers”“Out of these compounds”“Out of all the cookies”。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、论坛、科研及一般叙述

patterns.name: 固定短语 out of respect
patterns.context: “out of”引出表示动机或原因的名词短语“respect for the victims”，而非集合中的比例。

patterns.name: 固定短语 out of the darkness
patterns.context: “out of”表示从某种环境或状态中出现，后接地点/状态名词，并由“emerge”描述出现。

patterns.name: 固定短语 out of fear
patterns.context: “out of”引出恐惧这一动机；后续说明担忧的后果。

patterns.name: out of contract
patterns.context: “out of”与“contract”构成状态表达，修饰球员，表示合同到期或不在合同期内。

en.description: Activation concentrates on the phrase “out of”, covering selection or examples from a whole as well as emerging from somewhere, work titles, and fixed or context-specific uses such as “unexpectedly” and “because of fear”.

patterns.name: “out of” structures
patterns.context: The trigger mainly occurs in the phrase “out of”, followed by different determiners or pronouns, often indicating selection or counting a subset of a whole; paragraph 8 has the idiom “out of the blue”, paragraph 9 has “out of the darkness”, and paragraph 10 has “out of fear”.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, academic texts, reviews, and narratives

patterns.name: Subset selection or examples from a whole
patterns.context: “out of” is followed by the, these, them, or all, referring to selecting part of a previously mentioned set or category or introducing examples; it sometimes precedes a quantity or explanation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, experimental papers, research project descriptions, social commentary, and food blogs

patterns.name: Entity nouns following “out of the”
patterns.context: “out of” is followed by this or the plus a noun; the examples respectively express something arising from a meeting, part of an album title, and emerging from darkness, with different meanings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music discographies, and narrative texts

patterns.name: Fixed idioms and causal phrases
patterns.context: “out of the blue” means unexpectedly; “out of fear” means doing something because of fear. Neither is a literal use of selecting a subset from a set.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, biographies, or entertainment encyclopedias

5_1359.description: 激活集中在短语“out of”，涵盖从整体中选取或举例，也包括由某处出现、作品名称及“出乎意料”“因害怕”等固定或语境化用法。

patterns.name: “out of”结构
patterns.context: 触发词主要出现在短语“out of”中，后接不同限定词或代词，常表示从整体中选取、统计其一部分；第 8 段是习语“out of the blue”，第 9 段是“out of the darkness”，第 10 段则为“out of fear”。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术、评论、叙事等多种文体

patterns.name: 整体中取子集或举例
patterns.trigger: “Out« of»9« the»4 260 episodes”、“Out« of»9« the»4 20 subjects”、“Out« of»9« these»3 compounds”、“Out« of»9« them»2”、“Out« of»9« all»7 the cookies”
patterns.context: “out of”后接 the、these、them 或 all，指从前述集合或类别中选出部分、引出实例；有时后接数量或说明。
patterns.domain: 百科、实验论文、科研项目介绍、社会评论、饮食博客

patterns.name: “out of the”后接实体名词
patterns.trigger: “Out« of»10« this»2 meeting”、“Out« of»9« the»4 Wind»1”、“out« of»9« the»4 darkness”
patterns.context: “out of”后接 this 或 the 加名词；分别表达由某次会议产生、专辑名的一部分，以及从黑暗中出现，含义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 百科、音乐作品列表、叙事文本

patterns.name: 固定习语与原因短语
patterns.context: “out of the blue”表示出乎意料；“out of fear”表示因害怕而做某事，均非从集合中取子集的字面用法。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、人物传记或娱乐百科

en.concept: Subset within a set / introductory structure
en.description: Primarily responds to subsets, proportions, or enumerations within a whole introduced by English “Out of”; it also activates on the Spanish introductory structure “desde” and a few English function words and proper-name components.

patterns.name: “Out of” proportion or subset enumeration
patterns.context: After a quantity, whole, or set, “Out of X …” introduces a portion, case, member, or result within it; also includes set expressions such as “Out of all the cookies.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research, news, and general explanatory text

patterns.name: Spanish introductory expression “desde”
patterns.context: In Spanish sentences, “desde” indicates a starting point in time or a phase, followed by a time or event.
patterns.domain: Spanish academic abstracts, European Parliament texts

patterns.name: English “of” relational structure
patterns.context: Connected to a year, personal relationship, possession, or place; does not clearly form a quantity structure with “Out of.”

patterns.name: “Television” in an English proper name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a television network name.

patterns.name: “Under” in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in the competition name “Under 21 Premier League.”

5_1359.concept: 集合中的子集／起始结构
5_1359.description: 主要响应英语“Out of”引出的总体内子集、比例或列举；另对西班牙语“desde”起始结构及少数英语功能词、专名成分有激活。

patterns.name: “Out of”比例或子集列举
patterns.context: 在数量、总体或集合之后，用“Out of X …”引出其中一部分、案例、成员或结果；也包括“Out of all the cookies”等集合表达。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研、新闻及一般说明性文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语“desde”起始表达
patterns.context: 西班牙语句中“desde”表示从某时点或阶段开始，后接时间或事件。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语学术摘要、欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 英语“of”关系结构
patterns.context: 与年份、人物关系、所属关系或地点等相连；未明显构成“Out of”数量结构。

patterns.name: 英语专名中的“Television”
patterns.context: 作为电视网络名称的一部分出现。

patterns.name: 专名中的“Under”
patterns.context: 出现在“Under 21 Premier League”赛事名称中。

en.description: Primarily responds to the phrase “out of,” especially its use for taking or counting items from a total or set; also responds to the less common fixed expressions “out of the blue” and “out of respect.”

patterns.name: out of + quantity/set
patterns.context: “out of” indicates taking from, counting within, or giving an example from a total or set; it may be followed by “the 260 episodes,” “the 20 subjects,” “all the cookies,” “them,” “these compounds,” etc.
patterns.domain: Narration, statistics, popular science, reviews, and online posts

patterns.name: Fixed expression out of the blue
patterns.context: The complete idiom means that something happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

patterns.name: Fixed expression out of respect
patterns.context: Explains that an action is taken out of respect for the victims; “of” is not followed by a quantity or set.

5_1359.description: 主要响应短语“out of”，尤其是表示从总数或集合中取出、统计的用法；也响应其少见固定搭配“out of the blue”和“out of respect”。

patterns.name: out of + 数量/集合
patterns.trigger: «Out»« of»«9» 后接数量、比例或集合，并常继续限定集合成员
patterns.context: “out of”表示从某个总数或集合中取出、统计或举例；后续可为 “the 260 episodes”“the 20 subjects”“all the cookies”“them”“these compounds”等
patterns.domain: 叙述、统计、科普、评论及网络帖子

patterns.name: out of the blue 固定表达
patterns.context: 完整习语表示突然、出乎意料地发生

patterns.name: out of respect 固定表达
patterns.context: 说明某行为出于对受害者的尊重；of 后不接数量或集合

en.description: All segments contain “out of”, but the following elements and meanings vary: scope, source, cause, fixed idioms, titles, or emerging from darkness. Segment 1 also contains an ordinary “of” relation phrase; the other weakly marked words have no common theme.

patterns.name: “out of” structures
patterns.context: The core trigger is the prepositional phrase “out of”, followed by different types of noun phrases, pronouns, or fixed expressions; it can indicate source, scope, motive, or a change of state, with no single meaning required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, encyclopedias, forums, papers, titles, and online articles

patterns.name: “of” relation phrases
patterns.context: In segment 1, besides “out of”, “of” also occurs in a year expression and a kinship relation; whether this extends the same mechanism is uncertain.

patterns.name: Sporadic co-activated words
patterns.context: These are separately marked weaker activations in the segments and are distributed sporadically; the evidence does not support a unified, independent trigger pattern.

5_1359.description: 所有段都含“out of”，但后续成分及意义多变：范围、来源、原因、固定习语、标题或“由黑暗中出现”。第1段另有普通“of”关系短语；其余弱标记词缺乏共同主题。

patterns.name: “out of”结构
patterns.context: 核心触发是介词短语“out of”，后接不同类型的名词短语、代词或固定表达；可表示来源、范围、动机、状态转换等，不要求单一语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、百科、论坛、论文、标题及网络文章

patterns.name: “of”关系短语
patterns.context: 在第1段中，除“out of”外，“of”还出现在年份表达和亲属身份关系中；是否是同一机制的延伸不确定。

patterns.name: 零散共激活词
patterns.context: 这些是各段中另行标记的较弱激活，分布零散；材料不足以支持统一的独立触发模式。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to the fixed phrase “out of”: its core use is to introduce a portion of a whole, and it also responds to idiomatic expressions involving curiosity, the blue, or fear, as well as “out of all” introducing a set.

patterns.name: “out of” in proportions/quantities
patterns.context: After reporting a total, “out of + whole/set” introduces a portion or proportion within it, often followed by a number, noun, or pronoun.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, experiment reports, social issues, online discussions

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of curiosity”
patterns.context: Used as a sentence opener or parenthetical to introduce the motivation for a question.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of the blue”
patterns.context: Describes something happening suddenly and unexpectedly.

patterns.name: out of fear
patterns.context: Indicates acting out of fear of a possible consequence; followed by a “fear that” clause.

patterns.name: out of all + set
patterns.context: Selects or evaluates a portion of an overall set; in this example, it is followed by cookies in the world.

5_1359.description: 神经元主要响应固定搭配“out of”：核心是引出总体中的部分，也响应 curiosity、the blue、fear 等构成的惯用表达，以及“out of all”引出集合。

patterns.name: 比例/数量中的“out of”
patterns.context: 在报告总数后用“out of + 总体/集合”引出其中的部分或比例，常接数字、名词或代词。
patterns.domain: 百科、实验报告、社会议题、网络讨论

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of curiosity”
patterns.context: 用作句首或句中插入语，引出提问动机。

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of the blue”
patterns.context: 描述某事突然、出乎意料地发生。

patterns.name: out of fear
patterns.context: 表示因害怕某种后果而采取行动；后接 fear that 从句。

patterns.name: out of all + 集合
patterns.context: 从整体集合中挑选或评价一部分；本例后接 cookies in the world。

en.concept: The phrase “out of” and its collocations
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the phrase “out of” and its fixed collocations: it denotes counting or taking items from a whole, and also occurs in expressions such as out of respect, the blue, fear, and curiosity. There is also one activation on a newline character.

patterns.name: The phrase “out of”
patterns.context: The phrase appears at the beginning or middle of a sentence, followed by a set, whole, or quantity, and denotes taking from, counting within, or giving an example from a whole; it sometimes extends to fixed expressions.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including Wikipedia, ArXiv, HackerNews, and Pile-CC

patterns.name: Quantities and sets after “out of”
patterns.context: “out of + quantity/whole” describes a proportion, sample composition, or result, such as how many items out of a total or the proportion rejected.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narration, academic experiment descriptions, online comments

patterns.name: Fixed expression “out of respect”
patterns.context: “out of” is directly followed by the noun respect, expressing motivation and explaining that an action is taken out of respect or in remembrance.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “out of the blue”
patterns.context: The idiom means that something happens suddenly and unexpectedly; here it describes Microsoft unexpectedly making an acquisition offer.

patterns.name: “out of fear” expressing apprehension
patterns.context: “out of + fear” explains that an action or choice is made out of fear of a possible consequence.

patterns.name: “out of curiosity” expressing curiosity
patterns.context: The fixed expression introduces something the speaker looks at, asks about, or explores out of curiosity.

patterns.name: Anomalous standalone marker
patterns.context: A newline character is marked as activated, but the context contains no clear lexical trigger consistent with “out of.”
patterns.domain: HackerNews post formatting and line breaks

5_1359.description: 主要对短语“out of”及其固定搭配敏感：表示从整体中计数或取出，也出现在 out of respect、the blue、fear、curiosity 等表达中。另有一次换行符激活。

patterns.name: 短语 “out of”
patterns.trigger: «Out»« of»，包括后接计数词、限定词或代词的形式，如 «Out»« of»10« this»、«Out»« of»10« the»、«Out»« of»9« them»
patterns.context: 短语出现在句首或句中，后接集合、整体或数量，表示从某个整体中取出、计数或举例；有时延伸为固定表达。

patterns.name: “out of”后接数量与集合
patterns.trigger: «Out»« of»10« this»；«Out»« of»10« the»260 episodes；«Out»« of»10« the»20 subjects；«out»« of»100« publishers»
patterns.context: 用“out of + 数量/整体”说明比例、样本构成或结果，例如从总数中有多少、被拒绝的比例。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、学术实验描述、网络评论

patterns.name: 固定表达 “out of respect”
patterns.context: “out of”后直接接表示动机的名词 respect，说明因尊重或悼念而采取某行动。

patterns.name: 固定表达 “out of the blue”
patterns.context: 习语表示事情突然、出乎意料地发生；这里描述微软突然提出收购报价。

patterns.name: 表示担忧的 “out of fear”
patterns.context: “out of + fear”说明因害怕某种后果而采取行动或作出选择。

patterns.name: 表达好奇的 “out of curiosity”
patterns.context: 固定表达引出说话者出于好奇进行的查看、询问或探索。

patterns.name: 异常的单独标记
patterns.context: 换行符被标记激活，但上下文中没有明显与“out of”一致的词汇触发。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖子的格式与换行

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the consecutive phrase “out of” or the beginning of that phrase, covering taking a portion from a set, acting out of fear, sudden events, and being out of control; activation often extends to following determiners or complements. The “from a” in segment 3 cannot be reliably matched to the main pattern.

patterns.name: out of + quantity/range
patterns.context: “Out of” is followed by a range or total, often introducing a portion or subsequent statistical details; the same form also appears in « Out»2« of»10« this»2 meeting, « Out»2« of»10« these»3 compounds, Out« of»9« the»5 20 subjects.

patterns.name: out of + pronoun
patterns.context: “Out of them” refers to a previously mentioned group or set and introduces cases or members within it.

patterns.name: out of fear
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “out of fear” means acting or refraining from acting out of fear; activation is concentrated at the beginning of the phrase.

patterns.name: out of the blue
patterns.context: The fixed idiom “out of the blue” means that something happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

patterns.name: out of control
patterns.context: The fixed collocation “out of control” describes an aircraft losing control and crashing.

patterns.name: out of all
patterns.context: “out of all” introduces a selection or comparison drawn from a whole.

patterns.name: Possible literal departure use
patterns.context: This segment has no clear “out of” trigger; the strong visible activation falls on “from a,” which is inconsistent with the fixed expressions in other segments and may reflect an independent local pattern or anomalous sample.

5_1359.description: 主要对“out of”这一连续词组或其短语开头敏感，覆盖从集合中取部分、因害怕、突然发生、失控等用法；激活也常延伸到其后的限定词或补足语。第3段的“from a”无法与主模式可靠对应。

patterns.name: out of + 数量/范围
patterns.context: “Out of”后接限定范围或总量，常用于引出其中一部分或接下来的统计细节；同样形式也见于« Out»2« of»10« this»2 meeting、« Out»2« of»10« these»3 compounds、Out« of»9« the»5 20 subjects。

patterns.name: out of + 代词
patterns.context: “Out of them”指前文提及的人群或集合，并引出其中的案例或成员。

patterns.name: out of fear
patterns.context: 固定短语“out of fear”，表示因害怕而采取或不采取某行为；激活集中在短语开头。

patterns.name: out of the blue
patterns.context: 固定习语“out of the blue”，表示突然、出乎意料地发生。

patterns.name: out of control
patterns.context: 固定搭配“out of control”，描述飞机失控坠落。

patterns.name: out of all
patterns.context: “out of all”引出某个整体中的选择或比较对象。

patterns.name: 可能的字面离开用法
patterns.context: 此段没有清晰的“out of”触发语；可见的强激活落在“from a”，与其他段的固定搭配不一致，可能是独立的局部模式或异常样本。

en.concept: out of and related local phrases
en.description: Primarily responds to “out of” structures: extracting from a set, counting, or introducing a result; also occurs in fixed phrases such as “out of control” and “out of the blue”. One example is marked in the causal phrase “death from a heart attack”.

patterns.name: “Out of” introducing part of a whole or a subsequent result
patterns.context: “out of” is followed by a quantity, demonstrative, or pronoun, forming a phrase that selects or counts from a set or introduces a result; “the”, “all”, or other words sometimes occur between the quantity and “of”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research, legal texts, forums, and general explanatory texts

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of control”
patterns.context: Describes behavior or a situation becoming uncontrollable; “of 10” is marked in between here, but the original phrase is “out of control”

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of the blue”
patterns.context: “out of the blue” means something happens suddenly or unexpectedly; the marked positions span inserted content within the phrase
patterns.domain: Online forum discussion of a business acquisition

patterns.name: Directional use “out of a heart attack”
patterns.context: The cause-of-death expression is “death from a heart attack”; the marked position actually falls within the causal phrase and is not a typical “out of” structure

5_1359.description: 主要响应“out of”结构：从某集合中取出、统计或引出结果；也见于“out of control”“out of the blue”等固定短语。另有一例标记落在“death from a heart attack”的原因短语中。

patterns.name: “Out of”引出总体中的部分或后续结果
patterns.trigger: «Out»…« of»…，包括 “Out of the 260 episodes”“Out of this meeting”“Out of these compounds”“Out of the 20 subjects”“Out of them”“Out of the entire front page”
patterns.context: “out of”后接数量、指示词或代词，构成从某个集合中选取、统计或引出结果的短语；有时数量与“of”之间插入“the”“all”等词
patterns.domain: 百科、科研、法律、论坛及一般说明性文本

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of control”
patterns.context: 描述行为或局势失控；此处中间有“of 10”标记，但原文短语为“out of control”
patterns.domain: 法律/儿童福利案件叙述

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of the blue”
patterns.context: “out of the blue”表示突然、出乎意料地发生；此处被激活位置跨过短语中的插入内容
patterns.domain: 网络论坛对商业收购的讨论

patterns.name: 方位用法“out of a heart attack”
patterns.trigger: “death from «a» heart attack”中的标记 token «a»，以及邻近的“death”“from”
patterns.context: 死亡原因表达“death from a heart attack”；标记位置实际落在原因短语内部，并非典型的“out of”结构

en.description: Primarily responds to the “Out of” structure, especially its use to introduce a whole and identify a portion within it; it also responds to different fixed or literary expressions such as out of the blue, out of the spring, and out of curiosity.

patterns.name: Out of + quantity/whole + subset
patterns.context: “Out of” introduces a whole or total, usually followed by a portion, case, or member within it; activation is concentrated on Out, of, and the following determiner.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, blogs, news discussions, and research texts

patterns.name: Fixed expression Out of the blue
patterns.context: Means that something happens suddenly; preceded here by a discussion about Microsoft’s acquisition of Yahoo.

patterns.name: Fixed expression Out of the spring
patterns.context: In a literary context, the prepositional phrase indicates power welling up from the fountain of life, rather than a portion of a whole.

patterns.name: Fixed expression Out of curiosity
patterns.context: A sentence-opening idiom meaning that a question is asked out of curiosity.

5_1359.description: 主要响应“Out of”结构，尤其是引出整体并说明其中一部分的用法；也响应 out of the blue、out of the spring、out of curiosity 等不同固定或文学表达。

patterns.name: Out of + 数量/整体 + 子集
patterns.trigger: «Out»…« of»… 后接定指整体或数量，如“Out of the 260 episodes”“Out of all the cookies”“Out of these compounds”
patterns.context: “Out of”引出某个整体或总量，后续通常说明其中一部分、案例或成员；激活集中在 Out、of 及其后的限定词
patterns.domain: 百科、博客、新闻讨论、科研文本等多种文体

patterns.name: Out of the blue 固定表达
patterns.context: 表示某事突然发生；短语前有关于微软收购雅虎的讨论

patterns.name: Out of the spring 固定表达
patterns.trigger: “Out of the spring of their life”
patterns.context: 文学性语境中，介词短语表示力量从生命之泉涌出，并非“整体中的一部分”

patterns.name: Out of curiosity 固定表达
patterns.context: 句首惯用语，表示出于好奇而提问

en.description: Strongly responds to “out of” and its following constituents: primarily expressions denoting a portion of a whole, but also “out of curiosity,” “out of the blue,” “out of control,” and different uses such as the title “Out of the Past.”

patterns.name: “out of” proportion/portion of a whole
patterns.context: In statistical, proportional, or set expressions, identifies a portion within a whole, as in “Out of the 260 episodes,” “Out of all the cookies,” and “Out of them.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, lifestyle articles, forum discussions, and social issues

patterns.name: Idiomatic phrase “out of curiosity”
patterns.context: Introduces a subsequent question or inquiry, motivated by curiosity.

patterns.name: Idiomatic phrase “out of the blue”
patterns.context: Paired with “suddenly,” it means that something happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

patterns.name: State phrase “out of control”
patterns.context: Describes behavior as out of control and modifies the behaviors listed afterward.

patterns.name: “Out of the Past” in a work title
patterns.context: Appears as part of a song title in a track and creator information list.

5_1359.description: 强烈响应“out of”及其后续成分：主要是表示总体中部分的表达，也覆盖“out of curiosity”“out of the blue”“out of control”及标题“Out of the Past”等不同用法。

patterns.name: “out of”比例/总体中的部分
patterns.trigger: « Out»« of»«10» 或 «Out»« of»«9»，后接 «the»、«all»、«them» 等
patterns.context: 在统计、比例或集合表达中，说明某个总体里的一部分；如“Out of the 260 episodes”“Out of all the cookies”“Out of them”。
patterns.domain: 百科、生活类文章、论坛讨论及社会议题

patterns.name: “out of curiosity”惯用短语
patterns.context: 以“出于好奇”为由引出后续询问或调查。

patterns.name: “out of the blue”惯用短语
patterns.context: 与“suddenly”搭配，表示某事突然、出乎意料地发生。

patterns.name: “out of control”状态短语
patterns.context: 描述行为失控，修饰后续所列举的行为。

patterns.name: 作品标题中的“Out of the Past”
patterns.context: 作为歌曲标题的一部分，出现在曲目及创作者信息列表中。

en.description: Primarily responds to “out of” introducing quantities, sets, and portions within them, at the beginning or middle of a sentence; it also responds to the fixed idiom “out of the blue.” One segment activates on “death from a heart attack,” which does not match the main pattern.

patterns.name: “out of + quantity” proportion or portion
patterns.context: «out» and «of» occur together, followed by a portion, proportion, or member of a total; this often appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic texts, news, legal texts, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Idiom “out of the blue”
patterns.context: The fixed phrase out of the blue means suddenly and unexpectedly; it does not denote taking something from a set.
patterns.domain: Online comments and informal news discussions

patterns.name: Heart-attack-related death phrase
patterns.context: Describes the cause of someone’s death; activation falls on the local words death, from, and a, and does not fit the primary out of pattern.

5_1359.description: 主要响应句首或句中“out of”引出的数量、集合及其部分；也响应固定习语“out of the blue”。另有一段激活于“death from a heart attack”，与主模式不符。

patterns.name: “out of + 数量”比例或部分
patterns.trigger: «Out»/«out» + of + 数量或集合名词，如 «Out»« of»«10» the 260 episodes、«out»« of»«9»« the»«5 20 subjects»、«out»« of»«9»« them»
patterns.context: «out» 与 «of» 连用，随后指出某个总量中的部分、比例或成员；常出现在句首或分句开头。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术、新闻、法律及一般说明文

patterns.name: “out of the blue”习语
patterns.context: 固定短语 out of the blue，表示突然、出乎意料；此处不是表示从某个集合中取出。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、口语化新闻讨论

patterns.name: 心脏病相关死亡短语
patterns.context: 描述某人的死亡原因；激活落在 death、from、a 等局部词上，不符合主要的 out of 模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to “out of the” and “out of” structures, covering quantities, sets, sources, emission, and loss of control; sporadic nearby activations on general of, under, to, down/in, etc. cannot all be assigned to the same phrase pattern.

patterns.name: “out of the” phrases
patterns.context: A fixed prepositional phrase, often followed by a quantity, set, or source noun; can mean “among” or “from”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news commentary, cooking articles, legal texts, and literary narratives

patterns.name: Other “out of” collocations
patterns.context: The phrase out of occurs contiguously, but is not followed by the; the examples respectively indicate source/output or a state of loss of control.

patterns.name: Nearby collocation “down in flames”
patterns.context: Describes an aircraft being shot down and crashing in flames; activation falls on down and in, not out of.

patterns.name: “eru… explode out of the ground”
patterns.context: “out of the ground” indicates emerging from the ground; the same segment also contains the segmented “eruptions”, whose status as an independent trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: “under GRUDGE” and following phrases
patterns.context: Describes project affiliation and planned publications; in addition to out of, under and to are also marked.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on the preposition of
patterns.context: Activates in common prepositional structures with of, but the segment does not contain the full “out of the” sequence; this may reflect broad collocation or accidental co-occurrence.

5_1359.description: 主要响应“out of the”及“out of”结构，覆盖数量、集合、来源、喷出和失控等用法；另见一般 of、under、to、down/in 等零散邻近激活，无法完全归为同一短语模式。

patterns.name: “out of the”短语
patterns.context: 固定介词短语，常接数量、集合或来源名词；可表示“在……之中／从……中”。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻评论、烹饪文章、法律及文学叙述

patterns.name: “out of”其他搭配
patterns.trigger: «out» «of»，后接具体名词或短语，如“out of GRUDGE”“out of control”
patterns.context: 短语中 out of 连续出现，但后续成分不是 the；分别表示来源/产出或失控状态。

patterns.name: “down in flames”邻近搭配
patterns.context: 描述飞机被击落后燃烧坠落；激活落在 down 与 in，而非 out of。

patterns.name: “eru… explode out of the ground”
patterns.context: “out of the ground”表示从地面喷出；另有同段被拆分标记的“eruptions”，不能确定其是否独立触发。

patterns.name: “under GRUDGE”及后续短语
patterns.context: 描述项目隶属关系与计划出版内容；除 out of 外，under、to 也被标记。

patterns.name: 介词 of 的零散激活
patterns.trigger: «of»，如“invitation «of» Marguerite Doane”“daughter «of» hymn writer William Doane”“one «of» which”
patterns.context: 在常见 of 介词结构中激活，但所在片段并未出现完整“out of the”序列；可能反映宽泛搭配或偶然共现。

en.description: Primarily activates on the “out of” structure and its following constituents: a common use is to identify a portion of a total or whole; it also covers the fixed collocation “out of the blue” and the proportional expression “out of 100.”

patterns.name: Out of quantity: a portion of a whole
patterns.context: A group, total, or whole is given first, followed by “out of,” which introduces a portion, proportion, or specific member; it may be followed by a pronoun or category.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, social issues, research, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Fixed collocation out of the blue
patterns.context: “out of the blue” means suddenly and unexpectedly; it does not mean selecting something from a set.

patterns.name: out of 100 expressing a proportion
patterns.context: “out of 100” forms a quantity proportion, indicating that 99 out of 100 publishers rejected the submission.

5_1359.description: 主要对“out of”结构及其后的成分激活：常见用法是从总量或整体中指出部分；也覆盖固定搭配“out of the blue”和比例表达“out of 100”。

patterns.name: Out of 数量：总体中的部分
patterns.trigger: «Out» / Out« of» + 数词或限定词，如“« Out»2« of»10« this»”“Out« of»9« the»5 20 subjects”
patterns.context: 先给出一组、总数或整体，随后用“out of”引出其中的部分、比例或具体成员；有时后接代词或类别。
patterns.domain: 百科、社会议题、科研与日常说明文

patterns.name: out of the blue 固定搭配
patterns.context: “out of the blue”表示突然、出乎意料；不是从某个集合中选取。

patterns.name: out of 100 表示比例
patterns.context: “out of 100”构成数量比例，表示一百家出版商中有九十九家拒稿。

en.concept: out of phrases and their semantic uses
en.description: Primarily responds to out of phrases, especially those introducing quantities, wholes, or sources; also occurs in fixed expressions indicating motive, loss of control, or sudden occurrence. A few nearby word activations lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: “out of” quantity, proportion, or part of a whole
patterns.context: The phrase out of introduces a source, whole, or denominator, followed by a quantity, an entity in the whole, or a pronoun; it can also be used to express a proportion.
patterns.domain: Ordinary narration or argument in encyclopedias, news, forums, blogs, and legal texts

patterns.name: “out of” indicating cause or motive
patterns.context: out of is followed by an abstract noun, indicating the respect or motive behind an action.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “out of control”
patterns.context: out of and control form a fixed expression describing behavior becoming uncontrollable.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “out of the blue”
patterns.context: out of the blue means that something happens suddenly or unexpectedly.

patterns.name: Other activations in nearby structures
patterns.context: These activations do not form the same local phrase pattern as out of and may involve other contextual features or accidental co-occurrence.

5_1359.concept: out of 短语及其语义用法
5_1359.description: 主要响应 out of 短语，尤其是引出数量、整体或来源；也出现在表示动机、失控、突然发生的固定表达中。少数邻近词激活缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: “out of”数量、比例或整体中的一部分
patterns.trigger: «Out»/«out»« of»9/10 后接数量、指示词或代词，如 “«Out»2« of»10« this»3 meeting”、“«Out»1« of»10« the»6 260 episodes”、“«out»2« of»9« them»2”、“99 «out»« of»9 100”
patterns.context: 短语 out of 引出来源、整体或分母，后接数量、整体中的实体，或代词；也可用于比例表达。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、论坛、博客与法律文本中的普通叙述或论证

patterns.name: “out of”表示原因或动机
patterns.trigger: “postponed «out»1« of»9 respect for the victims”、“«out»1« of»9 deference”
patterns.context: out of 后接抽象名词，说明行为所出于的尊重或动机。

patterns.name: “out of control”固定搭配
patterns.context: out of 与 control 构成固定表达，描述行为失控。
patterns.domain: 法律／社会服务案件叙述

patterns.name: “out of the blue”固定搭配
patterns.context: out of the blue 表示事情突然、出乎意料地发生。

patterns.name: 其他出现在邻近结构中的激活
patterns.context: 这些激活未构成与 out of 相同的局部短语模式，可能涉及其他上下文特征或偶然共现。

en.description: Primarily activates on word-initial Ser subwords across various medical terms, proper names, and identifiers, with no common semantics apparent; additional sporadic activations occur on can, imaging, Martin-Rieux, and Hip.

patterns.name: Ser-initial fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on tokenized items beginning with Ser; continuations form different words or names such as Serine, Serodiagnosis, Serum, Serotonin, Ser608, and Serigne, which do not all share a meaning.
patterns.domain: Biomedical terminology, proper names, and Wikipedia text

patterns.name: Ser at a word boundary
patterns.context: Serine is part of a protein kinase category name, with Ser at the beginning of the word.

patterns.name: Other activations in non-Ser words
patterns.context: Activations occur separately on the function word can, the medical term imaging, the proper name Martin-Rieux, and Hip split across a line break; these do not clearly match the Ser-initial pattern.

5_1468.concept: 词首 Ser 子词
5_1468.description: 主要在词首 Ser 子词激活，覆盖多种医学词、专名及编号，未见统一语义；另有 can、imaging、Martin-Rieux、Hip 等零散激活。

patterns.name: Ser-词首片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Ser 开头的切分 token；后续拼成 Serine、Serodiagnosis、Serum、Serotonin、Ser608、Serigne 等不同词或名称，并非都共享词义
patterns.domain: 生物医学术语、专名及 Wikipedia 文本

patterns.name: 成词边界中的 Ser
patterns.context: Serine 是蛋白激酶类别名称的一部分，Ser 位于词首

patterns.name: 非 Ser 词中的其他激活
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在功能词 can、医学术语 imaging、专名 Martin-Rieux，以及换行后被拆分的 Hip；不与 Ser 词首模式明显吻合

en.description: Activation is dominated by the capitalized word-initial fragment “Ser” across various biomedical terms and one person’s name; there are also isolated triggers such as imaging, can, and Martin, appearing in medical, patent, and encyclopedia texts, respectively.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment “Ser”
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on word-initial fragments spelled Ser in words starting with capital S; subsequent meanings and parts of speech vary widely
patterns.domain: Mainly PubMed/NIH biomedical texts; also Wikipedia person names

patterns.name: Words beginning with “im”
patterns.context: Triggered by imaging in the medical abstract context “The role of … in early hip OA”

patterns.name: Modal verb can
patterns.context: Patent background text describing digital assistants’ ability to provide functions and make it easier for users to interact with devices

patterns.name: Proper name Martin-
patterns.context: Appears in the repeated string “Any-Martin-Rieux”

5_1468.concept: 大写词首/子词片段检测
5_1468.description: 激活以大写词首片段“Ser”为主，跨多种生物医学词及一个人名；另有 imaging、can 和 Martin 等孤立触发，分别见于医学、专利和百科文本。

patterns.name: 词首片段“Ser”
patterns.context: 激活集中在以大写 S 开头、拼写片段为 Ser 的词首；后续词义和词类差别很大
patterns.domain: 主要为 PubMed/NIH 生物医学文本，也见 Wikipedia 人名

patterns.name: 以“im”开头的词
patterns.context: 在“The role of … in early hip OA”这一医学摘要语境中，触发于 imaging

patterns.name: 情态词 can
patterns.context: 描述数字助理能够提供功能、让用户更容易与设备交互的专利背景文本

patterns.name: 专名 Martin-
patterns.context: 出现在重复的“Any-Martin-Rieux”字符串中

en.description: Most passages activate on the word-initial substring Ser, spanning various medical terms and proper names; isolated triggers such as imaging, Martin, and can show no shared context.

patterns.name: Word fragments beginning with Ser-
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on words or word-initial substrings beginning with the letter string Ser; various letter sequences may follow.
patterns.domain: Mainly PubMed medical abstracts; also NIH project texts and Wikipedia

patterns.name: Other medical terms or title words
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a medical research study without a Ser prefix; this word receives the strongest activation in the passage.

patterns.name: Martin-Rieux name
patterns.context: Appears in the hyphenated proper name “Any-Martin-Rieux” and activates again when repeated.

patterns.name: Functional description word
patterns.context: The modal verb can activates repeatedly in a sentence describing digital assistant capabilities.

5_1468.concept: 词首 Ser 字符串检测
5_1468.description: 多数段落在词首 Ser 子串处激活，覆盖多种医学术语和专名；另有 imaging、Martin、can 等孤立触发，未显示共同上下文。

patterns.name: Ser-开头的词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以字母串 Ser 开始的词或词首子串；后续可接多个不同字母序列。
patterns.domain: 主要为 PubMed 医学摘要，也见 NIH 项目文本和 Wikipedia

patterns.name: 其他医学术语或标题词
patterns.context: 在医学研究标题中出现，未见 Ser 前缀；该词获得本段最强激活。

patterns.name: Martin-Rieux 名称
patterns.context: 出现在带连字符的专名“Any-Martin-Rieux”中，并在重复出现时再次激活。

patterns.name: 功能性描述词
patterns.context: 在描述数字助理能力的句子中，情态动词 can 重复激活。

en.description: The main pattern is activation on the word-initial subword token “Ser,” spanning various medical terms, variant sequences, and personal names; two isolated patterns also occur on “can” in a patent sentence and “imaging” in a medical title.

patterns.name: Ser-initial subword tokens
patterns.context: Activations concentrate at the beginnings of words or fragments starting with Ser; the continuations vary widely, including complete medical terms, personal names, and digit sequences.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles, abstracts, and database text, as well as Wikipedia biographical entries

patterns.name: Modal verb can
patterns.context: Appears after the sentence subject “Digital assistants,” expressing ability; provide and other words in the same sentence are also marked, but can has the peak activation.

patterns.name: imaging
patterns.context: Appears in the title “The role of imaging in early hip OA” as a noun naming the research topic.

5_1468.concept: 词首 Ser 子词元
5_1468.description: 主要模式是词首子词元“Ser”激活，涵盖多种医学术语、变体序列和人名；另有专利句中的“can”及医学标题中的“imaging”两个孤立模式。

patterns.name: Ser-词首子词元
patterns.trigger: 词首 «Ser»10，后续分别接 «ine»（Serine）、«odiagnosis»（Serodiagnosis）、«um»（Serum）、«608»（编号/变体序列）、«oton»（Serotonergic/Serotonin）、«igne»（人名）、«hi»（人名）
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Ser 开头的词或词片段起始处；后续词形差异很大，既有完整医学词汇，也有人名及数字序列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题、摘要与数据库文本，以及维基百科人名条目

patterns.name: 情态动词 can
patterns.context: 出现在句子主语“Digital assistants”之后，表示能力；同一句中还标记 provide 等词，但峰值为 can。

patterns.name: imaging
patterns.context: 出现在“The role of imaging in early hip OA”标题中，作为研究主题名词。

en.concept: Word-initial fragment “Ser” and a few formatting words
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to “Ser” at the start of words or proper names, with varied subsequent spelling, commonly in biomedical vocabulary; also responds weakly to the split state name Connecticut and the webpage section “Event Details.”

patterns.name: Serium string beginnings
patterns.context: Activation falls on initial segments of words or strings split into multiple tokens; subsequent spelling is not fixed and may include “Serine,” “Serodiagnosis,” “Serum-free,” “Ser608Leu,” “Serotonergic,” and “Serotonin.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research texts; also proper names and general web text

patterns.name: Ser in personal names
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of personal names or similar proper names; paragraph 7 also has a subsequent standalone «Ser», and paragraph 8 has a subsequent «Serhi».

patterns.name: Connecticut in legal citations
patterns.context: The state name “CONNECTICUT” is split into multiple tokens and appears in uppercase in a case citation.

patterns.name: Event Details in webpage titles
patterns.context: Appears as a standalone section or link text between a webpage title and promotional copy.

5_1468.concept: 词首片段“Ser”及少量格式词
5_1468.description: 主要对词首或专名首部的“Ser”强烈响应，后续拼写多样，常见于生物医学词汇；另对 Connecticut 的拆分州名及网页栏目“Event Details”有较弱响应。

patterns.name: Serium 字符串开头
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分为多个 token 的词或字符串首段；后续拼写并不固定，可能是 “Serine”“Serodiagnosis”“Serum-free”“Ser608Leu”“Serotonergic”“Serotonin” 等。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研文本；也见于专名和一般网页文本

patterns.name: 人名中的 Ser
patterns.trigger: «Ser»，随后为姓名拼写片段，如 «igne»、«Abd» 或 «hi»
patterns.context: 出现在人名或类似专名的开头；第 7 段还有后续独立的 «Ser»，第 8 段也有后续 «Serhi»。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 Connecticut
patterns.context: 州名 “CONNECTICUT” 被拆成多个 token，位于判例引文中的全大写州名。

patterns.name: 网页标题中的 Event Details
patterns.context: 出现在网页标题与宣传文案之间的独立栏目或链接文字中。

en.description: The strongest activations repeatedly fall on “courts” in legal texts; other strong activations are scattered across mathematical solutions, Aristotle, micellar solutions, and operator theory, and cannot be fully explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “courts” in courts and legal proceedings
patterns.context: Legal texts mention courts, often near adjudication, legal rules, review, or litigation procedures; also appears in informal texts discussing court rulings.
patterns.domain: Case law, legal proceedings, and legal commentary

patterns.name: “yield/solutions” denoting results in mathematical or scientific texts
patterns.context: Computational or theoretical derivations discuss a system producing correct solutions; “solutions” also describes experimental subjects in a scientific paper, but is not marked as a strong activation.

patterns.name: “Aristotle” in philosophical texts
patterns.context: Activates when discussing Aristotle and his work Metaphysics.

patterns.name: “solutions” in solution chemistry
patterns.context: Describes solutions containing surfactant micelles and compares their relaxation times.

patterns.name: “solutions” in operator theory
patterns.context: A theoretical paper discusses operator properties and their solutions; “solutions” refers to solutions of equations or operator problems.

5_1468.concept: 法律文本中的法院
5_1468.description: 最强触发反复落在法律文本的“courts”；其余强触发分散于数学解、亚里士多德、胶束溶液和算子理论，无法由单一语义模式完整解释。

patterns.name: 法院及法定程序中的“courts”
patterns.context: 法律文本中提及法院，常与裁判、法律规则、审查或诉讼程序相邻；也见于讨论法院裁决的非正式文本。
patterns.domain: 判例、法律程序及法律评论

patterns.name: 数学或科学文本中表示结果的“yield/solutions”
patterns.context: 计算或理论推导中谈到系统产生正确解；另有科学论文中“solutions”描述实验对象，但未标记为强触发。

patterns.name: 哲学文本中的“Aristotle”
patterns.context: 讨论亚里士多德及其著作《形而上学》时触发。

patterns.name: 溶液中的“solutions”
patterns.context: 描述表面活性剂胶束所在的溶液，并比较其弛豫时间。

patterns.name: 算子理论中的“solutions”
patterns.context: 理论论文讨论算子性质及其解；“solutions”指方程或算子问题的解。

en.concept: Various proper names and structured text fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed: particularly responsive to Aristotle in philosophical texts; also responds to HTML/XML markup, mathematical and physical formulas, Wikipedia links, legal case titles, and wording about criminal evidence collection.

patterns.name: Aristotle
patterns.context: Aristotle appears by name in philosophical discussion, sometimes alongside Hume or Pascal.

patterns.name: HTML/XML markup
patterns.context: Doctype and HTML/XHTML markup, including namespace and DTD declarations.

patterns.name: Mathematical operators and formula structure
patterns.context: Summation, partial-derivative operators, and real coefficients appear in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Physics formulas
patterns.context: Formulas containing integrals, cross sections, and dark-matter-related symbols.

patterns.name: Wikipedia links
patterns.context: Wikipedia links pasted in Markdown format in HackerNews posts, linking to submarine or psychology entries.

patterns.name: New York case titles
patterns.context: Case titles list the state, defendant, and litigants, using a court-record format.

patterns.name: Criminal precedents and evidence collection
patterns.context: Cites precedents and discusses collecting breath samples.

5_1468.concept: 多种专名与结构化文本片段
5_1468.description: 激活模式分散：哲学文本中特别响应 Aristotle；另对 HTML/XML 标记、数学与物理公式、维基百科链接，以及法律案件标题和刑事证据措辞有反应。

patterns.name: Aristotle
patterns.context: Aristotle appears by name in philosophical discussion, sometimes alongside Hume or Pascal.

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记
patterns.context: Doctype and HTML/XHTML markup, including namespace and DTD declarations.

patterns.name: 数学算子与公式结构
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现求和、偏导算子及实数系数。

patterns.name: 物理学公式
patterns.context: 包含积分、截面及暗物质相关符号的公式。

patterns.name: 维基百科链接
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子中以 Markdown 格式贴出的维基百科链接，链接到潜艇或心理学条目。

patterns.name: 纽约州案件标题
patterns.context: 案件标题列出州、被告及诉讼双方，含法庭记录格式。

patterns.name: 刑事判例与证据采集
patterns.context: 援引判例，讨论采集呼吸样本。

en.concept: Proper names and structured terminology in technical texts
en.description: Activations occur across various technical texts: HTML/CSS class names and styles, I/O system terminology, scientists in research contexts, drug court statistics, cell experiment titles, Seyfert galaxies, email recipient names, and C++ template implementation symbols.

patterns.name: Markers or attribute values in HTML/CSS code
patterns.context: In HTML/CSS snippets, neuron-response class names, attribute values, and adjacent punctuation; background image paths and style declarations are especially salient.

patterns.name: I/O and system switching in technical text
patterns.context: Describes an application process waiting for I/O, another process handling a request, and the operating system switching context.

patterns.name: Scientist identity terms in academic passages
patterns.context: In research projects or academic discussions, scientists refers to researchers; contexts include career stages, researcher groups, or training objectives.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, materials science discussions

patterns.name: Juvenile drug court statistics
patterns.context: Discusses the history, number, and development of juvenile drug courts.

patterns.name: Experimental methods section headings and cell experiment terminology
patterns.context: Cell culture or transfection methods passages, including experiment subheadings, separator lines, and biomedical terminology.

patterns.name: Galaxy names in astrophysics
patterns.context: Activates on the galaxy class name Seyfert when discussing AGN, the iron Kα line, and galaxy observations.

patterns.name: Recipient names in email headers
patterns.context: Enron email headers with date, time, sender, or recipient fields; strong activations fall on recipient names.

patterns.name: Tuple implementation symbols generated by the C++ compiler
patterns.context: Implementation symbols in C++ template instantiations or compiler error output, alongside lambda expressions, hexadecimal values, and template parameters.

5_1468.concept: 技术文本中的专名与结构化术语
5_1468.description: 激活分布于多种技术文本：HTML/CSS 类名与样式、I/O 系统术语、科研语境中的 scientists、药物法院统计、细胞实验标题、Seyfert 星系、邮件收件人姓名及 C++ 模板实现符号。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 代码中的标记或属性值
patterns.context: HTML/CSS 片段中，神经元响应类名、属性值及相邻标点；背景图片路径和样式声明尤为明显。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 I/O 与系统切换
patterns.context: 描述应用进程等待 I/O、另一进程处理请求及操作系统切换上下文。

patterns.name: 学术段落中的科学家身份词
patterns.context: 科研项目或学术讨论中，scientists 指研究人员；包括职业阶段、研究者群体或培养目标等语境。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、材料科学讨论

patterns.name: 青少年药物法院统计
patterns.context: 讨论青少年药物法院的历史、数量和发展。

patterns.name: 实验方法章节标题及细胞实验术语
patterns.context: 细胞培养或转染方法段落，包含实验小标题、分隔线和生物医学术语。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 天体物理中的星系名称
patterns.context: 讨论 AGN、铁 Kα 线及星系观测时，触发星系类别名称 Seyfert。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的收件人姓名
patterns.context: 带日期、时间、发件人或收件人字段的 Enron 邮件头；强激活落在收件人姓名上。

patterns.name: C++ 编译器生成的元组实现符号
patterns.context: C++ 模板实例化或编译器错误输出中的实现符号，伴随 lambda、十六进制值及模板参数。

en.concept: Text line boundaries and formatting structure
en.description: Activations commonly occur at line endings and formatting boundaries such as line breaks and indentation; the corpus spans legal decisions, CSS/JavaScript, configuration code, and license declarations. Content words vary, while formatting boundaries are the shared clue.

patterns.name: Newline characters and adjacent whitespace
patterns.context: The newline itself or indentation after a line break in code and legal documents; recurs across multiple passages and is often the strongest activation token.
patterns.domain: Formatting and text layout across domains

patterns.name: Formatting fragments in legal decisions
patterns.context: Formatted positions such as case titles, background paragraphs, citations, and paragraph numbering in decisions.

patterns.name: CSS declarations and selectors
patterns.context: Declaration endings or selector lines in stylesheets, where punctuation and line breaks form formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Output comments after JavaScript line breaks
patterns.context: Near the end of code statements, output results, or the start of comments, with activations concentrated around line breaks.

patterns.name: Configuration array entries and keys
patterns.context: Array mapping entries in configuration or program code, separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: Software licenses and copyright notices
patterns.context: Source file headers or license clauses, especially at declaration line endings, line breaks, and continued clauses.

5_1468.concept: 文本行边界与格式结构
5_1468.description: 激活广泛出现在行末和换行、缩进等排版边界；语料横跨法律判决、CSS/JavaScript、配置代码及许可证声明。各类内容词并不统一，格式边界是共同线索。

patterns.name: 换行符及其相邻空白
patterns.context: 换行符本身或换行后代码、法律文书中的缩进位置；在多段中反复出现，常是最强激活 token
patterns.domain: 跨领域的排版与文本格式

patterns.name: 法律判决书的格式片段
patterns.context: 判决书的案件标题、背景段、引注和段落编号等格式化位置

patterns.name: CSS声明与选择器
patterns.context: 样式表中声明结束或选择器行，标点与换行构成格式边界

patterns.name: JavaScript换行后的输出注释
patterns.context: 代码语句结束、输出结果或注释开始附近，激活集中在换行前后

patterns.name: 配置数组条目与键名
patterns.context: 配置或程序代码中，数组映射条目以换行分隔

patterns.name: 软件许可证与版权声明
patterns.context: 源代码文件头或许可证条款，特别是声明行结束、换行及条款续行处

en.description: Activations are scattered: way and expressions of routes, intervals, or relations appear in multiple passages; other activations cover fraction code, button attributes, mathematical/physical symbols, graph theory definitions, holster descriptions, and album entries, with no common trigger pattern apparent.

patterns.name: way
