patterns.context: In phrases such as “the way between… / all the way to… / on the way to…,” or with to, between, and similar words following way; the highlighted token is sometimes way itself and sometimes a nearby function word.

patterns.name: Fraction or ratio
patterns.context: fraction indicates a proportional position between two points; in code macros it appears as part of an identifier, with from and to also occurring in the same passage.

patterns.name: Button selectors and size attributes
patterns.context: JavaScript queries a button and reads its clientHeight; activation falls on button and adjacent code tokens.

patterns.name: Mathematical subscripts and coordinate expressions
patterns.context: Multivariable/coordinate index expressions in formulas, with markers distributed across mathematical symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Field and state symbols in physics formulas
patterns.context: Vector position, time, potential terms, and wavefunction symbols in aligned formulas; activations are distributed across LaTeX commands and punctuation.

patterns.name: Graph-theoretic description of edge betweenness
patterns.context: Defines an edge’s contribution to shortest paths between pairs of vertices, focusing on graph theory terminology and relational expressions.

patterns.name: Holster position and orientation
patterns.context: Describes a shoulder holster and pistol placement, followed by a list of three orientations.

patterns.name: People, albums, and song titles
patterns.context: Names, labels/media, and work titles in discography entries; activations are scattered with no clear shared trigger word.

patterns.name: Routes and data for transport infrastructure
patterns.context: A cable car passes steel towers on its way to a terminus, alongside route details and basic data such as distance and vertical drop.

5_1468.concept: way及关系表达（宽泛）
5_1468.description: 激活较分散：多段出现way及路线、区间或关系表达；另覆盖分数代码、按钮属性、数学/物理符号、图论定义、枪套描述和唱片条目，未见统一触发模式。

patterns.name: way
patterns.context: 在短语“the way between… / all the way to… / on the way to…”中，或way后接to、between等；被强调的token有时是way本身，有时是邻近的功能词
patterns.domain: 网页问答、百科、学术文本

patterns.name: 分数或比例
patterns.context: fraction表示两点间的比例位置；代码宏中作为标识符的一部分，且同段还出现from、to

patterns.name: 按钮选择器与尺寸属性
patterns.context: JavaScript中查询按钮并读取其clientHeight，激活落在button及相邻代码token上

patterns.name: 数学下标与坐标表达式
patterns.trigger: x_{1}, y_{1}及其相邻的下标、逗号和括号
patterns.context: 公式中的多变量/坐标索引表达式，标记分散在数学符号及数字上

patterns.name: 物理公式中的场与态符号
patterns.context: 对齐公式中的矢量位置、时间、势项和波函数符号，激活分布于LaTeX命令及标点

patterns.name: 图论边介数叙述
patterns.context: 定义边在顶点对之间最短路径上的贡献，关注图论术语及关系表达

patterns.name: 枪套位置与方位
patterns.context: 描述肩部枪套及手枪放置方式，随后列举三种方位

patterns.name: 人名、唱片与歌曲标题
patterns.context: 唱片目录条目中的人名、厂牌/介质与作品名；激活分散且无明显共同触发词

patterns.name: 交通设施路线与数据
patterns.context: 缆车经过钢塔前往终点，伴随路线及距离、垂直落差等基本数据

en.description: Activations are distributed across local regions of heterogeneous specialist texts: paper affiliation addresses, chemical oxidation states, and narratives about opera history and camp emails; various mathematical and physics formulas also appear. Some share proper names, punctuation, LaTeX markup, or local word forms, but no specific semantic pattern accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Institutional addresses and author affiliations
patterns.context: Paper author affiliations or institutional addresses; often accompanied by LaTeX superscript numbers, commas, and line breaks.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata; some academic text

patterns.name: Chemical elements and coordination chemistry notation
patterns.context: Element symbols, oxidation states, and NMR coordination shifts occur together.

patterns.name: Dates and hurried revisions in opera narratives
patterns.context: Recounts an opera premiere date and the hurried revisions made because a replacement singer was absent.

patterns.name: Camp pickup and transport arrangements
patterns.context: Describes morning childcare, camp staff, and bus pickup; includes possessive or first-person expressions addressed to the recipient.

patterns.name: Mathematical physics integral formulas
patterns.context: Formula derivation following the Schwinger–Dyson equation, including integral limits and LaTeX math notation.

patterns.name: Matrix/tensor formula notation
patterns.context: Pairs of subscripted and superscripted symbols appear in aligned formula lines.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical or theoretical physics formulas

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions with coordinate parameters
patterns.context: Parameterized formulas consisting of variables, indices, and ± signs.

patterns.name: Time direction and path-ordering operator in gauge field theory
patterns.context: A LaTeX formula introduces the path-ordering operator and an exponential integral containing field variables.

5_1468.concept: 异质文本局部特征
5_1468.description: 激活分布于异质的专业文本局部：论文署名地址、化学氧化态，以及歌剧史和营地邮件叙述；另有多种数学物理公式。部分共同伴随专名、标点、LaTeX 标记或局部词形，但未见能覆盖所有段落的具体语义模式。

patterns.name: 机构地址与作者单位
patterns.trigger: «School», «University», «Academy», «Laboratory», «Institute», 以及城市、邮编和国家名称
patterns.context: 论文作者署名或单位地址；常伴随 LaTeX 上标编号、逗号和换行
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据；个别段落为学术文本

patterns.name: 化学元素与配位化学记号
patterns.context: 元素符号、氧化态及核磁共振配位位移并列出现

patterns.name: 歌剧叙述中的时间与匆忙修改
patterns.context: 叙述歌剧首演日期及因替补歌手缺席而匆忙修订的经过

patterns.name: 营地接送与交通安排
patterns.context: 描述早晨托管儿童、营地工作人员及巴士接送；有面向收件人的所有格或第一人称表达

patterns.name: 数学物理积分公式
patterns.context: Schwinger–Dyson 方程后的公式推导，包含积分上下限和 LaTeX 数学记号

patterns.name: 矩阵／张量公式记号
patterns.context: 成对的带下标上标符号出现在对齐的公式行中
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或理论物理公式

patterns.name: 带坐标参数的数学表达式
patterns.context: 变量、索引及 ± 号组成的参数化公式

patterns.name: 规范场论中的时间方向与路径序算符
patterns.context: LaTeX 公式引出路径序算符及含场变量的指数积分

en.description: Responds to mathematical formulas and LaTeX commands in ArXiv papers, as well as title-page author names, affiliations, addresses, and other author information formatting; covers both theoretical formulas and academic metadata contexts.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula structures
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas, definitions, derivations, or equations in the paper body; activation falls on commands, symbols, and some variables.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical research

patterns.name: Author names and affiliation formatting
patterns.context: Conditioned on an author block on the paper title page or in the author list, composed of line breaks, names, departments, universities, labs, and addresses.
patterns.domain: Academic paper metadata and author addresses

patterns.name: Multilingual academic names
patterns.context: Names appear in paper author lists or HTML-formatted author information; this may differ from the formula pattern.

5_1468.concept: ArXiv论文排版标记
5_1468.description: 响应 ArXiv 论文中的数学公式与 LaTeX 命令，也响应标题页作者姓名、机构、地址等署名排版；覆盖理论公式和学术元数据两类上下文。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文的数学公式、定义、推导或方程中，激活落在命令、符号及部分变量上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论研究

patterns.name: 作者姓名与机构署名排版
patterns.trigger: 如“Li”“Yang”“Dibyendu Nandy”“Department of”“Institute of Science”“Harvard Medical School”“Gordon McKay Laboratory”，以及“\”后的署名换行和地址
patterns.context: 论文标题页或作者列表中，以换行、姓名、院系、学校、实验室和地址组成的署名块为条件。
patterns.domain: 学术论文元数据与作者地址

patterns.name: 多语言学术姓名
patterns.context: 姓名出现在论文作者列表或带有 HTML 格式的署名中；可与公式模式并不相同。

en.description: High activations occur primarily in complex LaTeX formulas in ArXiv papers, and also in representation theory, physics, machine learning, and fractional calculus prose; author lists and multiparticle-state title fragments also occur. There is no evidence that all formulas share a particular symbol or topic.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical relations and operators
patterns.context: Activations occur in paper excerpts containing complex formulas; the notation varies, with no common specific operator or symbol apparent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and machine learning papers

patterns.name: Representation theory and group representations
patterns.context: Discusses irreducible admissible or automorphic representations of the general linear group.

patterns.name: Field theory formulas in physics
patterns.context: Formulas contain time directions, integrals, and field variables, possibly expressing operators or evolution in a physical model.

patterns.name: Machine learning function formulation
patterns.context: Mentions machine learning applications in the context of real-valued function families and parameters.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers related to machine learning

patterns.name: Preliminaries in fractional calculus
patterns.context: A paper’s preliminaries introduce conformal fractional calculus and specify a function domain.

patterns.name: Multiparticle physics and author information
patterns.context: An author list follows the phrase; activations may also be affected by paper metadata or name formatting.

patterns.name: HTML names and author lists
patterns.context: Personal names in small-caps HTML styling, formatted as an author list.

5_1468.concept: ArXiv 学术排版
5_1468.description: 高激活主要出现在 ArXiv 论文的复杂 LaTeX 数学公式中，也见于表示论、物理、机器学习和分数阶微积分正文；另有作者名单及多粒子态标题片段。没有证据表明所有公式共享特定符号或主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学关系与算子
patterns.trigger: 公式中的 `=`, `\int`, `\exp`, `\mathcal`, `\operatorname` 等数学记号
patterns.context: 激活出现在含复杂公式的论文片段中；记号本身类型各异，未见统一的具体算子或符号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及机器学习论文

patterns.name: 表示论与群表示
patterns.context: 讨论一般线性群上的不可约可容许或自守表示。

patterns.name: 物理场论公式
patterns.context: 公式含时间方向、积分及场变量，疑似物理模型中的算符或演化表达式。

patterns.name: 机器学习函数表述
patterns.context: 以实值函数族及参数为背景，提及机器学习应用。
patterns.domain: 机器学习相关数学论文

patterns.name: 分数阶微积分预备知识
patterns.context: 论文预备章节介绍共形分数阶微积分，并给出函数定义域。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，分数阶微积分

patterns.name: 多粒子物理与作者信息
patterns.context: 短语后紧接作者名单；激活也可能受论文元数据或姓名排版影响。
patterns.domain: 物理论文及作者元数据

patterns.name: HTML 姓名与作者列表
patterns.context: HTML 小型大写样式中的人名，呈作者列表形式。

en.description: Primarily responds to structural notation in mathematical typesetting: integrals, sums, norms, subscripted variables, and indices; also responds to polynomial ring and fractional calculus terminology.

patterns.name: Definite integral expressions
patterns.context: Integral signs and their limits or integrands appear in mathematical formulas; some spans extend to upper limits, infinity, and differential symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas across physics, analysis, probability, and other texts

patterns.name: Mathematical variable subscripts and indices
patterns.context: Variables have subscripts, or text/formulas explicitly enumerate index ranges; activation falls near variables, equals signs, and index numbers

patterns.name: Summation symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A summation symbol combines with subscripts, superscripts, or function terms in a formula
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas and machine learning application papers

patterns.name: Norms and function-space notation
patterns.context: Norm symbols or function-space notation appear in formulas
patterns.domain: Functional analysis, probability, and mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: Fractional calculus terminology
patterns.context: Appears as a topic term in a paper’s background section
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper body and section titles

patterns.name: Polynomial ring notation
patterns.context: Describes a polynomial ring over a field generated by indeterminates, adjacent to variable indices

5_1468.concept: 数学公式结构记号
5_1468.description: 主要响应数学排版中的结构性记号：积分、求和、范数、带下标变量及索引；也响应多项式环和分数阶微积分术语。

patterns.name: 定积分表达式
patterns.context: 积分符号及其上下限或被积函数出现在数学公式中；有的片段激活延伸到上限、无穷和微分符号
patterns.domain: 数学公式，涵盖物理、分析及概率等文本

patterns.name: 数学变量下标与索引
patterns.context: 变量带下标，或文字/公式显式枚举索引范围；激活落在变量、等号和索引数字附近

patterns.name: 数学公式中的求和符号
patterns.context: 求和符号与下标、上标或函数项组成公式
patterns.domain: 数学公式及机器学习应用论文

patterns.name: 范数与函数空间记号
patterns.context: 范数符号或函数空间记号出现在公式中
patterns.domain: 泛函分析、概率与数学问答

patterns.name: 分数阶微积分术语
patterns.context: 作为论文预备知识部分的主题术语出现
patterns.domain: 数学论文正文及章节标题

patterns.name: 多项式环记号
patterns.context: 说明由不定元生成的域上多项式环，并邻接变量索引

en.concept: Mathematical formula markers in scientific text
en.description: The most prominent activations are parentheses, commands, integrals, and formula symbols in LaTeX mathematical text; scattered activations also include formula constraints, academic transitions, statistical indices, machine learning terminology, theoretical physics equations, and German institutional addresses, with no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Formula delimiters in mathematical environments
patterns.context: Parentheses, equals signs, backslash commands, and integral/fraction structures occur together in mathematical formulas or LaTeX fragments; many activated tokens are formula punctuation or parts of commands.
patterns.domain: Mathematical and scientific/technical literature, formula text

patterns.name: Integrals and limits of integration in formulas
patterns.context: Integral signs and their limits, variables, or integrands form formula fragments; some passages also contain infinite upper limits or differentials.
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, physics, and other quantitative sciences

patterns.name: Bold mathematical symbols and operators
patterns.context: LaTeX commands denote boldface, font, or vector symbols, often alongside formula variables and differential operators.

patterns.name: Conditions and variable constraints after mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Formula endings or nearby text list function spaces, variable ranges, parameter inequalities, and other constraints; these symbols do not all belong to one content pattern.

patterns.name: Introductory and transitional phrases in academic passages
patterns.context: Section headings or English academic expressions introducing preceding conclusions or research findings appear in prose; these differ from the surrounding formula text.

patterns.name: Statistical notation definitions and sample indices
patterns.context: Defines expression values indexed by sample i and gene j, and specifies index ranges; activations include both symbols and explanatory text.

patterns.name: Machine learning application phrasing
patterns.context: Mentions machine learning applications after a general mathematical definition or objective function; the words are prose, not formula commands.

patterns.name: Chemical and university names in institutional addresses
patterns.context: Split German institution and university names, as well as city names, appear in an address line, preceded by “address:” and a list marker.

patterns.name: Self-consistency equations and mass symbols
patterns.context: Text mentions the Schwinger-Dyson equation as a self-consistency condition, followed by a formula containing mass squared, an integral, and a cutoff parameter.

patterns.name: Residual activations with no shared theme
patterns.context: Specific symbols, word fragments, or formatting tokens in different passages activate strongly, but their semantic triggers are inconsistent and do not support a more specific shared interpretation from the excerpts alone.

5_1468.concept: 科学文本中的数学公式标记
5_1468.description: 最突出的是 LaTeX 数学文本中的括号、命令、积分和公式符号；另有公式约束、学术承接语、统计索引、机器学习用语、理论物理方程及德语机构地址等零散激活，未形成单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学环境中的公式定界符
patterns.context: 数学公式或 LaTeX 片段中，括号、等号、反斜杠命令及积分/分式结构相邻出现；许多激活 token 是公式标点或命令的一部分。
patterns.domain: 数学与科学技术文献、公式文本

patterns.name: 公式中的积分及积分上下限
patterns.context: 积分号与上下限、变量或被积函数构成公式片段；部分段落还出现无穷上限或积分微元。
patterns.domain: 数学分析、物理及其他定量科学

patterns.name: 粗体数学符号与算子
patterns.context: LaTeX 中以命令表示粗体、字体或向量等符号，常与公式变量、微分算子并列。

patterns.name: 数学公式后的条件与变量约束
patterns.context: 公式末尾或公式附近列出函数所属空间、变量范围、参数不等式等约束；并非所有此类符号都同属一种内容模式。

patterns.name: 学术段落的引导与承接语
patterns.context: 正文中出现章节标题或引出前述结论、研究结果的英语学术表达；与周围公式文本不同。

patterns.name: 统计符号定义与样本索引
patterns.context: 定义按样本 i 和基因 j 索引的表达值，并说明索引范围；触发同时包含符号与说明文字。
patterns.domain: 生物统计、基因表达分析论文

patterns.name: 机器学习应用表述
patterns.context: 一般数学定义或目标函数之后提及机器学习应用；词语本身是正文，不是公式命令。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的化学与大学名称
patterns.context: 论文地址栏中出现拆分的德语机构名、大学名及城市名，前有“address:”和列表符号。

patterns.name: 自洽方程与质量符号
patterns.context: 文字提及 Schwinger-Dyson 方程作为自洽条件，随后给出含质量平方、积分及截止参数的公式。

patterns.name: 无法归入共同主题的残余激活
patterns.context: 不同段落中的特定符号、单词片段或排版 token 虽然激活较强，但语义触发条件并不一致，无法仅凭片段建立更具体的共同解释。
patterns.domain: 跨领域论文及排版文本

en.description: High activation commonly occurs in technical texts with dense notation, especially LaTeX mathematical formulas and their academic explanations; also appears in biostatistical definitions, paper addresses, and regular-expression configurations in code.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical formulas and operators
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical or physical formulas, often alongside subscripts, superscripts, integrals, Greek letters, operators, or LaTeX markup.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, theoretical physics, and scientific papers; also mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: Academic expressions in prose
patterns.context: Academic discussion or question contexts, with explanations, definitions, results, or self-consistency conditions before or after formulas.

patterns.name: Address and affiliation information
patterns.context: Institutional affiliation information such as paper authors’ or correspondents’ addresses, including German institution names and address formats.

patterns.name: Gene expression statistical notation
patterns.context: Defines aggregate expression values indexed by samples and genes, interspersed with statistical notation and variable descriptions.

patterns.name: String regex in code
patterns.context: Regular expressions describe string syntax in syntax-highlighting or language-configuration objects.

patterns.name: Date and ordinal-suffix regex in code
patterns.context: JavaScript-style regular-expression branches for matching dates, times, or ordinal suffixes.

5_1468.concept: 专业文本中的结构化符号
5_1468.description: 高响应常见于带密集标记的专业文本：尤其是 LaTeX 数学公式及其学术说明；另见生物统计定义、论文地址，以及代码中的正则表达式配置。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学公式与算符
patterns.context: 处于数学或物理公式中，常伴随上下标、积分、希腊字母、算符或 LaTeX 标记。
patterns.domain: 数学、理论物理与科学论文；也包括数学问答

patterns.name: 正文中的学术表达
patterns.trigger: 「Before presenting our main results」「Let」「we get」「I know that the following equality」
patterns.context: 学术论述或提问语境，公式前后出现解释、定义、结果或自洽条件等表述。

patterns.name: 地址与机构信息
patterns.trigger: 「Institut für Organische Chemie」「Goethe-Universität」「Frankfurt」以及邮政编码和街道地址
patterns.context: 论文作者或通讯地址一类的机构署名信息，包含德语机构名称与地址格式。

patterns.name: 基因表达统计符号
patterns.context: 定义样本和基因索引下的表达量汇总值，穿插统计符号与变量说明。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串正则
patterns.context: 在语法高亮或语言配置对象中，用正则表达式描述字符串语法。

patterns.name: 代码中的日期与序数后缀正则
patterns.context: JavaScript 风格的正则表达式分支，用于匹配日期时间或序数后缀。

en.concept: Special symbols in mathematics and source code
en.description: Activations are concentrated in LaTeX formulas in mathematical and scientific texts, especially integrals, subscripts and superscripts, and typesetting commands; also seen in JavaScript regexes and code identifiers, Markdown headings, English function words, and statistical variable notation.

patterns.name: LaTeX integral symbols
patterns.context: Integrals appear in mathematical expressions, often with limits, differentials, or integrands; no specific mathematical topic is required
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, Q&A, and formula source code

patterns.name: LaTeX subscript, superscript, and exponent symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical notation uses subscripts and superscripts for powers, indices, or variables; often alongside formulas and integrals

patterns.name: LaTeX commands and mathematical typesetting structures
patterns.context: LaTeX formulas or paper source code; near typesetting commands for parentheses, fractions, arrows, and similar elements

patterns.name: Delimited regular-expression source code
patterns.context: JavaScript regular expressions enclosed in slashes, often containing anchors, quantifiers, groups, or alternatives

patterns.name: Common function words in English syntax
patterns.context: Words in English prose that connect clauses, introduce results, or qualify conditions; activations are scattered across different sentences

patterns.name: Mathematical variables and parameter notation
patterns.context: Latin or Greek letters denote variables, indices, or parameters in formulas; some are adjacent to subscripts or superscripts

patterns.name: Markdown heading markers
patterns.context: Bold text in Markdown headings and the equals-sign heading underline below them

patterns.name: Code identifiers and comment text
patterns.context: Property names, function syntax, and comments in JavaScript code; co-occurs with regular expressions

patterns.name: Asterisk and tilde notation in statistical expressions
patterns.context: In notation for gene expression estimates, asterisks and tildes mark mathematical variables

5_1468.concept: 数学与源码中特殊符号
5_1468.description: 激活主要分布于数学及科学文本的 LaTeX 公式，尤其积分、上下标和排版命令；另见 JavaScript 正则与代码标识符、Markdown 标题、英文功能词及统计变量标记。

patterns.name: LaTeX 积分符号
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现积分，常伴随上下限、微分或被积函数；不要求特定数学主题
patterns.domain: 数学论文、问答及公式源码

patterns.name: LaTeX 上下标与幂次符号
patterns.context: 数学记号中用上下标表示幂、指标或变量；常与公式及积分同时出现

patterns.name: LaTeX 命令及数学排版结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式或论文源码；括号、分式、箭头等排版命令附近

patterns.name: 带分隔符的正则表达式源码
patterns.context: 斜杠包围的 JavaScript 正则表达式，常含锚点、量词、分组或备选项

patterns.name: 英文句法中的常见功能词
patterns.trigger: «Before»、« presenting»、« our»、« get»、« when»、« holds»、« such that»
patterns.context: 英文叙述中连接从句、引出结果或限定条件的词语；激活分散在不同句子

patterns.name: 数学变量及参数记号
patterns.context: 公式中用拉丁或希腊字母表示变量、索引、参数，部分紧邻上下标

patterns.name: Markdown 标题标记
patterns.context: Markdown 标题的加粗文本及其下方等号式标题线

patterns.name: 代码标识符与注释文本
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中的属性名、函数语法及注释；与正则表达式并存

patterns.name: 统计表达式的星号和波浪号标记
patterns.context: 基因表达估计的符号说明中，星号与波浪号标示数学变量

en.concept: Scientific and technical document structure markers
en.description: Primarily responds to LaTeX mathematical formulas and structural notation, spanning analysis, integrals, function spaces, and physical operators; also responds to structured document fragments such as paper titles, author addresses and name formatting, and translation file header metadata.

patterns.name: Mathematical typesetting and formula structures
patterns.context: Activation falls on formulas, mathematical environments, or adjacent symbols and typesetting tokens; topics include integrals, norms, fractional calculus, differential operators, function spaces, and vector expressions
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical physics papers, mathematical Q&A; paragraphs 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: Section heading openings in paper body
patterns.context: Section headings in the paper body marked in bold, appearing before the introduction of the main results

patterns.name: Institutional and postal addresses
patterns.context: Institution names, streets, and postal codes follow author information or correspondence address fields

patterns.name: GNU gettext plural rule fields
patterns.context: Metadata and plural-form declarations in translation file headers

patterns.name: HTML small-caps formatting for author names
patterns.context: HTML span tags set author names in small caps, alongside footnotes or superscript numbers
patterns.domain: Paper author lists or author information transcribed from webpages

5_1468.concept: 科学与技术文档结构标记
5_1468.description: 主要响应 LaTeX 数学公式及其结构标记，覆盖分析、积分、函数空间和物理算子；也响应论文标题、作者地址与姓名排版，以及翻译文件头部元数据等结构化文档片段。

patterns.name: 数学排版与公式结构
patterns.context: 激活落在公式、数学环境或紧邻公式的符号和排版 token 上；主题涵盖积分、范数、分数阶演算、微分算子、函数空间与向量表达式
patterns.domain: 数学及理论物理论文、数学问答；段 1、2、3、5、8、9、10

patterns.name: 论文正文中的章节标题起始
patterns.context: 论文正文中以加粗格式标记的章节标题，且标题位于介绍主要结果之前

patterns.name: 机构地址与邮政地址
patterns.context: 作者信息或通讯地址字段之后出现机构名、街道和邮编

patterns.name: GNU gettext 复数规则字段
patterns.context: 翻译文件头部的元数据与复数形式声明
patterns.domain: GitHub 本地化/软件翻译文件

patterns.name: 作者姓名的 HTML 小型大写排版
patterns.context: HTML span 标签把作者姓名设置成 small-caps，伴随脚注或上标编号
patterns.domain: 论文作者列表或网页转录的作者信息

en.description: Activations occur mainly in symbol-dense sequences: boundaries and escape characters in code regexes, LaTeX mathematical commands, and formulas; also seen in name typesetting, address line breaks, and Shell pipeline substitutions.

patterns.name: Regular expressions and boundary syntax
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on regex syntax characters, pattern beginnings, or branch boundaries; commonly found in JavaScript regex literals or regexes built by concatenation.
patterns.domain: Github code, including syntax highlighting, date handling, Markdown parsing, and operator matching

patterns.name: LaTeX symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in inline or displayed mathematical formulas, often with subscripts, superscripts, braces, and integral expressions.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers and StackExchange mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Word and glyph boundaries in names
patterns.context: Author names are typeset with HTML small-caps styling, superscript numbers, and punctuation; activations are scattered across name spellings and boundaries.

patterns.name: Line breaks and punctuation in address fields
patterns.context: Multiline institutional mailing addresses follow field labels; line breaks and separators format the address.
patterns.domain: Institutional address information in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Command-line pipelines and regex substitution
patterns.context: A Shell script pipes display information to sed and uses a substitution pattern with anchors and groups to filter text.

patterns.name: Exponential structure in integral formulas
patterns.context: Exponential and power functions form part of an integral expression; although adjacent to the LaTeX mathematical-symbol pattern, the salient local feature is the combination of exponential terms.

patterns.name: Norms and integrals in displayed formulas
patterns.context: Formulas discussing random-variable norms or probability-distribution properties, including infinity norms and generalized integrals.

5_1468.concept: 结构化文本的符号边界
5_1468.description: 主要激活于结构密集的符号序列：代码正则表达式的边界与转义符、LaTeX 数学命令及公式；另在姓名排版、地址换行和 Shell 管道替换中出现。

patterns.name: 正则表达式及其边界语法
patterns.context: 激活集中在正则语法字符、模式开头或分支边界；常位于 JavaScript 的正则字面量或拼接生成的正则表达式中。
patterns.domain: Github 代码，语法高亮、日期处理、Markdown 解析、运算符匹配等

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 LaTeX 符号
patterns.context: 出现在行内或独立展示的数学公式中，常伴随上下标、花括号和积分表达式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文及 StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 姓名中的分词或字形边界
patterns.trigger: 姓名内部或相邻的 HTML/标记边界，如 `Nohara`、`Tou`、`Yoshikazu`，以及 ``、`$^{1}`
patterns.context: 作者姓名以 HTML 小型大写字样式、上标编号和标点排版，激活分散在姓名拼写及其边界处。

patterns.name: 地址字段换行与标点
patterns.context: 字段标签后接多行机构邮寄地址，换行与分隔符用于排版地址。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的机构地址信息

patterns.name: 命令行管道与正则替换
patterns.context: Shell 脚本将显示器信息通过管道传给 sed，并用带锚点和分组的替换模式筛选文本。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 中的 Bash 脚本示例

patterns.name: 积分公式的指数结构
patterns.trigger: `e^{...}`、`x^{...}` 及其间的分式、微分符号
patterns.context: 指数函数和幂函数构成积分表达式的一部分；该段虽与 LaTeX 数学符号模式相邻，但突出的局部是指数项组合。

patterns.name: 展示数学公式中的范数与积分
patterns.context: 讨论随机变量范数或概率分布性质的公式，包含无穷范数和广义积分。

en.concept: Structured symbols in code and mathematics
en.description: Primarily activates on regular-expression syntax in source code, especially negated character classes, escapes, and quantifiers; also appears on code boundary punctuation, LaTeX formulas, numeric ranges, and sporadic intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Negated character classes in regular expressions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on negated ranges in regex character classes, often adjacent to escapes, quantifiers, or groups; the condition is a code character class targeting “characters other than” a specified character.

patterns.name: Regex and string concatenation syntax
patterns.context: Regex literals in code or regexes constructed through string concatenation; a negated character class is not required and the pattern also includes boundaries, escapes, and capture groups.

patterns.name: Closing brace and code block boundaries
patterns.context: The ends of expressions, functions, or control structures and subsequent code block boundaries; the trigger is punctuation or braces rather than a single semantic concept.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical formula markers
patterns.context: LaTeX commands, math delimiters, and adjacent markers appear in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in English technical terms
patterns.context: Subword fragments within English words are marked; contexts involve a display switching script and physics discussion, with no shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: English word endings and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Local letter fragments within source identifiers or words; adjacent to regex code, but it is unclear whether this is a trigger pattern independent of code syntax.

patterns.name: Numbers and range forms
patterns.context: Numbers, subscripts, or numeric ranges appear in formulas or character-code matching expressions.

patterns.name: Markdown heading regex
patterns.context: A regex defined in code to identify Markdown headings, including line starts, hash marks, and heading text.

5_1468.concept: 代码与数学中的结构化符号
5_1468.description: 主要激活于源码中的正则表达式语法，尤其否定字符类、转义与量词；也见代码边界标点、LaTeX公式、数值范围及零散词内片段。

patterns.name: 正则表达式中的否定字符类
patterns.context: 激活集中在正则字符类的否定范围，常与转义、量词或分组相邻；条件是代码中出现针对“不含某字符”的字符类。

patterns.name: 正则与字符串拼接语法
patterns.context: 代码中的正则字面量或由字符串拼接构造的正则；不一定要求否定字符类，也包括边界、转义及捕获组。

patterns.name: 右花括号与代码块边界
patterns.context: 代码中表达式、函数或控制结构的结尾及后续代码块边界，触发点是标点或花括号而非单一语义概念。

patterns.name: LaTeX数学公式标记
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现LaTeX命令、数学分隔符及其邻接标记。

patterns.name: 英文技术词内部片段
patterns.context: 英文词内部的子词片段被标记；上下文分别涉及显示器切换脚本和物理学论述，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文词尾与标识符片段
patterns.context: 源码标识符或单词中的局部字母片段；与正则代码相邻，但不能确定是独立于代码语法的触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字及范围形式
patterns.context: 数值、上下标或数值范围出现在公式或字符编码匹配表达式中。

patterns.name: Markdown标题正则
patterns.context: 代码中定义用于识别Markdown标题的正则表达式，包含行首、井号和标题文本。

en.description: Activations are distributed across structured passages in technical and academic text: author and institutional addresses, name formatting, code and command lines, and mathematical, biostatistical, and physics notation; no single clear word meaning or domain explains all examples.

patterns.name: Paper author addresses and institutional formatting
patterns.context: Near the end of a paper or in the author information section, institutional addresses are listed line by line, often with backslashes, commas, postal codes, email addresses, or author names; triggers are scattered throughout the formatted passage.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and author addresses

patterns.name: Author names and formatting markers
patterns.context: Names in author lists are split or wrapped in small-caps HTML tags, with nearby superscripts, commas, or line breaks.

patterns.name: Syntax and regex fragments in code
patterns.context: Punctuation, keywords, regex fragments, and code-line structure co-occur in JavaScript function and object definitions.

patterns.name: Mathematics paper titles and formula introductions
patterns.context: The paper body develops through section headings, mathematical terminology, and formula definitions; activations fall on headings, ordinary academic phrasing, and formula symbols.

patterns.name: Biostatistical notation and variable definitions
patterns.context: The Methods section defines variables with subscripts and superscripts for gene expression or sample summaries, and specifies index ranges.

patterns.name: Shell commands and pipeline text
patterns.context: Terminal commands are combined through pipelines and include regex substitution, filtering, and selecting the first line; connection-status matching expressions also appear locally.

patterns.name: Symbols in physics terminology
patterns.context: The body of a physics paper discusses nuclear spin relaxation rates and dynamical spin structure factors, with symbols adjacent to technical terms.

5_1468.concept: 技术文本中的结构化标记
5_1468.description: 激活分布于技术学术文本的结构化片段：作者与机构地址、姓名排版、代码和命令行，以及数学、生物统计和物理符号；没有单一明显词义或领域能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 论文作者地址及机构栏排版
patterns.trigger: «address:»、«\»、«Department»、«University»，以及机构、人名、邮编前的空格和换行
patterns.context: 论文末尾或作者信息区，机构地址按行排列，常伴随反斜线、逗号、邮编、邮箱或作者姓名；触发点分散在整段格式中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与作者地址

patterns.name: 作者姓名及排版标记
patterns.trigger: «Sh»iva« Pr»as«ad»、«Kas»iv«is»wanathan，以及 «<span style="font-variant:small-caps">» 等姓名或格式片段
patterns.context: 作者列表中姓名被拆分或套用 small-caps HTML 标记，附近有上标、逗号或换行。

patterns.name: 代码中的语法/正则片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数和对象定义中，标点、关键字、正则表达式片段及代码行结构共同出现。

patterns.name: 数学论文标题与公式引导
patterns.context: 论文正文以章节标题、数学术语和公式定义展开；激活落在标题、普通学术措辞及公式符号上。

patterns.name: 生物统计符号与变量定义
patterns.context: 方法部分用带上下标的变量定义基因表达或样本汇总值，并说明索引范围。

patterns.name: Shell 命令与管道文本
patterns.context: 终端命令通过管道组合，包含正则替换、过滤和取首行等操作；局部也有连接状态匹配表达式。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论/命令行文本

patterns.name: 物理术语中的符号
patterns.context: 物理论文正文讨论核自旋弛豫率和动力学自旋结构因子，符号与专业术语相邻。

en.description: Activates across paper typesetting, formulas, code, and configuration; the most stable cue is a backslash introducing an escape or command. Local activation patterns also occur around paper author names and footnotes, JS regex structures, and key-value pairs with escaped quotes.

patterns.name: Escaped backslash sequences
patterns.context: Activates on commands introduced by backslashes and nearby formulas, markers, and punctuation in LaTeX mathematics or mathematical typesetting; in [4], [5], and [7], it appears in backslash escapes in regular expressions.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical typesetting; Github regular expressions and code

patterns.name: Author names and footnote markers
patterns.context: Near paper author lists, name formatting, and superscript footnote/affiliation markers after names; activation is distributed across names, footnote markers, and list formatting.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and author lists

patterns.name: Regex anchors and capture groups
patterns.context: In JavaScript regular expressions, especially near patterns beginning with ^, optional groups, character classes, repetition quantifiers, or alternation branches.

patterns.name: Backslash key-value pairs in configuration/serialization
patterns.context: Near key names with escaped quotes and following numbers, Boolean values, or nested objects in JSON-style configuration fragments.

5_1468.concept: 反斜杠转义与排版标记
5_1468.description: 跨论文排版、公式、代码和配置激活，最稳定的线索是反斜杠及其引出的转义或命令；论文作者名与脚注、JS 正则结构和转义引号键值也有局部激活模式。

patterns.name: 转义反斜杠序列
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学或数学排版文本中，反斜杠引出的命令及其附近的公式、标记和标点处激活；[4]、[5]、[7]中则出现在正则表达式中的反斜杠转义。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学排版；Github 正则表达式与代码

patterns.name: 作者姓名与脚注标记
patterns.context: 论文作者列表、姓名排版和姓名后的上标脚注/单位标记附近；激活分布在姓名内部、脚注标记及列表格式中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与作者列表

patterns.name: 正则表达式锚点与捕获组
patterns.context: JavaScript 正则表达式中，尤其是以 ^ 开头的模式、可选分组、字符类、重复量词或替代分支附近。

patterns.name: 配置/序列化中的反斜杠键值
patterns.context: JSON 风格的配置片段中，带转义引号的键名及其后的数字、布尔值或嵌套对象附近。

en.description: Activations occur in paper formulas, author and institutional metadata, and regex and string-processing code; the shared feature appears to be sensitivity to dense structural markers, punctuation, and formatting fragments, rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: Symbol definitions or equation environments in mathematical formulas or papers; activations fall on formula markers, commands, or tokens adjacent to mathematical symbols.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical papers

patterns.name: Paper author and institutional metadata
patterns.context: Formatting of authors, affiliations, and addresses in paper metadata, often with LaTeX superscripts, line breaks, postal codes, and country names.

patterns.name: Regexes and code punctuation
patterns.context: Regular expressions or similar pattern strings in code; triggers concentrate on escape characters, character classes, quantifiers, and their combinations.

patterns.name: String method calls in code
patterns.context: String-processing chains in JavaScript-style code, followed by property checks and regex matching.

5_1468.concept: 结构化文本标记
5_1468.description: 激活分布在论文公式、作者与机构元数据，以及代码中的正则表达式和字符串处理处；共同特点更像对密集结构标记、标点和格式化片段敏感，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式
patterns.context: 数学公式或论文中的符号定义、方程环境；激活落在公式标记、命令或紧邻数学符号的 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 论文作者与机构元数据
patterns.context: 论文元数据中作者、单位、地址的排版，常见 LaTeX 上标、换行、邮编和国家名。

patterns.name: 正则表达式及代码标点
patterns.context: 代码中的正则表达式或类似模式串；触发集中在转义符、字符类、量词及其组合上。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串方法调用
patterns.context: JavaScript 风格代码中，字符串处理链及其后的属性检查和正则匹配。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on author, affiliation, and address metadata in structured paper text; it also appears in well-defined local patterns such as mathematical formulas, astronomical coordinates, code snippets, and code-availability statements.

patterns.name: Author fields and author name formatting
patterns.context: In author lists at the end or on the first page of a paper, marks author numbers, affiliation references, and special footnotes; names are often split into formatted fragments.

patterns.name: Institutional and postal addresses
patterns.context: In author affiliation or contact address fields, containing institution names, streets, cities, and postal codes, often across multiple lines and with LaTeX markup.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula structures
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas or definitions in the main text, including typesetting structures for vectors, sets, subscripts, superscripts, fractions, and encoding functions.

patterns.name: Astronomical coordinate notation
patterns.context: Celestial positions are given in right ascension, declination, and J2000 epoch format.

patterns.name: String processing and regular expressions in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript code, comparing string lengths and using regular expressions to extract matched content.

patterns.name: Code availability statement at the end of a paper
patterns.context: An abstract- or conclusion-style statement in a paper indicating that code is available; consistency proofs and empirical results appear nearby.

5_1468.concept: 结构化学术文本标记
5_1468.description: 激活主要集中在论文结构化文本中的作者、单位与地址元数据，也出现在数学公式、天文坐标、代码片段和代码提供声明等格式明确的局部模式。

patterns.name: 作者栏与作者姓名格式
patterns.trigger: “author:”“1-”“|”以及姓名前后的“LaTeX 上标、脚注符号”
patterns.context: 论文末尾或首页的作者列表中，标记作者编号、单位引用与特殊脚注；姓名常被拆成带格式的片段。

patterns.name: 机构地址与邮政地址
patterns.trigger: “address:”“Institut für Organische Chemie”“School of Mathematics and Statistics”“China”
patterns.context: 作者单位或联系地址栏，含机构名称、街道、城市和邮编，常跨行并带 LaTeX 标记。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.context: 正文数学公式或定义，包含向量、集合、上下标、分式及编码函数等排版结构。

patterns.name: 天文坐标表示
patterns.context: 天体位置以赤经、赤纬及 J2000 历元格式给出。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串处理与正则表达式
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码处理中，比较字符串长度并用正则表达式提取匹配内容。

patterns.name: 论文结尾的代码提供声明
patterns.context: 论文摘要或结论式陈述中说明提供代码；附近出现一致性证明和实证结果。

en.description: Activations concentrate on structured formatting and syntax fragments in papers and code: LaTeX author lists and mathematical notation, JavaScript regular expressions, and institutional addresses; one paper sentence also activates on “prove”.

patterns.name: LaTeX author information and name formatting
patterns.context: Near paper author lists, affiliation/footnote markers, and line breaks; some fragments also contain name spellings and punctuation
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and LaTeX typesetting

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: At mathematical formulas or the boundary between formulas and body text; segment 2 also contains an author list, so formulas alone cannot explain it

patterns.name: Regexes and punctuation in code
patterns.context: Regex literals in JavaScript source code, commonly with anchors, character classes, escapes, and capture groups; sometimes adjacent to function or object syntax

patterns.name: Institutional addresses and place names
patterns.context: Author affiliation or mailing address lists on the first page of a paper

patterns.name: Proof-related phrasing
patterns.context: Statements of theoretical results in a paper abstract or body; occurs only once, so its relation to other patterns is uncertain

5_1468.concept: 结构化文本标记
5_1468.description: 激活集中于论文与代码中的结构化排版/语法片段：LaTeX 作者列表及数学标记、JavaScript 正则表达式，以及机构地址；另在一处论文语句的“prove”上激活。

patterns.name: LaTeX 作者信息及姓名格式
patterns.context: 论文作者列表、作者单位/脚注标记及换行附近；有的片段还包含姓名拼写与标点
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 数学公式或公式与正文的边界处；段2另含作者列表，不能仅以公式解释

patterns.name: 代码中的正则表达式与标点
patterns.context: JavaScript 源码中正则字面量，常见锚点、字符类、转义和捕获组；部分邻接函数或对象语法

patterns.name: 机构地址与地名
patterns.trigger: `The University of Chicago`、`Chicago, IL 60637, USA`、`Department of Astronomy & Astrophysics`
patterns.context: 论文首页作者单位或通讯地址列表

patterns.name: 证明措辞
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文中陈述理论结果；仅有单次出现，不能确定与其他模式有关

en.concept: Academic paper metadata and authorship formatting
en.description: Activations cluster around the boundary where ArXiv papers shift from the main text to author and address metadata, line separators, and authorship formatting. They also cover institutional place names. A few occur at the end of abstracts, in equations, and in physics text fragments.

patterns.name: Author metadata delimiters
patterns.context: The text shifts from the paper body or abstract to metadata such as authors, institutions, and references; activations cluster around field labels, line breaks, and list markers.

patterns.name: Author names and authorship formatting
patterns.context: Author lists mix names with LaTeX superscripts, footnotes, or author numbers; activations may occur on characters within names and on markers.

patterns.name: Institutional addresses and place names
patterns.context: After the authorship information, departments, research institutes, universities, cities, postal codes, and countries are listed, usually line by line and separated by commas or backslashes.

patterns.name: Statements at the end of an abstract
patterns.context: The end of the main text or abstract summarizes proofs, results, numerical examples, or code, followed immediately by author metadata.

patterns.name: Physical quantities and symbols
patterns.context: In a physics context, describes spin projections of states and related quantities; this passage is adjacent to `address:` metadata.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression fragments
patterns.context: Standalone LaTeX mathematical formula fragments followed by author information; footnote markers also appear nearby.

patterns.name: Fragments of research content
patterns.context: Fragments of main-text sentences without an obvious shared lexical pattern, followed by author information.
patterns.domain: Academic paper main text; specific field unclear

5_1468.concept: 学术论文元数据与署名排版
5_1468.description: 激活主要聚集于ArXiv论文从正文转入作者与地址元数据的边界、行分隔符及署名格式，也覆盖机构地名；少量落在摘要结尾、公式和物理正文片段。

patterns.name: 作者元数据分隔符
patterns.context: 论文正文或摘要后转入作者、机构、参考文献等元数据；触发集中在字段标签、行分隔和列表标记附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的结构化元数据

patterns.name: 作者姓名及署名格式
patterns.trigger: `R²une Christiansen`、`Sushovan Majhi`、`Yonghui Ling`、`Miroslav Grmela`、`F. T. Brandt`、`Piotr Kalita`、`T. Grzywny`，以及 `^`、`$`、`[^…]`
patterns.context: 作者列表中姓名与 LaTeX 上标、脚注或作者编号混排；激活可落在姓名内部字符及标记上。

patterns.name: 机构地址与地名
patterns.trigger: `School of Mathematics and Statistics`、`Institute of Physics`、`University`、`Polish Academy of Sciences`、`China`、`Poland`、`Wrocław`、`Technische Universität München`
patterns.context: 署名后列出院系、研究机构、大学、城市、邮编及国家，通常逐行排列并以逗号或反斜线分隔。

patterns.name: 摘要末尾的论文陈述
patterns.trigger: `We prove consistency, present empirical results and provide code.`、`the numerical examples are presented.`
patterns.context: 正文或摘要末尾概述证明、结果、数值例子或代码，随后紧接作者元数据。

patterns.name: 物理量与符号
patterns.context: 物理学语境中描述态的自旋投影及其相关量；该处邻接 `address:` 元数据。

patterns.name: 数学表达式片段
patterns.context: 独立的 LaTeX 数学公式残片，后接作者信息；附近还出现脚注标记。

patterns.name: 研究内容正文残片
patterns.trigger: `investigation of the result of the reduction (reduced dynamics)`、`process, provided that the points are close enough`
patterns.context: 没有明显共同词汇模式的正文句片段，之后转入作者信息。
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文；具体领域不明确

en.description: Responses are scattered: decimal-place phrasing stands out in rounding problems; other examples include a female pronoun in patient or legal contexts, privacy language addressing readers, paper formulas, author bylines, and experimental measurement expressions.

patterns.name: “decimal places” in rounding questions
patterns.context: Asks for a decimal to be rounded to a specified number of decimal places, often adjacent to a number and question mark; numbers, signs, and place counts vary.

patterns.name: “her” in legal text
patterns.context: The pronoun refers to a female party or patient; appears in a description of visitation rights.

patterns.name: “her” in patient consent statements
patterns.context: States that the patient consented to the use of her images and clinical information; her refers to a female patient.

patterns.name: “your” in privacy notices
patterns.context: A company privacy notice addresses the reader directly, in the phrase “takes your privacy seriously”.

patterns.name: Symbols and formulas in mathematics papers
patterns.context: Around definitions of coding functions and mathematical formulas such as finite-field products.

patterns.name: Author names and institutional affiliations
patterns.context: After a paper abstract or body, transitions to author metadata listing authors, departments, universities, and addresses.

patterns.name: Measurement expressions in cell-experiment methods
patterns.context: Describes colon cancer cell seeding density and the number of experimental plate wells, including scientific notation.

5_1468.concept: 局部词语与格式特征
5_1468.description: 响应分散：数学舍入题中突出小数位数措辞；另见患者或法律语境的女性代词、面向读者的隐私称呼、论文公式、作者署名和实验计量表达。

patterns.name: 四舍五入题目中的 decimal places
patterns.context: 要求将小数舍入到指定小数位数，常紧邻数值与问号；数字、正负号和位数会变化。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 her
patterns.context: 代词指女性当事人或患者；出现在探视权描述中。

patterns.name: 患者同意声明中的 her
patterns.context: 说明患者同意使用其图像和临床信息，her 指女性患者。

patterns.name: 隐私宣传中的 your
patterns.context: 公司隐私声明中直接称呼读者，出现在“takes your privacy seriously”一语。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的广告/免责声明

patterns.name: 数学论文中的符号与公式
patterns.context: 编码函数定义及有限域乘积等数学公式周边。

patterns.name: 作者姓名与机构署名
patterns.trigger: 姓名片段及其后的“\”或机构名称
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文结束后进入 author 元数据，列出作者、院系、大学及地址。

patterns.name: 细胞实验方法中的计量表达
patterns.context: 描述结肠癌细胞接种密度及实验板孔数，包含科学计数法。

en.description: Activations are scattered across paper structure and professional formatting: author metadata, equations, ethics statements, experimental concentration notation, and paper narrative. They also cover rounding exercises. No single stable lexical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Mathematics paper author metadata
patterns.context: Appears in the author information section after the abstract or main text, often including author names, institutions, or mathematical formatting markers; the trigger does not consistently fall on a single word.

patterns.name: Patient consent statements
patterns.context: Ethics statements in medical papers describe consent to publish images or clinical information; consent and patient recur in context.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula and symbol formatting
patterns.context: Near formulas or mathematical definitions, including LaTeX mathematical symbols and structural markers.

patterns.name: Rounding instructional questions and answers
patterns.context: Rounding questions about a given decimal and specified number of decimal places, mixed with numbers, punctuation, and answers.

patterns.name: Cell concentration notation in experimental procedures
patterns.context: A cell experiment methods section specifies seeding density, with scientific-notation numbers adjacent to cells.

patterns.name: Results statements in general paper narrative
patterns.context: The abstract or main text summarizes supplementary results, numerical examples, or research contributions; this pattern appears in the same passage as author metadata, but its trigger lies in the narrative text.

5_1468.concept: 结构化专业文本标记
5_1468.description: 激活散布于论文结构与专业排版：作者元数据、公式、伦理声明、实验浓度记号及论文叙述，也覆盖舍入教学问答；未见单一稳定词汇触发器。

patterns.name: 数学论文作者元数据
patterns.trigger: author:↵-、« |»、作者姓名及其后的 «$»、«^»、«\» 等标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文摘要或正文结束后的作者信息区，常包含作者姓名、机构或数学排版标记；触发点不固定在单个词上。

patterns.name: 患者同意声明
patterns.context: 医学论文伦理声明中描述患者同意发表图像或临床信息；上下文中反复出现 consent 与 patient。

patterns.name: 数学公式与符号排版
patterns.context: 公式或数学定义附近，包含 LaTeX 数学符号与结构标记。

patterns.name: 四舍五入教学问答
patterns.context: 围绕给定小数及指定小数位数提出舍入问题，夹杂数字、标点和答案。

patterns.name: 实验步骤中的细胞浓度记号
patterns.context: 细胞实验方法段落中，说明接种密度，科学计数法数字紧邻 cells。

patterns.name: 一般论文叙述中的结果表达
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文概述补充结果、数值例子或研究贡献；此模式与作者元数据同段出现，但触发词位于叙述文本中。

en.description: Primarily responds to negative phrasing in legal opinions stating that oral argument is unnecessary and would not aid the decision, especially “would not be” and its continuation. It also responds to related legal boilerplate, neuroscience formula symbols, paper authorship formatting, and crystallographic refinement table headings and rules.

patterns.name: “No need for oral argument” language in appellate opinions
patterns.context: U.S. appellate court boilerplate: after reviewing the case, briefs, and record, the court determines that oral argument would not aid the decision; strong activations cluster around “would not be” and the continuation of “not be”.

patterns.name: Other legal formulations stating oral argument is unnecessary
patterns.context: The court dispenses with oral argument or deems it unnecessary because the facts and legal arguments are adequately presented; the legal theme is shared, but the wording differs, with strong activations on negative judgments such as “would not aid the decision”.

patterns.name: “Adequately presented” co-occurring with briefs/record in legal documents
patterns.context: The arguments and materials have been adequately presented, followed by a statement that oral argument is unnecessary or would not significantly aid adjudication.

patterns.name: Neuroscience teaching-neuron symbols
patterns.context: Discusses neural networks involving cerebellar granule cells or hypothalamic central nucleus neurons, and expresses teaching neurons using symbols; activations cluster on mathematical variables, punctuation, and formula fragments.

patterns.name: Paper authorship and delimiters
patterns.context: Author lists and institutional superscripts on a paper's first page or in its title area; activations mainly fall on vertical bars, line breaks, formula-like superscripts, and authorship delimiters.

patterns.name: Crystallographic refinement table headings and rules
patterns.context: Headers, rules, and refinement-object markers in tables of crystallographic refinement data in structural determination papers; adjacent entries include reflection counts and atomic site positions.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central crystallography/structural biology paper tables

5_1468.concept: 语境与格式片段触发
5_1468.description: 主要响应法律判决中认定口头辩论无必要、不会帮助决策的否定句式，尤其“would not be”及其后续；另响应相关法律套语、神经科学公式符号、论文署名排版，以及晶体学精修表格标题和线条。

patterns.name: 上诉判决中“无需口头辩论”措辞
patterns.trigger: “decision”后的片段 «al»3« process»1« would»5« not»8« be»10« significantly»5« aided»6«by»1 oral« argument»6«.”»2；以及“briefs”“record”“adequately presented”等邻近词
patterns.context: 美国上诉法院判决套语：法院审阅案情、书状和记录后，认定口头辩论无助于决策；强激活集中在“would not be”及“not be”的续接位置

patterns.name: 无需口头辩论的其他法律表述
patterns.trigger: «dispense»3« with»4 oral« argument»6« because»2，及«argument»6« would»6« not»8« aid»6« the»3« decision»5«al»2 process
patterns.context: 法院以事实和法律主张已充分呈现为由，免除或认为无须口头辩论；虽有相同法律主题，但措辞不同，强激活落在“不援助决策”一类否定判断上

patterns.name: 法律文书中“adequately presented”与 briefs/record 共现
patterns.trigger: «arguments»1 are adequately« presented»3 in the« briefs»6« and»2 the« record»3，及相邻的«decision»al process« would»4« not»7« be»9
patterns.context: 论证与材料已充分提交，继而说明口头辩论不必要或不会显著帮助裁决

patterns.name: 神经科学教学神经元符号
patterns.context: 讨论小脑颗粒细胞或下丘脑中央核神经元的神经网络，并以符号表达教学神经元；激活集中在数学变量、标点及公式片段
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 神经科学论文

patterns.name: 论文作者署名与分隔符
patterns.context: 论文首页或标题区的作者名单及机构上标；激活主要落在竖线、换行、公式式上标和署名分隔符

patterns.name: 晶体学精修表格标题和分隔线
patterns.context: 结构测定论文表格中，晶体学精修数据的表头、分隔线和精修对象标记；邻近反射数、原子位点位置等表格条目
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学/结构生物学论文表格

en.description: Responds to local markers in various structured and formatted texts: paper author metadata, Objective-C identifiers, rounding instructions, medical terminology, legal boilerplate, and crystallographic refinement tables; these patterns differ markedly in vocabulary and domain.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and author lists
patterns.context: When a paper excerpt transitions to author, title, or affiliation information; activations concentrate on markers, name fragments, and separators

patterns.name: Objective-C containers and variable identifiers
patterns.context: When Foundation class names, type names, and related syntax appear in code

patterns.name: Decimal-rounding problems and answer format
patterns.context: A math exercise asks to round a decimal to a specified precision, with the answer on a separate line

patterns.name: Magnetic resonance relaxation rates and measurement methods
patterns.context: Describes measurement, calculation, and fitting relationships for magnetic resonance relaxation rates

patterns.name: Court boilerplate declining oral argument
patterns.context: The court states that oral argument is unnecessary and decides the case on the record

patterns.name: Crystallographic refinement tables
patterns.context: Table rules, reflection counts, and atomic-site information occur together in a crystal-structure refinement data table

5_1468.concept: 结构化文本标记
5_1468.description: 响应多种结构化、格式化文本中的局部标记：论文作者元数据、Objective-C标识符、舍入题指令、医学术语、法律套语及晶体学精修表格；这些模式的词汇与领域差异明显。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与作者列表
patterns.context: 论文正文片段转入作者、标题或机构信息时；激活集中在标记符、姓名片段和分隔符

patterns.name: Objective-C 容器与变量标识符
patterns.context: 代码中出现 Objective-C 的 Foundation 类名、类型名及相关语法时

patterns.name: 小数舍入题及答案格式
patterns.context: 数学练习要求把小数舍入到指定精度，答案以数字另起一行

patterns.name: 磁共振弛豫率与测量方法
patterns.context: 描述磁共振弛豫率的测量、计算及拟合关系

patterns.name: 法院拒绝口头辩论的裁判套语
patterns.context: 法院说明无需口头辩论，并依据案卷材料作出决定

patterns.name: 晶体学精修表格
patterns.context: 晶体结构精修数据表中，表格线、反射数及原子位点信息相邻出现

en.description: Activations cluster around crystallographic refinement tables and formulas, appellate court boilerplate, and rehearing language. They also occur in commercial email disclaimers and descriptions of DNA extraction concentration. The shared feature is specialized terminology or a stylistic template, not a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Crystallographic refinement tables
patterns.context: Appears in refinement data tables in crystallography papers, including their headers, rules, and nearby content.

patterns.name: Crystallographic statistical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in formulas and numerical reporting of crystallographic structure refinement metrics.

patterns.name: Boilerplate dispensing with oral argument in legal opinions
patterns.context: In appellate court opinions, states that the written materials are adequate and oral argument would not aid adjudication; the boilerplate recurs as a full passage.

patterns.name: Court rulings and rehearing procedure language
patterns.context: In the context of court judgments or orders on en banc review.

patterns.name: Privacy and advertising disclaimers
patterns.context: Commercial service disclaimers in emails, discussing advertising content, product guarantees, and privacy.

patterns.name: DNA extraction and concentration units
patterns.context: Describes DNA extraction using a kit and measurement of its concentration.

5_1468.concept: 文档模板与专业术语
5_1468.description: 激活集中于晶体学精修表格与公式、上诉法院裁判套语和再审措辞；另见商业邮件免责声明及DNA提取浓度描述。共享特定领域术语或文体模板，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 晶体学精修表格
patterns.trigger: "Refinement on *F*^2"、"Primary atom site location"、"Secondary atom site location"、"independent reflections"
patterns.context: 出现在结晶学论文精修数据表及其表头、分隔线或紧邻内容中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central；晶体学/结构解析论文

patterns.name: 晶体学统计公式
patterns.context: 出现在晶体结构精修指标的公式及数值报告中。

patterns.name: 法律意见中免除口头辩论的套语
patterns.trigger: "We dispense with oral argument because"、"facts and legal contentions"、"would not aid the decisional process"
patterns.context: 上诉法院意见中，说明书面材料充分、口头辩论无助于裁决；整段套语重复出现。

patterns.name: 法院裁判与再审程序措辞
patterns.trigger: "affirm"、"order"、"Petition for Rehearing is denied"、"Court be polled on rehearing"
patterns.context: 法院判决或全院复审程序的裁定语境。

patterns.name: 隐私与广告免责声明
patterns.trigger: "not responsible"、"no warranties or guarantees"、"your privacy seriously"
patterns.context: 邮件中的商业服务免责声明，讨论广告内容、产品保证和隐私。

patterns.name: DNA提取与浓度单位
patterns.trigger: "DNA isolation kit"、"quantity of the DNA"、"ng µL"
patterns.context: 描述使用试剂盒提取DNA及测量其浓度。

en.description: Primarily activates on standard appellate court phrasing that oral argument would not aid adjudication; it also responds to questions asking who has authority to assess or decide. It additionally appears in the formatting of attorneys' briefs, experimental concentrations, and chromatography flow-rate units.

patterns.name: Conclusion that oral argument is unnecessary in judicial opinions
patterns.context: The court finds that the facts and legal arguments have been adequately presented and that oral argument would not aid the decision-making process; common in standard opinion language.

patterns.name: Who assesses or decides risk
patterns.context: Asks who has authority to assess risk or make a decision, with surrounding discussion of social risk, tools, or family circumstances.

patterns.name: Attorney and record information in legal opinions
patterns.context: Case captions or procedural information identify attorneys who filed briefs and the parties they represented.

patterns.name: Exponential units in DNA concentration measurements
patterns.context: Reports DNA concentration after extraction in ng/µL, using scientific notation or superscripts for inverse units.

patterns.name: Exponents in chromatography flow-rate units
patterns.context: Describes flow rates in liquid chromatography in ml·min⁻¹.

5_1468.concept: 决定或帮助裁决
5_1468.description: 主要激活于上诉法院固定表述：口头辩论不会帮助裁决；也响应“谁有权评估/决定”的问句。另在律师提交辩护状、实验浓度和色谱流速单位的格式中出现。

patterns.name: 司法意见中“不需口头辩论”结论
patterns.context: 法院认为事实与法律论点已充分呈交，口头辩论不会帮助决策过程；常见于固定判决措辞

patterns.name: 由谁评估或决定风险
patterns.context: 询问谁有权评估风险或作出决定，周围讨论社会风险、工具或家庭处境

patterns.name: 法律意见的律师与案卷信息
patterns.context: 案件标题或程序信息中介绍律师提交辩护状及其代表的一方

patterns.name: DNA浓度测量中的指数单位
patterns.context: DNA提取后报告浓度，单位为 ng/µL，且以科学记数或上标表示倒数

patterns.name: 色谱流速单位中的指数
patterns.context: 液相色谱方法描述流速，单位为 ml·min⁻¹

en.concept: Corpus fragment formatting and domain terminology
en.description: Primarily responds to standard appellate opinion boilerplate about dispensing with oral argument and deciding on written materials alone. It also shows weaker, independent responses to crystallographic refinement table headings and formatting, DNA extraction, and concentration units.

patterns.name: Appellate court boilerplate dispensing with oral argument
patterns.context: An appellate court explains why oral argument is unnecessary, especially because the facts and legal arguments are adequately presented in the materials and argument would not aid adjudication; the same boilerplate recurs across multiple fragments.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate opinions, legal documents

patterns.name: Request for decision on written submissions and panel review
patterns.context: The opinion's opening states that the panel reviewed the written materials and granted the parties' request for a decision based solely on those materials, without oral argument.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate opinions, legal documents

patterns.name: Crystallographic refinement table headings and formatting
patterns.context: Structured paper tables contain refinement data headings, reflection data, and atomic site fields; activations cluster around table headings and formatting markers.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, crystallography/structural biology paper tables

patterns.name: DNA extraction and concentration units
patterns.context: Describes extracting DNA according to the manufacturer's protocol and reporting the measured concentration range and units.

5_1468.concept: 语料片段格式与领域术语
5_1468.description: 主要响应上诉判决中免口头辩论、仅据书面材料裁决的固定套语；另对晶体学精修表格标题与排版、DNA提取及浓度单位有较弱而独立的响应。

patterns.name: 免口头辩论的上诉法院套语
patterns.trigger: «We» dispense with oral «argument» because the facts and legal contentions are adequately presented ... «argument» would not aid the decisional process
patterns.context: 上诉法院说明为何无需口头辩论，尤其是事实与法律主张已在材料中充分呈现、辩论无助裁决；同一套语在多个片段反复出现
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉判决，法律文书

patterns.name: 请求书面审理及合议决定
patterns.trigger: «After» examining the «briefs» and appellate record ... grant the parties’ request ... decision on the briefs without oral
patterns.context: 判决开头说明合议庭审阅书面材料，并准许当事人请求仅依据书面材料作出决定、不举行口头辩论
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉判决，法律文书

patterns.name: 晶体学精修表格标题与排版
patterns.context: 结构化论文表格中出现精修数据标题、反射数据及原子位点字段；触发集中在表格标题和排版标记附近
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，晶体学/结构生物学论文表格

patterns.name: DNA提取与浓度单位
patterns.context: 描述按厂家方案提取DNA，并报告测得的浓度范围和单位
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，生物医学方法部分

en.concept: Boilerplate formats in legal procedure and scientific notation
en.description: Responds mainly to standard language used by courts of appeals to dispense with oral argument and close variants; also responds to procedural language denying rehearing en banc, and to Å, reciprocal units, and radiation data in crystallographic parameter tables, especially the strong activation on “^−1”.

patterns.name: Court of appeals boilerplate dispensing with oral argument
patterns.context: A federal court of appeals finds that the written materials adequately present the facts and legal arguments, so oral argument would not aid the decision; activations concentrate on words such as “not”, “would”, “aid”, “argument”, and “before” in the boilerplate, and on adjacent formatting
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, court opinions and procedural orders

patterns.name: Rehearing request denied
patterns.context: The court states that no one requested an en banc vote on a rehearing petition; appears in a procedural order, with high activation on “having requested”

patterns.name: Lattice and radiation data in crystallographic parameter tables
patterns.context: A crystallography paper or structure data table lists unit-cell parameters, radiation source, wavelength/units, and temperature; activations concentrate on the reciprocal-unit symbol “^−1”
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, crystallographic data in scientific papers

patterns.name: Oral-argument language in other appellate contexts
patterns.context: Similar to court boilerplate dispensing with oral argument, but phrased as “decision process would not be significantly aided by oral argument”; the preceding text mentions briefs, the record, and an appeal

5_1468.concept: 法律程序与科学符号中的固定格式
5_1468.description: 主要响应上诉法院免除口头辩论的固定措辞及其近义变体；另响应拒绝全院再审的程序语句，以及晶体学参数表中的Å、倒数单位和辐射数据，尤其对“^−1”强烈激活。

patterns.name: 上诉法院免除口头辩论的套语
patterns.trigger: “We dispense with oral argument because the facts and legal contentions are adequately presented … and argument would not aid the decisional process.”；也包括变体“decision[al] process would not be significantly aided by oral argument”
patterns.context: 联邦上诉法院认为书面材料已充分呈现事实与法律论点，因此口头辩论无助于裁决；激活集中在该套语中的“not”“would”“aid”“argument”“before”等词及其相邻格式
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，法院意见及程序性裁定

patterns.name: 再审请求被拒绝
patterns.trigger: “FOR REHEARING EN BANC”“The Petition for Rehearing is denied”及“having requested”
patterns.context: 法院说明无人要求对再审请求进行全院表决，出现在程序性命令中；高激活落在“having requested”

patterns.name: 晶体学参数表中的晶格与辐射数据
patterns.context: 晶体学论文或结构数据表中列出晶胞参数、辐射源、波长/单位与温度；激活集中在倒数单位符号“^−1”
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，科学论文中的晶体学数据

patterns.name: 其他上诉程序语境中的口头辩论措辞
patterns.context: 与免除口头辩论的法院套语相近，但句式改为“decision process would not be significantly aided by oral argument”；前文提到简报、记录和上诉

en.description: Primarily responds to the contrast structure “as opposed to,” used to distinguish two views, objects, or approaches across domains. It also occurs in patent text contrasting “related to… and not…” and in the legal idiom “so far as to,” which expresses the extent of an action.

patterns.name: Contrast phrase “as opposed to”
patterns.context: Contrasts one object, view, or choice with another. Examples include lyrics versus a coherent explanation, Devotion versus devotions, the advantages and disadvantages of Kant's arguments, forest types, model approaches, wrestlers versus commentators, and theories of product liability or entrepreneurial ideas.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain forum discussions, religious commentary, academic discussion, scientific text, legal text, and entrepreneurship discussions

patterns.name: Contrast between related subject matter and exclusions
patterns.context: After “however,” states that an approach concerns one type of subject rather than another; expresses contrast or exclusion without using “as opposed to”.

patterns.name: Degree idiom “so far as to”
patterns.context: “So far as to” indicates that an action reaches a certain extent, followed by a specific action; here it describes the plaintiff attaching a copy of the contract.

5_1468.concept: 对照与区分
5_1468.description: 主要响应对照结构“as opposed to”，用于跨领域区分两类观点、对象或方案；另见专利文本以“related to… and not…”作对照，以及法律惯用语“so far as to”表达行为程度。

patterns.name: 对照短语“as opposed to”
patterns.trigger: “as opposed to”，其中“opposed”最强；[1]–[4]、[7]、[8]、[10]标记“opposed”，[9]标记“opposed to”
patterns.context: 用来把一个对象、观点或选择与另一个相对照；可比较歌词与连贯解释、Devotion 与 devotions、康德论证的优缺点、森林类型、模型方案、摔角选手与解说，以及产品责任理论或创业理念。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的论坛、宗教评论、学术论述、科学文本、法律文本与创业讨论

patterns.name: 相关性与排除项的对比
patterns.trigger: “being related to golf clubs, and not putters”中的“related”
patterns.context: 在“however”之后说明某方案涉及某类对象、而非另一类对象；虽没有“as opposed to”，仍表达对照或排除。

patterns.name: 程度惯用语“so far as to”
patterns.trigger: “went so far as to attach copies”，尤其“far”
patterns.context: “so far as to”表示行为达到某种程度，后接具体行动；此处描述原告附上合同副本。

en.description: Primarily responds to the template “picking … letters … without replacement” in probability problems, especially specified letters and counts, and the frequencies of letters in the source. It also covers probability questions about drawing a specified letter sequence. Segment 10 is an unrelated comment about guns and does not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Probability questions about drawing without replacement
patterns.context: Asks for the probability of drawing a specified number of letters or a specified sequence from a given multiset of letters, without replacement. Common phrasing includes “What is prob of picking … when … letters picked without replacement” or “Calculate prob of …”.

patterns.name: Specified letter counts and multisets
patterns.context: The target is specified by each letter's count; source letters and their frequencies are represented as a letter string or counts in braces. The number of draws usually equals the total number of target letters.

patterns.name: Specified draw sequences
patterns.context: Asks for the probability of drawing a specific string of letters in order, still under without-replacement conditions.

patterns.name: Adjacent answers and question templates
patterns.context: Probability questions and answers often appear consecutively, and question templates recur. Activations also cover boundaries near answers; these may reflect adjacency or formatting effects rather than an independent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Discussion of weapons and firearms
patterns.context: Discusses opposing camps, gun laws, and killing animals; it has no clear connection to without-replacement sampling problems, and the marked words do not form a clear, unified local pattern.

5_1468.concept: 不放回抽取概率题
5_1468.description: 主要响应概率题中“picking … letters … without replacement”的模板，尤其是指定字母及其数量、来源字母频数；也覆盖指定顺序字母串的概率题。第10段是无关的枪支评论，无法纳入该模式。

patterns.name: 不放回抽取的概率问题
patterns.context: 询问从给定字母多重集合中不放回抽取若干次，得到指定字母数量或序列的概率；常见措辞为“What is prob of picking … when … letters picked without replacement”或“Calculate prob of …”。

patterns.name: 指定字母计数与多重集合
patterns.context: 目标由各字母的出现次数指定，来源字母及其频数以字母串或花括号计数表示；抽取数通常与目标字母总数相同。

patterns.name: 指定抽取序列
patterns.context: 询问按顺序抽出特定字母串的概率，仍是在不放回抽取条件下。

patterns.name: 邻近答案与题目模板
patterns.trigger: «↵»、分数答案如«1/15»、以及«What is prob»或«Calculate prob»
patterns.context: 概率题与答案常连续出现，题目模板重复，激活也覆盖答案边界附近；这些可能是主触发词的邻接或格式效应，而非独立语义模式。

patterns.name: 武器与枪支讨论
patterns.context: 讨论对立阵营、枪支法律及杀害动物；与不放回抽样概率题无明显联系，所标记词也未形成清楚统一的局部模式。

en.concept: Local patterns in common English expressions
en.description: Activations cluster in three local lexical patterns: the negative construction you won’t, the contrast phrase opposed to, and as soon as possible in email requests. The most common is won’t, often introduced by you.

patterns.name: Negative contraction string won’t
patterns.context: Forms “you won’t” after You/you; appears in negative statements about future behavior, outcomes, or ability.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, emails/marketing copy, technology commentary, and general writing

patterns.name: Contrast phrase opposed to
patterns.context: Introduces an object contrasted with the preceding approach, view, or category; it need not occur in a second-person or negative context.

patterns.name: Emphatic collocation with soon
patterns.context: Occurs in the polite request “as soon as possible,” meaning to complete something promptly.

5_1468.concept: 常见英语表达的局部模式
5_1468.description: 激活集中在三类局部词汇模式：you won’t 否定句、opposed to 对照短语，以及邮件请求中的 as soon as possible；其中最常见的是 won’t，且常由 you 引出。

patterns.name: 否定性缩约串 won’t
patterns.context: 在第二人称 You/you 后构成 “you won’t”；出现在对未来行为、结果或能力的否定陈述中。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、邮件/营销文案、科技评论及一般论述

patterns.name: 对照短语 opposed to
patterns.context: 用于引出与前述方案、观点或类别相对的对象；不要求第二人称或否定语境。

patterns.name: soon 的强调搭配
patterns.context: 出现在礼貌请求 “as soon as possible” 中，表示尽快完成。

en.description: Most fragments activate on local words in fixed collocations or idiomatic constructions, such as “so far as to” and “give rise to”; other discrete patterns include email boilerplate, legal terminology, patent boilerplate, and mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: “so far as to” construction
patterns.context: The degree adverb “so” introduces “far as to”, indicating that something reaches a certain extent; the verb and subsequent action vary.

patterns.name: “as soon as possible” boilerplate
patterns.context: A polite request asks that something be done as soon as possible; “soon” activates most strongly.

patterns.name: “give rise to” collocation
patterns.context: A negative sentence states that something cannot give rise to a cause of action or a double-jeopardy issue.

patterns.name: “opposed to” contrast expression
patterns.context: The author contrasts the view under discussion with another view.

patterns.name: Request for decision on the briefs
patterns.context: After reviewing the record, the panel grants a party’s request for a decision based on the briefs without oral argument.

patterns.name: Patent boilerplate referring to drawings
patterns.context: At the end of a patent specification, the text advises reading the detailed description and claims in conjunction with the drawings.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and typesetting symbols
patterns.context: Dense formula typesetting; activations fall on formula markers, characters, and numbers, and the specific semantic condition is difficult to infer from the fragment.

5_1468.concept: 惯用搭配与格式片段
5_1468.description: 多数片段激活于固定搭配或惯用句式中的局部词语，如“so far as to”“give rise to”；另有邮件套语、法律术语、专利套语及数学符号等离散模式。

patterns.name: “so far as to”结构
patterns.trigger: “so far as to”（[2]为“so far as to say”，[3]为“so far as to attach”，[4]为“so far as completely removing”）
patterns.context: 程度副词“so”引出“far as to”，表示做到某种程度；动词或后续动作各异。
patterns.domain: 新闻/百科、法律文书、技术论坛

patterns.name: “as soon as possible”套语
patterns.context: 礼貌请求中要求尽快完成某事；“soon”激活最强。

patterns.name: “give rise to”搭配
patterns.context: 否定句中说明某事不能导致诉因或双重危险问题。

patterns.name: “opposed to”对照表达
patterns.context: 作者将所讨论的观点与另一观点相对照。

patterns.name: 申请书面裁决
patterns.trigger: “request”及“request for a decision on the briefs”
patterns.context: 合议庭审查案卷后，批准当事人不经口头辩论、依据书状作出裁决的请求。

patterns.name: 指向附图的专利套语
patterns.context: 专利说明书结尾处提示结合附图阅读详细说明和权利要求。

patterns.name: 数学公式与排版符号
patterns.context: 符号密集的公式排版；激活落在公式标记、字符和数字上，难以从片段判断具体语义条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的数学表达式

en.concept: Academic and legal technical text formatting fragments
en.description: The strongest pattern is paper formulas and their numerical formatting. Other activations occur in patent boilerplate, court ruling language, and biomedical paper methods, genes, and strain markers; they cannot be summarized by a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Formula and numerical formatting
patterns.context: Activations cluster on a recurring formula fragment in papers and nearby numbers and symbols; formula formatting details and values vary slightly across excerpts.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central academic papers, mathematical or statistical formula formatting

patterns.name: Description in patent background disclaimers
patterns.context: The patent background states that the section is provided for background or context and does not necessarily constitute prior art; stronger activation falls on “is”.

patterns.name: Common phrasing in patent specifications
patterns.context: Patent text uses conventional phrasing to introduce features of the invention, detailed descriptions, claims, and drawings; activations cluster on short function words and words such as “reference”.

patterns.name: Biological experimental methods and strain markers in papers
patterns.context: Methods or materials sections mention Drosophila strains, sequencing sources, and laboratory stock center names, mixed with formatting markers and identifiers.

patterns.name: Ruling language in court orders
patterns.context: After a date, a formal ruling format states that a motion is denied; “hereby” is the strongest activation in this passage.

patterns.name: Gene and disease background in biomedical papers
patterns.context: The title and main text discuss gene expression in an atherosclerosis mouse model; activation markers cluster around the formatting symbols in gene names and strain notation.

5_1468.concept: 学术与法律技术文本格式片段
5_1468.description: 最强模式是论文公式及其数值排版；其余激活散见专利惯用语、法院裁定措辞和生物医学论文中的方法、基因与品系标记，无法由单一词义概括。

patterns.name: 公式与数值排版
patterns.context: 激活集中在论文中重复出现的同一公式片段及其邻近数字、符号；公式格式细节和数值各段略有变化。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 学术论文，数学或统计公式排版

patterns.name: 专利背景免责声明中的描述
patterns.trigger: 「what is described in this section is not prior art」，以及「description」「herein」「prior art」
patterns.context: 专利背景部分说明本节内容仅供背景或语境参考，并不必然构成先前技术；较强激活落在「is」上。

patterns.name: 专利说明书常见措辞
patterns.trigger: 「These and other objects, features and characteristics」「detailed description」「appended claims」「accompanying drawings」
patterns.context: 专利文本以惯用句式引出发明特征、详细说明、权利要求及附图；激活集中在短功能词和「reference」等词上。

patterns.name: 论文中的生物实验方法与品系标记
patterns.trigger: 「protein extraction」「D. melanogaster」「iso-1 strain flies」「Bloomington Stock Centre」及带星号的品系编号
patterns.context: 方法或材料部分出现果蝇品系、测序来源及实验室库存中心名称，夹杂排版标记和编号。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学研究方法

patterns.name: 法院命令的裁定措辞
patterns.context: 日期之后以正式裁定格式写明驳回动议；「hereby」是本段最强激活位置。

patterns.name: 生物医学论文中的基因与疾病背景
patterns.trigger: 「Endothelial Dicer regulates miRNAs during atherosclerosis」「Dicer」「Apoe−/− mice」
patterns.context: 标题及正文讨论动脉粥样硬化小鼠模型中的基因表达；激活标记集中在基因名的排版符号和品系记号附近。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.description: Activation patterns vary: the most consistent is “letters picked without replacement” in math problems; the rest occur in legal decisions, experimental methods and parameters, online comments, local history, and patent documents, with no apparent unified trigger.

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in probability sampling problems
patterns.context: A combinatorics or probability problem describes drawing letters without replacement from a sequence or set, often near a letter sequence, draw count, and probability question.

patterns.name: Requests and rulings in legal opinions
patterns.context: A court of appeals opinion mentions a party’s request and explains how the court decides to handle it; activation is strongest on “request” in this passage.

patterns.name: DNA experimental methods and concentration units
patterns.context: The Methods section describes a DNA extraction kit, procedure, and DNA concentration measurement, including units such as ng/µL.

patterns.name: Comments emphasizing details and explanations
patterns.context: Informal critical context discussing someone’s failure to follow simple logic or explain an issue.

patterns.name: Roads and locations in local-history accounts
patterns.context: A local history or biographical account describes a creek, a bridge builder, and a location.

patterns.name: Engineering experimental operating parameters
patterns.context: Describes reactor operating conditions, listing hydraulic retention time, flow rate, temperature, and other parameters.

patterns.name: Formal closing language in patent claims
patterns.context: At the end of a patent specification, states that the novel features are set out in the appended claims.

5_1468.concept: 多领域文本中的局部措辞
5_1468.description: 激活模式多样：最一致的是数学题中“letters picked without replacement”；其余分布于法律裁定、实验方法与参数、网络评论、地方史和专利文书，未见统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 概率抽样题中的固定措辞
patterns.context: 组合或概率题中描述从字母序列或集合里无放回抽取字母，常与字母序列、抽取数量和概率问题相邻。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的请求与裁定措辞
patterns.context: 上诉法院意见中提及当事方的请求，并说明法院决定如何处理；本段在“request”处激活最强。

patterns.name: DNA实验方法与浓度单位
patterns.context: 实验方法部分说明DNA提取试剂盒、操作流程及DNA浓度测量，含ng/µL等单位。

patterns.name: 反复强调细节与解释的评论
patterns.context: 非正式批评语境，谈论某人未能遵循简单逻辑或解释问题。

patterns.name: 地方历史叙述中的道路与地点
patterns.context: 地方历史或传记叙述中介绍溪流、建桥者及地点。

patterns.name: 工程实验运行参数
patterns.context: 描述反应器运行条件，列出水力停留时间、流速及温度等参数。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/环境工程论文

patterns.name: 专利权利要求的正式结尾措辞
patterns.context: 专利说明书结尾处说明新颖性特征在所附权利要求中指出。

en.description: Activation most consistently corresponds to including: across multiple domains, the word introduces subsequent examples, details, or lists; there is also one activation on a subword fragment inside a Wikipedia name, which does not reflect the word.

patterns.name: including followed by a list or examples
patterns.context: Introduces examples, items, people, or specific content in a sentence; the word itself is marked as the maximum activation, 10, and appears in all snippets
patterns.domain: Expository, narrative, and document text across domains

patterns.name: Subword fragment inside a name
patterns.context: The name Stefan ie Z ad ra vec (Stefanie Zadravec) is split into multiple subword tokens, with activation concentrated on fragments inside the name; including is absent

patterns.name: Lists of recruitment or survey items containing including
patterns.context: In a research-methods description, including introduces specific topics covered by a questionnaire

patterns.name: Lists of historical sources containing including
patterns.context: When recounting personal memories and verifiable records, introduces specific historical sources used as evidence

5_1653.description: 激活最稳定地对应 including：该词在多领域文本中引出后续例项、细节或名单；另有一次 Wikipedia 人名内部子词片段激活，未体现该词。

patterns.name: including及其后列表/例项
patterns.context: 在句中引出例子、项目、人员或具体内容；该词本身标为最高激活10，且出现在全部片段
patterns.domain: 跨领域的说明性、叙述性与文档文本

patterns.name: 人名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 人名 Stefan ie Z ad ra vec（Stefanie Zadravec）被拆成多个子词 token，激活集中在人名内部片段；未见 including

patterns.name: 含 including 的招募或调查项目列举
patterns.context: 在研究方法描述中，including 引出调查问卷的具体关注内容
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划/学术行政文本

patterns.name: 含 including 的历史资料列举
patterns.context: 叙述个人回忆与可查记录时，引出作为依据的具体史料
