en.description: The main pattern is strong activation on the standalone word including across many genres, followed by examples or supplementary lists on varied topics; sporadic activations also occur in name fragments, clause-letter labels, and link formats.

patterns.name: Trigger after including
patterns.context: The standalone word including appears in lists, supplementary explanations, or examples; the following content spans syntactic categories, with no fixed collocation requirement.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including email, web, research, literary, legal, and patent texts

patterns.name: Subword fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: A name is split into multiple fragments by the tokenizer, with the strongest activation on “ie”; including does not occur in this example.

patterns.name: Document-number or label fragment
patterns.context: The parenthesized letter label “(c)” appears in clause-style text and may be a secondary local pattern; it differs from the main trigger word.

patterns.name: Measurement unit AM
patterns.context: AM appears in the time expression “10 AM - 7 PM”, but is unmarked and there is insufficient evidence to confirm it as an independent trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Address or URL prefix
patterns.context: The link begins with angle brackets and http://; this may reflect a secondary response to special punctuation or URL formatting.

5_1653.description: 主要模式是在多种文体中对独立词 including 强烈激活，后接举例或补充列举，内容不限；另有姓名分片、条款字母标记及链接格式等零散激活。

patterns.name: including 后触发
patterns.context: 在列举、补充说明或举例时，including 作为独立词出现；其后内容跨句法类别，未见固定搭配要求。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页、科研、文学、法律文本、专利说明等多种文体

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 姓名被分词器切为多个片段，最高激活落在“ie”；此例未出现 including。

patterns.name: 文档编号或标记残片
patterns.context: 括号中的字母标记“(c)”出现在条款式文字中，可能是次要的局部模式；与主要触发词不同。

patterns.name: 计量单位 AM
patterns.context: 时间表达“10 AM - 7 PM”中出现 AM，但未标记且证据不足以确认它是独立触发模式。

patterns.name: 地址或网址前缀
patterns.context: 链接以尖括号和 http:// 开始；可能反映特殊标点或网址格式的次要响应。

en.description: The most stable trigger is “including”, used to introduce supplementary items or examples across email, forums, research, history, and patent texts; line breaks also frequently activate. A few other cases involve split names, clause numbering, and domain-specific fragments, which are difficult to explain consistently.

patterns.name: List following including
patterns.context: including often appears in sentences introducing supplementary examples, items, or scope; it is itself marked as strongly activating, with no topic constraint on what follows.
patterns.domain: Expository writing, email, and web text across domains

patterns.name: Line breaks and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Line-break markers also activate in multiple samples, often at paragraph, list, or field boundaries; this is not necessarily related to the semantics of including.

patterns.name: Name segmentation and continuation
patterns.context: A proper name is split into multiple subword tokens, followed by a line break and a recurrence of its initial fragment.

patterns.name: Hyphenated numbered clauses
patterns.context: Legal or project contribution statements use parenthesized letter labels for clauses, followed by formal statements.

patterns.name: Past dates and campaign records
patterns.context: A retrospective account mentions campaign-date statistics as corroborating evidence.

patterns.name: Contract payments and monetary clauses
patterns.context: A contract or project communication describes waived payments, payment arrangements, and amounts.

patterns.name: Medical interviews and medical-history questions
patterns.context: Describes a postpartum telephone interview and questionnaire content about demographics, reproduction, medicine, and medication use.

patterns.name: Mail sorting process
patterns.context: Explains the ordering and grouping of delivered mail and categories of mail.

patterns.name: Uncategorized local activations
patterns.context: Aside from clearer patterns such as including lists and line breaks, several local activations show no independent semantic trigger condition that recurs across samples.

5_1653.description: 最稳定的触发是“including”，用于引入补充项目或例子，横跨邮件、论坛、研究、历史及专利文本；换行边界也常激活。另有少量姓名拆分、条款编号及领域专属片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: including 后列举
patterns.context: including 常出现在引入补充例子、项目或范围的句子中；它本身被标记为强激活，后续内容不要求特定主题。
patterns.domain: 多领域说明文、邮件、网页文本

patterns.name: 换行及段落边界
patterns.context: 多个样本中换行标记处也有激活，常见于文本换段、列表或字段分隔；不一定与 including 的语义有关。
patterns.domain: 跨领域语料及结构化文本

patterns.name: 姓名分块与续写
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词 token，姓名后换行并再次出现其开头片段。

patterns.name: 连字符编号条目
patterns.context: 法律或项目贡献声明中，以括号字母标记条款，条款后续接正式陈述。

patterns.name: 过往日期与战役记录
patterns.context: 回忆性叙述提及作为佐证的战役日期统计资料。

patterns.name: 合同付款及金额条款
patterns.context: 合同或项目沟通中描述款项免除、付款安排及金额。

patterns.name: 医疗访谈与病史询问
patterns.context: 描述产后电话访谈及有关人口统计、生殖、医疗和用药的问卷内容。

patterns.name: 邮件分拣流程
patterns.context: 说明投递邮件的排序、分堆及邮件类别。

patterns.name: 未能归入的局部激活
patterns.context: 除包括列举和换行等较明显模式外，若干局部激活未显出可跨样本复现的独立语义触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to tokenized fragments of Stephanie and the frequent marker including; it also activates on multiple line breaks, web markup, and sporadic username fragments. Segment 5 has no clear corresponding trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of the name Stephanie
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive subword fragments of the name Stephanie, including repeated names in Wikipedia articles and forms of address or body text in Enron emails.

patterns.name: Tokenization of including
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences listing, elaborating on, or qualifying what is included; appears across multiple domains, and the word is scored 9 or 10.
patterns.domain: Event promotions, web descriptions, license text, historical narratives, contracts, research plans

patterns.name: Address/web and special-formatting fragments
patterns.context: In text with frequent line breaks, web links, or username-like strings, line breaks repeatedly receive activation; web markup and username fragments occur only in individual segments.

5_1653.description: 主要响应 Stephanie 的分词片段及高频标记 including；也对多处换行、网页标记和零散用户名片段激活。第5段没有明确对应触发模式。

patterns.name: Stephanie 名字的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名 Stephanie 的连续子词片段上，包含 Wikipedia 条目中的重复姓名及 Enron 邮件中的称呼或正文。

patterns.name: including 的分词
patterns.context: 在列举、补充说明或限定所含内容的句子中出现；多个领域均有，且该词被标为 9 或 10。
patterns.domain: 活动宣传、网页说明、许可文本、历史叙述、合同、研究计划

patterns.name: 地址/网页与特殊排版残片
patterns.context: 换行密集、带网页链接或类似用户名的文本中，换行本身反复获得激活；网页标记和用户名片段仅见于个别段。

en.description: The most stable trigger is including, often appearing in supplementary lists or examples across domains. Other highlighted activations are scattered across split words, proper names, abbreviations, and formatted text, with no clear, consistent trigger condition.

patterns.name: including token
patterns.context: The word introduces a supplementary list, example, or additional information in a sentence; it appears mid-sentence, at the beginning of a phrase, or after a line break.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, email, web, and academic text

patterns.name: Subword fragments of proper names or words
patterns.context: Case-sensitive word fragments, names, or abbreviations are split into multiple tokens; the available data make it difficult to establish how these fragments relate to a shared context.
patterns.domain: People’s names, forum text, medical abbreviations, etc.

patterns.name: Possible local triggers in formatting or lists
patterns.context: Appears in only one or a few fragments, with inconsistent neighboring words and syntactic conditions; this is insufficient to establish a stable rule.
patterns.domain: Email, web, legal forms, and narrative text

5_1653.description: 最稳定的触发是 including，常位于补充列举或例示处，跨领域出现。其余高亮分散于拆分词、专名、缩写及格式文本，未呈现清楚一致的触发条件。

patterns.name: including词元
patterns.context: 该词在句中引出补充列举、例子或附加信息；出现在句中、短语开头或换行后。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、邮件、网页、学术文本

patterns.name: 专名或词语的子词片段
patterns.context: 大小写敏感的词片段、名称或缩写被拆分成多个 token；现有材料难以确认这些片段与共同语境的关系。
patterns.domain: 人物姓名、论坛文本、医学缩写等

patterns.name: 疑似格式或清单中的局部触发
patterns.context: 只在单个或少数片段出现，邻近词和句法条件不一致，不能据此确认稳定规则。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页、法律表单、叙述文本

en.concept: The word including and heterogeneous format features
en.description: The most consistent trigger is including, which occurs across a range of topics and styles; there are also sporadic activations on ie in names, code/HTML fragments, numeric formats, and typographic delimiters, which may not share a source.

patterns.name: Jie/ie syllable in names
patterns.context: Occurs when names are split into multiple subword fragments, especially the ie letter sequence in the middle of a name; Stefanie and Zadravec in [1] and Jackie Gallagher in [6] show related activations.

patterns.name: including
patterns.context: The word itself is marked as strongly activating and appears in parenthetical additions, examples, or supplementary lists; surrounding styles and topics vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, web discussions, business email, legal text, news, and legislative reports

patterns.name: Code and markup syntax fragments
patterns.context: Short fragments in HTML tags, attributes, code identifiers, or resource paths activate; no single specific syntax trigger emerges.
patterns.domain: GitHub, web code, and StackExchange questions

patterns.name: Numbers and monetary expressions
patterns.context: Some tokens in numbers, dates, currency amounts, and version numbers activate, usually in structured records or formal text.
patterns.domain: Business email, email headers, legislative reports, web resource paths

patterns.name: Document formatting and delimiters
patterns.context: Weak or sporadic activation occurs near line breaks, HTML angle brackets, and layout separators; common in lists, email headers, and web snippets, with no stable single delimiter pattern.
patterns.domain: Web, email, discussion posts, and legal text

5_1653.concept: including 词及异质格式特征
5_1653.description: 最稳定的触发是 including，跨多种主题与文体出现；另有名字中的 ie、代码/HTML 片段、数字格式及排版边界符的零散激活，彼此未必同源。

patterns.name: 名字中的 Jie/ie 音节
patterns.context: 人名被拆成多个子词片段时，尤其在名字中间的 ie 字母序列；[1] 的 Stefanie、Zadravec 与 [6] 的 Jackie Gallagher 均有相关激活。

patterns.name: including
patterns.context: 该词本身被标记为强激活，出现在括号补充、举例或补充列举中；词前后文体与话题差异很大。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、网页讨论、商业邮件、法律文本、新闻及立法报告

patterns.name: 代码与标记语法片段
patterns.context: HTML 标签、属性、代码标识符或资源路径中的短片段被激活；未形成统一的具体语法触发点。
patterns.domain: GitHub、网页代码及 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 数字与金额表达
patterns.context: 数字、日期、货币和版本号等数字串中部分 token 激活，通常处于结构化记录或正式文本中。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、邮件头、立法报告、网页资源路径

patterns.name: 文档排版与边界符
patterns.context: 换行、HTML 尖括号及版面分隔符附近出现较弱或零散激活；多见于列表、邮件头与网页片段，未显示稳定的单一边界模式。
patterns.domain: 网页、邮件、讨论帖及法律文本

en.concept: The ie string in split words
en.description: Activation often occurs on ie letter fragments in split tokens: names, Baltic-language forms, and medical terms are all represented; there are also a few ordinary word fragments, with no shared semantics apparent.

patterns.name: ie string in names
patterns.context: Occurs inside names that are split into several subword tokens; surrounding names may have surnames, quotation marks, or email-header formatting.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, IRC, email, legal cases

patterns.name: Baltic-language character fragments
patterns.context: Split words contain the ie letter sequence or Baltic-language forms with diacritics; contexts include Latvian parliamentary text, Latin-style text, and Polish text.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Latin-style passages, Polish text

patterns.name: ie string in medical terms
patterns.context: Occurs inside terms or words in medical abstracts, including split medical word forms; the terms themselves are not consistent.

patterns.name: ie in other split words
patterns.context: Besides names and obvious ie substrings, activation also occurs on ordinary words or near other token boundaries, with no stable semantic condition.

5_1653.concept: 拆分词中的 ie 字符串
5_1653.description: 激活多见于拆分 token 中的 ie 字母片段：人名、波罗的海语言词形及医学术语均有；另有少数普通词片段，未显出共同语义。

patterns.name: 人名中的 ie 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在人名内部，名字被拆分为若干子词 token；周围人名可带有姓氏、引号或邮件头格式。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、IRC、邮件、法律判例

patterns.name: 波罗的海语言字符片段
patterns.context: 拆分后的词中出现 ie 字母序列或含变音符号的波罗的海语言词形；语境分别是拉脱维亚语议会文本、拉丁文样式文本和波兰语文本。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、拉丁文样式段落、波兰语文本

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 ie 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在医学摘要的术语或词语内部，包含被拆分的医学词形；但术语本身并不一致。

patterns.name: 其他拆分词中的 ie
patterns.context: 除主要的人名和明显的 ie 子串外，也有普通词或其他分词边界附近的激活，未见稳定语义条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across Organ in organization names, line breaks and directory formats, I and forms of address in email and business phrasing, football proper names and personal names in Wikipedia categories, as well as Arabic text, e-book scan fragments, and address directories; no single semantic pattern covers all samples.

patterns.name: Organ in organization names
patterns.context: Occurs in organization names or categories, often combining with the following word ending to form Organizations; also appears in the name of a chemical research institute.
patterns.domain: Organization directories, disability/autism organization descriptions, academic institution names

patterns.name: Formatting markers and line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks and entry separators repeatedly activate, especially in directories, category lists, or formatted text.
patterns.domain: Web category lists, email, e-books, and organization directories

patterns.name: Personal pronoun I
patterns.context: First-person expressions beginning with I in email body text; this strong trigger appears in only two email samples.

patterns.name: Football categories and club names
patterns.context: Names of football clubs, players, positions, and related topics in Wikipedia category entries; activation falls on subword fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: Personal-name fragments
patterns.context: Names occur in biographical category lists, with strong activation concentrated on tokenized name fragments.

patterns.name: Arabic script symbols
patterns.context: In continuous Arabic text, activation falls on letters, diacritics, and their specially tokenized fragments.

patterns.name: Arabic captions in scanned books
patterns.context: Arabic captions follow e-book scan/illustration placeholders; strong activation mainly falls on special token fragments in the caption text.
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg e-books and scanned prefaces

patterns.name: Email-style salutations and business phrasing
patterns.context: Emails begin with a recipient's name followed by a comma, then move into first-person business communication; other emails contain thanks and accounting-related phrasing.

patterns.name: Administrative addresses and German organization names
patterns.context: Addresses, company addresses, or German organization names are listed item by item; the format resembles a directory rather than ordinary prose.
patterns.domain: Addresses and institutional information in papers or academic documents

patterns.name: Publication metadata and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Front matter made up of e-book source notes, illustration placeholders, separator lines, and scanned text fragments.

patterns.name: Accounting department vocabulary in email body text
patterns.context: An email thanks the recipient and mentions the sender's accounting department; activation is not concentrated on an obvious proper name or list format.

patterns.name: Autism organizations and advocacy content
patterns.context: Discusses autism advocacy, families, and organizational resources, followed by an organization or news headline.

patterns.name: Unclassifiable fragments
patterns.context: These activation fragments occur respectively near the word advocacy and in a sporadic stretch of Latin characters before Arabic text; it is unclear whether they share a cause with the other triggers.
patterns.domain: Web body text and mixed-script text

5_1653.description: 激活分散于机构名中的 Organ、换行与目录格式、邮件中的 I/称呼和商务措辞、维基分类里的足球专名与人名，以及阿拉伯文、电子书扫描残片和地址名录；没有单一语义模式覆盖全部样本。

patterns.name: 机构名称中的 Organ
patterns.context: 出现在机构名或机构类别中，常与后续词尾组成 Organizations；也见于化学研究所名称。
patterns.domain: 机构目录、助残/自闭症组织介绍、学术机构名称

patterns.name: 格式标记与换行
patterns.context: 换行及条目分隔处反复激活，尤其在目录、分类列表或带格式文本中。
patterns.domain: 网页类别列表、邮件、电子书及机构目录

patterns.name: 人称代词 I
patterns.context: 邮件正文中以 I 开头的第一人称表达；此处只有两个邮件样本出现该强触发。

patterns.name: 足球类别与俱乐部名称
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类条目中，足球俱乐部、球员或足球位置等名称；激活落在专名的子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科体育分类

patterns.name: 人物姓名片段
patterns.context: 姓名出现在人物生平分类列表中，强激活集中于姓名的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物分类

patterns.name: 阿拉伯文书写符号
patterns.context: 阿拉伯文连续文本中，激活落在字母、变音符号及其特殊 token 化片段上。

patterns.name: 扫描书籍中的阿拉伯文插图说明
patterns.context: 电子书扫描/插图占位标记后跟阿拉伯文说明；强激活主要落在说明文字中的特殊 token 片段。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书及扫描件前言

patterns.name: 邮件主题式称呼与商务措辞
patterns.context: 邮件以收件人姓名加逗号起头，随后进入第一人称商务沟通；其他邮件含致谢和 accounting 相关措辞。

patterns.name: 行政地址与德语机构名
patterns.context: 地址、公司地址或德语机构名称被逐项列出；与普通句子不同，呈现名录式格式。
patterns.domain: 论文或学术文档中的地址、机构信息

patterns.name: 出版元数据与排版残片
patterns.context: 电子书文件来源说明、插图占位符、分隔线及扫描文本残片构成的前置材料。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书前置页

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的会计部门词汇
patterns.context: 邮件感谢对方后提到本方会计部门；激活并未集中在明显的专名或列表格式上。

patterns.name: Autism 组织及倡议内容
patterns.context: 谈论自闭症倡议、家庭与组织资源，正文后接组织或新闻标题。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的片段
patterns.context: 这些激活片段分别位于倡议一词附近、以及阿拉伯文前的一段零散拉丁字符；无法确认与其他触发是否同因。
patterns.domain: 网页正文及混合字符文本

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: Wikipedia category lists, reminders or requests, and subwords inside miles, conjecture, and courtyards; there is also an evaluation of a risky practice. No single semantic or syntactic pattern covers all snippets.

patterns.name: English Wikipedia category entries
patterns.context: After an encyclopedia article or biographical description, a newline-separated list of Category entries; often involving immigrants, occupations, religious groups, or people

patterns.name: Reminders, warnings, or requests
patterns.context: Second-person expressions addressed to a conversation partner; includes reminding someone, advising, or requesting

patterns.name: Subword fragment of mile/miles
patterns.context: In “travel many miles,” miles is split into two tokens, with activation concentrated on the latter subword fragment

patterns.name: Subword fragment of conjecture
patterns.context: Conjecture occurs in a discussion of whether stable flight has been achieved, with activation concentrated on a middle subword fragment

patterns.name: Comments about risk or danger
patterns.context: Comments on hands-on experimentation and trial and error, first calling it dangerous and then saying it is cool

patterns.name: Subword fragment of courtyard
patterns.context: Describes how different parts of a building and its courtyard make it difficult to identify addresses

5_1653.description: 激活模式分散：维基分类列表、提醒或请求，以及 miles、conjecture、courtyards 等词内部子词；另见对危险做法的评价。没有单一语义或句法模式能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 英文维基分类条目列表
patterns.trigger: «Category»:、重复的类别标签及条目名，如 «British» «motorcycle» «pioneers»、«Mormon» «pioneers»
patterns.context: 百科条目或人物介绍之后，以换行分隔的 Category 分类列表；常涉及移民、职业、宗教群体或人物

patterns.name: 提醒、告诫或提出请求
patterns.context: 面向对话对象的第二人称表达；包括提醒某人、劝告或请求

patterns.name: 词内部的 mile/miles 子词片段
patterns.context: “travel many miles”中 miles 被拆分成两个 token，激活集中在后一个子词片段

patterns.name: 词内部的 conjecture 子词片段
patterns.context: 讨论稳定飞行是否实现时出现 conjecture，激活集中在词中间的子词片段

patterns.name: 围绕风险、危险的评价
patterns.context: 评论动手尝试、试错的做法，先称其危险，再转而认为很酷

patterns.name: 词内部的 courtyard 子词片段
patterns.context: 描述建筑中不同部分及庭院造成的地址辨认困难

en.description: Activation is most prominent on several specific fragments, such as “oster,” “Dams,” “Farms,” “Bets/ets,” and a fragment in “brothels”; there are also weaker or sporadic hits on reagent identifiers, instrument names, and encyclopedia category structures. These span multiple domains and are difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: “oster” fragment in words and names
patterns.context: A continuous spelling fragment containing “oster” occurs in statistical data, an antibody supplier name, an email recipient, or an attorney's name in a legal document.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, PubMed Central, Enron Emails, FreeLaw

patterns.name: “Dams” category entries
patterns.context: A plural noun in a category heading, especially alongside locations, rivers, or construction dates.

patterns.name: “Farms” category entries
patterns.context: A plural noun in a location category heading.

patterns.name: “ets” fragment and related words
patterns.context: Occurs in a title or noun; these examples contain the spelling fragment “ets” but differ in meaning and context.
patterns.domain: HackerNews titles, Enron email body text

patterns.name: “bro” fragment and adult-content vocabulary
patterns.context: In pornographic-advertisement-style text, it repeatedly co-occurs with words such as “sex clubs,” “massage,” and “prostitutes.”

patterns.name: “Cat number” experimental reagent identifier
patterns.context: A catalog-number field following an antibody/reagent name.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, experimental materials and methods

patterns.name: “LightCycler” instrument name
patterns.context: Appears as an instrument or product name in a methods list for quantitative gene expression.

patterns.name: Other category pages and reference structures
patterns.context: Category, notes, and references sections at the end of encyclopedia pages; activation here is weaker and cannot be explained by the spelling-fragment patterns above.

5_1653.description: 激活最突出地落在若干特定词片上，如“oster”“Dams”“Farms”“Bets/ets”及“brothels”中的片段；另有试剂编号、仪器名和百科分类结构等较弱或零散命中，跨越多个领域，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: “oster”词片及人名/词汇
patterns.context: 词中出现含“oster”的连续拼写片段；出现在统计资料、抗体供应商名、邮件收件人或法律文件中的律师姓名。

patterns.name: “Dams”分类条目
patterns.context: 作为分类标题中的复数名词，尤其与地点、河流或建成时间并列。

patterns.name: “Farms”分类条目
patterns.context: 作为地点分类标题中的复数名词。

patterns.name: “ets”词片及其词汇
patterns.context: 出现在标题或名词中；这些例子含有“ets”拼写片段，但语义和语境不同。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 标题、Enron 邮件正文

patterns.name: “bro”片段及成人内容词汇
patterns.context: 在色情广告式文本中，反复与“sex clubs”“massage”“prostitutes”等词共同出现。

patterns.name: “Cat number”实验试剂编号
patterns.context: 作为抗体/试剂名称后的目录编号字段。

patterns.name: “LightCycler”仪器名
patterns.context: 在定量基因表达的实验方法列表中，作为仪器或产品名出现。

patterns.name: 其他分类页与参考资料结构
patterns.context: 百科页面末尾的分类、注释和参考资料区域；此处激活较弱，且无法由上述词片模式解释。

en.description: Activation is mainly scattered across substrings within words in multilingual text, covering English common words and proper names, Bulgarian forms, medical unit symbols, and paper-author names and punctuation; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Consonant or syllable fragments inside English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive subword fragments inside English words; the words vary in spelling and length, and fragments may occur at the beginning or middle of a word, often near punctuation, spaces, or other word fragments.
patterns.domain: English web pages, technology product copy, medical papers, Wikipedia, and academic text

patterns.name: Greek letters and unit symbols
patterns.context: Occurs in the notation of concentrations, solution formulations, temperatures, or imaging parameters; these triggers appear in the same passages as ordinary word fragments.
patterns.domain: Biomedical methods and imaging research text

patterns.name: Fragments inside Bulgarian words
patterns.context: Triggers are scattered inside Bulgarian words spelled in Cyrillic, especially forms and affixes in parliamentary text; the fragments themselves do not show a clear semantic category.

patterns.name: Fragments inside names and citation punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs in citations comprising author lists, Latin-script names, and their footnote or superscript markers; activation covers both name fragments and separators.

patterns.name: English conjunction fragments
patterns.context: Occurs where phrases or items are linked in English sentences, with no stable semantic or syntactic trigger beyond the conjunction itself.

patterns.name: English noun-phrase markers
patterns.context: Occurs in noun phrases describing electronic devices, products, or technology; co-occurs with activations on other word-internal fragments in the same passage.

patterns.name: Word fragments in a specific book title
patterns.context: Occurs in the title Child of the Owl, near a book award and a children's-literature description.

patterns.name: Word fragments in a fixed phrase
patterns.context: Part of camouflage, in a sentence discussing camouflage patterns used for base layers under uniforms; it may also be an isolated instance of activation on an English word-internal fragment.

5_1653.description: 激活主要分散在多语种文本的词内子串上，覆盖英语普通词与专名、保加利亚语词形、医学单位符号及论文作者姓名和标点；未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语中间的辅音或音节片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的连续子词片段上；涉及拼写不同、词长不一的单词，片段可位于词首或词中，周边常有标点、空格或其他词片段。
patterns.domain: 英语网页、科技产品文案、医学论文、维基百科及学术文本

patterns.name: 希腊字母与单位符号
patterns.context: 出现在浓度、溶液配方、温度或成像参数等数值和单位的书写中；这些触发与普通词汇片段同段出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法及影像研究文本

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发分散在西里尔字母拼写的保加利亚语词内部，尤其出现在议会文本中的词形和词缀；这些片段本身未显示出明确的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 保加利亚语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 姓名内部片段与引文标点
patterns.context: 出现在作者名单、拉丁字母姓名及其脚注或上标标记构成的引文中；激活既覆盖姓名片段，也覆盖分隔符。

patterns.name: 英文连接词片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文句子中连接短语或项目的位置，未见稳定的语义或句法触发条件超出其本身。

patterns.name: 英语名词性短语标记
patterns.context: 出现在描述电子设备、产品或技术的名词性短语中；与该段其他单词内部片段的激活并存。

patterns.name: 具体书名中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在作品名 Child of the Owl 中，附近有书籍奖项及儿童文学介绍。

patterns.name: 固定短语中的词片段
patterns.context: 组成 camouflage，出现在讨论球衣下基础层所用伪装图案的句子中；也可能只是英语词内片段激活的个例。
patterns.domain: 体育或服饰相关网页文本

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments within English words, including Out, stems, or suffixes; they also occur in proper names, ship types, and fragments within Bulgarian words. The examples span domains and vary in segmentation position, making them difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Out in Outfitters
patterns.context: Out embedded in an English brand or product name, followed by fitters or other word fragments; [1] is the sponsor name American Eagle Outfitters, and [5] is the product name True Orange Out, But Brown.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sponsor list; product copy in Enron email

patterns.name: Within-word English fragment tokens
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on a segment within a word, rather than a complete word or syntactic unit; the segments occur in Genome-Wide, willow, sloops, Warns, jackets, and Batteries.
patterns.domain: Various English genres, including biomedical text, encyclopedia entries, news headlines, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Latin-Cyrillic letter fragment
patterns.context: Strong activation occurs within Cyrillic words in Bulgarian, particularly in fragments of words related to «закон» (law); there is no clear English semantic or formatting counterpart.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across spelling fragments in organization names, plant names, ship types, place names, and common nouns; they may relate to within-word segmentation, but the triggering fragments are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news links, and product descriptions

5_1653.description: 激活多落在英文词内部的子词片段，包括 Out、词干或词尾；也见于专名、船型及保加利亚语词内片段。跨领域且切分位置不一，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: Outfitters 中的 Out
patterns.context: 嵌在英文品牌或产品名称中的 Out，后接 fitters 或其他词片段；[1] 是赞助商名称 American Eagle Outfitters，[5] 是产品名 True Orange Out、But Brown。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 赞助商列表；Enron 邮件中的产品文案

patterns.name: 英文词内片段 token
patterns.context: 强激活落在词内的一段，而非完整词或句法单位；分别组成 Genome-Wide、willow、sloops、Warns、jackets、Batteries。
patterns.domain: 生物医学文本、百科条目、新闻标题、产品说明等多种英文文体

patterns.name: 拉丁西里尔字母片段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语西里尔字母词内部出现强激活，尤其 «закон»（法律）相关词的字内片段；没有明显的英文语义或格式对应。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 名称与专名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散于机构名、植物名、船型名、地名或普通名词的拼写片段中；可能与词内切分有关，但触发片段并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻链接与产品说明

en.description: Activation is distributed across word-internal fragments in multiple languages and a few punctuation marks and function words; “ard” and “ow” are prominent in hoard/hoarder, cowboy, and willow, but other triggers span unrelated meanings and styles, with limited overall regularity.

patterns.name: The “ard” substring inside words
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments inside English words; the two strongest examples are hoard and hoarder. Similar letter sequences also occur in Dardic and willow, suggesting the trigger may not be limited to the complete “ard”
patterns.domain: Animal-behavior abstracts, home articles, linguistics, plant descriptions

patterns.name: “ow” or adjacent letter fragments inside words
patterns.context: Local letter strings inside English words are marked; the fragments have no consistent meaning, and the activation span for Wide differs from the other examples
patterns.domain: Radio show descriptions, plant descriptions, musical instrument specification tables

patterns.name: Proper names, terminology, and irregular subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across word fragments in different languages, proper names, technical terms, and tables/control instructions, with no shared semantic or positional pattern
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, legal citations, ship catalogs, specification tables, game control instructions

patterns.name: Common function words or inflectional fragments
patterns.context: A few markers occur in ordinary conjunctions, prepositions, or near punctuation; they are weak and difficult to link to a specific word meaning
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, bibliographic citations, linguistics, and catalog text

5_1653.description: 激活分布在多语言词内片段与少量标点、功能词上；“ard”“ow”在 hoard/hoarder、cowboy、willow 等词中较突出，但其他触发跨越无关词义与文体，整体规律有限。

patterns.name: 词内的“ard”子串
patterns.trigger: «ard»9（“ho«ard»9 food”“h«o»3«ard»9er show”）；“D«ard»2ic”“will«ow»9”也有较弱或边界相似形式
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的字母片段上；最强的两例分别来自 hoard、hoarder。另有 Dardic 和 willow 中相似字母序列，说明触发条件可能不止是完整的“ard”
patterns.domain: 动物行为摘要、家居文章、语言学、植物描述

patterns.name: 词内的“ow”或相邻字母片段
patterns.context: 英语词内局部字母串被标记；片段间并无一致词义，且 Wide 的触发范围与其余例子不同
patterns.domain: 广播节目介绍、植物描述、器乐规格表

patterns.name: 专名、术语及不规则子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在不同语言或专名、技术词及表格/控制说明的词片段上，未见共同语义或稳定位置规律
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、法律引文、船舶目录、规格表、游戏控制说明

patterns.name: 常见功能词或词形片段
patterns.trigger: « при»1« так»3«ив»3а；« и»2；« for»等附近词片段，以及«-»4
patterns.context: 少量标记出现在普通连接词、介词或标点邻近处，强度较弱，难以与特定词义建立联系
patterns.domain: 议会文本、书目引文、语言学及目录文本

en.description: Most activations fall on the within-word letter fragments av/ow or ard across different domains and meanings; there are also we fragments in technical text, and punctuation and key names in game-control instructions.

patterns.name: av fragment in stressed syllables
patterns.context: Activation occurs on a letter fragment within a word; token boundaries vary, and spellings such as heavy/heaviest and ow are common.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including news, encyclopedias, academic writing, and email

patterns.name: ard spelling fragment
patterns.context: A sequence of letters within words, embedded in different word forms and proper names.
patterns.domain: Home and garden articles, zoology abstracts, and linguistic encyclopedias

patterns.name: we-related fragments
patterns.context: Appears in URLs/project names and word sequences adjacent to line breaks; the specific word forms and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Punctuation and square brackets in control instructions
patterns.context: In game instructions, a colon marks key descriptions, and square brackets and a hyphen appear at the line end; left, mouse, and other words in the same passage are also marked.

patterns.name: Square-bracket fragment
patterns.context: An incomplete square bracket and hyphen at the end of control instructions, isolated from the patterns in other passages.

5_1653.description: 多数激活落在词内的 av/ow 或 ard 字母片段上，跨越不同领域和词义；另有技术文本中的 we 片段，以及游戏控制说明里的标点和按键词。

patterns.name: 重音节中的 av 片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在单词内部的字母片段；分词边界不固定，常见于 heavy/heaviest、ow 等拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；新闻、百科、学术、邮件等

patterns.name: ard 拼写片段
patterns.context: 单词内部的连续字母片段，分别嵌在不同词形和专名中。
patterns.domain: 家居文章、动物学摘要、语言学百科

patterns.name: we 相关片段
patterns.context: 出现在网址/项目名以及紧邻换行的词串中，具体词形与语境不一致。

patterns.name: 控制说明中的标点与方括号
patterns.context: 游戏操作说明中，冒号标记按键说明，行末出现方括号和连字符；同段也标记了 left、mouse 等词。

patterns.name: 方括号片段
patterns.context: 控制说明末尾的未完结方括号和连字符，孤立于其他段落模式。

en.description: Activation often falls on word-internal letter fragments or punctuation: the cow letter string recurs across contexts; other local patterns include words following only, a fragment in hoarder, a domain suffix, Dutch word-internal fragments, and punctuation in titles and lists.

patterns.name: The word-internal fragment cow
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the word-internal letter fragment “cow” assembled across tokens, without requiring a specific meaning for the word; it occurs in code identifiers, linguistic etymology transcriptions, and ship types.

patterns.name: The domain suffix ing
patterns.context: In the domain string youtube.com/watch?v=..., activation falls on the “ing” letter sequence at the end of the domain.

patterns.name: Words following only
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the word immediately following only in English sentences: benefit and be; adjacent words in the same passage also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in hoarder
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the “ard” fragment in hoarder; the context compares a house to a hoarding show and recommends cleaning it up.

patterns.name: Dutch word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in formal Dutch sentences about trade protection and changes in case counts; activation falls on internal word fragments rather than an obviously consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: News headline and date formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs near line breaks and date-number separators in a list of headlines; the same passage also contains low-intensity, scattered word fragments.

patterns.name: Colon and control-key markers
patterns.context: In a game control-instructions list, punctuation separators activate, especially colons and trailing square brackets and hyphens.

5_1653.description: 激活多落在词内字母片段或标点上：跨语境重复出现 cow 字母串；另有 only 后词、hoarder 内片段、域名末尾、荷兰语词内片段及标题和列表标点等局部模式。

patterns.name: 词内片段 cow
patterns.context: 激活集中在跨 token 拼出的词内字母片段“cow”，不要求该词具有特定语义；出现在代码标识符、语言词源转写和船型名称中。

patterns.name: 域名词尾 ing
patterns.context: 在域名字符串 youtube.com/watch?v=... 中，激活落在域名末尾的“ing”字母序列。

patterns.name: only 后续词
patterns.context: 在英语句子中紧随 only 的词上激活，分别是 benefit 和 be；同段相邻词也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: hoarder 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 hoarder 中的“ard”片段；语境是把房屋与囤积症节目相比并建议清理。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在荷兰语有关贸易保护与案件数量变化的正式句子中，激活落在词的内部片段，而非显然一致的语义类别。

patterns.name: 新闻标题与日期格式
patterns.context: 标题列表中换行及日期数字分隔符附近出现激活；同段还含有低强度的零散词片段。

patterns.name: 冒号和控制键标记
patterns.context: 在游戏操作说明的控制列表中，标点分隔符获得激活，尤其是冒号和末尾方括号、连字符。

en.concept: Local text fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations often fall on word fragments split by tokenization, and also occur in local positions involving quotations, news clippings, slogans, ship-type terms, and line breaks in lists; the examples vary widely in word meaning and domain, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Substring within a tokenized word
patterns.context: Positive activation falls on a fragment inside a word; these fragments do not share stable meanings or forms, and tokenization splits words into multiple marked parts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including biomedicine, papers, film, web, ships, and people’s lists

patterns.name: Citation and bibliography formatting
patterns.context: When citing authors, references, or bibliographic data, activation falls on local elements such as conjunctions, journal abbreviations, and fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in political and religious slogans
patterns.context: In religious-political discourse and uppercase slogans, activation falls on common words and split slogan fragments; no stable single semantic trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Word fragments in news headlines and media bylines
patterns.context: In news-clipping-style headlines, media sources, and date information, activation is distributed across within-word fragments and publication names.
patterns.domain: Business news clippings and forwarded email content

patterns.name: Common word in a technical question
patterns.context: After a web link, a question recommending a resource appears; activation marks only the infinitive preposition “to”, and the context is insufficient to identify a more specific trigger.

patterns.name: Ship-category vocabulary
patterns.context: In directory-style passages about early vessels, the evolution of sailing ships, and modern ship types, local activations occur on multiple ship-category names.

patterns.name: List formatting and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: In lists of people, activation appears on line breaks and near single-letter entries; fragments of names in the list also activate.

patterns.name: Content unexplained by a shared pattern
patterns.context: In a cosmology paper discussing statistical measures, a common adjective activates; it has no clear connection to the other evident cases involving subword fragments, citations, or layout.

5_1653.concept: 文本局部片段与格式特征
5_1653.description: 激活多落在被分词切开的词片段，也出现在引文、新闻剪报、口号、船型术语和名单换行等局部位置；各例的词义与领域差异很大，无法归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 分词中包含子串
patterns.context: 正激活落在一个词的内部片段；这些片段并不共享稳定的词义或词形，分词边界还会把单词拆成多个被标记部分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括生物医学、论文、影视、网页、船舶、人物名单

patterns.name: 引文与文献索引格式
patterns.context: 引用作者、参考文献或书目数据时，激活落在连接词、期刊缩写和作者名片段等局部位置。

patterns.name: 政治宗教口号中的局部词片段
patterns.trigger: « impossible»1、« versions»1、« to»2、SH«AR»4IA THE TRUE« SOL»1UTION« F»3RE«ED»1«OM»1« CAN»2« GO»1 TO HE«LL»8'/’IS«L»2AM« WILL»1« DOM»3IN
patterns.context: 宗教政治论述及大写口号中，激活落在普通词和被拆开的口号词片段；未见稳定的单一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 新闻标题与媒体署名中的词片段
patterns.trigger: St«ru»1«gg»1ling、Houston« Chronicle»1、05/31«/»101、BP« Doesn»4«'t»2、« Source»2、D«ow»8« Jones»1« Energy»1« Service»1
patterns.context: 新闻剪报式标题、媒体来源和日期信息中，激活分布于词内片段及出版物名称。
patterns.domain: 商业新闻剪报、邮件转发内容

patterns.name: 技术问句中的常见词
patterns.context: 网页链接之后出现资源推荐问句时，激活仅标记不定式介词“to”，上下文不足以确认更具体触发因素。

patterns.name: 船舶类别词汇
patterns.context: 介绍早期船只、帆船演变和现代船型的目录式段落中，多个船类名称出现局部激活。

patterns.name: 名单格式与换行边界
patterns.context: 人物名单中，激活出现在换行符以及单字母条目附近；名单里的姓名片段也有激活。

patterns.name: 未能由共同模式解释的内容
patterns.context: 宇宙学论文论述统计量时激活普通形容词；与其余明显的分词片段、引文或版式现象缺少清楚联系。

en.description: Activations are distributed across in-word substrings in texts from multiple domains, especially proper names, inflectional fragments, and formatting markers. Other localized topics include ship types, films, religion, classification, and military history; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on contiguous character spans inside complete words, often affixes, stems, or irregularly segmented forms. The fragments span different parts of speech and cannot be reduced to a single meaning.

patterns.name: Email subject and news headline formatting
patterns.context: Appears in short entries with line-separated email/news headlines, bylines, dates, and dense punctuation.

patterns.name: Fragments of proper names, personal names, and organization names
patterns.context: Proper names appearing in headlines, cast/work descriptions, or address fields; activations may cover only part of a name.

patterns.name: English inflectional and affix fragments
patterns.context: Activations cover roots, derivational affixes, and word endings in common or compound words, usually embedded in narration, names, or classification phrases.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, encyclopedia entries, and classification information

patterns.name: Email address fragments
patterns.context: Located in email addresses joined by @, periods, and commas; activations are distributed across internal fragments of usernames or domain names.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia directories and category entries
patterns.context: References, external links, and category lists following the body of music entries, often accompanied by years and category labels.

patterns.name: Ship types and nautical terminology
patterns.context: In directory-style passages introducing early ships, sailing-ship evolution, and ship types, activations concentrate within ship names and type terms.

patterns.name: Historical battles and date entries
patterns.context: Appears in timeline-style narratives of American Civil War battles, sieges, and battlefield locations, where place names occur next to dates.

patterns.name: Film names and editing descriptions in reviews
patterns.context: In passages comparing films, such as original versions, shot-for-shot remakes, and radical re-edits, activations include fragments within film titles and common words.

patterns.name: Religious organizations and gender-identity-related phrasing
patterns.context: When discussing the ordination of transgender people, religious associations, and church programs welcoming to LGBT people, activations fall on fragments of identity terms, organization names, and program names.

5_1653.description: 激活分布在多领域文本的词内子串，尤见专名、词形片段及格式标记；另有船型、影片、宗教、分类和战史等局部主题，未显示统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 词中间的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词内部的连续字符片段上，常见于词缀、词干或不规则切分；片段本身跨词类，无法归纳为单一词义。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本与子词切分

patterns.name: 邮件标题与新闻标题格式
patterns.context: 出现在换行分隔的邮件／新闻标题、署名、日期及标点密集的短条目中。

patterns.name: 专名、人名与机构名片段
patterns.context: 在标题、演员／作品介绍或地址字段中出现的专名；激活也可能只覆盖名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 英语词形及词缀片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖普通词或复合词中的词根、派生词缀及词尾，通常嵌在叙述、名称或分类词组中。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、百科词条与分类信息

patterns.name: 邮箱地址片段
patterns.context: 位于由 @、点号及逗号连接的邮件地址中，激活沿用户名或域名的内部片段分布。

patterns.name: 百科目录与类别条目
patterns.context: 音乐条目正文之后的参考资料、外部链接和分类列表，常伴随年份及类别标签。

patterns.name: 船只类型与航海术语
patterns.context: 在介绍早期船只、帆船演变及船型的目录式段落中，激活集中于船名和船型词内部。

patterns.name: 历史战役与日期条目
patterns.context: 出现在美国内战战役、围城和战场地点的时间线式叙述中，地点名与日期相邻。

patterns.name: 影评中的影片名与剪辑描述
patterns.context: 在讨论原版与逐镜重拍、激进重剪等影片比较的段落中，激活包括影片名内部片段及一般词。

patterns.name: 宗教组织与性别身份相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论跨性别者受按立、宗教协会及对 LGBT 群体友善的教会项目时，激活落在身份词、机构名和项目名片段上。

en.description: Activations often fall on subwords within words or sporadic tokens; the clearer recurring pattern is the English phrase “At least”, alongside line-break markers in lists and within-word fragments in Baltic languages. The remaining triggers span word meanings, languages, and genres, making them difficult to group under a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Within-word letter or subword fragments
patterns.context: The activation fragment is inside a complete word, often a subword of an English or other-language word; it is not consistently restricted to a particular root or meaning.
patterns.domain: Various text types, including biomedicine, news, academic writing, headlines, and Q&A

patterns.name: Possible suffix or medial “-id” fragment
patterns.context: Appears in personal names; passage 1 is near a biomedical paper citation, while passage 4 is a list.

patterns.name: English “at least” construction
patterns.context: A fixed phrase appears in an English sentence, followed by a quantity or time qualifier; fragments 1, 7, and 10 show strong activation on «least».

patterns.name: Fragments near numerical or enumerative expressions
patterns.context: Activation occurs near statements of quantities, examples, or statistical order, but the triggering words and languages vary.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting markers in lists
patterns.context: Activates in lists arranged with one person’s name per line and letter-group headings; the role in the body text’s semantics is unclear.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Baltic languages
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Latvian or Estonian words; shared spelling fragments across different words may be related, but the evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Other within-word fragments with no single meaning
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across terminology, citations, numbers, headlines, and Russian question text, with no explanation based on shared semantics or stable grammatical conditions.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, academic text, news headlines, Russian technical Q&A

5_1653.description: 激活多落在词内子词或零碎 token 上；较清楚的重复模式是英语短语“At least”，另有名单换行标记和波罗的海语言词内片段。其余触发跨词义、语言与文体，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: 词内字母或子词片段
patterns.context: 激活片段位于完整词内部，常是英文或其他语言词的子词；并未稳定限定为某个词根或词义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、新闻、学术、标题、问答等多种文本

patterns.name: 疑似词尾或词中「-id」片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名中；第1段为生物医学论文引文附近，第4段为名单。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、人物名单

patterns.name: 英语「at least」结构
patterns.context: 在英语句子中出现固定短语，后接数量或时间限定；片段1、7、10均在 «least» 上有强激活。

patterns.name: 数字或枚举表达附近的片段
patterns.trigger: «least»9 27 newspapers；«kaks»1 nä«id»7«et»2（两个例子）；« lowest»2« order»1
patterns.context: 激活出现在数量、例子或统计阶次的陈述附近，但触发词和语言并不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻、议会文本、学术论文

patterns.name: 名单中的换行与格式标记
patterns.context: 在以逐行排列人物姓名、并含字母分组标题的名单中激活；正文语义作用不明显。

patterns.name: 波罗的海语言词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拉脱维亚语或爱沙尼亚语词的内部；不同词中共有的拼写片段可能相关，但证据有限。

patterns.name: 未见单一词义的其它词内片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在术语、引文、数字、标题和俄语问题文本中，无法由共同语义或稳定语法条件解释。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、学术、新闻标题、俄语技术问答

en.description: Activations often fall on local fragments within English words (Out, Heav, Heid, Welsh, Uncertainties), and also repeatedly activate strongly on the Estonian conjunction kuid. The pattern spans corpora and styles, with no unified semantic explanation yet.

patterns.name: kuid / uid substrings in Estonian
patterns.context: In Estonian sentences, activation is strongest when the full conjunction kuid (“but”) appears; the marker starts within kuid, and boundary segmentation may cause only uid to stand out.

patterns.name: English word Out
patterns.context: Phrases beginning with capitalized Out in English headlines or phrases, such as “Outline Press” and “Out of This World”; may relate to headline formatting or word-initial Out.

patterns.name: Un at the start of Uncertainties
patterns.context: Appears in the proper name “Special Fund for Economic Uncertainties”; activation concentrates on the word-initial and stem fragments of Uncertainties.
patterns.domain: Financial/economic text quoted in Enron emails

patterns.name: Heav in Heaviest
patterns.context: A fragment within the English headline word “Heaviest”; the surrounding text is a news headline about tree shrew drinking. Activation falls within the word rather than on a stable standalone word.

patterns.name: Heid in Heidmann
patterns.context: At the beginning of the name “Heidmann,” in an author name cited in a biomedical paper; there is no evidence of a general medical-term pattern.

patterns.name: Heav in Heav'n

patterns.name: elsh in Welsh

5_1653.description: 激活多落在英文词内的局部片段（Out、Heav、Heid、Welsh、Uncertainties），另在爱沙尼亚语转折词 kuid 上反复强激活；跨语料与文体，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语中的 kuid / uid 子串

patterns.name: 英文单词 Out
patterns.context: 英文标题或短语中以大写 Out 开头的词组，如“Outline Press”和“Out of This World”；可能与标题格式或词首 Out 有关。

patterns.name: Uncertainties 中的 Un

patterns.name: Heaviest 中的 Heav

patterns.name: Heidmann 中的 Heid

patterns.name: Heav'n 中的 Heav

patterns.name: Welsh 中的 elsh

en.concept: Specific word forms and substrings in proper names

patterns.name: Swedish “tydlig” forms
patterns.context: Appears in Swedish sentences; segmentation produces tydligt/tydlig, meaning “clear, explicit”. The forms describe market problems, signaling, and opinions or texts.

patterns.name: “Outline” in an English bibliography
patterns.context: Appears in a book bibliography entry as part of the publishing organization name Outline Press Ltd.

patterns.name: “Wylie” in a mathematics competition name
patterns.context: A substring within the proper name Wylie, appearing in the name of the Furman University mathematics competition.

patterns.name: “Outdoor” in the name of a burial survey

patterns.name: “Wylie” in a character’s name

patterns.name: “Welsh” in a category label
patterns.context: Appears in the Wikipedia category label Welsh rock music groups, referring to Welsh rock music.

patterns.name: Unexplained foreign-language fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across several Cyrillic fragments in a Bulgarian-like passage, with no evident shared word-form or semantic trigger condition linking them to other passages.

patterns.name: Unexplained ArXiv fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the cited author name @Heavens1998; it has no evident shared meaning or stylistic function with the other highly activating substrings.

5_1653.description: 激活主要落在若干特定词或专名的内部子串：瑞典语 tydlig 词形，以及英文 Outline、Wylie、Outdoor、Welsh 等；另有保加利亚语碎片与引用作者名。

patterns.name: 未解释的 ArXiv 碎片
patterns.context: 出现在引用作者名 @Heavens1998 的内部；与其他高激活子串缺少明显共同词义或文体功能。

en.concept: English out and word forms such as Swedish tydligt
en.description: Strongly responds to the English string out (in different contexts including album titles, locations, church names, coming out, and baseball outs), and also to Swedish tydligt. Other activations include the directory term based and the string dwalt.

patterns.name: Swedish tydligt
patterns.context: The full word “tydligt” (clearly/obviously) appears in Swedish text, in contexts evaluating facts or arguments.

patterns.name: English out
patterns.context: English phrases beginning with capitalized Out; appears in bibliographic titles and music album titles.

patterns.name: English based

patterns.name: English Welcoming

patterns.name: English out (verb)

patterns.name: English out (baseball)

patterns.name: String dwalt

5_1653.concept: 英文 out 及瑞典语 tydligt 等词形

patterns.name: Swedish tydligt

patterns.name: 英文 out

patterns.name: 英文 Welcoming

en.description: Most strong activations occur in Category listings and place-related categories at the end of Wikipedia entries, often on category words, place names, or compound-word subword fragments; the rest are within-word fragments in Greek, research citations, forum questions, and plant names, with no single consistent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Place categories in Wikipedia category entries
patterns.context: Category lists at the end of Wikipedia entries; common for companies, organizations, archaeological sites, towns, and institutions. Activation concentrates on category words, places, and adjacent fragments.

patterns.name: End-of-entry lists with category names
patterns.context: One or more category labels appear after the entry text or references; some category names concern non-place attributes such as film year, nationality, medium, or institution type.

patterns.name: Segments within compound words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within words, rather than complete words; examples commonly occur in compound words or proper names in category labels.

patterns.name: Within-word Greek fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Greek text, activation falls on character fragments within words; this passage does not show the structure of a Wikipedia category list.

patterns.name: Citations and abbreviations in scientific literature
patterns.context: Research papers describe experiments and cite journals, volume and page numbers, years, and authors; activation falls on fragments within abbreviations or author names.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in a Q&A context
patterns.context: Discusses whether an early-stage startup team needs a designer and whether relevant people can be found; activation falls inside ordinary English words or at word boundaries.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in plant taxonomy names and descriptions
patterns.context: A botanical entry describes subspecies morphology and lists scientific and common names; activation falls within Latin names and English common plant names.

5_1653.description: 多数强激活出现在 Wikipedia 条目末尾的 Category 分类及地点类目中，常落在分类词、地名或复合词子词片段；其余为希腊语、科研引文、论坛问答和植物名称中的词内片段，缺少单一一致触发条件。

patterns.name: 带有类别名的条目尾部列表

patterns.name: 复合词内部的切分片段

en.description: Activations are scattered across structured tails or metadata in webpages and documents: especially Wikipedia category lists (including in, and, and work/year categories), as well as subscription prompts, music genres, car configurations, patent boilerplate, Russian month names, and paper fields. No single word meaning explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Category labels near “in”
patterns.context: The trigger fragment appears in category names or labels, usually the preposition in followed by a topic or field; examples include “Eugenics in fiction” and “Adultery in films”.

patterns.name: Structural markers in category headings
patterns.context: Many category entries begin with Category:, followed by work types, countries, years, or topics. The neuron shows sporadic activation on multiple words in category entries; not every category triggers equally.
patterns.domain: Categories and navigation lists at the end of Wikipedia pages

patterns.name: Conjunction “and” at category boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in adjacent category names, article text, or news snippets, with no fixed position or meaning; it also activates in “-and-” in segment 2.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia category lists and general webpage text

patterns.name: Website newsletter subscription prompt
patterns.context: Near “Newsletter Sign up,” often in a webpage footer or navigation area and accompanied by line breaks.
patterns.domain: Website pages and news promotional copy

patterns.name: Style or subgenre names in categories
patterns.context: The trigger is a specific music genre or category name in album classifications.

patterns.name: References and external-links section at the end of a webpage entry
patterns.context: Fixed section headings after the body of an encyclopedia page and before the category list; there is slight activation near these unmarked words.

patterns.name: Specific components in car feature lists
patterns.context: In parallel lists of vehicle features, especially items such as power door locks, power mirrors, and keyless entry.

patterns.name: Qualifying language in patent templates
patterns.context: Appears in a common patent specification disclaimer about the use of illustrations, stating that embodiments and drawings are not limiting.
patterns.domain: Patent background or specification legal boilerplate

patterns.name: Character fragments in Russian month names
patterns.context: Activations fall on Cyrillic subword fragments inside Russian month names rather than on complete words; the surrounding text is a list of month strings.
patterns.domain: Russian text in code or data

patterns.name: Paper titles and metadata markers
patterns.context: Triggered in paper titles and subsequent formatted metadata fields, including LaTeX/XML-like markup.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in proper names or webpage content
patterns.context: Located in personal and brand names in news promotional sentences; cannot be matched to the stable trigger conditions in other segments.
patterns.domain: Local news or commercial promotional webpages

patterns.name: Tennis tournament year categories
patterns.context: A year followed by in tennis / Australian tennis, forming a tournament or sports category heading.

5_1653.description: 激活分散于网页与文档的结构化尾部或元数据：尤其是 Wikipedia 分类列表（含 in、and、作品/年份类别），也见订阅提示、音乐流派、汽车配置、专利套语、俄语月份及论文字段；没有单一词义能解释全部片段。

patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子中谈及转型、援助及合作；触发片段分散在多个词内

patterns.name: 专利法律限定语
patterns.context: 专利背景部分说明附图仅作示例、不得解释为界定发明范围

patterns.name: 网页导航与订阅提示
patterns.context: 网页页眉或导航区域中的 Newsletter Sign Up 提示

patterns.name: 电影网页标题与影片名称
patterns.context: 电影网站的标题、菜单及影片名片段

patterns.name: 华盛顿雕塑分类
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类条目，按地点、年代或材质列出雕塑类别

patterns.name: 教堂建筑分类
patterns.context: 教堂历史条目末尾的建筑分类标签

en.description: Activation is most concentrated in category lists at the ends of Wikipedia articles, especially “in” in category names; it also appears on “koostööd” in Estonian parliamentary text, as well as in two passages of poetry and one configuration string, where the evidence for triggering is weaker.

patterns.name: Wikipedia category list entries
patterns.context: Multiple categories are listed consecutively on separate lines after the article body or references; activation often falls on words such as “in” in category names

patterns.name: Estonian term for cooperation
patterns.context: In an EU parliamentary context discussing cooperation, development aid, or relations with neighboring countries; activation falls mainly on subword fragments within the term

patterns.name: comply in poetry
patterns.context: An English dramatic verse line expressing obedience or adherence to a principle, adjacent to a line break and verse formatting

patterns.name: Version string in configuration text
patterns.context: Appears as part of a hyphenated version value in a GitHub configuration or metadata field

patterns.name: out in poetry
patterns.context: Part of a set prepositional phrase in English narrative verse, preceded by descriptive language

5_1653.description: 激活最集中于维基百科条目尾部的分类列表，尤其分类名中的“in”；也见爱沙尼亚语议会文本的“koostööd”，以及两处诗文和一处配置字符串，后几者触发依据较弱。

patterns.name: 维基百科分类条目列表
patterns.trigger: “Category:”及分类词串，如“Category: Houses completed in”“Category: National Register of Historic Places in”
patterns.context: 条目正文或参考资料之后，以换行分隔、连续列出多个分类；激活常落在分类名称中的“in”等词上
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科条目尾部

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语合作用词
patterns.context: 欧盟议会语境中谈及合作、发展援助或邻国关系；激活主要落在该词内部的子词片段

patterns.name: 诗歌中的 comply
patterns.context: 英文戏剧诗行中表达服从或遵从原则，紧邻换行及诗体排版

patterns.name: 配置文本中的版本字符串
patterns.context: GitHub 配置或元数据字段中，作为带连字符版本值的一部分出现

patterns.name: 诗歌中的 out
patterns.context: 英文叙事诗体文本中作为固定介词短语的一部分，前接描写性语句

en.concept: Multiple patterns of word fragments and formatting triggers
en.description: Strong activations are mainly found in questions and unit-relation words in fraction-based unit-conversion problems. Other activations appear in chapter headings, legal compounds, explanatory phrases, and Wikipedia category metadata. Some fragments within proper names also activate, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Quantifiers/prepositions in fraction and unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: Math questions ask about a fraction of a unit quantity or conversions between different units; activations may fall on question words, unit-relation words, and fraction terms, with activation also at the answer.

patterns.name: Numerical markers in chapter headings
patterns.context: Roman-numeral chapter headings are followed by line breaks and section headings; activations concentrate around periods and heading formatting.

patterns.name: Compound ordinal expressions in legal text
patterns.context: In legal explanations, a hyphen joins a number word and the name of a judicial office; strong activations fall on “just” and “to”.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker in explanatory phrases
patterns.context: An explanatory aside introduces a gloss; strong activation falls on “to”, surrounded by popular-science discussion of meteors.

patterns.name: Category names and locations in encyclopedia category entries
patterns.context: At the end of Wikipedia entries, repeated Category fields list location-related categories; activations are scattered across category terms and place names.

patterns.name: Proper names or in-word word-part fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in tokenized fragments of proper names, organization names, or category terms, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Various encyclopedia/book texts, including literary history, place names, and music categories

5_1653.concept: 多模式词片段与格式触发
5_1653.description: 强激活主要见于分数单位换算题中的问句及单位关系词；另见章节标题、法律复合词、释义短语和维基百科分类元数据。若干专名词内片段也被激活，无法归为统一语义。

patterns.name: 分数与单位换算题中的量词/介词
patterns.context: 数学问句询问一个单位量的分数，或不同单位间的换算；激活可落在问句词、单位关系词和分数词上，答案处也有激活。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的单位换算练习

patterns.name: 章标题中的数字标记
patterns.context: 罗马数字章节标题之后接换行和小节标题；激活集中在句点及标题格式附近。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍正文/章节标题

patterns.name: 法律文本中的复合序数表达
patterns.context: 法律说明中，连字符连接数字词与司法职务名称；强激活落在 “just” 和 “to”。

patterns.name: 解释性短语中的不定式标记
patterns.context: 说明性插入语引出释义；强激活在 “to”，周围为流星现象的科普叙述。

patterns.name: 百科分类条目中的类别名与地点
patterns.trigger: “Category:”及其后的类别标签，如 “Buildings and structures”“Tourist attractions”“National Historic Sites”
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾以重复的 Category 字段列出地点相关分类；激活散布在类别词和地名中。

patterns.name: 专名或词内分词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在被分词切开的专名、机构名或类别词片段中，未见一致的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 小说史料、地名与音乐分类等多种百科/书籍文本

en.concept: Category text and sporadic subword patterns
en.description: Activation is most concentrated in Wikipedia category lists, particularly location qualifiers following category names and church-architecture categories; album genre categories also appear. The rest is scattered across fragments within words such as foxtail, configuration fields, operations notices, negative comments, and book contents, with no consistent semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: “in” and location hierarchy in category titles
patterns.context: Wikipedia category titles where a location qualifier follows a category name; often appears with multiple consecutive Category entries, punctuation, and line breaks

patterns.name: Religious architecture and church-related categories
patterns.context: Historical descriptions or category entries for church buildings, often accompanied by location categories; overlaps with the category hierarchy pattern

patterns.name: Token activation within nouns or roots
patterns.context: Activation falls on short token fragments within words rather than complete semantic units; it may be sensitive to particular subword spellings or segmentations, but the available examples are insufficient to establish a consistent condition
patterns.domain: Mixed: narrative text, configuration text, literary contents

patterns.name: Music genres and album categories in category lists
patterns.context: Consecutive Wikipedia album category entries, especially combinations of genre names and albums/by artists

patterns.name: Labeled configuration or metadata fields
patterns.context: Key-value text containing field names, quotation marks, and configuration values; activation also falls on an internal fragment of the value “foxtail”

patterns.name: Server names in system outage notices
patterns.context: Brief maintenance or outage notice templates; fragments “fo”, “xt”, and “rot” within “foxtrot” are marked

patterns.name: Derogatory judgments about people and attribution of Southern identity
patterns.context: Colloquial, insulting comments containing “to be” and a regional attribution

patterns.name: Hostile remarks and the phrase “out of”
patterns.context: A narrative describes a person criticizing a target and comments possibly receiving no response; activation is scattered across un- words and the phrase “out of”

patterns.name: Chapter titles and directory text related to monasteries
patterns.context: Book chapter titles and contents-style summaries; title numbering, religious institutions, and the phrase “out of” appear

patterns.name: Historical sites and heritage-list narratives
patterns.context: A church history description followed by references and category entries; strong markers fall mainly on the fragments “anc” and “et” and on category text

patterns.name: Angular building categories
patterns.context: Architectural shape categories in Wikipedia category lists, alongside prison and museum categories

5_1653.concept: 分类文本与零散子词模式
5_1653.description: 激活最集中于维基百科分类列表，特别是类别名后接“in”地点限定及教堂建筑分类；另见专辑流派分类。其余分散在 foxtail 等词内片段、配置字段、运维通知、负面评论和书籍目录中，未显示统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 分类标题中的“in”及地点层级
patterns.trigger: « in»，尤其是“museums in Ontario”“buildings in Canada”“church buildings in North Carolina/Gloucester”
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类标题中，类别名后接地点限定；常与多个连续的 Category 条目及标点换行一起出现

patterns.name: 宗教建筑与教会相关分类
patterns.trigger: “Episcopal church buildings”“Church of England church buildings”“churches”“baptistery”
patterns.context: 教堂建筑的历史介绍或分类条目，常伴随地点分类；与分类层级模式重叠

patterns.name: 名词或词根内部的分词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的短 token 片段，而非完整语义单位；可能对特定子词拼写或切分敏感，现有例子不足以确定一致条件
patterns.domain: 混合：叙述文字、配置文本、文学目录

patterns.name: 类别列表中的音乐流派与专辑分类
patterns.context: 连续的 Wikipedia 专辑分类条目，尤其是流派名与 albums/by artists 组合

patterns.name: 带标签的配置或元数据字段
patterns.context: 键值式文本中出现字段名、引号和配置值；激活也落在值“foxtail”的内部片段

patterns.name: 系统故障通知中的服务器名称
patterns.trigger: “Outage: Update to new disk layout for server foxtrot”“Environments Impacted”
patterns.context: 简短的维护或故障通知模板；“foxtrot”内部的“fo”“xt”“rot”片段被标记
patterns.domain: 企业邮件/IT 运维通知

patterns.name: 对人物的贬损性评价及南方身份判断
patterns.trigger: “buffoon”“to be expected since he's from the south”
patterns.context: 口语化、带侮辱性的评论，句中出现“to be”及地域归因

patterns.name: 攻击性言论及“out of”短语
patterns.context: 叙述人物批评对象、评论可能无人回应；激活分散在 un- 词与“out of”短语

patterns.name: 章节标题与修道院相关目录文字
patterns.trigger: “CHAPTER IV.”、“Anecdotes of the Sacré Cœur”、“just out of the convent”
patterns.context: 书籍章节标题与目录式摘要；可见标题编号、宗教机构及“out of”短语
patterns.domain: 文学作品扫描文本/目录

patterns.name: 历史地点与遗产名录叙述
patterns.trigger: “windows”“rebuilt after it burned in 1885”“National Register of Historic Places”
patterns.context: 教堂历史介绍后接参考文献和类别条目；主要强标记落在“anc”“et”片段及分类文本

patterns.name: 棱角形建筑分类
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类列表中的建筑形状类别，与监狱及博物馆类别并列

en.description: The main pattern is chains of categories and category names at the ends of encyclopedia articles, often accompanied by plural category labels, architecture/location categories, and stock phrases from historical listings. Other activations include operations email fields, un- word fragments, bibliography end matter, self-help prose, and sporadic phrases and function words.

patterns.name: Wikipedia category titles and category chains
patterns.context: The category section at the end of an encyclopedia article, especially when category names contain multiple words, proper nouns, or specialized topics; activation often falls on category words, affixes, and adjacent punctuation

patterns.name: Stock phrasing in National Register of Historic Places entries
patterns.context: Describes a site or building listed on the U.S. National Register of Historic Places, followed by a year, state name, and article-end content such as References and Category entries

patterns.name: Plural categories and morphological segmentation
patterns.context: Noun category labels in encyclopedia categories or category-like phrases, often plural or compound; different subword fragments of category terms may activate

patterns.name: Technical outage notice fields
patterns.context: An outage/change notification in an email, containing fields such as server disk layout updates and affected environments; activation falls on fragments of outage and host names, as well as field text
patterns.domain: Enron corporate email, IT operations notices

patterns.name: Negation and expressions of unrealized or unanswered actions
patterns.context: Word-initial un- and subsequent stem fragments in English; in adjacent sentences they express being unshaken, unanswered, harshly attacking (unloaded), or a problem state, without a unified meaning
patterns.domain: Philosophical commentary, news narratives, and general prose

patterns.name: Title and bibliography citation formatting
patterns.context: Book names/titles, publication information, or external links sections at the end of an entry, adjacent to category metadata

patterns.name: Purpose and success language in instructional prose
patterns.context: Near paragraphs and numbered subheadings in persuasive or self-help articles, with statements about clarification, purpose, or the relationship between success and happiness

patterns.name: Phrase combinations and common function words outside categories
patterns.context: These activations fall on fixed phrases or high-frequency function words in ordinary narrative, with no context sufficient to establish a unified specialized meaning

5_1653.concept: 百科分类与条目尾部模式
5_1653.description: 主模式是百科条目尾部的分类链及类别名，常伴随分类复数、建筑/地点类别和历史名录套语。另有运维邮件字段、un-词形分片、书目尾项、自助文体，以及零散短语和功能词激活。

patterns.name: 维基百科分类标题与分类链
patterns.trigger: «Category:»、«Category:Album»s、«Category:Church»、«Category:» 后接类别名称；常见 «↵» 与多级分类连续出现
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾的分类区，尤其分类名称由多个词组成、包含专名或细分主题时；激活常落在分类词、词缀及相邻标点上

patterns.name: 国家历史名录条目套语
patterns.trigger: «listed» on the National« Register» of Historic Places« in»；«National Register of Historic Places»
patterns.context: 描述地点或建筑被列入美国国家历史名录，后接年份、州名及 References、Category 等条目尾部内容
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 历史地点/建筑条目

patterns.name: 类别复数及形态切分
patterns.context: 百科分类或分类式短语中的名词类别标签，常有复数、复合名词，且类别词的不同子词片段均可能激活

patterns.name: 技术故障通知字段
patterns.context: 邮件中的故障/变更通知，包含服务器磁盘布局更新及受影响环境等字段；激活落在 outage 与主机名片段及字段文字上
patterns.domain: Enron 企业邮件、IT 运维通知

patterns.name: 否定词与未实现/未回应表达
patterns.context: 英语词首 un- 与后续词干分片；在相邻句中分别表示不可动摇、未回应、猛烈抨击（unloaded）或问题状态，语义并不统一
patterns.domain: 哲学评论、新闻叙述及一般散文

patterns.name: 标题与书目引文格式
patterns.context: 条目末尾的书名/标题、出版信息或外部链接小节，和分类元数据相邻
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 参考书目及页面尾部

patterns.name: 指导性散文中的目的与成功措辞
patterns.context: 劝导或自助类文章的段落与编号小标题附近，出现澄清、目的或成功/幸福关系的表述

patterns.name: 分类以外的短语搭配及常见功能词
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在普通叙述中的固定短语或高频功能词上，未见足以确立统一专门语义的上下文

en.concept: is to followed by an infinitive
en.description: The most stable pattern is the “is to” construction, especially with a following infinitive or passive structure. Other activations are scattered across subwords within words, category directories, URL dates, and number formats, spanning styles without a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Fixed construction “is to”
patterns.context: Appears after “is to”; the following phrase may be a base-form verb, passive construction, or “be”, as in “is to attack”, “is to review”, “is to be feared”, and “is not to be”.

patterns.name: Word-final or in-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments inside words, often aligned with segmentation, affix, or proper-name spelling boundaries; no unified semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal text, webpage titles, proper names, and academic text

patterns.name: Category directory formatting
patterns.context: In Wikipedia category lists, activations are scattered across category names, compounds, and adjacent words; not every Category item is marked equally.

patterns.name: Number and percentage formatting
patterns.context: Percentage-size values in image markup.

patterns.name: URL path separators and date fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the path and year/month dates of mailing-list links.

patterns.name: Title-style proper names and category terms
patterns.context: Localized activations appear in proper names or title text, such as place names, work titles, or archaeological categories; this partly overlaps with directory formatting, but trigger locations are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: News snippets and Wikipedia geography and archaeology entries

5_1653.description: 最稳定的模式是“is to”搭配，尤其其后的不定式或被动结构。其余激活分散在词内子词、分类目录、URL日期和数字格式中，跨文体且缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“is to”
patterns.context: 出现在“is to”之后；后续可接动词原形、被动结构或“be”，如“is to attack”“is to review”“is to be feared”“is not to be”。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的子词片段，常与分词、词缀或专名拼写边界重合；没有显示出统一的词义条件。
patterns.domain: 法律、网页标题、专名及学术文本

patterns.name: 分类目录格式
patterns.trigger: «Category:»及其后紧邻的类别词，如«Post»«hard»«core»« albums»、«Archaeological»« sites»
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类列表中，激活散布于类别名、复合词及其相邻词；并非每个 Category 项目都同样标记。

patterns.name: 数字及百分数格式
patterns.context: 图像标记中的百分比尺寸数值。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的 Markdown/图像标记

patterns.name: URL 路径分隔符与日期片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件列表链接的路径和年月日期中。

patterns.name: 标题式专名与类别词
patterns.context: 地名、作品名或考古分类等专名/标题文本中出现局部激活；与目录格式部分重叠，但触发位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻片段及 Wikipedia 地理、考古条目

en.concept: Preference for infinitival to, mixed with heterogeneous triggers
en.description: Most English passages highlight the infinitival marker to, especially to be; sporadic word forms or phrases such as free of, out of, and union busters also trigger. In two Latvian passages, et occurs within a word and cannot be unified with the English pattern.

patterns.name: to before infinitival be
patterns.context: The active marker falls on infinitival to, often immediately followed by be, and sometimes say; preceding text may involve different structures such as evaluation, inference, obligation, or legal review
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, legal texts, literature, forums, and philosophical discussion

patterns.name: Word-internal et in Latvian
patterns.context: et occurs within words: ietvaros in the first example and ietekme in the second; both are Latvian sentences, in economic or social policy contexts respectively

patterns.name: free phrase
patterns.context: free combines with of in a legal expression meaning not subject to a mortgage or lien

patterns.name: union in union busters
patterns.context: Appears in criticism of university officials, where union modifies busters, meaning people who break unions

patterns.name: feared in literary context
patterns.context: Embedded in the expression “it is to be feared,” describing an unfortunate event that may still occur

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Under
patterns.context: A sentence-initial prepositional phrase introduces conditional background, followed by a judgment about the reasonableness of a contract

patterns.name: out of phrase
patterns.context: out of introduces a motive for an action, meaning in consideration of a fact

patterns.name: not all concessive expression
patterns.context: Parenthetically qualifies agreement with the people concerned as not universal

patterns.name: thousand fires before a noun
patterns.context: Literary description of numerous lights illuminating a capital at night

patterns.name: Bestseller title words
patterns.context: The segmentation marker covers Selling Best, appearing in a verse about book sales

5_1653.concept: 不定式标记 to 偏好，但混有异质触发
5_1653.description: 多数英语段落突出 to 不定式标记，尤其 to be，也有 free of、out of、union busters 等零散词形或短语触发；两段拉脱维亚语的 et 位于词内，无法与英语模式统一。

patterns.name: to be 不定式前的 to
patterns.context: 活跃标记落在不定式标记 to 上，常紧接 be，也出现 say；前文可为评价、推断、义务或法律审查等不同结构
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、法律文本、文学、论坛及哲学论述

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内 et
patterns.context: et 位于词内：第一例为 ietvaros，第二例为 ietekme；均在拉脱维亚语句子中，且分别处于经济或社会政策语境
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: free 短语
patterns.trigger: «free»3 of each of them；sold «free»1 of liens
patterns.context: free 与 of 构成法律表达，说明不受抵押权或留置权约束

patterns.name: union busters 中的 union
patterns.context: 出现在对大学官员的批评中，union 修饰 bust­ers，指破坏工会者

patterns.name: 文学语境中的 feared
patterns.context: 嵌在“it is to be feared”表达中，描述不幸现象仍可能发生

patterns.name: 句首 Under
patterns.context: 句首介词短语引出条件背景，后接对合同合理性的判断

patterns.name: out of 短语
patterns.context: out of 引出行为动机，意为出于对某事实的顾及

patterns.name: not all 让步表达
patterns.context: 括号中限定对相关人员的认同并非全体

patterns.name: 名词前的 thousand fires
patterns.context: 文学描写夜间照亮首都的众多灯火

patterns.name: 畅销书标题词
patterns.context: 拆分标记覆盖 Selling Best，出现在图书销量诗句中

en.description: Activation patterns are heterogeneous: English tends toward not/only structures after to; encyclopedia article endings concentrate on category labels and word fragments; poetry conjunctions, within-word segmentation in encyclopedia text, and Estonian within-word fragments also appear.

patterns.name: Negation or restriction after “to”
patterns.context: not follows infinitival to (e.g., “not to mention,” “not to be”), or only introduces a purpose/result structure; not all instances of “to” trigger.
patterns.domain: English narrative, recipes, literary dialogue, and forum text

patterns.name: Within-word fragments and boundaries in English
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within words rather than complete words; this passage includes segmentation in split or compound words, such as “co«x»sw«ain»”.

patterns.name: Wikipedia page categories and link endings
patterns.context: References, categories, category labels, and adjacent headings or entity names at the end of encyclopedia articles; activation is distributed across varied category terms and proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article endings and category lists

patterns.name: Conjunctions or prepositions in poetry
patterns.context: Appears in verse, connecting coordinated elements or introducing an infinitive; markers in this passage are scattered, with no stable dedicated phrase.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Estonian
patterns.context: Activation lies within consecutive Estonian word forms, involving a word with diacritics and word endings; differs from the English trigger structures.

5_1653.description: 激活模式异质：英语中偏向 to 后的 not/only 结构；百科条目尾部集中于分类标签及词片段；另见诗歌连接词、百科词内切分和爱沙尼亚语词内片段。

patterns.name: “to”后否定或限制结构
patterns.trigger: “to”后出现 «not» 或直接在 «only» to 之后
patterns.context: 不定式标记 to 后紧接 not（如“not to mention”“not to be”），或 only to 引出的目的/结果结构；并非所有“to”均触发。
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、食谱、文学对话及论坛文本

patterns.name: 英语词内片段与边界
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部片段，而非完整词上；本段包含分词或复合词的切分，如“co«x»sw«ain»”。

patterns.name: 百科页面分类与链接尾部
patterns.trigger: «Category:»及分类名中被标记的词片段，如“«Muse»ums”“«Modern» art”“«novels»”
patterns.context: 百科词条末尾的参考资料、分类、类别标签及相邻标题或实体名；激活分布在多种分类词和专名上。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目尾部与分类列表

patterns.name: 诗歌中的连接词或介词
patterns.context: 出现在韵文诗句中，连接并列成分或引入不定式；本段标记分散，未显示稳定的专属短语。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于连续的爱沙尼亚语词形内部，涉及含变音符号的词及词尾；与英语触发结构不同。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会文本

en.concept: not to phrases and category endings
en.description: The most consistent activation corresponds to “not to” and its supplementary or enumerative uses (especially “not to mention”); “Not to speak of,” “not to be,” Wikipedia person-category endings, and a few sporadic phrases also appear.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “not to mention”
patterns.context: “not to mention” as a supplementary, escalating, or emphatic phrase; it may precede or follow a complete sentence or noun phrase.
patterns.domain: Narrative, technical Q&A, commentary, expository prose

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Not to…” for addition or qualification
patterns.context: A sentence-initial phrase adds to or qualifies preceding content; it does not necessarily continue with mention.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Not to speak of”
patterns.context: “Not to speak of…” continues an enumeration or strengthens the preceding argument.

patterns.name: Category-name endings in Wikipedia categories
patterns.context: Category names and their endings are marked in category lists at the end of entries; adjacent category markers and line breaks also commonly appear.

patterns.name: Ordinary conjunctions and residual phrases
patterns.context: Appears in narrative or literary text but shows no stable shared collocation; these fragments alone do not establish consistent triggering conditions.

patterns.name: “end and” mixed with person categories
patterns.context: A local phrase appears at the start of the passage, followed by a Wikipedia person-category list; it is unclear whether the main activation comes from the phrase or the category format.

patterns.name: “not to be” in an escape context
patterns.context: “not to be” is embedded in a negative sentence, forming an expression meaning “not to be taken lightly,” distinct from the fixed phrase “not to mention.”

5_1653.description: 激活最一致地对应“not to”及其补充、列举用法（尤其“not to mention”）；另见“Not to speak of”“not to be”，以及 Wikipedia 人物分类词尾和少数零散词组。

patterns.name: “not to mention”固定搭配
patterns.context: “not to mention”作为补充、递进或强调的短语；前后可接完整句或名词短语。
