patterns.context: A person performs a sequence of bodily actions, described in order; strong activations fall on multiple action words and prepositions rather than a single salient term.

5_2017.description: 强激活主要出现在 when 引导的条件或时间从句，也见于 later 表示后续时间；另有一段引用标记结构和一段连续身体动作描写，触发形式不同。

patterns.name: when 引导的条件或时间从句
patterns.trigger: «when»9，以及后续的 «the»、«I» 或动词短语
patterns.context: when 引出某个条件或时间情境，描述在该情境下发生的状态、变化或结果；不要求固定主语或领域。
patterns.domain: 医学、专利、百科、新闻与一般叙述

patterns.name: 过去时间标记 later
patterns.context: later 标记相对于前文的后续时间或事后评价，通常位于谓语之前。

patterns.name: 引文标记与括号结构
patterns.context: 密集的上标、方括号和花括号组成参考文献交叉引用标记；激活集中于结构符号而非普通叙述词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文的 XML/标记化参考文献文本

patterns.name: 连续动作叙述
patterns.context: 人物连续进行身体动作，按动作顺序描写；强激活落在多个动作词和介词上，而非单一显著术语。

en.description: Primarily responds to later in narratives, especially when it introduces a subsequent event after the subject; it also activates strongly on when clauses introducing time or conditions, event conditions introduced by upon, and the patent formula will appreciate that.

patterns.name: Temporal adverb later
patterns.context: In accounts of people or events, it often follows a subject or relative pronoun and indicates what happens afterward; [1] is in “who later resigned,” [3] “she later said,” [4] “He later was,” [7] “who later fell out,” and [10] “who later added.”

patterns.name: Time or condition clauses introduced by when
patterns.context: Introduces the circumstances or conditions under which something happens; examples include “when I told him,” “when the patient was lying,” and “when variables …”.
patterns.domain: Personal recollection, medical case reports, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Conditional or temporal phrases introduced by upon
patterns.context: “upon ingestion” means at or after ingestion, followed by the biological effect.

patterns.name: Acknowledgment formula in patents
patterns.context: Appears in the conventional patent phrase “those skilled in the art will appreciate that …”, introducing something the reader is expected to understand.

5_2017.concept: 后续事件与时间条件引导
5_2017.description: 主要响应叙述中的 later，尤其是主语后引出后续事件；也对 when 引导的时间或条件从句、upon 引出的事件条件，以及专利套语 will appreciate that 有较强激活。

patterns.name: later 时间副词
patterns.context: 在人物或事件叙述中，常接在主语或关系代词之后，表示随后发生的事；[1]位于“who later resigned”，[3]“she later said”，[4]“He later was”，[7]“who later fell out”，[10]“who later added”。

patterns.name: when 引导的时间或条件从句
patterns.context: 引出某事发生时的情形或条件；见“when I told him”“when the patient was lying”“when variables …”。
patterns.domain: 口语回忆、医学病例、技术问答

patterns.name: upon 引导的条件或时间短语
patterns.context: “upon ingestion”表示摄入时或摄入后，后接生物作用结果。

patterns.name: 专利套语中的认可判断
patterns.context: 出现在“those skilled in the art will appreciate that …”这一专利惯用表达中，引出读者应理解的内容。

en.description: In most passages, the neuron is sensitive to temporal or conditional clauses introduced by when, especially when followed by a subject and a description of the situation; it also shows sporadic activation on punctuation formats such as academic citations, comma-separated numbers, and parenthetical numbering.

patterns.name: when conditional clauses
patterns.context: when introduces a temporal, conditional, or state clause describing the circumstances in which something happens; activation falls on when or the immediately following token.
patterns.domain: Medical narratives, patent technical descriptions, encyclopedias, health education; paragraphs 1, 4, 5, 7, 9

patterns.name: when I in temporal clauses
patterns.context: when is followed by the first-person subject I and introduces a subsequent event in a personal narrative; the passage also contains narrative words such as “told” and “dropped”.
patterns.domain: Online essays or personal narratives; paragraph 2

patterns.name: Reference markers and parentheses
patterns.context: Numbered citation markers, parentheses, and superscript symbols appear densely; activation is concentrated on paired parentheses and formatting symbols.
patterns.domain: Academic paper XML/Markdown citation formats; paragraph 3

patterns.name: Comma-separated numbers
patterns.context: Commas separate adjacent numbered references; the following text is an academic discussion of methods or data.

patterns.name: Number in parentheses
patterns.context: Parentheses enclose a single number near a citation or narrative text.

patterns.name: Citation marker after a medical term
patterns.context: A bracketed citation and superscript formatting immediately follow an explanation of a medical term; this belongs to the same citation-marker pattern as paragraph 3, but uses a different symbol format.

5_2017.description: 多数段落中神经元对 when 引导的时间或条件从句敏感，尤其是 when 后接主语及情境描述；另对学术引文格式、数字逗号分隔和括号编号等标点格式有零散激活。

patterns.name: when 条件从句
patterns.trigger: «when»10/9 后接条件或状态，如“when the patient was lying”“when used in production”“when it comes in contact”“when the object is no longer inside”“when the body acclimates”
patterns.context: when 引出时间、条件或状态，从句描述某事发生时的状况；激活落在 when 或其后紧邻 token。
patterns.domain: 医学叙述、专利技术说明、百科、健康科普；段1、4、5、7、9

patterns.name: 时间从句中的 when I
patterns.context: when 后接第一人称主语 I，引出个人叙述中的后续事件；同时段内有“told”“dropped”等叙事词。
patterns.domain: 网络随笔或个人叙事；段2

patterns.name: 参考文献标记与括号
patterns.context: 编号式引用标记及其括号、上标符号密集出现，激活主要落在成对括号与格式符号。
patterns.domain: 学术论文的 XML/Markdown 引文格式；段3

patterns.name: 数字逗号分隔
patterns.context: 逗号分隔相邻的数字编号；后文是对方法或数据的学术讨论。

patterns.name: 括号内编号
patterns.context: 括号包围单个数字，出现在引文或叙述正文附近。

patterns.name: 医学术语后的引文标记
patterns.context: 医学术语说明后紧跟方括号引用与上标格式；与段3同属引文标记，但符号格式不同。

en.description: Activations are scattered: several passages activate on when clauses; others involve paper citation formats, numeric markers, figure captions, food or technical descriptions, and opinion words in news, without a common clear lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Words following when
patterns.context: Activation falls directly on when, followed by a conditional, temporal, or situational clause. The fragments alone do not establish a more specific syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical narratives, personal essays, educational articles, patent descriptions

patterns.name: Citation and reference markers
patterns.context: Dense reference markers occur next to parentheses and superscript symbols; activations are distributed across these formatting tokens.

patterns.name: Academic markers made of numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers and commas in a paper on election methods, followed by a contribution statement; the fragment is insufficient to determine what the numbers mean.
patterns.domain: Political or social science academic writing

patterns.name: Taste and texture in food descriptions
patterns.context: When describing lemon loaf cake, poppy seeds, and emergency food, activations occur in reader-directed food descriptions; no unified local trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Preservation descriptions of volatile compounds
patterns.context: Describes DMS volatilizing and being lost during storage; activations occur on prepositions expressing conditions or timing.
patterns.domain: Food science or product technical descriptions

patterns.name: Experimental figures and sample labels
patterns.context: In Western blot and RNA experiment results, activations fall on panel letters and caption formatting such as parentheses and commas.

patterns.name: Expression of opinion in economic news
patterns.context: After reporting retail employment data, quotes an economist’s judgment about whether growth is sustainable.

5_2017.description: 激活模式分散：多段在 when 条件从句处激活；其余涉及论文引用格式、数字标记、图注、食品或技术描述及新闻观点词，缺乏共同的明确词汇触发。

patterns.name: when 后的词语
patterns.context: 激活直接落在 when 上；后面接条件、时间或情境从句。仅凭片段难以确定是否有更具体的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学叙述、个人随笔、教育文章、专利说明

patterns.name: 引用与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 密集的参考文献标记与括号、上标符号相邻；激活分布在这些格式 token 上。

patterns.name: 数字及标点构成的学术标记
patterns.context: 选举方法论文中的数字与逗号序列，后接贡献陈述；片段不足以确认数字含义。
patterns.domain: 政治学或社会科学学术写作

patterns.name: 食物描述中的味道与口感
patterns.context: 描述柠檬蛋糕面包、罂粟籽及应急食品时，激活落在面向读者的食物描述中；未见统一的局部触发词。
patterns.domain: 烹饪或生活类网络文章

patterns.name: 挥发性成分的保存性描述
patterns.context: 描述 DMS 储存时挥发、损失的过程；激活位于表示条件或时点的介词。
patterns.domain: 食品科学或产品技术说明

patterns.name: 实验图表与样本标记
patterns.context: Western blot 和 RNA 实验结果说明中，激活落在图板字母及括号、逗号等图注格式上。

patterns.name: 经济新闻中的观点表达
patterns.context: 报道零售业就业数据后，引述经济学家对增长是否可持续的判断。

en.description: The clearest signal is a temporal or conditional transition such as when, often introducing a subsequent response, observation, or change; group judgments and quantified expressions also occur in financial reporting. Other activations are sporadic and lack a consistent trigger.

patterns.name: when clauses and points in time
patterns.context: In clauses describing the conditions under which a change, response, observation, or event occurs, the temporal/conditional connective when is prominent; paragraph 9 uses the semantically similar upon.
patterns.domain: Narrative, medical case reports, technical Q&A, news, and commentary

patterns.name: Quantification and judgments in economic news
patterns.context: Economic, market, or employment reporting includes group judgments, statistical changes, and market performance; activation is distributed across multiple words, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Other sporadic text patterns
patterns.context: Volatility in patent technical descriptions, speculation in conspiracy reporting, code/notebook fragments, and religious-tradition topics; these passages have no clear shared local trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Patents, news commentary, programming Q&A, religious essays

5_2017.description: 最清楚的线索是 when 等时间或条件转折，常引出后续反应、观察或变化；另有财经报道中的群体判断与量化表达。其余激活零散，缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: when 从句与时间点
patterns.trigger: “when I told him”“when the patient was lying”“when I look”“when Mr. Gifford stated”“upon return”
patterns.context: 在描述变化、反应、观察或事件发生条件的从句中，突出时间/条件连接词 when；第9段则是语义相近的 upon。
patterns.domain: 叙事、医学病例、技术问答、新闻与评论

patterns.name: 经济新闻中的量化与判断
patterns.trigger: “most economists don’t think”“analysts were impressed”“reported”“winners”“losers”“applications ... have risen”
patterns.context: 财经市场或就业报道中出现群体判断、统计变化和市场表现；激活分布在多个词上，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 其他零散文本模式
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中的挥发性、阴谋论报道中的推测、代码/笔记本片段，以及宗教传统话题；这些段落没有共同的明确局部触发模式。
patterns.domain: 专利、新闻评论、编程问答、宗教随笔

en.concept: when clauses and heterogeneous local patterns
en.description: Activation is concentrated on when and the clause that follows it, across narratives, technical descriptions, and legal text; there is also local activation on author citations, Notebook prompts, Go comments, and several isolated words, with no common condition established.

patterns.name: Temporal or conditional clauses introduced by when
patterns.context: Marks the circumstances in which an event occurs in a narrative or explanation; it may be followed by a subject, as in “when I told him”, “when the patient was lying”, and “when extracted”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, Q&A, scientific explanations, and legal statements

patterns.name: claim after an attributed assertion
patterns.context: Introduces one side’s assertion in an argument or commentary; activation is concentrated on claim and the immediately following text.

patterns.name: panics on in code comments
patterns.context: A Go code comment describes how a function behaves when it encounters an error.

patterns.name: References and special markers
patterns.context: Author names, reference links, and parenthetical citation formats appear in the body of a paper.

patterns.name: Notebook input prompt
patterns.context: An input-cell prompt in an interactive Python Notebook.

patterns.name: Other locally activated words or phrases
patterns.context: Only sporadic words or adjacent phrases are marked in each passage; the material does not establish that they share a more specific trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Religious commentary, spice/patent descriptions, and postal-policy commentary, respectively

5_2017.concept: when 从句及异质局部模式
5_2017.description: 激活最集中于 when 及其后续从句，跨叙述、技术说明与法律文本；另有作者引文、Notebook 提示符、Go 注释和若干孤立词的局部激活，尚无共同条件可证。

patterns.name: when 引导的时间或条件从句
patterns.context: 在叙述或说明中标记某事件发生时的情形，后面可接主语，如 “when I told him”“when the patient was lying”“when extracted”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的叙述、问答、科学说明和法律陈述

patterns.name: 引用主张后的 claim
patterns.trigger: «claim»«they»«8»（上下文为 “defenders claim they do now”）
patterns.context: 争论或评论中介绍一方的主张；激活集中于 claim 及其紧邻后文。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 panics on
patterns.context: Go 代码注释描述函数遇到错误时的行为。

patterns.name: 参考文献与特殊标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中出现作者名、参考文献链接和括号式引文格式。

patterns.name: Notebook 输入提示符
patterns.context: 交互式 Python Notebook 中的输入单元格提示符。

patterns.name: 其它局部激活词或短语
patterns.trigger: «tradition»附近的«people»、«I»、«remember»；«sulphury, vegetal, crab-like top note»后的«However»；«DMS»及«evaporates»；«Royal Mail»附近的«defenders»
patterns.context: 各段只有零散词或相邻短语被标记，无法从材料确认这些词共享更具体的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 分别涉及宗教评论、香料/专利说明及邮政政策评论

en.description: Mixed activation patterns: several passages activate on when (including within-word strings), along with notebook code, citation markers, JSON metadata, and scattered word fragments in narratives, case reports, and financial reporting; no unified semantics or stable syntactic feature is apparent.

patterns.name: when as a clause introducer
patterns.context: Introduces a temporal or conditional clause; activation falls on when itself, without necessarily requiring a fixed syntactic category.
patterns.domain: Prose including narratives, medical case reports, and patent descriptions

patterns.name: The string when inside English words
patterns.context: The letter sequence when appears inside words other than “when,” especially spellings like “whenever”; this may simply share a position with ordinary when activations.

patterns.name: Python/Jupyter code and output structure
patterns.context: Near interactive notebook code or output, often with parentheses, indexing, and newlines; activation does not correspond to a single punctuation mark.

patterns.name: Numbered citation markers
patterns.context: Literature citation anchors before the paper text, containing numbers, links, and citation attributes.

patterns.name: JSON field names and string punctuation
patterns.context: Key-value pairs, quotation marks, colons, and commas in JSON objects; activations are scattered across field content and structural punctuation.

patterns.name: Word fragments formed by tokenization
patterns.context: Activations fall on ordinary English words or tokens consisting of a space plus a word; there is no visible shared syntactic function within the passage.

patterns.name: Descriptive word fragments in case reports
patterns.context: Physical examination narrative following a medical history, including anatomical descriptions and changes in patient position.

patterns.name: News word fragments in business reporting
patterns.context: Sentences reporting quarterly results and analyst forecasts and identifying the source; activations are distributed across words and function words.

5_2017.description: 激活模式混杂：多段命中 when（含词内字符串），另有笔记本代码、引文标记、JSON 元数据，以及叙述、病例和财经报道中的分散词片段；看不出统一语义或稳定句法特征。

patterns.name: when 从句引导词
patterns.context: 引出时间或条件从句；激活落在 when 本身，未必要求固定句法类别。
patterns.domain: 叙述、医学病例、专利说明等散文

patterns.name: 英语词内部的 when 字符串
patterns.context: 字母串 when 出现在 “when” 以外的词中，尤其是 “whenever” 类拼写；此处也可能只是位置与普通 when 激活相似。

patterns.name: Python/Jupyter 代码与输出结构
patterns.context: 交互式笔记本代码或输出附近，常有括号、索引和换行；激活并非只对应某个单一标点。

patterns.name: 带编号的引用标记
patterns.context: 论文正文前的文献引用锚点，包含编号、链接和引用属性。

patterns.name: JSON 字段名与字符串标点
patterns.context: JSON 对象中的键值对、引号、冒号和逗号；激活分散在字段内容和结构标点上。

patterns.name: 分词形成的单词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英文词或空格加词的 token 片段上；段内没有可见的共同句法功能。

patterns.name: 病例中的描述性词语片段
patterns.context: 病史之后的体格检查叙述，包含解剖描述和患者体位变化。

patterns.name: 商业报道中的新闻词语片段
patterns.context: 报道季度业绩、分析师预测并注明消息来源的句子；激活分布于词语和功能词。

en.description: Activation is distributed across conditional clauses, code-interaction prompts, citation markers, and a few prose and linguistic terms; there is no single stable lexical or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Conditional or temporal clauses introduced by when
patterns.context: After a main clause or question narrative, introduces a condition, point in time, or event; it is often followed by a subject and predicate.

patterns.name: Special markers in code and interactive output
patterns.context: Appears in Python/Jupyter-style input/output prompts, code fragments, or line-break structures.

patterns.name: References and citation markers
patterns.context: The text is followed by bibliographic citation markers with superscripts, square brackets, or XML/HTML attributes.

patterns.name: Words in emphasis or quotations
patterns.context: Prose contains quoted expressions about tradition and people’s reactions.

patterns.name: Relation terms in dependency descriptions
patterns.context: Describes types of linguistic relations and embeds HTML links or annotations.

5_2017.description: 激活分散于条件从句、代码交互提示、引文标记及少数散文和语言学术语；没有单一稳定的词义或领域模式。

patterns.name: when 引出的条件或时间从句
patterns.context: 在主句或问题叙述之后，引出某个条件、时刻或事件；后面常接主语和谓语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述与技术问答

patterns.name: 代码与交互式输出中的特殊标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Python/Jupyter 风格的输入输出提示符、代码片段或换行结构中。

patterns.name: 参考文献与引文标记
patterns.context: 正文后跟带上标、方括号或 XML/HTML 属性的文献引用标记。

patterns.name: 强调或引述中的词语
patterns.context: 散文中出现关于传统与人们反应的引述式表达。
patterns.domain: 个人评论或宗教相关散文

patterns.name: 依存关系说明中的关系术语
patterns.context: 描述语言学关系类型，并嵌入 HTML 链接或标注。
patterns.domain: 语言学资源或技术文档

en.concept: local structural markers in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activation appears across several text types: Notebook prompts and code-cell boundaries, scientific computing operations, paper citation markers, narratives involving interpersonal reactions, technical failure reports, and descriptions of discontent in history. Overall, there is no single clear trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Jupyter/IPython interactive cell boundaries
patterns.context: After code or results are displayed, an interactive notebook begins or ends a cell; markers often fall near input prompts, output prompts, or line breaks.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code Q&A, interactive Python sessions

patterns.name: Python scientific computing and array operations
patterns.context: The context contains pandas grouping/indexing, array, or sparse linear algebra operations; some fragments also include notebook prompts.

patterns.name: Medical paper citation markers
patterns.context: The paper cites prior work, with a reference link or formatting marker immediately after the author name.

patterns.name: Quotes and interpersonal reactions in everyday narratives
patterns.context: The narrator recalls a conversation with someone else and describes that person’s emotional response; the topic here is religious tradition.

patterns.name: Technical failure narratives involving failed requests/connections
patterns.context: The questioner describes a program, server, HTTP request, or process malfunction and reports an error message, null value, or stalled state.

patterns.name: Interpersonal discontent in historical narratives
patterns.context: After a person is appointed, members of a group become dissatisfied because they believe that person has too much power.

5_2017.concept: 异质文本中的局部结构标记
5_2017.description: 激活出现在多类文本中：Notebook提示符和代码单元边界、科学计算操作；另见论文引文标记、带人际反应的叙述，以及技术故障报告和历史中的不满描述。整体没有单一清晰触发模式。

patterns.name: Jupyter/IPython交互单元边界
patterns.context: 代码或结果显示后，交互式 notebook 接着开始或结束单元；标记常落在输入提示符、输出提示符或换行附近。

patterns.name: Python科学计算与数组操作
patterns.trigger: `df.loc[mask, new_cols] = tmp.iloc[:mask.sum()].values`、`groupby(on level=0 ... apply a lambda)`、`arr`、`spsolve(A, B)`
patterns.context: 上下文包含 pandas分组/索引、数组或稀疏线性代数操作；部分片段同时带有 notebook 提示符。

patterns.name: 医学论文引文标记
patterns.trigger: `al et.` 后的 `^(^5^ [^13^](#acm20031-bib-0013){ref-type="ref"})` 等上标编号与 XML/HTML 风格引文标记
patterns.context: 论文正文援引先前研究，作者名后紧接参考文献链接或格式化标记。

patterns.name: 日常叙述中的引语与人际反应
patterns.trigger: `people? I remember telling a friend`、`His face dropped`
patterns.context: 叙述者回忆与他人的谈话，并描述对方的情绪反应；此处谈及宗教传统。

patterns.name: 请求/连接失败的技术故障叙述
patterns.trigger: `I really don't know`、`503 Forbidden`、`get ... message`、`appears to be null`、`returns null`、`not booting`、`just hangs`
patterns.context: 提问者描述程序、服务器、HTTP请求或进程异常，并报告错误消息、空值或卡住状态。

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的人际不满
patterns.trigger: `caused great resentment among her sisters`、`believed it granted her too much power`
patterns.context: 人物被任命后，群体成员因认为其权力过大而产生不满。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科传记/历史叙述

en.concept: local lexical forms and formatting triggers
en.description: Activation is distributed across various local lexical forms and formats: I, she, people, claim, JSON fields, chart panel markers, et al., and Python/IPython prompts and code-cell boundaries. There is no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: First-person pronoun I
patterns.context: First-person narration of experiences, opinions, or actions in English sentences; activation falls on I, often near a verb.
patterns.domain: Narrative prose, personal descriptions in Q&A

patterns.name: Python/IPython prompts and code output
patterns.context: Interactive Python/Jupyter code or output fragments, especially near prompts, blank lines, and code-cell boundaries.

patterns.name: English pronoun she
patterns.context: In a biography of a woman, the pronoun refers to a woman mentioned earlier; here it occurs in the “she was appointed” construction.

patterns.name: people in commentary
patterns.context: Discusses why a tradition makes many people afraid, in the phrase “so many people”.

patterns.name: JSON field integrity
patterns.context: A field name in a JSON-style object, containing an underscore prefix and a string value.

patterns.name: claim in a quoted assertion
patterns.context: Discusses what Royal Mail’s defenders assert, in “defenders claim they do now”.

patterns.name: A marker in a chart citation
patterns.context: A panel marker in a figure caption or figure-number citation in a medical paper.

patterns.name: Author abbreviation al.
patterns.context: The abbreviation “et al.” after an author name in a medical citation.

patterns.name: when I in a log-related issue
patterns.context: Describes a problem that occurs when checking logs after running a program; overlaps with the first-person I pattern, but activation also covers when.

5_2017.description: 激活分散于多种局部词形与格式：I、she、people、claim、JSON字段、图表面板标记、et al.，以及Python/IPython提示符和代码单元边界。缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 第一人称代词 I
patterns.trigger: «I»（第4段有“I had”“when I told”；第10段有“I look”）
patterns.context: 英语句子中以第一人称叙述经历、看法或操作；激活点落在 I，邻近常有动词。
patterns.domain: 叙述性散文、问答中的个人描述

patterns.name: Python/IPython 提示符与代码输出
patterns.trigger: «In» [»…«]:»、«Out»[»…«]:»、«↵»，以及 «df»；第1、2、8段的 IPython 符号与提示符附近有明显激活。
patterns.context: Python/Jupyter 交互式代码或输出片段，尤其是提示符、空行和代码单元边界附近。

patterns.name: 英文 she 的代词指代
patterns.context: 女性人物传记叙述中，代词指向前文提到的女性；此处位于“she was appointed”结构。

patterns.name: 评论中的 people
patterns.context: 讨论某种传统为何使许多人害怕，位于“so many people”短语中。

patterns.name: JSON 字段 integrity
patterns.context: JSON 风格对象中的字段名，包含下划线前缀和字符串值。

patterns.name: 引述动词 claim
patterns.context: 讨论 Royal Mail 的辩护者所声称的观点，位于“defenders claim they do now”中。

patterns.name: 图表引用中的 A 标记
patterns.context: 医学论文中图注或图号引用的面板标记。

patterns.name: 文献作者缩写 al.
patterns.context: 医学文献引用中作者名后的“et al.”缩写。

patterns.name: 日志问题中的 when I
patterns.context: 描述运行程序后查看日志时出现问题；与第一人称 I 模式相交，但激活点还覆盖 when。

en.concept: Text structure boundaries and condition markers
en.description: The main pattern is when introducing temporal or conditional clauses, along with Jupyter input prompts; some code output and citation markers also activate. Several local activations in natural language show no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Conditional/temporal clauses introduced by when
patterns.context: when introduces a temporal or conditional clause followed by a subject and verb; activations cluster on when and nearby words, with some examples followed by subjects such as I or the patient.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including narratives, technical failure descriptions, patent texts, and clinical case reports

patterns.name: Jupyter input prompts
patterns.context: Appears in input-cell prompts in Jupyter/IPython interactive notebooks; activations occur around the prompt and its number.

patterns.name: Code symbols and output prompts
patterns.context: Near code, array indexing, or expressions; several passages contain input/output cell formatting, but the specific triggering symbols vary.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code Q&A and interactive Python output

patterns.name: Segmented citation markers
patterns.context: Paired literature citation markers appear before the text; activations fall on parentheses, numbers, and boundaries in the citation syntax.

patterns.name: Unclear partial phrases
patterns.context: These local activations occur in natural-language sentences or patent descriptions; the samples alone cannot establish whether they share a trigger condition with the when pattern or code-formatting pattern.
patterns.domain: Narrative articles, patent texts, clinical case reports

5_2017.concept: 文本结构边界与条件标记
5_2017.description: 主要模式是 when 引导时间或条件从句，以及 Jupyter 输入提示；部分代码输出和引用标记也有激活。若干自然语言局部激活未显示出统一触发条件。

patterns.name: when 引导的条件/时间从句
patterns.context: when 引出时间或条件从句，后接主语和动词；激活集中在 when 及邻近词，部分例子后续是 I / the patient 等主语。
patterns.domain: 叙述、技术故障描述、专利文本和临床病例等多种文体

patterns.name: Jupyter 输入提示
patterns.context: 出现在 Jupyter/IPython 交互式笔记本的输入单元格提示中，提示符及编号附近激活。

patterns.name: 代码符号与输出提示
patterns.trigger: "Out["、"]:"、冒号、括号及逗号等代码或笔记本格式符号
patterns.context: 代码、数组索引或表达式附近；多段含有输入/输出单元格格式，但具体触发符号不一致。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码问答与交互式 Python 输出

patterns.name: 分段引用标记
patterns.trigger: "[^22^](#acm20031-bib-10002){ref-type=\"ref\"}" 等带方括号、锚点和 ref-type 属性的标记
patterns.context: 正文前出现成对的文献引用标记，激活落在引用语法的括号、数字及标记边界。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central XML/HTML 转换文本

patterns.name: 部分短语未明
patterns.trigger: 未见稳定的独立触发子串；第 1 段含 "terrify"、"people"、"I remember"，第 7 段含 "note"，第 8 段含 "On examination"
patterns.context: 这些局部激活处于自然语言句子或专利描述中，不能仅凭样本确认它们与 when 模式或代码格式模式有共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 叙述性文章、专利文本、临床病例

en.concept: event-introducing words in conditional or temporal clauses
en.description: The most consistent trigger is when (five passages), which introduces the time or condition of an event, especially in technical failure narratives; there are also upon, code prompts, and several isolated narrative-response and assertion contexts, with no shared semantics apparent.

patterns.name: when in temporal or conditional clauses
patterns.context: when introduces a subsequent event, condition, or temporal background, often followed by a subject and predicate; it typically occurs in a subordinate clause within a problem description or explanation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English narratives and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Program output and code fragments
patterns.context: Prompts, variables, assignments, or function-return statements appear in code or interactive interpreter output; not all such tokens have strong activation.

patterns.name: Failure or error reports in technical questions
patterns.context: Describes a program, server, or component failing and explains what happened; this pattern may co-occur with when introducing the condition under which the failure occurred.

patterns.name: Onset introduced by upon
patterns.context: upon is followed by an event or condition, indicating when something happens; one example is an object becoming invalid on return, and another is an ingredient evaporating during storage.

patterns.name: Emotional or reactive shifts in narratives
patterns.context: In a personal narrative, when introduces someone’s reaction after learning something; it is unclear whether the trigger is when or the specific emotional content.

patterns.name: claim in assertion and attribution contexts
patterns.context: Describes a group claiming that another party receives subsidies amid a dispute over a position or interest.
patterns.domain: News commentary or public policy discussion

5_2017.concept: 条件或时间从句中的事件引出词
5_2017.description: 最一致的触发是 when（5段），用于引出事件发生的时间或条件，尤其见于技术故障叙述；另有 upon、代码提示符，以及若干孤立的叙述反应和主张语境，未见共同语义。

patterns.name: 时间或条件从句中的 when
patterns.context: when 引出后续事件、条件或时间背景，常接主语和谓语；在句中位置多为问题描述或解释中的从句。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语叙述与技术问答

patterns.name: 程序输出与代码片段
patterns.context: 代码或交互式解释器输出中，出现提示符、变量、赋值或函数返回语句；并非所有此类 token 都有强激活。

patterns.name: 技术问题中的故障或错误报告
patterns.context: 描述程序、服务器或组件运行失败，并说明遇到的现象；此模式可能与 when 引出的故障发生条件共现。

patterns.name: upon 引出的发生时点
patterns.context: upon 后接事件或条件，表示某事发生之时；一例是对象在 return 时失效，另一例是成分在储存时挥发。
patterns.domain: 编程解释、专利背景描述

patterns.name: 叙述中的情绪或反应转折
patterns.trigger: «when»10« I»7 told him« I»1 had really« enjoyed»2 it
patterns.context: 个人经历叙述中，以 when 引出某人得知情况后的反应；是否由 when 触发，还是由具体情感内容触发，无法确定。

patterns.name: 主张与归因语境中的 claim
patterns.context: 围绕某一立场或利益争议，描述某群体声称另一方获得补贴。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论或公共政策论述

en.concept: local lexical and formatting cues in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activation is distributed across several text types: first person and when/recall expressions, Jupyter prompts and Python code, medical processes and case examinations, and economic/financial evaluations; there are also local triggers involving religious expressions, medical citations, Q&A labels, and unusual tokenization.

patterns.name: Pronoun I in recall/observation contexts
patterns.context: First-person narration, especially when I is followed by a time reference, recollection, or personal observation; also appears in constructions such as “when I look at”.

patterns.name: Jupyter/IPython cell boundaries and prompts
patterns.context: In code or interactive notebook content, activation occurs at input/output cell prompts and nearby line breaks; it covers tokens near code, results, and prompts.

patterns.name: Specific operators/variables in mathematical software code
patterns.context: Code expressions and surrounding technical explanations in Python/SymPy, NumPy, or pandas examples; overlaps with the notebook-prompt pattern but does not require a prompt.

patterns.name: Changes or examination findings in medical text
patterns.context: Describes changes in a pathological process or patient signs, including process connectives, examination findings, or conditional observations.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central medical papers, case reports

patterns.name: Evaluations or trend statements in market and economic reporting
patterns.context: Economic or financial reporting mentions economists’ judgments about whether data are sustainable or analysts’ assessments of market performance.

patterns.name: Q&A labels and formatting markers
patterns.context: Explicit question and answer labels in Q&A text, appearing before the body.

patterns.name: Statements about fear of religious tradition
patterns.context: Personal narrative discussing “tradition” and people’s reactions; this example also overlaps with the first-person recall pattern.

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and literature citation markers
patterns.context: Activation near abbreviations and numbered literature citations in a discussion of cardiac electrical remodeling.

patterns.name: Patient positioning and signs in case records
patterns.context: A case examination reports changes in abdominal wall bulging when the patient is in a particular lateral position.

patterns.name: Unusual spelling or tokenization of financial terms
patterns.context: An English word in a financial-market sentence is split into multiple subwords; activation falls on subword fragments rather than an obvious independent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Unusual characters and mixed-language output
patterns.context: Code output/notebook content contains a special punctuation string or a Russian result label; this may be a local formatting or lexical trigger.

5_2017.concept: 异质文本中的局部词形与格式线索
5_2017.description: 激活分散于多类文本：第一人称及 when/回忆表达、Jupyter 提示符和 Python 代码、医学过程与病例检查、经济金融评价；另有宗教表述、医学引文、问答标签及异常分词等局部触发。

patterns.name: 人称代词 I 与回忆/观察语境
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中，尤其在“I”后接时间、回忆或个人观察；也见于“when I look at”等结构。

patterns.name: Jupyter/IPython 单元格边界与提示符
patterns.context: 代码或交互式笔记本内容中，单元格输入输出提示符以及相邻换行处激活；覆盖代码、结果和提示符附近 token。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Python 笔记本

patterns.name: 数学软件代码中的特定运算符/变量
patterns.context: Python/SymPy、NumPy 或 pandas 示例中，代码表达式及其周围技术说明；与笔记本提示符模式有重叠，但不要求提示符本身。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的变化或检查描述
patterns.context: 描述病理进程变化或患者体征时，包含过程连接词，或检查发现及条件性观察。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文、病例报告

patterns.name: 市场、经济报道中的评估或趋势陈述
patterns.context: 经济或金融报道中，提到经济学家判断数据是否可持续，或分析师对市场表现的评价。

patterns.name: 问答标签与格式标记
patterns.context: 问答文本中问题与回答的显式标签，出现在正文之前。

patterns.name: 宗教传统引发恐惧的表述
patterns.context: 谈论“tradition”及人们对其反应的个人叙述；该例还与第一人称回忆模式重叠。

patterns.name: 医学缩写与文献引用标记
patterns.context: 心脏电重塑的医学论述中，缩写和带编号的文献引用附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 病历中的患者体位与体征
patterns.context: 病例检查描述中，报告腹壁膨隆在患者处于特定侧卧姿势时的变化。

patterns.name: 异常拼写或分词的金融词形
patterns.context: 金融市场句子中的英文词被切分成多个子词；激活落在分词片段，而非明显独立的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 异常字符及混合语言输出
patterns.context: 代码输出/笔记本内容中出现特殊标点串或俄语结果标签；可能是局部格式或词形触发。

en.concept: mixed response to formatting markers and local vocabulary
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on notebook-style Python code and prompts, as well as medical-paper citation formats; there are also sporadic occurrences of many and words related to groups or populations. The first two categories belong to different text structures and are difficult to unify under a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Jupyter/Python code and output
patterns.context: Appears in interactive Python notebook input prompts, code lines, output prompts, or code explanations; activation often falls near prompts, parentheses, line breaks, and code fragments.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, especially Python, pandas, SymPy, SciPy, and Jupyter content

patterns.name: Citation markers and reference formats
patterns.context: Bracketed citations, superscript citations, or similar reference markers are inserted in the body of a medical paper, alongside academic prose and reference numbers.

patterns.name: many and expressions of observation/quantity
patterns.context: Expressions of quantity such as people/many observers occur in ordinary narrative or discussion; they sometimes involve groups, age, or opinions, but not all instances share the same semantics.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC news or commentary prose; also sporadically in medical narratives

5_2017.concept: 格式标记与局部词汇的混合响应
5_2017.description: 激活主要集中在笔记本式 Python 代码与提示符，以及医学论文的引文格式；另有零星的 many、群体或人群相关词。前两类分属不同文本结构，难以归并为单一语义。

patterns.name: Jupyter/Python 代码与输出
patterns.context: 出现在交互式 Python 笔记本的输入提示、代码行、输出提示或代码解释中；激活常落在提示符、括号、换行及代码片段附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，尤其是 Python、pandas、SymPy、SciPy 和 Jupyter 内容

patterns.name: 引文标记与参考文献格式
patterns.context: 医学论文正文中插入方括号引文、上标引文或类似文献标记时；同时出现学术叙述和参考文献编号。

patterns.name: many 与观察/数量表达
patterns.context: 普通叙述或论述中出现 people/many observers 等数量表达；有时涉及群体、年龄或观点，但并非所有实例都同一语义。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 新闻或评论性散文；也零星出现在医学叙述

en.concept: Heterogeneous patterns including when conditions and code prompts
en.description: Activations commonly occur on when clauses and Jupyter input prompts; other examples include many, medical orientation and temporal connectives, patent storage contexts, code numbers, and sporadic terms, with no single semantic regularity across corpora.

patterns.name: when conditions in code
patterns.context: In Python code, programming Q&A, medical narratives, or explanatory text, when introduces a condition or temporal clause; activation falls on when, often followed by an article or pronoun.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, medical papers, explanatory text

patterns.name: Jupyter input prompts
patterns.context: In Python/Jupyter interactive notebook code or output, activations cluster near the closing parenthesis, number, or colon in the input prompt.

patterns.name: Quantifier many
patterns.context: In ordinary narratives, many modifies plural nouns such as people or observers.

patterns.name: Orientation/position terms in medical text
patterns.context: When describing a physical examination after hernia repair, right refers to the right side of the body; the same sentence also mentions the patient lying on their side.

patterns.name: Temporal connective in the AF remodeling process
patterns.context: Describes atrial fibrillation triggering electrical remodeling and its progression; until introduces the endpoint at which remodeling is complete.

patterns.name: Temporal/conditional clauses in storage contexts
patterns.context: A volatile compound is rapidly lost during storage; upon storage indicates storage as the condition or time period.

patterns.name: Numeric tokens in code arrays
patterns.context: In an interactive Python example, activations also fall near prompt numbers, array indices, or numeric values; there is insufficient evidence for a more specific code semantics.

patterns.name: HTTP status code and connection error
patterns.context: A Java HttpURLConnection connection to a URL fails, producing a “503 Forbidden” error message; activations are distributed around the error text.

patterns.name: Unknown or weakly related local activations
patterns.context: These words occur respectively in narratives, political reporting, and explanations of medical mechanisms, without a clear semantic condition shared with the other highly activating triggers.

5_2017.concept: when 条件与代码提示符等异质模式
5_2017.description: 激活常见于 when 条件从句及 Jupyter 输入提示符；另见 many、医学方位与时间连接词、专利储存语境、代码数值和零散词项，跨语料缺少单一语义规律。

patterns.name: 代码中的 `when` 条件
patterns.context: Python 代码、编程问答、医学叙述或说明文字中，`when` 引出条件或时间从句；激活落在 `when` 上，后续常接冠词或代词。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、医学论文、说明性文字

patterns.name: Jupyter 输入提示符
patterns.context: Python/Jupyter 交互式笔记本代码或输出中，激活集中在输入提示符的右括号、编号或冒号附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、Python 代码

patterns.name: 众多/数量词 many
patterns.context: 普通叙述中，`many` 修饰 people、observers 等复数名词。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的方位/体位词
patterns.context: 描述疝修补术后体检时，`right` 指身体右侧；同句还提到患者侧卧。

patterns.name: AF 重塑过程中的时间连接词
patterns.context: 说明房颤引发电重塑及变化进展，`until` 引出达到完全重塑状态的终点。

patterns.name: 存储条件下的时间/条件从句
patterns.context: 挥发性成分在储存时快速损失；`upon storage` 表示储存这一条件或期间。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、食品风味说明

patterns.name: 代码数组中的数值 token
patterns.context: 交互式 Python 示例里，激活还落在提示符编号、数组索引或数值附近；未见足够证据确定更具体的代码语义。

patterns.name: HTTP 状态码及连接报错
patterns.context: Java HttpURLConnection 连接 URL 失败，出现“503 Forbidden”错误信息；激活分布在错误文本周围。

patterns.name: 未知或弱关联的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在叙事、政治报道和医学机制说明中，未显示与其他高激活触发项一致的明确语义条件。
patterns.domain: 散文、报道、生物医学文本

en.description: Activation is distributed across academic citation formats, uncertainty in medical diagnoses, age comparisons, concessive criticism in commentary, technical failures, economic trends, and group attitudes; there is also a signal from common connectives, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Diagnostic or judgment uncertainty
patterns.context: Discusses a diagnosis that is difficult to establish or symptoms that resemble the target disease; uncertainty is explicitly expressed.

patterns.name: Comparison of age and disease occurrence
patterns.context: Uses age data to compare disease or subtype incidence and age at diagnosis.

patterns.name: Concession and drawbacks in evaluations
patterns.context: First praises a work or product as entertaining, having merits, or being well received, then points out flaws.

patterns.name: Failed technical operations and errors
patterns.context: Describes a failed attempt to perform a software or network operation and gives the error or failure context.

patterns.name: Economic data and whether trends will persist
patterns.context: Reports changes in employment or economic indicators and assesses whether growth can continue.

patterns.name: Public reactions and attitudes
patterns.context: Describes a group’s reaction to a plan’s contents or an activity; the emotional attitude is expressed explicitly.

patterns.name: Citation markers and reference formats
patterns.context: Literature citation markers appear near the end of a sentence or clause in a medical paper; activated fragments include multiple parenthetical and citation-code formats.

patterns.name: Common connectives and syntactic positions
patterns.context: Activation falls on several common words in contrastive, temporal/conditional, or explanatory clauses, without a consistent semantic condition.

5_2017.description: 激活分散于论文引文格式、医学诊断不确定性、年龄对比、评论中的让步批评、技术故障、经济趋势及群体态度；另有常见衔接词信号，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 诊断或判断不确定性
patterns.context: 讨论某种诊断难以确定，或症状与目标疾病相似；不确定性是明确表达的条件。

patterns.name: 年龄与疾病发生情况的对比
patterns.trigger: « at»1 an average age of 24 years«，与前文 «average age of diagnosis»、«63 years» 对照
patterns.context: 以年龄数据比较疾病或亚型的发病、诊断年龄。

patterns.name: 评价中的让步与缺点
patterns.context: 先肯定作品或产品有娱乐性、优点或受到赞扬，再转而指出缺陷。

patterns.name: 技术操作失败及报错
patterns.trigger: « fail»、« error»、« when»，以及 « Forbidden»« message»
patterns.context: 描述尝试执行软件或网络操作时失败，并给出错误或报错情境。

patterns.name: 经济数据及趋势是否持续
patterns.trigger: « risen»、« sizable job gain»、« economists»、« don’t»、« sustainable»
patterns.context: 报道就业或经济指标的变化，并对增长能否持续作判断。

patterns.name: 公众反应与态度
patterns.trigger: « many»« people»« were»« happy»，以及 « hate»、« groan»
patterns.context: 描述群体对规划内容或活动的反应；情绪态度用明确词语表达。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、培训/教育文章

patterns.name: 引文标记及参考文献格式
patterns.context: 医学论文中句末或分句附近出现文献引用标记；激活片段包括多种括号与引文编码形式。

patterns.name: 常见衔接词与句法位置
patterns.trigger: « While»、« but»、« when»、« which»、« so» 等
patterns.context: 激活落在转折、时间/条件从句或解释句中的若干常见词，语义条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文与技术文本

en.concept: Heterogeneous textual cues without a unifying pattern
en.description: Activations are distributed across varied corpora: when is most prominent in two technical Q&A passages; the rest involve citation markers, code and logs, medical/scientific narratives, personal recollections, and insecticidal mechanisms in patents, with no consistent trigger word.

patterns.name: Conditional or temporal introducer when
patterns.context: When describing program execution or network requests, introduces the time at which a condition, observation, or attempt occurs; this is the clearest and strongest lexical trigger in the two passages.

patterns.name: Academic citations and citation markers
patterns.context: In academic paper excerpts, punctuation, line breaks, and citation numbers near reference markers are also often marked; they are not necessarily the same literal token.

patterns.name: Technical Q&A and code/log vocabulary
patterns.context: Program startup, connection errors, debugging logs, or interactive Python code appear; markers are distributed across the question narrative, error messages, and nearby code.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and code notebooks

patterns.name: Descriptions of change, symptoms, and disease in biomedicine
patterns.context: Medical or biological text describes diseases, diagnoses, symptoms, risks, or drug-related reactions; the specific marked words vary.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and grant project text

patterns.name: Attitudes and experiences in narratives
patterns.context: Personal recollection or dialogue describes people’s reactions to religious traditions.

patterns.name: Biopesticide mode of action
patterns.context: Patent background text describes the mechanism as a sequence in which ingestion of a toxin kills insect larvae.

5_2017.concept: 异质文本线索，难以统一
5_2017.description: 激活分布于多种语料：when 在两段技术问答中最突出；其余涉及引用标记、代码与日志、医学科学叙述、个人回忆及专利中的杀虫机制，触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 条件或时间引导词 when
patterns.context: 在描述程序运行或网络请求时，引出某个条件、观察或尝试发生的时点；这是两段中最强的明确词汇触发。

patterns.name: 学术引文与引用标记
patterns.context: 学术论文片段中，紧邻参考文献标记的标点、换行及引文编号也常被标记；不一定是同一字面 token。

patterns.name: 技术问答与代码/日志词汇
patterns.context: 出现程序启动、连接错误、调试日志或交互式 Python 代码；标记分布在问题叙述、错误信息和代码邻近处。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答与代码笔记

patterns.name: 生物医学中的变化、症状与疾病描述
patterns.trigger: «ion channel changes»、«overweight and obesity»、«ovarian cancer»、«heart failure»、«drug craving»、«relapse»
patterns.context: 医学或生物学文本描述疾病、诊断、症状、风险或药物相关反应；具体被标记的词并不统一。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及资助项目文本

patterns.name: 叙述中的态度与经历
patterns.context: 以个人回忆或对话说明人们对宗教传统的反应。

patterns.name: 生物杀虫剂作用过程
patterns.context: 专利背景文字按摄入毒素后杀死昆虫幼虫的过程描述机制。

en.description: Primarily responds to anatomy in biomedical text, including different collocations and morphological and surgical contexts; sporadic activation also occurs on deviations in statistical summaries, the irregularly split word form U-next…, stock-related words in financial Q&A, and the SQL field grid.

patterns.name: Anatomical term anatomy
patterns.context: anatomy appears in discussions of anatomical structures, tissue morphology, or surgical techniques; the term appears explicitly in segments 1 and 5–9, usually as a noun within a sentence.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, case reports, or surgical reports

patterns.name: Subword anatomy
patterns.context: The trigger occurs within the word anatomy; the complete word appears in segments 1 and 5–9, though tokenization sometimes splits it.

patterns.name: Mathematical terminology in an abstract
patterns.context: The abstract discusses asymptotic distributions, maximum deviations, and sample covariance matrices; there is no clear anatomy trigger word.

patterns.name: Split U-next word form
patterns.context: A tokenized, split word form appears at the beginning of the abstract, preceded by a single quotation mark; it does not fit the anatomical content of the other segments.

patterns.name: Stock-trading Q&A context
patterns.context: Asks whether company executives selling their shares is a warning sign; the strongly activated words are scattered through the sentence, with no anatomical trigger.

patterns.name: Database field identifier
patterns.context: The backtick-quoted field name `sys_objects_grid` in an SQL update statement; unrelated to the topics of the other segments.

5_2456.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的 anatomy（含该词的不同搭配和形态学、手术语境）；另有统计摘要中的 deviations、异常拆分词形 U-next…、金融问答中的股票词和 SQL 字段 grid 等零散激活。

patterns.name: 解剖学术语 anatomy
patterns.context: anatomy 出现在解剖结构、组织形态或手术技术等讨论中；段1、5—9都明确出现该词，通常是句中名词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、病例或手术报告

patterns.name: 子词 anatomy
patterns.trigger: «ana»…«tomy» 的词内片段；可见于 anatomy、Choroidal anatomy
patterns.context: 触发位置处在 anatomy 一词中；段1、5—9均出现完整词，分词边界有时拆开。

patterns.name: 抽象摘要中的数学术语
patterns.context: 摘要讨论渐近分布、最大偏差与样本协方差矩阵；没有明显的 anatomy 触发词。

patterns.name: 拆分的 U-next 词形
patterns.context: 摘要开头出现被分词拆开的词形，前有单引号；与其余段落的解剖学内容不相符。

patterns.name: 股票交易问答语境
patterns.context: 询问公司高管出售所持股票是否构成警讯；显著激活的词分散在句中，未见解剖学触发。

patterns.name: 数据库字段标识符
patterns.context: SQL 更新语句中的反引号包围字段名 `sys_objects_grid`；与其他段落主题无关。

en.concept: Medical anatomy terms and sporadic word-form triggers
en.description: The most stable trigger is anatomy in medical contexts, especially dissection, surgery, or tissue structure. Other isolated triggers include catheter titles, financial negation, special abstract strings, statistical deviations, and SQL identifiers; these do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: anatomy as a medical topic word
patterns.context: The word anatomy itself is marked; it appears in phrases or sentences, often near topics involving organs, tissues, surgery, or pathology.
patterns.domain: Medical and biological abstracts and full text

patterns.name: Specific anatomical structures and catheter context
patterns.context: Before the abbreviation UV for Umbilical vein catheterization, the title discusses catheter placement in critically ill newborns; activation also involves the split form of Umbilical.

patterns.name: Risk warnings in financial Q&A
patterns.context: In a Q&A-style explanation of whether company executives selling their shares is a red flag, the stem of the negation isn’t is especially prominent; this does not fit the main anatomy pattern.
patterns.domain: Financial investment Q&A and email corpora

patterns.name: Special token and distribution term in a paper abstract
patterns.context: After abstract: at the start of an abstract, the split string U next end ible in single quotes is highlighted; the fragment also mentions product bases, but the trigger relationship is unclear.

patterns.name: Maximum deviations terminology
patterns.context: A statistics abstract discusses the distribution of maximum deviations of a sample covariance matrix; this is an independent semantic trigger outside the main medical anatomy pattern.

patterns.name: SQL grid field identifier
patterns.context: In an SQL UPDATE statement, the grid part of the backtick-quoted identifier sys_objects_grid is prominent; it has no clear connection to the other patterns.

5_2456.concept: 医学解剖词及零散词形触发
5_2456.description: 最稳定触发是医学语境中的 anatomy，尤其解剖、手术或组织结构。另有导管标题、金融否定词、摘要特殊字符串、统计 deviations 和 SQL 标识符等孤立触发，不能归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: anatomy 作为医学主题词
patterns.context: 词 anatomy 本身被标记；出现在短语或句子中，常与器官、组织、手术或病理主题相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学摘要及正文

patterns.name: 特定解剖结构与导管语境
patterns.context: Umbilical vein catheterization 的缩写 UV 前，标题讨论危重新生儿中的导管置入；激活同时涉及被拆分的 Umbilical。

patterns.name: 金融问答中的风险提示
patterns.context: 公司高管出售所持股票是否是 red flag 的问答式解释中，否定词 isn’t 的词干特别突出；与 anatomy 主模式不相符。
patterns.domain: 金融投资问答、邮件语料

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的特殊 token 与分布术语
patterns.context: 摘要开头 abstract: 后，单引号中的拆分字符串 U next end ible 被突出；片段同时提到 product bases，但触发关系不明。

patterns.name: 最大偏差术语
patterns.context: 统计论文摘要讨论样本协方差矩阵的 maximum deviations 分布；除医学 anatomy 主模式外的独立语义触发。

patterns.name: SQL 网格字段标识符
patterns.context: SQL UPDATE 语句中，反引号包围的 sys_objects_grid 标识符内的 grid 部分突出；与其他模式无明显联系。

en.description: The main response is anatomy in medical and biological contexts, especially descriptions of anatomical structures and their clinical, functional, or research aspects. Sporadic responses also involve umbilical vein, U/statistical terms in paper abstracts, isn’t in financial text, and several surgical and experimental terms.

patterns.name: Anatomical vocabulary: anatomy
patterns.context: The word anatomy itself is the most stable and strongest trigger; it appears in varied contexts, including interventional procedures, surgery, reviews, tissue-structure descriptions, and research plans.

patterns.name: Anatomy in proper names
patterns.context: Adjacent to names of body parts or anatomical structures; in [1], triggers are distributed across subword fragments of Umbilical vein, but anatomy remains strongest.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of blood vessels, flaps, and organ structures in medical literature

patterns.name: Reviews and anatomy collocations
patterns.context: Reviews or retrospective discussions involving anatomy and related techniques, functions, or structures.
patterns.domain: Medical reviews and clinical technology introductions

patterns.name: Paper abstract formatting and mathematical terminology
patterns.context: At the beginning of an ArXiv abstract; the strong activation in [3] falls on the quoted letter U, while [4] falls on maximum deviations, with no clear anatomy trigger.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstracts; mathematics or statistics

patterns.name: Negated contraction in financial text
patterns.context: Informal explanations use isn’t to state that investor concern does not necessarily indicate a risk signal; this has no apparent connection to the anatomy pattern.
patterns.domain: Financial Q&A, email, or explanatory text

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and surgical context
patterns.context: Around clinical terms such as bone cyst debridement and reduction, and flap use; activation still mainly falls on anatomy, with sporadic local triggers as well.

patterns.name: Biological vocabulary without a clear correspondence
