patterns.context: 讨论车辆事故中的冲击，以及座椅或部件承受的力。

patterns.name: 义务或权利相关表达
patterns.context: 谈论个人应得到的保护；句中涉及民主法治与社会基本规则。

patterns.name: 建议与考虑表达
patterns.context: 提出机构或利益相关方可考虑改进常规监测和报告。

patterns.name: 命令行提示中的输入符号
patterns.context: 软件说明中的终端交互提示，括号内询问 y/n，随后出现 HTML 结束标签。

patterns.name: 转义引号和菜单文字
patterns.context: 网页或代码中以 HTML 实体表示引号，包围菜单项“edit”；附近也有 «&»«gt»«;»。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学命令
patterns.context: 公式中的偏序关系定义；激活 token 出现在符号命令附近。

patterns.name: 普通英文中的功能词
patterns.context: 少数非代码文本中，激活落在常见功能词或其邻近位置，未形成跨文段一致的语义模式。
patterns.domain: 专利、政治文本、医学摘要

en.concept: Web markup and patent-solution lead-in phrasing
en.description: Activation primarily clusters around HTML source tags, attributes, entities, and template snippets; it also clusters around the patent-background phrasing “it would be advantageous to …” that introduces a desired solution. Web subpatterns include footers, navigation, tables, example descriptions, and player controls.

patterns.name: HTML markup and webpage templates
patterns.context: In webpage source, activation falls on HTML tag snippets, attributes, entities, and surrounding delimiters; common in template structures such as closing tags, table cells, footers, or navigation bars.
patterns.domain: Github webpage source, StackExchange page HTML

patterns.name: Advantageous-solution phrasing in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A conventional patent-background phrase that, after reviewing prior-art drawbacks or problems, introduces the need to provide, have, or improve a device, technology, system, or material.

patterns.name: Copyright symbols in HTML
patterns.context: A copyright notice in a footer, where an HTML entity is followed by a company name and year.

patterns.name: External-link markup and download text in HTML
patterns.context: A link in a navigation list item points to an external site and displays download-link text after an icon marker.

patterns.name: Example description text and calendar interface
patterns.context: A footer example description introduces how to customize an event calendar interface, surrounded by paragraph tags.

patterns.name: Player time display elements
patterns.context: In player-control HTML, an element with timer semantics displays the current playback time and contains whitespace entities.

patterns.name: HTML skip-navigation link and navigation-end comment
patterns.context: A skip-to-top navigation link and its end comment appear in page source, followed by a navigation-spacing element.

5_2456.concept: 网页标记与专利方案引出语
5_2456.description: 激活主要集中于HTML源码的标签、属性、实体和模板片段；另在专利背景中集中响应“it would be advantageous to …”引出所需方案的句式。网页子模式包含页脚、导航、表格、示例说明和播放器控件。

patterns.name: HTML标记与网页模板
patterns.context: 网页源码中，激活落在HTML标签片段、属性、实体及其周围的分隔符；常见于闭合标签、表格单元格、页脚或导航栏等模板结构。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的有利方案措辞
patterns.context: 在回顾现有技术缺点或问题之后，引出需要提供、具有或改进某种装置、技术、系统或材料的专利背景惯用句式。

patterns.name: HTML中的版权符号
patterns.context: 页脚版权声明中，HTML实体后接公司名和年份。

patterns.name: HTML中的外链标记与下载文字
patterns.context: 导航列表项里，链接指向外部网站，并以图标标记后显示下载链接文字。

patterns.name: 示例说明文字与日历界面
patterns.context: 页脚示例描述介绍如何定制事件日历界面，周围含段落标签。

patterns.name: 播放器时间显示元素
patterns.context: 播放器控件HTML中，以带计时器语义的元素显示当前播放时间，含空白实体。

patterns.name: HTML跳过导航链接与导航结束注释
patterns.context: 页面源码中的跳转到顶部导航链接及其结束注释，随后出现导航间距元素。

en.concept: Expressions of intention and web markup
en.description: One group of activations occurs in expressions of intention or suggestion, especially like/wish/want + to; another occurs near entity encoding and tag structure in HTML source. These expression patterns share the pragmatic function of wishes or suggestions, but do not explain the source-code pattern.

patterns.name: like to suggestion/request
patterns.context: The subject is you/you'd/you might/would, etc., followed by like to and an action or plan; activations mainly fall on like and to.
patterns.domain: News emails, online articles, Q&A/forum conversations

patterns.name: wish to expressing intention or suggestion
patterns.context: The modal verb may is followed by wish to and then an action such as suggesting, considering, or monitoring.

patterns.name: HTML closing tags and document markup
patterns.context: Strong activations occur near entity encodings or tag boundaries in structured webpage source; activation positions vary across passages.

patterns.name: want to expressing intention
patterns.context: The modal expression might is followed by want to and an action being suggested for consideration.

5_2456.description: 一类激活出现在意向或建议表达中，尤其是 like/wish/want + to；另一类落在 HTML 源码的实体编码与标签结构附近。各表达模式共享意愿、建议的语用功能，但源码模式无法由此解释。

patterns.name: like to 提议/请求
patterns.trigger: «like»« to»（如 [1] “you'd like to help”、[4] “you might like to take into consideration”、[10] “would like to stay”）
patterns.context: 主语为 you/you'd/you might/would 等，后接 like to 和动作或计划；激活主要落在 like、to 上。
patterns.domain: 新闻邮件、网络文章、问答/论坛对话

patterns.name: wish to 表示意愿或建议
patterns.trigger: «wish»« to»（[3] “may wish to consider”、[5] “may wish to monitor”）
patterns.context: 情态动词 may 后接 wish to，再接建议、考虑或监测等动作。

patterns.name: HTML 结束标签与文档标记
patterns.trigger: HTML/XML 标记中的特殊 token，如 [2] “©”、[6] “ ”、[7] “ ”、[8] “ ”及邻近的标签闭合符号
patterns.context: 结构化网页源码中，实体编码或标签边界附近出现强激活；各段激活位置并不完全相同。

patterns.name: want to 表达意向
patterns.context: 情态表达 might 后接 want to 和建议尝试的动作。

en.description: Primarily responds to HTML source tag boundaries, closing tags, attributes, and entity references; also activates on XML external entities, LaTeX mathematical symbols, and a few ordinary English words or phrases.

patterns.name: HTML closing tags and tag boundaries
patterns.context: Activations concentrate near angle brackets, slashes, tag names, and closing symbols in HTML tags, often in nested elements and at the ends of snippets.

patterns.name: HTML entities and whitespace placeholders
patterns.context: Activations occur near the ampersand, entity name, or semicolon in entity references; often used for copyright symbols, nonbreaking spaces, or placeholder whitespace.

patterns.name: HTML attributes, values, and control markup
patterns.context: Near attributes, attribute values, class names, and interactive-control markup within tags; activations are not restricted to a single attribute.

patterns.name: XML entity declarations and references
patterns.context: An external entity is defined in an XML document type declaration and referenced as &e; in a wrapper element.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical relations and symbol commands
patterns.context: Relation symbols and their LaTeX commands in mathematical expressions, including inline notation and formula source.

patterns.name: Words in ordinary English phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall on words in ordinary English emails or explanatory text, without an obvious shared local code or mathematical structure.

patterns.name: Sentences and punctuation in webpage text
patterns.context: Embedded in user-facing English instructions, tutorials, or email body text; specific triggers and meanings vary.

5_2456.description: 主要响应 HTML 源码中标签边界、闭合标签、属性和实体引用；另对 XML 外部实体、LaTeX 数学符号及少量普通英文词句有激活。

patterns.name: HTML 闭合标签与标签边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在 HTML 标签的尖括号、斜杠、标签名及闭合符号附近，常见于嵌套元素和片段末尾。

patterns.name: HTML 实体与空白占位
patterns.context: 对实体引用中的 &、实体名称或分号附近激活；常用于版权符号、不换行空格或占位空白。

patterns.name: HTML 属性和值及控件标记
patterns.context: 出现在标签内属性、属性值、类名以及交互控件相关标记附近；激活不固定于单一属性。

patterns.name: XML 实体声明与引用
patterns.context: 在 XML 文档类型声明中定义外部实体，并在包装元素中以 &e; 引用。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学关系与符号命令
patterns.context: 数学表达式中的关系符号及其 LaTeX 命令；包括正文数学记号和公式源码。

patterns.name: 普通英文短语中的词语
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英文邮件或说明文字中的词语，没有明显共享的局部代码或数学结构。

patterns.name: 网页文本的句段与标点
patterns.context: 嵌在面向用户的英文说明、教程或邮件正文中；具体触发词和语义不一致。
patterns.domain: 网页说明、邮件、技术文档

en.description: Primarily responds to HTML/XML tag boundaries, closing structures, and entity references; also covers comments, page placeholders, and specific controls. There is a separate XML entity-declaration pattern and like in link-suggestion copy. Passage 8 cannot be reliably matched to the source-code patterns.

patterns.name: HTML tags and closing structures
patterns.context: HTML/XML markup appears densely, especially tag boundaries, closing tags, and line breaks between tags; visible in [1–3], [5–6], and [9–10].

patterns.name: HTML entity references
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the & and entity name in entity references, often in HTML whitespace placeholders or XML text.

patterns.name: XML document type and entity declarations
patterns.context: An example XML snippet declares an external entity and references it in a wrapper document.

patterns.name: HTML comments and page-structure markup
patterns.context: Comments describe page-layout sections, accompanied by HTML structures such as navigation bars and containers.

patterns.name: Links and prompts to click
patterns.context: Reader-facing instructions or suggestions invite readers to click a link, contribute content, or consider a service; activations fall on words such as like in suggestion sentences.

patterns.name: Webpage explanatory text and demonstration placeholder paragraphs
patterns.context: An explanatory paragraph on an example page is followed by an empty paragraph or whitespace entity placeholder.

patterns.name: Empty paragraph after TPM configuration prompt
patterns.context: Command-line/software instructions are followed by an HTML paragraph and whitespace entity.

patterns.name: Angular template controls and whitespace layout
patterns.context: Angular-bound radio-button controls followed by consecutive whitespace entities used for layout.

patterns.name: Time display control
patterns.context: A player’s current-time display with accessibility attributes, surrounded by nested divs and nbsp entities.

patterns.name: Path tag in translation resources
patterns.context: In a translation-resource XML unit, the source text contains an escaped ampersand and the word Path as a tag.

5_2456.description: 主要响应 HTML/XML 的标签边界、闭合结构与实体引用，也覆盖注释、页面占位和具体控件；另有单独的 XML 实体声明模式及链接建议文案中的 like。第8段无法与源码模式可靠对应。

patterns.name: HTML标签与闭合结构
patterns.context: HTML/XML标记密集出现，尤其是标签边界、闭合标签及标签间换行；[1–3]、[5–6]、[9–10]中可见。

patterns.name: HTML实体引用
patterns.context: 激活集中在实体引用的 & 与实体名，常位于 HTML 空白占位或 XML 文本中。

patterns.name: XML文档类型与实体声明
patterns.context: XML片段示例中，声明外部实体并在 wrapper 文档里引用实体。

patterns.name: HTML注释与页面结构标记
patterns.context: 注释描述页面布局区块，伴随导航栏、容器等 HTML 结构。

patterns.name: 链接及引导点击的文案
patterns.context: 面向读者的指令或建议，邀请点击链接、参与提供内容或考虑某项服务；激活落在建议句中的 like 等词。
patterns.domain: 新闻推广邮件、营销文案

patterns.name: 网页说明文字与演示占位段落
patterns.context: 示例页面的说明段落后接空段落或占位空白实体。

patterns.name: TPM配置提示后的空段落
patterns.context: 命令行/软件说明文本结束后跟 HTML 段落及空白实体。

patterns.name: Angular模板控件与空白布局
patterns.context: Angular绑定的单选按钮控件及其后用于布局的连续空白实体。

patterns.name: 时间显示控件
patterns.context: 带无障碍属性的播放器当前时间显示区域，周围是嵌套 div 与 nbsp 实体。

patterns.name: 翻译资源中的路径标签
patterns.context: 翻译资源 XML 单元中，source 文本含转义的 ampersand 和 Path 标签文字。

en.description: Primarily responds to patent phrasing such as “would be … advantageous/desirable to,” which first states a problem and then proposes an ideal technical solution; it also responds to suggestions or invitations using wish to, and independently activates on HTML entities such as   and © in webpage source.

patterns.name: Advantageous/desirable solution phrasing
patterns.context: The preceding text points out problems or shortcomings in existing technology, followed by a proposal for a solution to obtain or improve something; strong activation clusters on the consecutive expression would be, advantageous, to.

patterns.name: wish to suggesting an action
patterns.context: may wish to introduces an action worth considering; activation clusters on wish to.

patterns.name: like to invitation or request
patterns.context: A news website prompt addressed to readers invites them to help the site.

patterns.name: HTML entity nbsp
patterns.context: Appears as a space entity in HTML markup; activation primarily falls on the entity’s character sequence and occurs in player controls, page layouts, or style code.

patterns.name: Footer copyright entity
patterns.context: A copyright-symbol entity in an HTML footer; the entity characters activate.

5_2456.description: 主要对“would be … advantageous/desirable to”这类先述问题、再提出理想技术方案的专利句式反应；也响应 wish to 的建议或邀请表达，并在网页源码中对  、© 等 HTML 实体有独立激活。

patterns.name: 有利/期望方案句式
patterns.trigger: “it would be advantageous to” / “it would be desirable and highly advantageous to” / “it would be advantageous to have”；另有 “Hence,” “Accordingly,” “Therefore” 引出的句子
patterns.context: 前文指出现有技术的问题或不足，随后提出希望获得或改进某种方案；强激活集中在 would be、advantageous、to 等连续表达上。

patterns.name: wish to 建议行动
patterns.context: 以 may wish to 引出建议考虑的行动，激活集中于 wish to。

patterns.name: like to 邀请或请求
patterns.context: 面向读者的新闻网站提示，邀请读者帮助网站。
patterns.domain: 网站新闻提示、面向用户的文案

patterns.name: HTML 实体 nbsp
patterns.context: HTML 标记中作为空格实体出现，激活主要落在实体的字符片段上；出现在播放器控件、页面布局或样式代码中。

patterns.name: 页脚版权实体
patterns.context: HTML 页脚中版权符号实体，实体字符获得激活。

en.description: Responses concentrate on HTML source markup, whitespace entities, and webpage snippets, and also strongly on the patent improvement boilerplate “it would be advantageous”; other sporadic patterns include conventional patent specification sentences, copyright footers, news solicitation wording, calendar instructions, navigation comments, and color styles.

patterns.name: HTML structural tags and closing tags
patterns.context: Near opening or closing element boundaries in HTML snippets, especially div and p tags; activations fall on closing delimiters or tag names in multiple passages.

patterns.name: HTML whitespace entity
patterns.context: A nonbreaking-space entity appears in HTML attributes or text; activations concentrate on the entity name nbsp and adjacent symbols.

patterns.name: Patent boilerplate “it would be advantageous”
patterns.context: Patent background first describes a problem or shortcoming, then introduces a desired improvement with “it would be advantageous to …”; peak activation is around advantageous.

patterns.name: Conventional patent specification wording
patterns.context: Patent specifications introduce material to be described later and transition to a paragraph on achieving the objectives of the invention.

patterns.name: Footer copyright-year text
patterns.context: A footer paragraph uses an HTML character entity for the copyright symbol, followed by a company name and year.

patterns.name: GOPUSA reader-recruitment wording
patterns.context: A news email invites readers to click a state-news link and asks them to help GOPUSA; strong responses concentrate on “you’d like to help”.
patterns.domain: Enron emails containing promotional news text

patterns.name: Custom interface in code instructions
patterns.context: Example instructions describe how to customize a calendar interface; activation is weak and does not occur in other patterns.

patterns.name: Closing navigation marker in code comments
patterns.context: An HTML comment marks the end of the top navigation bar, near the closing tag for the navigation container.

patterns.name: Color styling in code strings
patterns.context: HTML span styling embedded in a code string specifies a background color; activation favors background.

5_2456.description: 响应集中于HTML源码标记、空白实体及网页片段，也对专利中“it would be advantageous”改进套语强烈响应；另有专利说明书惯用句、版权页脚、新闻求助措辞、日历说明、导航注释与颜色样式等零散模式。

patterns.name: HTML结构标签与结束标签
patterns.context: HTML片段中闭合或打开元素的标签边界附近，尤其是 div、p 等标签；多段中激活落在标签结束符或标签名上。

patterns.name: HTML空白实体
patterns.context: HTML属性或文本内容中出现不换行空格实体，激活集中在实体名 nbsp 及邻近符号。

patterns.name: 专利套语“it would be advantageous”
patterns.context: 专利背景技术先描述问题或不足，随后以“it would be advantageous to …”引出期望改进；最高激活集中在 advantageous 一带。

patterns.name: 专利说明书惯用表述
patterns.context: 专利说明书中介绍后文将阐述的内容，并转入实现本发明目的的段落。

patterns.name: 页脚版权年份文本
patterns.context: 页脚段落中用 HTML 字符实体表示版权符号，后接公司名与年份。

patterns.name: GOPUSA 读者招募措辞
patterns.context: 新闻邮件邀请读者点击州新闻链接，并提出帮助 GOPUSA 的请求；强响应集中在“you’d like to help”。
patterns.domain: Enron邮件中的新闻宣传文字

patterns.name: 代码说明中的自定义界面
patterns.context: 示例说明文字描述如何定制日历界面；激活较弱，且未见于其他模式。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的结束导航标记
patterns.context: HTML 注释标示顶部导航栏结束，邻近导航容器闭合标签。

patterns.name: 代码字符串中的颜色样式
patterns.context: 嵌在代码字符串里的 HTML span 样式，指定背景颜色；激活偏向 background。

en.concept: HTML markup and expressions of intention or suggestion
en.description: Primarily activates on closing tags, tag boundaries, and whitespace/greater-than entities in HTML code; it also activates in expressions of intention or suggestion such as wish to and you'd like to, followed by different action verbs.

patterns.name: HTML closing tags and tag boundaries
patterns.context: Repeated HTML/XML-style markup, especially closing tags and adjacent boundaries; often accompanied by line breaks, indentation, or nesting.
patterns.domain: HTML templates or code in Github

patterns.name: HTML whitespace entities
patterns.context: HTML entities occur near tag contents or attributes; across multiple snippets they co-occur with closing tags and line breaks.

patterns.name: wish to in suggestive contexts
patterns.context: wish is followed by a to-infinitive to express a suggestion, intention, or action readers may take; the following verbs vary.
patterns.domain: Formal expository writing such as abstracts, patent backgrounds, and popular-science articles

patterns.name: like to in polite requests
patterns.context: you'd like to forms a polite reader-facing offer, followed by help.
patterns.domain: News website copy or promotional email text

5_2456.description: 主要激活于 HTML 代码的结束标签、标签边界及空白/大于号实体；另在 wish to 与 you'd like to 等表达意愿或建议的结构中激活，后接不同动作动词。

patterns.name: HTML 标签闭合与标签边界
patterns.context: 反复出现的 HTML/XML 风格标记中，尤其是结束标签及其相邻边界；常伴随换行、缩进或嵌套结构。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML 模板或代码

patterns.name: HTML 空白实体
patterns.context: HTML 实体写在标签内容或属性附近；多段里与标签闭合、换行共同出现。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML 代码

patterns.name: 建议语境中的 wish to
patterns.trigger: « wish»10« to»6« consider»4（3）；« wish»9« to»5« monitor»2（9）；« wish»9« to»6« build»5（10）
patterns.context: wish 后接 to 不定式，表达建议、意愿或读者可采取的行动；后续动词各不相同。
patterns.domain: 摘要、专利背景、科普文章等正式说明文

patterns.name: 礼貌请求中的 like to
patterns.context: you'd like to 构成面向读者的礼貌提议，后接 help。
patterns.domain: 新闻网站文案或邮件中的宣传文字

en.concept: Proper names and domain-specific subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across technical and medical terms, names and proper nouns, legal captions, and cryptocurrency terms. The shared feature is weak, mainly involving proper names or domain-specific subword fragments in multi-domain text.

patterns.name: Device, scientific, or technical terms
patterns.context: Specialized terms appear in technical or scientific text; activations fall on several tokens within the terms, with no consistent fixed grammatical position.
patterns.domain: Hardware code, patents, medical and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Personal names and name fragments
patterns.context: Activations appear when proper names or personal names are split into multiple subwords; contexts include a team name, a directory entry, and a producer field.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, bibliographic catalogs, wine lists

patterns.name: Specific proper names or entity strings
patterns.context: Code or data fields contain a proper name followed by an image URL; there is insufficient evidence to equate this pattern with general personal names.

patterns.name: Legal case names and dates
patterns.context: Formal fields such as organization names, court information, and dates appear in court case captions.

patterns.name: Cryptocurrency-related terms
patterns.context: Web content discusses mining rig setup, maintenance, and definitions of scams; activations concentrate within split terms.

5_2513.description: 激活分散在技术和医学术语、姓名与专名、法律抬头及加密货币词语中；共同点较弱，主要表现为多领域文本里的专名或领域词片段。

patterns.name: 器件、科学或技术术语
patterns.trigger: « bus»、«channel»、«Frequency»、«credit card identifiers»、«reader station»、«dietary Na»、«blood»、«ultrasound stethoscope»
patterns.context: 技术或科学文本中出现专门名词；激活落在术语内部的若干 token，未见一致的固定语法位置。
patterns.domain: 硬件代码、专利、医学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 人名及姓名片段
patterns.context: 专名或姓名被拆分成多个子词时出现；上下文分别是球队名称、目录条目和生产者字段。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、书目目录、葡萄酒列表

patterns.name: 特定专名或实体字符串
patterns.context: 代码或数据字段中包含专有名称，后接图像 URL；未见足够证据与一般人名模式等同。

patterns.name: 法律案件名称与日期
patterns.context: 法院案件抬头中，组织名称、法院信息和日期等正式字段。

patterns.name: 加密货币相关用语
patterns.context: 谈论矿机设置、维护及诈骗定义的网页内容；激活集中在拆分的术语内部。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code fields, fragments within proper nouns, directory page numbers, and local words or formatting in patent, scientific, marketing, and legal texts. The segments have no unified, stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Specific split word fragments in code
patterns.context: In code, configuration, or key-value fields, the marker falls on a split identifier or assignment symbol.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper nouns, compound words, or intra-word fragments split by tokenization; different examples lack consistent semantics.
patterns.domain: Sports, wine catalogs, medicine, card fields, etc.

patterns.name: Bibliographic directory formatting
patterns.context: In an aligned directory of book titles, author names, and page numbers, activations occur on or around page numbers or entries.

patterns.name: Phrase in a patent citation
patterns.context: A patent background description of a credit card being brought near a reader to identify it; activations cluster around “near a reader”.

patterns.name: Reported findings in scientific statements
patterns.context: Research findings are introduced with “it has repeatedly been reported that”, followed by a relationship between dietary sodium and blood measures.

patterns.name: “you” and scam wording in marketing copy
patterns.context: Reader-directed second-person promotional text discusses setting up and maintaining mining equipment and cryptocurrency scams.

patterns.name: Case-title formatting in legal texts
patterns.context: A court case title begins with the parties’ names in all caps, followed by the case number, court, and date.

5_2513.description: 激活分散于代码字段、专名词内片段、目录页码，以及专利、科研、营销和法律文本中的局部词语或排版；各段没有统一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码中的特定拆分词片段
patterns.context: 代码、配置或键值字段中，标记落在被切分的标识符或赋值符号上。

patterns.name: 专名或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、复合词或被分词切开的词内部片段；不同例子缺乏一致语义。
patterns.domain: 体育、葡萄酒目录、医学及卡牌字段等

patterns.name: 书目目录排版
patterns.context: 书名、作者名与页码组成的对齐目录中，激活出现在页码或条目周边。

patterns.name: 专利引文中的词组
patterns.context: 专利背景技术描述信用卡靠近读卡器站点以识别的情形；激活集中在“near a reader”附近。

patterns.name: 科学陈述中的报道措辞
patterns.context: 以“it has repeatedly been reported that”引出研究发现，后接膳食钠与血液指标的关系。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要或科研文本

patterns.name: 营销文案中的“you”及骗局措辞
patterns.context: 面向读者的第二人称宣传文字，讨论挖矿设备的设置维护和加密货币骗局。

patterns.name: 法律案名标题排版
patterns.context: 法院案件标题以全大写当事人名称开头，随后列出案号、法院与日期。

en.description: Activations occur throughout ten heterogeneous text segments, falling on proper nouns, technical terms, common words, intra-word substrings, numbers, punctuation, and formatting fields. Although there are local clusters in code, directories, and medicine, there is no stable shared semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Boundary/subword fragments in concatenated words
patterns.context: Activations fall on local fragments within words or adjacent tokens. The fragments vary widely across segments and are difficult to group into a stable word meaning or fixed form.
patterns.domain: Multiple corpora, including technical documents, encyclopedias, patents, bibliographies, web pages, medical abstracts, code, and card data

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper nouns, titles, and labels
patterns.context: Occurs in entity names, titles, field values, or proper nouns; activations are scattered across subword fragments of names rather than a consistent entity category.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, code comments/configuration, wine product information, medical literature, card data

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and formatted structures
patterns.context: In code comments, directory or poetry entries, and structured fields, activations occur near formatting symbols, line breaks, or numbers; some numbers correlate with layout position.
patterns.domain: GitHub code, bibliographic directories, structured text

patterns.name: Medical terms and research-abstract fragments
patterns.context: In medical abstracts or research statements, activations can fall on drug names, disease/treatment terms, research device names, or common phrasing; they do not respond only to a particular medical concept.

patterns.name: Card/web URL fields
patterns.context: When card entries use key-value fields and URLs, activations occur on field names, name fragments, and path fragments.
patterns.domain: Card data or configuration in GitHub

patterns.name: Wine names and producer fields
patterns.context: In product- or directory-style entries, local fragments of abbreviated labels, regional wine names, and producer names activate.

patterns.name: Cryptocurrency web copy
patterns.context: Reader-directed web text discusses mining equipment and cryptocurrency scams; several common words and intra-term fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Word fragments in patent phrasing
patterns.context: In patent background citations and descriptions of credit card readers, abbreviations, numbering formats, and body-text words all activate.

patterns.name: Poetry titles and names in bibliographic directories
patterns.context: Authors, work titles, and page numbers are listed in directory format; activations are distributed across title-word fragments, name fragments, and numbers.

patterns.name: Parameters and frequency expressions in code comments
patterns.context: A code comment explains channel-frequency calculations and includes parameter names, natural-language comments, and expressions; activations span these different types of fragments.

patterns.name: Italian national curling team name
patterns.context: The encyclopedia entry is titled Italian national curling team; activations cover the country name, category word, and fragments within the sport name.

patterns.name: Dietary sodium and blood measures research phrasing
patterns.context: A research abstract introduces the effect of dietary sodium on blood measures with a reporting-style sentence; activations cover common phrasing and research-topic words.

5_2513.description: 激活遍布十段异质文本，落在专名、术语、普通词、词内子串、数字标点及格式字段上。虽有代码、目录和医学等局部聚类，但没有稳定共享的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 连写词中的边界/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部或相邻 token 的局部片段上，片段本身跨段差异很大，难以归并为一个稳定词义或固定词形。
patterns.domain: 跨技术文档、百科、专利、书目、网页、医学摘要、代码/卡牌资料等多种语料

patterns.name: 专名与标题/标签中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在实体名称、标题、字段值或专名中；激活分散在名称的子词片段上，而非一致的实体类别。
patterns.domain: 百科、代码注释/配置、酒类商品信息、医学文献、卡牌资料

patterns.name: 数字、标点与格式化结构
patterns.context: 代码注释、目录/诗集条目及结构化字段中，格式符号、换行或数字附近出现激活；部分数字与排版位置相关。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码、书目目录、结构化文本

patterns.name: 医学术语及研究摘要片段
patterns.trigger: «Ceftazidime» 相关片段；«severe»、«burns»、«infections»；«ultrasound»；«that»（“It has repeatedly been reported that”）
patterns.context: 医学摘要或研究陈述中，激活可落在药名、疾病/治疗术语、研究设备名或常见句式词上；并非仅响应某个特定医学概念。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究描述

patterns.name: 卡牌/网页 URL 字段
patterns.context: 卡牌条目以键值字段及 URL 表示时，字段名、名称片段和路径片段均有激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的卡牌数据或配置

patterns.name: 葡萄酒名称与生产者字段
patterns.context: 商品/目录式条目中，缩写标签、产地酒名及生产者名称的局部片段被激活。
patterns.domain: 网页商品或酒类目录文本

patterns.name: 加密货币网页文案
patterns.context: 面向读者的网页说明中，涉及挖矿设备、加密货币骗局；同时激活若干普通词及术语内部片段。

patterns.name: 专利表述中的词语片段
patterns.context: 专利背景技术引用及信用卡识别器描述中，缩写、编号格式和正文词语均有激活。

patterns.name: 书目目录中的诗歌标题与姓名
patterns.context: 作者、作品标题及页码以目录式排版列出，激活分布于标题词片段、姓名片段和数字。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的参数与频率表达式
patterns.context: 代码注释说明通道频率计算，含参数名、自然语言注释与表达式；激活跨越这些不同类型的片段。

patterns.name: 冰壶国家队名称
patterns.context: 百科条目标题为意大利国家冰壶队，激活覆盖国名、类别词和运动名称内部片段。

patterns.name: 饮食钠与血液指标研究句式
patterns.context: 研究摘要以报告式句型引出膳食钠对血液指标的影响，激活覆盖常见句式词和研究主题词。

en.description: Activations are distributed across many unrelated proper names and word fragments: Rock/Rockwell, medical infections and fungi, an ultrasonic stethoscope, Armagnac, certificate markers, code comments, and the Italian national team. No unified trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Rockwell strings
patterns.context: Rock or rock combines with a subsequent word fragment in the names “Rock dormouse” and “Rockwell Automation”; capitalization varies.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article titles and business names

patterns.name: Antifungal/infection-related medical text
patterns.context: Medical abstracts discuss severe burns and infections, antifungal activity, or ringworm treatment; activations are scattered across related terms.

patterns.name: Device name fragments
patterns.context: An abstract describes experience using an ultrasonic stethoscope; activations concentrate on the device name and its component fragments.

patterns.name: Alcohol name fragments
patterns.context: Producer information for alcoholic beverages contains the name Armagnac and repeated word fragments.

patterns.name: Certificate headers
patterns.context: The PEM-format BEGIN CERTIFICATE marker; activations occur on the tokenized certificate text and its boundary symbols.

patterns.name: Code comments and channel variables
patterns.context: A code comment introduces an expression, followed by a 2GHz channel frequency calculation; activations concentrate on English comment fragments and the split word channel.

patterns.name: Italian national team fragments
patterns.context: In the title “Italy national korfball team,” activations cover tokenized fragments of Italy, national, korfball, and team.

5_2513.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的专名和词段：Rock/Rockwell、医学感染与真菌、超声听诊器、Armagnac、证书标记、代码注释及意大利国家队；看不出统一触发特征。

patterns.name: Rockwell 字符串
patterns.context: Rock 或 rock 与后续词片段组合，分别出现在名称“Rock dormouse”和“Rockwell Automation”中；大小写不一。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题及商业名称

patterns.name: 抗真菌/感染相关医学文本
patterns.trigger: « severe»10« burns»5；« infections»7；« antifungal»3；« three»9« nec»2«rot»5rophic fungi；« t»1«inea»1
patterns.context: 医学摘要中涉及严重烧伤及感染、抗真菌活性或癣治疗；激活点分散于相关词语。

patterns.name: 器械名称片段
patterns.context: 描述超声听诊器使用经验的摘要，激活集中在器械名称及其组成片段。

patterns.name: 酒类名称片段
patterns.context: 酒类生产者信息中出现 Armagnac（雅文邑）名称及重复词段。

patterns.name: 证书头部
patterns.context: PEM 格式证书的 BEGIN CERTIFICATE 标记；激活在分词后的证书字样及其边界符号。

patterns.name: 代码注释及信道变量
patterns.context: 代码注释介绍表达式，随后给出 2GHz 信道频率计算；激活集中在英文注释片段及被拆分的 channel。

patterns.name: 意大利国家队词段
patterns.context: “Italy national korfball team”标题中，激活覆盖 Italy、national、korfball 和 team 的分词片段。

en.description: Strong activations fall mainly on sentence-initial Primary, especially when followed by a disease or tumor name in medical text; there are also a web-navigation Primary Menu, sentence-initial Rock, and a few heterogeneous triggers such as that he in news.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Primary
patterns.context: The first word of a sentence, followed by a disease, syndrome, or tumor name; the subsequent content varies.

patterns.name: Primary in a menu heading
patterns.context: Primary is followed by Menu, with navigation labels separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: Words beginning with Rock
patterns.context: Rock begins a passage and is followed by different continuations, such as dormouse or well.

patterns.name: Enron board news phrase
patterns.context: The news sentence structure that he has resigned from Enron's Board; strong activation falls on that.

5_2513.description: 强激活主要落在句首 Primary，尤其医学文本中接疾病或肿瘤名；另有网页导航的 Primary Menu、句首 Rock 及新闻中 that he 等少数异质触发。

patterns.name: 句首 Primary
patterns.context: 作为句首首词，后接疾病、综合征或肿瘤名称；后续内容不固定。
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、摘要或陈述

patterns.name: 菜单标题中的 Primary
patterns.context: Primary 后接 Menu，并以换行分隔导航标签。

patterns.name: Rock 开头的词
patterns.context: Rock 是段落开头，后接 dormouse 或 well 等不同续接。
patterns.domain: 百科文本或网页/企业名称

patterns.name: Enron 董事会新闻短语
patterns.context: 新闻句中 that he has resigned from Enron's Board 的结构；强激活落在 that。

en.concept: Terms and titles in scientific text
en.description: Activations occur in scientific titles and abstracts across multiple fields: medical diseases, treatments, and vaccines; environmental and materials research; scattering processes; plant pathogens and miRNA; and a passage of ontology bibliography. Some titles begin with «[»; no unified theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Abstract title opening marker
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of bracketed titles, followed by a medical or research topic; subsequent content varies.

patterns.name: Medical disease and treatment titles
patterns.context: Titles concern treatment, disease, patients, or medical interventions and often contain medical terminology; they cover different conditions, with no shared specific disease topic.

patterns.name: Biomedical research terminology
patterns.context: Research descriptions involve pathogens, vaccines, free radicals, or molecular biology entities; some occur in titles and others in abstract bodies.

patterns.name: Materials and processes in scientific titles
patterns.context: Focuses on objects and properties or processes involving soil, material luminescence, or molecular scattering; these belong to different scientific subfields.
patterns.domain: Environmental science, materials science, and physical chemistry

patterns.name: Formal ontology bibliographic information
patterns.context: Appears in bibliographic text about book titles, editors, publishers, and philosophy institutions, including ontology-related terminology.

patterns.name: Plant diseases and small RNAs
patterns.context: Describes plant health or disease, phytoplasma treatment, and identification of conserved or novel miRNAs.
patterns.domain: Plant pathology and molecular biology abstracts

5_2513.concept: 科研文本中的术语与题名
5_2513.description: 激活见于多领域科研题名和摘要：医学疾病、治疗与疫苗，环境和材料研究，散射过程，植物病原体及miRNA，也包括一段本体论书目。部分题名以«[»起始；未见统一主题。

patterns.name: 摘要标题起始标记
patterns.context: 出现在方括号式题名开头，后接医学或研究主题；其后的词语内容多样。

patterns.name: 医学疾病与治疗题名
patterns.context: 题名涉及治疗、疾病、患者或医疗干预，常出现医学术语；覆盖不同病种，未见共同的具体疾病主题。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究术语
patterns.context: 研究描述涉及病原体、疫苗、自由基或分子生物学对象；有些出现在题名，有些出现在摘要正文。

patterns.name: 科学研究题名中的材料与过程
patterns.context: 关注土壤、材料发光或分子散射等对象及其性质、过程；属于不同科学子领域。
patterns.domain: 环境科学、材料科学与物理化学

patterns.name: 形式本体论书目信息
patterns.context: 出现在书名、编者、出版社和哲学机构等书目文字中，包含本体论相关术语。

patterns.name: 植物病害与小分子 RNA
patterns.context: 描述植物健康或患病状态、植原体处理及保守或新型 miRNA 的鉴定。
patterns.domain: 植物病理学与分子生物学摘要

en.concept: Practice-related words and organic matter phrases
en.description: Activations concentrate on the phrases organic matter/carbon/liquids and on practicing describing scientific, athletic, or medical practice. There are also isolated triggers in academic research, medical professional contexts, and title separators.

patterns.name: organic matter phrases
patterns.context: organic is followed by a matter- or carbon-related noun, concerning organic matter in soil, water, or liquids
patterns.domain: Soil and environmental science, physical chemistry

patterns.name: Inflected form of practicing
patterns.context: practicing describes the professional, scientific, or athletic activities of physicians, academic science, science, or sport activity
patterns.domain: Medical, research, sports, and public health texts

patterns.name: Academic research and practice expressions
patterns.context: Discusses changes and responsibilities in research practice, science education, or academic work; practicing need not appear
patterns.domain: Research policy, science education, and academic commentary

patterns.name: Clinical and health professional contexts
patterns.context: Describes the practice, consultation, or educational work of doctors or healthcare providers; several passages also contain practicing
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical care, and public health

patterns.name: academic as a homograph outside organic matter
patterns.context: academic modifies a medical institution or doctor, rather than research practice

patterns.name: Symbol in video titles
patterns.context: Appears as a title separator in an interview title; no clear semantic connection is evident

5_2513.concept: 实践相关词与有机物短语
5_2513.description: 激活集中于 organic matter/carbon/liquids 短语，以及 practicing 描述科研、体育或医疗实践；另有若干学术科研、医疗专业人士语境和标题分隔符的孤立触发。

patterns.name: organic matter 短语
patterns.context: organic 后接物质或碳相关名词，涉及土壤、水体或液体中的有机物
patterns.domain: 土壤与环境科学、物理化学

patterns.name: practicing 的分词形式
patterns.context: practicing 描述专业人士、科学家或运动参与者的实践活动，后接 physicians、academic science、science、sport activity 等
patterns.domain: 医学、科研、体育及公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 学术研究与实践表达
patterns.context: 讨论研究实践、科研教育或学术工作的变化与责任；不要求出现 practicing
patterns.domain: 科研政策、科学教育与学术评论

patterns.name: 临床与健康专业人士语境
patterns.context: 描述医生或医疗服务提供者的实践、咨询或教育工作；其中多段也有 practicing

patterns.name: 有机物之外的 academic 同形词
patterns.context: academic 修饰医疗机构或医生，而非科研实践

patterns.name: 视频标题中的符号
patterns.context: 出现在采访标题中，作为标题分隔符；没有明显的语义联系

en.description: Activations are distributed across scientific text and medical promotion, especially medical/biological terminology. Other local words, including organic, Because, and many, also trigger repeatedly, but the passages do not share a single unified meaning or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Organic matter and biomedical contexts
patterns.context: The word appears in a research title or body, concerning soil active organic matter, psychiatric disorder classification, or volatile organic compounds.
patterns.domain: Agricultural and biomedical abstracts, climate science

patterns.name: Causal statements introduced by Because
patterns.context: Appears after a statement of fact to introduce a reason or inference; both passages are medical abstracts.

patterns.name: many followed by quantities or categories
patterns.context: many is followed by receptors or plural categories such as medical and health professions.

patterns.name: Disease and medical topic vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical research titles or abstracts contain a high density of terms for organs, diseases, treatments, or physiological processes.

patterns.name: Fixed opening of project summaries
patterns.context: NIH project summaries begin with Project Summary, followed by an explanatory sentence.

patterns.name: Local phrases in truncated fragments
patterns.context: The context is truncated, and only local scientific expressions are discernible, making more specific trigger conditions difficult to determine.

patterns.name: 3D and medical learning software promotion
patterns.context: Introduces interactive anatomy software, course resources, and intended users.

patterns.name: Noun phrases in paper titles
patterns.context: Scientific titles consisting of noun phrases and containing terms related to soil, plants, and organic matter.

patterns.name: Gene delivery kinetics and effects
patterns.context: Discusses promoters, adenoviral vector delivery, and the effects of expression kinetics on efficacy and toxicity.

patterns.name: Greenhouse gas and pollutant reactions
patterns.context: Describes the indirect effects of CO on greenhouse gas lifetimes, oxidation, and ozone formation.

patterns.name: Clinical research institutions and psychiatric disorder classification
patterns.context: Introduces the organizational structure of a research center and lists major categories of psychiatric disorders.

patterns.name: Immune transcription factors and receptors
patterns.context: Describes how transcription factor families regulate immunity, inflammatory responses, and receptor activation.

5_2513.description: 激活分布于科研文本和医学宣传中，尤其涉及医学/生物学术语；另有 organic、Because、many 等局部词语重复触发，但各段缺乏单一统一词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 有机物质及其生物医学语境
patterns.context: 该词出现在科研标题或正文中；涉及土壤活性有机质、精神疾病分类，或挥发性有机化合物。
patterns.domain: 农业与生物医学摘要、气候科学

patterns.name: Because 引导的因果论述
patterns.context: 出现在陈述事实后，用于引出原因或推论；两段均为医学摘要。

patterns.name: many 后接数量或类别
patterns.context: many 后接 receptors 或 medical and health professions 等复数类别。
patterns.domain: 免疫学摘要、医学教育宣传

patterns.name: 疾病与医学主题词汇
patterns.trigger: “Cholinergic modulation of sensory representations in the olfactory bulb”及“sick cell disease”“gallstones”等
patterns.context: 医学研究标题或摘要中密集出现器官、疾病、治疗或生理过程术语。

patterns.name: 项目摘要的固定开头
patterns.trigger: “Project Summary Because of their elevated frequency”
patterns.context: NIH 项目摘要以 Project Summary 开头，随后进入说明性句子。

patterns.name: 残缺片段中的局部词组
patterns.trigger: “their elevated frequency ability to self”及“Variations in the rates of neuropeptide synthesis and release are to be”
patterns.context: 上下文截断，只有局部科学表达可辨，难以确定更具体的触发条件。

patterns.name: 3D 与医学学习软件宣传
patterns.context: 介绍互动式解剖软件、课程资源及其适用人群。

patterns.name: 论文标题式名词短语
patterns.trigger: “Dynamics of soil active organic matter in Chinese fir plantations”
patterns.context: 以名词短语构成的科研标题，含土壤、植物与有机质术语。

patterns.name: 基因递送动力学与效果
patterns.context: 讨论启动子、腺病毒载体递送，以及表达动力学对疗效和毒性的影响。

patterns.name: 温室气体与污染物反应
patterns.context: 描述 CO 对温室气体寿命、氧化及臭氧形成的间接影响。

patterns.name: 临床研究机构与精神疾病分类
patterns.trigger: “Mental Health Clinical Research Center”及“organic mental syndrome”
patterns.context: 介绍研究中心的组织结构，并列出主要精神疾病类别。

patterns.name: 免疫转录因子与受体
patterns.context: 描述转录因子家族调控免疫、炎症反应及受体激活。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on you, both, and a few seemingly unrelated words. you occurs across conversational, legal, and narrative text; both often appears in coordination or comparison structures. The remaining isolated trigger words have no readily identifiable shared condition.

patterns.name: Second-person you
patterns.context: you appears in sentences as a subject or object; it is inactive in other passages, so not every occurrence triggers
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative, dialogue, and explanatory prose

patterns.name: Structures following both
patterns.context: both is followed by coordinated items, as in “both nocturnal and diurnal mammals” and “in both cases”

patterns.name: Other sporadic words
patterns.context: The words occur in different local syntactic contexts; there is insufficient evidence to identify a shared trigger condition

5_2513.description: 激活主要落在 you、both 及少数互不明显相关的词上。you 跨对话、法律和叙述文本出现；both 多见于并列或比较结构。其余孤立触发词难以归纳共同条件。

patterns.name: 第二人称 you
patterns.context: you 出现在句子中，充当主语或宾语；不同段落中也有非激活的 you，因而不是所有出现都会触发
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、对话及说明文

patterns.name: both 后的结构
patterns.context: both 后接并列项，如“both nocturnal and diurnal mammals”和“in both cases”

patterns.name: 其他零散词项
patterns.context: 各词出现在不同局部句法环境中；没有足够证据确定共同的触发条件
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、论坛文章、邮件

en.concept: Local English phrases and formatting patterns
en.description: The most stable pattern is the fixed English phrase “all sorts of,” which occurs across academic disciplines, literature, online discussions, and legal corpora. Other isolated patterns include code punctuation formatting, literary rhetoric about submission and freedom, dating safety, and courtroom date questions; the remaining activations in several passages have no clear explanation.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “all sorts of”
patterns.context: When the full phrase appears, activations concentrate on sorts; nearby all and of may also have weaker activations. It is followed by different nouns.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, discussions, legal texts

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting markers
patterns.context: Activations appear near punctuation, whitespace-control fields, and newline sequences in code or annotated text.

patterns.name: Semantics of submission, enslavement, and freedom
patterns.context: Didactic or rhetorical descriptions of submission, enslavement, freedom, and their opposites.

patterns.name: Safety and dating
patterns.context: Discusses feeling safe while dating, as well as discriminatory culture and protective measures.

patterns.name: “July 8” date and oral question-answer format
patterns.context: Testimony repeatedly asks about a specific date, including colloquial questions and date corrections.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: A mathematical physics explanation includes “perp,” “coordinates,” “definitions,” and “collects … excitations”; the available activation annotations are insufficient to assign it to the patterns above.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: Narrates a journey, hospitality, and purchases along the way; although “all sorts of” appears, it is assigned to the fixed phrase pattern.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: Apart from “all sorts of,” discusses a political two-party system and social tensions; no additional clear trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: Legal text discusses transferring cases and appeals from nonfinal orders; no clear shared trigger pattern is apparent.

5_2513.concept: 英文局部词组与格式模式
5_2513.description: 最稳定模式是英文固定搭配“all sorts of”，跨学科、文学、网络讨论和法律语料出现。另有代码标点格式、屈从与自由的文学修辞、约会安全、庭审日期问答等孤立模式；若干段的其余激活无明确解释。

patterns.name: “all sorts of”固定搭配
patterns.context: 短语完整出现时，激活集中在 sorts，邻近的 all、of 也可能有较弱激活；后接不同名词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、讨论、法律文本

patterns.name: 标点与格式化标记
patterns.context: 代码或标注文本中的标点、空格控制字段及换行等序列附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 屈从、奴役与自由的语义
patterns.context: 以训诫或修辞方式描写屈从、被奴役、自由及其反面。

patterns.name: 安全与约会
patterns.context: 讨论约会时是否感到安全，以及歧视性文化和保护机制。

patterns.name: “July 8”日期及口述问答格式
patterns.context: 证词中反复询问具体日期，包含口语化问答和日期纠正。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 数学物理说明中出现“perp”“coordinates”“definitions”“collects … excitations”等；现有激活标注不足以归入上述模式。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 叙述旅程、款待及沿途购买物品；虽有“all sorts of”，已归入固定搭配模式。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 除“all sorts of”外，讨论政治两党制及社会紧张；未见额外清晰触发模式。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 法律文本讨论移送案件及对非终局命令的上诉；未见明确共享触发模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to throughout followed by a time, geographic, or activity scope; it also responds to the legal expression in … behalf and to any modifying an entity. There are weaker activations in statements describing interests in multiple entities and their litigation histories.

patterns.name: throughout + scope/period
patterns.context: throughout is followed by a time period, geographic area, or activity scope; the pattern is not limited to legal contexts.
patterns.domain: Legal, encyclopedia, sports reporting, medical news

patterns.name: Making a statement or acting on someone’s behalf
patterns.context: In legal contexts, indicates acting, advocating, or presenting evidence for oneself or another; often uses the “in … behalf” structure.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, explanations of trial rights

patterns.name: any + scope or entity
patterns.context: any modifies a following noun and appears in negative, conditional, or general legal discussion.

patterns.name: Number of entities and their case histories
patterns.context: Describes a party’s interests in multiple entities and notes that some of them previously filed for bankruptcy.

5_2513.description: 主要响应 throughout 后接时间、地域或活动范围；也响应法律表达 in … behalf，以及 any 限定对象。另对描述持有多个实体权益及其诉讼经历的语句有较弱激活。

patterns.name: throughout＋范围/时段
patterns.trigger: «throughout»（如“throughout the five years”“throughout the proceedings”“throughout New Zealand”“throughout the season”“throughout Asia”）
patterns.context: “throughout”后接时间段、地域或活动范围；不局限于法律语境。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科、体育报道、医学新闻

patterns.name: 代表某人陈述或行事
patterns.trigger: “in your own behalf”“in his brother's behalf”“in his behalf”，以及“present evidence in your own behalf”
patterns.context: 法律语境中，表示为自己或他人利益行事、辩护或举证；常见“in … behalf”结构。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、庭审权利说明

patterns.name: any＋范围或对象
patterns.context: “any”限定后续名词，出现在否定、条件或概括性法律论述中。

patterns.name: 实体数量及其案件经历
patterns.trigger: “held interests in a number of entities”及“some of which have filed cases”
patterns.context: 描述当事人持有多个实体的权益，并交代其中一些实体曾申请破产。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several semantic contexts: especially periods or ranges introduced by throughout, as well as evaluations of impact, litigation obligations, short duration, nude images of minors, small expenditures, and sports-draft expressions.

patterns.name: Time span following throughout
patterns.context: Describes ongoing behavior, experience, or coverage over a period introduced by throughout; sometimes accompanied by the, a number, or a period noun.

patterns.name: High impact / important role
patterns.context: Evaluation words such as impactful or crucial combine with nouns such as work or roles to emphasize the impact or importance of the work.

patterns.name: Legal responsibility and litigation matters
patterns.context: Concerns contractual defenses, indemnification obligations, and pending or potential litigation.

patterns.name: Expeditious judicial handling
patterns.context: Expeditious modifies a processing stage, with a specific number of days indicating a short duration.

patterns.name: Descriptions related to child sexual exploitation
patterns.context: Describes adults luring minors via email and chat into sending nude or pornographic photos.

patterns.name: Emphasis on small expenditures
patterns.context: Very little modifies monetary spending and is accompanied by a specific month.

patterns.name: Sports draft picks
patterns.context: Discusses fantasy football lineups, drafts, and player selections; all of nine refers to multiple drafts.

5_2513.description: 激活分散于多种语义情境：尤其见于 throughout 引出的持续时期或覆盖范围，也见于影响力评价、诉讼义务、耗时短、未成年人裸露、少量支出和体育选秀表达。

patterns.name: throughout 后接时间跨度
patterns.trigger: “throughout”及其后的时间或时期表达，如 “throughout the five years” [6]、“throughout the proceedings” [10]；另有 “throughout all three of the Anglo-Dutch Wars” [8]
patterns.context: 在 throughout 引出的时间范围内，描述持续行为、经历或覆盖范围；有时搭配 the、数字或时期名词

patterns.name: 高影响力／重要作用
patterns.context: impactful 或 crucial 等评价词与 work、roles 等名词搭配，强调工作的影响或作用的重要性
patterns.domain: 个人经历、科研项目说明

patterns.name: 法律责任与诉讼事项
patterns.trigger: “a number of suits” [4]，以及 “obligations to defend and indemnify” [4]、“product liability” [4]
patterns.context: 围绕合同约定的抗辩、赔偿义务及正在审理或可能发生的诉讼

patterns.name: 迅速完成的司法处理
patterns.context: expeditious 修饰处理阶段，并以具体天数说明耗时较短

patterns.name: 儿童性剥削相关描述
patterns.context: 描述成年人通过邮件和聊天诱骗未成年人发送裸露或色情照片

patterns.name: 少量花费的强调
patterns.context: very little 修饰金钱支出，并附带具体月份

patterns.name: 体育选秀选择
patterns.context: 谈论 fantasy football 阵容、选秀及球员选择；all of nine 表示多个选秀

en.description: Activations occur mainly in legal texts concerning litigants, obligations, and procedure, and often fall on expressions of importance/significance and low quantity/limited impact. Other specific patterns involve technical contact, research equipment and funding, criminal case facts, and historical amounts.

patterns.name: Parties, obligations, and procedures in litigation
patterns.context: Legal texts describe defense or indemnity obligations, claims, jury procedure, union grievance procedures, preclusion, or corporate liability; some activations fall on common prepositions, articles, and subwords of legal terms.
patterns.domain: Case law, litigation documents, legal arguments

patterns.name: Importance and progress evaluations
patterns.context: Describes importance, progress, quantity, or degree; includes both positive assessments and the small amount, limited scope, or low impact expressed by little.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, research project descriptions, historical narratives

patterns.name: Close contact and mixing
patterns.context: Discusses whether reactants are adequately mixed or in contact; activations concentrate on intimate contact and nearby function words.

patterns.name: Custom-designed equipment
patterns.context: Describes specialized equipment made by an institution and its role in research.

patterns.name: Independent development and funding
patterns.context: Describes scholars becoming independent researchers after completing training and pursuing independent funding.
patterns.domain: Academic training and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Inducing minors to send nude photos
patterns.context: Describes an adult using email and chat to induce underage girls to take photos at different stages of undressing or nudity; activations fall on subwords of independently and various.

patterns.name: Time and amount records
patterns.context: A historical narrative states that a political party spent little in a particular month.

5_2513.description: 激活主要见于法律文本中的诉讼主体、义务和程序，也常落在“重要／显著”及“很少／影响有限”等程度表达；另有技术接触、科研设备与资助、刑事案事实及历史金额等具体模式。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中涉及的主体、义务与程序
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述抗辩或赔偿义务、诉讼请求、陪审团程序、工会申诉程序、既判事项或公司责任；部分激活落在常见介词、冠词及法律术语的子词上。
patterns.domain: 判例、诉讼文书、法律论证

patterns.name: 重要程度与进展评价
patterns.context: 描述事项的重要性、进展或数量／程度；既包括肯定评价，也包括 little 所表达的少量、有限或影响不大。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、科研项目介绍、历史叙述

patterns.name: 紧密接触与混合
patterns.context: 谈反应物是否充分混合、彼此接触；激活集中在 intimate contact 及其邻近功能词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、化学／反应器技术

patterns.name: 定制设计的设备
patterns.context: 说明机构制作的专用设备及其在研究中的作用。
patterns.domain: 科研设备、机构项目介绍

patterns.name: 独立发展与资助
patterns.context: 描述学者完成培训后成为独立研究者、推进独立资助的过程。
patterns.domain: 学术培训与 NIH 项目介绍

patterns.name: 诱导未成年人发送裸露照片
patterns.context: 叙述成年人通过邮件和聊天诱导未成年女孩拍摄不同脱衣／裸露阶段的照片；激活落在 independently、various 等词的子词上。

patterns.name: 时间与金额记录
patterns.context: 历史叙述中说明某政党在特定月份花费很少。

en.concept: Local lexical collocations and emphatic expressions
en.description: Activations cluster around a few collocations and local expressions: intimate contact/association, quantity or group qualifiers, legal case and document phrasing, evaluations of impact or progress, and contexts describing stages of nudity. They span multiple domains, with no single shared trigger word.

patterns.name: “intimate” and its collocations
patterns.context: Intimate modifies contact or association, meaning close contact or relationship; both instances occur in noun phrases.

patterns.name: Qualifying expressions after numbers or percentages
patterns.context: Related to a quantity, proportion, or range, followed by a noun such as a region or group; activations cluster on a qualifier and group noun after tokenization.

patterns.name: Case or litigation-group expressions in legal texts
patterns.context: Occurs in accounts of litigation facts, requests, or procedural documents; may involve case numbers, the number of lawsuits, or jointly filed documents.

patterns.name: Evaluation of impact or significant progress
patterns.context: Evaluates the impact of work or research progress, emphasizing importance or influence; the latter example crosses a line break.

patterns.name: Descriptions of age stages and gradual undressing
patterns.context: Describes different stages of undressing or nudity in photos of minors; the trigger is around various stages.

5_2513.concept: 局部词汇搭配与强调表达
5_2513.description: 激活集中在少数搭配与局部表达：intimate contact/association、数量或群体限定、法律案件与文件表述、影响或进展评价，以及描述裸露阶段的语境。跨越多个领域，未见统一触发词。

patterns.name: 程度副词“intimate”及其搭配
patterns.context: intimate 修饰 contact 或 association，表示紧密接触、亲密联系；两次均在名词短语中
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明；历史叙述

patterns.name: 数字或百分比后的限定性表达
patterns.trigger: «60»« pro»2cent；« in»1« som»3«m»3«ige»10« lid»4«stat»2«en»3（“some Member States”）
patterns.context: 与数量、比例或范围相关，后接地区、群体等名词；激活集中在分词后的限定词及群体名词

patterns.name: 法律文本中的案件或诉讼群体表达
patterns.trigger: «729»10« their»3« complaint»4；« a»7« number»4« of»9« suits»3；« a»5« joint»4« stipulation»5
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼事实、请求或程序文件叙述中；可能涉及案件编号、诉讼数量或联合提交的文件

patterns.name: 有影响力或显著进展的评价
patterns.context: 评价工作影响或研究进展，强调重要性、影响力；后一例跨换行
patterns.domain: 个人经历叙述；机器学习讨论

patterns.name: 年龄阶段及逐步脱衣的描述
patterns.context: 描述未成年人照片中不同的脱衣、裸露阶段；触发点在 various stages 一带

en.concept: Subword fragments and local collocation detection
en.description: Activation patterns are varied: they include Dutch subword fragments within words, collocations of intimate with contact/association, page-number markers and litigation obligation language in legal texts, and the technical expression significant progress.

patterns.name: Dutch in-word affixes/subword fragments
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary text, activations fall on subword fragments within words; the same passage contains participles, compounds, or inflected forms

patterns.name: intimate contact/association collocations
patterns.context: In English, intimate is followed by contact or association, indicating close contact or connection; both passages also contain bring/brought into

patterns.name: Numbering/page markers in legal documents
patterns.context: In US case law, numbers appear near asterisk page-break markers or contract quotations containing page markers

patterns.name: Legal litigation and obligation vocabulary
patterns.context: Legal contexts involving complaints, motions, contractual liability, or insurance defenses; activations are scattered across legal terms and common words

patterns.name: significant progress collocation
patterns.context: When discussing reinforcement learning methods or game solutions, significant progress denotes substantial progress

5_2513.concept: 词片段与局部搭配检测
5_2513.description: 激活模式并不单一：包括荷兰语词内子词片段、intimate 与 contact/association 的搭配、法律文本中的分页编号及诉讼义务用语，以及 significant progress 技术表达。

patterns.name: 荷兰语句内词缀/词片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会文本中，激活落在词内部的子词片段；同段有分词、复合词或屈折词形

patterns.name: intimate contact/association 搭配
patterns.context: 英语中 intimate 后接 contact 或 association，表示紧密接触或联系；两段也都含 bring/brought into
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、历史散文

patterns.name: 法律文书中的编号/分页标记
patterns.context: 美国判例文本里，数字出现在星号分页标记或带分页标记的合同引文附近

patterns.name: 法律诉讼及法律义务词汇
patterns.context: 诉状、动议、合同责任或保险抗辩等法律语境；激活位置分散于法律术语及常见词

patterns.name: significant progress 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论强化学习方法或游戏解法时，significant progress 表示显著进展

en.concept: Expressions of important relationships and actions
en.description: Activations cluster around several local collocations: intimate modifying relationships or contact, important decisions, legal litigation phrasing, and isolated cases involving contract effect, absolute negation, facility closure, and reaching an agreement.

patterns.name: intimate collocations
patterns.context: The adjective intimate modifies a relationship or contact; the second example also contains brought into.

patterns.name: important decisions collocation

patterns.name: Fixed legal phrase “in effect”

patterns.name: Page numbers or citation numbers in legal records

patterns.name: Store closure in a factual account

patterns.name: Insurance liability and pending litigation

patterns.name: Criminal history and sentencing materials in criminal rulings

patterns.name: Close contact between reactants

patterns.name: Litigation or supplemental-record phrasing in legal documents

patterns.name: Formatting placeholders and effect phrasing in legal texts

patterns.name: “little difference” phrasing in legal contexts

patterns.name: Legal citation markers containing numbers

5_2513.concept: 重要作用及法律文本特征

en.description: Activations cluster around several common collocations: intimate denotes close proximity or association; play an important role(s) in describes a function; other examples include legal-effect and litigation terminology, diplomatic expressions for reaching an agreement, and role collocations concerning the effect of sample size on performance.

patterns.name: intimate and its collocations
patterns.context: Occurs in collocations describing objects or components as being in close proximity, contact, or association, such as “intimate proximity,” “intimate contact,” and “intimate association”; surrounding collocates vary by context.

patterns.name: Effect and procedural terminology in legal texts
patterns.context: Legal documents describe agreements remaining in effect, as well as the filing of lawsuits and parties’ complaints.

patterns.name: Fixed expression for an important role
patterns.context: Uses “play an important role(s) in” to introduce a factor’s role in a biological process or disease.

patterns.name: role collocations in performance contexts
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of sample size on some performance measure; similar to “play an important role,” but without important here.

patterns.name: Reaching an agreement in diplomatic news
patterns.context: News reports describe diplomats attempting to reach an agreement with another party; the same passage also includes “agree to share intelligence” and ceasefire-related content.

5_2513.description: 激活集中于若干常见搭配：intimate 表示紧密接近或关联；play an important role(s) in 表述作用；另见法律效力与诉讼用语、外交达成协议表达，以及样本量影响性能的 role 搭配。

Repeated disclaimer fragments show a liability-clause pattern, but the other triggers are difficult to group.

patterns.name: action/actions in legal proceedings

5_2513.concept: 法律文本及局部词串触发

en.concept: Expressions of importance and status across contexts
en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: legal texts highlight specific numeric placeholders and expressions of negation or emphasis; academic texts respond strongly to “play(s) … important/crucial/fundamental role(s)” collocations; there are also a Dutch subword fragment and a phrase in a report about an engineering facility closure.

patterns.name: Numeric placeholders and following words in legal documents
patterns.context: Numbers are surrounded by asterisks or occur in legal texts such as contracts and complaints; activation centers on the number itself and an immediately following pronoun or status word (such as «their» or «effect»).

patterns.name: Expressions of negation and emphasis
patterns.context: Legal arguments contain judgments involving negation, qualification, or emphasis, such as whether there was an independent finding or whether a difference was significant.

patterns.name: “play(s) … role(s)” collocation
patterns.context: The subject identifies a factor, action, or mechanism that plays an important role in a subsequent process or issue; an intensifying adjective and article may intervene, and the phrase often takes in.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and abstracts, including biomedical or social-science texts

patterns.name: Dutch word-internal fragments and “all languages”
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary speech, words are split into subword fragments; a local passage contains a statement along the lines of “available in all languages.”

patterns.name: Report on engineering facility closure
patterns.context: A forum post reports a company closing an engineering facility, along with an equipment auction and location information.

5_2513.concept: 多类重要性与状态表达
5_2513.description: 激活模式多样：法律文本中突出特定数字占位符及否定、强调表达；学术文本中显著响应“play(s) … important/crucial/fundamental role(s)”搭配；另有荷兰语词片段和工程设施关闭报道中的短语。

patterns.name: 否定与强调表达

patterns.name: “play(s) … role(s)”搭配

en.concept: Local lexical collocations and expressions of importance
en.description: Responses are scattered: common collocations expressing importance or role, a lot of, legal formulae, Dutch/German policy-word fragments, and little difference. Some fragments may derive from local collocations or word fragments and cannot be grouped under a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Importance or role in common collocations
patterns.context: Describes a person or thing as having an important role, status, or influence; related words may be separated by multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, government or public-affairs texts

patterns.name: Common phrase lot of
patterns.context: Indicates a large quantity, followed by things or improvements; activations concentrate on «of» within the phrase, with adjacent tokens also responding.

patterns.name: Fixed expressions in legal texts
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in clauses where a contract remains in effect and in descriptions of authority; no obvious shared trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: little difference expression

5_2513.concept: 局部词汇搭配与重要性表达
5_2513.description: 响应分散：常见重要性与作用搭配、a lot of、法律固定短语、荷德语政策词片段及 little difference。部分片段可能来自局部搭配或词片段，无法归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的固定表达

en.description: In most passages, the neuron responds to descriptions of a role formed with play(s)/played and role(s), especially major, important, and crucial role; other examples include only the role of in a mathematical context and made little difference in a legal context.

patterns.name: play only the role of

patterns.name: little difference

5_2513.description: 多数段落中，神经元响应 play(s)/played 与 role(s) 构成的作用描述，尤其是 major、important、crucial role；另见数学语境的 only the role of，以及法律语境的 made little difference。

patterns.name: 发挥重要作用的固定表达

patterns.context: 动词 play 的不同时态或单复数形式，后接 a major role、important roles 或 a crucial role，并常接 in + 作用内容；激活集中在 role(s) 及其前后的搭配词上
