patterns.name: make little difference
patterns.context: Made little difference means that something has little impact; activation falls on little.

patterns.name: Degree adverb utterly
patterns.context: Utterly modifies immaterial, meaning completely insignificant; the later phrase any kind of use does not show the same structure.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Dutch
patterns.context: A continuous span across words forms the Dutch phrase sommige lidstaten (“some member states”); the trigger is the subword fragments after tokenization.

5_2513.description: 多数段落激活于 play/plays 与 important、major、crucial 及 role/part 的搭配，表达因素的重要作用；另有 utterly immaterial、made little difference，以及荷兰语词内片段等少数模式。

patterns.name: play a role/part
patterns.context: play 及其变体 plays 后接重要性形容词，再接 role(s) 或 part；词序可有变化，通常说明某因素的作用。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学、科学及一般议论

patterns.name: make little difference
patterns.context: made little difference 表示某事影响甚微；激活落在 little 上。

patterns.name: 程度副词 utterly
patterns.context: utterly 修饰 immaterial，表示完全无关紧要；后文另有 any kind of use，但未见相同结构。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 连续跨词片段拼成荷兰语 sommige lidstaten（某些成员国）；触发的是分词后的子词片段。

en.description: In most passages, forms of play collocate with modifiers such as important, crucial, key, and critical, followed by role(s), describing an entity’s role across different domains; one passage uses functions to express a similar function. Activation on Dutch subword fragments is a separate category.

patterns.name: play + importance modifier + role(s)
patterns.context: Forms of play are followed by an adjective denoting importance or evaluation and role(s), often continuing with in + the object or process; variants include a, multiple adjectives, and other forms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and life-science research abstracts; policy or survey narratives

patterns.name: play + important functions
patterns.context: play is followed by important functions, then an explanation of the function, such as “in clearing the stomach.”

patterns.name: Dutch subword-fragment activation
patterns.context: Subword fragments distributed within or across words in Dutch sentences; activation centers around “sommige lidstaten,” with no structure matching the English play/role pattern.

5_2513.description: 多数段在不同领域中以 play 的词形变化搭配 important、crucial、key、critical 等修饰语和 role(s)，描述某实体的作用；一段用 functions 表达类似功能。荷兰语段的词片段激活另成一类。

patterns.name: play + 重要性修饰语 + role(s)
patterns.trigger: «play»« important»« roles»、«play»« crucial»« roles»、«plays»« a»« crucial»« instructive»« role»、«play»« key»« roles»、«played»« a»« critical»« role»
patterns.context: 不同词形的 play 后接重要性或评价性形容词及 role(s)，常继续接 in + 作用对象或过程；可出现 a、多个形容词等变体。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、生命科学研究摘要及政策/调查叙述

patterns.name: play + important functions
patterns.context: play 后接 important functions，随后说明功能，如“in clearing the stomach”。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词片段激活
patterns.context: 荷兰语句子中分散于词内或词间的词片段；激活集中在“sommige lidstaten”一带，未见与英语 play/role 模式相同的结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical expressions such as “play a major/essential/crucial role”; also activates in mathematics for “serve only as a parameter,” in Dutch for “among many...,” and in legal contexts for “direct control.”

patterns.name: Expressions of playing an important role
patterns.context: The subject is a biomolecule, cell signal, or other factor, followed by a description of its important role in a process or function. Activation is distributed across multiple tokens in the phrase, especially strong on major/essential/crucial.

patterns.name: A parameter serving only a role
patterns.context: A variable is explicitly limited to “serving only as a parameter,” rather than performing a substantive function.

patterns.name: Dutch “many/a lot of”
patterns.context: In Dutch sentences, means “among many...,” followed by plural nouns such as zaken or landen.

patterns.name: Direct control in legal contexts
patterns.context: Discusses a governor’s direct control and responsibility for training as commander-in-chief.

5_2513.description: 主要响应生物医学中“发挥重要作用”的 play a major/essential/crucial role 表述；也对数学中“仅作参数”、荷兰语“许多……中的”及法律中的“直接控制”出现激活。

patterns.name: 起重要作用的表述
patterns.context: 主语是生物分子、细胞信号或其他因素，后接对某过程/功能发挥重要作用的描述；激活分布在短语多个 token 上，尤以 major/essential/crucial 为强。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究摘要

patterns.name: 参数只起某种作用
patterns.context: 变量被明确限定为“仅充当参数”，而不是承担实质功能。

patterns.name: 荷兰语“许多/很多”
patterns.trigger: «ve»«el»« van»（[6]）；«ve»«el»« van»（[10]，分词与激活位置略有不同）
patterns.context: 荷兰语句子中表示“许多……中的”，后接 zaken 或 landen 等复数名词。

patterns.name: 法律中的直接控制
patterns.context: 讨论州长作为总司令，对训练负有直接控制权和责任。

en.concept: Common collocations and fixed legal wording
en.description: Mainly responds to Dutch “veel van de,” research English “play a … role,” and control and the fixed phrase “IN NO EVENT” in legal language; there is also an isolated phrase and a typesetting marker. No clear corresponding trigger pattern appears in paragraph 8.

patterns.name: Dutch «veel van de»
patterns.context: Occurs in the Dutch phrase structure “In veel van de …”; the following noun phrases differ in two passages.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, PhilPapers; Dutch political or academic texts

patterns.name: English “play a … role”
patterns.context: Describes a factor playing an important role; the modifier occurs between “a” and “role,” with slight variation in the wording.

patterns.name: Phrase about control
patterns.context: English passages discuss direct control over an object or the regulation of a system; the latter occurs in “control of energy balance.”

patterns.name: “NO EVENT” in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: Fixed disclaimer wording: “In no event shall … be liable”; activation centers on the uppercase “NO.”

patterns.name: Dutch “het gehele”
patterns.context: A Dutch noun phrase meaning “the entire …,” followed by “Oostzeegebied.”

patterns.name: End of a legal compound
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the hyphen, word ending, and following comma in the English compound “commander-in-chief.”

patterns.name: Line-break and indentation markers in disclaimers
patterns.context: A disclaimer layout has a line break followed by a space and “A”; this is not a clear semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Github; license texts with Markdown/code-block-style formatting

5_2513.concept: 常见搭配与固定法律措辞
5_2513.description: 主要响应荷兰语“veel van de”、科研英语“play a … role”及法律语体中的 control 和 “IN NO EVENT”固定措辞；另有单例词组与排版标记。第8段未见明显对应触发模式。

patterns.name: Dutch «veel van de»
patterns.context: 在荷兰语短语中，出现在“In veel van de …”结构；两段后文接不同名词短语。
patterns.domain: EuroParl、PhilPapers；荷兰语政治或学术文本

patterns.name: 英语“play a … role”
patterns.context: 描述某因素发挥重要作用；修饰词在“a”和“role”之间，具体措辞略有变化。

patterns.name: 控制权短语
patterns.context: 英语中谈及对某对象的直接控制或某系统的调控；后者嵌在“control of energy balance”中。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的“NO EVENT”
patterns.context: 固定免责声明句式“In no event shall … be liable”，激活集中在大写“NO”。
patterns.domain: Github 法律/软件许可文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语“het gehele”
patterns.context: 荷兰语名词短语中表示“整个……”，其后为“Oostzeegebied”。

patterns.name: 法律复合词尾部
patterns.context: 英语“commander-in-chief”复合词的连字符、词尾及紧随逗号处出现激活。

patterns.name: 免责声明的换行与缩进标记
patterns.context: 免责声明排版中换行后接空格和“A”，并非明确的语义触发词。
patterns.domain: Github；带 Markdown/代码块式排版的许可文本

en.description: Primarily responds to the biomedical structure “play + important/crucial/major + role(s) + in,” especially when describing the role of biological factors in disease, pathological, or physiological processes; also shows high activation in Dutch word-internal substrings and fixed patent phrasing.

patterns.name: “play important role(s) in” construction
patterns.context: Describes the role of cells, proteins, or biological processes in disease, pathological mechanisms, or physiological processes; “role(s)” is followed by in and the specific object of the role.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH research proposals

patterns.name: “play crucial role(s) in” construction
patterns.context: Emphasizes the crucial role of metabolic or molecular factors in disease mechanisms; similar to the important-role construction, but uses the adjective crucial.

patterns.name: “play a major role in” construction
patterns.context: A singular subject describes the major contribution of a component to a specific biological effect.

patterns.name: Highly activated Dutch words in context
patterns.context: Continuous Dutch text; activation falls on substrings within words, with no clear semantic context matching the biomedical construction.

patterns.name: Patent example phrasing
patterns.context: Fixed legal-technical phrasing in patent background or example passages; this does not match the biomedical role construction.

5_2513.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中“play + important/crucial/major + role(s) + in”结构，尤其描述生物因素在疾病、病理或生理过程中的作用；另在荷兰语词内子串及专利固定措辞中也有高激活。

patterns.name: “play important role(s) in”句式
patterns.context: 描述细胞、蛋白或生物过程对疾病、病理机制或生理过程的作用；“role(s)”后接 in 及具体作用对象。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: “play crucial role(s) in”句式
patterns.context: 强调代谢或分子因素在疾病机制中的关键作用；与重要作用句式相近，但形容词为 crucial。

patterns.name: “play a major role in”句式
patterns.context: 单数主语，说明某成分对具体生物效应的主要贡献。

patterns.name: 荷兰语句内高激活词
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本；激活落在词内子串，未见明确与生物医学句式相同的语义上下文。

patterns.name: 专利实施例措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景或实施例段落中的固定法律技术表述；此处不符合生物医学作用句式。

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on the Dutch “de huidige,” and occurs sporadically in English degree, quantity, and common fixed collocations; other triggers include disclaimers, patent boilerplate, line breaks, and separators, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Adjective form meaning current/at this stage
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on huidige (“current”) following the Dutch definite article de, and also appears in the phrase “current monopoly stage”; words are marked as fragments, so a single triggering fragment cannot be inferred from the fragments alone.

patterns.name: Degree/quantity structures in English phrases
patterns.context: In English, activation falls on degree adjectives or quantifiers and adjacent words. Common structures include large an amount, a huge facility, such an important role, as many games, a more efficient war; the phrases are not fully consistent with one another.
patterns.domain: English prose across legal, news, encyclopedia, sports reporting, and email texts

patterns.name: Uppercase boilerplate in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: Appears in an all-caps, line-formatted software disclaimer, especially fixed expressions such as “AS IS,” “OF ANY KIND,” “EXPRESS OR IMPLIED,” and “IN NO EVENT.”

patterns.name: Patent example phrasing
patterns.context: Appears in the common patent boilerplate “In one or more embodiments,” with activation mainly on more.

patterns.name: Separators and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: The line-break marker itself is marked; it appears at paragraph, list, or quoted-text boundaries, with insufficient evidence for a stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Forum texts and encyclopedia-style web texts

patterns.name: Multiword activation in adjacent paragraphs
patterns.context: Appears in a sequence of hyphen-separated lines in HackerNews text; the passage also contains English degree constructions, but those do not directly explain activation on the lines.

patterns.name: Conditional structure in insurance clauses
patterns.context: Located in the legal expression “in good faith,” surrounded by conditional clauses about whether an insurer issues a policy or provides coverage.

5_2513.description: 激活最集中于荷兰语“de huidige”，并零散出现在英文程度、数量及常见固定搭配中；另有免责声明、专利套语、换行和分隔线等格式或模板触发，难以归并为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 当前/现阶段的形容词形式
patterns.trigger: « de» « h» «uid» «ige»（合起来为荷兰语 «de huidige»）；另见 « monopol» «ist» «ische» « f» «ase»
patterns.context: 激活集中在荷兰语定冠词 de 后的 huidige（“当前的”），也出现于“当前垄断阶段”短语中；词语被分片标记，不能仅凭分片断定单一触发片段。

patterns.name: 英文短语中的程度/数量结构
patterns.trigger: « large» « an»；« a» « huge»；« such» « an» « important»；« as» « many»；« a» « more» « efficient»
patterns.context: 在英文中，激活落在程度形容词或数量词及相邻词上，常见结构包括 large an amount、a huge facility、such an important role、as many games、a more efficient war；不同短语之间并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 法律、新闻、百科、体育报道及邮件等英文散文

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的大写固定套语
patterns.trigger: « IS» « OF» « ANY» « KIND»；« OR» « IMPLIED»；« NO»
patterns.context: 出现在全大写、逐行排版的软件免责声明中，尤其是“AS IS”“OF ANY KIND”“EXPRESS OR IMPLIED”及“IN NO EVENT”等固定句式。
patterns.domain: GitHub 软件许可证/版权免责声明

patterns.name: 专利实施例措辞
patterns.context: 出现在“In one or more embodiments”专利常用套语中，激活主要落在 more。

patterns.name: 分隔符与排版边界
patterns.context: 换行标记本身被标记；出现在段落、列表或引用文本边界，未见足够证据确定稳定的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本及百科类网页文本

patterns.name: 相邻段落中的多词组激活
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 文本中的一串连字符分隔线；该段还包含英文程度结构，但分隔线激活无法由该结构直接解释。

patterns.name: 保险条款中的条件性结构
patterns.context: 位于“in good faith”法律表述中，周围为保险人是否签发保单或提供保障的条件条款。

en.description: Mainly responds to collocations expressing a role or importance, such as play a/an important/major role(s) in; also activates on close a deal, close a facility, intimate contact, and play little or no role.

patterns.name: play a major/important role collocation
patterns.context: Describes the important role of a factor in a biological process, disease, mechanism, or academic debate; often followed by an in phrase.

patterns.name: close a deal collocation
patterns.context: close is followed by an article and deal, meaning to reach an agreement; here it concerns U.S.–Russia ceasefire negotiations.

patterns.name: close a facility collocation
patterns.context: close is followed by an article and a descriptive noun phrase, meaning to shut down an engineering facility.

patterns.name: intimate contact collocation
patterns.context: Describes two materials being in close contact; there is no play/role collocation.

patterns.name: little or no role collocation
patterns.context: Discusses whether a factor has little or no role in preference formation; opposite to the common important/major role pattern.

5_2513.description: 主要对 play a/an important/major role(s) in 等表示作用或重要性的搭配反应；另对 close a deal、close a facility、intimate contact 及 play little or no role 等局部词组有激活。

patterns.name: play a major/important role 搭配
patterns.context: 说明某因素在生物过程、疾病、作用机制或学术争论中的重要作用；常接 in 短语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及神学论述

patterns.name: close a deal 搭配
patterns.context: close 后接冠词和 deal，指达成协议；此处涉及美俄停火谈判。

patterns.name: close a facility 搭配
patterns.context: close 后接冠词和描述性名词短语，指关闭工程设施。

patterns.name: intimate contact 搭配
patterns.context: 描述两类材料紧密接触；无 play/role 搭配。

patterns.name: little or no role 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论某因素在偏好形成中的作用是否很小或不存在；与常见的 important/major role 相反。

en.description: Most passages activate on play(s) a/important/crucial/major/large role(s), describing the role, mechanism, or outcome of biomedical factors; two other passages activate on close/closed a deal or facility, possibly sharing a local “verb + article + noun” collocation.

patterns.name: “play a role” functional/causal expression
patterns.context: The verb play/plays is followed by a/important/crucial/major/large role(s), usually followed by in or a phrase specifying function, disease mechanism, or outcome determination; activation is concentrated on role(s) and its preceding and following modifiers.
patterns.domain: Functional or causal descriptions in biomedical papers, medical abstracts, and patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Collocation for reaching an agreement
patterns.context: close is followed by a deal, meaning to reach an agreement through negotiation; activation falls on close, a, deal.

patterns.name: Collocation for closing a facility/completing a transaction
patterns.context: closed is followed by a + size or property modifier + facility; nearby context also mentions auctioned-off equipment and describes a facility closure.

5_2513.concept: 常见动词—冠词—名词搭配
5_2513.description: 多数段落激活于 play(s) a/important/crucial/major/large role(s)，用于说明生物医学因素的作用、机制或结果；另有两段激活于 close/closed a deal 或 facility，可能共享“动词+冠词+名词”局部搭配。

patterns.name: “play a role”功能/因果表述
patterns.trigger: “play important roles in the pathogenesis” [2]；“plays important role” [4]；“plays a major role” [5][8]；“play crucial roles” [6]；“play important roles” [7]；“plays a role in determination” [9]；“plays a large role in determining” [10]
patterns.context: 动词 play/plays 后接 a/important/crucial/major/large role(s)，通常再接 in 或表示功能、疾病机制、结果决定的短语；激活集中在 role(s) 及其前后的限定词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、医学摘要、专利背景中的功能或因果说明

patterns.name: 达成协议的搭配
patterns.context: close 后接 a deal，表示通过谈判达成协议；激活落在 close、a、deal。

patterns.name: 关闭设施/完成交易的搭配
patterns.context: closed 后接 a + 规模或性质修饰语 + facility；邻近语境也提及 auctioned off 设备，描述设施关闭。

en.concept: English noun phrases and common collocations
en.description: Activation often occurs in phrases where a is followed by an adjective and a noun, and also covers “play an important role,” wage a war/battle, and similar collocations; other examples include close a deal, intimate contact, and effect in legal clauses. The remaining triggers in the first passage are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Intensity or scale modifier after the indefinite article
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near the article a and the following adjective or degree word; the adjective is followed by a noun phrase, as in “a huge engineering facility,” “a more efficient war,” “a major role.”
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including news, email, legal texts, and scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Important role in a fixed collocation
patterns.context: A subject or topic “plays an important role,” commonly in descriptions of disease mechanisms, historical conflicts, or physiological regulation.

patterns.name: War or struggle phrasing after the verb wage
patterns.context: wage/waged is followed by a, a modifier, and then war or battle; expresses waging or initiating a war or struggle.
patterns.domain: War metaphors in emails, political news

patterns.name: close a deal collocation
patterns.context: close is followed by the indefinite article and deal, meaning to reach an agreement; associated with a ceasefire negotiation context.

patterns.name: intimate contact collocation
patterns.context: Describes close contact between two types of material, with intimate modifying contact.

patterns.name: Fixed expression with effect in legal texts
patterns.context: effect appears after a page number or citation marker, in a clause concerning the continued validity of a contract.

5_2513.concept: 英语名词短语与常见搭配
5_2513.description: 激活多见于 a 后接形容词及名词的短语，也覆盖“发挥重要作用”、wage a war/battle 等搭配；另有 close a deal、intimate contact 和法律条款中的 effect。第1段的其余触发尚难统一解释。

patterns.name: 不定冠词后接强度或规模修饰语
patterns.trigger: «a»9/10« more»、«a»9« huge»、«a»9« major»、«a»9« large»，以及 «a»9« successful»
patterns.context: 激活集中在冠词 a 和其后的形容词或程度词附近；形容词后接名词短语，如 “a huge engineering facility”“a more efficient war”“a major role”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、邮件、法律、科学摘要等多种文体

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的重要角色
patterns.trigger: «play»« important»« roles»；«played»« such»« an»« important»« role»；«play»« a»« major»« role»
patterns.context: 主语或论述对象“发挥/扮演重要作用”，常见于对疾病机制、历史冲突或生理调控的说明。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、宗教历史说明

patterns.name: 动词 wage 后的战争或斗争表述
patterns.trigger: «waging»« a»« more»« efficient»« war»；«waged»« a»« successful»« battle»
patterns.context: wage/waged 后接 a 与修饰语，再接 war 或 battle；表达进行或发起战争、斗争。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的战争比喻、政治新闻

patterns.name: close a deal 搭配
patterns.context: close 后接不定冠词和 deal，指达成协议；与停火谈判语境相连。

patterns.name: intimate contact 搭配
patterns.context: 描述两类材料之间紧密接触，形容词 intimate 修饰 contact。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 effect 固定表达
patterns.context: 页码或引文标记后出现 effect，处在合同持续有效的条款中。

en.description: High activation occurs in several local collocations: biomedical plays a major/important role, transaction or facility nouns after closed, quantity-range expressions, and phrases such as open a time rift and intimate contact. There are also forum separators and sporadic words; the collocations span a broad range of meanings.

patterns.name: Expression of a significant role
patterns.context: A subject is followed by plays a major/important role, describing the importance of a factor in a process or phenomenon.

patterns.name: Completing a transaction or lease
patterns.context: closed is followed by an article and a noun phrase referring to a transaction, lease, or facility; it denotes completing a transaction or closing a facility.

patterns.name: Quantity and range qualification
patterns.context: Emphasizes very small or no quantity, or a larger range.

patterns.name: Opening a time rift
patterns.context: open is followed by a and a specific object in a fantasy setting.

patterns.name: Close contact
patterns.context: intimate modifies contact, describing the contact relationship between material components.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous items and markers
patterns.context: Separators, placeholder-like text, and words that collocate with nearby phrases but do not form any of the stable patterns above.

5_2513.description: 高激活落在多种局部搭配中：生物医学的 plays a major/important role、closed 后的交易或设施名词、数量范围表达，以及 open a time rift 和 intimate contact 等。另有论坛分隔符及零散词项；各搭配语义跨度较大。

patterns.name: 重大作用表述
patterns.trigger: “plays a major role”“plays an important role”
patterns.context: 主语后接 plays a major/important role，说明某因素在某过程或现象中的重要作用。

patterns.name: 完成交易或租赁
patterns.trigger: “closed a huge engineering facility”“closed a new lease”
patterns.context: closed 后接冠词及交易、租赁或设施等名词短语；所指是完成交易，或关闭设施。

patterns.name: 数量与范围限定
patterns.context: 强调程度或数量的极少、没有或较大范围。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、保险法律文本

patterns.name: 开启时间裂隙
patterns.context: open 后接 a 与奇幻设定中的具体对象。

patterns.name: 紧密接触
patterns.context: intimate 修饰 contact，描述材料组分间的接触关系。

patterns.name: 杂项及标记
patterns.context: 分隔符、占位式文本，以及与相邻短语搭配但未形成以上稳定模式的词。

en.concept: Expressions of important roles and article-following collocations
en.description: Most passages in research contexts express that a process, mechanism, factor, or method plays an important or key role, commonly using play(s) + article + importance adjective + role(s); there are also the narrative collocations closed a huge engineering facility and open a time rift.

patterns.name: plays a major role collocation
patterns.context: play(s) is followed by an article, an importance adjective, and role, with the role explained afterward; the article and spacing between words vary.

patterns.name: plays essential/crucial roles
patterns.context: Expresses that a factor, mechanism, or method plays a key role; includes both play(s) and makes crucial use constructions.

patterns.name: Closing equipment or a facility
patterns.context: Describes a company shutting down a large engineering facility; activation falls on the closure verb and the following article, scale, and facility words.

patterns.name: Indefinite article and time rift
patterns.context: Describes a character opening a time rift; activation spans open, a, and parts of rift.

5_2513.concept: 重要作用表达及冠词后续搭配
5_2513.description: 多数段落在科研语境中表达某过程、机制、因子或方法发挥重要、关键作用，常见 play(s) + 冠词 + importance 形容词 + role(s)；另有 closed a huge engineering facility 和 open a time rift 两个叙事性搭配。

patterns.name: plays a major role 固定搭配
patterns.trigger: « plays»…« a»…« major»…« role»；« play»…« an»…« important»…« role»
patterns.context: 动词 play(s) 后接冠词、重要性形容词和 role，后文说明其作用；冠词及词间距离有所变化。

patterns.name: plays essential/crucial roles
patterns.trigger: « plays»…« essential»…« roles»；« makes»…« crucial»…« use»；« play»…« crucial»…« roles»
patterns.context: 表达某因素、机制或方法具有关键作用；包含 play(s) 和 makes crucial use 两种句式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研论文

patterns.name: 闭合设备或设施
patterns.context: 叙述公司关闭大型工程设施，激活落在闭合动词及其后的冠词、规模和设施词上。

patterns.name: 不定冠词与时间裂隙
patterns.context: 叙述角色打开时间裂隙；激活覆盖 open、a 及 rift 的部分字词。

en.description: All passages contain the collocation of play/plays with role(s), usually modified by major, crucial, essential, or important; it describes the role of entities in biomedical processes, and also occurs in physics contexts.

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: Describes the important role of a molecule, factor, or pathogen in a biological process, phenotype, or disease development; commonly appears in subject–verb sentences.

patterns.name: play crucial role(s)
patterns.context: Explicitly emphasizes a factor’s crucial role in a pathological mechanism or in preventing infection; may include modifiers or intervening prepositional phrases.

patterns.name: play essential role(s)
patterns.context: Emphasizes that a biological structure or physical process is indispensable to function, dynamics, or dissipation.

patterns.name: play important role(s)
patterns.context: Associates a protein, pathogen, or matrix component with processes such as disease, signaling, or tissue maintenance; adverbs may also intervene.

5_2513.description: 所有段落都包含 play/plays 与 role(s) 的搭配，通常由 major、crucial、essential 或 important 修饰；用于陈述实体在生物医学过程中的作用，也见于物理学语境。

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: 描述某种分子、因子或病原体对生物过程、表型或疾病发生的重要作用；常见主谓句式。

patterns.name: play crucial role(s)
patterns.context: 明确强调某因素在病理机制或预防感染中的关键作用；可有修饰语或介词短语插入。

patterns.name: play essential role(s)
patterns.context: 强调生物结构或物理过程对功能、动力学或耗散不可或缺。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及物理学论文

patterns.name: play important role(s)
patterns.context: 将蛋白、病原体或基质成分与疾病、信号、组织维持等过程关联；也可有副词插入。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及专利背景

en.description: The most prominent pattern is play(s) combined with a/an or a plural noun and role(s), modified by major, important, or crucial, to describe the role of a factor; less common fragments include play a role as, huge facility, and little difference.

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: A subject, often a biomolecule, factor, or process, is followed by plays a major role to describe its function or role.

patterns.name: play an important role
patterns.context: play(s) is followed by an important role, often followed by a specific mechanism or outcome; sometimes the phrase spans marked tokens.

patterns.name: play crucial role
patterns.context: play is followed by crucial role, describing a factor’s crucial role in an outcome or in prevention.

patterns.name: play important roles in pathogenesis
patterns.context: Plural roles is followed by a disease development process.

patterns.name: play a role as
patterns.context: play a role is followed by as, describing an object’s identity or capacity rather than its role in an outcome.

patterns.name: Large-scale or degree modifier
patterns.context: The adjective huge modifies the size of a facility; there is no clear play a role construction.

patterns.name: little difference
patterns.context: little modifies difference, expressing a minor effect; there is no clear play a role construction.

5_2513.description: 最显著模式是 play(s) 与 a/an 或复数名词搭配 role(s)，再由 major、important、crucial 修饰，说明某因素的作用；另有 play a role as、huge facility 与 little difference 等少见片段。

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: 主语（常为生物分子、因子或过程）后接 plays a major role，说明其作用或功能。

patterns.name: play an important role
patterns.trigger: “play an important role”或“plays an important role”
patterns.context: play(s) 后接 an important role，常跟随具体机制或结果；有时短语跨越标记 token。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学及技术文本

patterns.name: play crucial role
patterns.context: play 后接 crucial role，说明某因素对于结果或预防具有关键作用。

patterns.name: play important roles in pathogenesis
patterns.trigger: “play important roles in the pathogenesis of”
patterns.context: 复数 roles 后接疾病发病过程。

patterns.name: play a role as
patterns.trigger: “play a role as an orphan ligand or receptor”
patterns.context: play a role 后接 as，描述某对象所扮演的身份，而非其对某结果的作用。

patterns.name: large规模或程度修饰语
patterns.context: 形容词 huge 修饰设施规模；没有明显的 play a role 结构。

patterns.name: little difference
patterns.context: little 修饰 difference，表达结果影响很小；没有明显的 play a role 结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to the collocations play/plays with a major, crucial, or essential role across life science, medical, and physics genres; two other passages involve closing an engineering facility and made little difference, without the main collocation.

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: The verb play/plays is followed by a major role and may be followed by complements such as in or as; the same expression may have appeared earlier in the text.

patterns.name: play a crucial role
patterns.context: play is followed by a crucial role, describing a factor’s important role in an outcome.
patterns.domain: Medical papers on surgery and infection prevention

patterns.name: play an essential role
patterns.context: play is followed by an essential role, describing a process’s role in a subsequent physical process.

patterns.name: Closure of an engineering facility
patterns.context: Describes a company closing a large engineering facility; this passage has no role collocation.

patterns.name: Company profit differences are immaterial
patterns.context: In a legal context concerning company ownership and profit distribution, states that a particular difference makes little difference to the relevant parties; this passage has no role collocation.

5_2513.description: 主要响应 play/plays 与 a major、crucial 或 essential role 的搭配，跨生命科学、医学和物理学文体；另有两段分别涉及关闭工程设施和 made little difference，缺少主搭配。

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: 动词 play/plays 后接 a major role，后面可接 in、as 等补足成分；有时前文已出现相同表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与生命科学论文

patterns.name: play a crucial role
patterns.context: play 后接 a crucial role，描述某因素对结果的重要作用。
patterns.domain: 医学论文，涉及手术与感染预防

patterns.name: play an essential role
patterns.context: play 后接 an essential role，说明某过程在后续物理过程中的作用。

patterns.name: 工程设施关闭
patterns.context: 描述公司关闭大型工程设施；本段没有 role 搭配。

patterns.name: 公司利润差异无关紧要
patterns.context: 在公司所有权与利润分配的法律语境中，说明对相关人员而言某种差别不大；本段没有 role 搭配。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in collocations of play(ed/s) with an article and role, describing an object playing an important role; there are also responses to fixed collocations close a deal, close a facility, and make little difference.

patterns.name: play/play a role
patterns.context: The verb is followed by an article and “role,” often modified by “major,” “crucial,” “essential,” “critical,” or “important”; used to describe the role of a factor, person, or event.
patterns.domain: Expository writing in biomedicine, physics, history, and other fields

patterns.name: close a deal
patterns.context: “close” means to reach an agreement and is followed by “a deal”; the context involves U.S.–Russia negotiations and a ceasefire.

patterns.name: close a facility
patterns.context: “closed” means shut down and is followed by a facility and descriptions of its scale and nature.

patterns.name: make little difference
patterns.context: “make little difference” indicates that an outcome or choice has little effect on the parties; the context involves company shareholders and profit distribution.

5_2513.description: 主要激活于 play(ed/s) 与冠词、role 搭配并说明某对象发挥重要作用；另对 close a deal、close a facility 及 make little difference 等固定搭配有反应。

patterns.name: play/play a role
patterns.context: 动词后接冠词和“role”，常由“major”“crucial”“essential”“critical”“important”等修饰；用于说明某因素、人物或事件的作用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、物理、历史等说明性文体

patterns.name: close a deal
patterns.context: “close”表示达成协议，后接“a deal”，语境涉及美俄谈判及停火。

patterns.name: close a facility
patterns.context: “closed”表示关闭；后接设施及其规模、性质等描述。

patterns.name: make little difference
patterns.context: 以“make little difference”表示结果或选择对当事人影响不大，语境涉及公司股东和利润分配。

en.concept: Expressions of important roles and event outcomes
en.description: Primarily responds to phrases meaning “play an important role,” and also to finalizing a deal, little combined with difference or negation, and closing a large engineering facility; common in formal discussion and reporting.

patterns.name: “play a major/important role” expression
patterns.context: Indicates that a factor, event, or system plays an important role in a biological process or historical development; word order may vary, and inflections or modifiers may separate the phrase.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical research, historical narratives

patterns.name: Reaching or finalizing a deal
patterns.context: close means to finalize or reach a commercial or diplomatic agreement, rather than to shut something; deal may be followed by a purpose or plan.

patterns.name: Expressions with little and negation or difference
patterns.context: little combined with difference indicates a negligible effect, or combined with to no indicates virtually no significance.

patterns.name: Closure of an engineering facility
patterns.context: closed means shutting a large engineering facility; nearby text also mentions equipment being auctioned off.

5_2513.concept: 重要作用及事件结果表达
5_2513.description: 主要响应“发挥重要作用”的词组，也响应敲定交易、little 与差异或否定意义搭配，以及关闭大型工程设施；多见于正式论述与报道。

patterns.name: “play a major/important role”表达
patterns.context: 表示某因素、事件或系统在生物过程、历史发展中发挥重要作用；词序可能有变化，且常被分词时态或修饰语隔开。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学研究、历史叙述

patterns.name: 达成或敲定交易
patterns.context: close 表示敲定、达成商业或外交协议，而非关闭物体；deal 可接后续目的或计划。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、娱乐人物简介

patterns.name: little 与否定或差异表达
patterns.context: little 与 difference 组合表示影响甚微，或与 to no 组合表示几乎毫无意义。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、网络论坛讨论

patterns.name: 工程设施关闭
patterns.context: closed 表示关闭大型工程设施，附近还提及设备拍卖。

en.description: Mainly responds to academic expressions of roles in the form play a/an + importance modifier + role(s), with modifiers including major, important, distinct, and fundamental. Other examples include key component of the and the news collocation close a deal.

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: Biomedical papers describe a factor, mechanism, or system playing an important role; activation centers on play, a, and major, while role itself is not marked.

patterns.name: play important/distinct roles
patterns.context: Academic texts use plural roles to describe the role of receptors, factors, or cells; modifiers include distinct and important.

patterns.name: play fundamental roles
patterns.context: Summarizes the fundamental role of a type of organism in an ecosystem; there is no article a, and roles is plural.

patterns.name: key component of the
patterns.context: Describes the composition of Anthrax toxin; activation falls on key and the following of the, with play a major role appearing later in the same passage.

patterns.name: close a deal
patterns.context: News reporting describes reaching an agreement with Russia; distinct from the biomedical play-a-role expression.

5_2513.description: 主要响应学术文本中 play a/an + 重要性修饰语 + role(s) 的作用表述，修饰语涵盖 major、important、distinct、fundamental。另见 key component of the 与新闻搭配 close a deal。

patterns.name: play a major role
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中描述某因素、机制或系统发挥重要作用；激活集中在 play、a、major，role 本身未标记。

patterns.name: play important/distinct roles
patterns.context: 学术文本中以复数 roles 描述受体、因子或细胞的作用；修饰语包括 distinct、important。

patterns.name: play fundamental roles
patterns.context: 概述某类生物在生态系统中的基础作用；没有冠词 a，roles 为复数。

patterns.name: key component of the
patterns.context: 描述 Anthrax toxin 的组成；激活落在 key 及其后的 of the，随后同段又出现 play a major role。

patterns.name: close a deal
patterns.context: 新闻报道中表示与俄罗斯达成协议；与生物医学中的 play-a-role 表达不同。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on the word Classical: it functions as an adjective in physics, music, philosophy, communications, architecture, and data analysis, followed by nouns from different fields. Two other passages do not contain the word and are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: Classical as an adjective: physics
patterns.context: Appears in physics comparisons or discussions, such as classical physics versus quantum physics and Classical and Quantum Mechanics; physics terms also appear adjacent to «Classical».
patterns.domain: Quantum physics, dynamical systems, and scientific titles

patterns.name: Classical as an adjective: guitar music
patterns.context: Modifies guitar, appearing in introductions to people recording CDs and in music reviews.

patterns.name: Classical as an adjective: philosophical methods or reasoning
patterns.context: Modifies philosophical research methods or Reductio; both occur in the context of philosophy paper titles or abstracts.

patterns.name: Classical as an adjective: electronic equalization technology
patterns.context: Appears in technical discussions involving abbreviations such as AFE and DFE, data eye diagrams, and equalizer performance.
patterns.domain: Patent background, communications, and signal processing

patterns.name: Classical as an adjective: architectural style
patterns.context: Refers to architectural language or traditional style in architectural introductions and reference book titles.

patterns.name: Classical as an adjective: data analysis techniques
patterns.context: Associated with methods such as hierarchical clustering, referring to traditional techniques used for graph data analysis.

5_2718.description: 激活集中在 Classical 一词：它在物理、音乐、哲学、通信、建筑和数据分析语境中作形容词，后接不同领域名词；另有两段未见该词，难以解释。

patterns.name: Classical 作形容词：物理学

patterns.name: Classical 作形容词：吉他音乐

patterns.name: Classical 作形容词：哲学方法或推理
patterns.context: 修饰哲学研究方法或 Reductio；均出现在哲学论文标题或摘要语境。

patterns.name: Classical 作形容词：电子均衡技术

patterns.name: Classical 作形容词：建筑风格
patterns.context: 在建筑介绍及参考书名中，指建筑语言或传统风格。

patterns.name: Classical 作形容词：数据分析技术
patterns.context: 与层次聚类等方法相连，指用于图数据分析的传统技术。

en.description: Most passages activate on the capitalized word «Classical», followed by terms from diverse fields; there is also the collocation classical guitar. The «killer» in the medical passage and «Wouri estuary» in the place-name passage also activate, which this does not explain.

patterns.name: Classical prefix and following content
patterns.context: The word Classical appears in a title, body text, or phrase; it may be followed by terms from different fields, such as physics, Reductio, Approach, DFE, Language, and techniques, or contrasted with quantum.

patterns.name: Specific phrase classical guitar

patterns.name: Independent repetitions of the capitalized word Classical

patterns.name: Unexplained activation near a special term
patterns.context: Strong activation near the place name Wouri estuary, although the passage contains no Classical; this cannot be explained by the dominant word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Unexplained activation near a technical term

5_2718.description: 多数段落在大写词 «Classical» 处激活，后接多样领域词语；另有 classical guitar 搭配。医学段的 «killer» 与地名段的 «Wouri estuary» 激活，无法由此解释。

patterns.name: Classical 前缀及后接内容
patterns.context: 词语 Classical 出现在标题、正文或短语中；后文可接不同领域词语，如 physics、Reductio、Approach、DFE、Language、techniques，也可与 quantum 对举。

patterns.name: 特定短语 classical guitar

patterns.name: 大写词 Classical 的独立重复

patterns.name: unexplained 的特殊近邻触发

patterns.name: unexplained 的术语邻近激活
