en.description: The most consistent cue is the English word “Classical,” found across diverse fields and noun collocations. Other high activations are sporadic, appearing in mathematical digit expressions, medical terminology, immunology fragments, and proper names or subword fragments, with no common semantic explanation so far.

patterns.name: The word Classical
patterns.context: The complete English word Classical appears; it can modify different nouns such as physics, Reductio, guitar, Approach, DFE, techniques, and Language, and can also occur in a title or book title. No specific syntax or domain is required.
patterns.domain: Academic and encyclopedic genres across fields: physics, philosophy, music, engineering, data analysis, architecture

patterns.name: Numbers and digit expressions
patterns.context: In the mathematical phrase “hundreds digit of x?” number- or digit-related tokens activate consecutively; a line break and “2” follow.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and abbreviations
patterns.context: The medical term “Posterior tibial tendon dysfunction” and its parenthetical abbreviation “PTTD” activate after tokenization, especially the abbreviation’s character fragments.

patterns.name: Immunology terms and the letter G
patterns.context: In immunological descriptions related to antibodies and natural killer cell receptors, G and tokens such as killer activate; the same passage also contains Crohn’s disease and a trial title.

patterns.name: Name or proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens, and some name or abbreviation fragments activate; the main salient cues differ across passages, so proper names themselves cannot be confirmed as a common condition.
patterns.domain: Paper bylines, encyclopedic biographies, and references

patterns.name: Other local fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments, abbreviation fragments, or common short tokens occur in different contexts; aside from the word cues listed above, there is insufficient evidence for a shared trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, engineering patents, medical texts, and others

5_2718.description: 最稳定的线索是英文单词“Classical”，分布于多种领域与名词搭配中。其余高激活分散在数学位数表达、医学术语、免疫学片段及专名或分词碎片，暂无共同语义解释。

patterns.name: Classical 一词
patterns.context: 英文中出现完整单词 Classical；该词可修饰 physics、Reductio、guitar、Approach、DFE、techniques、Language 等不同名词，也可位于标题或书名中。无需特定句法或领域。
patterns.domain: 跨学术与百科文体：物理学、哲学、音乐、工程、数据分析、建筑

patterns.name: 数字与位数表达
patterns.context: 数学式短语“hundreds digit of x?”中，数值/位数相关 token 连续激活；后接换行和“2”。

patterns.name: 医学术语与缩写
patterns.context: 医学术语“Posterior tibial tendon dysfunction”及其括号内缩写“PTTD”被分词后激活，尤其缩写字符片段较强。

patterns.name: 免疫学术语及 G 字母
patterns.context: 抗体及自然杀伤细胞受体相关的免疫学描述中，G 和 killer 等 token 激活；同段也出现 Crohn’s disease 与试验标题。

patterns.name: 姓名或专名片段
patterns.context: 专有名称被拆分为多个 token，部分姓名或缩写片段激活；同段的主要显著线索各异，不能确认专名本身构成统一条件。
patterns.domain: 论文署名、百科人物介绍与参考文献

patterns.name: 其他局部碎片
patterns.context: 不同语境中出现的词内分词、缩写片段或常见短 token；除已列出的词语线索外，尚无足够证据构成共同触发模式。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文、工程专利及医学文本等

en.concept: Proper names and structural fragments in technical texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across number strings, medical terminology and abbreviations, academic titles and metadata, academic expressions related to Classical, and blank spacing in legal texts; no single word meaning or domain accounts for all examples.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric suffixes
patterns.context: Values, number strings, or number words appear in math problems or legal citations; some numbers are adjacent to letters or line breaks.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of technical terms or abbreviations
patterns.context: Subword fragments in biomedical proper names, disease names, or abbreviations activate through tokenization, often at the start of a title or term.
patterns.domain: Medical paper titles, abstracts, and funding texts

patterns.name: Paper titles and academic metadata
patterns.context: Academic page elements such as paper titles, authors/institutions, and abstracts; activations fall on title words, metadata, or section names.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, institutional funding texts, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Classical and related philosophical/logical terms
patterns.context: “Classical” modifies physics or logical-reasoning terms in quantum mechanics papers or philosophical argumentation.

patterns.name: Irregular spacing and layout fields
patterns.context: Activations occur near padded spaces, page layouts, or line-break markers in legal citations.

5_2718.concept: 专业文本中的专名与结构片段
5_2718.description: 激活分散于数字串、医学术语及缩写、学术标题和元数据、Classical相关学术表述，以及法律文本的空白排版；没有一个词义或领域能覆盖全部样例。

patterns.name: 数字与数字后缀
patterns.context: 数值、数字串或数量词出现在数学题或法律引文中；部分数字紧邻字母或换行。

patterns.name: 专业术语或缩写的内部片段
patterns.context: 生物医学专名、疾病名或缩写中的词片段被分词激活，常处于标题或术语开头。
patterns.domain: 医学论文标题、摘要及资助文本

patterns.name: 论文标题与学术元数据
patterns.context: 论文标题、作者/机构与摘要等学术页面元素；激活落在标题词、元数据或栏目名称上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、机构资助文本、百科条目

patterns.name: Classical 与相关哲学/逻辑术语
patterns.context: “Classical”修饰物理学或逻辑推理术语，出现在量子力学论文或哲学论证文本中。

patterns.name: 不规则空白与排版字段
patterns.context: 法律引文中的填充空格、页面布局或换行标记附近出现激活。

en.description: Activations occur across mathematical quantity expressions, title and proper-name fragments, medical terms and abstract phrases, funding statements, email attachment formulas, and macro definitions; the trigger points span word classes and genres, with no unified semantic or stable surface pattern.

patterns.name: Number and unit/quantifier expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical text contains the quantifier “hundreds,” a number, and a following variable and question mark, followed by a line break

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names or titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within multiword proper names, titles, or terms; fragments may cross tokenization boundaries and share no common meaning
patterns.domain: Entertainment news headlines, medical paper titles

patterns.name: Medical terms and abbreviations
patterns.context: In medical text, activation covers components of disease or drug terms, abbreviations, and neighboring words

patterns.name: Specific phrases in medical research titles
patterns.context: In medical oncology titles or abstracts, activation falls on phrases describing disease status or treatment line

patterns.name: Funding and training-program wording
patterns.context: In sentences describing training grants and their research focus, activation centers on program categories and funding-related expressions

patterns.name: Email attachment notification formula
patterns.context: An email informs the recipient that a revised attachment is included, with a possible subsequent description of its contents

patterns.name: Code macro definitions and character sequences
patterns.context: In C/C++ preprocessor macro definitions, the macro name consists of an underscore-separated uppercase identifier followed by a character list

5_2718.description: 激活分布于数学数量表达、标题与专名片段、医学术语和摘要短语、资助说明、邮件附件套语及宏定义；触发点跨词类与文体，未见统一语义或稳定表面模式。

patterns.name: 数值与单位/量词表达
patterns.context: 数学文本中出现数量词“hundreds”、数字及其后的变量和问号，后接换行

patterns.name: 专名或标题内部的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多词专名、标题或术语的词内片段上；片段可能跨越分词边界，缺乏共同词义
patterns.domain: 娱乐新闻标题、医学论文标题

patterns.name: 医学术语及缩写
patterns.context: 医学文本中，激活覆盖疾病或药物术语的组成部分、缩写及邻近词

patterns.name: 医学研究标题中的具体短语
patterns.context: 医学肿瘤学标题或摘要中，激活落在描述疾病状态或治疗线次的短语上

patterns.name: 资助与培训项目措辞
patterns.context: 描述培训资助项目及其研究重点的句子中，激活集中在项目类别和资助相关表达

patterns.name: 邮件附件通知套语
patterns.context: 邮件中告知收件人有修订版附件，后续可说明附件内容

patterns.name: 代码宏定义与字符序列
patterns.context: C/C++预处理器宏定义中，宏名由下划线分隔的大写标识符组成，后接字符列表

en.description: The most stable pattern is word-initial “Mod” in PubMed titles, corresponding to Modulation, Modifications, and Modifying. There is also a strong response to hyphens in email and code text; other activations are sporadic across punctuation, RAGE, filenames, and tokenized fragments of command-line arguments.

patterns.name: Word-initial Mod-
patterns.context: Occurs at the start of a PubMed paper title or abstract as the beginning of an English word; subsequent forms make up Modulation, Modifications, and Modifying.

patterns.name: Hyphens and dashes
patterns.context: Occurs on hyphens in English text or prefixes of command-line options; in one case it joins a phrase, and in another it introduces a compiler argument.

patterns.name: Specific compiler option marker
patterns.context: A percent-sign placeholder and the hyphen before an option in a Clang command-line example; may be a local trigger beyond the previous pattern.

patterns.name: Punctuation and internal fragments of proper names
patterns.context: In passage 1, punctuation in a short phrase after “-”; in passage 4, the word-initial tokenization position of the biomedical proper name RAGE. The contexts differ.

patterns.name: BugDriver identifier fragment
patterns.context: The filename BugDriver.cpp in a GitHub source-file comment; this identifier pattern does not appear elsewhere.

patterns.name: Other token fragments
patterns.context: The token triple in the compiler command in passage 10; activation falls on subword fragments within proper names or arguments, with no cross-passage pattern.

5_2718.description: 最稳定的模式是 PubMed 标题中的词首“Mod”，对应 Modulation、Modifications、Modifying。另在邮件和代码文本中对短横线强烈响应；其余激活零散落在标点、RAGE、文件名和命令参数的分词片段上。

patterns.name: Mod- 词首
patterns.context: 位于 PubMed 论文标题或摘要开头，作为英文单词的词首；后续词形分别组成 Modulation、Modifications、Modifying。

patterns.name: 连字符与破折号
patterns.context: 出现在英文文本中的连字符或命令行选项前缀；一次连接短语，一次引出编译器参数。

patterns.name: 特定编译器选项标记
patterns.context: Clang 命令行示例中，百分号占位符及选项前的短横线；可能是上一模式之外的局部触发。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释、编译命令

patterns.name: 标点与专名内部片段
patterns.context: 第1段在“-”之后的短句标点；第4段则在生物医学专名 RAGE 的词首分词位置。两者上下文不相同。
patterns.domain: 邮件短语；生物医学文献

patterns.name: BugDriver 标识符片段
patterns.context: GitHub 源文件注释中的文件名 BugDriver.cpp；除此之外未见该标识符模式。

patterns.name: 其他分词片段
patterns.context: 第10段编译器命令中的 triple 分词；激活落在专名或参数内部的子词片段，不构成跨段模式。

en.concept: Structured symbols and terminology in technical texts
en.description: Activations occur in technical texts across multiple fields: LaTeX symbols and alignment environments in mathematics and physics formulas, as well as biochemical terminology, code macro definitions, and ecological classification narratives; no single semantic theme covers all examples.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical formulas and symbols
patterns.context: Triggered inside mathematical expressions, especially adjacent LaTeX control sequences, variables, and subscripts/superscripts in formulas; no specific mathematical topic is required.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical physics texts, mainly StackExchange and ArXiv

patterns.name: LaTeX aligned equation environments
patterns.context: Occurs in line-aligned formulas or reaction equations containing typesetting commands, mathematical symbols, and variables.
patterns.domain: Formula typesetting in ArXiv scientific papers

patterns.name: Chemical terminology and molecular site markers
patterns.context: Biochemical discussion introducing a phospholipase and the site at which it hydrolyzes a phospholipid.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central medical and biochemistry papers

patterns.name: Code definitions and identifiers
patterns.context: Macro definitions, container names, and field identifiers appear adjacent to one another in code snippets.

patterns.name: Mountain plants and snail taxonomy/ecology text
patterns.context: Natural history or ecology narratives mention mountain plant habitats and land snails.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central ecology and biogeography literature

5_2718.concept: 专业文本中的结构化符号与术语
5_2718.description: 激活分布于多领域的专业文本：数学和物理公式中的 LaTeX 符号、对齐环境，另有生化术语、代码宏定义及生态分类叙述；没有单一语义主题能覆盖全部。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学公式与符号
patterns.context: 触发在数学表达式内部，尤其是公式中相邻的 LaTeX 控制序列、变量和上下标；不要求特定数学主题。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论物理文本，主要为 StackExchange 和 ArXiv

patterns.name: LaTeX 对齐公式环境
patterns.context: 出现在分行对齐的公式或反应式中，包含排版命令、数学符号和变量。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文中的公式排版

patterns.name: 化学术语与分子位置标记
patterns.context: 生化论述中介绍一种磷脂酶及其水解磷脂的位置。
patterns.domain: PubMed 中央医学、生物化学论文

patterns.name: 代码定义与标识符
patterns.context: 代码片段中宏定义、容器名及字段标识符相邻出现。

patterns.name: 山地植物与蜗牛分类生态文本
patterns.context: 自然史或生态学叙述中提到山地植物栖息地及陆生蜗牛。
patterns.domain: PubMed 中央生态、生物地理文献

en.concept: Sparse triggers in numerical and academic texts
en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is sorting negative numbers, decimals, and fractions, or finding the nearest value, in math problems; there are also numerical-array code examples and triggers on specialized terms in physics papers and math abstracts.

patterns.name: Numerical sorting questions
patterns.context: Several candidate numbers with minus signs, decimals, or fractions are given, followed by a question about their position in a ranking or the value closest to a target; answer choices and line breaks are common.

patterns.name: Numerical table code with options
patterns.context: A code comment lists levels and numbers, followed by initializing a numerical table with braces.

patterns.name: Particle physics decay notation and values
patterns.context: Particle physics sentences discussing resonant/non-resonant amplitudes, gluon amplitudes, and branching ratios.

patterns.name: Convergence analysis terminology in abstracts
patterns.context: The abstract opens by introducing a sequence of functions, a method, and its convergence to a solution.

patterns.name: Electroweak phase transition and effective model terminology
patterns.context: Theoretical physics sentences discussing static backgrounds, fluctuation determinants, and three-dimensional effective models.

5_2718.concept: 数值及学术文本中的稀疏触发
5_2718.description: 最强且反复的模式是数学题中对负数、小数、分数列表进行大小排序或求最近值；另有数值数组代码，以及物理论文和数学摘要中的专门术语触发。

patterns.name: 数值排序问答
patterns.trigger: “What is the third smallest value”, “What is the sixth biggest value”, “the smallest value”, “the nearest to”
patterns.context: 先给出若干带负号、小数或分数的候选数，随后询问排序位置或离某个目标最近的值；常见答案选项及换行

patterns.name: 带选项的数值表格代码
patterns.trigger: “table[] =”及后续整数、负数和逗号分隔的数组
patterns.context: 代码注释列出 level 与数字，随后以花括号初始化数值表

patterns.name: 粒子物理衰变记号与数值
patterns.context: 讨论共振/非共振振幅、胶子振幅及分支比的粒子物理句子

patterns.name: 摘要中的收敛分析术语
patterns.context: 摘要开头介绍函数序列、方法及其收敛到某个解

patterns.name: 电弱相变与有效模型术语
patterns.context: 讨论静态背景、涨落行列式及三维有效模型的理论物理论文句子

en.concept: Structural words in mathematical numerical problems
en.description: Primarily responds to “common denominator/multiple” in common-denominator and least-common-multiple problem statements; it also responds to questions asking to order multiple values, as well as ordinal, comparison, and answer-choice terms. Fractions and negative numbers are common but insufficient on their own to explain the activations.

patterns.name: Common-denominator questions
patterns.context: Asks for the common denominator of two fractions, often phrased as “What is the common denominator of … and …?” or “Find the common denominator of … and …”; the trigger falls mainly on “denominator” and nearby words.

patterns.name: Common-multiple questions
patterns.context: Asks for the least common multiple of two integers; the prompt contains “smallest common multiple” or “multiple of … and …”.

patterns.name: Ordinals and comparison words in sorting questions
patterns.context: Asks to compare several values labeled with letters and find their ranking; often adjacent to answer-choice tables, fractions, or negative numbers.

patterns.name: Answer-choice labels in ranking problems
patterns.context: Appears as labels for values to be compared, often alongside minus signs, fractions, or decimals; may be part of an ordinal comparison question format.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics multiple-choice questions and answer lists

patterns.name: Fraction and negative-number strings
patterns.context: Appears in prompts and answer choices for fraction, common-denominator, or numerical-sorting problems; not a stable trigger condition on its own.

5_2718.description: 主要响应公分母、公倍数题干中的“common denominator/multiple”；也响应要求对多项数值排序的题干及序数、比较词和选项标签。分数、负数等数值形式常见但不足以单独解释激活。

patterns.name: 公分母题干
patterns.context: 询问两个分数的公分母，常见句式为“What is the common denominator of … and …?”或“Find the common denominator of … and …”；触发主要落在“denominator”及其邻近词

patterns.name: 公倍数题干
patterns.context: 询问两个整数的最小公倍数，题干含“smallest common multiple”或“multiple of … and …”

patterns.name: 排序题中的序数与比较词
patterns.context: 要求比较若干带字母标签的数值并找出排名；常与选项表、分数或负数相邻
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 多项选择/排序题

patterns.name: 排名题选项标签
patterns.context: 作为待比较数值的选项标记出现，常伴随负号、分数或小数；可能是序数比较题格式的一部分
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 选择题及选项列表

patterns.name: 分数与负数数值串
patterns.context: 出现在分数、公分母计算或数值排序的题干与选项中；单独看并非稳定触发条件

en.description: Activations span patent chemistry/material symbols, PrP biomedical names, sequences of numbers and punctuation, XML/OWL fields, C++ identifiers, and algorithm-comparison statements; many highlights fall on fragmented abbreviations or structured tokens, making it difficult to group them under one semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Technical terms and chemical/material symbols in patent claims
patterns.context: Long patent-style sentences describe reactions, compound compositions, or molded structures, with symbols and terms embedded in technical limitations.

patterns.name: PrP protein names and biomedical abbreviations
patterns.context: When discussing protein structure, antibody binding, or recombinant protein generation, the PrP name is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and compact numerical sequences
patterns.context: Activations fall on punctuation-separated numbers, hexadecimal bytes, or tabular numeric fields; natural-language syntax is not required.
patterns.domain: Medical data, code data, or structured tables

patterns.name: Structural fields in XML/RDF/OWL markup
patterns.context: In machine-readable markup and attribute declarations, activation covers parts of tag names, attribute names, and field values.

patterns.name: C++ identifiers and engine template paths
patterns.context: Code declares macros, concatenates identifiers, and includes source files in template directories.

patterns.name: Splitting, comparison, and range judgments in natural language
patterns.context: Explains how an algorithm splits characters and numbers and compares numeric parts, surrounded by ordinary Q&A-style explanation.

patterns.name: Unclear local triggers
patterns.context: Trigger locations vary across passages, with insufficient shared context; some may simply be parts of proper names, code identifiers, or formatted numbers.
patterns.domain: Across patent, paper, and code corpora

5_2718.concept: 碎片化技术与结构化 token
5_2718.description: 激活分布于专利化学/材料符号、PrP 生物医学名称、数字与标点序列、XML/OWL 字段、C++ 标识符及算法比较语句；多处高亮落在碎片化缩写或结构化 token 上，难以归并为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的技术术语与化学/材料符号
patterns.context: 专利式长句中描述反应、化合物组成或成型结构，符号和术语嵌在技术限定中

patterns.name: PrP 蛋白名称及生物医学缩写
patterns.context: 讨论蛋白结构、抗体结合或重组蛋白生成时，PrP 名称被拆分成多个 token

patterns.name: 数字、标点与紧凑数值序列
patterns.context: 激活落在标点分隔的数字、十六进制字节或表格数值字段中；不要求自然语言句法
patterns.domain: 医学数据、代码数据或结构化表格

patterns.name: XML/RDF/OWL 标记中的结构性字段
patterns.context: 机器可读标记与属性声明中，激活覆盖标签名、属性名及字段值的一部分
patterns.domain: Github 中的本体/结构化数据

patterns.name: C++ 标识符与引擎模板路径
patterns.context: 代码声明宏、拼接标识符并包含模板目录中的源文件

patterns.name: 自然语言中的拆分、比较及范围判断
patterns.context: 解释算法如何拆分字符与数字并比较数值部分，周围是普通问答式说明

patterns.name: 无法确定的局部触发
patterns.context: 各段触发位置分散，缺少足够共同上下文；其中部分可能只是专名、代码标识符或格式化数字的一部分
patterns.domain: 跨专利、论文与代码语料

en.concept: Qualification and effect statements in technical texts
en.description: Activations span legal, historical, scientific, medical, code, and patent texts, including quantity limits, negation, technical effects, and proper names from multiple fields; patent technical narratives predominate, but the trigger words and semantics are dispersed, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numerical values, proportions, and claim-style quantity limits
patterns.context: Activations occur near quantity words, fractions, percentages, or upper/lower-bound expressions; the context uses values to specify quantity, degree, or a threshold.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, patent chemistry, scientific reports

patterns.name: Morphological/affix fragments in tokenized and split words
patterns.context: Mostly longer English words or words composed of subword fragments; activations fall within words or adjacent morphemes, with varied meanings and syntactic roles.

patterns.name: Function, performance, and causal-effect statements
patterns.context: Technical texts describe effects, adjustable functions, performance, or cost consequences resulting from components or methods.

patterns.name: Permission, division, and attribution statements in legal/historical narratives
patterns.context: Statements concern a previously permitted amount, or the division of organizational members and majority affiliation; activated words are scattered across different syntactic constituents.

patterns.name: Negation and restriction expressions
patterns.context: Negation or upper-limit restrictions occur next to nouns, quantities, or states, but their forms and meanings are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, process error logs, patent chemistry

patterns.name: Parent-child relationship terminology in Java exceptions
patterns.context: An exception stack trace describes a child service lacking a parent object and contains Java type names and hierarchy terms.

patterns.name: Golf and motion control
patterns.context: Describes how a putter imparts intended rolling and motion to a golf ball; some activations fall on ordinary function words.

patterns.name: Automotive power steering and driving states
patterns.context: Estimates the immediate driving state and provides steering assistance accordingly, emphasizing state, applied force, and method.

patterns.name: Surgical approaches and operative field
patterns.context: In a tumor surgery context, lists approaches such as transpalatal access and describes the operative field obtained; abbreviations are split into tokens.

patterns.name: Semiconductor chips, vias, and solder
patterns.context: Describes vias on the back of a semiconductor device and the solder and material properties used for chip bonding.

patterns.name: Methods, components, and technical limitations in patent phrasing
patterns.context: Common patent-specification elements include prior-art comparisons, component descriptions, and solutions introduced with phrases such as “by providing a method”; activations span different parts of speech.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in organization and personal names
patterns.context: A personal name is truncated or tokenized in a historical narrative; no stable semantic trigger condition is evident.

5_2718.concept: 技术文本中的限定与效果表述
5_2718.description: 激活跨法律、历史、科研、医学、代码及专利文本，包含数量限制、否定、技术效果和多个领域专名；专利技术叙述占多数，但触发词与语义分散，尚无单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 数值、比例及权利要求式数量限制
patterns.trigger: “not exceeding one-third of the amount”；“up to three 6-member carbocyclic and nitrogen-containing heterocyclic rings”；“no more than two nuclear nitrogens”；“>90%”；“>98%”；“minimum of 50”
patterns.context: 激活与数量词、分数、百分比或上限/下限表达相邻；上下文将数值用于限定数量、程度或阈值。
patterns.domain: 法律、专利化学、科研报告

patterns.name: 分词与拆分词中的构词/词缀片段
patterns.context: 多为较长英文词或由子词片段组成的词，激活落在词内或相邻词素；具体词义和句法角色不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书及技术叙述

patterns.name: 功能、性能与因果效果表述
patterns.trigger: “cost”；“power transferred”；“give the golf ball”；“assisting force”；“good adhesion and heat radiating properties”
patterns.context: 技术文本描述部件或方法带来的效果、可调功能、性能或成本后果。

patterns.name: 法律/历史叙述中的许可、分裂与归属表达
patterns.trigger: “amount heretofore allowed”；“a majority or a minority split from Correspondence”；“had a majority of the members”
patterns.context: 围绕先前准许的金额，或组织成员分裂及多数归属作陈述；激活词分散在不同句法成分。
patterns.domain: 判决文本、维基百科历史叙述

patterns.name: 否定词与限制表达
patterns.context: 否定或上限限制紧邻名词、数量或状态；但表现形式和语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律、程序错误日志、专利化学

patterns.name: Java 异常中的父子关系术语
patterns.context: 异常堆栈中描述子服务缺少父对象，包含 Java 类型名和层级关系词。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答/程序错误日志

patterns.name: 高尔夫球运动及运动控制
patterns.context: 描述推杆如何赋予高尔夫球预期滚动和运动；有些激活落在普通功能词上。

patterns.name: 汽车转向助力与驾驶状态
patterns.context: 依据即时驾驶状态估计并提供转向助力，强调状态、施力和方法。

patterns.name: 外科入路与手术视野
patterns.context: 肿瘤手术语境，列举经腭等入路，并描述可获得的手术视野；缩写被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 半导体芯片、通孔与焊料
patterns.context: 描述半导体器件背面通孔及芯片键合所用焊料和材料性质。

patterns.name: 专利句式中的方法、部件与技术限定
patterns.trigger: “according to the latter related art”；“components, respectively”；“by providing a method of setting”
patterns.context: 专利说明书常见的现有技术比较、部件说明及“通过提供方法”式方案引出；激活覆盖不同词类。

patterns.name: 组织名称与人名中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 历史叙述中人名被截断或分词，未见稳定的语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across patents, Q&A, comments, and papers: give/giving, ingredient-quantity descriptions, technical questions, row counts in multi-section tables, negative responses, power-unit configurations, and lack of research attention; they are difficult to reduce to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Giving, providing, or granting
patterns.context: Activates in constructions meaning that something is given, granted, or brought about; [2] also contains «give»10, used in the colloquial expression “give a shit”.

patterns.name: Quantity and ingredient descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the content, separation result, or absence of an ingredient in a feed, often followed by a noun phrase.
patterns.domain: Patent texts about chemical processing and separation

patterns.name: Question openings and obligation/need expressions
patterns.context: In a Q&A post, a question label opens the post, followed by a first-person question about whether something is needed or still has to be done.

patterns.name: Row counts in multi-section tables
patterns.context: Discusses a TableView with multiple sections and the number of rows in a given section.

patterns.name: Negative or contrastive response
patterns.context: After a link or code fragment, a brief negative/corrective response opens, followed by an explanation of software behavior.

patterns.name: Combined-cycle and power-unit type descriptions
patterns.context: Compares different shaft configurations in power plants and their operation or efficiency.

patterns.name: Statements about lack of research attention
patterns.context: An academic paper states that a topic has received little or no attention previously.

patterns.name: Scattered activation among high-frequency function words or common collocations
patterns.context: These words occur in different syntactic positions and do not form a stable, independently interpretable pattern across passages.

5_2718.description: 激活分散于专利、问答、评论和论文：包括 give/giving，成分数量描述，技术问句，多节表格行数，否定回应，机组配置及研究缺乏关注；难以归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 给予、提供或赋予
patterns.context: 在表示某物被给予、赋予或带来的结构中激活；[2] 同样出现 «give»10，但用作口语表达“give a shit”。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书与 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: 数量与成分描述
patterns.context: 描述进料中某成分的含量、分离结果或不存在的组分，常接名词短语。
patterns.domain: 专利化工与分离过程文本

patterns.name: 疑问句开头与义务/需要表达
patterns.trigger: «Q»1«:»3；«Do»2« I»9« need»6« to»6；«Do»2« I»9« still»4« have»3« to»7
patterns.context: 问答帖中以问题标签开头，随后用第一人称询问是否需要、是否仍须做某事。

patterns.name: 多节表格中的行数
patterns.context: 讨论含多个 section 的 TableView，以及某个 section 所含行数。

patterns.name: 否定或转折回应
patterns.context: 链接或代码片段后，以简短否定/修正回应开头，接着说明软件行为。

patterns.name: 组合循环与机组类型描述
patterns.context: 比较发电厂中不同轴系配置及其运行或效率。

patterns.name: 研究注意力缺乏的表述
patterns.context: 学术论文指出某主题此前受到很少或没有关注。

patterns.name: 高频功能词或常见搭配中的分散激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在不同句法位置，未形成跨段稳定且可独立解释的模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to the fixed phrase “little to …”: including “little to no” meaning almost none, “little to do with” meaning little relation, and “little to worry about” meaning nothing to worry about; occurs across multiple fields and genres.

patterns.name: little to no construction
patterns.context: “little to no + noun” means almost none of something; the noun may be impact, side-effect, immunity, health issues, communication, fuel, etc.
patterns.domain: Academic, patent, encyclopedia, legal, forum, and narrative texts

patterns.name: little to do with
patterns.context: Means that something has little relation to an object; the subject or topic may be technical issues, technical concepts, etc.

patterns.name: little to worry about
patterns.context: “have little to worry about” means there is little to worry about; the preceding text discusses work conditions.

5_2718.description: 主要响应固定短语“little to …”：包括“little to no”表示几乎没有、“little to do with”表示关系很小，以及“little to worry about”表示无须担心；横跨多种领域与文体。

patterns.name: little to no 结构
patterns.trigger: « little» « to» « no»（含变体« little» « to» «9»「no」）
patterns.context: “little to no + 名词”表示几乎没有某物；名词可为 impact、side-effect、immunity、health issues、communication、fuel 等。
patterns.domain: 学术、专利、百科、法律、论坛及叙事文本

patterns.name: little to do with
patterns.context: 表示某事与某对象关系很小；主语或谈论对象可以是技术问题、技术概念等。

patterns.name: little to worry about
patterns.context: “have little to worry about”表示没什么可担心的，前文谈论工作状况。

en.description: Activation centers on two types of expression: little to…: little to no + noun, meaning almost none; and little to do with + object, meaning little relation. These occur across fields and genres; the key cue is to following little.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “little to no”
patterns.context: “Little to no + noun” means almost none of something, influence, attention, integration, fuel, immunity, or communication; intervening tokens may occur.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including patents, academic papers, technical discussions, forums, and legal texts

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “little to do with”
patterns.context: Says that something has little relation to something else, followed by content such as casting or states.

5_2718.description: 激活集中在 little to… 两类表达：little to no + 名词，表示几乎没有；little to do with + 对象，表示关系很小。跨领域、跨文体出现，关键线索是 little 后接 to。

patterns.name: little to no 固定搭配
patterns.context: “little to no + 名词”表示几乎没有某种事物、影响、关注、整合、燃料、免疫或交流；中间可有插入 token。
patterns.domain: 专利、学术论文、技术讨论、论坛、法律文本等多种文体

patterns.name: little to do with 固定搭配
patterns.context: 用于说某事与另一事关系很小，后接 casting、states 等内容。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、哲学学术文本

en.concept: English expressions with little meaning lack or irrelevance
en.description: Primarily responds to the English phrases little to no (almost none) and little to do with (almost unrelated), regardless of domain; passage 10 is a Romanian character fragment and appears to be an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed construction little to no
patterns.context: The phrase means almost none and is followed by a noun or noun phrase; “little,” “to,” and “no” often activate separately.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including patents, scientific papers, forums, and webpages

patterns.name: Fixed construction little to do with
patterns.context: The phrase means almost unrelated to something; it may also occur as “very little to do with” in context.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, forums, physics papers, programming Q&A

patterns.name: Character fragment in Romanian text
patterns.context: Occurs in Romanian parliamentary speeches and acknowledgments; no direct connection to the English fixed-phrase pattern is apparent.

5_2718.concept: little 表示缺少或无关的英语搭配
5_2718.description: 主要响应英语短语 little to no（几乎没有）及 little to do with（几乎无关），不受具体领域限制；第10段为罗马尼亚语字符片段，似属独立模式。

patterns.name: little to no 固定结构
patterns.context: 该短语表示几乎没有，后接名词或名词短语；“little”“to”“no”常分别激活。
patterns.domain: 专利、科研论文、论坛、网页等多种文体

patterns.name: little to do with 固定结构
patterns.context: 该短语表示与某事几乎无关；在语境中也可扩展为“very little to do with”。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文、论坛、物理学论文、编程问答

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语文本中的字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在罗马尼亚语议会发言及致谢文本中；看不出与英语固定短语模式的直接联系。

en.concept: little-to-no / to-do expressions and local function words
en.description: Primarily responds to little-to-no and little-to-do-with expressions, and also covers infinitives introduced by to and auxiliary do; it also activates in two patent technical descriptions and one “do I” question, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: “little to no” and similar negative-quantity structures
patterns.context: Little and to no combine to mean almost none; it may also occur in the fixed expression “have little to do with,” with variable spacing and punctuation after to.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, including forums, papers, Q&A, and patents

patterns.name: Verb following infinitival to
patterns.context: To introduces an infinitive, especially in negation, judgment, or relation expressions; a fixed little/no phrase is not required.

patterns.name: To in function-word and phrase contexts
patterns.context: To in ordinary infinitives or purpose/result expressions; neither example has a little-to-no structure.

patterns.name: Claim-style noun phrases in patent text
patterns.context: Activation is distributed over technical nouns, modifiers, and adjacent function words in patent background text; there is no clear shared little-to-no or to-infinitive trigger substring.

patterns.name: Local emphasis on the word do
patterns.context: The auxiliary do in the question “do I really have”; unlike the little to do with expressions in [1]–[3].

5_2718.description: 主要响应 little-to-no 及 little-to-do-with 一类表达，也覆盖 to 引导的不定式和 do 助动词；另在两段专利技术描述及一处“do I”疑问句中激活，未见统一词义解释。

patterns.name: “little to no”及近似否定数量结构
patterns.context: little 与 to no 连用表示几乎没有；或出现在固定表达“have little to do with”中，to 后的间隔和标点可变。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言，包括论坛、论文、问答及专利

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后接动词
patterns.context: to 引出不定式，尤其在否定、判断或关系表达中；不一定要求固定的 little/no 短语。
patterns.domain: 论坛、学术论文、技术问答

patterns.name: 功能词与词组语境中的 to
patterns.context: 普通不定式或目的/结果表达中的 to；两例都没有 little-to-no 结构。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的权利要求式名词短语
patterns.context: 激活分布在专利背景文本的技术名词、限定词和相邻功能词上；没有明显共享的 little-to-no 或 to 不定式触发子串。

patterns.name: 单词 do 的局部强调
patterns.context: 疑问句“do I really have”中的助动词 do；与 [1]–[3] 的 little to do with 不同。

en.description: The strongest and most stable activations fall on way, especially in a way to… and one-/two-way; there are also activations on patented chemicals, power steering, and a few isolated terms, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: way and neighboring phrases
patterns.context: way is a high-activation trigger; it commonly appears in the “a way to …” structure and also in the compounds two-way / one-way. The trigger does not depend on a single fixed meaning: it can refer to a method, mode of communication, function, or means of monetization.
patterns.domain: patent backgrounds, communications, network comments, mental health, physics

patterns.name: Purpose and process terms in patent texts
patterns.context: Power steering, solvent or chemical names, and descriptions of ester separation and byproducts in technical patent background sections; no clear shared local syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Abstract-style “Provides” in patents
patterns.context: Begins with Provides or uses an abstract-style statement to introduce a communications device, random sequence generation, or a bidirectional authentication scheme. Adjacent to way activation in the same passage, but other words also activate.

patterns.name: Local triggers in specific technical terms
patterns.context: Isolated occurrences in HackerNews text, a chaotic motion problem, and a discussion of electroweak parameters, with no clear semantic pattern shared with other high-activation passages.

5_2718.description: 高激活最稳定地落在 way，尤其是 a way to…及 one-/two-way；另有专利化学、转向助力和少数孤立术语激活，未见统一语义解释。

patterns.name: way 及其邻近短语
patterns.context: way 是高激活触发点；常见于“a way to …”结构，也出现在 two-way / one-way 复合词中。触发并不依赖单一固定语义：可指方法、通信方式、功能或变现途径。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、通信、网络评论、心理健康、物理学

patterns.name: 专利文本中的用途与工艺词
patterns.context: 技术性专利背景段中的转向助力、溶剂或化学品名称，以及酯类分离与副产物描述；没有明显共同的局部句法触发词。

patterns.name: 专利摘要式的 Provides
patterns.context: 以 Provides 开头或采用摘要式陈述，介绍通信设备、随机序列生成或双向认证方案。与同段的 way 激活相邻，但也有其他激活词。

patterns.name: 特定技术术语中的局部触发
patterns.context: 孤立出现于 HackerNews 文本、混沌运动问题和电弱参数讨论，分别没有与其他高激活段共享的清晰语义模式。

en.description: Activates mainly on way and collocations such as one-way, two-way, a way to/of, covering communication, function, means of solving a problem, and progress; there are also sporadic patterns involving methods/forces, a Java exception class, legal warnings, and little to no sense.

patterns.name: Expressions involving “way”
patterns.context: Way is a noun appearing in expressions such as two-way/one-way and a way to/of; the context involves communication, function, problem-solving, or progress
patterns.domain: Patents, popular science, forums, and general discussion

patterns.name: Parameters and methods in technical terms
patterns.context: A vehicle steering-assistance patent describes methods, forces, and driving-condition parameters

patterns.name: Java exception class-name fragment
patterns.context: Consecutive identifiers in a Java import list for an exception class

patterns.name: Warnings and defects in legal arguments
patterns.context: Determining whether the lack of a warning for asbestos-related products constitutes a defect

patterns.name: Negation and degree expressions
patterns.context: Expresses that something makes almost no sense when commenting that a feature should not be included in the core

5_2718.description: 主要激活于 way 及 one-way、two-way、a way to/of 等搭配，涵盖通信、功能、解决途径和进展；另有方法/力、Java 异常类、法律警告及 little to no sense 等零散模式。

patterns.name: “way”相关表达
patterns.context: way 作名词，出现在 two-way/one-way、a way to/of 等表达中；前后文涉及通信、功能、解决问题或进展
patterns.domain: 专利、科普、论坛及一般论述

patterns.name: 技术术语中的参数与方法
patterns.context: 汽车转向辅助专利描述方法、力及驾驶条件参数

patterns.name: Java 异常类名片段
patterns.context: Java import 列表中异常类名的连续标识符

patterns.name: 法律论证中的警告与缺陷
patterns.context: 判断石棉相关产品缺少警告是否构成缺陷

patterns.name: 否定与程度表达
patterns.context: 评论某功能不应纳入核心部分时，表达几乎毫无道理

en.concept: Diverse string patterns, difficult to unify
en.description: Activations span multiple word forms and contexts: various English collocations with way are most common; Dutch energy compounds, Java NoSuch exception class names, and same value in math problems also appear.

patterns.name: way compounds and expressions
patterns.context: Appears in English idioms or noun phrases; may express bidirectionality in communication, method, distance, or degree of progress, rather than a single fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: patents, forum Q&A, travel texts, game patents, news commentary

patterns.name: Dutch energy infrastructure vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses future European energy needs and infrastructure in Dutch sentences; activation falls inside a compound word.

patterns.name: Such in Java security class names
patterns.context: Exception class names in Java import lists; neighboring words form a repeated NoSuch…Exception naming pattern.

patterns.name: same value in math Q&A
patterns.context: A question about whether two numerical expressions are equal; the passage also contains true/false answers and comparison problems.

5_2718.concept: 多样词串模式，难以统一
5_2718.description: 激活跨多类词形与语境：way 的多种英语搭配最常见；另见荷兰语能源复合词、Java NoSuch 异常类名，以及数学题中的 same value。

patterns.name: way 复合表达
patterns.trigger: “way”及其搭配，如 “two-way video communication”, “only way to”, “long way from/away/to go”
patterns.context: 出现在英语习语或名词短语中；可能表达通信的双向性、方法、距离或进展程度，并非单一固定含义。
patterns.domain: 专利、论坛问答、旅游文本、游戏专利、新闻评论

patterns.name: 荷兰语能源基础设施词汇
patterns.context: 荷兰语句中讨论欧洲未来能源需求及基础设施；触发落在复合词内部。

patterns.name: Java 安全类名中的 Such
patterns.trigger: “No Such Algorithm Exception”“No Such Provider Exception”中的 “Such”
patterns.context: Java import 列表里的异常类名；相邻词构成重复的 NoSuch…Exception 命名模式。

patterns.name: 数学问答中的 same value
patterns.context: 判断两个数值表达式是否相等的问句；本段还包含真假答案及比较题。

en.description: Activations are scattered across heterogeneous texts: numbers and abbreviations, hyphenated words, code/HTML fragments, legal wording, and Dutch subword fragments all have local hits; there is no stable semantic or syntactic pattern covering all samples.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases and token boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of numbers, hyphens, abbreviations, or proper names; the specific meanings and syntactic contexts differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Natural-language text, including patents, travel, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in code import statements, HTML tags/attributes, or function signatures; may be sensitive to combinations of identifier fragments, punctuation, and type names.

patterns.name: Legal negation and product-defect wording
patterns.context: In discussion of asbestos product liability, around sentences concerning lack of warnings, legal requirements, and determinations of defects.

patterns.name: Dutch subword segmentation
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across subword fragments within Dutch words, in sentences related to supply, pipelines, and natural gas.

5_2718.description: 激活分散在异质文本中：数字与缩写、连字符词、代码/HTML 片段、法律措辞及荷兰语词内子词均有局部命中；没有覆盖全部样本的稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 固定短语与词元边界
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、连字符、缩写或专名的内部片段；各段的具体词义和句法环境不同。
patterns.domain: 专利、旅游、医学摘要等自然语言文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码导入语句、HTML 标签/属性或函数签名中；可能对标识符片段、标点及类型名的组合敏感。

patterns.name: 法律否定及产品缺陷措辞
patterns.trigger: « not»1« require»2；« without»4« a»4« warning»9；« defective»4 product
patterns.context: 在论述石棉产品责任时，围绕警告缺失、法律要求与缺陷认定的句子。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内分段
patterns.context: 激活分布在荷兰语词内部的子词片段，处于供应、管道和天然气相关句子中。

en.description: Most strongly responds to way, especially the way to… structure for expressing a method; there are also sporadic responses to Java algorithm exceptions, C error macros, table numbers and whitespace, legal warning language, and MD algorithm names.

patterns.name: “way” followed by an infinitive
patterns.context: The noun way, meaning a method or means, is often followed by to + verb; to or the following verb may also be marked. It can appear after modifiers such as better/another.
patterns.domain: prose in emails, Q&A, news, Wikipedia, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Java security algorithm exception names
patterns.context: Exception class names containing NoSuchAlgorithm or NoSuchProvider in import statements from the Java security package.

patterns.name: “No such” error text in C macros
patterns.context: A comment in an error-code macro describes a file or directory that does not exist.

patterns.name: Table numbers and separating whitespace
patterns.context: Near numbers, alignment spaces, and horizontal separator lines at the end of table rows or in cells.

patterns.name: Warning obligations in legal texts
patterns.context: Discusses whether asbestos-containing products are defective when no warning is provided.

patterns.name: Algorithm names in digest code
patterns.context: The string argument to a Java MessageDigest.getInstance call contains MD followed by a number; algorithm exception handling appears nearby.

5_2718.description: 最集中地响应 way，尤其是 way to… 表示方法的结构；另对 Java 算法异常、C 错误宏、表格数字与空白、法律警告措辞及 MD 算法名有零散响应。

patterns.name: “way”及其后续不定式
patterns.context: 在表示方法、途径的名词 way 后，常接 to + 动词；to 或后续动词也可能被标记。可位于 better/another 等修饰语之后。
patterns.domain: 邮件、问答、新闻、维基百科及技术讨论等散文

patterns.name: Java 安全算法异常名
patterns.context: Java security 包的 import 语句中，异常类名包含 NoSuchAlgorithm 或 NoSuchProvider。

patterns.name: C 宏中的“No such”错误文本
patterns.context: 错误码宏的注释描述文件或目录不存在。
patterns.domain: GitHub C 头文件/宏定义

patterns.name: 表格数字与分隔空白
patterns.context: 表格行末或单元格中的数字、对齐空格和横线分隔符附近。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文中的表格

patterns.name: 法律文本中的警告义务
patterns.context: 讨论涉石棉产品在没有警告时是否构成缺陷。

patterns.name: 摘要算法代码中的名称
patterns.context: Java MessageDigest.getInstance 调用的字符串参数中，MD 后接数字；周围出现算法异常处理。

en.description: Activations mainly center on way meaning method or means, especially in way to/of + action; it often appears in contexts asking about or explaining a method. Modifiers such as better, good, and only, and content from various domains, are not essential.

patterns.name: way to + verb phrase
patterns.context: Way means a method or means, followed by to + verb or of + gerund; it often appears in questions, comparisons, or statements about how something can be achieved, including modified forms such as “only way” and “good/better way”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, including forum Q&A, technical discussions, political commentary, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Expressions for improving a method with better way
patterns.context: First expresses an existing approach, question, or dissatisfaction, then asks whether a more suitable method exists; passage 6 has “a better way” but no explicit following to-verb.

5_2718.description: 激活主要集中在表示方法、途径的 way，尤见于 way to/of + 动作；常置于询问或说明方法的语境。better、good、only 等修饰语及各种领域内容并非必要条件。

patterns.name: way to + 动词短语
patterns.trigger: «way»、«to»及其后的动作或目的（如 “way to interact”“way to solve”“way to count”“way to contribute”“way to record”“way to show”“way to incorporate”“way of doing”）
patterns.context: “way”表示方法或途径，后接 to + 动词或 of + 动名词；常见于询问、比较或陈述某事能否实现的方法，也包括“only way”“good/better way”等修饰形式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的论坛问答、技术讨论、政治评论及产品说明等散文

patterns.name: better way 的方法改进表达
patterns.context: 先表达已有做法、疑问或不满，再提出是否存在更合适的方法；第6段为“a better way”但未接显式 to 动词。

en.concept: Multiple local patterns, difficult to unify
en.description: Strong activations most consistently fall on “way to + verb” and “same value” in mathematical judgments; other local triggers include HTML attributes, warning in legal sentences, BCI subword fragments, and mathematical symbols. They span domains and do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: way to structure
patterns.context: The noun way is followed by a to-infinitive, expressing a way to implement, solve, interact, or define something; it may be preceded by modifiers such as the, a, or standard.
patterns.domain: various styles, including forums, news, Q&A, and academic abstracts

patterns.name: same value in math problems
patterns.context: Compares whether variables, expressions, or values are equal, often in math exercises that pose questions one at a time and provide True/False answers.
patterns.domain: math Q&A or automatically generated algebra exercises

patterns.name: HTML input control attributes
patterns.context: Input elements in HTML tables and their name, class, type, and other attributes; activation is concentrated in attribute-value fragments.

patterns.name: Warning and product defect language
patterns.context: In the legal argument “without a warning” when discussing asbestos product liability.

patterns.name: BCI-related term fragments
patterns.context: Discussion of structure and temporal entities in brain-computer interface experiments; activation falls on subword fragments of an abbreviation.

patterns.name: Scattered mathematical symbols and operation fragments
patterns.context: Punctuation, operators, numbers, and answer markers in algebraic expressions, equations, and true/false judgments; apart from same value, no stable shared trigger condition is apparent.

5_2718.concept: 多种局部模式，难以统一
5_2718.description: 强激活最稳定地落在“way to + 动词”和数学判断中的“same value”；另有 HTML 属性、法律语句中的 warning、BCI 分词及数学符号等局部触发，跨域且并非单一语义模式。

patterns.name: way to 结构
patterns.trigger: “way»10« to»5« get»2” [1]；“way»10« to»5« do»4” [2]；“way»9« to»6« interact” [7]；“way»9« to»6« define” [9]
patterns.context: 名词 way 后接 to 不定式，表示实现、解决、互动或定义某事的方式；前面可有 the、a 或标准等修饰
patterns.domain: 论坛、新闻、问答、学术摘要等多种文体

patterns.name: 数学题中的 same value
patterns.context: 比较变量、表达式或数值是否相等，常处于逐题提问并给出 True/False 的数学练习中
patterns.domain: 数学问答或自动生成的代数练习

patterns.name: HTML 输入控件属性
patterns.context: HTML 表格中的 input 元素及其 name、class、type 等属性，激活集中在属性值片段
patterns.domain: 网页代码、StackExchange 技术内容

patterns.name: 警告与产品缺陷表述
patterns.context: 讨论石棉产品责任时，在“without a warning”这一法律论证语境中

patterns.name: BCI 相关术语片段
patterns.context: 脑机接口实验的结构与时间实体讨论；激活落在缩写的分词片段

patterns.name: 杂散的数学符号与运算片段
patterns.context: 代数表达式、方程及真假判断中出现的标点、运算符、数字和答案标记；除 same value 外未显示稳定共同触发条件

en.description: In most passages, the neuron responds to wording that compares numerical values or determines whether expressions are equal in math problems, often alongside negative numbers, fractions, and True/False answers. Other examples include quantity comparisons in papers, shared properties between objects, and percentage statements.

patterns.name: Mathematical numerical-comparison questions
patterns.context: Asks about the relative size of two numbers or expressions, often involving negative numbers, fractions, or integers; typically followed by True/False or a comparison result.

patterns.name: Numerical equality judgments
patterns.context: Compares whether two numbers, variables, or expressions are equal, often with True/False answers; several passages also repeat this across adjacent questions.

patterns.name: Numerical relation operators and symbols
patterns.context: Size or equality relations in math problems, especially comparisons involving negative numbers and fractions; relation words may occur in a complete question or standalone judgment.

patterns.name: Quantity expressions for many or more
patterns.context: Describes the number of susceptibility loci discovered, followed by cancer-related research results; unlike numerical comparison questions in math Q&A.

patterns.name: Comparisons of shared properties or structures
patterns.context: Compares whether different objects have a shared property or structure; not an arithmetic equality judgment.

patterns.name: Ratio and percentage statements
patterns.context: States the proportion of a certain type of spectrum in an astronomy research narrative.

5_2718.description: 多数段落中，神经元响应数学题里比较数值大小或判断表达式是否相等的措辞，常伴随负数、分数及 True/False 答案。另有论文中数量比较、对象共享性质及百分比表述。

patterns.name: 数学数值比较问句
patterns.trigger: “Which is greater”, “Which is smaller”, “Which is bigger”, “Is … > …?”, “at least as big as”
patterns.context: 询问两个数或表达式的大小，常涉及负数、分数或整数；后面通常跟 True/False 或一个比较结果。

patterns.name: 数值相等判断
patterns.trigger: “Do … and … have the same value?”、“same value”
patterns.context: 比较两个数、变量或表达式是否相等，常见回答为 True/False；多段还在相邻题目中重复出现。

patterns.name: 数值关系运算符及符号
patterns.context: 数学题中的大小或相等关系，尤其负数和分数比较；关系词可出现在完整问句或独立判断题中。

patterns.name: 众多或更多的数量表达
patterns.context: 描述已发现的易感位点数量，后接癌症相关研究结果；不像数学问答中的数值比较题。

patterns.name: 相同性质或结构的比较
patterns.context: 比较不同对象是否具有共同性质或结构；并非算术数值相等判断。

patterns.name: 比例及百分数表述
patterns.context: 陈述某类光谱所占比例，处于天文学研究叙述中。

en.description: The strongest pattern is the sentence form “better way to…” and its interrogative variants; there are also responses to way-related expressions in performance and definition contexts, along with isolated triggers such as same performance, alleviating, and fulleride that cannot be explained by a single phrase pattern.

patterns.name: “better way” expressions
patterns.context: Common forms include “there has to be a better way to…”, “there is a better way to…”, or “any better way to…” when expressing a question, desire for improvement, or comparison of options.

patterns.name: way to with performance or operation
patterns.context: way is directly followed by to and then get performance; discusses how to improve or obtain Spark performance.

patterns.name: way to define (absence of a standard or method)
patterns.context: Describes the lack of a unified description model or standard, with way followed by to define.

patterns.name: way with method/performance collocations
patterns.context: Compares model experiment results; activation falls on same, with no “better way” structure.

patterns.name: Terms related to alleviating effects
patterns.context: Describes chaperones alleviating Escherichia coli’s sensitivity to butanol; no clear correspondence to the way pattern.

patterns.name: Fullerene term fragment
patterns.context: A substance formed by Eu and C60 is mentioned in a physical chemistry paper; this is an isolated trigger in a context unlike the other passages.

5_2718.description: 强模式是句式“better way to…”及其疑问变体；另在性能、定义语境中响应way相关表达，也有same performance、alleviating和fulleride等孤立触发，不能由单一短语模式解释。

patterns.name: “better way”表达
patterns.context: 在表达疑问、改进愿望或比较方案时，常见形式为“there has to be a better way to…”、“there is a better way to…”或“any better way to…”。

patterns.name: way to 与性能或操作
patterns.context: way 与 to 直接相邻，后接 get performance；讨论如何提升或获得 Spark 性能。

patterns.name: way to define（标准或方法缺失）
patterns.context: 描述缺少统一描述模型或标准，way 后接 to define。

patterns.name: way 与方式/性能搭配
patterns.context: 比较模型实验结果，激活落在same；没有出现“better way”结构。

patterns.name: 缓解作用相关词
patterns.context: 描述伴侣蛋白缓解大肠杆菌对丁醇的敏感性；与 way 模式无明显对应。

patterns.name: 富勒烯术语片段
patterns.context: 物理化学论文中提及 Eu 与 C60 形成的物质；孤立触发，语境与其他段不同。

en.description: Activation focuses on one or a few objects in quantities or comparisons (one, few), as well as judging whether values are the same in math problems; there is also one instance of alleviating. The same=value pattern is stable in math problems, but its connection to the quantifier pattern is limited.

patterns.name: Determining unique/quantifier one
patterns.context: When describing the sole member of a class, a specific object, or a single extreme; does not require immediately preceding only.

patterns.name: Few in quantity/range phrases
patterns.context: Few modifies a plural noun to indicate a very small quantity; here it occurs with only.

patterns.name: Same value in math questions
patterns.context: Exercises compare numerical values item by item or ask whether two expressions are equal, often with questions and answers separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: Other sporadic triggers
patterns.context: No stable shared context is apparent; this example occurs in a microbiology paper discussing alleviating ethanol sensitivity.

5_2718.concept: 单个/少数对象与数值等同性
5_2718.description: 激活集中于数量或比较中的单个/少数对象（one、few），以及数学题判断 same value；另有一次 alleviating。数学题中 same=value 模式稳定，但与数量词模式的联系有限。

patterns.name: 唯一/数量词 one 的判断
patterns.trigger: «one»10「only one known species」；«one»10「the most widely used one」；«one»9「only one analytic study」；«one»9「There is one maximum」
patterns.context: 在描述某类事物中唯一一个、一个具体对象或单个极值时；不要求紧邻 only。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术论文、科学描述

patterns.name: 数量/范围短语中的 few
patterns.context: few 修饰复数名词，表示数量很少；此处与 only 连用。

patterns.name: 数学问答中的 same value
patterns.trigger: 「Do ... and ... have the same value?」中的«same»9；另有「Which is greater/smaller/bigger」及回答 False
patterns.context: 练习题逐题比较数值或判断两个表达式是否相等，常以换行分隔题目与答案。

patterns.name: 其余零散触发
patterns.context: 未见稳定的共同上下文；该例位于微生物学论文中，讨论缓解乙醇敏感性。

en.description: Activations primarily reflect various uses of one: especially population-proportion expressions of the form one in N, as well as unique/single, anaphoric reference, and Japanese “一番”; there is also an isolated way to expression for a proposed approach.

patterns.name: “one in N” proportion expressions
patterns.context: Describes a proportion or frequency in a group; the common format is one in + number, possibly followed by a group or predicate.
patterns.domain: demographics, public health, social science, and encyclopedic explanatory prose

patterns.name: “one” meaning unique or single
patterns.context: States that there is only one species or one peak in a distribution; not a proportion expression.
patterns.domain: plant taxonomy and biomedical academic texts

patterns.name: “one” in English ordinal numbers
patterns.context: Appears in a Japanese ordinal expression to mean first; distinct from the English proportion usage.

patterns.name: “one” as a pronoun referring to a preceding quantity
patterns.context: one refers to a statistic or item mentioned earlier, rather than expressing a numerical proportion or uniqueness.

patterns.name: “way to” expression for an approach
patterns.context: way is followed by a to-infinitive, expressing a way to solve a problem or take action; it has no clear semantic link to the other patterns.
patterns.domain: climate policy commentary or news texts

5_2718.concept: one 的数词及相关表达
5_2718.description: 激活以 one 的多种用法为主：尤其是 one in N 的人群比例表达，也见唯一/单个、指代前项及日语“一番”；另有孤立的 way to 方案表达。

patterns.name: “one in N”比例表达
patterns.context: 描述某一群体中某比例或频率的人；常见格式为 one in + 数字，也可在后面接群体或谓语。
patterns.domain: 人口统计、公共卫生、社会科学与百科类说明文

patterns.name: “one”表示唯一或单个
patterns.context: 陈述仅有一个物种，或分布中有一个峰值；不是比例表达。
patterns.domain: 植物分类与生物医学学术文本

patterns.name: 英文数字序数的“one”
patterns.context: 出现在日语序数表达中，表示第一；与英文比例用法不同。

patterns.name: “one”作代词，指代前述数量
patterns.context: one 指代前文提到的统计量或项目，并非数字比例或唯一性陈述。

patterns.name: “way to”方案表达
patterns.context: way 后接 to 不定式，表示解决问题或采取行动的方式；与其他模式没有明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 气候政策评论或新闻文本

en.description: Activation is distributed across code structures and list/type identifiers, English expressions of time and quantity, academic statistical discussions, and Japanese search and inquiry text. Different trigger words occur in each area, with no stable semantic pattern covering all snippets.

patterns.name: List queries and member collections
patterns.context: Code includes collection/list return values, member filtering, or chained list operations
patterns.domain: Software code and comments in C#, Go, etc.

patterns.name: Types, properties, and object interfaces
patterns.context: Defines types, properties, interface methods, or object fields returned by a function

patterns.name: Function words/identifier boundaries in code
patterns.context: Methods, expressions, or blocks in code syntax; no specific semantics required

patterns.name: Past time and recent statistics
patterns.context: Describes a historical period or recent groups/events, quantifying proportions or the occurrence of problems

patterns.name: Quantitative statements in English research
patterns.context: Reports quantities, proportions, research, or statistical results in academic discussion

patterns.name: Japanese search/inquiry statements
patterns.context: Japanese webpage instructions prompting users to search for an article or access inquiry content

5_2718.description: 激活分散在代码结构与列表/类型标识符、英文的时间和数量表达、学术统计论述及日语检索咨询文本中。各处触发词不同，未见一个能覆盖全部片段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 列表查询与成员集合
patterns.context: 代码中出现集合/列表返回值、成员筛选或链式列表操作
patterns.domain: C#、Go 等软件代码及注释

patterns.name: 类型、属性及对象接口
patterns.context: 定义类型、属性、接口方法或返回对象字段

patterns.name: 代码中的功能词/标识符边界
patterns.context: 代码语法结构中的方法、表达式或块；不要求特定语义

patterns.name: 过去时间与近期统计
patterns.context: 叙述历史时期或近期群体/事件，并量化比例或问题发生情况

patterns.name: 英文量化研究表述
patterns.context: 学术论述中报告数量、比例、研究或统计结果

patterns.name: 日语检索/咨询表述
patterns.context: 日语网页说明，提示用户搜索文章或进入咨询内容

en.description: Covers math comparison problems and their true/false or numerical answers, and also activates on legal citations, botanical classification descriptions, code macro definitions, Japanese webpage instructions, and snippets of linguistic terminology; cross-domain commonality is unclear.

patterns.name: Repeated binary-judgment problem format
patterns.context: Math exercises ask users to compare numerical values or judge equality or magnitude; answers usually follow the questions. Some problems contain negative numbers, fractions, decimals, or algebraic expressions

patterns.name: Punctuation and number strings in legal citations
patterns.context: Case citations interleave commas, parentheses, hyphens, and court reporter volume and page numbers

patterns.name: Plant genus names and taxonomic descriptions
patterns.context: The opening of an encyclopedia entry introduces a genus name, family relationship, naming year, and known species

patterns.name: Code identifier splitting and configuration macros
patterns.context: C/C++ preprocessor definitions pair macro identifiers with their displayed text

patterns.name: Japanese webpage search instructions
patterns.context: Japanese instructions tell users to visit a URL and search for an article, then indicate a location at the bottom of the page

patterns.name: Functional-load terminology in linguistics
patterns.context: Discusses the linguistic functional load of words and the scarcity of words with similar pronunciations

5_2718.concept: 多样文本中的结构化标记
5_2718.description: 覆盖数学比较题及其真假/数值答案，也对法律引注、植物分类描述、代码宏定义、日文网页指引和语言学术语片段有激活；跨域共性不明显。

patterns.name: 重复二值判断题格式
patterns.trigger: “Do … have the same value?”, “Which is smaller”, “Which is greater”, “Are … unequal?”以及其后的“True”“False”或数值答案
patterns.context: 数学练习中，要求比较数值、判断相等性或大小，答案通常紧接题目出现；部分题含负数、分数、小数或代数表达式

patterns.name: 法律引注中的标点与数字串
patterns.context: 判例引注中，逗号、括号、连字符与法院报告卷页码交错

patterns.name: 植物属名及分类描述
patterns.context: 百科条目开头介绍属名、科属关系、命名年份及已知物种

patterns.name: 代码标识符拆分与配置宏
patterns.trigger: “OPTIONS_SECTION”“OPTION_PREFER_FOLDER”等由大写词、下划线组成的宏名，以及对应引号内标签
patterns.context: C/C++预处理器定义中，宏标识符和其显示文本成对出现

patterns.name: 日文网页检索指引
patterns.trigger: “下記URLで記事を検索してみてください”“一番下”

patterns.name: 语言学中的功能负载术语
patterns.context: 讨论词语的语言学功能负载及相似发音词的稀少程度

en.description: Repeatedly responds to “in the past” in English forum text and “So far” in papers; it also occurs in isolated formats such as legal citations, C/C++ conditional compilation, and Japanese search requests, and marks some first-person or line-break positions.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “in the past”
patterns.context: The phrase “in the past” appears in English narration to introduce past experiences, changes, or a time span; it is sometimes followed by “century or so”.

patterns.name: “So far” introducing research progress
patterns.context: Appears in statements of the current state of research or research gaps, followed by content such as “there is no study” or “only a small fraction”.

patterns.name: Punctuation and number strings in legal citations
patterns.context: A citation string composed of commas, numbers, volume numbers, court abbreviations, and reporter abbreviations in case law or legal literature.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor macros and identifiers
patterns.context: A conditional compilation directive in code, followed by an uppercase project- or configuration-related macro name.

patterns.name: Japanese search requests and web URLs
patterns.context: A polite Japanese request for readers to search for an article, followed by a URL and a continuation identifying an item or issue on the page.

patterns.name: “I” and line breaks in ordinary English narration
patterns.context: A first-person statement begins after a line break in a forum post; activation marks local tokens such as the pronoun or line break, without indicating a more specific unified meaning.

5_2718.description: 反复响应英语论坛文本中的“in the past”和论文中的“So far”；也出现在法律引证、C/C++ 条件编译、日语搜索请求等孤立格式中，并标记部分第一人称或换行位置。

patterns.name: 固定短语“in the past”
patterns.context: 英语叙述中出现短语“in the past”，可用于引出过往经历、变化或时间范围；有时继续说明“century or so”。

patterns.name: “So far”引出研究进展
patterns.context: 出现在陈述研究现状或研究空白的句子中，后接“there is no study”或“only a small fraction”等内容。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的标点与数字串
patterns.context: 法律判例或法律文献引证中，逗号、数字、卷号、法院缩写及报告集缩写组成的引用串。

patterns.name: C/C++ 预处理宏与标识符
patterns.context: 代码中的条件编译指令，后接项目或配置相关的大写宏名。

patterns.name: 日语搜索请求及网页 URL
patterns.context: 日语礼貌请求读者搜索文章，附带 URL，并接续指出页面上的项目或问题。

patterns.name: 普通英语叙述中的“I”及句首换行
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中换行后开始第一人称陈述；激活标记落在代词或换行等局部 token 上，未体现更特定的统一语义。

en.description: Activation is distributed across languages, styles, and topics: code structures/identifiers, legal citations, Japanese requests, and various English narratives all respond. Triggering snippets vary in form, making it difficult to identify a stable semantic feature.

patterns.name: Continuation snippets after English tokens/phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across English and Japanese text, often occurring locally after short function words, affixes, or punctuation; these snippets alone do not establish a unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: patents, papers, legal texts, webpages, forums, code

patterns.name: Structural tokens and test calls in code
patterns.context: Located at function names, calls, types, or syntax boundaries in source code; activation spans identifier interiors and boundaries such as parentheses and spaces, with no stable single code semantics.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, C++/Go and other code text

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case citations containing dense sequences of volume/page numbers, state abbreviations, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Local characters in Japanese request sentences
patterns.context: In Japanese sentences, activation falls on character fragments in phrases related to search requests and contact information; the material contains a suspicious URL.

patterns.name: Hybrid offspring and trait comparisons
patterns.context: A patent background section describes self-pollination of hybrid plants and how their offspring compare with the hybrid generation; multiple biological terms and comparative expressions activate together.

patterns.name: Real-time capture and memory/prior academic research
patterns.context: Discusses how real-time capture systems lower the barrier to recording high-quality moments, and reports a gap in academic research.

patterns.name: Social media posting times and reach
patterns.context: Discusses social media policies and when to publish content to achieve greater reach.

patterns.name: Astronomical records and superlative expressions
patterns.context: Uses an analogy to introduce the record for the most distant known galaxy and a new candidate record.

patterns.name: Mobile data alerts and past download experiences
patterns.context: A personal forum reply describes an alert that mobile data is off when opening an app and mentions previously downloading large files.

patterns.name: Code type interfaces and return values
patterns.context: A Go method implements an interface for an object and returns a type field; activation is distributed across the interface declaration, method name, and syntax snippets.

patterns.name: Resource synchronization test assertions
patterns.context: Test code compares resource structs and defines a resource synchronization test.

5_2718.description: 激活跨语言、文体与主题分散：代码结构/标识符、法律引文、日语请求及多类英语叙述均有响应。各段触发片段形态不一，难以归结为稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 英语 token/短语边界后的续接片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在英语及日语文本中，常落在短功能词、词缀或标点之后的局部续接；单看这些片段无法确定统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 混合语料：专利、论文、法律、网页、论坛、代码

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性 token 与测试调用
patterns.context: 位于源码中的函数名、调用、类型或语法边界；激活覆盖标识符内部及括号、空格等边界，未见稳定的单一代码语义。
patterns.domain: Github 源码，C++/Go 等代码文本

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与缩写
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文中，包含卷页数字、州名缩写及标点的密集序列。

patterns.name: 日语请求语句中的局部字符
patterns.context: 日语句子中，激活落在搜索请求和联系信息相关短语的字符片段；材料含可疑 URL。

patterns.name: 基因杂交后代与性状比较
patterns.trigger: « maintenance»1、«crossing»1、« produces»2、« progeny»4、« generally»4、« exhibit»5、« less»9、« desirable»5、« characteristics»5
patterns.context: 专利背景段落说明杂交植物自交及其后代相对杂交一代的性状；多个生物学词汇和比较表达同时激活。

patterns.name: 实时捕获与记忆/学术先前研究
patterns.trigger: « real»3«-»1«time»1« capture»1、« dramatically»2« lower»3« the»2« bar»« of»1、« memory»2« keeping»2、« prior»8« work»3
patterns.context: 讨论实时捕获系统降低高质量瞬间记录门槛，并转述学术研究空缺。
patterns.domain: 计算机/人机交互研究论文

patterns.name: 社交媒体发布时机与传播效果
patterns.trigger: «One»2« of»2、« is»3、« one»8 simple trick、« maximum»2« reach»2
patterns.context: 谈社交媒体政策及何时发布内容以获得更大触达。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体营销网页文章

patterns.name: 天文学纪录及最高程度表达
patterns.trigger: «Much»1« like»1、« record»4« for»5« farthest»5« known»8« galaxy»2、« newest»1 potential« record»2
patterns.context: 以类比引出已知最遥远星系纪录及新候选纪录。

patterns.name: 移动数据提示与过往下载经历
patterns.trigger: «Every»1«time»1« I»2 open、«even»4、« perfect»2、« past»8« I»4 downloaded
patterns.context: 个人论坛回复描述打开应用时出现移动数据关闭提示，并提到过去下载大文件。

patterns.name: 代码类型接口与返回值
patterns.trigger: « Type»2« implements»5 the« plumbing»1.«2Encoded«Object»1« interface»2、« Type»4()、«return»1
patterns.context: Go 方法为对象实现接口并返回类型字段；激活分布于接口声明、方法名及语法片段。

patterns.name: 资源同步测试断言
patterns.context: 测试代码比较资源结构体，并定义资源同步测试。

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on the phrase “So far,” indicating the state of research to date, and also occurs on the synonymous “Thus far.” It additionally covers past-time expressions, legal citation page numbers, Go function declarations, and the literary expression “scarcely a,” without a unified syntactic or domain feature.

patterns.name: “So far” statements about evidence/research status
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, summarizes research progress, evidence, or feasible approaches to date; spans medical and physics papers

patterns.name: “so far” followed by a research overview
patterns.context: “so far” appears after the subject “Most studies” and summarizes existing research findings

patterns.name: “Thus far” introducing prior work
patterns.context: Follows discussion of a preceding issue and shifts to the amount of information needed to date

patterns.name: Time phrase “in the past”
patterns.context: Colloquial recollection of past circumstances, followed by a description of something that once prompted sympathy

patterns.name: Numbers and statutory citation format
patterns.context: A case citation contains a volume number, court reporter series, and page number; the activation marker falls on the number “502”

patterns.name: Page numbers in citations
patterns.context: A case citation and quoted sentence contain consecutive page numbers; the activation marker falls on a page number

patterns.name: Code identifiers and function syntax
patterns.context: Camel-case identifiers, parentheses, type parameters, and the opening brace of a function body in code

patterns.name: “scarcely a” emphasizing rarity
patterns.context: Literary prose uses scarcely to modify a noun phrase, emphasizing that there are almost no places matching the description

5_2718.description: 激活最集中于表示截至目前的研究现状短语“So far”，也见近义“Thus far”；此外覆盖过去时间表达、法律引证页码、Go 函数声明及“scarcely a”文学表达，缺少统一句法或领域特征。

patterns.name: “So far”证据/研究现状表述
patterns.trigger: “So far,”，后接“there is no study”“only a small fraction”“the most feasible realization”等
patterns.context: 位于句首或分句开头，用于概括截至目前的研究进展、证据或可行方案；可跨越医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: “so far”后接研究概况
patterns.context: “so far”出现在主语“Most studies”之后，概述既有研究结果

patterns.name: “Thus far”承接已有工作
patterns.context: 承接前文已讨论的问题，转而说明迄今所需的信息量

patterns.name: 时间短语“in the past”
patterns.context: 口语化回顾过去情况，后接对某事曾引发同情的描述

patterns.name: 引证中的数字与法条格式
patterns.context: 判例引用中出现卷号、法院报告系列及页码；激活标记落在数字“502”

patterns.name: 引证中的页码数字
patterns.context: 判例引证和引述语句中出现连续页码；激活标记落在页码数字

patterns.name: 代码标识符和函数语法
patterns.context: 代码中的驼峰式标识符、括号、类型参数和函数体起始大括号

patterns.name: “scarcely a”强调稀少
patterns.context: 文学叙述中以 scarcely 修饰名词短语，强调几乎没有符合描述的地点

en.description: Activation occurs in several text types: Go test code test signatures and assertions; numbers, punctuation, and principle-oriented wording in legal decisions and case citations; as well as complaints about forum management, hybrid seed traits, and estimates of influenza-related mortality. The latter topics have no obvious shared trigger.

patterns.name: Go test function signatures and test assertions
patterns.context: Defines a test function in Go code or compares expected and actual resource structs in a test; multiple consecutive tokens activate.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: In US case citations, volume numbers, reporter names, page numbers, court abbreviations, and citation punctuation occur together; activation is especially concentrated on commas, page numbers, and hyphens.

patterns.name: Judgment or principle language in legal discussion
patterns.context: A judgment states legal findings, presumptions, or litigation principles; this occurs alongside case citation formats, but the specific phrases are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Complaints about technical management and workload
patterns.context: Uses first-person plural to discuss technological development, management, and work circumstances, expressing an inability to change the situation.

patterns.name: Hybrid seeds and offspring traits
patterns.context: Explains how the traits of self-pollinated hybrid plant offspring differ from those of the hybrid plants.

patterns.name: Influenza exclusion and mortality estimates
patterns.context: Describes methods for extrapolating a baseline after excluding weeks of influenza activity and estimating excess mortality, including differences between estimates.

5_2718.description: 激活出现在多类文本：Go 测试代码的测试签名与断言；法律判决中的判例引证数字、标点及原则性措辞；另有论坛管理抱怨、杂交种子性状和流感相关死亡率估算。后几类主题彼此缺少明显共同触发点。

patterns.name: Go 测试函数签名与测试断言
patterns.context: Go 代码中定义测试函数，或在测试中比较期望值与实际资源结构；多个 token 连续激活。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字标点
patterns.context: 美国判例引证中，卷号、记者名、页码、法院简称和引证标点相邻出现；激活尤其集中在逗号、页码数字及连字符。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的判断或原则措辞
patterns.context: 判决书陈述法律判断、推定或诉讼原则；与判例引证格式同时出现，但这些具体词句并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 技术管理与工作负荷抱怨
patterns.trigger: 「overloaded」「management」「doesn't understand what we do」「there isn't much we can do」
patterns.context: 以第一人称复数讨论技术发展、管理与工作处境，并表达无力改变现状。

patterns.name: 杂交种子与后代性状
patterns.context: 解释杂交植物自交后代相较于杂交植株的性状变化。

patterns.name: 流感排除与死亡率估计
patterns.context: 描述排除流感活跃周后外推基线、估算超额死亡率的方法及其估计差异。

en.description: Visible clues include the quantity word “one,” the comparative “less,” the expression of inability “not much…we can do,” Go function identifiers, and a few proper names or scattered subword fragments; these clues are dispersed and do not cover all activations.

patterns.name: “one” and quantity/singularity expressions
patterns.context: The numeral one indicates quantity or uniqueness; it often forms quantity expressions with nearby words such as only, known, user, and fifth.
patterns.domain: encyclopedic, academic, and patent explanatory texts

patterns.name: less in degree comparisons
patterns.context: Appears in comparative or evaluative structures to describe a lower degree, cost, or desirability.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “much we can do”
patterns.context: Appears in a negative context as “isn't much we can do,” expressing inability to act.

patterns.name: Go code structure identifiers
patterns.context: Near Go function signatures, test functions, or method definitions; activations are distributed across multiple tokens such as identifiers, parentheses, and braces.

patterns.name: Androgen project name fragment
patterns.context: A proper-name phrase in a project title, tokenized into subwords.

patterns.name: Unexplained word forms and syntactic activations
patterns.context: Local activations are scattered across plant taxonomy terms, path/code fragments, and ordinary academic phrases, with no evident common trigger condition.

5_2718.description: 可见线索包括数量词“one”、比较词“less”、否定无能为力表达“not much…we can do”、Go 函数标识符，以及少数专名或零散词片段；这些线索分散，不能覆盖全部激活。

patterns.name: “one”及数量/单一性表述
patterns.context: 数词 one 表示数量或唯一性；常与 only、known、user、fifth 等邻近词组成数量表达。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术、专利等说明性文本

patterns.name: 程度比较中的 less
patterns.context: 出现在比较或评价结构中，描述较低的程度、成本或 desirability。

patterns.name: much we can do 固定表达
patterns.context: 否定语境下出现“isn't much we can do”，表达无能为力。

patterns.name: Go 代码结构标识符
patterns.context: 位于 Go 函数签名、测试函数或方法定义附近；激活分布在标识符、括号及大括号等多个 token。

patterns.name: androgen 项目名称片段
patterns.context: 项目标题中的专名词组，呈分词 token 化。

patterns.name: 难以解释的词形与句法激活
patterns.context: 局部激活分散在植物分类词、路径/代码片段及普通学术短语中，缺少明显共同触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to hyphenated compounds, especially dimensional expressions combining numbers with terms such as dimensional; it also covers combinations involving quantity classifications and body/time/day. It additionally responds to punctuation and number strings in legal case citations and to uncommon academic terms and linguistic definitions.

patterns.name: Dimensional expressions following a hyphen
patterns.context: Dimensional descriptions in hyphenated compounds in academic prose; triggering snippets sometimes mark only part of a number, hyphen, or dimensional.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and computer science papers

patterns.name: Numerical ranges or classification terms joined by a hyphen
patterns.context: Hyphens connect quantities, ranges, or classification terms, especially in technical terminology, method names, and entry titles; a full dimensional expression is not required.

patterns.name: Punctuation and number strings in legal citations
patterns.context: In court case citation formats, state abbreviations, volume/page numbers, commas, and periods occur next to one another.

patterns.name: Low functional-load terminology and similarity explanations
patterns.context: Defines a term in parentheses and explains similarities in sound or low functional load between words; activation is concentrated on the term and explanatory words.

patterns.name: Body operators collocation
patterns.context: When discussing properties extractable from a physical description, body collocates with operators and appears with one-/two-body classifications.

patterns.name: Terminology for generating one-forms
patterns.context: Explains how explicit formulas generate a particular mathematical object; one-forms is a specialized term and cannot be fully reduced to a dimensional usage.

5_2718.description: 主要响应连字符复合结构，尤其数字与 dimensional 等术语组成的维度表达，也覆盖数量分类、body/time/day 等组合；另对法律判例引证的标点数字串及少见学术术语和语言学定义有响应。

patterns.name: 连字符后接维度表达
patterns.context: 学术叙述中连字符复合词的维度描述；触发片段有时只标出数字、连字符或 dimensional 的一部分。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 连字符连接的数值范围或分类项
patterns.context: 连字符连接数量、范围或分类词，尤其是技术术语、方法名称和条目标题；不要求完整维度表达。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的标点与数字串
patterns.context: 法院判例引证格式中，州名缩写、卷页数字及逗号句点相邻出现。

patterns.name: 低功能负载术语及相似性说明
patterns.context: 括号内定义术语，并解释词语间的相似声音或低功能负载；激活集中于术语和说明用词。
patterns.domain: 语言学/语音学说明文本

patterns.name: body operators 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论可由某种物理描述提取的性质时，body 与算符搭配并带有 one-/two-body 分类。

patterns.name: 生成 one-forms 的术语
patterns.context: 说明显式公式如何生成特定数学对象；one-forms 是专门术语，不能完全归为维度用法。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text snippets and code structure markers
en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: prominent on Go test function signatures and general Go declarations, and also on C++ test constructs; specific snippets in medical research, diabetes proportions, chemical analysis, and conversational advice also activate. No single semantic or morphological pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: Go test function signature and function-body opening
patterns.context: In Go test files, test function names begin with Test and take *testing.T as a parameter; activation is concentrated on the parameter, the end of the signature, and the left brace.

patterns.name: Go function declaration and return type
patterns.context: At Go method or function declarations, especially near the method name, parentheses, and slice return type.

patterns.name: Conditional compilation and test-case code
patterns.context: C/C++-style preprocessor directives switch feature branches, with numeric type conversion tests listed nearby.

patterns.name: Programmatic test construction and type markers
patterns.context: Test code sets constructor fields and specifies a protocol or test message type.

patterns.name: Medical research project titles and effect descriptions
patterns.context: A research project abstract or description outlines an intervention and its effects on muscle size and quality.

patterns.name: Diabetes statistics phrase
patterns.context: When discussing diabetes management or complication risks, describes a proportion as “fewer than one in eight.”

patterns.name: Chemical analysis values and functional group labels
patterns.context: Compound analysis data intermixes values, wavenumber ranges, and structural group abbreviations.

patterns.name: Pronoun strings in colloquial English advice
patterns.context: Discussing work management or technological development, colloquially expresses that “there is little we can do.”

5_2718.concept: 异质文本片段与代码结构标记
5_2718.description: 激活模式多样：突出 Go 测试函数签名及一般 Go 声明，也覆盖 C++ 测试构造；另对医学研究、糖尿病比例、化学分析和口语建议中的特定片段激活。没有单一语义或词形模式能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: Go 测试函数签名与函数体起始
patterns.context: Go 测试文件中，测试函数名以 Test 开头，参数为 *testing.T，激活集中在参数、签名结束和左花括号处。

patterns.name: Go 函数声明与返回类型
patterns.context: Go 方法或函数声明处，尤其是方法名、括号及切片返回类型附近。

patterns.name: 条件编译与测试用例代码
