patterns.name: Abbreviation fragment in a disease name
patterns.context: Appears in the context of Crohn's disease; the full disease name is given first, followed by the abbreviation IBD.

5_2733.description: 激活分散于事件字段、医学词语、数学符号、体育人名及科研文本片段；部分医学与体育段落各有弱局部相似，但没有覆盖全部段落的清晰共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 事件标题与日期时间字段
patterns.context: 出现在类似表单或日程条目的字段标签中，后接换行及日期、时间等内容。
patterns.domain: 事件信息、日程或网页片段

patterns.name: 活动名称后的数字/分隔符
patterns.context: Event 后换行，再出现数字和活动标题片段；与第1段的事件字段格式部分相似，但日期、时间标签缺失。

patterns.name: 医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学术语或疾病名称的词内片段中；不同词项，未见明确共同词形或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的运算符与符号
patterns.context: 出现在含数字及乘方等符号的数学表达式中；触发位置横跨单词片段、减号和双星号，模式不确定。

patterns.name: 人名及体育队伍缩写
patterns.context: 出现在运动员姓名、球队或位置缩写附近，激活覆盖姓名片段与体育缩写。
patterns.domain: 体育人物介绍或新闻片段

patterns.name: 科研文本中的一般词或短语片段
patterns.context: 出现在实验方法描述或研究对象统计信息中；这些触发项彼此并无明显一致的语义类别。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的缩写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Crohn's disease 的语境中，疾病名称先以全称出现，随后给出 IBD 缩写。

en.description: All examples activate on internal fragments or local boundaries of different words; the fragments span domains and are semantically dispersed. Some examples also activate on newline characters. There is no evidence for a unified semantic or topical pattern.

patterns.name: Cross-word internal letter fragments and boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs within different words, at word endings, or at newline positions, with no stable part-of-speech, semantic, or syntactic condition; it often concentrates on subword fragments rather than complete words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; medical abstracts, encyclopedia entries, news/web text, academic titles

5_2733.description: 所有样例都在不同词语的内部片段或局部边界激活，片段跨领域且语义分散；部分样例还在换行符激活。没有证据支持统一的语义或主题模式。

patterns.name: 跨词内字母片段与边界
patterns.trigger: 词内或词间的片段，如«ell»、«Relation»、«ice»、«array»、«atro»、«aration»、«Progression»、«Cooperation»、«z»、«ne»；另有行末«↵»
patterns.context: 多种不同单词内部、词尾或换行位置激活，未见稳定的词类、语义或句法条件；激活常集中在子词片段而非完整词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；医学摘要、百科条目、新闻/网页文本、学术标题

en.concept: Quoted proper nouns and explanatory fragments
en.description: Activation often occurs in information-dense text fragments: explanations in quotation marks or parentheses, foreign-language text/names, abbreviations and proper nouns, as well as code strings and patent titles. Medical papers and encyclopedic text are especially common; segment 3 shows no clear corresponding feature.

patterns.name: Definitions, explanations, or naming of technical and scientific terms
patterns.context: A term, name, or abbreviation is followed by an explanation, translation, or etymology in parentheses; also includes aliases and definitions marked with quotation marks.

patterns.name: Quotations and foreign-language fragments
patterns.context: Narrative text contains foreign-language text, work titles, or phrases in quotation marks, often followed by an explanation or addition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, art history, and film/TV entries

patterns.name: Patent titles and formal literature citations
patterns.context: In patent background paragraphs, a quoted patent title or literature title is introduced by a number and author.

patterns.name: Strings and assignment expressions in code
patterns.context: Example code contains quoted strings, variable assignments, and function calls; explanatory text precedes the code fragment.

patterns.name: Punctuation and parenthetical structures near proper nouns or abbreviations
patterns.context: Proper nouns, abbreviations, experimental conditions, or numbers are interspersed with parentheses, quotation marks, commas, and similar punctuation, and may contain information-dense noun phrases.

5_2733.concept: 括引号的专名与解释片段
5_2733.description: 激活常出现在信息密集的文本片段：引号或括号中的解释、外语/名称、缩写与专名，以及代码字符串和专利标题。医学论文与百科文本尤常见；第3段没有明显对应特征。

patterns.name: 技术或科学术语的定义、释义或命名
patterns.trigger: "(\"...\")"、"The genus name is a combination of..."、"(\"disease score\")"
patterns.context: 术语、名称或缩写后接括号中的解释、翻译或命名依据；也包括文中以引号标出的别称、定义。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学论文、科学论文

patterns.name: 引语及外语片段
patterns.trigger: "heller wunderbar gleichmäßig geführter Bass herrlich timbriert"；"Blood Oath"；"Little square of deception"
patterns.context: 叙述性文本中出现引号括起的外语、作品名或短语，往往随后继续解释或补充。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、艺术史及影视条目

patterns.name: 专利标题与正式文献引文
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，以编号和作者引出带引号的专利标题或文献名称。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串与赋值表达式
patterns.context: 示例代码中出现引号包裹的字符串、变量赋值及函数调用；代码片段前有说明性文字。

patterns.name: 专名或缩写旁的标点及括号结构
patterns.context: 专名、缩写、实验条件或编号处夹有括号、引号、逗号等，可能包含信息密集的名词短语。

en.description: Activation concentrates on short newline-separated entries and title–body structures, and also appears in encyclopedia definitions, location templates, lists, advertisements, papers, and forum questions; the common feature is an entry boundary or opening in formatted text.

patterns.name: Repeated titles and entry openings
patterns.context: The first line is a title/name, followed by a blank line or newline, after which the same name appears again and the body begins

patterns.name: List entries and entry separators
patterns.context: Multiple items in a list or directory are arranged line by line, or a newline separates an entry from the body text

patterns.name: Encyclopedia location-entry template
patterns.context: A place name heading is followed by a brief introduction to its administrative division and geographic location

patterns.name: Encyclopedia categories and definitional phrasing
patterns.context: Introduces a language or dialect, followed by information about classification or affiliation

patterns.name: Definitions of chess terms
patterns.context: A definitional sentence explaining a chess tactic or rule

patterns.name: Accommodation advertisement format and prices
patterns.context: Rental prices are listed by night/week, followed by a description of vacation accommodation

patterns.name: Research gaps in scientific papers
patterns.context: An opening statement in a paper or report identifies an unresolved question

patterns.name: Medical and health articles and statements of evidence
patterns.context: Introduces a health issue, then discusses salt intake, cardiovascular risk, and research evidence

patterns.name: Forum discussion and subjective questions
patterns.context: Online discussion expresses personal observations through colloquial rhetorical questions or direct questions

5_2733.concept: 结构化文本的条目边界
5_2733.description: 激活集中在换行分隔的短条目及标题—正文结构，也见百科定义、地点模板、列表、广告、论文和论坛问句；共同点是格式化文本中的条目边界或开头。

patterns.name: 重复标题与条目开头
patterns.trigger: 标题或名称先以分词形式出现，换行后再次出现，如 «Tur»«ton»、«T»«az»«g»«ait»、«O»«uled» «R»«iy»«ah»、«M»«p»«ak»«with»«i»
patterns.context: 首行是标题/名称，后有空行或换行，随后再次出现同一名称并开始正文

patterns.name: 列表条目与条目分隔
patterns.trigger: 连续的条目名称及 «↵»，如疾病名称后反复出现 «syndrome»«↵»，以及 «Sleeps - Bedrooms - Bathrooms»
patterns.context: 列表或目录中多项内容按行排列，或条目与正文间有换行分隔
patterns.domain: 百科列表、商品/住宿信息

patterns.name: 百科地点条目模板
patterns.context: 地名标题后接行政区划与地理位置的简短介绍

patterns.name: 百科分类与定义句式
patterns.trigger: «is an extinct Australian Aboriginal dialect»、«Classification»、«is generally regarded as»
patterns.context: 介绍语言或方言，并接分类、归属等说明

patterns.name: 棋类术语释义
patterns.trigger: «Turton doubling»、«in chess»、«a piece moves along a line»
patterns.context: 解释棋类战术或规则的定义句

patterns.name: 住宿广告格式与价格
patterns.context: 按晚/周列出租价格，随后描述度假住宿

patterns.name: 科学论文中的研究缺口
patterns.trigger: «There is a fundamental gap in our understanding»
patterns.context: 论文或报告开篇陈述尚未解决的知识问题

patterns.name: 医学健康文章及证据陈述
patterns.trigger: «Should we eat less salt?»、«High blood pressure»、«overwhelming evidence»
patterns.context: 以健康问题引入，讨论盐摄入与心血管风险及研究证据

patterns.name: 论坛讨论及主观提问
patterns.trigger: «Is it just me or»、«Does timing play»、«Have you watched TV lately?»
patterns.context: 网络讨论中以口语化反问或直接提问表达个人观察

en.description: Primarily responds to moral and expressions related to moral values, knowledge, responsibility, and so on, covering [1–5] and [8–10]; it also activates on repeatedly paired and phrases in [6] and his character expressions in [1][7], the latter two having no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Moral-related vocabulary
patterns.context: The word moral itself appears, or a compound beginning with moral, such as «moral commitment», «moral knowledge», «moral responsibility», «moral compass»; the word may be split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Ethics, political commentary, and general discussion

patterns.name: Paired coordinated and phrases
patterns.context: Adjacent or consecutive lists of fixed two-word phrases; not limited to moral contexts.

patterns.name: His possessives and character narration
patterns.context: A character or the pronoun his appears in narration or a phrase; this pattern has no clear connection to moral vocabulary.

5_2733.description: 主要响应 moral 及道德价值、知识、责任等相关表达，覆盖[1–5]、[8–10]；另在[6]反复成对的 and 短语、[1][7]的 his 人物表达中激活，后两者与主模式未见明确联系。

patterns.name: moral 相关词汇
patterns.context: 出现 moral 本身，或以 moral 开头的复合词，如 «moral commitment»、«moral knowledge»、«moral responsibility»、«moral compass»；词内部可能被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 伦理学、政治评论及一般论述

patterns.name: 成对并列的 and 短语
patterns.trigger: «and» 连接两项的反复列表，如 «hand and foot»、«Heaven and Hell»、«him and her»、«hills and valleys»
patterns.context: 相邻或连续列举形式固定的二项词组；并非只限于道德语境。
patterns.domain: 百科词条中的短语清单

patterns.name: his 所有格及人物叙述
patterns.context: 人物或代词 his 出现在叙述或短语中；此模式与 moral 词汇无明显共同点。

en.description: Activation is dispersed across medical, biological, and dietary texts: right/left contrasts, Failure phrasing, and local patterns involving image classification, antibody terminology, immune experiments, radiological descriptions, food cutting, and parasite-related diets.

patterns.name: Right-side or rightward directional terms
patterns.context: right appears in paired anatomical positions with left or in left-right movement parameters; nearby words often refer to body parts, limbs, or magnitude.
patterns.domain: Medical imaging cases, motor control research

patterns.name: Failure, absence, or inability to maintain
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or noun phrase, describes failure to understand a pathological mechanism, abnormal anatomical fusion, or inability to maintain normal physiological function.

patterns.name: Classification results and label colors
patterns.context: Tissue or images are divided into components, followed by color-based labels for each class.

patterns.name: CDR and variable-region terminology
patterns.context: In antibody sequences or patent claims, immunological abbreviations such as variable light and CDR occur nearby.

patterns.name: Immune signaling and experimental model terminology
patterns.context: A study plan on immune mechanisms describes signal dependence, cell models, and experimental resources; strong activation appears on available.

patterns.name: Clearly delineated structures in radiological imaging
patterns.context: Describes clearly defined, radiolucent bone regions in X-ray images.

patterns.name: Food cutting and child feeding safety
patterns.context: A food list describes how fruits or vegetables are cut and cooked, and how to prevent choking; raw modifies vegetables.
patterns.domain: Dietary guidance for families or children

patterns.name: Parasite exposure and raw-meat diets
patterns.context: Discusses how parasite exposure rates vary by region and population, and relates this to eating raw or lightly cooked meat.

5_2733.description: 激活分散于医学、生物学及饮食文本：右侧/左右对照、Failure句式，以及影像分类、抗体术语、免疫实验、放射描述、食物切分和寄生虫饮食等局部模式。

patterns.name: 右侧或右向的方位词
patterns.context: right 出现在与 left 成对的解剖位置或左右运动参数中；附近常有表示身体部位、肢体或幅度的词。
patterns.domain: 医学影像病例、运动控制研究

patterns.name: 失败、缺失或未能维持
patterns.context: 句首或名词短语开头，描述未能理解病理机制、解剖融合异常，或无法维持正常生理状态。

patterns.name: 分类结果及标签颜色
patterns.context: 组织或图像被划分为若干成分，随后用颜色为各类标注。

patterns.name: CDR 与可变区术语
patterns.context: 抗体序列或专利权利描述中，variable light 与 CDR 等免疫学缩写相邻。

patterns.name: 免疫信号与实验模型术语
patterns.context: 免疫机制研究计划中，描述信号依赖性、细胞模型与实验资源；可见较强激活落在 available。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 放射影像中的清晰界定
patterns.context: 描述 X 光影像中骨骼区域的边界清晰、透亮表现。

patterns.name: 食物切分与儿童进食安全
patterns.context: 食物清单描述水果或蔬菜如何切分、烹调，以及避免噎食；raw 修饰蔬菜。
patterns.domain: 面向家庭或儿童的饮食说明

patterns.name: 寄生虫暴露及生肉饮食
patterns.context: 讨论寄生虫接触率随地区和族群变化，并联系食用生肉或轻度烹熟肉类。
patterns.domain: 流行病学或医学背景介绍

en.concept: Word forms and positional uses of right
en.description: Activation is most concentrated on right: it is used both for sentence-final confirmation and to indicate direction or the right side of a chart; other sporadic activations occur on the medical field date, the medical term functional, blank table tabs, and the continuation prompt more.

patterns.name: Emphatic or right-side meaning of right
patterns.context: right appears in sentence-final questions as a confirmation tag (segments 1, 2, 3, 5); indicates a right turn in a list of directions (segment 6); or contrasts with left to indicate the right side of a chart (segment 7).
patterns.domain: Forum conversation, narrative, directions, scientific chart text

patterns.name: Date field in identity information
patterns.context: Appears in a list of patient identification fields, followed by of birth.

patterns.name: Term related to functional impairment
patterns.context: Appears in a parallel list of health-status domains, modifying impairment.

patterns.name: Blank spaces and tabs in numerical tables
patterns.context: Activation falls on tabs or blank columns in an aligned table consisting of numbers, currency, and codes.

patterns.name: Continuation prompt more
patterns.context: Appears in the parenthetical prompt “(more)”, indicating that additional content follows.

5_2733.description: 激活最集中于 right：既用于句末确认，也表示方向或图表右侧；其余零散落在医疗字段 date、医学术语 functional、表格空白制表符及续读提示 more 上。

patterns.name: 短语 right 的强调或右侧含义
patterns.context: right 出现在句末问句中，作为确认语气（段 1、2、3、5）；或在方向列举中表示右转（段 6）；或与 left 对照表示图表中的右侧（段 7）。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、叙述、路线说明、科学图表文字

patterns.name: 身份信息字段中的 date
patterns.context: 出现在患者身份识别信息的字段列表中，后接 of birth。

patterns.name: 功能障碍相关词
patterns.context: 出现在健康状态领域的并列列表中，修饰 impairment。

patterns.name: 数字表格中的空白与制表符
patterns.context: 数值、货币和代码构成的对齐表格中，激活落在制表符或空白列上。
patterns.domain: 能源市场数据表、电子邮件

patterns.name: more 的续读提示
patterns.context: 出现在“(more)”这一括号内提示中，表示还有后续内容。

en.description: Activations are scattered across English function words, numbers and units, table delimiters, code identifiers, and medical or conference text terms; there is no single semantic theme. Table formatting and common token forms are prominent.

patterns.name: English function words and prepositions
patterns.context: Activates when ordinary function words or common affixes in continuous English text serve syntactic linking, modifying, or explanatory roles; specific words and positions vary.
patterns.domain: Product descriptions, forum conversations, academic and technical text

patterns.name: Dimensions, quantities, and measurements
patterns.context: Numbers, units, range symbols, or statistics appear in product specifications, age descriptions, and table data; numbers activate frequently, but number strings are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Product specifications, demographics, medical papers, and tables

patterns.name: Tables and column-delimiter formatting
patterns.context: Vertical bars, alignment hyphens, and padding spaces in Markdown or plain-text tables; activation may fall on delimiters and whitespace.
patterns.domain: StackExchange tables, example tables in code documentation

patterns.name: Code, identifiers, and formatting syntax
patterns.context: Underscored identifiers, camel-case names, and date-format patterns in code or technical explanations; often co-occur with tables or code examples.

patterns.name: English word segmentation or boundary continuation
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple tokens, fragments include word beginnings, endings, or continuations across tokens; the language may be English or Portuguese, and segmentation is inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Product copy, medical papers, multilingual StackExchange content

patterns.name: Meeting bot commands
patterns.context: Several command names and their introductory words activate when a meeting log's bot lists available commands.

patterns.name: Deictic expression in a quotation
patterns.context: A conversational reference to an object or purchase recommendation in a forum quotation; there is no evidence here that it forms a broader pattern.

patterns.name: Medical nouns and modifiers
patterns.context: Scattered activation on words for methods, degree, body parts, or research subjects in medical or rules-related text; no stable single-term pattern is evident.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and academic discussions of sports rules

patterns.name: Medical table field labels
patterns.context: Variable headings, category labels, and statistical symbols activate in demographic or clinical-characteristic tables.

5_2733.description: 激活分散于英文结构词、数字与单位、表格分隔符、代码标识符及医学/会议文本词项；并无单一语义主题，表格格式和常见 token 形态较突出。

patterns.name: 英文结构词与介词
patterns.trigger: « your»、« time»、« designed»、« in»、« a»、« the»、« according»、« more»
patterns.context: 英文连续文本中，普通功能词或常见词缀处于句法连接、修饰或说明关系时激活；具体词项和位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 商品描述、论坛对话、学术与技术文本

patterns.name: 尺寸、数量与测量值
patterns.context: 数字、单位、范围符号或统计量出现在产品规格、年龄描述及表格数据中；数字激活较多，但数字串本身并不一致。
patterns.domain: 商品规格、人口统计、医学论文与表格

patterns.name: 表格及列分隔格式
patterns.context: Markdown 或纯文本表格中的竖线、对齐用横线及填充空格；激活可落在分隔符和空白上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 表格、代码文档中的示例表

patterns.name: 代码、标识符与格式语法
patterns.trigger: « Null»、« Index_type»、« Index_comment»、« formatPattern»、« Date»、« yyyy»、«/»
patterns.context: 代码或技术说明中的带下划线标识符、驼峰式名称及日期格式模式；常与表格/代码示例共现。
patterns.domain: 数据库问答、Github 技术文档

patterns.name: 英语词内分词或边界续接
patterns.context: 词被分成多个 token 时，片段包含词首、词尾或跨 token 续接；语言可能为英语或葡萄牙语，切分形式并不统一。
patterns.domain: 商品文案、医学论文、StackExchange 多语言内容

patterns.name: 会议机器人命令
patterns.trigger: « Available»、« commands»、« action»、« idea»、« info»、« link»、« nick»
patterns.context: 会议记录中机器人列举可用命令时，多个命令名及其引导词激活。

patterns.name: 引语中的指示语
patterns.context: 论坛引语中以口语方式指向某个对象或购买建议；此处缺少证据显示它构成更广泛模式。

patterns.name: 医学名词及修饰语
patterns.trigger: « stained»、« modified»、« significantly»、« length»、« skin»、« patients»
patterns.context: 医学或规则说明的正文中，方法、程度、身体部位或研究对象等词语零散激活，未见稳定的单一术语模式。
patterns.domain: 医学论文与体育规则学术讨论

patterns.name: 医学表格字段标签

en.description: Activations are scattered across time/times, never, ch, human beings, H fragments, medical-table terms, walking descriptions, and poetic vocabulary. Most triggers appear in only one passage, with no unified semantics or clear shared conditions.

patterns.name: Heading marker

en.description: Activations are scattered across schedule-related time words, whitespace and separator lines in medical tables, clinical values and lists of subjects, as well as chat punctuation, fragments within Greek words, and wording about plots or medication risks; no single stable semantic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Time, date, and time-period markers
patterns.context: Appears in television scheduling descriptions, especially notes about monthly sampling, times, and time zones; activation concentrates on times, days, and adjacent time-period/time-zone text.

patterns.name: Specific letter fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on letters or letter combinations within English or Greek words, with no shared meaning or semantic context; the fragments may reflect subword fragments or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Table structure and numerical fields
patterns.context: Typeset tables or aligned fields in medical text; activation falls on padding whitespace, separator lines, and table values.

patterns.name: Clinical grades, units, and statistical abbreviations
patterns.context: Grades, units, abbreviations, and formatted numbers appear in medical tables or scale descriptions; beyond the table-formatting pattern, no evidently consistent word-meaning trigger is present.

patterns.name: Humans, animals, and clinical subjects in lists of subjects or categories
patterns.context: Appears in lists or descriptions of research subjects or patient groups; human-related words activate strongly, but animal categories also appear in the same passage, so it cannot be attributed only to human references.

patterns.name: Safety, risk, and adverse consequences
patterns.context: One passage discusses the abuse risk, safety, and side effects of cannabis medication; another describes a fictional plot involving disaster, the undead, and protecting what matters. The semantics are similar, but the styles and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Function words and descriptions of change in Greek parliamentary sentences
patterns.context: In continuous Greek text, local high activation falls on letter fragments within words, articles, or around a committee subject following a sentence transition; a shared lexical trigger is difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Punctuation, emoticons, and spelling corrections in IRC chat
patterns.context: In chat dialogue, activation falls on reply openings, commas, asterisk-enclosed action emoticons, and the ends of spelling corrections; this differs from formal written-language patterns.

patterns.name: Disability level and walking-ability descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptions of functional grading or mobility related to neurological disease, including disability level, need for assistance, and walking distance.

patterns.name: Medication dose and follow-up time

5_2733.description: 激活分布于英文散文中的所有格、限定词和常见小词，也落在词内子词、格式字符及希腊语片段上；跨语料未见稳定语义或单一上下文条件。

patterns.name: 英文所有格或限定词后接空白
patterns.context: 高亮词之后紧跟空格、标点或未标记内容；在不同语法结构中都出现，不能确定具体句法条件
patterns.domain: 论坛、新闻评论、宗教讨论及邮件等英文散文

patterns.name: 分词或词内连续子词边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在被切分的词或特殊格式串的子词片段上；不同例子中的具体字符与词义并不一致
patterns.domain: 网页文本、莎士比亚诗句、聊天及排版数据

patterns.name: 句首或句中小词及标点
patterns.context: 普通英语句子或对话中出现常见功能词、标点，但相邻语境各异，未见稳定搭配
patterns.domain: 诗歌、IRC 对话、论坛文本

patterns.name: 希腊语词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文字中，激活落在被拆分的词片段上，未显示与英文片段相同的语义

en.description: Activations are scattered across IRC asterisk action markers and questions, in vivo/in vitro in medical text, and sporadic punctuation and words in dictionaries or tables. Triggers vary across these contexts and are difficult to reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Asterisk-enclosed IRC actions/emoticons
patterns.context: In IRC conversations, asterisks mark actions, states, or emoticons; trigger points fall on the asterisks and adjacent content, while the action semantics vary between examples

patterns.name: in vivo / in vitro terminology
patterns.context: Latin phrases in experimental or clinical research contexts in biomedical text, especially vivo; activation is not equally strong in every occurrence
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter, PubMed abstracts, and PMC biomedical papers

patterns.name: Punctuation or syntactic fragments in English entries
patterns.context: Punctuation, pronouns, common phrases, and table text are marked sporadically in dictionary definitions, examples, or tables; no unified local trigger condition is evident

patterns.name: Question marks and conversational markers in IRC
patterns.context: Short questions, colloquial expressions, or asterisk-marked corrections/actions in chat turns; locally overlaps with the asterisk-action pattern, but activation is itself inconsistent

5_2733.description: 激活分散于 IRC 的星号动作标记与问句、医学文本中的 in vivo/in vitro，以及词典或表格中的零散标点和词语。各处触发不一致，难以归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 星号包围的 IRC 动作/表情
patterns.context: IRC 对话中，星号标记动作、状态或表情；触发点落在星号及其相邻内容上，不同例子里的动作语义不一

patterns.name: in vivo / in vitro 术语
patterns.trigger: « in»2« vivo»9 and in« vitro»5；« in»1« vivo»9 and in« vitro»4；« in»1« vivo»8
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中，出现在实验研究或临床研究语境里的拉丁短语，尤其是 vivo；并非每次出现都同样激活
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter、PubMed 摘要及 PMC 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 英语词条中的标点或句式片段
patterns.context: 词典释义、例句或表格内容中，标点、代词、常见短语及表格文本被零散标记；未见统一的局部触发条件
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 词典/例句、PMC 表格

patterns.name: IRC 中的问号及对话标记
patterns.context: 聊天轮次中，简短问句、口语表达或带星号的修正/动作标记；与星号动作模式有局部重叠，但本身触发不稳定

en.description: Activations are scattered across in vivo/in vitro research expressions, medical terminology, function words and asterisked action markers in chat and fiction, narrative time words, and tab and space labels in code. There is no single stable triggering feature.

patterns.name: in vivo/in vitro phrases
patterns.context: Appears in research, experimental, or clinical descriptions, often contrasting in vivo and in vitro; activations focus on vivo and also cover vitro.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or medial function words
patterns.context: In spoken dialogue or narrative dialogue, activations fall on ordinary grammatical or discourse words; their positions and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Asterisk-enclosed symbols
patterns.context: In IRC dialogue, asterisks mark actions or nonverbal expressions; activations fall on the asterisks and adjacent content.

patterns.name: Components of academic terms
patterns.context: In medical or biological contexts, activations are scattered across technical nouns and modifiers, with no unified part of speech or root.

patterns.name: Words marking the passage of time
patterns.context: In narration, words describe an instantaneous reaction or buying time; their meanings do not clearly match the patterns in other passages.

patterns.name: Space labels
patterns.context: In code or annotation data, activations fall on tabs and labels related to spaces.

5_2733.description: 激活分散于体内/体外科研表达、医学术语、聊天与小说中的功能词和星号动作标记、叙事时间词，以及代码里的制表符和空格标签；没有单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: in vivo/in vitro 短语
patterns.context: 出现在研究、实验或临床描述中，常并列对比体内与体外；激活集中在 vivo，也覆盖 vitro。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研项目摘要

patterns.name: 句首或句中功能词
patterns.context: 口语对话、叙事对白中，激活落在普通语法词或语气词，具体位置和语义不一致。

patterns.name: 星号包围的符号
patterns.context: IRC 对话中，星号标记动作或非言语表达，激活在星号及其相邻内容。

patterns.name: 学术词语的成分
patterns.context: 医学或生物学语境，激活散布在专业名词及修饰语上，未见统一的单一词类或词根。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、项目摘要

patterns.name: 时间推进词
patterns.context: 叙事中描述瞬间反应或争取时间，激活词义与其他段落模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 空格标注
patterns.context: 代码或标注数据中，激活的是制表符及空格相关标签。
patterns.domain: GitHub 格式或语法标注数据

en.description: Activations are scattered across various text and word types: the locative use of here, chat question marks and asterisks, apologies, poetic vocabulary, emphasis in comments, contrast words in Q&A, archaic exclamations, dictionary-definition words, and line-break formatting. No unified semantic pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Deictic use of here
patterns.context: Appears in sentences narrating that something happened somewhere, often with was; [10] introduces an event with “here”.

patterns.name: Sentence-final question mark
patterns.context: Used for questions or confirmation in conversational IRC chat; nearby words vary considerably.

patterns.name: Nonstandard markers or special symbols
patterns.context: Asterisks appear as correction/insertion symbols or similar formatting markers in chat; their specific function varies by context.

patterns.name: Apology expression
patterns.context: An email begins with Sorry to express an apology, followed by confusion.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in poetry
patterns.context: Words with rhythmic or lyrical qualities appear in poetic lines; activation is distributed across different words, with no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Time words and emphatic expressions
patterns.context: A commentary emphasizes events and reproach through time-related or exclamatory wording.

patterns.name: Word-meaning explanations and antonym pairs
patterns.context: Q&A text lists words, contrasts options, or explains phrase meanings.

patterns.name: Archaic exclamatory vocabulary in literary text
patterns.context: Archaic or dramatic supplicatory contexts containing exclamations and lamentations.

patterns.name: Dictionary-style definitions and negation
patterns.context: Definitions or examples separated by semicolons describe states, meanings, and negative conditions.

patterns.name: Line breaks and paragraph formatting
patterns.context: Layout spacing consisting of multiple blank lines or line breaks; activation markers cluster near blank lines.

5_2733.description: 激活分散于多种文本与词类：here 的地点指示、聊天问号和星号、道歉、诗歌词汇、评论强调词、问答中的对照词、古体感叹、词典释义词及换行排版。未见能解释全部样例的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: here 的指示性用法
patterns.context: 出现在叙述某处发生事情的句子中，常与 was 连用；[10]则为“在这里”引出事件。

patterns.name: 句末问号
patterns.context: 口语 IRC 对话中用于提问或确认，邻近词语本身差异较大。

patterns.name: 非标准标记或特殊符号
patterns.context: 星号作为聊天中的修正/插入符号或类似格式标记出现；具体功能依上下文而异。

patterns.name: 道歉表达
patterns.context: 邮件中以 Sorry 开头表达歉意，后接 confusion。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的强调词
patterns.context: 诗行中出现带韵律或抒情色彩的词语；激活分布在不同词上，未见单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 时间词及强调表达
patterns.context: 评论性散文中以时间或感叹式措辞强调事件与责难。

patterns.name: 词义解释与反义搭配
patterns.context: 问答文本列举词语、对照选项或解释短语含义。

patterns.name: 古体诗文中的感叹词汇
patterns.context: 古风或戏剧化祈求语境，含感叹与哀叹措辞。

patterns.name: 词典式释义及否定
patterns.context: 以分号分隔释义或例项，描述状态、含义与否定条件。

patterns.name: 换行及段落格式
patterns.context: 多个空行或换行组成的排版间隔；激活标记集中于空白行附近。

en.description: Activations are scattered across genres and word classes. Salient examples include sentence- or clause-initial Here, sentence-initial late, medial time/Enough/Him, and yours, *, and short word fragments in chat or at text endings. No stable semantic pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Here at line or clause boundaries
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or a new clause after a comma; in [4] followed by lies, in [5] by and in its immediate vicinity, and in [8] by 's another.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial time word late
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence, followed by as about the beginning of our era.

patterns.name: Yourself / sign-off-style yours at sentence ends or across lines
patterns.context: Near the end of phrases or chat text, around markers or usernames; the triggering words vary.

patterns.name: Emphatic or summarizing words in main clauses
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in “it was time for…”, “Enough of woe…”, and “trust in Him”; meanings and syntactic positions differ.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, poetry, personal religious narrative

patterns.name: Participles / short word fragments in poetic lines or quotations
patterns.context: In poetic formatting or quotations, words are split into multiple tokens; strong activations fall on part of a word.

patterns.name: Conversational transitions and tone markers in IRC chat
patterns.context: Around questions, colloquial spellings, or emoticons in chat turns; strong activations also occur on “*” near line endings.

5_2733.description: 激活分散在多种文体与词类：显著例子包括句首/分句首的 Here、句首 late、句中 time/Enough/Him，以及聊天或结尾处的 yours、*、短词片段。未见能覆盖全部段落的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 行首或边界处的 Here
patterns.context: 在句首或逗号后的新分句开头；[4] 后接 lies，[5] 后接 and in its immediate vicinity，[8] 后接 's another。

patterns.name: 行首的时间词 late
patterns.context: 出现在句首，后接 as about the beginning of our era。

patterns.name: 句末或跨行的 yourself／署名式 yours
patterns.context: 短语或聊天文本末尾、标记或用户名附近；触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 主句中的强调或总结性词
patterns.context: 分别位于“it was time for…”，“Enough of woe…”，以及“trust in Him”中；词义与句法位置各异。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、诗歌、个人宗教叙述

patterns.name: 诗行或引文中的分词／短词片段
patterns.context: 诗歌排版或引文中，单词被分成多个 token；较强激活落在词的一部分。

patterns.name: IRC聊天中的对话衔接与语气标记
patterns.context: 聊天轮次中，问句、口语拼写或表情符号前后；主要激活也出现在行末附近的“*”。

en.concept: Deictic and introductory use of Here
en.description: Primarily activates on Here and its variants in deictic or introductory uses, often pointing to what follows or to the current discourse; also activates on IRC asterisk action markers, the chat spelling correction of an onomatopoeia, and “all yours” meaning handing something over.

patterns.name: Deictic/introductory use of Here
patterns.context: Here points to content, a location, or discourse presented next, at the start or within a sentence; includes “Here’s,” “from here,” “here is,” and Here before a character speaks.
patterns.domain: Email, forum comments, academic text, narrative literature

patterns.name: Asterisk action markers in IRC
patterns.context: Asterisks enclose actions or mark asterisked chat text in logs; activation falls on the asterisks or adjacent text.

patterns.name: Transfer and relinquishment of ownership
patterns.context: Offers to hand a project to someone else to take over, improve, and publish, with yours indicating delivery or relinquishment.

patterns.name: Informal onomatopoeia and spelling correction
patterns.context: In chat, colloquial onomatopoeia or spelling appears first, followed by an asterisk-marked correction.

5_2733.description: 主要对 Here 及其变体作指示性、引出性用法激活，常指向后文或当前话语；另对 IRC 星号动作标记、聊天中的拟声修正及表示交付的“all yours”激活。

patterns.name: Here 的指示/引出用法
patterns.context: 句首或句中用 here 指向接下来呈现的内容、位置或话语；包括 “Here’s”“from here”“here is”及人物说话前的 Here。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛评论、学术文本、叙事文学

patterns.name: IRC 中的星号动作标记
patterns.context: 聊天记录中星号用于包围动作或表示带星号的聊天文本；激活落在星号本身或紧邻文本。

patterns.name: 所有权转交与让渡
patterns.context: 提出把项目交给他人接手、完善和发布，以 yours 表示交付或让渡。

patterns.name: 非正式拟声与拼写修正
patterns.context: 聊天中先出现口语化的拟声/拼写，再用星号标示修正。

en.description: Activations are scattered across words and phrases such as Here, yours, and now on, as well as IRC asterisks, fictional narration, and email phrasing. There is no unified trigger pattern spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Locative/deictic use of Here
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, Here introduces a place, content, or what follows; it is sometimes preceded by a comma or line break.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “now on”
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence, From now on introduces a future action or manner of speaking.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “from here on out”
patterns.context: Means from this point onward when promising future action or continued provision of something.

patterns.name: Possession or attribution with yours
patterns.context: In a you/your context, indicates ownership or attribution; may refer to ownership of contract edits or handing a project over to someone.

patterns.name: Asterisks and abbreviations in IRC
patterns.context: Asterisk-enclosed action markers in chat logs, or an asterisk adjacent to the colloquial abbreviation am.

patterns.name: Negation and experiential endings after sermon
patterns.context: In fiction, discussion of having heard sermons and experience/ignorance; activations are distributed across a negation word and several word fragments.

patterns.name: Spirit/Man and sky imagery
patterns.context: A heading followed by text describing Manwe, the sky, and birds.

patterns.name: Plural and group narration
patterns.context: The narrator shifts from shared experience to speaking in the plural.

patterns.name: Yours and attribution of responsibility in email
patterns.context: Discusses draft edits, omitted markers, and attribution of responsibility.

patterns.name: Physical suffering and the soul
patterns.context: Juxtaposes bodily torment and the soul's suffering, then uses none to introduce an emphatic expression.

patterns.name: Uncertainty of judgment and introducing a quotation with Here
patterns.context: After discussing whether an academic question is solvable, Here introduces a full quotation.

patterns.name: Email request and project handoff
patterns.context: A conditional request for someone else to take over, improve, and release a project.

patterns.name: Colloquial spellings and action tone in IRC
patterns.context: Colloquial spellings, onomatopoeia/possible misspellings, and asterisked action markers in informal chat.

5_2733.description: 激活分散在 Here、yours、now on 等词句及 IRC 星号、小说叙述和邮件措辞上；没有覆盖全部片段的统一触发规律。

patterns.name: Here 的位置性/指示性用法
patterns.context: 句首或从句边界处用 Here 引出地点、内容或后文；有时前面带逗号或换行

patterns.name: now on 固定表达
patterns.context: 句首以 From now on 引出未来的行动或说话方式

patterns.name: from here on out 固定表达
patterns.context: 承诺未来将采取行动或继续提供某物时，表示从此以后

patterns.name: yours 所有权或归属
patterns.context: you/your 的语境中表示归属；可用于合同修改归属或把项目交给他人

patterns.name: IRC 中的星号与缩写
patterns.context: 聊天记录中星号包围的动作标记，或星号紧邻口语缩写 am

patterns.name: sermon 后的否定及经历词尾
patterns.context: 小说中谈论听过讲道与经验/无知，激活分布在否定词及若干词片段上

patterns.name: Spirit/Man 与天空意象
patterns.context: 标题及随后描写 Manwe、天空和飞鸟的文字

patterns.name: plural 及群体叙述
patterns.trigger: « our»1；« us»2；« From»5« now»9« on»4« I»1
patterns.context: 叙述者从共同经历转向以复数口吻发言

patterns.name: 邮件中的 yours 和责任归属
patterns.context: 讨论草稿修改、遗漏标记及责任归属

patterns.name: 身体痛苦与灵魂
patterns.trigger: « Physical»5« suffering»1；« the»3 torment« of»2« the»2« body»4；« none»9
patterns.context: 将身体折磨与灵魂受难并置，随后以 none 引出强调性表达

patterns.name: 判断不确定与 Here 引文引介
patterns.context: 讨论学术问题是否可解后，以 Here 引出完整引文

patterns.name: 邮件请求及项目交接
patterns.context: 提出由他人接手、完善并发布项目的条件性请求

patterns.name: IRC 口语拼写与动作语气
patterns.context: 非正式聊天中的口语拼写、拟声/可能的拼写错误及星号动作标记

en.description: Responds mainly to here and its word-boundary forms, commonly in from here, hereinafter/Heretofore, sentence-initial Here, and nowhere. Sporadic high activations also occur on asterisks, yours, shrug action markers, and dashes, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Strong activation on here
patterns.context: here itself is marked; it is often preceded by from ([4][6][9]), or occurs at a word boundary in forms such as hereinafter/Here tofore ([7]). It also appears as sentence-initial Here ([8]) and in the fixed expression nowhere ([1]).
patterns.domain: Various styles, including religious discourse, web/forum text, patents, fiction, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Sparse triggers unrelated to here
patterns.context: Activations fall on an asterisk in a time expression, a sentence-final possessive pronoun, an italic/action marker in IRC, and a dash in legal text; no shared local syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: IRC conversations, forum posts, instant messages, legal rulings

5_2733.concept: here/此处相关 token，兼有杂项
5_2733.description: 主要对 here 及其词形边界强响应，常见于 from here、hereinafter/Heretofore、句首 Here 和 nowhere；另有星号、yours、shrug 动作标记及破折号等零散高激活，缺乏统一语义模式。

patterns.name: here 强激活
patterns.context: here 本身被标记；前面常接 from（[4][6][9]），或出现在 hereinafter/Here tofore 一类词形边界（[7]），也有句首 Here（[8]）和固定短语 nowhere（[1]）。
patterns.domain: 跨宗教论述、网页/论坛、专利、小说、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 非 here 的稀疏触发
patterns.context: 激活分别落在时间表达中的星号、句末所有格代词、IRC 中的斜体/动作标记，以及法律文本中的破折号字符；未见共同的局部句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: IRC 对话、论坛留言、即时聊天、法律判决

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on here: it commonly appears in from here, also in the concatenated word nowhere (now+here) and the stage direction O, here she comes; back then also appears in a temporal recollection.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “from here”
patterns.context: “here” immediately follows “from”; it may be followed by on out, it is possible, you have to, or appear in narrative descriptions of movement or elaboration.
patterns.domain: Web text, fiction, Q&A, forums, and encyclopedia narration

patterns.name: Fixed expression “nowhere”
patterns.context: Now and here combine as nowhere in a rhetorical question about whether the Quran says something.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “nowhere”
patterns.context: Now and here combine as nowhere, followed by does the article say, indicating that the article does not mention an issue.
patterns.domain: Technical blog or forum article comment

patterns.name: “here” in a stage context
patterns.context: Standalone here appears in an address or cue, followed by a stage direction indicating that a character is about to appear; it does not contain from.

patterns.name: Past-time reference and recollection
patterns.context: Recollects a prior experience or level of knowledge; the preceding text discusses studying computer science during college.

5_2733.concept: here 的局部词形/短语特征
5_2733.description: 强激活主要落在 here：常见于 from here，也见于连写 nowhere（now+here）和戏剧提示语 O, here she comes；另有 back then 的时间回顾。

patterns.name: 固定表达“from here”
patterns.trigger: «from»5«here»9（有时中间有标点或标记，如 «From»4« here»9«,»4）
patterns.context: “here”紧接在“from”之后；后续可接 on out、it is possible、you have to，也可进入叙述中的地点移动或补充说明。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、小说、问答、论坛及百科叙述

patterns.name: 固定表达“nowhere”
patterns.context: Now 与 here 连写构成 nowhere，出现在关于《古兰经》是否说某事的反问语境中。

patterns.name: 固定表达“nowhere”
patterns.context: Now 与 here 连写构成 nowhere，后接 does the article say，表示文章中没有指出某问题。
patterns.domain: 技术博客或论坛文章评论

patterns.name: 舞台语境中的“here”
patterns.context: 独立的 here 位于呼唤或提示语中，后接人物即将出现的舞台指示；不含 from。

patterns.name: 过去时间指示与回顾
patterns.context: 回顾先前的经验或知识水平，前文谈及大学阶段学习计算机科学。

en.description: Strong activation centers on here: used with from to indicate departure from a place or point in time; combined with now in nowhere for emphasis of absence; or used alone at the start of a sentence to indicate discourse or introduce an opportunity. There is also an exceptional from in died from.

patterns.name: from here introducing what follows
patterns.context: The phrase occurs at the start of a sentence or clause, followed by a route, action, progress, or future plans; in [2], « it»1 immediately follows, and “from here” means departing from the current location.
patterns.domain: Narrative, explanatory text, forum comments, and web copy

patterns.name: Emphatic negation with Nowhere
patterns.context: The compound nowhere is followed by an auxiliary or predicate to emphasize that a claim or situation is entirely absent somewhere or in a text; common structure: “Nowhere does/is ...”.

patterns.name: Here as a discourse or deictic starting point
patterns.context: Here functions independently as a sentence-initial deictic, introducing the current statement or an opportunity; it is neither nowhere nor part of a fixed phrase with from.

patterns.name: From indicating cause of death
patterns.context: from introduces the injury or illness that caused a death; it does not contain here, and its activation form differs from the main pattern.

5_2733.description: 强激活集中于 here：与 from 连用表示从此处出发或从此刻起；与 now 合成 nowhere，强调绝无；也单独句首指示话语或引出机会。另有 died from 的 from 异例。

patterns.name: from here 局部引出后续
patterns.context: 短语位于句首或分句起始处，后接路线、行动、进展或未来安排；[2]紧接« it»1，「from here」表示从当前位置出发。
patterns.domain: 叙述、说明、论坛评论及网页文案

patterns.name: Nowhere 否定强调
patterns.context: 合写词 nowhere 后接助动词或谓语，用于强调某处/文本中绝无某种说法或情况；常见结构“Nowhere does/is ...”。
patterns.domain: 论辩、法律论述、在线评论

patterns.name: Here 作为话语或指示起点
patterns.context: Here 独立作句首指示词、引出当前发言或机会；不是 nowhere，也没有与 from 构成固定短语。

patterns.name: From 修饰死亡原因
patterns.context: from 引出死亡所由的伤情或病因；不含 here，激活形式与主模式不同。

en.description: Strong activation is mainly on here, especially in transition expressions such as From here and Now here, and also when Here introduces speech. Other examples include from now on, back then, and the patent term hereinafter, suggesting a response to expressions involving here/then for time, deixis, and discourse transitions.

patterns.name: Here followed by a locative or transitional phrase
patterns.context: here immediately follows From or Now, often as a sentence-initial transition; in one instance, Here introduces a character's speech.
patterns.domain: Narrative, exposition, legal discourse, religious texts

patterns.name: Continuation expressions with From here on
patterns.context: From here is followed by on or out, or introduces the next place, action, or judgment.

patterns.name: Future shift with From now on
patterns.context: A sentence-initial phrase marks a narrative or action change starting at the present moment.

patterns.name: Back then for temporal retrospection
patterns.context: Looks back at the past in contrast with the present state; it is not a here phrase.

patterns.name: Patent term hereinafter
patterns.context: Introduces an abbreviation or definition used later in a patent text.

5_2733.concept: 含 here 的篇章指示语
5_2733.description: 强激活主要集中于 here：尤其是 From here、Now here 等过渡表达，也包括 Here 引出发言；另有 from now on、back then 与专利术语 hereinafter，显示对含 here/then 的时间、指示及篇章转换表达的响应。

patterns.name: Here 后接位置或转折短语
patterns.context: here 紧接 From 或 Now，常作为句首过渡语；另有一次 Here 引出人物说话。
patterns.domain: 叙事、说明、法律论述、宗教文本

patterns.name: From here on 的延续表达
patterns.context: From here 后接 on、out，或引出接下来的地点／行动／判断。
patterns.domain: 网站介绍、论坛讨论、叙事

patterns.name: From now on 的未来转向
patterns.context: 句首短语标示从此刻起的叙述或行动变化。

patterns.name: 时间回顾用语 back then
patterns.context: 回顾过去，与现在的状态形成对照；并非 here 短语。

patterns.name: 专利术语 hereinafter
patterns.context: 专利文本中引入后文简称或定义。

en.description: Activations mainly target here and fixed expressions containing it, especially from here, hereinafter, and herein below. These respectively indicate a current location/starting point, define a term below, or refer to what follows. Also includes from now on and standalone here.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase from here
patterns.context: “from here” occurs contiguously or with only light punctuation between the words; it may be followed by expressions of direction, time, scope, or action.

patterns.name: Legal definition with hereinafter
patterns.context: hereinafter appears with definitional language such as “referred to as” to introduce a term.

patterns.name: Reference to below with herein
patterns.context: herein below appears near patent figures or terminology explanations, referring to what follows.

patterns.name: Here meaning this place or current situation
patterns.context: Standalone here refers to the current place, situation, or point in the discussion; surrounding contexts vary.

patterns.name: Time transition with from now on
patterns.context: A fixed time phrase meaning starting now; appears before the narrator changes their manner of expression.

5_2733.description: 主要对 here 及其构成的固定表达激活，尤强于 from here、hereinafter、herein below；这些表达分别表示当前位置/出发点、下文定义或下文指代。也包括 from now on 与单独 here。

patterns.name: 固定短语 from here
patterns.context: “from here”连续出现，或中间只隔少量标点；后面可接方向、时间、范围或动作表达。
patterns.domain: 一般说明、叙事、论坛文字

patterns.name: hereinafter 法律定义
patterns.context: hereinafter 与“referred to as”等定义措辞相连，用于引入术语。

patterns.name: herein 下文指代
patterns.context: herein below 出现在专利图示或术语说明附近，指向下文。

patterns.name: here 表示此处或当前情形
patterns.context: here 单独出现，指当前地点、情形或论述位置；周围语境各异。

patterns.name: from now on 时间转换
patterns.context: 固定时间短语，表示从现在起；出现在叙述者转换表达方式之前。

en.concept: here/where substrings and sporadic letter features
en.description: Activation mainly falls on locative words such as here/where or their substrings, including nowhere, anywhere, From here, hereinafter, and ordinary here. The accented letter í in Spanish así is another case, difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: nowhere split word
patterns.context: The where/here portion is activated; in segment 1 it occurs in “Anywhere,” and in segment 3 in sentence-initial “Nowhere in the Quran.” Both carry a negative or prohibitive sense, but their contextual structures differ.

patterns.name: From here phrase
patterns.context: here occurs in the sentence-initial locative or discourse-linking phrase “From here”; From is also activated.
patterns.domain: Accommodation descriptions, sports forums, plot narratives

patterns.name: here within a sentence
patterns.context: here occurs within a sentence: segments 5 and 6 contain ordinary adverbial here; in segment 7 it is embedded in the patent term “hereinafter,” with activation concentrated on the here portion.

patterns.name: Any where split word
patterns.context: In dialogue, anywhere is written as two tokens, with strong activation on where; this resembles the within-word split of anywhere in segment 1, but here the context is asking about a location.

patterns.name: Spanish así
patterns.context: Activation falls on the accented-letter token in the Spanish word así, with no evident English here/where context.

5_2733.concept: here/where 子串及零散字母特征
5_2733.description: 激活主要落在 here/where 一类位置词或其子串上，见于 nowhere、anywhere、From here、hereinafter 及普通 here；另有西班牙语 así 的重音字母 í，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: nowhere 拆分词
patterns.trigger: «here»10，前接未标记的“Anywhere, anytime, anyhow …without further”（第1段中实际为“anywhere”被拆成“ any”“where”）或“Now”“here”“ in”“the Quran”
patterns.context: 受激活的是 where/here 部分；第1段在“Anywhere”中，第3段为句首“Nowhere in the Quran”。两处都带否定或不允许意味，但上下文结构不同。

patterns.name: From here 短语
patterns.trigger: «From»…«here»，包括“From here it is possible”“From here you have to”“From here, the dozen travel”
patterns.context: here 出现在句首的方位或话语衔接短语“From here”中；From 本身也有激活。
patterns.domain: 住宿介绍、体育论坛、剧情叙述

patterns.name: 句中 here
patterns.trigger: «here»，如“here was a new variety”“here has the fascination”“hereinafter”
patterns.context: here 位于句中：第5、6段是普通副词 here；第7段则嵌在专利术语“hereinafter”中，激活集中于该词的 here 部分。
patterns.domain: 小说、医学论文、专利文本

patterns.name: Any where 拆分词
patterns.context: 对话中把 anywhere 拆写为两个 token，where 得到强激活；与第1段的 anywhere 词内分割相似，但语境是询问地点。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 así
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词 así 的重音字母 token 上，未见明显英语 here/where 语境。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语发言

en.description: Primarily responds to here, covering location, narrative progression, and reference to the current context; it also appears in patent here-compounds. The where in an anywhere parallel and the í in Spanish Así may be incidental patterns.

patterns.name: here indicating a location or current context
patterns.context: here refers to the current location, narrative position, or current discussion/research; “from here” can introduce subsequent action or development.
patterns.domain: General narrative, dialogue, travel descriptions, sports commentary, research texts

patterns.name: here-compound expressions in patents
patterns.context: In legal or patent writing, here is joined to a following word or forms part of a formal referring expression.

patterns.name: where in anywhere
patterns.context: Combines with any- to form an indefinite adverb and occurs in a parallel list emphasizing “any time, place, or manner.”

patterns.name: Spanish word-final fragment
patterns.context: In a Spanish passage, the marked token is the accented í in Así; it does not clearly match the English here pattern.

5_2733.description: 主要响应 here，涵盖地点、叙述推进及当前语境指示；也出现在专利 here-复合词。另有 anywhere 排比中的 where，以及西语 Así 的 í，可能是偶发模式。

patterns.name: here 指示位置或当前语境
patterns.trigger: «here»；包括“from here”“here was”“here in this aim”
patterns.context: here 指当前地点、叙述位置或当前讨论/研究；“from here”可引出后续行动或发展。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、对话、旅游介绍、体育评论、科研文本

patterns.name: 专利中的 here-复合表达
patterns.context: 法律或专利文体中，here 与后续词连写或构成正式指称表达。

patterns.name: anywhere 中的 where
patterns.context: 与 any- 构成泛指副词，并处于强调“任何时间、地点、方式”的排比中。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词尾片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语段落中，标记落在 Así 的重音 í 上；与英语 here 模式不明显相符。

en.description: Activation concentrates on boundaries within or at the ends of several words and phrases: here, where, mine, more, and the í in Spanish así. Diverse contexts share a local word-form or tokenization-boundary feature, but no unified semantics.

patterns.name: here within compound transition/linking expressions
patterns.context: here is highlighted, often in phrases such as now here, from here on/out/on, or from here you...; the surrounding words are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Web text, religious discourse, sports commentary, legal writing, Wikipedia entries, StackExchange

patterns.name: Spanish sentence-initial connector
patterns.context: The sentence-initial connector Así pues is followed by a comma and a negative expression; activation centers on the segmented í.

patterns.name: Open-ended indefinite pronoun/adverb ending
patterns.context: where combines with any- to form anywhere, followed by the parallel items anytime and anyhow; where is the main highlighted part.
patterns.domain: Quotations in web news or legal reporting

patterns.name: Emphatic colloquial reflexive/possessive ending
patterns.context: mine is strongly emphasized in a rhetorical question, preceded by “my brethren” and a dash with a repeated correction.

patterns.name: Ending of a negative-frequency adverb
patterns.context: After Nevermore is segmented, more receives secondary activation; it occurs at the start of a poem and emphasizes that something will not happen again.

5_2733.description: 激活集中在若干词尾或短语内部的边界：here、where、mine、more，以及西班牙语 así 的 í。多种场景共享局部词形/分词边界特征，但没有统一语义。

patterns.name: 复合转折/承接词中间的 here
patterns.context: here 被高亮，常出现在 now here、from here on/out/on 或 from here you... 等短语中；前后词并不固定。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、宗教论述、体育评论、法律、维基条目、StackExchange

patterns.name: 西班牙语连接语起始
patterns.context: 句首连接语 Así pues 后接逗号和否定表达；激活集中在被拆分标记的 í。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语发言

patterns.name: 开放式不定代词/副词词尾
patterns.context: where 与 any- 组合构成 anywhere，后接并列的 anytime、anyhow；where 是主要高亮部分。
patterns.domain: 网页新闻或法律报道中的引语

patterns.name: 口语反身/所有格强调词尾
patterns.context: mine 在反问中被强烈强调，前有 my brethren 和破折号重复修正。

patterns.name: 否定频率副词的词尾
patterns.context: Nevermore 拆分后，more 获得次级激活；处于诗歌句首并强调不再发生。

en.description: Mainly responds to from in phrases such as “from here” and “from time to time”; it also activates on thee and mine in classical texts and him in religious contexts. These span multiple genres and cannot be fully reduced to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “from here” for transition or origin
patterns.context: The phrase indicates continuing, moving, or taking action from a current location, stage, or starting point; punctuation or a following direction word may intervene.
patterns.domain: Web narration, explanation, dialogue, and informal sports commentary

patterns.name: Temporal frequency phrase “from time to time”
patterns.context: A fixed time phrase meaning periodically or occasionally; in passage 1, the highest activation falls on the first “time”.

patterns.name: Second-person object pronoun in classical poetry
patterns.context: Appears in a lyric poem as an address to or object referring to a person being missed; connected to the surrounding “I think of …” construction.

patterns.name: Pronoun “him” in a religious context
patterns.context: Refers to Christ or the Son of God in religious expressions about death, resurrection, glory, and related themes.

patterns.name: Emphatic possessive in classical narrative
patterns.context: Reasserts ownership in a rhetorical question (“mine?”) and appears next to kinship terms such as “my brethren”.

5_2733.description: 主要响应“from here”及“from time to time”等from短语中的from；另在古典文本的thee、mine和宗教语境的him上激活，涵盖多种文体，不能完全归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: “from here”转移或起始表达
patterns.context: 短语表示从当前位置、阶段或出发点继续、移动或采取行动；中间可有标点或后续方向词。
patterns.domain: 网页叙述、说明、对话及非正式体育评论

patterns.name: “from time to time”时间频率短语
patterns.context: 固定时间短语表示周期性或不时发生；第1段的最高激活落在第一次“time”。

patterns.name: 古典诗歌中的第二人称宾格
patterns.context: 出现在抒情诗中，作为对所思念之人的称呼或宾语；与周围的“I think of …”句式相连。

patterns.name: 宗教语境中的代词“him”
patterns.context: 指向基督或上帝之子，处于死亡、复起、荣耀等宗教表述中。
patterns.domain: 基督教灵修或神学文字

patterns.name: 古典叙事中的强调性所有格
patterns.context: 以反问形式重申归属（“mine?”），并紧邻“my brethren”等亲属称呼。

en.description: Activation centers on expressions that advance or delimit discourse (Now, Here, Later, then, as far as), and also includes emotionally marked personal pronouns. A common feature is the prominence of common function words in specific syntactic positions and discourse transitions.

patterns.name: Now opening discourse or a transition
patterns.context: Occurs at a sentence or discourse transition/progression point, followed by a comma, then continued exposition or a shift to new information.

patterns.name: Pronouns and intimate forms of address
patterns.context: First- and second-person pronouns are emphasized in poetry, dramatized dialogue, or religious narrative, often conveying intimacy, emotion, or possession.
patterns.domain: Victorian poetry (2); fictional dialogue (4); Christian testimony (5)

patterns.name: Here introducing the current location or speech
patterns.context: here occurs near the start of a sentence and refers to the current argument or scene; in 6 it shifts the argument to scripture, and in 8 it shifts the narrative to a character's speech.

patterns.name: Temporal marker Later in a title
patterns.context: Appears in a table of contents or title, indicating a subsequent attempt.

patterns.name: Adverbial then introducing a subsequent result
patterns.context: After a condition or hypothesis, then introduces a result that will occur; here, the preceding text describes someone potentially being blown off a mountain by the wind if they do not resist.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase far as
patterns.context: In a sports discussion, “as far as” limits the scope of the topic, followed by trapping and on-ball defense.

5_2733.description: 激活集中在语境中的话语推进或限定表达（Now、Here、Later、then、as far as），也见情感性人称代词；共同点偏向常见功能词在特定句法位置及语篇转接中的突出。

patterns.name: Now 开启话语或转折
patterns.context: 句首或话语中的转折/推进位置，后接逗号，随后继续陈述或转向新信息。
patterns.domain: 法律庭审陈述（1）；小说对话（3）

patterns.name: 代词与亲密称呼
patterns.context: 第一、第二人称代词在诗歌、戏剧化对话或宗教性叙述中受到强调，常带亲密、情感或所有关系语气。
patterns.domain: 维多利亚诗歌（2）；小说对话（4）；基督教见证（5）

patterns.name: Here 引出当前位置或发言
patterns.context: here 位于句首附近，指当前论述/场景位置；6中为论辩转入经文，8中为叙事转入人物发言。

patterns.name: Later 标题中的时间标记
patterns.context: 出现在章节目录或标题中，表示后续发生的尝试。

patterns.name: 副词 then 表示后续结果
patterns.context: 条件或假设之后，then 引出将发生的结果；此处前文描述若不抵抗便可能被风吹下山。

patterns.name: far as 固定搭配
patterns.context: 体育讨论中以“as far as”限定话题范围，后接 trapping 和 on-ball defense。

en.description: Activation is distributed across different items: Later as a marker of what follows, the fixed phrase from time to time, the preposition in with a pronoun, and pronouns or location words such as mine, home, him, and thee. The contexts, styles, and meanings do not form a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Later as a temporal adverb
patterns.context: At the start of a paragraph or sentence, it narrates subsequent events, learning experiences, or plans; it also appears as a chapter title in a table of contents.
patterns.domain: Book tables of contents, narrative prose, Hacker News posts

patterns.name: time in an interval expression
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed expression “from time to time,” meaning intermittently or regularly.

patterns.name: Preposition in adjacent to a personal pronoun
patterns.context: In the religious expression “in him,” it means through or within someone.

patterns.name: Emphasis on possessive mine
patterns.context: Immediately follows “my brethren--” and uses a rhetorical question to emphasize family or community belonging.

patterns.name: home as a location
patterns.context: Paired with “at” and contrasted with “in colonies,” referring to home as a location.

patterns.name: him in an emotional and mourning context
patterns.context: After “grieving him,” the text describes his breakdown; the pronoun refers to the person being mourned.

patterns.name: Second-person objective thee
patterns.context: Serves as the object of “think of” in a poetic line, referring to an intimate person.

5_2733.concept: 无法概括的词项/短语偏好
5_2733.description: 激活分散在不同词项上：Later 作后续标记、固定短语 from time to time、介词 in 与代词搭配，以及 mine、home、him、thee 等代词或地点词。各处语境、文体与语义并不统一。

patterns.name: Later 作时间副词
patterns.context: 段首或句首，叙述后续事件、学习经历或计划；在目录中也作章节标题。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、叙事散文、Hacker News 帖子

patterns.name: 时间间隔表达中的 time
patterns.context: 出现在固定表达“from time to time”中，表示不时、定期发生。

patterns.name: 与人称代词相邻的介词 in
patterns.context: “in him”宗教表达中，指借由或处于某人之中。

patterns.name: 所有格 mine 的强调
patterns.context: 紧接“my brethren--”，以反问形式强调亲属或共同体归属。

patterns.name: home 表地点
patterns.context: 与“at”搭配，和“in colonies”并列，表示家中这一地点。

patterns.name: 情绪与哀悼语境中的 him
patterns.context: “grieving him”之后接描述其崩溃，代词指被哀悼的人。

patterns.name: 第二人称宾格 thee
patterns.context: 诗句中作为“think of”的宾语，指亲密对象。

en.description: Activation is distributed across common words such as pronouns, prepositions, temporal and locative words, and conjunctions. A few segments involve intimate forms of address, table-of-contents headings, recollection, project progress, or sensory description in a quotation. There is no stable, unified trigger pattern across contexts.

patterns.name: First- and second-person pronouns and demonstratives
patterns.context: Activation is stronger when personal pronouns or direct forms of address appear; sometimes they immediately follow a preposition or verb. The actual trigger words vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Cross-genre: literature, religion, interviews, news quotations, emails, and explanatory text

patterns.name: Locative and temporal expressions
patterns.context: Activation occurs on prepositions or temporal and locative adverbs; it is especially noticeable in phrases such as “from here on out,” “at home,” and “from time to time,” but there is no consistent fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Narrative and explanatory text across genres

patterns.name: Discourse connectors and common function words
patterns.context: Occurs when connecting sentences or adding supplementary, contrasting, or progressive information; some words appear in only one segment.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, religious writing, and everyday explanations

patterns.name: Intimate forms of address in literary or religious contexts
patterns.context: Someone or God is addressed in an intimate or prayer-like tone; activation falls on the form of address, pronouns, and surrounding function words.
patterns.domain: Historical fiction or poetry, Christian writing

patterns.name: Titles and chapter structure
patterns.context: Occurs near table-of-contents-style or chapter titles and ending-chapter markers; this segment also contains “Georgia,” a word without clear activation.
patterns.domain: Book tables of contents or historical narrative

patterns.name: Recollection and past time
patterns.context: Looks back at the past and contrasts it with the current situation, as in “back then (and still...).”

patterns.name: Time progression and future plans
patterns.context: Discusses a period that has already passed, upcoming work, or future progress.

patterns.name: Sensory description and identification in a quotation
patterns.context: A book-review quotation uses second person to describe a reader's sensory experience, with “too” adding agreement.

patterns.name: Rare proper nouns or structural fragments
patterns.context: Roman numeral section markers are interspersed with lines of poetry; the section marker itself shows no clear strong activation.

patterns.name: Rare word forms and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: Includes hyphenated word forms, a sentence-initial capitalized preposition, or “Beside” split by a subword fragment; these local activations have no shared semantic cue.
patterns.domain: Medical history paper, business email, web text

5_2733.description: 激活分散在代词、介词与时间方位词、连接词等常见词上；少数段涉及亲密称谓、目录标题、回忆、项目进展或引语感官描写。不同语境间缺乏稳定统一的触发模式。

patterns.name: 第一、第二人称与指示词
patterns.context: 在人称代词或直接称呼出现时较强；有时紧接在前置词或动词之后。各例的实际触发词并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 跨文体：文学、宗教、访谈、新闻引语、邮件及说明文字

patterns.name: 方位与时间表达
patterns.context: 介词或时间、方位副词处出现激活；在短语“from here on out”“at home”“from time to time”等中尤其明显，但没有一致的固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 跨文体叙述与说明文字

patterns.name: 篇章连接和常见功能词
patterns.context: 连接句子或补充、转折、递进信息时出现，部分词只在单段出现。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、宗教文字及日常说明

patterns.name: 文学或宗教语境中的亲密称谓
patterns.context: 以亲密或祈祷式口吻称呼他人或神；激活落在称谓、代词及周围功能词上。
patterns.domain: 历史小说或诗歌、基督教文字

patterns.name: 标题和章节结构
patterns.context: 出现在目录式或章节标题、结尾章节标记附近；本段另有“Georgia”等未明显激活词。

patterns.name: 回忆与过去时间
patterns.context: 回顾过去并与当前状况对照，见“back then (and still...)”。

patterns.name: 时间进展与未来安排
patterns.context: 谈及已经过去的阶段、即将到来的工作或未来进展。

patterns.name: 引语中的感官描写与认同
patterns.context: 书评引语以读者第二人称描述感官体验，并由“too”补充认同。

patterns.name: 少见专名或结构性碎片
patterns.context: 诗歌段落中罗马数字分节标记与诗句交错；分节符本身未显示明确强激活。

patterns.name: 少见词形与标点邻接
patterns.context: 涉及连字符词形、句首大写介词，或被分词片段切开的“Beside”；这些局部激活缺少共同语义线索。
patterns.domain: 医学史论文、商务邮件、网页文本

en.concept: Varied uses of common function words
en.description: Activations are scattered across first-person reference, pronominal prepositional phrases, and adverbs or temporal expressions such as now, far, so, then, again, time, and Later. They occur across literary, religious, legal, sports, and everyday texts, with no single stable semantic pattern or register.

patterns.name: First person and self-reference
patterns.context: First-person pronouns appear in narration, inner monologue, or direct speech, often near emotion, relationships, or self-emphasis, though not in every passage.
patterns.domain: Fiction, poetry, religious texts, and online writing

patterns.name: Pronominal objects and “in” phrases
patterns.context: A preposition is followed by a pronoun, describing attribution, participation, or a state; passage 3 is in Christian discourse, while passage 7 narrates personal feelings.

patterns.name: Temporal or transitional adverb now
patterns.context: “Now” appears mid-sentence, followed by a quotation or explanation; in both examples in this set, the word itself is marked.

patterns.name: Emphatic degree or result words
patterns.context: Emphasizes degree, result, or recurrence in sports tactics and descriptions of the natural environment; the triggering words differ.

patterns.name: Temporal interval expression
patterns.context: A fixed phrase meaning intermittent recurrence; the surrounding text discusses caring for a sourdough starter.

patterns.name: Later in headings and directory-style text
patterns.context: In a chapter heading or table-of-contents entry, “Later” introduces a subsequent event.
patterns.domain: Book contents, historical or biographical text

5_2733.concept: 常见功能词的多样用法
5_2733.description: 激活散见于第一人称指称、代词介词短语及 now、far、so、then、again、time、Later 等副词或时间表达；跨文学、宗教、法律、体育与日常文本，未见单一稳定语义或文体。

patterns.name: 第一人称与自我指称
patterns.context: 第一人称代词在叙述、内心独白或直接引语中出现；常与情绪、关系或自我强调相邻，但并非每段都如此。
patterns.domain: 小说、诗歌、宗教文本及网络文字

patterns.name: 代词性宾语与“in”短语
patterns.context: 介词后接代词，描述归属、参与或状态；第3段处于基督教论述中，第7段为个人感受叙述。

patterns.name: 时间或转折副词 now
patterns.context: 句中出现“Now”，后接引语或说明；本组两例都标在该词上。
patterns.domain: 法律庭审陈述、小说对话

patterns.name: 强调性程度或结果词
patterns.context: 在运动战术、自然环境叙述中，强调程度、结果或重新发生；触发词各异。

patterns.name: 时间间隔表达
patterns.context: 固定短语中表示间歇性重复，周围谈及照料酵种。
patterns.domain: 日常生活、饮食相关文字

patterns.name: 标题与目录式文字中的 Later
patterns.context: 章节标题或目录条目中，以“Later”引出后续事件。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、历史或传记文本

en.concept: Personal reference words and a few other items
en.description: Activation is mainly distributed across personal pronouns referring to specific people, especially me, my, you, and him. There are also two isolated cases—Later Attempts in a table-of-contents heading and home in a medical history context—with no evident shared context.

patterns.name: me/my/you as personal reference
patterns.context: Activation occurs when first-, second-, or third-person pronouns refer to specific people; it often appears in emotional, direct-address, or interpersonal contexts, but the surrounding words vary.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including religious prose, lyric poetry, personal narrative, commentary, and technical discussion

patterns.name: Later Attempt in a chapter title
patterns.context: Part of a title phrase in a table of contents or chapter heading; nearby titles may include chapter names, people, or place names.
patterns.domain: Book table of contents or historical text

patterns.name: home in medical history
patterns.context: Paired with “at home and in colonies,” discussing medical professionalization, medical monopolies, and their effects at home and in the colonies.

5_2733.concept: 人称指称词及少数词项
5_2733.description: 激活主要分布在指向具体人物的人称代词处，尤以 me、my、you、him 为主；另有目录标题中的 Later Attempts 与医学史语境中的 home 两个孤例，未见明显共同上下文。

patterns.name: me/my/you 作为人称指称
patterns.context: 在第一、第二或第三人称代词指向具体人物时激活；多出现在情感、直接称呼或人物关系语境中，周围词语并不固定。
patterns.domain: 宗教散文、抒情诗、个人叙述、评论及技术讨论等多种文体

patterns.name: 章节标题中的 Later Attempt
patterns.context: 目录或章节标题中，作为标题短语的一部分；标题周围还出现章节名、人物名或地点名。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录或历史性文本

patterns.name: 医学史中的 home
patterns.context: 与“at home and in colonies”并列，讨论医学专业化、医疗垄断及其在国内和殖民地的影响。

en.description: Activations are not uniform: multiple passages fall on first-person me/my/mine in self-reference or emphasis; others occur on words in far as and from time to time, and on home in at home. These belong to different collocations and contexts.

patterns.name: Emphatic or object use of the personal pronoun me
patterns.context: In first-person narration, the pronoun appears in emphatic, emotional, or self-referential positions; also includes speaking to others, religious narration, and general personal accounts.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase far as
patterns.context: The fixed collocation “as far as” limits the scope of a judgment; passage 6 contains the same collocation but with weaker activation.

patterns.name: Time word time
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed phrase “from time to time”, meaning occasionally or repeatedly.
patterns.domain: Everyday blog about caring for a sourdough starter

patterns.name: Location/place word home
patterns.context: Forms “at home” with “at” and is paired with “in colonies”, referring to locations covered by medicalized action.
patterns.domain: Medical history or public health academic discussion

5_2733.description: 激活分布不统一：多段落在第一人称 me/my/mine 的自我指涉或强调处；另有 far as、from time to time 中的词，以及 at home 的 home，分属不同搭配与语境。

patterns.name: 人称代词 me 的强调或宾语用法
patterns.trigger: «me»、«Me»，以及围绕其出现的所有格/复数形式 «my»、«mine»
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中，代词处于强调、情感表达或自我指涉位置；也包括对他人说话、宗教叙述和一般个人叙事。
patterns.domain: 文学、宗教、个人博客/论坛文本

patterns.name: 介词短语 far as
patterns.context: 固定搭配“as far as”，用于限定判断范围；段6也有同一搭配但激活较弱。

patterns.name: 时间词 time
patterns.context: 出现在“from time to time”这一表示偶尔、反复发生的固定短语中。
patterns.domain: 日常博客，谈论照料酵种

patterns.name: 方位/场所 home
patterns.context: 与“at”构成“at home”，并与“in colonies”并列，表示医疗化行动覆盖的地点。
patterns.domain: 医学史或公共卫生学术论述

en.description: Activates on multiple local cues: most prominently, pleaded in legal texts (especially pleaded guilty), oft in photosoft.* domain names, and the Exp/RegExp substring; also triggered by line breaks and formatting, code paths, name segmentation, and content from several specific webpages or cases.

patterns.name: Expand, Exp, and similar substrings
patterns.context: Occurs inside words or proper names, especially at word-initial capitalized fragments; examples include the segmentation of “Exponential,” “QRegExpValidator,” and “perspective.”

patterns.name: Legal phrase pleaded guilty
patterns.context: An admission-of-guilt expression in criminal judgments or accounts of legal facts; the word also activates in “pleaded not guilty” and in contradictory preceding or following judgment records.

patterns.name: Short domain suffix oft
patterns.context: In repeated “photosoft.[suffix]” strings, oft follows photos; followed by domain suffixes such as loan, biz, win, and club.

patterns.name: Line breaks and whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Multiple activations occur near line breaks, blank lines, or line-separated structures; often co-occurs with headings, lists, quotations, or webpage snippets, but is not a sufficient condition.
patterns.domain: Webpages, code, legal documents, and Q&A formatting

patterns.name: GitHub paths and gotest substring
patterns.context: In paths or repository identifiers, especially repeated gotestyourself; activations concentrate on the domain fragment and gotest.

patterns.name: binge eating in titles
patterns.context: A short title or podcast description includes a term related to an eating disorder, alongside a line break between title and body.

patterns.name: Segmentation within personal names
patterns.context: A personal name is split into multiple subword tokens; occurs in police reports or legal case accounts.

patterns.name: Web navigation and promotional copy
patterns.context: Web navigation links, section headings, and generic promotional language interspersed with line breaks.

patterns.name: Child pornography case descriptions
patterns.context: Legal documents describing related criminal facts and admitted charges.

patterns.name: Technical product descriptions
patterns.context: Webpage or product promotional copy describing a technical product growing or developing over the years.

patterns.name: Regular expression validator Q&A
patterns.context: A StackExchange question title or opening, containing a technical identifier.

patterns.name: Stun gun and confession accounts
patterns.context: A police press release recounts a suspect being stunned, surrendering, and confessing.

patterns.name: Ecstasy trafficking case
patterns.context: Case background in a legal document describes conspiracy and drug trafficking.

5_2830.concept: 局部字符串与排版线索
5_2830.description: 激活呈多种局部线索：最显著的是法律文本中的 pleaded（尤其 pleaded guilty）、域名 photosoft.* 中的 oft，以及 Exp/RegExp 子串；另受换行排版、代码路径、人名切分和若干特定网页或案件内容触发。

patterns.name: Expand、Exp 等子串
patterns.context: 出现在单词或专名内部，尤其是词首大小写片段；分别见于“Exponential”“QRegExpValidator”及“perspective”的切分。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、问答、网页标题

patterns.name: pleaded guilty 法律措辞
patterns.context: 刑事判决或法律事实叙述中，出现认罪表述；该词即使在“pleaded not guilty”与前后矛盾的判决记录中也会激活。

patterns.name: 短域名后缀 oft
patterns.context: 重复的“photosoft.[后缀]”字符串中，紧接 photos 后出现 oft；后接 loan、biz、win、club 等域名后缀。

patterns.name: 换行及空白排版
patterns.trigger: «↵»，以及标题或正文间的连续空行
patterns.context: 多段激活出现在换行、空行或分行结构附近；常与标题、列表、引文或网页片段共现，但并非充分条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、代码、法律文书及问答排版

patterns.name: GitHub 路径与 gotest 子串
patterns.context: 路径或仓库标识符中，尤其重复的 gotestyourself；激活集中于域名片段和 gotest。

patterns.name: 标题中的 binge eating
patterns.context: 短标题/播客简介中出现饮食障碍主题词，并伴随标题与正文的换行。

patterns.name: 人名内部切分
patterns.context: 人名被分成多个子词 token；出现在警务报道或法律案件叙述中。

patterns.name: 网页导航与宣传文案
patterns.trigger: “Follow via email”“Follow via RSS”“A Student’s Perspective”
patterns.context: 网页导航链接、栏目标题和通用宣传语交错，伴随换行。

patterns.name: 儿童色情案件描述
patterns.trigger: “use two fingers to spread open her labia”“child pornography”
patterns.context: 法律文书对相关犯罪事实及认罪罪名的描述。

patterns.name: 技术产品描述
patterns.context: 网页或产品宣传语描述逐年增长/发展的技术产品。

patterns.name: 正则表达式验证器问答
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题或提问开头，含技术类标识符。

patterns.name: 电击器及认罪叙述
patterns.context: 警方新闻稿转述嫌疑人被电击、投降并认罪。

patterns.name: Ecstasy 走私案件
patterns.context: 法律案件背景中描述共谋及毒品走私。

en.description: Activations are distributed across fragments such as Exp, pleaded, gotestyourself, Perspective, episode, and oft within domain names; many passages contain web or legal-document formatting and line breaks, but there is no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Exp word-form fragment
patterns.context: Exp appears at the beginning or within words, especially in the exponential-growth word “Exponential” and the validator name “RegExpValidator”; it also occurs with line breaks.

patterns.name: guilty in litigation text
patterns.context: In legal narratives, pleaded occurs with guilty, or the surrounding text mentions criminal charges, prosecution, or a guilty plea. Paragraph [7] contains pleaded, but it is followed by not guilty, with weaker activation, and appears in a court-document format.
patterns.domain: Criminal justice rulings or case narratives

patterns.name: gotestyourself URL fragment
patterns.context: gotestyourself occurs continuously in a GitHub path; the same list also contains a Docker API path.

patterns.name: Perspective in a webpage title
patterns.context: Appears in webpage text with navigation links and the title “A Student’s Perspective / More than words”.

patterns.name: Podcast episode title
patterns.context: Promotional sentence beginning “This podcast episode will…”; the title or topic is Binge Eating.

patterns.name: oft in a domain list
patterns.context: Repeated photosoft.<domain suffix> strings, separated by line breaks; activation falls on the oft character fragment within the URLs.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting markers
patterns.context: Many activation examples contain repeated line breaks, blank columns, or list formatting; however, these markers are not the strongest trigger in each passage and often co-occur with specific word fragments.
patterns.domain: Various formats, including webpages, code, and legal documents

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 激活分散在 Exp、pleaded、gotestyourself、Perspective、episode、域名内 oft 等片段上；多段带网页或法律文档排版和换行，但没有统一语义触发。

patterns.name: Exp 词形片段
patterns.context: Exp 出现在词首或词内，尤其是指数级增长词“Exponential”和验证器名称“RegExpValidator”中；也伴随换行。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传文案、StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 诉讼文本中的 guilty
patterns.context: 法律叙述中 pleaded 与 guilty 连用，或周围出现刑事指控、起诉、认罪等内容。第[7]段虽有 pleaded，但后接 not guilty，激活较弱，且出现在法院文件格式中。
patterns.domain: 刑事司法判决或案件叙述

patterns.name: gotestyourself URL 片段
patterns.context: GitHub 路径中连续出现 gotestyourself；同一列表另有 Docker API 路径。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库或文件路径列表

patterns.name: 网页标题中的 Perspective
patterns.context: 出现在带导航链接和标题的网页文本中，标题为“A Student’s Perspective / More than words”。

patterns.name: 播客节目标题
patterns.context: “This podcast episode will…”的宣传式句子，标题或主题为 Binge Eating。
patterns.domain: 播客或健康主题网页文案

patterns.name: 域名列表中的 oft
patterns.context: 重复的 photosoft.<域名后缀> 字符串，每项以换行分隔；激活落在网址中间的 oft 字符片段。

patterns.name: 换行与排版标记
patterns.context: 多处激活数据含重复换行、空白列或列表式排版；但这些标记并非各段最强触发，且常与特定词片段共现。
patterns.domain: 网页、代码、法律文件等多种格式

en.concept: Structured text boundaries and distinctive word forms
en.description: Activations occur in titles and labels, names and plea wording in legal text, structured paths and domain lists, chemical formulas, and encyclopedia name-disambiguation formats; several passages are also sensitive to consecutive line breaks after titles or lists. The commonality is primarily text structure and local distinctive word forms, not a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Standalone headings or labels in passages
patterns.context: Before the main text begins, a title, section name, or question heading appears on its own line, often followed by a blank line; activation concentrates on specific word fragments within the heading.
patterns.domain: Web article titles, podcast titles, StackExchange question titles and section names

patterns.name: Names and conventional phrases in legal documents
patterns.context: Names are split into subword fragments; in legal narratives, the phrase pleaded guilty to is followed by a specific crime or charge.

patterns.name: Structured identifiers, paths, and domain lists
patterns.context: URLs, repository paths, or multiple domain suffixes for the same name are listed consecutively; delimiters and line breaks create a clear list format.

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and variable ranges
patterns.context: Headings and body text contain element chemical formulas with subscripts and variable ranges expressed as inequalities.
patterns.domain: Materials science and nanocatalysis paper abstracts

patterns.name: Name-disambiguation list format
patterns.context: A name is followed by may refer to: and a list of people or entities with the same name; spelling fragments within the name also activate.

patterns.name: Line breaks and whitespace after headings
patterns.context: Several samples contain consecutive line breaks after headings, labels, or list items; the line breaks themselves activate, but not equally clearly in every passage.

5_2830.concept: 结构化文本边界与特殊词形
5_2830.description: 激活分布于标题和标签、法律中的人名及认罪措辞、结构化路径与域名清单、化学式，以及百科人名消歧格式；多段还对标题或列表后的连续换行敏感。共同点主要是文本结构与局部特殊词形，难归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 段落中的独立标题或标签
patterns.context: 在正文开始前，标题、栏目名或问题标题以独立行出现，常有后续空行；激活集中在标题内部的特定词片段。
patterns.domain: 网页文章标题、播客标题、StackExchange 问题标题及栏目名

patterns.name: 姓名及法律文书中的惯用短语
patterns.context: 姓名被拆分成词片段；在法律叙述中，短语 pleaded guilty to 后接具体罪名或指控。

patterns.name: 结构化标识符、路径与域名清单
patterns.context: 连续列举 URL、仓库路径或同一名称的多个域名后缀；分隔符和换行构成明显的列表格式。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码路径、域名清单

patterns.name: 化学式与变量范围
patterns.context: 标题和正文出现带下标的元素化学式，以及用不等式描述的变量范围。
patterns.domain: 材料科学与纳米催化论文摘要

patterns.name: 人名消歧列表格式
patterns.trigger: Humphrey Lloyd may refer to:、« Ll»w«yd»
patterns.context: 人名后接 may refer to:，引出同名对象列表；姓名内部的拼写片段也有激活。

patterns.name: 换行及标题后空白
patterns.context: 多个样本在标题、标签或名单项后出现连续换行；换行本身有激活，但并非所有段落都同样明显。

en.description: Activations span vehicles and driving technology, synchronization in two technical contexts, fragmentary words in titles or phrases, and lists of domain suffixes; there is no clear shared semantic theme, though vehicle passages are the most concentrated.

patterns.name: Vehicles and driving
patterns.context: Introductory statements about vehicles, driving, in-vehicle equipment, or vehicle safety systems; mostly patent background or technical text.
