patterns.domain: Vehicle and transportation technology, patent background

patterns.name: Synchronization or bilateral synchronization
patterns.context: Describes bilateral synchronization of EEG discharges, or propagation delay differences in a synchronous (clock) circuit.

patterns.name: Fragmentary activation on specific words
patterns.context: A word within a complete word or phrase is split into consecutive tokens; occurs in title, growth-description, and podcast-title contexts.
patterns.domain: Entertainment titles, business descriptions, podcast copy

patterns.name: Domain lists and suffixes
patterns.context: Lists available domain extensions, repeatedly using the same domain stem with different suffixes.

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 激活分布于车辆与驾驶技术、两种技术语境中的同步，以及标题或短语的片段式词语和域名后缀列表；没有明显统一语义，车辆段最集中。

patterns.name: 车辆及驾驶
patterns.context: 车辆、驾驶、车载设备或车辆安全系统的介绍性陈述；多为专利背景或技术文本。
patterns.domain: 车辆与交通技术、专利背景

patterns.name: 同步或双侧同步
patterns.context: 描述 EEG 放电的双侧同步，或同步（时钟）电路中的传播延迟差异。
patterns.domain: 神经电生理、电子电路技术

patterns.name: 特定词语的片段式激活
patterns.context: 在完整词或短语中，词语被拆成连续 token；分别处于标题、增长描述和播客标题语境。
patterns.domain: 娱乐标题、商业描述、播客文案

patterns.name: 域名列表与后缀
patterns.context: 列举可用域名扩展时，重复出现同一域名主体及不同后缀。

en.description: Activations concentrate in automotive and vehicle-technology contexts (1, 2, 3, 5), while other hits are scattered across domain lists, neuroscience, crime news, film titles, and website copy; these passages do not exhibit a clear shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Vehicle-related wording
patterns.context: Sentences discuss vehicles, driving, or control-input devices installed in vehicles; triggers may appear in component tokens of related terms, such as “Autom”+“obile” and “Work”+“ vehicles”.
patterns.domain: Patent background and automotive or vehicle-technology abstracts

patterns.name: Repeated URL directory text
patterns.context: The same string recurs in a list separated by line breaks, with different suffixes listed item by item.

patterns.name: Neuroanatomical terminology
patterns.context: At the beginning of an academic title or abstract about trigeminal nerve projections and synaptic connections.

patterns.name: Names and criminal-case wording
patterns.context: News accounts mention police, a Taser, surrender, or criminal charges; a name appears multiple times, and related phrases can independently be strong triggers.

patterns.name: Film-title-style phrase
patterns.context: A work title is set in quotation marks, followed by the title-like phrase “Comes Back From the Dead”.

patterns.name: Website name and branding text
patterns.context: Webpage text mentions that a particular website’s logo has been finalized.

patterns.name: Story title and exponential-growth statement
patterns.context: “Our Story” appears as a heading, followed by a description of year-over-year exponential growth since 2011.
patterns.domain: Website introduction or corporate promotional copy

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 激活集中在汽车与车辆技术语境（1、2、3、5），但其余命中分散于域名列表、神经科学、犯罪新闻、影视标题和网站文案；这些段落未呈现共同的明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 车辆相关措辞
patterns.trigger: “vehicles are used over a wide range”; “vehicles include a collision avoidance system”; “Automobile driving”; “Work vehicles”; “operator input devices”
patterns.context: 句子谈到车辆、汽车驾驶或车辆配备的操作输入设备；触发可出现在相关术语的组成 token 中，如 “Autom”+“obile”、“Work”+“ vehicles”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与汽车、车辆技术摘要

patterns.name: 重复网址目录文本
patterns.trigger: 重复的 “photosoft.”，后接 “club”“online”“vip”“wang”“mobi”“site”“bid”“men” 等域名后缀
patterns.context: 换行分隔的列表中反复出现相同字符串，并逐项列出不同后缀。

patterns.name: 神经解剖学术语
patterns.trigger: “Projection and synaptic connectivity of trigeminal …”中的 “Projection”及“synaptic connectivity”
patterns.context: 在关于三叉神经投射和突触连接的学术标题或摘要开头。

patterns.name: 人名与刑事案件措辞
patterns.context: 新闻叙述警察、泰瑟枪、投案或刑事指控；人名在文本中多次出现，相关短语可单独成为强触发点。

patterns.name: 影视标题式短语
patterns.context: 以引号标出作品名，后接带标题感的“Comes Back From the Dead”。

patterns.name: 网站名称与标识文本
patterns.context: 网页文字提及特定网站的 logo 已确定。

patterns.name: 故事标题与指数增长表述
patterns.context: “Our Story”作为标题，随后介绍自2011年以来逐年指数增长。
patterns.domain: 网站介绍或企业宣传文案

en.description: Activations occur across several vehicle phrases, proper names or split words, synchronous in two distinct contexts, and isolated number sequences and quoted text; vehicle phrases are most concentrated, while the other patterns lack a shared semantic cue.

patterns.name: vehicles subword
patterns.context: Activations cluster around vehicles and its preceding modifiers; combinations include Many, Work, and Two wheel.
patterns.domain: Patent background, vehicles and work vehicles

patterns.name: Bromus name
patterns.context: The botanical Latin name Bromus madritensis is split into subwords, followed by a line break and another occurrence of Bromus.

patterns.name: Synchronous seizure EEG terminology
patterns.context: Describes bilateral synchronous interictal EEG discharges that persist after corpus callosotomy.

patterns.name: synchronous attribute in code
patterns.context: A method declaration in XML-style code has a synchronous attribute.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and BE/Y string
patterns.context: Activations occur around quotation marks, an English phrase, and the segmented spelling BEAUTY; both appear in the same passage, but their association is unclear.

patterns.name: Boeing brand name
patterns.context: Boeing is split into subwords, followed by a news-style sentence requesting that U.S. authorities allow something.

patterns.name: Numeric sequence
patterns.context: A continuous string of digits is followed by a line break and a math problem; the meaning of the digit sequence itself is unclear.

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 激活出现在多类车辆短语、若干专名或拆分词、两种不同语境的 synchronous，以及孤立数列和引号文本；车辆词组最集中，其余模式缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: vehicles 子词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 vehicles 及其前置限定语附近；有 Many、Work、Two wheel 等不同搭配。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，车辆与工作车辆

patterns.name: Bromus 名称
patterns.context: 植物学拉丁学名 Bromus madritensis 按子词拆分，名称后换行并再次出现 Bromus。

patterns.name: 同步发作 EEG 用语
patterns.context: 描述胼胝体切开后仍出现的双侧同步发作间期 EEG 放电。

patterns.name: 代码中的 synchronous 属性
patterns.context: XML 样式代码中，方法声明带有 synchronous 属性。

patterns.name: 引号与 BE／Y 字符串
patterns.context: 激活分布在引号、英文短语和分段拼写的 BEAUTY 周围，二者同段出现，关联不明。

patterns.name: Boeing 品牌名称
patterns.context: Boeing 被拆分为子词，后接请求美国当局允许某事的新闻式句子。

patterns.name: 数值序列
patterns.context: 一串连续数字后换行并出现数学问题；数字序列本身的含义不明。

en.description: Primarily responds to “You/you” in license texts that state rights, restrictions, or instructions for obtaining a copy; also responds to asterisks and line-break formatting in license notes and disclaimer terminology. It additionally activates on the forum interface phrase “You are currently viewing” and the title “Something There”; the latter two are of unclear relation to the main pattern.

patterns.name: You in Apache license statements
patterns.context: In the Apache license header, after a grant of permission or license conditions, addresses the file user in the second person to state rights, restrictions, or how to obtain a copy of the license; «You» is especially prominent at the start of the copy-acquisition sentence.
patterns.domain: Apache license copyright headers in GitHub source files

patterns.name: You in GNU licenses
patterns.context: After a license disclaimer or explanation, the sentence “You should have received a copy …” tells readers that they should have received a copy.
patterns.domain: GNU GPL disclaimers and license text in GitHub source files

patterns.name: There in a work title
patterns.context: The quoted work title “Something There,” followed by “in Herriman’s BE…”; activation falls on There within the title.
patterns.domain: Cultural or entertainment text in Pile-CC

patterns.name: You on forum pages
patterns.context: The site interface text “You are currently viewing all threads …” directly informs visitors about the current page state.
patterns.domain: Forum webpage interface/navigation text in Pile-CC

patterns.name: Fixed formatting and legal terminology in license text
patterns.context: In asterisks, line breaks, and formatting structures in legal disclaimers or license files; these markers co-occur with the You notice above, but there are also activations on formatting symbols and disclaimer wording.
patterns.domain: License comments and legal text in GitHub source code

5_2830.concept: 面向读者的第二人称告知语
5_2830.description: 主要在许可证文本向读者陈述权利、限制或提示获取副本时响应“You/you”，也响应许可证注释的星号换行格式及免责声明术语；另在论坛界面“You are currently viewing”及标题“Something There”中激活，后两者与主模式关系不明。

patterns.name: Apache 许可证声明中的 You
patterns.context: Apache 许可证头部中，许可授予或许可条件之后，以第二人称向文件使用者陈述权利、限制或如何获取许可证副本；«You» 在副本获取句开头尤其突出。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码文件中的 Apache 许可证版权头

patterns.name: GNU 许可证中的 You
patterns.context: 许可证免责声明或许可证说明之后，出现“You should have received a copy …”这一告知读者已应收到副本的句式。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码文件中的 GNU GPL 免责声明及许可证文本

patterns.name: 游戏作品名中的 There
patterns.context: 引号中的作品标题 “Something There”，且后接 “in Herriman’s BE…”；激活落在标题内的 There。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 中的文化或娱乐文本

patterns.name: 论坛页面中的 You
patterns.context: 站点界面文字“You are currently viewing all threads …”中，直接向访问者说明当前页面状态。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 中的论坛网页界面/导航文本

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的固定格式与法律术语
patterns.context: 法律免责声明或许可证文件的星号注释行、换行和排版框架中；这些标记与上述 You 告知句共同出现，但此处也对格式符号及免责声明措辞有激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码中的许可证注释和法律文本

en.description: All passages activate near second-person/user-directed expressions such as You or Who; the most stable pattern is You as the sentence-initial subject, followed by can, should, may, or are. License snippets recur, but the activation is not limited to license contexts.

patterns.name: You-led imperative-like clauses
patterns.context: Second-person You is the sentence-initial subject, introducing advice, ability, obligation, or a state; matches are not limited to a particular predicate.

patterns.name: You should in license disclaimer
patterns.context: In the asterisk-prefixed license comment lines at the end of a GNU GPL disclaimer.

patterns.name: You may after license terms
patterns.context: In Apache 2.0 license terms, explaining how to obtain a copy of the license.

patterns.name: You can in dialogue
patterns.context: Second-person statements directed at a reader or interlocutor; one discusses model deployment, another prediction difficulty.
patterns.domain: Github model descriptions, dynamic dialogue text

patterns.name: You in forum questions
patterns.context: A forum post invites participation and begins with an expression of willingness; strong activation falls on Who rather than You, possibly due to nearby text.

patterns.name: You are in page navigation
patterns.context: A forum page tells users what they are currently viewing.

5_2830.concept: 第二人称祈使与用户指向
5_2830.description: 所有段落都在 You 或 Who 等第二人称/面向用户表达附近激活；最稳定的是 You 作句首主语，后接 can、should、may、are。许可证片段重复出现，但同一激活并不限于许可证语境。

patterns.name: 祈使式 You 后续句
patterns.trigger: “You”分别处于“I/许可证说明”之后或对话中，后接“can”“should”“may”“are”等
patterns.context: 第二人称 You 作为句首主语，引出建议、能力、义务或状态；命中不局限于某种谓语
patterns.domain: 代码文档、对话、论坛文本

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明的 You should
patterns.context: GNU GPL 免责声明末尾，星号前缀的许可证注释行中

patterns.name: 许可证条款后的 You may
patterns.context: Apache 2.0 许可证条款中，说明可获取许可证副本

patterns.name: 对话中的 You can
patterns.trigger: “You can test and deploy”及“You can't always predict”
patterns.context: 面向读者或对话对象的第二人称陈述；一处谈模型部署，一处谈预测麻烦
patterns.domain: Github 模型说明、动态对话文本

patterns.name: 论坛提问中的 You
patterns.trigger: “Who will play along?”之前的“Who”以及其后的“I'll start”
patterns.context: 论坛帖子提出参与邀请并自愿开头；强激活落在 Who 而非 You，可能是邻近文本关联

patterns.name: 页面导航中的 You are
patterns.context: 论坛页面告知用户当前查看的内容

en.concept: which clauses and heterogeneous text markers
en.description: The most stable signal is which introducing a continuative clause in academic text; there are also sporadic activations on questions, code comments, mathematical symbols and LaTeX, optimization discussions, open-question titles, percentages, and several term fragments.

patterns.name: which relative clauses
patterns.context: which introduces a non-restrictive or explanatory clause that continues the preceding statement; occurs mid-sentence or sentence-initially.

patterns.name: Questions introduced by interrogative words
patterns.context: An interrogative word appears in a question title or direct question, followed by the question content.
patterns.domain: Book titles, academic paper question lists

patterns.name: Code comment prefix
patterns.context: At the beginning of a code line, followed by a natural-language comment.

patterns.name: Vertical bar in mathematical set notation
patterns.context: Appears in set-builder notation, indicating a condition or separating a condition.

patterns.name: LaTeX alignment environment in equations
patterns.context: The aligned environment and its labels and symbol commands in mathematical equations.

patterns.name: Statements about uncertainty and maxima
patterns.context: Discusses the global maximum of an optimization objective, iterative search, and its limitations.

patterns.name: Open-question titles
patterns.context: A title marks a question to be discussed below.

patterns.name: Percentage values
patterns.context: Percentages and nearby numbers occur in quantitative results descriptions.

patterns.name: Substrings within technical terms
patterns.context: A local fragment inside a word is marked, with no consistent syntactic function observed.

patterns.name: Ordinary words at activation boundaries
patterns.context: Marks occur on proper names, title words, or ordinary body-text words, with no clear shared condition.

5_2830.concept: which从句及异质文本标记
5_2830.description: 最稳定的信号是学术文本中 which 引出的承接性从句；另对问句、代码注释、数学符号与 LaTeX、优化讨论、开放问题标题、百分数和若干术语片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: which 关系从句
patterns.context: which 引出非限制性或解释性从句，承接前文陈述；出现在句中或句首

patterns.name: 疑问词引导的问题
patterns.context: 疑问词出现在问题标题或直接提问中，后续为问句内容
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、学术论文的问题列表

patterns.name: 代码注释起始符
patterns.context: 位于代码行开头，后接自然语言注释

patterns.name: 数学集合符号竖线
patterns.context: 出现在集合构造式中，表示满足条件或分隔条件

patterns.name: 公式中的 LaTeX 对齐环境
patterns.context: 数学公式的 aligned 环境及其标签、符号命令

patterns.name: 不确定性与最大值相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论优化目标的全局最大值、迭代搜索及其局限

patterns.name: 开放问题标题
patterns.context: 以标题标示后续待讨论的问题

patterns.name: 百分比数值
patterns.context: 百分数及其邻近数字出现在定量结果叙述中

patterns.name: 专业术语内部子串
patterns.context: 单词内部局部片段被标记，未见一致的句法功能

patterns.name: 激活边界处的普通词语
patterns.context: 标记分布在专名、标题词或普通正文词上，未显示明确共同条件

en.description: The signal is dispersed: the strongest occurrences of “together” are in two abstracts; the rest involve formula symbols, specific terminology, or medical/chemical descriptions, with no clear shared semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Combination or whole formation expressed by “together”
patterns.context: Occurs after multiple factors, components, or objects of comparison, connecting them to content they jointly form, evaluate, or compare; activation is strongest in two passages.

patterns.name: Minus sign in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in a tunneling-rate formula, with the minus sign inside an exponent or fraction; may be related to mathematical formatting.

patterns.name: Ion exposure and altered synaptic plasticity
patterns.context: A hyphen links experimental exposure to an altered biological outcome, in a description of changes in synaptic plasticity.

patterns.name: Comparison of ECG results with prior reports
patterns.context: A relative pronoun introduces previously published findings, which are compared with ECG results from the current case.

patterns.name: Immunoliposomes
patterns.context: Listed alongside microorganisms and plant tissue cultures as one source for discovering anti-Candida drugs.

patterns.name: Field operator expression
patterns.context: Appears in a field-operator formula containing up/down arrows and a summation, marking the Hermitian conjugate operator.

patterns.name: Gel/emulsion formation in liquid-liquid extraction
patterns.context: A slash lists two types of formation to avoid, in the context of liquid-liquid extraction and immiscible liquids.

patterns.name: Gut commensal bacteria
patterns.context: Describes enterococci as commensals in the gastrointestinal tract that are usually less pathogenic.

patterns.name: Hyperalgesia-related findings
patterns.context: Appears alongside “allodynia,” describing pain abnormalities associated with nerve injury or inflammation and an experimental hypothesis.

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 信号分散：最强的“together”出现在两篇摘要；其余涉及公式符号、特定术语或医学/化学描述，缺少共同的明确语义触发模式。

patterns.name: “together”结构要求的组合或整体形成
patterns.context: 出现在多个因素、组成部分或比较对象之后，连接它们共同形成、评价或比较的内容；在两段中激活最强。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、PubMed 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 数学公式中的负号
patterns.context: 出现在隧穿率公式中，负号位于指数或分式表达式内；该信号可能与数学排版有关。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、LaTeX 数学文本

patterns.name: 离子暴露与改变的突触可塑性
patterns.context: 连字符连接实验暴露与改变的生物学结果，处于对突触可塑性变化的描述中。

patterns.name: 心电图结果与既往报告的比较
patterns.context: 关系代词引出已发表的既往发现，并与当前病例的心电图结果进行比较。

patterns.name: 免疫脂质体
patterns.context: 作为发现抗念珠菌药物的来源之一，与微生物和植物组织培养并列。

patterns.name: 场算符表达式
patterns.context: 出现在含上下箭头和求和的场算符公式中，标记厄米共轭算符。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、LaTeX 数学文本

patterns.name: 液液萃取中的凝胶/乳液形成
patterns.context: 斜线并列两种需要避免的形成现象，语境为液液萃取及不互溶液体。

patterns.name: 肠道共生菌
patterns.context: 描述肠球菌是胃肠道内的共生生物，通常较少致病。

patterns.name: 痛觉过敏相关结果
patterns.context: 与“allodynia”并列，描述神经损伤或炎症相关的痛觉异常及实验假设。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on colons in academic text that introduce results, hypotheses, observations, or lists, often followed by numbering or items; also occurs on colons introducing formulas in mathematical text.

patterns.name: Colon after results or hypotheses
patterns.context: In academic text, a colon introduces results, hypotheses, or a subsequent list; nearby numbering or parentheses are common, such as “1)” “(1)” or “a)”.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, NIH research proposals, and other academic texts

patterns.name: Colon and formula structure in mathematical formatting
patterns.context: In mathematical papers, the colon occurs in an explanatory or formula-introducing context, near LaTeX environments and structured equations.

5_2830.concept: 学术文本中的引出性冒号
5_2830.description: 激活主要集中在学术文本中引出结果、假设、观察或列举的冒号，常接编号或项目；另见数学文中引出公式的冒号。

patterns.name: 结果或假设后的冒号
patterns.trigger: “shown that:”（[1][2]）、“showed that:”（[3]）、“showing that:” （[4]）、“hypothesize:”或“hypothesized that … of:”（[5][6]）、“hypothesized that:” （[7]）、“show:” （[8]）、“observed:” （[10]）中的“:”
patterns.context: 学术文本中，冒号引出结果、假设或后续列举；相邻位置常有编号或括号，如“1)” “(1)”或“a)”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 研究计划及其他学术文本

patterns.name: 数学排版中的冒号及公式结构
patterns.context: 数学论文中，冒号处在解释或引出公式的语境，邻近 LaTeX 环境与结构化公式。

en.description: All snippets activate at the increment clause in a for-loop header. Trigger forms include ++ after a variable name, the closing parenthesis, and the opening brace of the loop body; languages, variable names, and loop contents vary.

patterns.name: Increment expression in a for loop
patterns.context: Appears in the header of a for loop in C/Java/C#-style code, where the loop variable is incremented and the loop body’s opening brace follows; different variable names and spacing formats can trigger it
patterns.domain: Iteration control structures in source code

5_2830.concept: for 循环递增子句
5_2830.description: 所有片段都在 for 循环头部的递增子句处激活，触发形式包括变量名后的 ++、右括号及循环体左花括号；语言、变量名和循环内容各异。

patterns.name: for 循环中的递增表达式
patterns.context: 出现在 C/Java/C# 等代码的 for 循环头部，循环变量递增并紧接循环体左花括号；不同变量名和空格格式均可触发
patterns.domain: 源代码中的迭代控制结构

en.concept: Code-structure punctuation and common continuation tokens
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on `++) {` after a code loop increment and on closing punctuation; other activations include English function words, `em` inside medical drug names, colons in Q&A, and sporadic parentheses/HTML tags. These do not form a consistent single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: C/C-like code loop closure
patterns.context: The closing parenthesis after a loop counter increment in code, often immediately followed by the opening brace of the loop body; these markers activate most strongly across multiple passages.
patterns.domain: C, C++, Java, and other code in Github/StackExchange

patterns.name: Colon in code
patterns.context: Occurs in the request-example lead-in `And your request looks like:` and triggers the strongest activation; colons in other snippets may also occur in code or quotation structures, but the evidence is weaker.

patterns.name: English prepositions and common conjunctions
patterns.context: Common English function words in academic abstracts or papers; activation is unstable, and it is difficult to distinguish them from code tokens with the same form.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment in tenofovir/emtricitabine
patterns.context: Occurs inside a drug name in medical text about HIV/HBV prevention or treatment.

patterns.name: Unexplained local code punctuation/parentheses
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across Python-compatible code and HTML examples, and cannot be reliably unified with the loop-closure pattern or English function-word pattern.

5_2830.concept: 代码结构标点与常见续接 token
5_2830.description: 强激活主要落在代码循环递增后的 `++) {` 及闭合标点；另有英语功能词、医学药名内部的 `em`、问答中的冒号和零散括号/HTML 标签激活，未形成一致的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: C/类 C 代码循环闭合
patterns.context: 代码中循环计数器递增后的闭括号，常紧接循环体左花括号；这些标记在多段中激活最强。
patterns.domain: Github/StackExchange 中的 C、C++、Java 等代码

patterns.name: 代码中的冒号
patterns.context: 出现在请求示例引导语 `And your request looks like:`，触发强度最高；其他片段中冒号也可能出现在代码或引文结构中，但证据较弱。

patterns.name: 英语介词及普通连接词
patterns.context: 学术摘要或论文叙述中的常见英语功能词；触发不稳定，且与代码中的同形 token 难以区分。

patterns.name: tenofovir/emtricitabine 药物名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HIV/HBV 预防或治疗的医学文本中，嵌在药物名内部。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 未解释的代码局部标点/括号
patterns.trigger: `hasattr(pd, 'Timestamp'):` 中的括号与冒号，以及 ``、`` 等标签闭合
patterns.context: 激活点散落于 Python 兼容代码和 HTML 示例中，无法与循环闭合模式或英语功能词模式可靠统一。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、StackExchange 网页示例

en.concept: Structural boundaries in code and formulas
en.description: Primarily responds to the closure of the `++)` increment expression in code, seen in six snippets; other high activations are scattered across OpenGL initialization, array assignment and release, iterative calculations, Python compatibility branches, and mathematical LaTeX formulas and questions.

patterns.name: C/C++ loop-increment syntax
patterns.context: At the end of the increment expression in a `for` loop header, usually immediately before the loop body’s `{` or a line break

patterns.name: Opening brace in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: A left brace used in a LaTeX mathematical expression to represent a set or piecewise structure

patterns.name: End of a LaTeX alignment environment
patterns.context: At the closing position of a mathematical formula alignment environment

patterns.name: LaTeX matrix-environment formatting symbols
patterns.context: Formula formatting and annotation displaying a transformed matrix equation

patterns.name: Problem introduction and mathematical question
patterns.context: States a condition on integer parameters and asks for an optimal constant
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper body text and formulas

patterns.name: GPU/OpenGL resource initialization
patterns.context: Creates texture and framebuffer objects consecutively, followed by loop and binding operations

patterns.name: Two-dimensional array flag assignment
patterns.context: Sets an element of a two-dimensional flag array to 1 when a condition holds within nested code blocks

patterns.name: C++ container iteration and recursive memory accounting
patterns.context: Iterates over a transaction-output container and accumulates recursive memory usage in the loop body

patterns.name: Java arrays and sectioned loops
patterns.context: Processes a byte array section by section after limiting the number of sections

patterns.name: Autocorrelation array loop
patterns.context: Iterates over sample data and accumulates autocorrelation results

patterns.name: Releasing a dynamic array
patterns.context: Iterates over the dictionary size and releases allocated array memory

patterns.name: Compatibility branch and Pandas timestamp
patterns.context: Checks whether an attribute exists, then selects a timestamp object for different versions

5_2830.concept: 代码与公式结构边界
5_2830.description: 主要响应代码中 for 循环递增式 `++)` 的闭合，见六段；其余高激活分散于 OpenGL 初始化、数组赋值与释放、迭代计算、Python 兼容分支，以及数学 LaTeX 公式和提问语句。

patterns.name: C/C++ 循环递增语法
patterns.context: 位于 `for` 循环头的递增表达式末尾，通常紧接循环体的 `{` 或换行

patterns.name: 数学公式中的左大括号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式中用左花括号表示集合或分段结构

patterns.name: LaTeX 对齐环境结束
patterns.context: 数学公式对齐环境的收尾位置

patterns.name: LaTeX 矩阵环境排版符号
patterns.context: 展示变换后矩阵方程的公式排版与标注

patterns.name: 问题引入与数学提问
patterns.trigger: `So, the following problem is quite natural:`、`Given a positive integer`、`what is the best constant`
patterns.context: 提出整数参数条件并询问最优常数

patterns.name: GPU/OpenGL 资源初始化
patterns.context: 连续创建纹理和帧缓冲对象，后接循环与绑定操作

patterns.name: 二维数组标志赋值
patterns.context: 嵌套代码块中条件成立时，将二维标志数组元素设为 1

patterns.name: C++ 容器迭代与递归内存统计
patterns.context: 遍历交易输出容器，并在循环体中累计递归内存量

patterns.name: Java 数组与分节循环
patterns.context: 限制分节数量后逐节处理字节数组

patterns.name: 自相关数组循环
patterns.context: 遍历样本数据并累加自相关计算结果

patterns.name: 释放动态数组
patterns.context: 循环遍历词典大小并释放已分配的数组内存
patterns.domain: 编程问答 C++ 代码

patterns.name: 兼容性分支与 Pandas 时间戳
patterns.context: 检查属性是否存在，再为不同版本选择时间戳对象

en.description: Activations cover code for-loop headers and the start of loop bodies, as well as mathematical LaTeX equation environments, lead-ins adjacent to equations, and lists; there is also one report of a medical prevalence range and one series summation. The trigger forms are not entirely uniform.

patterns.name: for loops and loop-body starts
patterns.context: In C/C++, Java, and other code, the loop body begins after a counter or iteration condition; activations often fall near “for,” the iterator variable, or the closing parenthesis.

patterns.name: LaTeX structural commands in mathematical environments
patterns.context: Near environment boundaries, alignment, or piecewise equation structures in displayed mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Formula transitions or introductions in mathematical text
patterns.context: Text before or after a formula introduces a test, condition, or example, adjacent to a displayed equation.

patterns.name: Expression of numerical or quantitative results
patterns.context: Reports prevalence estimates using ranges and percentages.

patterns.name: Listing a finite set of labels
patterns.context: Defines a finite set of labels and lists its members, then explains the label meanings or gives examples.

patterns.name: Summation series in English Q&A
patterns.context: Displays a series composed of powers or fractions, followed by a plain-language explanation.

5_2830.concept: 结构化表达边界与引入
5_2830.description: 激活涵盖代码 for 循环头及循环体起始，也涵盖数学 LaTeX 公式环境、公式邻接的引导语与列举；另有一例医学患病率区间报告和一例级数求和。不同触发形式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: for 循环及循环体起始
patterns.trigger: “for”以及循环头末尾的“++)”或“{”，尤其循环体前的“for (...) {”
patterns.context: 在 C/C++、Java 等代码中，循环计数或迭代条件后开始循环体；激活常落在“for”、迭代器变量或闭括号附近

patterns.name: 数学环境中的 LaTeX 结构命令
patterns.context: 数学展示公式的环境边界、对齐或分段公式结构附近
patterns.domain: 数学论文、问答中的 LaTeX

patterns.name: 数学文本中的公式转折或引入
patterns.context: 公式前后以文字引出检验、条件或示例，且与展示公式相邻

patterns.name: 数值或量化结果的表达
patterns.context: 以区间和百分比报告患病率估计

patterns.name: 有限标签集合的列举
patterns.context: 定义有限标签集并列出成员，随后说明标签含义或举例

patterns.name: 英文问答中的求和级数
patterns.context: 展示幂次或分数构成的级数，随后用口语文字解释

en.concept: Structural markers in academic text and code
en.description: Activations are scattered across common English function words in papers and derivation narratives, formulas and formatting markers, and code conditionals; there are also several isolated words. The triggers may reflect common text structures, but no single clear semantic topic is apparent.

patterns.name: Definite article and common following phrases
patterns.context: Occurs within noun or prepositional phrases in English prose; these words trigger in different passages, with no consistent specialized semantic condition
patterns.domain: Paper body text and general English

patterns.name: Connectives for methods or results in paper narratives
patterns.context: Academic prose introducing a derivation, method, solution, or conclusion

patterns.name: Punctuation, parentheses, and LaTeX structural markers
patterns.context: Near formulas, citations, paragraphs, or code blocks; activations are distributed across structural symbols and formatting markers

patterns.name: Conditional branches in code
patterns.context: Control-flow conditions and branch positions in program code

patterns.name: Other local words
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, and the snippets do not establish a shared triggering condition
patterns.domain: Academic papers, physics text, or program code

5_2830.concept: 学术文本与代码结构标记
5_2830.description: 激活分散在英语论文常见虚词与推导叙述、公式和排版标记，以及代码条件分支；另有若干孤立词项。各类触发可能反映常见文本结构，未见单一明确语义主题。

patterns.name: 定冠词及其后续常见搭配
patterns.context: 英语正文中位于名词短语或介词短语内；这些词在不同段落中分别触发，未显示统一的专门语义条件

patterns.name: 论文叙述中的方法或结果连接词
patterns.context: 介绍推导、方法、解或结论时出现的学术叙述

patterns.name: 标点、括号及 LaTeX 结构标记
patterns.context: 公式、引用、段落或代码块附近；激活分布在结构符号及格式标记上

patterns.name: 代码中的条件分支
patterns.context: 程序代码中控制流条件及其分支位置

patterns.name: 其余局部词项
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同语境，当前片段无法确认共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 学术论文、物理文本或程序代码

en.concept: Formulas and narrative structure in academic papers
en.description: Activations cluster around LaTeX formulas, numbering, and line breaks in ArXiv papers, and also occur in prose introducing conditions, conclusions, and examples; they involve terms from many fields and are difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Formula boundaries and line breaks in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Activations often occur near the boundaries of LaTeX mathematical formulas, numbering, or alignment environments; formulas on different topics show the same behavior.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and theoretical science papers

patterns.name: Specific connectives in academic prose
patterns.context: These words occur in the body of papers, introducing conclusions, conditions, formulas, or examples; trigger positions vary, making them difficult to group under a single lexical item.

patterns.name: Sentence-final colon before a mathematical formula
patterns.context: The colon occurs in academic prose, followed by label examples and mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Source-representation terminology in physics
patterns.context: The terms occur in descriptions of field equations containing source terms, near formula references.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase in a cosmology abstract
patterns.context: Occurs in an abstract describing the standard structure-formation paradigm; it is uncertain whether this is independent of the formula-typesetting pattern.

patterns.name: Curve-dynamics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses connections between curve motion and the mKdV and sine-Gordon equations.

patterns.name: Boundary-condition statements
patterns.context: Lists boundary positions and electric-field conditions, then introduces results and numbered formulas.

patterns.name: Example of a small label set in a formula
patterns.context: Introduces a finite label set and gives an example later; activations cluster around the labels and example.

patterns.name: Explanation of topological invariants
patterns.context: Explains a quantity on the right-hand side of a formula and the space it belongs to, adjacent to a numbered formula.

patterns.name: Local activations not sufficiently explained by shared lexical items
patterns.context: Appears as formula conditions in the respective papers; apart from formula typesetting and academic style, no stable shared semantic trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: Different branches of mathematics and science

5_2830.concept: 学术论文中的公式与叙述结构
5_2830.description: 激活主要聚集在 ArXiv 论文的 LaTeX 公式、编号与换行附近，也见于引出条件、结论和示例的正文；另涉及多种领域术语，难以归成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的公式边界与换行
patterns.context: 激活常出现在 LaTeX 数学公式、编号或对齐环境的边界附近；不同主题的公式都出现此现象。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论科学论文

patterns.name: 论文叙述中的特定连接词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在论文正文中，引出结论、条件、公式或示例；触发位置各异，难以归为单一词项。

patterns.name: 数学公式前的句末冒号
patterns.context: 冒号位于学术叙述中，后接标签示例及数学记号。
patterns.domain: 机器学习／序列标注论文

patterns.name: 物理领域的源表示术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在含源项的场方程说明中，附近有公式引用。

patterns.name: 宇宙学摘要中的介词短语
patterns.context: 出现在摘要中，描述标准结构形成范式；是否与公式排版模式独立不确定。

patterns.name: 曲线动力学相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论曲线运动与 mKdV、sine-Gordon 方程之间的联系。

patterns.name: 边界条件陈述
patterns.context: 列出边界位置及电场条件，随后引出结果和编号公式。

patterns.name: 公式中的小型标签集合示例
patterns.context: 介绍有限标签集，并在后文给出示例；激活集中在标记及示例附近。
patterns.domain: 机器学习／序列标注论文

patterns.name: 拓扑不变量解释
patterns.context: 解释公式右侧的量及其所属空间，紧邻编号公式。

patterns.name: 无法由共同词项充分解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 在各自论文中作为公式条件出现；除公式排版和学术文体外，未见稳定的共享语义触发因素。

en.description: Activations occur primarily in LaTeX mathematical formulas, environment markers, line breaks around formulas, and mathematical argumentation; they also cover that-clauses, physics vocabulary, figure references, and scattered English words. No single semantic topic accounts for all the variation.

patterns.name: LaTeX display math and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: Activations concentrate in mathematical expressions, formula environments, and surrounding line breaks or punctuation, often near the start of a formula or structural marker; however, most passages contain other local triggers as well, so this alone does not explain all activations.
patterns.domain: LaTeX text from ArXiv papers and math Q&A

patterns.name: that-introduced clauses
patterns.context: In English academic statements, that is followed by a result, inference, or clause; formulas or mathematical reasoning often occur nearby.

patterns.name: Alignment structure in formula environments
patterns.context: Structure of multiline or aligned formulas, especially at the beginning of a formula environment and near alignment symbols.

patterns.name: Specific vocabulary and phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall on several English words and phrases in the body text, including academic exposition, physics descriptions, and mathematical solutions; these words do not form a single stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Mathematical objects and notation
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols, variables, or operators occur in formulas and proof narratives; activation positions are not fixed to a single operation or object.

patterns.name: Figures and citation markers
patterns.context: Near structural paper text such as images, captions, figure numbers, or bibliographic citations.

patterns.name: Heading and table fragments
patterns.context: Extracted fragments that appear to come from headings or tables, with the original formatting incomplete.

5_2830.concept: 数学排版与论述文本
5_2830.description: 激活主要出现在LaTeX数学公式、环境标记、公式前后换行及数学论证文本中；也覆盖that从句、物理词汇、图表引用和零散英语词，未见单一语义主题能解释全部差异。

patterns.name: LaTeX数学展示与换行边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在数学表达式、公式环境及其前后换行或标点，常见于公式开头或结构标记附近；但多数段落中还有不同的局部触发，不能单独解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文及数学问答的LaTeX文本

patterns.name: that 引导从句
patterns.context: 英语学术陈述中 that 后接结果、推论或从句；周边常出现公式或数学论证。

patterns.name: 公式环境的对齐结构
patterns.context: 多行公式或对齐公式的环境结构，尤其是公式环境开头及对齐符号附近。

patterns.name: 特定词汇和短语
patterns.trigger: « boundary»、« at»、« value»、« electrons»、« proportion»、« gas»、« Hydrogen»、« maps»、« Then»、« general»
patterns.context: 激活落在正文中的若干英语词及短语上，包含学术论述、物理描述和数学解答；这些词未形成单一稳定语义类别。

patterns.name: 数学对象与记号
patterns.context: 数学符号、变量或算子出现在公式及证明叙述中，激活位置并不固定于一种运算或对象。

patterns.name: 图表与引用标记
patterns.context: 图像、图注、图号或文献引用等论文结构性文本附近。

patterns.name: 标题与表格残片
patterns.context: 疑似标题或表格文本的抽取残片，具体原始排版已不完整。

en.concept: Narrative text adjacent to mathematical formulas
en.description: The samples share mathematical text and formula typesetting. Activations often fall on explanatory transitions, condition descriptions, and LaTeX structural markers near formulas; specific triggers are sporadic, and the syntax and topics of different passages are not consistent.

patterns.name: Explanatory transitions after formulas
patterns.context: Ordinary English phrases connecting results, explanations, or subsequent formulas in mathematical derivations, especially prepositions or conjunctions such as that, in, as, and via.
patterns.domain: Explanatory text in mathematics papers and mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: that in mathematical text
patterns.context: Occurs in constructions such as “we show that,” “obtain that,” and “have that,” introducing a proposition or conclusion; activations fall on that in multiple contexts.

patterns.name: Introduction of boundary or interval conditions
patterns.context: Describes boundary, interval, or parameter conditions satisfied by mathematical objects, often near a formula or citation.
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, mathematical physics, and related papers

patterns.name: Specific LaTeX markers in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Activations occur near displayed formulas and their numbering or alignment structures; sometimes accompanied by textual transitions before or after the formula.

patterns.name: Small words, phrases, or local wording in mathematical contexts
patterns.context: Activations lie on local transitions or explanatory expressions in mathematical prose, but the specific syntax and meaning differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Mathematical texts in probability, analysis, physics, algebra, and other fields

patterns.name: Adjacency to special functions or symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur near complex formulas; there is insufficient evidence of a stable preference for any particular symbol or function.

5_2830.concept: 数学公式邻近的叙述文本
5_2830.description: 样本共同特点是数学文本及公式排版。激活多落在公式邻近的说明性衔接语、条件描述和 LaTeX 结构标记上；具体触发词分散，且不同段的句法与主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 公式后的解释性衔接语
patterns.trigger: “we show that”“we can obtain that”“we have that”“An explicit formula … is described in”“via the maps”
patterns.context: 数学公式推导中，连接结果、解释或后续公式的普通英文短语，尤其是 that、in、as、via 等介词/连词处。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答中的说明性文字

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 that
patterns.context: 出现在“we show that”“obtain that”“have that”等引出命题或结论的结构中；在多个上下文里激活落在 that。

patterns.name: 边界或区间条件的引出
patterns.context: 描述数学对象满足的边界、区间或参数条件，附近常接公式或引用。
patterns.domain: 数学分析、物理数学及相关论文

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定 LaTeX 标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在展示公式及其编号、对齐结构附近；其中有时伴随公式前后的文字衔接。
patterns.domain: 以 LaTeX 排版的数学论文

patterns.name: 数学语境中的小词、短语或局部措辞
patterns.trigger: “the law”“at some point”“in the case”“in terms of”“as follows”
patterns.context: 激活位于数学叙述的局部连接或说明性表达，但各段具体句法结构和含义不同。
patterns.domain: 概率、分析、物理及代数等数学文本

patterns.name: 特殊函数或符号表达式邻接
patterns.context: 复杂公式附近出现激活；未见足够证据表明对某一特定符号或函数有稳定偏好。

en.concept: Mathematical LaTeX structure and formula contexts
en.description: Primarily responds to structural boundaries in mathematical LaTeX text, formula environments, interval conditions, and phrases introducing conclusions; it also covers distinct mathematical content such as probability, special functions, physical boundaries, limits, and algebraic notation, with no single theme unifying them.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula environments and LaTeX structural symbols
patterns.context: At formulas, alignment environments, or boundaries between prose and formulas, activations concentrate on LaTeX control sequences and structural boundaries rather than a specific mathematical object.
patterns.domain: LaTeX text in mathematical papers and math Q&A

patterns.name: Relation and conclusion lead-ins
patterns.context: Phrases in mathematical statements that introduce a relation, derivation, or conclusion, usually adjacent to a formula.

patterns.name: Mathematical example markers
patterns.context: Identifies a specific parameter case or introduces an example, often followed by a formula.

patterns.name: Intervals and endpoint conditions
patterns.context: Specifies boundaries, intervals, or value ranges for a variable, often in piecewise arguments and boundary conditions.
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, mathematical physics, and probability-related text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula variables/operations
patterns.context: Variables, subscripts, powers, or equalities appear in formulas; mathematical objects differ across passages, with no consistent object-level trigger.

patterns.name: Bibliographic citations and section references
patterns.context: The body text cites references, propositions, or internal paper sections, often near formulas.

patterns.name: Specific physics abbreviations and limit contexts
patterns.context: Describes electromagnetic boundary conditions or a small-variable limit; only a few examples from different topics are present.

patterns.name: Total probability formula context
patterns.context: Mentions the law of total probability, followed by a recursive formula label.

patterns.name: Gamma-function special-case calculation
patterns.context: Moves from a generalized example to an integral expression for specified parameters.

patterns.name: Second derivative and specified intermediate point
patterns.context: An argument establishes the existence of a point within an interval, then discusses function values on a half-interval.

patterns.name: Exponential-decay limit
patterns.context: Gives an estimate of a power tending to zero as n increases under the condition «$x<1-\delta$».

patterns.name: High-energy algebra current-operator notation
patterns.context: Expresses generator relations of a quantum affine algebra using currents.

patterns.name: Poisson representation and solutions
patterns.context: Introduces a representation of solutions, together with conditions on the spatial domain.

patterns.name: Explicit coefficient formula
patterns.context: Describes polynomial coefficients and introduces an explicit formula for a matrix or quantity.

5_2830.concept: 数学 LaTeX 结构与公式语境
5_2830.description: 主要响应数学 LaTeX 文本的结构边界、公式环境、区间条件及结论引导语；同时覆盖多种彼此不同的数学内容，如概率、特殊函数、物理边界、极限与代数记号，未见单一主题统摄。

patterns.name: 数学公式环境与 LaTeX 结构符号
patterns.context: 公式、对齐环境或正文与公式之间的边界处，激活集中在 LaTeX 控制序列和结构边界，而非某个特定数学对象。
patterns.domain: 数学论文及数学问答中的 LaTeX 文本

patterns.name: 关系与结论引导语
patterns.context: 数学陈述中引出关系、推导或结论的正文短语；通常紧邻公式。

patterns.name: 数学例子标记
patterns.context: 指出特定参数情形或开启示例，常接着展示公式。

patterns.name: 区间及端点条件
patterns.context: 给变量规定边界、区间或取值范围，常出现在分段论证和边界条件中。
patterns.domain: 数学分析、物理数学及概率相关文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式中的变量/运算
patterns.context: 公式中出现变量、上下标、幂或等式；不同段的数学对象并不相同，未见统一的对象级触发条件。

patterns.name: 文献引用与章节指引
patterns.context: 正文引用文献、命题或论文内部章节；常位于公式前后。

patterns.name: 特定物理缩写与极限语境
patterns.context: 描述电磁边界条件或小变量极限；仅有少量不同主题实例。
patterns.domain: 电磁学与高能/粒子物理

patterns.name: 总概率公式语境
patterns.context: 提及全概率定律并接递归公式标签。

patterns.name: 伽马函数特例计算
patterns.context: 由一般化例子转到指定参数的积分表达式。
patterns.domain: 数学问答中的特殊函数计算

patterns.name: 二阶导数及指定中间点
patterns.context: 存在某个区间内点的论证，随后讨论半区间上的函数值。

patterns.name: 指数衰减极限
patterns.context: 在«$x<1-\delta$»条件下给出幂随 n 增大趋零的估计。

patterns.name: 高能代数流算子记号
patterns.context: 用 currents 表述量子仿射代数的生成关系。

patterns.name: Poisson 表示与解
patterns.context: 介绍解的表示方法，并伴随空间区域条件。

patterns.name: 显式系数公式
patterns.context: 说明多项式系数并引出矩阵或量的显式公式。

en.description: Activations cluster in ArXiv LaTeX mathematical text: after prose introduces or explains a result, it switches to a displayed formula, with backslash environment/label commands, math delimiters, and line breaks; some examples also involve citations or statements of prior results.

patterns.name: Highlighting commands in LaTeX math environments
patterns.context: Near mathematical formulas or derivations, especially when aligned or gathered environments begin after a line break, or when a formula is given a label; backslash commands occur alongside following braces, environment names, and related structures.
patterns.domain: LaTeX source code of ArXiv mathematics and theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: Prose lead-ins before formulas
patterns.context: The prose indicates that a conclusion, formula, or expression is to follow, then a comma, period, line break, or displayed formula appears; there is no fixed word, and the position is typically syntactic, introducing mathematical content.
patterns.domain: Main text of ArXiv academic papers

patterns.name: Assertions near citations
patterns.context: Discusses prior results or empirical observations, often near literature citations, and may be followed by a displayed formula.

patterns.name: Boundary between LaTeX math markers and prose
patterns.context: Inline or displayed math boundaries abut prose, often involving variables, parameters, or boundary conditions; these tokens have weak semantics in isolation.

patterns.name: Paragraph/line-break structure before displayed formulas
patterns.context: A prose paragraph ends or a new paragraph begins, followed immediately by a displayed formula, formula environment, or label; activations may also favor this layout structure.

patterns.name: Literature citations and academic statements after formulas
patterns.context: Citation parentheses occur in statements of prior results, theorems, or observations, sometimes near mathematical expressions; the specific field varies.

5_2830.concept: 学术公式排版边界
5_2830.description: 激活集中于 ArXiv LaTeX 数学文本：正文引出或说明结果后切换到展示公式，出现反斜杠环境/label 命令、数学分隔符和换行；部分例子还伴随引用或已有结果陈述。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境中的高亮命令
patterns.context: 数学公式或推导附近，尤其是换行后开始 aligned、gathered 等环境，或给公式添加 label；反斜杠命令与紧随其后的花括号、环境名等结构共同出现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论物理论文的 LaTeX 源码

patterns.name: 公式前的正文引导语
patterns.context: 正文说明某结论、公式或表达式将出现，随后接逗号、句号、换行或展示公式；并非固定单词，通常是引出数学内容的句法位置。

patterns.name: 引用附近的断言表达
patterns.context: 论述已有结果或经验观测，附近常有文献引用，随后可能接展示公式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文（数学、物理等）

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学标记与正文交界
patterns.context: 行内数学或展示数学的边界紧邻正文，内容常涉及变量、参数或边界条件；单独看这些 token 的语义较弱。

patterns.name: 行间公式前的段落/换行结构
patterns.context: 正文段落结束或转入新段后，紧接展示公式、公式环境或 label；激活也可能偏向这类版面结构。

patterns.name: 公式之后的文献引用与学术陈述
patterns.context: 引用括号位于已有结果、定理或观测的陈述中，有时靠近数学表达式；具体领域并不固定。

en.description: All passages are from ArXiv and contain mathematical formulas or LaTeX markers. Activations often occur near formula introductions, result statements, and formula environments, and are also scattered around domain-specific terminology and citations; no single triggering word can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Mathematical content following a formula or definition statement
patterns.context: Near a formula environment, alignment environment, or formula label when explaining, introducing, or reporting a mathematical formula; activated words include by, as, that, in, see, and others, but trigger positions and specific collocations are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical science papers; prose mixed with LaTeX formulas

patterns.name: Formula environments and formatting markers
patterns.context: Activations often occur near formula environments, alignment/grouping environments, labels, or example markers; many passages are followed immediately by a displayed formula.

patterns.name: Scattered responses to specific phrases and symbols
patterns.context: Beyond formula introductions and formatting, activations are scattered across domain-specific terminology, citation-adjacent text, and ordinary academic phrasing; these specific triggers have no obvious shared lexical pattern.
patterns.domain: Various ArXiv styles, including mathematics, physics, number theory, and academic citations

5_2830.concept: 学术数学公式语境
5_2830.description: 所有片段均来自 ArXiv，且都含数学公式或 LaTeX 标记。激活常见于公式引介、陈述结果及公式环境附近，也零散落在领域术语和引用周围；无法确认单一词项触发。

patterns.name: 陈述公式或定义后的数学内容
patterns.trigger: "coefficient of $x^a$ in« $»3f_i"；"formula for« $»3B"；"is given« by»1"；"can be written« as»1"；"they are« ("；"it is known« that»4"；"we can obtain« that»2"；"he»1 showed« that»3"
patterns.context: 在解释、引出或报告数学公式时，靠近公式环境、对齐环境或公式标签；涉及的激活词包括 by、as、that、in、see 等，但触发位置和具体搭配并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论科学论文；正文与 LaTeX 数学公式混排

patterns.name: 公式环境与排版标记
patterns.context: 激活常出现在公式环境、对齐/分组环境、标签或示例标记附近；不少段落在激活后紧接显示公式。

patterns.name: 特定短语与符号的零散响应
patterns.trigger: "in« Section»1"；"characteristic functions« in»1 space»3 and« energy»1"；"Regge« regime»1"；"q$-analogue"；"the PEC boundary"；"the square property"；"Ta»1uberian theorem"
patterns.context: 除公式引介与排版外，激活还散布于若干领域专属术语、引用附近和普通学术措辞中；这些具体触发项没有明显共同的词面模式。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、数论与学术引用等多种 ArXiv 文体

en.concept: LaTeX mathematical typesetting boundaries in papers
en.description: All passages come from ArXiv papers. Activations cluster in LaTeX formula blocks and their boundaries: mathematical environments, line breaks, alignment, labels, formula references, and explanatory text near formulas; there are also local patterns involving figure captions, quantum states, and domain terminology.

patterns.name: Start of a LaTeX math environment
patterns.context: At the start of a formula, derivation, or mathematical expression, often immediately following a line break and preceding an aligned environment; activations fall on mathematical markers, environment markers, or nearby tokens.
patterns.domain: LaTeX typesetting in ArXiv mathematics and science papers

patterns.name: Standalone formula numbers and labels
patterns.context: Numbered labels near formula blocks, followed by a line break and a formula environment.

patterns.name: Transition from theorem prose to a formula
patterns.context: After a theorem or exposition, the text transitions to a proof/derivation beginning with a displayed formula; these words are also activated.

patterns.name: Figure captions and figure references
patterns.context: Markdown-like image syntax, figure captions, or image filenames near mathematical formulas.
patterns.domain: Figure and table markers in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Mathematical relation markers in formulas
patterns.context: In scientific exposition before or after formulas, appears near parameter conditions, limits, equation explanations, or citation notes; triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Formula lead-in with citation
patterns.context: Introduces a specific theoretical case with a literature citation, then breaks to an aligned formula.

patterns.name: Quantum-state notation and quantum-number constraints
patterns.context: Angular-momentum state notation and quantum-number ranges, followed by a literature citation and formula.

patterns.name: Alignment and line breaks in multiline formulas
patterns.context: Within multiline aligned formulas, marks alignment points, formula-line endings, or unnumbered lines; activations include these typesetting markers.

patterns.name: Equation-number references
patterns.context: The prose refers to a previously numbered equation, followed by a figure marker or formula.

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: At line breaks between formulas, paragraphs, or structural text; occurs repeatedly across passages, with activation strength varying by context.

patterns.name: Generic mathematical symbols in formulas
patterns.context: Inside scientific formulas, adjacent to variables, differential operators, or terms; not a symbol specific to one field.

5_2830.concept: 论文LaTeX数学排版边界
5_2830.description: 所有片段均来自ArXiv论文，激活集中于LaTeX公式块及其边界：数学环境、换行、对齐、标签、公式引用和公式邻近的说明文字；另有图注、量子态及领域术语等局部模式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境起始
patterns.context: 公式、推导或数学表达式开始处，常紧接换行及 aligned 环境；激活落在数学标记、环境标记或其附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与科学论文的 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: 独立公式编号与标签
patterns.context: 公式块附近的编号标签，后接换行和公式环境。

patterns.name: 定理后的正文转入公式
patterns.context: 定理或论述文字之后转入证明／推导，并以展示公式开头；这些词本身也有激活。

patterns.name: 图注与图形引用
patterns.context: 数学公式邻近的 Markdown/类 Markdown 图片语法、图题或图文件名。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的图表标记

patterns.name: 公式中的数学关系标记
patterns.context: 在公式前后的科学论述中，出现在参数条件、极限、方程解释或引用说明附近；触发分布不完全一致。

patterns.name: 带引用的公式前置说明
patterns.context: 介绍特定理论情形并附文献引用，随后换行进入 aligned 公式。

patterns.name: 量子态符号与量子数约束
patterns.context: 角动量态符号及量子数范围，后跟文献引用和公式。

patterns.name: 多行公式中的对齐与换行
patterns.context: aligned 多行公式内部，标出对齐点、公式行结束或不编号；激活位置包括这些排版标记。

patterns.name: 方程编号引用
patterns.context: 正文中引用已编号方程，接着出现图形标记或公式。
patterns.domain: 科学论文 LaTeX 正文

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 公式、段落或结构性文本之间的换行处；多段反复出现，且激活强弱随上下文变化。

patterns.name: 公式内通用数学符号
patterns.context: 科学公式内部，邻近变量、微分算子或运算项；本身不是单一特定领域符号。

en.concept: Structural boundaries in code and academic formatting
en.description: Primarily responds to the start, line breaks, and structural boundaries of displayed mathematical formulas in LaTeX academic text; it also appears in graphics sizing syntax, formula alignment, and text labels within formulas. There are occasional activations in Python branches/return statements and Java exception blocks.

patterns.name: Start of displayed math in a formula environment
patterns.context: The trigger often occurs after a line break or where a paragraph transitions into a formula, especially at the beginning of displayed math; subsequent content may be an equation, definition, or derivation.

patterns.name: Structural markers before formulas
patterns.context: Appears between paper prose and a formula, figure, or example, serving as a line-break, numbering, or structural boundary; some activations fall on these markers.

patterns.name: LaTeX size and graphics-file syntax
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX code related to graphic dimensions or image files, especially near size parameters.

patterns.name: Alignment symbols in tables derived from formulas
patterns.context: Appears in multiline, multicolumn mathematical expressions; local strong activations fall on alignment symbols and formula content.

patterns.name: Section or theorem transitions in mathematical papers
patterns.context: The body text introduces a formula or argument after a theorem, example, or section description; activations occur across the text and the following formula boundary.

patterns.name: Branches and return statements in Python code
patterns.context: Appears in indented Python conditionals, including return expressions and type conversions.

patterns.name: Java exception-handling code
patterns.context: Appears in Java catch blocks and their comments, around exception types, variables, and code-block boundaries.

patterns.name: Small bold text and math-mode switching in LaTeX
patterns.context: A text label is bolded inside displayed math, followed by more mathematical expressions.

5_2830.concept: 代码与学术排版中的结构边界
5_2830.description: 主要响应 LaTeX 学术文本中显示数学公式的起始、换行和结构边界，也见于图形尺寸语法、公式对齐与公式内文字标签；另对 Python 分支/返回语句及 Java 异常块有零星激活。

patterns.name: 公式环境中的显示数学起始
patterns.context: 触发位置常在换行后或段落转入公式处，尤其是显示公式的开头；后续内容可为方程、定义或推导。
patterns.domain: 以 LaTeX 排版的学术论文

patterns.name: 公式前的结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文与公式、图示或示例之间，充当换行、编号或结构边界；部分激活落在这些标记上。

patterns.name: LaTeX 尺寸与图形文件语法
patterns.context: 出现在图形尺寸或图文件相关的 LaTeX 代码中，尤其是尺寸参数附近。
patterns.domain: 论文插图的 LaTeX 源码

patterns.name: 公式导出的表格对齐符号
patterns.context: 出现在分行、分列的数学表达式中；局部强激活落在对齐符和公式内容上。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的章节或定理衔接
patterns.context: 正文在定理、例子或章节说明后引出公式或论证；激活分布于文本和随后的公式边界。

patterns.name: Python 代码中的分支和返回语句
patterns.context: 出现在缩进的 Python 条件分支中，包含返回表达式及类型转换。

patterns.name: Java 异常处理代码
patterns.context: 出现在 Java 的 catch 块及其注释中，围绕异常类型、变量和代码块边界。

patterns.name: LaTeX 小型粗体文字与数学模式切换
patterns.context: 在显示公式内部用粗体标出文字标签，随后继续数学表达式。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文中的 LaTeX 公式

en.description: Strong activations mainly occur at boundaries in structured content: the start of LaTeX formulas or formula environments in papers, and line breaks and indentation in code; a possible commonality is that these mark mathematical or program structure.

patterns.name: Start of a formula or math environment
patterns.context: High activations often occur at the start of mathematical formulas, alignment environments, or formula labels, usually near LaTeX math symbols, variables, or theorem statements.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical papers

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in code blocks
patterns.context: Activations fall on line breaks in source code, especially inside if/else branches or statement blocks, with indentation and code punctuation nearby.

5_2830.concept: 结构化内容边界
5_2830.description: 强激活主要出现在结构化内容的边界：论文中的 LaTeX 公式或公式环境起始，以及代码中的换行和缩进位置；共同点可能是标记数学或程序结构的边界。

patterns.name: 公式或数学环境起始
patterns.context: 高激活常出现在数学公式、对齐环境或公式标签开始处，附近通常有 LaTeX 数学符号、变量或定理陈述。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 代码块中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: 激活落在源代码的换行处，尤其是 if/else 分支或语句块内部，前后有缩进和代码标点。

en.description: Strong activations occur mainly in academic text and LaTeX, especially at displayed-equation openings, equation labels, and nearby content. They also cover document-structure commands, equation lead-ins, and code control flow. Individual equation topics vary.

patterns.name: Inline or displayed equation opening
patterns.context: In LaTeX documents or academic prose, immediately before an equation opening, equation label, or mathematical expression; common after a line break.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and biomedical papers and their LaTeX source

patterns.name: Near equation labels and cross-references
patterns.context: Around numbers or labels for displayed equations, and references in the text to equations, sections, and figures or tables.

patterns.name: LaTeX document-structure commands
patterns.context: In the preamble or at the beginning or end of a paper’s source; may also occur between prose and equations.

patterns.name: Equation lead-ins or explanatory connectives
patterns.context: Academic prose introducing a definition, calculation step, or following equation, often immediately adjacent to a math environment.

patterns.name: Control flow or structural boundaries in code
patterns.context: Near control flow, null-pointer checks, or function calls in code; activations in this passage span syntax markers and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: Statistical notation and regression equations
patterns.context: The text introduces a logistic regression model and then transitions to its mathematical expression.

patterns.name: Rare mathematical prose symbols and inequalities
patterns.context: Displayed derivations of uncertainty relations and inequalities, with explanatory text before and after the equations.

patterns.name: Rare LaTeX figures and model equations
patterns.context: A figure marker is followed by a restricted Boltzmann machine equation.

patterns.name: Rare biomedical computational definitions
patterns.context: A methods section introduces the formula for calculating population doublings and includes LaTeX source snippets.

5_2830.concept: 学术公式与结构边界
5_2830.description: 强激活主要出现在学术文本与 LaTeX 中，尤其是陈列公式起始、公式标签及其邻近内容；也覆盖文档结构命令、公式引导语和代码控制流。个别公式主题各异。

patterns.name: 行间公式或陈列公式的起始
patterns.context: LaTeX 文档或学术正文中，紧接公式起始、公式标签或数学表达式；常见于换行之后。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学论文及其 LaTeX 源码

patterns.name: 公式标签与交叉引用附近
patterns.context: 陈列公式的编号或标签，以及正文对方程、章节、图表的引用周围。

patterns.name: LaTeX 文档结构命令
patterns.context: 论文源码的导言区或文档开始、结束位置；也可能混在正文与公式之间。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的 LaTeX 源码

patterns.name: 公式引导语或说明性连接词
patterns.trigger: «as follows»、«we can obtain that»、«the following inequalities hold true»
patterns.context: 学术文字引出定义、计算步骤或后续公式，常紧邻公式环境。

patterns.name: 代码中的控制流或结构边界
patterns.context: 代码行中控制流程、空指针判断或函数调用附近；本段激活分布在语法标记与邻近 token。
patterns.domain: C 代码及 Python 风格代码

patterns.name: 统计学符号与回归公式
patterns.context: 正文介绍 logistic 回归模型后，转入其数学表达式。

patterns.name: 稀有的数学正文符号与不等式
patterns.context: 不确定性关系及不等式的陈列推导，公式前后有解释性文本。

patterns.name: 稀有的 LaTeX 图示与模型公式
patterns.context: 插图标记及图后接续的受限玻尔兹曼机公式。

patterns.name: 稀有的生物医学计算定义
patterns.context: 实验方法段落引出群体倍增的计算公式，并夹杂 LaTeX 源码片段。

en.concept: Environment and block markers in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to displayed formula environments, formula citations, and surrounding typesetting markers in LaTeX academic text; also responds to paper-section prose, preamble configuration, scientific notation, and if statements, comments, and block structures in code patches.

patterns.name: LaTeX math environments and formula typesetting
patterns.context: In mathematics papers or scientific text, enters displayed formulas or array/alignment environments, often with line breaks and mathematical commands; activations often fall on environment commands or adjacent markers.
patterns.domain: LaTeX academic text from ArXiv and PubMed Central

patterns.name: Paper structure and section prose
patterns.context: The body introduces the organization of a paper, section locations, or references to sections, alongside section transitions and paragraph/line-break markers.

patterns.name: C/C++ conditional statements and code blocks
patterns.context: Conditionals, code-block endings, comments, and indentation occur in code or diffs; activations are distributed near statement keywords and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Formula lead-ins and derivation transitions
patterns.context: The academic prose first introduces a formula or result, then a displayed math environment follows; may also be adjacent to boundary conditions, citations, or model descriptions.
patterns.domain: ArXiv and PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: Section headings and formula-content cues
patterns.context: Short mathematical topic labels occur in aligned formulas, followed by parameter relations or formula terms.

patterns.name: LaTeX preamble and document start
patterns.context: The source-file preamble configures packages and layout before the document begins, then continues with array environments.

patterns.name: Formula references, figures, and scientific notation
patterns.context: Formula or figure references, model diagrams, and physical/mathematical notation occur where scientific paper prose connects to formulas.

5_2830.concept: 结构化文本中的环境与块标记
5_2830.description: 主要响应 LaTeX 学术文本中的显示公式环境、公式引述及其周边排版标记；另响应论文章节叙述、导言区配置、科学记号，以及代码补丁中的 if、注释和块结构。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境与公式排版
patterns.context: 数学论文或科学文本中进入显示公式、数组/对齐环境，常伴随换行及数学命令；激活常落在环境命令或相邻标记上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv、PubMed Central 的 LaTeX 学术文本

patterns.name: 论文结构与章节叙述
patterns.trigger: 「This article is organised as follows」「In the next section」「Section」
patterns.context: 正文介绍文章组织、章节位置或引用章节，伴随章节交接及段落/换行标记。

patterns.name: C/C++ 条件语句与代码块
patterns.context: 代码或 diff 中出现条件判断、代码块结束、注释及缩进；激活分布在语句关键字和格式标记附近。

patterns.name: 公式前的引述与推导衔接
patterns.context: 学术正文先引出公式或结果，随后接显示数学环境；也可能与边界条件、引用或模型说明相邻。

patterns.name: 章节标题与公式内容提示
patterns.context: 对齐公式中出现简短的数学主题标签，后接参数关系或公式项。

patterns.name: LaTeX 导言区与文档开始
patterns.context: 源文件导言区配置宏包、版面后开始正文，并继续排版数组环境。

patterns.name: 公式引用、图示及科学记号
patterns.context: 公式或图表引用、模型图示及物理/数学记号出现在科学论文正文与公式衔接处。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code and paper formatting: common around braces, block boundaries, conditional branches, and comments; they also cover initialization/return, linked lists, iterators, subscriptions, UI operations, and mathematical formula markers. The terminology heading in the second passage is relatively isolated.

patterns.name: Opening brace or code-block start
patterns.context: Near parentheses, block endings, or mathematical-environment boundaries; triggers may occur in code control flow, C++ declarations, and LaTeX math environments.

patterns.name: Conditional branch structure
patterns.context: At conditional checks and branch transitions in program code.

patterns.name: Code comment markers
patterns.context: At the beginning or end of a comment, often adjacent to a code-initialization explanation or inline note.

patterns.name: str initialization/close calls
patterns.context: Code snippets involving string-object initialization, condition checks, and closing.

patterns.name: Hirshfeld terminology and section heading
patterns.context: Near the term “Hirshfeld surface analysis” and its section heading.

patterns.name: Return values and initialization notes
patterns.context: A hardware detection function checks and returns a result, followed by an initialization comment.

patterns.name: Linked-list release condition
patterns.context: A memory-management branch that removes a linked-list node based on whether adjacent blocks are free.

patterns.name: Iterator type declaration
patterns.context: A template iterator struct and its type-alias declaration.

patterns.name: Partial differential equations and boundary annotations
patterns.context: Piecewise equations containing derivatives, parameters, and boundary conditions.

patterns.name: Inequalities and vector notation
patterns.context: Aligned mathematical inequalities containing vector inner products and maxima.

patterns.name: Stream subscription and error handling
patterns.context: A stream is published after subscribing to a flow object, or execution enters an error-handling branch.

patterns.name: UI highlighting and style calls
patterns.context: A file is selected and a line highlighted in a file-editing interface, followed by setting the editor style.

5_2830.concept: 结构边界与控制语法
5_2830.description: 激活分散于代码与论文排版：常见于花括号、块边界、条件分支和注释，也覆盖初始化/返回、链表、迭代器、订阅、界面操作及数学公式标记；第2段的术语标题较孤立。

patterns.name: 左花括号或代码块开始
patterns.context: 括号、块结束或数学环境边界附近；触发可落在代码控制流、C++ 声明及 LaTeX 数学环境中

patterns.name: 条件分支结构
patterns.context: 程序代码中条件判断及分支转换处

patterns.name: 代码注释标记
patterns.context: 注释开始或结束，常邻接代码初始化说明或行内说明

patterns.name: str 初始化/关闭调用
patterns.context: 字符串对象初始化、条件检查及关闭的代码片段

patterns.name: Hirshfeld 术语与章节标题
patterns.context: 术语“Hirshfeld surface analysis”及其章节标题附近

patterns.name: 返回值与初始化说明
patterns.context: 硬件探测函数中检查并返回结果，随后出现初始化注释

patterns.name: 链表释放条件
patterns.context: 根据相邻块是否空闲进行链表移除的内存管理分支

patterns.name: 迭代器类型声明
patterns.context: 模板迭代器结构体及其类型别名声明

patterns.name: 偏微分方程与边界标注
patterns.context: 分段书写含导数、参数和边界条件的方程

patterns.name: 不等式与向量记号
patterns.context: 对齐展示含向量内积及最大值的数学不等式

patterns.name: 流订阅与错误处理
patterns.context: 订阅流程对象后发布流，或进入错误处理分支

patterns.name: 界面高亮与样式调用
patterns.context: 文件编辑界面选中文件并高亮行，随后设置编辑器样式

en.description: Primarily sensitive to else in code conditional branches and its boundary formatting; also responds consistently to alignment, line breaks, and labels in multi-line LaTeX equations. Other activations are scattered across pointer syntax, calls, frontend markup, and local syntax in physics equations across languages.

patterns.name: else branch entry
patterns.context: The alternative branch begins after a conditional branch closes; activation concentrates on `else` and adjacent spaces, parentheses, braces, and line breaks, appearing across multiple languages.

patterns.name: Line breaks and line endings in LaTeX alignment environments
patterns.context: Near line-initial alignment symbols or end-of-line break markers in multi-line layouts such as aligned; activations also involve line breaks and equation delimiters.

patterns.name: LaTeX equation labels
patterns.context: A label appears immediately after an equation line or aligned line in an equation or equation environment.

patterns.name: C pointer dereferencing and field access
patterns.context: C code accesses struct members through pointers, in conditional checks or register-configuration logic; co-occurs with or is adjacent to the else-branch pattern.

patterns.name: Dagger and derivative fractions in LaTeX physics equations
patterns.context: Field operators with daggers, derivative operators, and mass-parameter fractions in field-theory equations.

patterns.name: LaTeX particle states and matrix-element notation
patterns.context: In particle-physics matrix elements or amplitude equations, sandwich states, bilinear operators, and particle symbols occur together.

patterns.name: JavaScript/jQuery selector calls
patterns.context: A branch uses a jQuery ID selector and calls a CSS method.

patterns.name: C++/C function calls and linked-list block-release logic
patterns.context: Adjacent calls release or remove a free-list block, followed by a comment describing the previous block’s state.

patterns.name: Java namespace mapping update
patterns.context: After parsing the target namespace, a schema and prefix are written to a map; the code is inside a conditional branch.

patterns.name: HTML/Angular external-link element
patterns.context: An HTML template uses an Angular click handler to open an external link and includes an external URL attribute.

patterns.name: Embedded DDR configuration register write
patterns.context: A DDR controller register is configured by chip-select index, within a branch such as `else if (i == 1)`.

patterns.name: Java image-resource setting
patterns.context: An image is retrieved from a resource array by position and set on an ImageView, with an alternative resource call commented out nearby.

patterns.name: Commutators and equation labels in quantum field theory
patterns.context: An aligned equation lists commutation relations for field operators and includes an equation-label tag.

patterns.name: Projected derivatives in fluid equations
patterns.context: A relativistic fluid equation constructs a projection tensor from a four-velocity and applies it to a pressure derivative.

5_2830.concept: 分支与结构边界标记
5_2830.description: 主要对代码条件分支中的 else 及其边界格式敏感；另对 LaTeX 多行公式的对齐、换行和标签有稳定响应。其余激活分散在各语言的指针、调用、前端标记及物理公式局部语法。

patterns.name: else 分支入口
patterns.context: 代码中的条件分支闭合后进入替代分支；激活集中在 `else` 及相邻空格、括号、花括号和换行，多个语言中均出现。

patterns.name: LaTeX 对齐环境换行与行终止
patterns.context: 数学公式的 aligned 等多行排版中，行首对齐符号或行末换行标记附近；激活也涉及换行及公式分隔标记。

patterns.name: LaTeX 方程标号标签
patterns.context: 公式或方程环境中，标签紧接公式行或对齐行出现。

patterns.name: C 指针解引用与字段访问
patterns.context: C 代码中通过指针访问结构体成员，出现在条件判断或寄存器配置逻辑里；与 else 分支模式并存或邻近。
patterns.domain: 系统/嵌入式 C 代码

patterns.name: LaTeX 物理公式中的 dagger 与导数分式
patterns.context: 场论公式中出现带 dagger 的场算符、导数算符及质量参数分式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 粒子态与矩阵元记号
patterns.context: 粒子物理矩阵元或振幅公式中，夹心态、双线性算符及粒子符号相邻。

patterns.name: JavaScript/jQuery 选择器调用
patterns.context: 分支代码中使用 jQuery 的 ID 选择器并调用 CSS 方法。

patterns.name: C++/C 函数调用与链表块释放逻辑
patterns.context: 释放或移除空闲链表块的相邻调用，随后以注释说明前一块状态。

patterns.name: Java 命名空间映射更新
patterns.context: 解析目标命名空间后将 schema 与前缀写入映射表，代码位于条件分支内。

patterns.name: HTML/Angular 外链元素
patterns.context: HTML 模板中用 Angular 点击处理器打开外部链接，并带外链 URL 属性。

patterns.name: 嵌入式 DDR 配置寄存器写入
patterns.context: 按片选索引配置 DDR 控制器寄存器，处于 `else if (i == 1)` 一类分支。
patterns.domain: Github 嵌入式 C 代码

patterns.name: Java 图像资源设置
patterns.context: 按位置从资源数组取图像并设置到 ImageView，附近还有被注释掉的替代资源调用。

patterns.name: 量子场论对易子与公式编号
patterns.context: aligned 公式中列出场算符对易关系，伴随方程编号标签。

patterns.name: 流体方程中的投影导数
patterns.context: 相对论流体方程中以速度四矢量构造投影张量并作用于压强导数。

en.concept: Mixed local lexical and formatting patterns
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to that in hypothetical sentences, and also activates on Delta in formulas, code indentation and control structures, and a few academic discourse words, superscript symbols, and reporting expressions; these patterns have no uniform source or semantics.

patterns.name: Hypotheses or research propositions introduced by that
patterns.context: that is followed by a declarative research hypothesis, proposition to be tested, or causal claim; common in project abstracts and also seen in paper prose. The word is often preceded by hypothesis/hypotheses or expressions about testing or uncertainty.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, grant texts, and papers

patterns.name: Delta in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In a formula environment, Delta is part of a mathematical symbol in a color-difference formula; it is not a natural-language hypothetical construction.
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas in biomedical methods or measurement papers

patterns.name: Indentation and whitespace in code diffs
patterns.context: Leading spaces, tabs, and other whitespace on added or modified lines in code patches are marked; the context is usually code statements or comments.

patterns.name: Code control structures or pointer-related tokens
patterns.context: In C/C++-style code, control-flow conditions, parentheses, or variable names are activated; these examples have no clear single semantic relation.

patterns.name: Superscript symbols in mathematical notation
patterns.context: A passage begins in a mathematical typesetting context, with a superscript and formula delimiters; it later transitions to an introduction of the paper's structure.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper text and mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: Discourse connective In
patterns.context: In at the beginning of a sentence or clause introduces the following explanation; it can introduce a description of paper organization or biomedical discussion, with no more specific shared semantics.

patterns.name: here reporting research results
patterns.context: Used with we report in academic prose to refer to findings reported in the current paper.

patterns.name: however expressing contrast or qualification
patterns.context: however occurs in an academic sentence to introduce a qualification of the preceding result or argument.

5_2830.concept: 混合的局部词形与格式模式
5_2830.description: 主要对假设句中的that强烈响应，也激活公式Delta、代码缩进与控制结构，以及少数学术篇章词、上标符号和报道用语；这些模式来源与语义并不统一。

patterns.name: that 引出的假设或研究命题
patterns.context: that 后接陈述性研究假设、待验证命题或因果主张；常见于项目摘要，也见于论文正文。该词前常出现 hypothesis/hypotheses 或测试、未知等表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、基金项目文本及论文

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 Delta
patterns.context: 公式环境中，Delta 作为数学符号的一部分，出现在色差计算公式里；不是自然语言里的假设句式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法或测量论文中的数学公式

patterns.name: 代码差异中的缩进与空白
patterns.context: 代码补丁中新增或修改行的前导空格、制表符等空白被标记；上下文通常是代码语句或注释。

patterns.name: 代码控制结构或指针相关 token
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中，控制流条件、括号或变量名被激活；这些例子没有明显共享的单一语义关系。

patterns.name: 数学模式中的上标符号
patterns.context: 段首处于数学排版上下文，出现上标及公式定界符；后文转入论文结构介绍。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文文本及数学排版

patterns.name: 篇章衔接词 In
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头的 In 引出后文说明；可用于论文组织介绍，也可用于生物医学论述，缺少更具体的共享语义。

patterns.name: 报道研究结果的 here
patterns.context: 学术叙述中与 we report 连用，指当前论文报告的发现。

patterns.name: 转折或保留语气的 however
patterns.context: however 位于学术句子中，引出对前述结果或论述的限定。

en.description: Primarily responds to LaTeX mathematical typesetting structure and control characters, alignment markers, line breaks, and variable expressions in equations; a few activations occur in Python code conditions, indexing, and field access, as well as citations and chemical prose.

patterns.name: Boundaries, line breaks, and alignment symbols in LaTeX math environments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on line breaks, alignment markers, environment boundaries, or nearby positions inside math environments; equations also contain variables and mathematical expressions.
patterns.domain: LaTeX mathematical typesetting in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: TeX control sequences and mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: Control sequences appear in mathematical equations, especially fractions, delimiters, labels, and relation symbols; activations may fall on the commands themselves or nearby math tokens.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical papers

patterns.name: Greek letters and subscripts/superscripts in physics equations
patterns.context: Equations composed of Greek letters, variables, and subscripts or superscripts in physics or mathematical derivations; when they appear alone, no specific disciplinary concept can be identified as the trigger.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics, mathematical physics, and related papers

patterns.name: Alignment structure in LaTeX equations
patterns.context: Used to align columns in multi-line equations or table-like expressions, often adjacent to line-break symbols, equals signs, or variables.

patterns.name: Prose transitions after equations and section headings
patterns.context: A colon, line break, or bold phrase introducing the following equation content appears after an equation or section reference.
patterns.domain: Mixed prose and equations in ArXiv academic papers

patterns.name: Conditional checks and comparisons in code
patterns.context: Boolean conditions, equality comparisons, or control-flow statements appear in Python-style code, usually inside an indented code block.

patterns.name: Author names and years in citations
patterns.context: A bibliographic citation formatted with an author and year in square brackets, with BibTeX-style citation markers.

patterns.name: Descriptions of chemical species and aggregates
patterns.context: Chemical or physicochemical prose discussing calcium ions, micelle-like aggregates, and parameter α, followed by a free-energy equation.

patterns.name: Object fields and string comparisons in code
patterns.context: An object or struct field is accessed and its converted value compared with a string; the code contains a condition and return statement.

patterns.name: Indexing and array-style access in code
patterns.context: Code accesses a container or array using an integer index, surrounded by assignment statements and control flow.

5_2830.concept: 结构化符号与代码边界
5_2830.description: 主要对 LaTeX 数学排版结构与公式中的控制符、对齐符、换行和变量表达式响应；少量激活出现在 Python 代码的条件、索引与字段访问，以及引文和化学叙述中。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境中的边界、换行与对齐符号
patterns.context: 激活常落在公式环境内的换行、对齐标记、环境边界或其邻近位置；公式中同时出现变量和数学表达式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的 LaTeX 数学排版

patterns.name: TeX 控制序列与数学排版命令
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现控制序列，尤其是分式、括号、标签和关系符号；激活可落在命令本身或邻近数学 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 物理公式中的希腊字母与上下标
patterns.context: 物理或数学推导中，以希腊字母、变量、上下标构成的公式；单独出现时不能确定某个特定学科概念是触发原因。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理、数学物理及相关论文

patterns.name: LaTeX 方程中的对齐结构
patterns.trigger: «&»，如 «&» 后接公式项，或 «&&» 后接反应道表达式
patterns.context: 多行公式或表格状方程中用于对齐各列，常邻接换行符、等号或变量。

patterns.name: 公式后的正文衔接与段落标题
patterns.context: 公式或章节引用之后出现冒号、换行，或以加粗短语引出后续公式内容。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文正文与公式混排

patterns.name: 代码中的条件判断与比较
patterns.context: Python 风格代码中出现布尔条件、相等比较或控制流语句，通常位于缩进代码块内。

patterns.name: 引文中的作者名与年份
patterns.context: 方括号内以作者和年份组成的文献引用，并夹有 BibTeX 风格的引用标记。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文参考文献引用

patterns.name: 化学物种及聚集体描述
patterns.context: 讨论钙离子、胶束样聚集体及参数 α 的化学或物理化学叙述，并接有自由能公式。

patterns.name: 代码中的对象字段与字符串比较
patterns.context: 访问对象或结构字段，并将转换后的值与字符串比较；代码中含有条件与返回语句。

patterns.name: 代码中的索引与数组式访问
patterns.context: 代码通过整数索引访问容器或数组，周围为赋值语句和控制流。

en.description: Activations occur at structural boundaries and connective positions in scientific text and code: LaTeX equation commands, line breaks and punctuation, diff addition/deletion symbols, and inter-sentence transitions or explanatory expressions in academic prose. No single clear trigger is apparent across the passages.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical-equation boundaries
patterns.context: Near line breaks, alignment, and equation endings in equations or alignment environments; often adjacent to markers or parentheses.

patterns.name: Code additions/deletions and line endings
patterns.context: At added or deleted lines, statement endings, or line breaks in code diffs; some activations occur near code-initialization statements.

patterns.name: English inter-sentence connections and contrasts
patterns.context: Near sentence beginnings, transitions between sentences, or conditional clauses in paper abstracts or prose; the trigger words vary across examples.

patterns.name: LaTeX document commands
patterns.context: Near LaTeX preamble or document-structure commands; activations also occur at the equation variable “y_{ij}”.

patterns.name: Research motivation and explanation in scientific prose
patterns.context: In sentences explaining experimental conditions, stating research findings, or introducing the rationale for a study.

5_2830.concept: 结构边界与衔接标记
5_2830.description: 激活分布于科学文本及代码中的结构边界和连接位置：LaTeX 公式命令、换行与标点，diff 增删符号，以及论文散文的句间过渡或解释性表达。不同片段之间看不出单一明确触发特征。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学公式边界
patterns.context: 公式或对齐环境中的换行、对齐及公式结束附近；常与标记或括号相邻。

patterns.name: 代码增删与行终止
patterns.context: 代码 diff 中的增删行、语句结束或换行处；部分激活落在代码初始化语句附近。

patterns.name: 英文句间连接与转折
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文中句首、句间过渡或条件从句附近；各例触发词不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及科学论文散文

patterns.name: LaTeX 文档命令
patterns.context: LaTeX 导言区或文档结构命令附近，激活也出现在公式变量处「y_{ij}」。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的 LaTeX 数学文本

patterns.name: 科学叙述中的研究动机与解释
patterns.trigger: 「conditioned」「Our data also suggest that」「The rationale is that」「elucidating」
patterns.context: 解释实验条件、陈述研究发现或引出研究理由的句子中。
