patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要/研究叙述

en.concept: Research Statements and Structured Technical Text
en.description: Most activations occur in sentences that state hypotheses, objectives, or findings in biomedical research; others occur in code-patch initialization/close operations, mathematical LaTeX array formatting, and descriptions of animal groups and experimental timelines.

patterns.name: Hypotheses or research objectives in scientific papers
patterns.context: Statements of testable hypotheses, research objectives, or findings in medical and biological papers; often in sentences introducing a specific mechanism, subject, or result.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and research proposals

patterns.name: Initialization and closing in code patches
patterns.context: C/C++ code changes in Git diff format, involving object initialization, condition checks, or closing operations, accompanied by added/deleted-line markers.

patterns.name: Arrays and row structure in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Arrays or algebraic expressions displayed in LaTeX math environments, with line breaks and alignment markers forming the layout structure.

patterns.name: Experimental time points and animal groups
patterns.context: Descriptions of animal-experiment groups, treatment conditions, or observation times after treatment; no explicit hypothesis wording.

5_2830.concept: 研究陈述及结构化技术文本
5_2830.description: 多数激活出现在生物医学研究中提出假设、目标或报告发现的句子；另有代码补丁的初始化/关闭操作、数学 LaTeX 数组排版，以及动物分组和实验时间描述。

patterns.name: 科研论文中的假设或研究目标
patterns.trigger: «hypotheses»、«hypothesize»、«surmise»、«hypothesis»、«proposal»、«will be tested»、«we report here»、«It is reported that»
patterns.context: 医学与生物学论文中陈述待检验假设、研究目标或研究发现；常位于引出具体机制、对象或结果的句子中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: 代码补丁中的初始化与关闭
patterns.context: Git diff 格式的 C/C++ 代码变更，围绕对象初始化、条件判断或关闭操作，并伴随增删行标记。
patterns.domain: 软件代码与版本控制补丁

patterns.name: 数学排版中的数组与行结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学环境中展示数组或代数表达式，换行符和对齐符构成排版结构。

patterns.name: 实验时间点与动物分组
patterns.context: 描述动物实验的分组、处理条件或处理后的观察时间；未明确出现假设措辞。

en.description: Primarily responds to that clauses introducing propositions, results, or reasons in sentences, especially in scientific and legal text; it also responds to initialization/close calls in one code patch and a formula passage describing a small-wavenumber power law.

patterns.name: Introduction of a hypothesis or proposition
patterns.context: In academic argumentation or legal reasoning, that introduces a proposition, explanation, result, or reason; it often occurs at a clause boundary in a long sentence.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, mathematics/physics papers, judicial opinions

patterns.name: Initialization call in a code diff
patterns.context: A code patch adds an initialization call, comments out a header file, and contrasts with a deleted close call; the activation is near the code-edit passage.

patterns.name: Wavenumber notation in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: A text label and mathematical notation in a formula environment describe a power-law relation in the small-wavenumber regime.

5_2830.concept: 命题从句引出
5_2830.description: 主要响应句中引出命题、结果或论证理由的 that 从句，尤见科研与法律文本；另对一段代码补丁中的初始化/关闭调用及一段描述小波数幂律的公式片段有响应。

patterns.name: 假设或命题引出
patterns.context: 在学术论证或法律推理中，that 引出命题、解释、结果或理由；常出现在较长句子的从句边界。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、数学/物理论文、司法意见

patterns.name: 代码差异中的初始化调用
patterns.context: 代码补丁中新增初始化调用、注释掉头文件，并与删除的关闭调用形成差异；激活落在代码编辑片段附近。

patterns.name: 数学公式的波数标记
patterns.context: 公式环境中以文字标签和数学记号描述小波数区间的幂律关系。
patterns.domain: 物理论文、LaTeX 数学公式

en.concept: Introduction and Boundaries of Hypotheses or Conditions
en.description: In most passages, activation occurs when hypothesis, hypothesize, or rationale introduces hypothesis content in scientific text, especially on that introducing a clause. Two other passages are code, with activations near conditional checks and statement or block boundaries.

patterns.name: that after a scientific hypothesis/rationale lead-in
patterns.context: In scientific text, the preceding text introduces a research hypothesis or rationale, and that introduces its specific content; strong activation falls on that, with nearby words such as hypothesis and rationale often present.
patterns.domain: NIH research proposals, paper abstracts, or research background

patterns.name: Conditions and statement boundaries in code
patterns.context: Near conditional checks, statement endings, or block boundaries in C/C++-style code; activations also include whitespace, line breaks, and punctuation, with no word triggers matching the scientific-hypothesis pattern.
patterns.domain: Github source code and code comments

5_2830.concept: 假设或条件的引出与边界
5_2830.description: 多数段落在科研文本中由 hypothesis、hypothesize 或 rationale 引出假设内容时激活，尤其是引出从句的 that。另有两段代码，激活落在条件判断及语句、块边界附近。

patterns.name: 科研假设/理由引导词后的 that
patterns.trigger: “The rationale … is that”、“The hypothesis is that”、“hypothesize that”、“central hypothesis is that”中的 “that”；[4] 还有 “The rationale … is that understanding …”
patterns.context: 科研文本中，前文提出研究假设或研究理由，that 引出其具体内容；强激活落在 that 上，周边假设、rationale、hypothesis 等词也常见。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划、论文摘要或研究背景

patterns.name: 代码中的条件与语句边界
patterns.trigger: [1] 的 “if (str->init)” 附近及换行、缩进；[2] 的 “if (retval)”、“return retval;”、“}” 附近
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中，条件判断、语句结束或块边界附近；激活也包括空白、换行和标点，未见与科研假设句式相同的词语触发。

en.description: Activations occur primarily in the NIH proposal pattern “rationale…that”; they also appear in GitHub code indentation, line breaks, and control structures, HTML tag formatting, and the phrase “reasoning that” in a legal opinion. Shared features may include structural markers or function words introducing clauses, but the cross-domain pattern is not uniform.

patterns.name: Argumentation pattern in grant applications
patterns.context: An NIH research abstract uses rationale to introduce the study’s reasoning, knowledge gap, or subsequent research objective; “that” is often followed by “once…” or a gerund/clause.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter biomedical and behavioral-science research proposals

patterns.name: Line-initial indentation and control structures in code
patterns.context: Indentation, line breaks, and code statements intermix in GitHub code or diff snippets; activations fall on whitespace, line breaks, and some syntax markers.

patterns.name: HTML tags and indentation formatting
patterns.context: Nested tags are arranged with indentation and line breaks in an HTML snippet.
patterns.domain: Web markup language, including Wikipedia page templates

patterns.name: Reasoning connectives in legal arguments
patterns.context: A court opinion uses reasoning that to introduce the grounds for a decision; the passage discusses whether prior art covers the claimed salts.

5_2830.concept: 结构边界与从句引导
5_2830.description: 激活主要出现在 NIH 申请书“rationale…that”论证句式中；另见 GitHub 代码的缩进、换行及控制结构，HTML 标签格式，以及法律意见中“reasoning that”的推理引述。共同点可能是结构标记或引出从句的功能词，但跨领域模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 基金申请中的论证句式
patterns.trigger: “The rationale for the proposed research is that”以及“ The rationale is that”；还包括前置的“hypothesis was formulated based on…”
patterns.context: 在 NIH 研究摘要中，以 rationale 引出研究理由、知识缺口或后续研究目标；“that”后常接“once…”或动名词/从句。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学及行为科学研究计划书

patterns.name: 代码中的行首缩进与控制结构
patterns.trigger: 行首空格/制表符及 “if (”“return”“}”“↵” 等代码格式 token；[1]另有“str->init();”“str->shutdown();”
patterns.context: GitHub 代码或差异片段中，缩进、换行与代码语句交错；激活落在空白、换行以及部分语法标记上。

patterns.name: HTML 标签与缩进格式
patterns.context: HTML 片段以缩进和换行排列嵌套标签。
patterns.domain: 网页标记语言，含 Wikipedia 页面模板

patterns.name: 法律论证中的推理连接词
patterns.context: 法院意见以 reasoning that 引出判决理由；此处讨论先前技术是否涵盖所主张的盐类。

en.description: Primarily responds to the “rationale … is that” pattern in research proposals, especially contexts where that introduces a rationale, explanation, or subsequent research. Other local patterns include webpage HTML tags and attributes, syntax and whitespace in code diffs, punctuation in philosophical quotations, and that in the mathematical phrase “such that”.

patterns.name: “rationale is that” research-proposal pattern
patterns.context: Appears after statements of research aims, hypotheses, or rationale, often introducing an explanation or rationale for subsequent research; sometimes followed by “once” or a gerund.
patterns.domain: NIH research funding applications, medicine, and biological sciences

patterns.name: HTML tag and attribute boundaries
patterns.context: In compressed or line-broken webpage source, activations are distributed around tag delimiters, tag names, and attribute text.

patterns.name: Indentation and syntax in code-edit diffs
patterns.context: In C/C++-style code diff snippets, added and deleted lines alternate, and formatting whitespace is also marked.

patterns.name: Quotation and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: In philosophical discussion, punctuation is adjacent to the introduction of an author’s view and the quoted content; seen in only one example.

patterns.name: Mathematical clause introduced by that
patterns.context: A mathematical paper says that a problem has no global solution and uses such that to introduce a clause requiring further study.

5_2830.concept: 特定文本边界与 that 从句
5_2830.description: 主要响应研究提案中的“rationale … is that”句式，尤其是that引出理由、解释或后续研究的语境。另有网页HTML标签与属性、代码diff的语法及空白、哲学引述标点，以及数学文本“such that”中的that等局部模式。

patterns.name: “rationale is that”研究提案句式
patterns.trigger: “The rationale for the proposed research is that” / “The rationale is that”中的“that”
patterns.context: 出现在研究目的、假设或研究依据的陈述之后，常引出解释或后续研究理由；有时紧跟“once”或动名词
patterns.domain: NIH研究资助申请、医学与生物科学

patterns.name: HTML标签与属性边界
patterns.trigger: HTML片段中的“>”“<”“div”“id”“class”及属性值附近的标记
patterns.context: 处于压缩或换行的网页源码中，激活分布在标签分隔符、标签名和属性文本周围

patterns.name: 代码编辑差异中的缩进与语法
patterns.trigger: “str->init();”“if”“+”“-”以及差异标记附近的空格和换行
patterns.context: C/C++风格代码的diff片段中，新增与删除行交错，格式空白也被标记

patterns.name: 引述与标点边界
patterns.trigger: “According to Walton,”附近的引号和逗号，尤其是“,”
patterns.context: 哲学论述中引入作者观点后，标点与引述内容相邻；只见于单例

patterns.name: that引导的数学从句
patterns.context: 数学论文叙述问题尚无全局解，并用such that引出需要继续研究的从句

en.description: Primarily responds to that, especially in the reason clause introduced by rationale is that in NIH research abstracts; it also responds to that in hypotheses, patent causal explanations, and mathematical conclusions.

patterns.name: that introducing a research rationale clause
patterns.context: In academic research plans, after stating research aims, hypotheses, or prior work, that introduces the research rationale or expected significance; it is sometimes followed by clauses beginning with once/how.

patterns.name: Variant expression of a research rationale
patterns.context: In research abstracts, rationale introduces the research rationale, followed by an account of understanding a biological process.

patterns.name: that in hypothesis sentences
patterns.context: States multiple hypotheses being tested, with that introducing their content.

patterns.name: that in causal explanations
patterns.context: Patent background text explains the reason for a change in friction characteristics.

patterns.name: that in mathematical derivations
patterns.context: In technical discussion of image restoration and hyperparameter selection, that introduces a conclusion about the optimal choice.

5_2830.concept: that 从句引导词
5_2830.description: 主要响应 that，尤其是 NIH 研究摘要中 rationale is that 引出的理由从句；也响应假设、专利因果解释及数学结论中的 that。

patterns.name: 研究理由从句引导词
patterns.trigger: «that»10，前接“The rationale is”或“The rationale for the proposed research is”
patterns.context: 学术研究计划中，在陈述研究目标、假设或前期工作后，用 that 引出研究理由或预期意义；常紧接 explaining/understanding/once 等内容

patterns.name: 研究理由的变体表达
patterns.trigger: «that»9，前接“The rationale for this work is”
patterns.context: 研究摘要中由 rationale 引出研究理由，后接对某生物学过程的理解

patterns.name: 假设句中的 that
patterns.context: 陈述正在检验的复数假设，that 引出假设内容

patterns.name: 原因解释中的 that
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中说明摩擦特性变化的原因

patterns.name: 数学推导中的 that
patterns.context: 图像恢复及超参数选择的技术论述中，that 引出关于最优选择的结论

en.concept: Research Discourse Structure Introduced by that
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to structures in scientific proposals where that introduces a rationale, explanation, or hypothesis; in two Github patches, it also activates on line breaks, indentation, and code-structure punctuation, with no clear connection to the scientific construction.

patterns.name: Rationale introducing an explanatory clause in research
patterns.context: A scientific abstract or funding application first states the research background, hypothesis, or objective, then uses that to introduce the rationale or mechanism to be clarified; often followed by elucidating, understanding, once, and similar terms.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans, life sciences, and other academic research styles

patterns.name: that in hypothesis statements
patterns.context: After a research hypothesis or proposition to be tested, that introduces the specific hypothesis content; rationale may also appear nearby.

patterns.name: Blank lines and initialization/conditional structures in code diffs
patterns.context: Added and deleted lines alternate in a Git diff, containing initialization calls and if conditions; activations concentrate around line breaks and code formatting.

patterns.name: Indentation, return values, and comment blocks in code diffs
patterns.context: Patch code contains added indentation, conditional returns, closing braces, and multi-line comments; activations fall on line breaks, indentation, and some punctuation.

5_2830.concept: that 引导的研究论述结构
5_2830.description: 主要对科研申请中用 that 引出研究理由、解释或假设的结构强烈反应；另在两段 Github 补丁中对换行、缩进及代码结构标点激活，未见与科研句式的明确联系。

patterns.name: 研究 rationale 引出解释性从句
patterns.trigger: “The rationale is that”或“The rationale for the proposed research is that”；部分段落中 that 标记最强
patterns.context: 科研摘要或资助申请先陈述研究背景、假设或目标，再用 that 引出研究理由或后续要阐明的机制；常接 elucidating、understanding、once 等
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划、生命科学及其他学术研究文体

patterns.name: 假设陈述中的 that
patterns.trigger: “hypotheses being tested are that”及“central hypothesis is that”
patterns.context: 研究假设或待检验命题之后，由 that 引出具体假设内容；附近也可出现 rationale
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划、科学论述

patterns.name: 代码差异中的空行与初始化/条件结构
patterns.context: Git diff 中新增、删除行交替，包含初始化调用和 if 条件；激活集中在换行及代码格式附近
patterns.domain: Github C/C++ 风格代码补丁

patterns.name: 代码差异中的缩进、返回值与注释块
patterns.context: 补丁代码中新增缩进、条件返回、闭合括号和多行注释；激活落在换行、缩进及部分标点上
patterns.domain: Github 驱动程序代码补丁

en.description: Primarily responds to that introducing an explanation or proposition in copular constructions in scientific text, especially research rationales (rationale is that), and also hypotheses (hypothesis is/are/were that).

patterns.name: that after research rationale
patterns.context: In research plans or project descriptions, that follows rationale is and introduces the research basis, significance, or subsequent explanation; sometimes followed by clauses beginning with once/how.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter research grant application text

patterns.name: that after a hypothesis statement
patterns.context: In scientific text, that follows a copular construction with hypothesis(s) and introduces a proposition to be tested.
patterns.domain: Research grant applications or research papers

5_2830.concept: 科研陈述中的补语 that
5_2830.description: 主要响应科研文本中由系词结构引出解释或命题的 that，尤其是研究理由（rationale is that），也包括假设（hypothesis is/are/were that）。

patterns.name: 研究理由后的 that
patterns.trigger: “The rationale for the proposed research is that”及“The rationale is that”；被标记的触发词为“that”
patterns.context: 研究计划或项目说明中，that 紧接 rationale is，引出研究依据、重要性或后续解释；有时接 once/how 等从句
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 科研资助申请文本

patterns.name: 假设陈述后的 that
patterns.trigger: “the central hypothesis is that”、“hypotheses being tested are that”、“hypotheses to be tested were that”；被标记的触发词为“that”
patterns.context: 科研文本中，that 紧接 hypothesis(s) 的系词结构，引出待检验的命题
patterns.domain: 科研资助申请或研究论文

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: Park at the beginning, abstract headings and Conclusions, fragments within technical terms, and contexts such as fast-food branding, interview identities, legal rulings, and French models. No stable semantic trigger covers all samples.

patterns.name: Park at the beginning
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on Park at the start of the segment; the following contexts differ: “Park fast Blog” and “Park Bit-”.

patterns.name: Paper title/abstract opening marker
patterns.context: A bracket and title-opening subword fragment in PubMed abstracts; the title topics differ.

patterns.name: Conclusion section marker
patterns.context: A Conclusions heading or transition in an abstract, possibly including preceding title content.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts; also legal text

patterns.name: Fragments within English technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on split word fragments with inconsistent meanings and contexts; the first passage also contains the web context “Park fast Blog”.
patterns.domain: Mixed: web, medical abstracts, French academic text

patterns.name: Fast-food brand recognition
patterns.context: Discusses children's recognition of fast-food restaurant brands and compares them with other food brands.

patterns.name: Identity and interaction in interviews
patterns.context: Researchers reflect on their identities and relationships and interactions during interviews with student participants.

patterns.name: Legal amounts and ruling terminology
patterns.context: A legal ruling lists monthly amounts and time periods and mentions the court's findings of fact and legal conclusions.

patterns.name: French academic expression and model description
patterns.context: A French paper introduces a new model for formal methods; activation is distributed across multiple French word fragments.

patterns.name: Chinese bioanalytical standards in a medical abstract
patterns.context: Discusses China's new CFDA BMV policy and related conference conclusions.

5_2969.description: 激活模式分散：开头的 Park、摘要标题与 Conclusions、专业词内部片段，以及快餐标识、访谈身份、法律判决和法语模型等语境；未见覆盖全部样本的稳定语义触发器。

patterns.name: Park 开头
patterns.trigger: «Park»；第 1 段紧接 «fast»，第 2 段紧接 « Bit»
patterns.context: 激活集中在片段开头的 Park；后续上下文不同，分别是“Park fast Blog”与“Park Bit-”。

patterns.name: 论文标题/摘要起始标记
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要中方括号及标题开头的词片段；这些标题主题并不相同。

patterns.name: 结论段落标记
patterns.context: 摘要中出现 Conclusions 标题或段落转折，可能包括前置的标题内容。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要；另见法律文本

patterns.name: 英文专业词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词片段上，词义和语境不统一；第 1 段还包含 Park fast Blog 的网页上下文。
patterns.domain: 混合：网页、医学摘要、法语学术文本

patterns.name: fast food 标识识别
patterns.trigger: fast« food» restaurant« logos»；« food» logos
patterns.context: 讨论儿童对快餐餐馆标识的识别，并与其他食品标识比较。

patterns.name: 访谈中的身份与互动主题
patterns.trigger: « Black» lesbian» researcher»；« self»-disclosure»、« empathy»、« rapport»
patterns.context: 研究者反思自身身份及与学生参与者访谈中的关系和互动。

patterns.name: 法律金额与判决用语
patterns.context: 法律判决中列示按月金额与时间段，并提及法院的事实认定和法律结论。

patterns.name: 法语学术表达与模型描述
patterns.context: 法语论文介绍一种用于形式化方法的新模型；激活分布在多个法语词片段。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的中国生物分析规范
patterns.trigger: « regulated» bioanalytical practice»；« new» BMV policy»；« Conclusions»
patterns.context: 讨论中国 CFDA 新 BMV 政策及相关会议结论。

en.concept: Text fragments and abstract structure markers
en.description: Patterns include Park fragments, paper titles and intra-word term fragments, abstract conclusion markers, and legal, French academic, and qualitative research texts. The clearest recurring cues across excerpts are medical abstract structure and long-word segmentation; other activations are distributed across different contexts.

patterns.name: Park text and surrounding content
patterns.context: Park is used as a name or place name, followed by phrases about a driving blog tag and Park Bit-na; these texts are adjacent to line breaks or title-like fragments.

patterns.name: Paper titles and title-like terms
patterns.context: Bracket-opened medical paper titles or title-like terms; strong activations occur at the start of titles and in components of compound technical terms.

patterns.name: Abstract conclusion markers
patterns.context: Markers for the conclusion section of medical abstracts or research reports; the same marker appears after content from multiple fields.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in long English words
patterns.context: Long, often technical English words are split into multiple subword tokens; activation is concentrated on intra-word fragments rather than a stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Narratives of amounts and dates in legal rulings
patterns.context: Rulings state amounts and time ranges by month, then move to the court's findings of fact and legal conclusions.

patterns.name: Methods and model terms in French academic style
patterns.context: French academic paragraphs introduce a new model and its method; activations are distributed across segmented French words and local expressions.

patterns.name: Researcher identity and interview reflexivity
patterns.context: First-person research reflections discuss researcher identity and its impact on interviews and relationships with student participants.

patterns.name: Children recognizing fast-food logos
patterns.context: The abstract discusses children's recognition of fast-food restaurant logos and related factors, followed by a conclusion marker.
patterns.domain: Public health or nutrition research abstracts

5_2969.concept: 文本片段与摘要结构标记
5_2969.description: 模式涵盖 Park 片段、论文标题及词内术语片段、摘要结论标记，以及法律、法语学术和质性研究文本。跨段最明显的重复线索是医学摘要结构与长词切分；其余激活分散于不同语境。

patterns.name: Park 字样及周边文本
patterns.context: Park 被用作名称或地名，后续短语分别涉及驾驶博客标签和 Park Bit-na；这些文本紧邻换行或标题式片段。

patterns.name: 论文标题与标题式术语
patterns.trigger: PubMed 片段开头的«[»，以及标题中的«Dem»«onstr»«ation»、«Effect»« and»« effectiveness»、«Ext»«rac»«orp»«oreal»等
patterns.context: 方括号起始的医学论文标题或标题式术语；强激活落在标题开头及复合专业词的组成部分。

patterns.name: 摘要结论标记
patterns.context: 医学摘要或研究报告的结论段落标记；同一标记在多个领域内容后出现。

patterns.name: 英语长词的词内片段
patterns.context: 较长、常为专业术语的英语单词被分成多个子词 token；激活集中在词内部片段，而非稳定的单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的金额与日期叙述
patterns.context: 判决书按月说明金额及时间范围，随后转入法院事实认定和法律结论。

patterns.name: 法语学术文体中的方法与模型词
patterns.context: 法语学术段落介绍一种新模型及其方法，激活分布在被拆分的法语词和局部表达中。

patterns.name: 研究者身份与访谈反思
patterns.context: 第一人称研究反思讨论研究者身份及其对访谈、学生参与者关系的影响。

patterns.name: 儿童识别快餐标识
patterns.context: 摘要讨论儿童对快餐餐馆标志的识别及相关影响因素，之后出现结论标记。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或营养研究摘要

en.concept: Specific word fragments and abstract structure
en.description: Activations cluster around position-specific word fragments in titles or sentences: two passages begin with Park, multiple abstracts activate at the start of titles or at Conclusions, alongside ici in a French passage, long medical terms, and several individually distinct topics. A common mechanism is unclear.

patterns.name: Park at the start of titles
patterns.context: “Park” appears at the start of short titles or entries, followed by a name, word fragment, or line break; there is insufficient evidence to determine a specific meaning

patterns.name: Academic abstract title openings
patterns.context: Bracketed titles at the start of PubMed abstracts, especially titles containing multisyllabic medical terms

patterns.name: Abstract conclusion markers
patterns.context: Conclusions appears in abstract text or a conclusion section, followed by a summary statement

patterns.name: Positional emphasis of here / ici
patterns.context: A word meaning “here” occurs in a sentence, often in an emphatic or restrictive position; in the examples, French “ici” appears in an argument that does not discuss only a particular…

patterns.name: fast food restaurant logos
patterns.context: Discusses children's recognition of fast-food restaurant logos and related factors

patterns.name: Bioanalytical regulation and policy
patterns.context: Discusses regulated bioanalytical practices in China and related policy meetings

patterns.name: French methodology and models
patterns.context: French papers introduce a new method or model and state the parameters it requires

patterns.name: Environmental issues involving mercury
patterns.context: Discusses preventing mercury from accumulating in the environment

patterns.name: Researcher identity and interview relationships
patterns.context: Reflects on how researcher identity affects interviews, self-disclosure, and relationships with student participants

patterns.name: Long fragments in medical terms in titles
patterns.context: Words in abstract titles or medical terms are split into multiple subword fragments; apart from title-opening activations, the specific trigger is uncertain

5_2969.concept: 特定词片段与摘要结构
5_2969.description: 激活集中于标题或句中位置性词片段：两段以 Park 开头，多篇摘要在标题起始或 Conclusions 处激活，另有法语段落的 ici、医学长术语及若干各自独特的主题内容。共同机制不明确。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Park
patterns.context: “Park”位于短标题或条目开头，后接名称、词片段或换行；没有足够证据确定具体语义

patterns.name: 学术摘要标题起始
patterns.trigger: «[» 后接标题式词语，如“«Dem»onstration”“«Effect» and effectiveness”“«Ext»racorporeal shock wave lithotripsy”
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要的方括号标题开头，尤其标题中含多音节医学术语

patterns.name: 摘要结论标记
patterns.context: 摘要正文或结论段落中出现 Conclusions，后接总结性陈述

patterns.name: here / ici 的位置性强调
patterns.trigger: «ici»（法语）或“«here»”对应词片段«ici»；上下文含«ici»8
patterns.context: 句中出现表示“这里/此处”的词，常处于强调或限定位置；在所给例子中，法语“ici”出现在“不是只谈某个……”的论述中
patterns.domain: 法语学术文本、议会发言

patterns.name: fast food restaurant 标识
patterns.context: 讨论儿童识别快餐餐馆标志及相关因素

patterns.name: 生物分析法规与政策
patterns.context: 讨论中国受监管生物分析实践及相关政策会议
patterns.domain: 生物医学监管、会议总结

patterns.name: 法语方法论与模型
patterns.context: 法语论文介绍新方法或模型，并陈述模型所需参数

patterns.name: 水银环境议题
patterns.trigger: «ici»8，句中提到“accumulation de mercure dans l'environnement”
patterns.context: 谈论阻止汞在环境中积累
patterns.domain: 法语议会发言、环境政策

patterns.name: 研究者身份与访谈关系
patterns.context: 反思研究者身份对访谈、自我披露及与学生参与者关系的影响

patterns.name: 医学术语标题中的长词片段
patterns.context: 摘要标题或医学术语中，词被拆分成多个子词片段；除标题开头触发外，具体触发机制不确定

en.description: Strong activation often falls on «ici», and also occurs on «Park», the «[» in PubMed abstracts, the French ending «ées», «le» in parliamentary text, and «Calculate» in math problems; the trigger words appear in markedly different contexts.

patterns.name: «ici» in French sentences
patterns.context: The token ici appears in French sentences; it may mean “here” or emphasize the current subject of discussion.
patterns.domain: French academic abstracts, European Parliament speeches, and math problems

patterns.name: Park at the beginning
patterns.context: The segment starts with Park, followed by a place, name, or related phrase.

patterns.name: PubMed abstract opening marker
patterns.context: A bracketed marker at the beginning of a PubMed abstract, followed by a title or abstract text.

patterns.name: French ending «-ées»
patterns.context: A feminine plural ending with an accent mark in French text; nearby tokens are split into multiple subword fragments.

patterns.name: «le» in French parliamentary discourse
patterns.context: The article le appears before a formal title or noun phrase in parliamentary speeches; these segments also contain «ici».

patterns.name: «Calculate» in probability problems
patterns.context: The instruction word Calculate appears at the start of a math problem or solution step.

5_2969.description: 强激活常落在 «ici»，也见于 «Park»、PubMed 摘要的 «[»、法语词尾 «ées»、议会文本的 «le» 及数学题的 «Calculate»；各触发词上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: 法语句中 «ici»
patterns.context: 词元 ici 在法语句子中出现；既可能表示“这里”，也可能用于强调当前讨论对象。
patterns.domain: 法语学术摘要、欧洲议会发言及数学题目

patterns.name: Park 开头
patterns.context: 片段以 Park 开头，后续接地点、名称或相关词组。

patterns.name: PubMed 摘要起始标记
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要开头的方括号标记，后接标题或摘要文本。

patterns.name: 法语词尾 «-ées»
patterns.context: 法语文本中带重音符号的复数阴性词尾，邻近词元被切分为多个子词。

patterns.name: 法语议会语篇 «le»
patterns.context: 议会发言中冠词 le 出现在正式称谓或名词短语之前；同时这些片段也含有 «ici»。

patterns.name: 概率题中的 «Calculate»
patterns.context: 数学概率题中，指令词 Calculate 出现在题目或解题步骤开头。

en.description: Activations are distributed across Park at the start and its continuations, line breaks and repeated names after encyclopedia titles, and PubMed abstract openings and medical term fragments; no single semantic theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: Park string and continuations
patterns.context: Park appears at the start of a title or entry, followed by differently spelled fragments; some contexts contain repeated Park

patterns.name: Bracketed openings in PubMed abstracts
patterns.context: A title-like first word follows an opening bracket at the start of an abstract; subsequent text describes medical or biological research

patterns.name: Entry titles with line breaks and repeated names
patterns.context: Wikipedia entry titles, disambiguation pages, or entry openings, with a line break after the title and the name repeated

patterns.name: -ation suffixes in medical terms
patterns.context: Medical process or measurement names appear in PubMed abstracts; activation falls on segmented suffix fragments

patterns.name: Biomedical intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Bacteria-, blood-, or hormone-related terms in abstract text are split by tokenization; this does not fully match the preceding title/suffix pattern

patterns.name: Line-break formatting in titles
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks follow a name or title, often with the name repeated, without requiring a specific entity or topic

5_2969.description: 激活分散于 Park 开头及其续接、百科标题后的换行与名称重复，以及 PubMed 摘要开头和医学术语片段；没有单一语义主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: Park 字符串及其续接
patterns.context: 在标题或词条开头出现 Park，随后接不同拼写片段；部分上下文含重复的 Park

patterns.name: PubMed 摘要的方括号开头
patterns.context: 摘要句首方括号后出现标题式首词；后续是医学或生物学研究内容

patterns.name: 带换行的词条标题与重复名称
patterns.trigger: «↵»«↵»，标题含«T»«ief»…«stadt»、«Mary»«borough»、«Mary»«etta»或«Mary»« Booth»；其后再次出现名称
patterns.context: 百科词条标题、消歧页或条目开头，标题后换行并重复名称

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 -ation 词尾
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要中出现医学过程或测量名称；激活落在被切分的词尾片段上

patterns.name: 生物医学词语内部片段
patterns.context: 摘要正文中的细菌、血液或激素相关术语被分词切分；与前述标题/词尾模式不完全相同

patterns.name: 标题中的换行格式
patterns.context: 名称或标题之后连续换行，常伴随名称重复，但不要求特定实体或主题

en.concept: Specific tokens and subword triggers in segments
en.description: Activation is scattered across text types: Park at the start of web pages or entries, call in code and math contexts, call in phone-related emails, and occasional name subwords, confidentiality notices, mathematical symbols, and technical terms. call is a recurring cross-genre cue, but its position and usage vary, so it does not explain all patterns.

patterns.name: Local activation after the name Park
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the context segment; following content varies: [1] continues with “fast Blog…Driving”, [2] with “Bit-na…Park Bit-”.

patterns.name: call in code
patterns.context: Appears in imperative code comments such as “call this when…” and in technical text describing how to execute a closure.
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments, HackerNews programming discussions

patterns.name: call in academic text
patterns.context: In math papers or Q&A, call introduces the naming or classification of a transformation, filter, or object.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math papers, StackExchange math Q&A

patterns.name: call in emails
patterns.context: Business emails mention a conference call or suggest calling someone; here “call” refers to a phone call.

patterns.name: Subword within the name Yamagu­chi
patterns.context: When a name is tokenized into pieces, activation falls on the final subword of the name.

patterns.name: CONFIDENTIAL label and attorney-client privilege notice
patterns.context: A confidentiality/attorney-client work-product disclaimer preceding the email body; “conference call” appears later in the same passage.

patterns.name: ij in matrix notation
patterns.context: Appears in matrix-element subscripts in mathematical expressions; matrix dimensions and exponentiation also occur nearby.

patterns.name: Park-fast web label and driving word
patterns.context: The segment begins with Park, contains a line break and Tag:, and is followed by Driving.

patterns.name: Self-intersecting elements and tetgen in code
patterns.context: Code and comments related to temporary paths discuss extracting self-intersecting element IDs and calling tetgen when an error occurs.

patterns.name: Negative values and anti- prefix in math text
patterns.context: After a formula, the text explains that some values are negative and introduces the name of a transformation; the final word is truncated.

patterns.name: Math filter objects and Supp
patterns.context: Formulas and text concerning quotient cycles, filters, and the support of modules.

patterns.name: Pre-dispatch and closure trees
patterns.context: Discusses runtime pre-dispatch, generating closure trees, and calling a top-level closure.

patterns.name: schedule and reminders in emails
patterns.context: Discusses schedules, deadlines, and a reminder to call in advance.

patterns.name: Certificate/label and biographical-entry structure
patterns.context: An entry or page segment begins with a name, followed by a line break and another name or entry fragment.

5_2969.concept: 片段中的特定词元与子词触发
5_2969.description: 激活分散于多类文本：Park 开头的网页/词条、代码与数学语境中的 call、电话邮件中的 call，以及少量姓名子词、保密声明、数学符号和技术术语。call 是跨文体重复线索，但触发位置与用法不统一，无法解释全部模式。

patterns.name: Park 名称后的局部激活
patterns.context: 在上下文片段开头出现；后续内容各异：[1] 接“fast Blog…Driving”，[2] 接“Bit-na…Park Bit-”。

patterns.name: 代码中的 call
patterns.context: 出现在命令式代码注释“call this when…”以及说明如何执行闭包的技术文本中。
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释、HackerNews 编程讨论

patterns.name: 学术文字中的 call
patterns.context: 数学论文或问答中，call 引出对变换、过滤或对象的命名/分类。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 邮件中的 call
patterns.context: 商务邮件提及电话会议，或建议致电联系他人；此处“call”是电话相关用法。

patterns.name: Yamagu­chi 姓名内部子词
patterns.context: 人名被分词切开时，激活落在名字末尾子词上。

patterns.name: CONFIDENTIAL 标记与律师特权声明
patterns.context: 邮件正文前的保密/律师客户工作成果免责声明；同段随后出现“conference call”。

patterns.name: 矩阵符号中的 ij
patterns.context: 数学表达式的矩阵元素下标中出现；同时附近有矩阵维度与幂运算。

patterns.name: Park-fast 网页标签与驾驶词
patterns.context: 片段以 Park 开头，含换行和 Tag:，随后出现 Driving。

patterns.name: 代码中自相交元素与 tetgen
patterns.context: 临时路径相关代码及注释，讨论提取自相交元素 ID，并在 tetgen 报错时调用。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的负值及 anti- 前缀
patterns.context: 公式后说明某些值为负，并引出一种变换的名称；末尾词被截断。

patterns.name: 数学过滤对象与 Supp
patterns.context: 关于循环商、过滤及模的支撑集的公式与文字说明。

patterns.name: 预先派发与闭包树
patterns.context: 讨论运行时预先派发、生成闭包树并调用顶层闭包。

patterns.name: 邮件中的 schedule 与提醒
patterns.context: 讨论存储计划、截止日期及提前致电提醒。

patterns.name: 证书/标签与人名条目结构
patterns.context: 词条或页面片段开头带有名称，后接换行及另一名称/词条片段。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: Park at the beginning, Page in technical paths, recommendations and reviews, calls and durations in business emails, “last rinse” in a patent, and “studying” in a research abstract all show local strong activation. The rest is mostly sporadic word fragments or formatting signals, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Park at the start
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the beginning of a segment or recurs after a line break; following forms vary, such as “fast” and “Bit”.

patterns.name: Page in a title or navigation path
patterns.context: Appears in the Windows configuration path “Security Page >> Site to Zone Assignment List”.

patterns.name: Recommendation or review language
patterns.context: The author recommends content to readers or says that something is interesting; also seen in “find this interesting” and “recommend learning about”.

patterns.name: Calls and time expressions
patterns.context: Recalls a past meeting or time spent, often using past tense and duration expressions.

patterns.name: “last rinse” collocation
patterns.context: Refers to adding fabric softener during the final rinse of a standard laundry cycle.

patterns.name: Research goals and exposure studies
patterns.context: Describes research on pollutants and reproductive-related targets, using purpose or methods phrasing.

patterns.name: Question mark after a percentage
patterns.context: A question mark immediately follows a percentage in a web-text segment; surrounding text is semantically incomplete.

patterns.name: Year abbreviations and purchase recommendations
patterns.context: Asks whether to buy an old computer and requests recommendations for 80s/90s models.

patterns.name: Unclear local word-fragment activation
patterns.context: Appears near URLs, usernames, or tokenized proper names; no stable semantic trigger can be determined from the segment.
patterns.domain: Forum text, URLs, and proper names

patterns.name: Unclear disclaimer and confidentiality marker
patterns.context: A confidentiality and attorney-client privilege notice at the start of an email; it is unclear whether activation is triggered by its content, formatting, or following body text.

patterns.name: Other unclear local activation
patterns.context: Each instance is embedded in text on a different topic; the available segments do not establish a shared trigger.

5_2969.description: 激活模式分散：开头的“Park”、技术路径中的“Page”、推荐评价、商务邮件中的通话与耗时、专利的“last rinse”及研究摘要中的“studying”均有局部强激活；其余多为零散词片或格式信号，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: Park 起始词
patterns.context: 激活出现在片段开头，或在换行后再次出现；后接词形各异，如“fast”“Bit”。

patterns.name: 标题或导航中的 Page
patterns.context: 出现在 Windows 配置路径中的“Security Page >> Site to Zone Assignment List”。

patterns.name: 推荐或评价用语
patterns.trigger: « recommend»9；« interesting»、« stimulating»等相邻评价词

patterns.context: The available context does not establish a shared semantic or formatting trigger; these may simply be general subword activations.

5_2969.concept: 伊比利亚语词内子词片段
5_2969.description: 激活跨西班牙语和葡萄牙语文本，主要落在词内子词片段；覆盖普通词、专名、数字和形态复杂词。另有零散标点、换行及代码编辑位置，未见一致语义主题。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词语的完整词或词内片段上，常见于形态复杂词、专名或数字表达；并非固定词项
patterns.domain: 西班牙语散文、问答、学术文本、IRC

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于葡萄牙语词语的词内片段，出现在议会文本、代码编辑记录和论文引用说明中
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会、代码/编辑记录、学术书目

patterns.name: 跨语言词内分词片段
patterns.trigger: «pa»、«qu»、«test» 等词内或词边界附近片段
patterns.context: 激活可覆盖单个常见子词，未见稳定的词义或句法条件；可能与多语种文本中的子词切分有关
patterns.domain: 多语种文本及混合代码

patterns.name: 句点与换行附近的局部格式
patterns.context: 部分激活出现在句末标点或换行后的编辑记录附近，但仅是零星位置，未形成可靠触发条件
patterns.domain: 网页文本、代码编辑记录

patterns.name: 未解释的字母序列与标注
patterns.context: 现有上下文无法从语义或格式上确定共同触发条件，可能只是一般子词激活

en.description: Strong activations mostly fall inside Spanish or Portuguese words, often concentrated at the beginning of a word or on a subword fragment. Examples involve courses, turning slang, parentheses, code, installation packages, philosophical terms, number words, choices, legal terminology, and steps. The words and contexts vary greatly.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Spanish “curso”
patterns.context: Appears in “como tener un curso de SEO gratis”, where the word is split into cur-so; this is the only explicit activation of this word fragment.

patterns.name: pirula in a Spanish phrase
patterns.context: Quotes the Spanish expression “hacer una pirula” and discusses whether it is used to describe an illegal U-turn; activation falls on the beginning and subsequent subword fragments of pirula.

patterns.name: Portuguese parenteses word beginning
patterns.context: An editing note says “Removido o parenteses de ViewBag”, meaning parentheses were removed from ViewBag; activation is concentrated at the beginning of the Portuguese word parenteses for parentheses.
patterns.domain: Portuguese editing note in programming Q&A

patterns.name: Stressed syllable in Portuguese código
patterns.context: An explanation of HTTP status codes contains “código de status 422”; activation is at the stressed beginning of código, with weaker later fragments.

patterns.name: Beginning of Spanish paquete
patterns.context: An IRC conversation instructs users to install “paquete testdisk”; activation falls on the beginning and subsequent fragments of paquete.

patterns.name: Spanish escolástico stem
patterns.context: A philosophical discussion says Brentano was not a scholastic philosopher in the strict sense; activation occurs on consecutive intra-word fragments of escolástico.

patterns.name: Spanish number word siete
patterns.context: Discusses a word consisting of seven characters; activation is concentrated on siete.

patterns.name: Beginning of Portuguese escolha
patterns.context: Mentions a fact chosen by Descartes; the word form is “escolhido”, with only the col fragment strongly activated.

patterns.name: Portuguese intra-word fragment in matéria
patterns.context: “em matéria de concorrência” appears in a European competition law context; activation falls on the beginning and stressed part of matéria.

patterns.name: Portuguese pass(o) ending
patterns.context: “dígito verificador (aquele do passo 1)” appears in an explanation of a check-digit algorithm; activation falls on the beginning and ending fragments of passo.

5_2969.description: 强激活大多落在西班牙语或葡萄牙语单词内部，常集中于词首或某个子词片段；涉及课程、转弯俚语、括号、代码、安装包、哲学术语、数字词、选择、法律用语及步骤。各例词义和语境差异很大。

patterns.name: 西班牙语“curso”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“como tener un curso de SEO gratis”中，词被切分成 cur-so；只有这一处明确激活该词片段。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语网页内容、SEO 教程

patterns.name: 西班牙语短语中的 pirula
patterns.context: 引述西班牙语表达“hacer una pirula”，讨论其是否用于形容非法掉头；激活落在 pirula 的词首及后续子词片段。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 parenteses 词首
patterns.context: 编辑说明“Removido o parenteses de ViewBag”，即从 ViewBag 移除括号；激活集中于葡萄牙语括号词 parenteses 的开头。
patterns.domain: 编程问答中的葡萄牙语编辑说明

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 código 的重音音节
patterns.context: HTTP 状态码的说明中出现“código de status 422”；激活在 código 的重音开头，后续片段较弱。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 paquete 的词首
patterns.context: IRC 对话中指示安装“paquete testdisk”；激活落在 paquete 的词首和后续片段。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 escolástico 词干
patterns.context: 哲学论述称 Brentano 并非严格意义上的经院哲学家；激活位于 escolástico 的连续词内片段。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 siete 数字词
patterns.context: 讨论一个由七个字符构成的词，激活集中于 siete。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 escolha 词首
patterns.context: 谈及笛卡尔所选择的事实，词形为“escolhido”；只有 col 片段显著激活。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 matéria 词内片段
patterns.context: 欧盟竞争法语境中出现“em matéria de concorrência”；激活位于 matéria 的开头及重音部分。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会／法律政策文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 pass(o) 词尾
patterns.context: 解释校验数字算法时出现“dígito verificador (aquele do passo 1)”；激活落在 passo 的词首和词尾片段。

en.concept: Iberian subword fragments and technical text
en.description: Activates on in-word subword fragments in Spanish and Portuguese text, especially technical Q&A, but also political commentary, philosophy, and lists; also appears on code brackets, separators, and IRC installation instructions. No stable single semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: In-word Spanish fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Spanish text, words are split into multiple subwords; highlights cover various parts of speech rather than fixed semantic words
patterns.domain: Spanish parliamentary text, web articles, philosophical bibliographies, and radio listings

patterns.name: In-word Portuguese fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese technical Q&A or general discussion, words are split into subwords, with activations scattered across various words

patterns.name: Code separators and brackets
patterns.context: Near the end of a code snippet or a line break, followed by Portuguese editing notes; trigger positions may relate to punctuation, brackets, or line boundaries

patterns.name: Spanish conversational instructions and software names
patterns.context: IRC conversation about a live CD, with instructions to install the TestDisk package

5_2969.concept: 伊比利亚语词片段与技术文本
5_2969.description: 激活分布在西班牙语和葡萄牙语文本中的词内子词片段，尤其见技术问答，也见政论、哲学和列表；另有代码括号、分隔符及 IRC 安装指令。未见稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.trigger: «Ac» «uer» «cum» «pl» « sit» «ios» «art» «ículo»等；高亮多落在词中部或词首的子词片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语连续文本中，词被切分为多个子词；高亮覆盖多种词类，并非固定语义词
patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会文本、网络文章、哲学书目与广播列表

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语技术问答或一般论述中，单词被子词切分，激活散布于多种词语
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 代码分隔符与括号
patterns.trigger: «]).»、«++;»、«↵»、«(»相关的文本上下文；另有“Removido o parênteses”
patterns.context: 代码片段结束或换行附近，紧接着出现葡萄牙语编辑说明；触发位置可能与标点、括号或行边界有关
patterns.domain: StackExchange 的代码与编辑说明

patterns.name: 西班牙语口语指令及软件名
patterns.context: IRC 对话中讨论 live CD，并指示安装 TestDisk 软件包

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and local collocations
en.description: Activations are distributed across intra-word fragments in Spanish and Portuguese text and a few code markers; several strong activations have local semantic themes, but there is no unified semantic or syntactic condition across the corpus.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation fragments in Spanish
patterns.context: In continuous Spanish text, activation often falls on part of a word or adjacent word fragments; no stable single part of speech or syntactic position is apparent
patterns.domain: Spanish parliamentary texts, encyclopedias, forums, and general web text

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation fragments in Portuguese
patterns.context: In Portuguese technical discussions or code explanations, activation falls on segmented word fragments; it also occurs near punctuation such as semicolons and commas

patterns.name: Code markers and line breaks
patterns.context: Code or template fragments are mixed with surrounding natural language; activations include increment operators, colons, and line-break markers
patterns.domain: StackExchange program code and template text

patterns.name: Spanish month-related expression
patterns.context: Asks how to calculate how many weeks a particular month has; activation highlights mes and nearby month-limiting expressions

patterns.name: Spanish cumplimiento phrase
patterns.context: In the context of EU agreements and regulations, concerns promoting compliance with or enforcement of regulations

patterns.name: Portuguese pará­grafo/package word fragment
patterns.context: Recommends installing the testdisk package in a live CD environment

patterns.name: Portuguese parênteses word fragment
patterns.context: An ASP.NET ViewBag editing note mentions removing parentheses

patterns.name: Spanish mont(ón) and link-related advice
patterns.context: Recommends finding many related sites through a website and contacting their maintainers or dealing with broken links
patterns.domain: Website promotion or SEO advice text

patterns.name: San place names and radio station listings
patterns.context: Repeatedly lists place names beginning with San and radio station call signs and frequencies
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia-style directory entries, including Spanish place names

patterns.name: Spanish phrase in song titles
patterns.context: A track list pairs song titles with English translations and durations

patterns.name: Spanish social-dimension word fragment
patterns.context: Discusses the social dimension of an agreement and its importance

patterns.name: mes word form outside the month theme
patterns.context: The word occurs in a question about determining the number of weeks in a month; it cannot be confirmed as the same semantic trigger as incidental intra-word segmentation in other fragments

patterns.name: Spanish philosophical terms and bibliographic text
patterns.context: A bibliography or academic discussion mentions scholastic philosophy and an author's intellectual characteristics

patterns.name: Unclustered sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across different word classes and semantic positions, with no shared condition confirmed by the examples

5_2969.concept: 多语词片段与局部搭配
5_2969.description: 激活分散于西班牙语和葡萄牙语文本的词内片段及少数代码标记；若干强激活有局部语义主题，但跨语料缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内切分片段
patterns.trigger: 多处西班牙语词被拆分标记，如«Com»1«o»2« hacer»3、«dest»1«aque»2、«mes»9« en»3« espec»5«ific»4
patterns.context: 西班牙语连续文本中，激活常落在词的一部分或相邻词片段上；未见稳定的单一词性或句法位置
patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会文本、百科、论坛和一般网页文字

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语技术讨论或代码说明中，激活落在被切分的词片段上；也见分号、逗号等标点附近
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 IRC 技术对话

patterns.name: 代码标记及换行
patterns.context: 代码或模板片段与周围自然语言混排；激活包括递增运算符、冒号和换行标记
patterns.domain: StackExchange 程序代码与模板文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语月份相关表达
patterns.context: 询问如何计算某个特定月份有多少周；激活突出 mes 及其附近的月份限定表达

patterns.name: 西班牙语 cumplimiento 短语
patterns.context: 欧盟协议与法规语境中，涉及促进遵守或执行法规
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会正式政策文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 pará­grafo/套件词片段
patterns.context: 建议在 live CD 环境中安装 testdisk 软件包

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 parênteses 词片段
patterns.context: ASP.NET ViewBag 编辑说明中提到移除括号

patterns.name: 西班牙语 mont(ón) 与链接相关建议
patterns.context: 建议从一个网站寻找大量相关站点，并联系其维护者或处理失效链接
patterns.domain: 网站推广或 SEO 建议文本

patterns.name: San 地名及电台列表
patterns.context: 重复列出以 San 开头的地名及广播电台呼号、频率
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科式目录条目，夹有西班牙地名

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的西班牙语短语
patterns.context: 歌曲名称与英文译名、时长并列的曲目清单
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科音乐列表

patterns.name: 西班牙语社会维度词片段
patterns.context: 讨论协议的社会维度及其重要性

patterns.name: 西班牙语月份之外的 mes 词形
patterns.context: 该词出现在如何确定一个月周数的问题中；与其他片段中偶然出现的词内切分无法确认是同一语义触发

patterns.name: 西班牙语哲学术语与书目文字
patterns.context: 书目或学术论述提及经院哲学及作者思想特征

patterns.name: 无法归并的零散词片段
patterns.trigger: « interés»5、« res»5«alt»5，以及多种分散的西班牙语、葡萄牙语片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于不同词类和语义位置，缺少可由样本确认的共同条件

en.concept: Code-related word forms in technical text
en.description: Responds strongly mainly to “código” in Portuguese technical Q&A, including HTTP status codes, code modification, validation, scripts, and image-processing code; also responds weakly to “cumplimiento” in Spanish place-name/radio directories and policy texts.

patterns.name: “código” in Portuguese code contexts
patterns.context: “código” appears in Portuguese technical Q&A and may mean code, verification code, or error code; usually near code explanations, debugging, or instructions.

patterns.name: Spanish place names and radio call-sign lists
patterns.context: Multiple place names listed line by line, followed by call signs and FM frequencies.

patterns.name: Compliance terms in formal Spanish policy texts
patterns.context: Formal statements in the context of EU agreements, social issues, and regulations.

5_2969.concept: 技术文本中的代码相关词形
5_2969.description: 主要对葡语技术问答中的“código”强烈响应，涵盖HTTP状态码、代码修改、验证、脚本及图像处理代码等语境；另对西语地名—电台目录和政策文本中的“cumplimiento”有较弱响应。

patterns.name: 葡语代码中的“código”
patterns.context: 葡语技术问答中出现“código”，可指代码、验证码或错误代码；通常处于代码解释、调试或操作说明附近。

patterns.name: 西语地名与广播呼号列表
patterns.trigger: «San»、«And»、«Vic»等地名片段，以及相邻的电台呼号和频率
patterns.context: 多个地名逐行列举，后接呼号、FM频率。

patterns.name: 西语正式政策文本中的履约词
patterns.context: 欧盟协议、社会层面及法规语境中的正式陈述。

en.concept: Local features of text segmentation and code syntax
en.description: Primarily responds to Portuguese word fragments and segmentation boundaries, and also to declaration syntax in program code; further examples include accented characters, Web annotations, and LiveCD installation chat, without a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Portuguese intra-word fragments and word boundaries
patterns.context: Fragments occur in continuous Portuguese text, often in segmented words; no fixed single word or meaning has been found

patterns.name: Program code syntax markers
patterns.context: In code, activations occur near class, method, and type declarations, falling on keywords, punctuation, and indentation

patterns.name: Software request mapping annotation
patterns.context: An annotation before a method declaration in Java-style Web interface code

patterns.name: LiveCD installation instructions in conversation
patterns.context: Spanish IRC conversation discusses installing software from a LiveCD and includes chat message formatting

patterns.name: Accented characters and intra-word segmentation
patterns.context: Intra-word positions in Portuguese words with accents; overlaps with the general Portuguese fragment pattern but may also be sensitive to accented characters or segmentation boundaries

5_2969.concept: 文本分词与代码语法局部特征
5_2969.description: 主要响应葡语文本中的词片段和分词边界，也响应程序代码的声明语法；另见重音字符、Web注解及LiveCD安装聊天，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 葡语词内片段与词边界
patterns.trigger: 反复激活的葡语词片段，如 «ex»、«verific»、«des»、«mat»；有时命中词首、词中或词尾
patterns.context: 片段出现在葡语连续文本中，常见于被分词切开的词；并未发现固定的单一词或固定语义

patterns.name: 程序代码语法标记
patterns.context: 代码段中类、方法及类型声明附近，激活落在关键词、标点及缩进位置

patterns.name: 软件请求映射注解
patterns.context: Java 风格 Web 接口代码中，方法声明之前的注解

patterns.name: LiveCD 安装指令对话
patterns.trigger: « inf»、« inst»、«pa»；周围出现 «live»«cd»、«installe el paquete»
patterns.context: 西语 IRC 对话中讨论从 LiveCD 安装软件，且有聊天发言格式

patterns.name: 重音字符及词内分词
patterns.context: 葡语含重音词的词内位置；与一般葡语片段模式重叠，但可能对重音字符或分词边界另有敏感性

en.description: Activations often fall on code type names, generics, and declaration keywords, and also on in-word fragments in Portuguese/Spanish and policy texts; there are also isolated contexts involving HTTP, SMTP, editing notes, and C++ virtual functions, with no unified trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: Code type names and declarations
patterns.context: Activations often fall on type names or generic parameters in code; examples include Java/C# declarations, as well as the Spanish “par” fragment in a CSV context, so the trigger is not limited to code.
patterns.domain: Mostly StackExchange code Q&A, plus Spanish text

patterns.name: HTTP error status code context
patterns.context: In Portuguese discussions of AJAX requests and HTTP responses, the activation falls on the word “código”.

patterns.name: In-word Spanish fragments
patterns.context: Multiple activation fragments occur within Spanish words or near word boundaries, involving content, code, sorting, and results; some occur in programming problem descriptions.

patterns.name: Java declarations and generic code
patterns.context: Activations occur in code blocks containing class member declarations, access modifiers, and generic type definitions; the exact positions of the fragments vary.

patterns.name: Spanish in SMTP configuration errors
patterns.context: After an SMTP connection failure message, the activation falls within “probablemente” (probably) in a Spanish explanation of possible causes.

patterns.name: Bracket-related code descriptions in editing notes
patterns.context: A Portuguese edit log mentions removing brackets near ViewBag.Ferias.Count; the activation is concentrated within “parênteses” (brackets).

patterns.name: In-word fragments in EU policy texts
patterns.context: In formal Spanish policy discussion, activations occur within “importancia” (importance) and “cumplimiento” (compliance, fulfillment).

patterns.name: C++ virtual function declarations
patterns.context: In a pure virtual function declaration in an abstract base class, the activation falls on the virtual keyword; the same passage also includes modifiers such as public, const, and noexcept.

5_2969.description: 激活多落在代码类型名、泛型及声明关键字，也出现在葡萄牙语/西班牙语词内片段和政策文本中；另有 HTTP、SMTP、编辑说明与 C++ 虚函数等孤立语境，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码类型名与声明
patterns.context: 激活常落在代码中的类型名或泛型参数；可见于 Java/C# 等声明，也有 CSV 语境中的西班牙语“par”片段，触发并非只限于代码。
patterns.domain: 以 StackExchange 代码问答为主，另有西班牙语文本

patterns.name: HTTP 错误状态码语境
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中讨论 AJAX 请求及 HTTP 响应时，激活落在“代码”一词。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 多个激活片段位于西班牙语词内部或词界附近，涉及内容、代码、排序和结果；其中部分处于编程问题描述中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 西班牙语编程问答

patterns.name: Java 声明与泛型代码
patterns.context: 类成员声明、访问修饰符和泛型类型定义的代码块中出现激活；不同片段具体落点不一。

patterns.name: SMTP 配置错误中的西班牙语

patterns.context: Comments for methods describe the return type or return value, immediately adjacent to a PHP function definition.

5_2969.concept: 代码中的方法声明与结构
5_2969.description: 主要响应多语言源码中方法/函数声明及其结构：void、修饰符、方法名与参数、括号和代码块；并覆盖 Objective-C 声明、注释、类型名、测试及 PHP 类型提示等局部模式。

patterns.name: 方法声明中的 void 返回类型
patterns.context: 出现在 C 系语言的函数或方法声明中，通常紧跟 public、private 等修饰符或 Objective-C 方法签名之后；常与方法名、参数列表相邻。

patterns.name: 方法或函数签名及参数列表
patterns.trigger: 方法名后接括号参数，如 «RemoveSFTAt(»、«engineGenerateParameters()»、«Parse(»、«StopSession(»、«OnPointerEnter(»、«loadExpiredUserModelByUser(»、«init:(»
patterns.context: 代码中的方法定义或声明附近，激活散布在访问修饰符、返回类型、方法名和参数类型/变量等签名元素上。
patterns.domain: 面向对象及过程式代码

patterns.name: Objective-C 声明与实现语法
patterns.context: Objective-C 类、协议或方法声明/实现周围；也可见于接口继承、属性声明及内存管理代码。

patterns.name: C# 访问修饰符与成员声明
patterns.context: 类或接口内部的成员、方法声明处，通常后接返回类型及成员名。

patterns.name: 文档注释与方法注解
patterns.context: 紧邻方法声明的 XML 风格或块注释、以及 Java 覆写注解；激活也覆盖注释中的标签和换行。

patterns.name: NS 类型与集合接口标识符
patterns.context: Objective-C 接口、属性或类型声明中，尤其 Cocoa 类名附近。

patterns.name: 局部代码标识符与结构体/类型名
patterns.context: 不同语言的类型名、参数类型或返回类型位置；未见这些标识符之间有共同语义。

patterns.name: 代码块与语句分隔符
patterns.context: 方法、接口或类定义中的换行、块边界和语句结束处；作为代码结构标记出现。

patterns.name: PHP 命名空间类型提示
patterns.context: PHP 函数返回类型及参数类型提示处，位于 private function 声明附近。

patterns.name: 释放与析构代码
patterns.context: Objective-C 手动内存管理的析构方法中；属于方法实现及资源释放语句。

patterns.name: 测试方法声明
patterns.context: 测试类中，在 setUp/tearDown 类生命周期代码之后定义测试方法。

patterns.name: 返回值文档标签
patterns.context: 方法注释中说明返回类型或返回值，紧邻 PHP 函数定义。

en.description: Mainly sensitive to function parentheses, declaration modifiers, documentation tags, and indentation; also includes localized patterns for property declarations, external symbols, test lifecycle methods, and PHP field assignments. Overall, it is oriented toward structured source code and API documentation.

patterns.name: Closing function-call parentheses
patterns.context: A closing empty-argument pair of parentheses appears after a function name or parameter list, or marks the end of a parameter list; mostly at code declarations or call sites.
patterns.domain: Source code and API documentation in various programming languages

patterns.name: Property declarations and modifiers
patterns.context: Declares a property in an Objective-C class or interface, often followed by a type and property name.

patterns.name: Tags and type descriptions in documentation comments
patterns.context: Tags in documentation comments mark return values, parameters, or links, often alongside a type or API name.

patterns.name: Access control and function declarations
patterns.context: Visibility modifiers appear in class member function declarations, often followed by a function name, parameter list, or return type.
patterns.domain: PHP, C#, Java, and other code

patterns.name: Code indentation whitespace
patterns.context: Indentation whitespace at the start of code blocks or comment lines is marked; common in formatted source code.

patterns.name: C/C++ external symbol declarations
patterns.context: Numerical computing code declares external functions or symbols, often with types, pointer parameters, and underscore suffixes.
patterns.domain: C/C++ numerical computing / Fortran interoperability code

patterns.name: Objective-C test lifecycle methods
patterns.context: Test classes contain setup/teardown lifecycle methods and superclass calls.

patterns.name: Object-oriented field assignments and stringification methods
patterns.context: A PHP class method assigns an instance field, followed by a string-conversion method declaration.

5_2969.description: 主要对代码中函数括号、声明修饰符、文档标签及缩进格式敏感；另有属性声明、外部符号、测试生命周期方法和 PHP 字段赋值等局部模式。整体偏向结构化源代码及 API 文档。

patterns.name: 函数调用括号闭合
patterns.context: 函数名或参数列表后出现闭合的空参数括号，或参数列表的结束括号；多为代码声明或调用处。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 属性声明及修饰符
patterns.context: Objective-C 类或接口中声明属性，常紧跟类型和属性名。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的标签与类型说明
patterns.context: 文档注释内用标签标注返回值、参数或链接，常伴随类型或 API 名称。
patterns.domain: 代码注释 / API 文档

patterns.name: 访问控制及函数声明
patterns.context: 类成员函数声明中出现可见性修饰符，常接函数名、参数列表或返回类型。

patterns.name: 代码缩进空白
patterns.context: 代码块或注释行起始处的缩进空白被标记；常见于格式化源代码。

patterns.name: C/C++ 外部符号声明
patterns.context: 数值计算代码中声明外部函数或符号，且常有类型、指针参数及下划线后缀。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 数值计算 / Fortran 互操作代码

patterns.name: Objective-C 测试生命周期方法
patterns.context: 测试类中出现 setup/teardown 生命周期方法及父类调用。

patterns.name: 面向对象字段赋值与字符串化方法
patterns.context: PHP 类方法中给实例字段赋值，随后声明字符串转换方法。

en.concept: Declaration boundaries and formatting in code
en.description: Activation primarily falls on indentation, line breaks, and declaration boundaries in multiline source code; covers comment tags, method signatures, types/fields, extern, and specialized declarations across multiple languages and domains, making it difficult to reduce to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Indentation and line breaks before declarations or definitions
patterns.context: In multiline source files, usually between comments, declarations, or struct contents; activation falls on indentation spaces and line breaks, often adjacent to declaration boundaries.
patterns.domain: Github source code in multiple languages

patterns.name: Return tags in documentation comments
patterns.context: Describes return values in Javadoc-style comments, near the end of the comment and the following method declaration.

patterns.name: Annotations and method declarations
patterns.context: Annotations or access modifiers occur at method declarations, often following documentation comments; trigger terms do not appear together in every segment.

patterns.name: Interface and class structure declarations
patterns.context: Near type declarations or struct definitions, followed by type names, members, or braces.
patterns.domain: Objective-C, C/C++, and other source code

patterns.name: extern external declarations
patterns.context: File-scope declarations of functions, variables, or symbols related to struct members, followed by a type name or identifier.
patterns.domain: C/C++ header files and source code

patterns.name: Type names and type qualifiers
patterns.context: A type or type-name fragment in a declaration, often in a member variable, function signature, or field list.

patterns.name: Field or variable declarations
patterns.context: A variable name follows a type, often ending with a semicolon; includes struct fields and file-level array declarations.

patterns.name: Method signatures and parameter lists
patterns.context: A method name and parentheses appear near a declaration or implementation; a signature may be followed by braces.

patterns.name: Package declarations and exception documentation
patterns.context: Java package declarations and exception-type descriptions or links in class documentation comments.

patterns.name: Protocol/implementation declarations
patterns.context: An Objective-C interface declaration includes a superclass and protocol, followed by braces and member declarations.

patterns.name: Function prototypes and filesystem symbols
patterns.context: A C extern function prototype has parameters including a struct pointer and integer type, adjacent to a filesystem-symbol comment.

patterns.name: Encoder/decoder array declarations
patterns.context: A comment labels an encoder or decoder byte array, followed by an extern array declaration.

patterns.name: Permission checks and lifecycle methods
patterns.context: An Android method implementation checks recording permissions, followed by the onPause lifecycle method.

patterns.name: Audio equalizer structure and GStreamer symbols
patterns.context: A C struct and external symbol declarations involve a multiband IIR equalizer.

patterns.name: EFI controller fields
patterns.context: Struct fields list controller identifiers, enabled state, and addresses, followed by EFI-related symbol declarations.

5_2969.description: 激活主要落在多行源代码的缩进、换行及声明边界；覆盖注释标签、方法签名、类型/字段、extern 与多种语言和领域的专有声明，难以归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 声明或定义前的缩进与换行
patterns.trigger: 行首缩进后、代码声明附近的空格，如 [1] 的 «    »、[2] 的 «    »、[4] 的 «    »；以及声明周边的 «↵»
patterns.context: 代码处于多行源文件中，通常在注释、声明或结构体内容之间；激活落在缩进空格和换行上，常与声明边界相邻。

patterns.name: 注释文档中的返回标签
patterns.context: Javadoc 风格注释里描述返回值，邻近注释结束和后续方法声明。

patterns.name: 注解与方法声明
patterns.context: 注解或访问修饰符位于方法声明处，常接在文档注释之后；触发词并不在每段都同时出现。

patterns.name: 接口与类结构声明
patterns.context: 类型声明或结构体定义附近，后续出现类型名、成员或花括号。

patterns.name: extern 外部声明
patterns.context: 文件作用域声明函数、变量或结构体成员相关符号，后接类型名或标识符。

patterns.name: 类型名与类型限定符
patterns.context: 声明中的类型或类型名片段，常处于成员变量、函数签名或字段列表中。

patterns.name: 字段或变量声明
patterns.context: 类型之后出现变量名，常以分号结束；包括结构体字段和文件级数组声明。

patterns.name: 方法签名与参数列表
patterns.context: 方法名及括号出现在声明或实现附近，签名后可能接花括号。

patterns.name: 包声明与异常文档
patterns.context: Java 包声明及类文档注释中出现异常类型说明或链接。

patterns.name: 协议/实现声明
patterns.context: Objective-C 接口声明带父类及协议，随后进入花括号和成员声明。

patterns.name: 函数原型与文件系统符号
patterns.context: C 语言 extern 函数原型，参数包含结构体指针和整数类型，并邻接文件系统符号注释。
patterns.domain: BSD 文件系统内核代码

patterns.name: 编码器/解码器数组声明
patterns.context: 注释标示编码器或解码器字节数组，随后以 extern 声明数组。
patterns.domain: C 语言纠错编码代码

patterns.name: 权限检查与生命周期方法
patterns.context: Android 方法实现中检查录音权限，随后进入 onPause 生命周期方法。

patterns.name: 音频均衡器结构及 GStreamer 符号
patterns.context: C 结构体及外部符号声明涉及 IIR 多段均衡器。

patterns.name: EFI 控制器字段
patterns.context: 结构体字段列出控制器标识、启用状态及地址，随后声明 EFI 相关符号。

en.concept: Source-code declarations and API documentation structure
en.description: Activation is primarily concentrated in function, method, property, or variable declarations in multilingual source code and their structural punctuation; it also often appears in documentation comments preceding declarations, especially @return descriptions. Specific identifiers and comment topics are sporadic, with another pattern involving extern function declarations in compiler diagnostics.

patterns.name: Types and signatures in function/method declarations
patterns.context: Occurs at function, method, or property declarations, with activation concentrated on declaration keywords, types, names, and signature structures such as parentheses; appears across languages and declaration types.

patterns.name: Return descriptions in documentation comments
patterns.context: A return-value tag or description appears in API documentation comments, near the comment terminator and the following declaration; not every comment segment explicitly contains @return.

patterns.name: Braces/semicolons and code boundaries after declarations
patterns.context: Appears at comment or declaration boundaries, function-body openings, property accessors, or array declarations; may reflect structural punctuation and adjacent code.

patterns.name: Specific type/parameter identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers appear in type, parameter, or function-name positions; their name semantics are sporadic, with no shared domain meaning confirmed by the samples.
patterns.domain: Java/XML, C#, PHP, C/C++, and systems code

patterns.name: C/C++ external declarations and compiler diagnostics
patterns.context: A compiler diagnostic cites a source declaration, with activation on extern, the function declaration, and type/parenthesis structures; this segment is in a StackExchange Q&A context.

patterns.name: Natural language and multilingual text in comments
patterns.context: English or Portuguese descriptions in source-code comments, adjacent to code declarations; activation does not consistently fall on the natural-language words themselves and may be a background pattern.

5_2969.description: 激活主要聚集于多语言源码的函数、方法、属性或变量声明及其结构标点，也常见于声明前的文档注释，尤其是@return说明；具体标识符和注释主题分散，另有编译诊断中的extern函数声明。

patterns.name: 函数/方法声明中的类型与签名
patterns.trigger: `public Point getLocation();`、`engineGenerateParameters()`、`ParameterType Type { get; }`、`private function loadUserByUsername(string $username): ...`、`static inline int handle_ipv4(`、`extern int diagonal(int[][]);`
patterns.context: 处于函数、方法或属性的声明处，激活集中在声明关键字、类型、名称及括号等签名结构；不同语言和声明种类均有出现。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的返回说明
patterns.trigger: `@return`，以及 `@return the new AlgorithmParameters object`、`@return a list of data types`
patterns.context: API 文档注释内出现返回值标签或返回值描述，邻近注释结束符和后续声明；并非所有注释段都明确有 @return。
patterns.domain: 源码文档注释/Javadoc 风格

patterns.name: 声明后的大括号/分号与代码边界
patterns.context: 出现在注释或声明的边界、函数体开端、属性访问器或数组声明附近，可能反映结构标点及其邻接代码。

patterns.name: 特定类型/参数标识符
patterns.context: 标识符位于类型、参数或函数名位置；名称语义分散，没有可由样本确认的共同领域含义。

patterns.name: C/C++ 外部声明和编译诊断
patterns.context: 编译器诊断引用源码声明，激活落在 extern、函数声明及类型/括号结构上；此段是 StackExchange 问答语境。

patterns.name: 注释中的自然语言与多语种文本
patterns.trigger: `The returned`、`Generates the parameters.`、`O valor da propriedade`、`Encoder parity bytes`、`group block number for a file system block.`
patterns.context: 源码注释中的英文或葡萄牙语说明，邻接代码声明；激活并未稳定落在这些自然语言词本身，可能是背景模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to Objective-C @property declarations, especially the property-modifier parentheses, type, and variable name; also covers method return-value documentation after some code comments, and extern function declarations in numerical code. The patterns are not fully uniform.

patterns.name: Objective-C property declarations
patterns.context: Properties declared in Objective-C interfaces or header files, often with modifiers such as nonatomic, readonly, assign, retain, or strong; activation falls mainly on @property, parentheses, and nearby code

patterns.name: Objective-C property Q&A examples
patterns.context: StackExchange answers explain how to expose or store data through properties, often in an interface, class-name, or public property context

patterns.name: Property recommendations in interfaces
patterns.context: Discussion of whether to declare a property in a public interface; the example is a ViewController's Cards property

patterns.name: Java methods and return documentation
patterns.context: Java documentation comments describe return values, immediately followed by a method or override-method definition; does not include Objective-C property declarations

patterns.name: C/Fortran-style external function declarations
patterns.context: Numerical code declares an external function with numerical or complex-type parameters; no evident shared local structure with property declarations

5_2969.description: 主要响应 Objective-C 的 @property 声明，尤其属性修饰符括号与类型、变量名；也覆盖部分代码注释后的方法返回文档，以及数值代码中的 extern 函数声明，模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: Objective-C 属性声明
patterns.trigger: «@»«property» 后接括号中的属性修饰符及类型、变量名，如 «@property (nonatomic, readonly) D...»
patterns.context: Objective-C 接口或头文件中声明属性，常见修饰符包括 nonatomic、readonly、assign、retain、strong；激活主要落在 @property、括号及其附近代码上

patterns.name: Objective-C 属性问答示例
patterns.trigger: «@»«property»，以及示例属性声明，如 «@property (nonatomic, assign) float x, y, z;» 和 «@property (nonatomic, strong) UIImage *thumbnailImage;»
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答中解释如何通过属性暴露或存储数据，常伴随 interface、类名或 public property 等语境

patterns.name: 接口中的属性建议
patterns.context: 讨论是否在 public interface 中声明属性；例子是 ViewController 的 Cards 属性

patterns.name: Java 方法及返回文档
patterns.context: Java 文档注释说明返回值，紧接方法或覆写方法定义；不包含 Objective-C 属性声明

patterns.name: C/Fortran 风格外部函数声明
patterns.context: 数值计算代码中声明外部函数，参数为数值或复数类型；与属性声明无明显共同局部结构

en.description: Mainly responds to declarative structures in code: C/C++ external symbol declarations, Objective-C property declarations, and C# HTTP GET routes/handlers; also responds to PHP test classes and @var comments. The patterns span different languages but all appear as declarations or comments.

patterns.name: External symbol declarations
patterns.context: Declares functions or variables with external linkage in C/C++ headers or source code, often with types, pointers, arrays, or assembly symbol names
patterns.domain: Systems programming, encoder/filesystem code, Fortran numerical libraries, and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Objective-C property declarations
patterns.context: Declares properties in Objective-C classes or protocols, followed by a type and property name

patterns.name: HTTP GET routes and handlers
patterns.context: C# Web API uses attributes to mark GET endpoints and declare handler methods

patterns.name: PHP test classes and documentation comments
patterns.context: PHPUnit test class declarations and PHPDoc type comments for their members

5_2969.description: 主要响应代码中的声明性结构：C/C++ 外部符号声明、Objective-C 属性声明、C# HTTP GET 路由/处理器；另对 PHP 测试类及 @var 注释有响应。模式分属不同语言，但都以声明或注释形式出现。

patterns.name: 外部符号声明
patterns.trigger: «extern»；«extern» 后接类型、返回类型或变量声明
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件或源代码中声明外部链接的函数、变量，常伴随类型、指针、数组或汇编符号名
patterns.domain: 系统编程、编码器/文件系统代码、Fortran 数值库及 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: Objective-C 属性声明
patterns.trigger: «@»«property»，常与 «(» 属性修饰符 «)» 连用
patterns.context: Objective-C 类或协议中声明属性，后接类型和属性名
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Cocoa/Objective-C 代码

patterns.name: HTTP GET 路由与处理器
patterns.trigger: «[»«Http»«Get»，以及 «[»«Route»；附近有 GET 路径、控制器方法
patterns.context: C# Web API 中用特性标注 GET 端点并声明处理方法
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 ASP.NET 问答代码

patterns.name: PHP 测试类及文档注释
patterns.context: PHPUnit 测试类声明及其成员的 PHPDoc 类型注释
patterns.domain: Github 上的 PHP 测试代码

en.description: Activation is distributed across code contexts, especially declaration boundaries and preceding documentation, routing, or comments; it involves multiple languages and structures, with no single semantic theme evident.

patterns.name: C# Web API routes and HTTP attributes
patterns.context: In C# controller or API code, HTTP method/route attributes are followed by public class or method declarations; also includes comments such as `// GET api/...`

patterns.name: Go test structs and query-parameter types
patterns.context: Test code constructs an anonymous struct containing options and expected query parameters

patterns.name: Specific identifiers in Objective-C property declarations
patterns.context: A property declaration with nonatomic and readonly modifiers follows a documentation comment; the same long identifier is shown split into tokens
patterns.domain: Generated code or interface declarations in Objective-C on Github

patterns.name: Private static big-integer array method declaration
patterns.context: A method declaration follows comments about p, q, seed, and counter in array indexing
patterns.domain: Java or similar syntax code involving big-integer generation on Github

patterns.name: Return descriptions in documentation comments and public member declarations
patterns.context: Javadoc-style comments describe a return value or related handler, immediately followed by a public method or interface-member declaration
patterns.domain: Java API/interface documentation and declarations on Github

patterns.name: Public type declaration after a conditional-compilation symbol list
patterns.context: After a platform or target-framework symbol list, `public global::Windows.Foundation...` follows

patterns.name: Inline function that resizes after freeing memory
patterns.context: A C/C++-style function checks a data pointer, frees and clears it, then begins an inline Boolean resizeData declaration

5_2969.concept: 代码声明及其前导结构
5_2969.description: 激活分散于代码上下文：尤见声明边界及其前导文档、路由或注释；涉及多种语言与结构，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: C# Web API 路由与 HTTP 属性
patterns.context: C# 控制器或 API 代码中，HTTP 方法/路由属性后接 public 类或方法声明；也包括注释中的 `// GET api/...`
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 ASP.NET/C# 问答代码

patterns.name: Go 测试结构体与查询参数类型
patterns.context: 测试代码构造包含 options 和 expected query 参数的匿名结构体
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 测试代码

patterns.name: Objective-C 属性声明中的特定标识符
patterns.context: 文档注释后出现带 nonatomic、readonly 修饰符的属性声明；同一长标识符被分词呈现
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Objective-C 生成代码或接口声明

patterns.name: 私有静态大整数数组方法声明
patterns.context: 说明数组索引中 p、q、seed、counter 的注释之后出现方法声明
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Java 或类似语法代码，涉及大整数生成

patterns.context: 更新式短文本提及交易及不确定性，并出现“a little more risky”。
patterns.domain: 网络文本；金融或风险措辞

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and punctuation, Russian subwords, English phrase fragments, proper names containing Kart, statistical terminology, and legal citation formatting; no single semantic theme or domain explains all examples, suggesting a mixture of tokenization morphology and local formatting cues.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur around digit strings, numbers, or numbers adjacent to punctuation; sometimes a numeric fragment itself is split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Math text, legal citations, and other mixed text

patterns.name: Russian Cyrillic fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur when Russian words are tokenized into Cyrillic letters or letter fragments.

patterns.name: English abbreviations and common word fragments
patterns.context: In English phrases, activations fall on quotation marks, word beginnings, or internal subword fragments; the two passages differ semantically.

patterns.name: Karting / Kartli tokenization in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names contain the letter sequence Kart, which is split into subword tokens; the contexts are track names and personal or geographic names, respectively.

patterns.name: Technical terminology and statistical method fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur when statistical methods or model terminology appear in scientific abstracts; unmarked ordinary words provide a comparison.

patterns.name: Formatted fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Activations occur around volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, page numbers, and line-break formatting in court case citations.

5_2976.concept: 分词片段与格式线索
5_2976.description: 激活分布于数字与标点、俄语子词、英文短语片段、含 Kart 的专名、统计术语及法律引文格式；没有单一语义或领域能解释全部样本，可能混合了分词形态与局部格式线索。

patterns.name: 数字及数字边界
patterns.context: 数字串、编号或数字与标点相邻时激活；有时数字片段本身被拆分成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、法律引文及其他混合文本

patterns.name: 俄语西里尔字母片段
patterns.context: 俄语单词内部被分词为西里尔字母或字母片段时激活。

patterns.name: 英文缩写及常见词片段
patterns.trigger: «“»、«We»、«'re»、« come»、« away»、« the»；«H»、«urry»、« and»、« sign»、« as»
patterns.context: 英文短语中，激活落在引号、词首或词内子词片段上；两段语义内容不同。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Karting / Kartli 分词
patterns.context: 专名中含有 Kart 字母序列，且该序列被拆成子词 token；上下文分别是赛道名称和人名地名。

patterns.name: 技术术语与统计方法片段
patterns.context: 科学摘要中出现统计方法或模型术语时激活；未标记的普通词提供对照。
patterns.domain: PubMed 计算机网络/统计摘要

patterns.name: 法律引文中的格式化片段
patterns.context: 法院判例引文的卷号、报告集缩写、页码和换行格式附近激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across Russian character fragments, mathematical abbreviations, English titles and contractions, medical vocabulary, proper nouns, legal citation numbers, and line-break punctuation; no unified semantic or stable orthographic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Russian Cyrillic strings
patterns.context: Activations cluster on Cyrillic fragments in Russian text, within words; the fragment is followed by “защит”.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation wrt
patterns.context: The abbreviation “wrt” appears in a mathematical expression, followed by the variable “w” and a question mark; numbers and formula symbols appear nearby.

patterns.name: English contraction We're
patterns.context: The contraction “We're” opens an English quotation, followed by “happy to come away with the point”.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Testicular seminoma
patterns.context: “Testicular seminoma” appears in a medical title; activation spans character fragments split within and across words, followed by case-duration information.

patterns.name: Test and medical-term fragments
patterns.context: A research description begins with “Test”, then discusses the relationship between hypovolemia and a factor.

patterns.name: Proper noun Mersey
patterns.context: The proper noun “HMS Mersey” appears in an encyclopedia entry; activation falls on the “Mer” fragment in the ship's name.

patterns.name: Title word Behind
patterns.context: In the English title “Behind The Design”, activation clusters on a within-word fragment of “Behind”.

patterns.name: Words related to samples and isolation
patterns.context: In an experimental methods context, fresh samples are mentioned for isolating organoids or mammary stem cells; activation falls on “isolation”.

patterns.name: Numbers and line breaks in legal citations
patterns.context: In federal case citation formats, number strings, reporter abbreviations, and page numbers after a line break occur adjacent to one another.

patterns.name: Place name Park and punctuation
patterns.context: The place name “Victoria Forest Park” recurs in an encyclopedia entry title and body; the title is followed by a line break and numbering.

5_2976.concept: none
5_2976.description: 激活分散在俄语字符片段、数学缩写、英语标题与缩约、医学词汇、专名、法律引证数字及换行标点等；未见统一语义或稳定词形模式。

patterns.name: 俄语西里尔字母串
patterns.context: 激活集中在俄语文本中的西里尔字母片段，处于单词内部；片段后接“защит”。

patterns.name: 数学记号 wrt
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现缩写“wrt”，后接变量“w”和标点问号；周围有数字与公式符号。

patterns.name: 英语缩约形式 We're
patterns.context: 英文引语开头的缩约形式“We're”，后接“happy to come away with the point”。

patterns.name: Testicular seminoma 词内片段
patterns.context: 医学标题中的“Testicular seminoma”，激活覆盖跨词内切分的字符片段；后接病例年限信息。

patterns.name: Test 与医学术语片段
patterns.context: 研究描述中以“Test”开头，随后讨论低血容量（hypovolemia）与某因素的关系。

patterns.name: 专名 Mersey
patterns.context: 百科条目中的专名“HMS Mersey”，激活落在舰名中的“Mer”片段。

patterns.name: Behind 标题词
patterns.context: 英文标题“Behind The Design”中，激活集中在词“Behind”的词内片段。
